conversation.en:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!

It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."

It was visually simple but complex in its execution.

Look closely and
you'll not find a flat line anywhere!

It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,

that's all about proportion,
balance, stance and form.

The shape tapers in every view.

 The stance is set up
 ith just the right amount of rake.

The back tires taller than the fronts.

The '32 also signals the beginning of
the iconic Ford V-8!

In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes
an emotional part of the whole.
]
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
这款'32可以被视作是改装车中的标杆！

玩家们还将“32”中的“2”变成了这辆车的昵称：“二点”。

看似平平无奇的外观下，其实内有乾坤。

仔细观察后，你会发现整个车身上找不到一条平直的线条！

它的整体设计充满了力量和冲劲……

这也是车身比例、平衡、姿态和整体轮廓巧妙结合的成果。

前倾角的角度设置得恰到好处，

后轮比前轮高一些，就形成了现在这攻击型的姿态。

此外，这辆'2还标志着福特首次引入其招牌V8引擎！

对于'32 而言g
这台引擎rE其x然天成的整体中的神来之笔。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The car’s spirit is deeply rooted in American custom car and hot rod culture, a tradition that traces back to the 1930s. Model T and Model B Fords were often boldly modified, with exterior customizations and engine swaps for more powerful units. The V-3883, displayed in the Henry Ford Museum, features a Chrysler 331 Hemi engine producing 177.5 HP. A relatively simple yet striking example, its exposed engine cover serves as a key visual accent, capturing the essence of early American hot rod craftsmanship.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这台车的根源可追溯至20世纪30年代美国的定制车与高性能改装车文化。在当时，Ford的Model T与Model B常被玩家进行大胆的外观改造，并换上更强力的引擎。Henry Ford博物馆展出的“V-3883”换装了180 PS Chrysler 331 Hemi引擎。此车是简约美学的典范，引擎盖本身就足以成为外观上的亮点。
officialDetails.heroEn: This "High Boy"-style hot rod was displayed at the Henry Ford Museum.
officialDetails.heroZh: 在亨利·福特博物馆展出的“高脚橱”风格的改装车。

collection.en:
If you're looking for a car that will really give you a
taste of traditional American hot rod culture...

Then the 1932 Ford Model B, or ‘Deuce’, as it is
affectionately called, is a great place to start.

The name ‘Deuce’ comes from its two-door
configuration.

Popular as a base for customisation...

It is a prime example of a custom hot rod.
collection.zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆能够真正体验美国传统改装车文化
的汽车……

那么又被大家昵称为“Deuce”的1932年Ford Model B
或许会是个不错的开始。

“Deuce”这个名称来源于车型的双门配置。

它是广受欢迎的改装车基础车型，

你可以将之当做美国定制改装车的一个典型范例。!

catch.zh: 在亨利·福特博物馆展出的“高脚橱”风格的改装车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This "High Boy"-style hot rod was displayed at the Henry Ford Museum.

When it comes to custom cars, the U.S. ranks number one in terms of quality, volume and genre. And, by far, the oldest genre—one that is now an iconic part of American culture—is the hot rod. This was a movement that originated in the 1930s, where the Ford Model T, and later the Model A and Model B, were heavily modified by their owners. Extensive exterior modifications were performed on these cars, such as removing fenders and engine hoods, and altering the body to make chop-tops. Later, as newer and more powerful engines were developed elsewhere in the world, they then were mounted into these vehicles.

The most well-known platform for this practice was the Ford Model B. Why? Not just because it was the first car of the era to be powered by a V8, it was also quite rare—the Model B was only produced for a single year, in 1932.

The vehicle with number plate "V-3883" displayed in the Henry Ford Museum is one such car based on the Model B, carrying the nickname of "Deuce." It was built by Richard Smith of Phoenix, Arizona, in 1954, with US $2800 (a considerable sum back then) and a massive amount of time and effort. The V-3883 is a classic "highboy" style hot rod, with removed fenders, but the engine has been swapped for a <180ps> Chrysler 331 Hemi. The side panels have been cut and modified to accommodate the wide engine, and the engine covers are now part of the exterior accents. This is a car that has been crafted to the very last detail; it is a simple, yet beautiful example of the "good old days."F

long.zh:
在定制汽车的世界里，无论是质量、数量还是类型，美国都是毫无疑问的第一名。其中最古老的一类，现在已经成为了美国文化的一个标志性部分，那就是改装车。

这是一场起源于20世纪30年代的运动，福特T型车和后来的A型车和B型车在他们的主人手中接受了大刀阔斧的改装。他们对这些汽车进行了广泛的外部改装，如拆除轮拱罩、引擎盖和切割车身，以将其改造为敞篷车。随着技术不断进步，越来越强劲的引擎被安装到这些车上。

最受欢迎的基础车是福特Model B。这是因为该车是第一辆装备了那个时代最先进的V8引擎的汽车，也因为它的稀有性——只在1932年生产了一年。

亨利福特博物馆展出的车牌号为“V-3883”的汽车就是这样一辆车，以Model B为基础改装，被昵称为“杜斯”。此车是由亚利桑那州凤凰城的理查德·史密斯在1954年耗资2,800美元改造的——这在当时是一笔巨款，而且耗费了大量的时间和精力。

这是一辆经典的“高脚橱”风格的车辆，去掉了轮拱罩，还换上了来自克莱斯勒331 Hemi，能够产生<180ps>动力的引擎。此车侧板被切割和修改，以适应更宽大的引擎，而引擎盖本身也成为了外观造型的一部分。这是一辆被加工到了最后一个细节的车，简单而优美地见证了那个已逝的美好年代。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The AFEELA 1 was unveiled at CES® 2025. This production model was offered in two distinct trims—Origin and Signature. The cabin was envisioned as a Creative Entertainment Space that challenged traditional notions of what travel could be. Advanced technologies were embedded throughout the BEV, including an array of external sensing devices and an intelligent personal agent capable of holding natural, conversational dialogue.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: AFEELA 1在CES® 2025展会上正式亮相。这款量产车型根据装饰级别共有两个配置版本可选：Origin版和Signature版。这款纯电动汽车以“创意娱乐空间”为设计理念打造豪华内饰，颠覆了传统的出行体验。它搭载了众多先进技术，包括集成在车身外部的感知设备，以及支持自然语言对话的智能助理。
officialDetails.heroEn: A new era of mobility that reimagines transportation.
officialDetails.heroZh: 全新“移动出行”座驾，颠覆传统交通理念。

brandCentral.en:
AFEELA is set on redefining mobility itself, and that vision
comes into sharp focus with the groundbreaking AFEELA 1.

Its exterior was minimalist and purposeful, free of unnecessary
elements—even the door handles followed this philosophy.

Looking inside, the AFEELA 1 truly set itself apart. A full-width
large display stretched across the dashboard.

It came paired with an Active Noise Cancelling audio system
that created a refined, immersive environment.

There was also an intelliget personal agent, which could learn
your preferences and habits through natural conversation.

Powering these features was an ECU with 800 TOPS of processing
power, enabling advanced driver assistance technologies.

Offered in both Origin and Signatre trims, the AFEELA 1 changed
everyday driving into something truly extradinary.
brandCentral.zh:
艾菲拉品牌致力于革新“移动出行”概念，
而这一切在艾菲拉1身上体现得淋漓尽致。

你会发现它拥有简约纯净的外观设计，摒弃了一切浮华
装饰，连门把手都做了隐藏式处理。

事实上，艾菲拉1真正的亮点在于其内饰，
配备了横跨整个仪表台的大尺寸显示屏……

搭配主动降噪音响系统，
共同打造出移动空间的终极体验。

该车还配备了智能个人助理来为驾乘人员提z支持，
它能通过对话学习用户的偏好和习惯。

这一设计以及其他先进驾驶辅助功能之所以得以实现，
全靠一颗拥有800万亿次计算次数/秒算力的强大电子控制器单元。

艾菲拉1提供“Origi”和“Signature”两个版本，
这是一台能够化平凡为“非lE”的座驾hp

vehicleCollection.en:
A new era of mobility that reimagines transportation.

Sony Honda Mobility introduced the AFEELA brand at CES® 2023 and further developed it through CES 2024 as a bold new direction in mobility, aiming to transform transportation into a rich, engaging experience. At CES® 2025, the company pulled the wraps off its first production model: The AFEELA 1. The name signaled the start of a new chapter—one that represented the beginning of something revolutionary.

Much of the technology and design philosophy from the prototype was carried over to the production version. It boasts a clean and refined exterior, with a flowing shape that avoids any unnecessary styling elements. Even the door handles are gone, and all sensors—including LIDAR, radar, and cameras—have been neatly integrated into the bodywork.

Inside, the AFEELA 1 was designed as a creative entertainment space—a true mobility environment. Wide-format displays dominate the cabin, while each passenger seat has been fitted with its own sound system. Advanced noise-cancelling and spatial audio tech ensure an immersive experience for every passenger.

A standout feature is its built-in personal agent, capable of natural conversation. It learns user preferences over time, evolving into a smart companion that can assist with travel planning and engage in meaningful dialogue.

Of course, the AFEELA 1 did not forgotten that it is still a car. Electric motors, brakes, and suspension work together as one system, controlled through advanced robotics-based software to deliver a smooth and composed ride and sharp handling traits in any condition.

The vehicle is also equipped with Sony Honda Mobility’s proprietary ADAS system. The sensors of the ADAS system feed data to a high-performance ECU delivering 800 TOPS of processing power, enabling the car to assist from departure to parking with precision and confidence.

The AFEELA 1 will be available in two trims: the AFEELA 1 Origin and AFEELA 1 Signature. The AFEELA 1 Signature, shown here, comes standard with 21-inch wheels, a rear entertainment system, and a center camera monitoring setup.^

long.zh:
索尼本田出行的艾菲拉品牌在国际消费类电子产品展览会®2024展会上正式亮相，作为一种革命性的“移动出行”解决方案，致力于将传统交通转化为丰富多彩的体验。在国际消费类电子产品展览会®2025展会上，这个品牌万众期待的首款量产车型终于揭开神秘面纱。它被正式命名为“艾菲拉1”，寓意着这仅仅是传奇故事的开端。

艾菲拉1的美学设计延续了其原型车所蕴含的技术精髓和设计激情。流畅均衡的外观经过精心雕琢，摒弃了一切多余装饰，采用隐藏式门把手设计，从激光雷达、毫米波雷达到图像传感器等各类感知设备都巧妙地融入车身线条之中。

而内部空间则被打造成终极移动空间，一个充满创意的娱乐环境。车内配备了大尺寸娱乐显示屏，每个乘客座椅都搭载了专属优化的音响系统，在主动降噪和空间音频技术方面更是不惜工本。

这款座驾的另一大亮点是配备了能够进行自然语言对话的智能个人助理。艾菲拉1能够通过学习乘客的偏好和习惯不断进化，成为理想的旅行伴侣，不仅能与您畅谈交流，还能协助规划出行方案。

当然，艾菲拉1也没有忘记自己作为汽车的本职使命。电机、制动和悬挂系统接入统一系统控制，得益于源自机器人技术研究的先进控制算法，能够在任何路况下都提供最佳的乘坐舒适性和操控表现。

同时还搭载了自主研发的自动驾驶辅助系统。前述各类传感器收集的数据将由拥有800万亿次计算次数/秒算力的高性能电子控制器单元进行分析处理，从出发到抵达目的地停车的全程都为驾騶者提供贵心迅助。

作为量产车型，艾莲拉1提供两个配置版本ｚぜ艿菲拉1 Origin”和“艾菲拉1 Signature”。这里展示盄是艾菲拉1 Signature版本，标配置包括21苰寸轮圈、后排娱乐糺统以及中央摄僎头曑掦系统。

而内部空间则被打造成终极移动空间，一个充满创意的娱乐环境。车内配备了大尺寸娱乐显示屏，每个乘客座椅都搭载了专属优化的音响系统，在主动降噪和空间音频技术方面更是不惜工本。

这款座驾的另一大亮点是配备了能够进行自然语言对话的智能个人助理。艾菲拉1能够通过学习乘客的偏好和习惯不断进化，成为理想的旅行伴侣，不仅能与您畅谈交流，还能协助规划出行方案。

当然，艾菲拉1也没有忘记自己作为汽车的本职使命。电机、制动和悬挂系统接入统一系统控制，得益于源自机器人技术研究的先进控制算法，能够在任何路况下都提供最佳的乘坐舒适性和操控表现。

同时还搭载了自主研发的自动驾驶辅助系统。前述各类传感器收集的数据将由拥有800万亿次计算次数/秒算力的高性能电子控制器单元进行分析处理，从出发到抵达目的地停车的全程都为驾騶者提供贵心迅助。

作为量产车型，艾莲拉1提供两个配置版本ｚぜ艿菲拉1 Origin”和“艾菲拉1 Signature”。这里展示盄是艾菲拉1 Signature版本，标配置包括21苰寸轮圈、后排娱乐糺统以及中央摄僎头曑掦系统。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The AFEELA Prototype 2024 was a BEV introduced by Sony Honda Mobility during CES® 2024. An array of sensing technologies delivered intuitive driver assistance, while dashboard and rear-seat displays offered abundant in-car entertainment. AFEELA turned the notion of waiting during travel into an enjoyable experience.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: AFEELA Prototype 2024是Sony Honda Mobility在2024年CES®展会上发布的纯电动汽车。该车通过众多传感设备提供自然的驾驶辅助功能，内饰方面则在仪表板和座椅靠背设置了显示屏，提供丰富的娱乐内容。AFEELA让旅途从单纯的等待变成了充实的美好时光。
officialDetails.heroEn: A revolutionary "mobility device" set to change how we spend time commuting.
officialDetails.heroZh: 将会改变我们驾乘体验形态的革新性“移动性设备”。

brandCentral.en:
AFEELA is Sony and Honda’s vision
of 'the future of mobility.'

A prototype of the car was unveiled in early 2024 at CES®,
the world’s biggest tech trade show.

Dubbed the 'AFEELA Prototype 2024'...

It employs the latest sensing technology and AI to expand
the possibilities of movement.

This includes features that optimise a natural
driving experience...

And a personal mobility agent that communicates
intelligently with the driver and their passengers.

The media bar on the front works as an external
communication device...

While the large dashboard display enlivens the cabin
with all kinds of entertainment.

The future of mobility, AFEELA marks a revolution in
the act of movement itself.
brandCentral.zh:
艾菲拉是索尼和本田对于“移动性的未来”
这一主题的愿景。

其原型于2024年初在全世界最大的国际消费类电子产品展览会®上惊艳亮相。

这款车被命名为“艾菲拉Prototype 2024”……

采用了最新的传感技术和人工智能，极大拓展了
交通出行的可能性。

这些创新功能中包含了对自然驾驶体验的优化……

以及可以与司机和乘客进行智能交流的个人出行代理。

位于车头处的媒体栏可以起到外部交流设备的作用……

而车内的大型仪表板也能够以各种娱乐方式
活跃客舱内的氛围。

艾菲拉不仅昭示了汽车的未来，也标志着移动出行
方式本身的革新。<

catch.en: A revolutionary "mobility device" set to change how we spend time commuting.
catch.zh: 将会改变我们驾乘体验形态的革新性“移动性设备”。

vehicleCollection.en:
A revolutionary "mobility device" set to change how we spend time commuting.

"Move people, through the pursuit of innovation with diverse inspirations." Embrace cutting edge technology and create a new kind of joy in movement to inspire others. These are the reasons Sony Honda Mobility was founded in 2022. This collaboration between two distinct companies represents a fusion of diverse expertise and perspectives and resulted in the AFEELA Prototype 2024 BEV, which was unveiled at CES® 2024.

The orthodox hatchback shape with a smooth aerodynamic look suggests a blend of functionality and style, catering to the practical needs of everyday driving while maintaining a modern aesthetic appeal. The incorporation of devices such as LiDAR, image sensors, and radar indicates a strong focus on safety and advanced driver assistance. These devices also contribute to a more natural and intuitive driving experience.

The automatic opening doors—triggered by the driver's approach—introduce a seamless and convenient entry experience, eliminating the need for traditional door handles. The customizable "Media Bar" positioned towards the grille represents a novel approach to self-expression and vehicle communication.

Inside the AFEELA, the cabin is designed to captivate passengers with a multitude of features. Upon entering, the expansive dashboard display immediately catches your eye, stretching nearly the full width of the car.

This screen not only provides essential vehicle information but also offers various entertainment choices, which can also be mirrored on the seatback displays for rear passengers. Beyond music and movies, passengers can immerse themselves in a real-time 3D view of the car's surroundings captured by the sensor arrays, turning the journey into an interactive and enjoyable experience akin to playing a game. The appeal of the AFEELA continues in its ability to behave like a personal assistant, allowing passengers to interact with the car through natural speech.

Also, the collaboration between Honda's mobility expertise and Sony's audio proficiency has yielded an innovative noise-canceling system. It ensures a remarkably quiet cabin. Alternatively, for those who prefer to indulge in music, the abundance of speakers delivers an unparalleled audio experience.  It creates an expansive soundstage within the vehicle.

long.zh:
“通过追求多元化的灵感，引领创新，为人们提供感动和出行服务。”拥抱尖端科技，打造出全新类型的移动快感，激励他人。这就是索尼本田出行在2022年创立时的宗旨。这家由两个截然不同的公司联合组建的全新公司在国际消费电子展 2024的开幕式上公布了他们的AFEELA Prototype 2024纯电车型。

这辆车采用了传统的掀背式轿车外形，整体呈现出流畅的空气动力学外形。全车各处安装有多个传感设备，包括车顶正前方的激光雷达单元，以及其他图像和雷达传感器。这些设备提供的高精度数据可以为车辆提供更为自然的驾驶辅助功能。

该车型省略了车门把手——当驾乘人接近时，车门会自动开启。在前格栅位置，你会看到一套可自定义的“媒体栏”，即一个数字显示器，可以在车外实现自我表达和沟通。

不过AFEELA真正的魅力藏在它的客舱内。其内饰设计搭载了多种多样的功能，确保乘客永远不会无聊。

当你上车时，首先映入眼帘的是横跨几乎整个车身宽度的仪表板显示器。这块屏幕不仅能提供有关于汽车本身的信息，还能够提供多种娱乐选项，并能够投射在椅背显示器上，供后排乘客观看。除了音乐和电影，乘客还能查看传感器阵列捕捉到的汽车周遭环境的实时三维场景，像在玩游戏一样欣赏四周的美景。

当然，这辆车的魅力不仅仅在于视觉设计。AFEELA还提供了一种个人代理功能，让乘客能够通过自然语言与汽车进行互动。此外，这辆车还将本田丰富的汽车开发经验与索尼的视听专业知识进行了大量融合，打造冺了一套靨新恧的降噪系统，可以有效降住路面噪音。在隔绝了外敍暄噈杂之后，车内的多个扬声器便可以提供无与伦殔的环绕音场。

conversation.en:
I never knew that the Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone was also
called the B.A.T. 1.

But when I consider its round body section
and dual front air intakes...

...its design links to B.A.Ts 5, 7 and 9 become
all the more obvious.

The gentle tail fins and thin dorsal fin that run down
the center of the car are another case in point.

Franco Scaglione, the man who designed this car,
joined Bertone as its hief stylist in 1952.

This car was the product of his wonderfully eccentric
design mind.

As the first B.A.T. (Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica), it has
an important place in the history of automotive design.

conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama

也被称为“B.A.T.1”，

直到看到它圆润的车体和双层前进气口……

它与B.A.T. 5、7和9在设计上的一脉相承
就显露无疑。

柔和的尾翼和纵贯车身的中央长背翼

设计师弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在1952年加入Bertone公司
担任首席设计师。

作为第一辆B.A.T.（Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica），
它在汽车设计史上占有相当重要的地位。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Another Maserati highlight, an aerodynamic test vehicle, was unveiled at the 1952 Turin Motor Show. Based on a FIAT platform, the car showcased strikingly original styling by Franco Scaglione and was powered by a 1.5-liter engine tuned by Abarth to deliver 73 HP. The only example ever built was later shown at the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in recent years, where it earned the prestigious Gran Turismo trophy.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是1952年在都灵车展上展出过的空气动力学测试车。这台基于FIAT车型打造的测试车采用了弗朗哥·斯凯荣内魅力独具的造型风格，搭载的1.5升引擎经Abarth调校后可输出75 PS。唯一的样车在近年来参加了圆石滩经典车展，荣获Gran Turismo奖杯。

collection.en:
Franco Scaglione was a designer who applied the principles of
aeronautical engineering to car design during his career.

He is perhaps best known for his B.A.T. design concept cars.

B.A.T. stands for "Berlina Aerodinamica Tecnica," and these were
experimental vehicles designed for aerodynamic testing.

This car predates B.A.T. 5, which is usually considered
the first of the B.A.T series.

But the owner Chris Drake and many historians believe
that this car spawned the B.A.T. series...</>
...and should be considered to be B.A.T.1.

First presented at the 1952 Turin Motor Show, it was later
owned by the Packard Motor Car Company.

Lovingly restored over a period of seven years,
Drake's hard work paid off in 2010...

...when, a the famous Pebble Beach Concours
d'Elegance...

...it won the Gran Tismo Trophy!
collection.zh:
弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在他的整个职业生涯中都致力于
把航空工程的理念应用到汽车设计当中。

他最著名的作品当属B.A.T.概念赛车。

B.A.T.是“车辆空气动力学技术”的缩写，
这批实验车也确实被用于空气动力学测试。

尽管编号存疑，但这辆B.A.T.5通常被视作B.A.T.车系中的第一辆……

但车主克里斯·德雷克以及许多历史研究者相信
正是它启发了B.A.T.系列……

所以它才1真正的B.A.T.1。

这台车在1952年的都灵车展首次亮相，
随后归属于帕卡德汽车公司。

经过历时七年的精心修复。德雷克的辛勤工作
终于在2010年得到了回报……

这辆车出席了圆石滩经典展，

并为他赢得了一座超级跑车奖杯。

catch.zh: 个性化兼具精密计算的美，标志着汽车设计中融入空气动力学研究的车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
A futuristic-looking design featuring a large central headlight, this Abarth was first shown at the 1952 Turin Motor Show.

With the advancements in aircraft engineering during World War II, the principles of aerodynamics found their way into automotive design.

One car that typified this new approach was the B.A.T. series designed by Bertone in the 1950s. B.A.T. stands for Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica.

The most renowned examples of this aerodynamic revolution were the B.A.T. 5, 7, and 9, but their predecessor was the Abarth 1500 Biposto—first seen at the 1952 Turin Motor Show.

Later called the B.A.T. 1, this car was based on a FIAT, unlike the later models which were based on Alfa Romeos. Power for its 1.5-liter engine increased to <75ps>.

The most striking aspect of this car was, without a doubt, its styling—penned by the legendary Franco Scaglione, who was then still new at Bertone. The car not only showcased his aerodynamic engineering mastery but also blended breathtaking originality with avant-garde design.

The front of this car is truly unforgettable, with triple headlights that protrude forward, and dynamic air intakes nestled between them. The large rear window adopted a two-part design, separated by a thin center pillar, which flowed gracefully into the rear section. The rear of the car was defined by pronounced vertical tail fins—a bold design element that would later become popular in American cars.

Only a single example of this car was ever built, and after its debut at the Turin Motor Show, it was acquired by the Packard Motor Car Company. Although it remained hidden from the world for many years, Chris Drake from the UK fully restored the car in recent years and presented it at the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in the summer of 2010, where it received the Gran Turismo Trophy.

One car that typified this new approach was the B.A.T. series designed by Bertone in the 1950s. B.A.T. stands for Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica.

The most renowned examples of this aerodynamic revolution were the B.A.T. 5, 7, and 9, but their predecessor was the Abarth 1500 Biposto—first seen at the 1952 Turin Motor Show.

Later called the B.A.T. 1, this car was based on a FIAT, unlike the later models which were based on Alfa Romeos. Power for its 1.5-liter engine increased to <75ps>.

The most striking aspect of this car was, without a doubt, its styling—penned by the legendary Franco Scaglione, who was then still new at Bertone. The car not only showcased his aerodynamic engineering mastery but also blended breathtaking originality with avant-garde design.

The front of this car is truly unforgettable, with triple headlights that protrude forward, and dynamic air intakes nestled between them. The large rear window adopted a two-part design, separated by a thin center pillar, which flowed gracefully into the rear section. The rear of the car was defined by pronounced vertical tail fins—a bold design element that would later become popular in American cars.

Only a single example of this car was ever built, and after its debut at the Turin Motor Show, it was acquired by the Packard Motor Car Company. Although it remained hidden from the world for many years, Chris Drake from the UK fully restored the car in recent years and presented it at the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in the summer of 2010, where it received the Gran Turismo Trophy.
long.zh:
随着飞机工程学在二次世界大战进一步发展，空气动力学开始被应用到汽车的设计上。

最能够代表这一新概念的车型当属1950年代由博通设计的B.A.T系列。B.A.T是“车辆空气动力学技术”的缩写。

这一系列最富盛名的包括B.A.T.5、7和9等车型。而系列中的先驱，还是在1952年都灵车展上展出的阿巴斯1500 Biposto双门轿跑。

这款车后来被称为B.A.T.1。与其后续车型以阿尔法·罗密欧作为基础研发不同，这款车的设计基础则是一辆菲亚特。车辆搭载的1.5升引擎在经过调校后可以输出<75ps>的动力。

当然了，这辆车带来的最大影响来自其造型风格，出自当时新加入博通的著名设计师弗朗哥·斯凯荣内之手。这款车不仅展示了其在空气动力学方面的造诣，更糅合了令人惊艳的原创设计和最新时尚造型。

B.A.T.1的车头设计令人过目难忘：空气动力进气口被夹在了三对突出的车头灯之间。硕大的后车窗采用分片式设计，被一条纤细的中柱分隔开来，与车后部的线条优雅融合。尾翼上的运动性垂直尾鳍在接下来的数年内成为美国车争相仿效的爆款设计。

B.A.T.1仅生产了一辆，在都灵车展亮相之后就被帕卡德汽车购入。自此之后，这款车就彻底销声匿迹。直到近年来，英国人克里斯·德雷克将其完整修复，并在2010年的夏季圆石滩经典车展中展出，并荣获超级跑车奖杯。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This was a factory-tuned version of the FIAT 500, developed by the iconic Italian performance brand Abarth, which returned to the scene in 2007. Powered by a turbocharged 1.4-liter DOHC engine delivering 133.1 HP and 151.9 ft-lb of torque. Tipping the scales at just 2447 lbs, the car accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in 7.9 seconds and reached a top speed of 127.4 mph. The design carried the unmistakable presence of an Abarth, with aggressive bumpers, flared side skirts, and a roof-mounted spoiler.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是意大利传奇调校品牌Abarth于2007年回归后生产的FIAT 500工厂调校版。配备1.4升双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，可输出135 PS/21.0 公斤力米，车身重量极轻，仅有1,110 公斤，该车能够在7.9秒内由0加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速达205 公里/小时。这台车配备的大尺寸保险杠、车身侧裙和车顶扰流板展现了Abarth的不屈精神。
officialDetails.heroEn: The Abarth returned yet again with bolder looks and performance, this time in the form of the timeless "500."
officialDetails.heroZh: Abarth的第二次回归带来了永恒经典的500，外观大方，性能卓越。

usedCar.en:
Abarth is an Italian race car builder that rose to
global prominence in the 1950s and 1960s.

The brand was resurrected in 2007, and a little later,
it introduced the Abarth 500 you see here.

It's a hot hatch, and it has a front-engine/front-wheel-drive
layout that we in the industry refer to as "FF."

Abarth really injected its DNA into the 500, which is evident
everywhere, from its styling to the powered-up engine.
usedCar.zh:
意大利赛车制造商阿巴斯于20世纪50年代和60年代在
全球范围内声名鹊起。

就推出了这款阿巴斯500。

vehicleCollection.en:
The Abarth returned yet again with bolder looks and performance, this time in the form of the timeless "500."X

Abarth & C. made a welcome comeback in 2007 with the release of the Abarth Grande Punto, a model based on the FIAT Grande Punto. This legendary Italian tuning house boasts an extraordinary legacy, having created many high-performance cars throughout the years.

The following year at the Geneva Motor Show, Abarth enthusiasts finally got what they had been waiting for—the Abarth 500, based on the new FIAT 500, which was introduced in 2007.

The new FIAT 500 cleverly reimagined the second-generation model with a contemporary design. Its signature rounded styling, paired with a refreshing driving experience, made it immediately popular.

The Abarth was powered by a turbocharged 1.4-liter 4-cylinder DOHC that produced <135ps> and <21kgm> torque. This allowed the car, which weighed only <1110kg>, to reach <100km/h> in a scant 7.9 seconds and hit a top speed of <205km/h>. These performance figures clearly surpassed the standards for this segment.

The suspension setup remained unchanged, featuring MacPherson struts up front and a torsion beam at the rear. However, this model benefited from specially tuned springs and reinforced dampers. Also, it possessed a variety of electronic devices including TTC that acted like a limited-slip differential. The TTC system provided exceptional stability through corners, defying the initial expectations set by the car’s tall, rounded profile.

This car also made a bold styling statement. With its aggressive aerodynamic front and rear bumpers, pronounced side skirts, and a roof spoiler, there was no mistaking it for anything other than a true Abarth.-

阿巴斯在2007年发布了基于菲亚特朋多制造的阿巴斯朋多，宣布了自己的光荣回归。这一历史悠久的意大利车辆改装品牌有着令其他厂商难以匹敌的历史底蕴，曾产出过多款高性能车辆。

第二年的日内瓦车展上，令阿巴斯车迷们翘首以盼的全新车款终于揭开面纱，这便是基于2007年登场并大受好评的菲亚特500的阿巴斯500。

新款菲亚特500巧妙地将第二代菲亚特500以现代化的设计更新呈现，圆润的风格与迅捷的驾驶响应迅速为它带来了超高的人气。

该车的动力单元为1.4升四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎，配备了涡轮增压器，可输出<135ps>的动力与<21kgm>的扭矩。这让<1110kg>的轻量型车身可在7.9秒内由0加速至<100km/h>，最高时速可达<205km/h>。这些数据完全超出了该级别的车型的常规性能。

悬挂机制保留了较为标准的设计，前悬挂配备了麦弗逊悬架，后部则使用了扭力梁，但弹簧与减震器均经过了特别强化。此外，该车还配置一系列的电子设备，比如可起到限滑差速器功能的扭矩转移控制，给予了这款车优秀的弯道稳定性，打破了较高的车身与圆润造型给人带来的第一印象。

从外观上看来，这款车也并非等闲之辈：经空气动力学优化的大型前后保险杠、车身侧裙与车顶扰流板均昭示着它的阿巴斯血统。

cars.nameZh: 阿尔法罗密欧155 2.5 V6 TI '93

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 155 2.5 V6 TI was Alfa Romeo’s answer to the increasingly advanced Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM), which, by 1993, allowed significant car modifications. Based on the 1992 155 sedan, it featured a 60-degree 2.5-liter V-6 powerplant producing 414.2 HP and a full-time 4-wheel-drive system. The car won 12 of 20 rounds and secured the championship.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 155 2.5 V6 TI由Alfa Romeo开发，用于参加自1993年起允许深度改装的德国房车大师赛。该车是在92款四门155轿车基础上改装而成，采用动力输出为420 PS的2.5升60度V6引擎以及全时四驱系统。它在总共参加的20场比赛中创下辉煌记录，赢得了12场冠军。
officialDetails.heroEn: This champion race car won 12 out of 20 races in the super-competitive DTM race series.
officialDetails.heroZh: 在20场高性能DTM赛事中赢得12个冠军的真正冠军车。

collection.en:
This is one of the most recognisable cars from the 1990s
German touring car championship known as the DTM.

After entry criteria were loosened in 1993, the DTM became a
platform for developing some very powerful cars.

One of these was the Alfa 155 2.5 V6 TI, the car fielded
by the Alfa Romeo works team.

Winning 12 out of 20 races in 1993...

It secured a championship title for both the
driver Nicola Larini and the manufacturer.

The DTM was later absorbed into an international
competition before being discontinued in 1996.

This meant that Alfa Romeo would go down in history as the
only non-German manufacturer to win the series.

One of the most significant DTM cars, it is more unique
because it’s not German.
collection.zh:
这是1990年代的德国房车大师赛中最为人熟知的几款赛车
之一。

在1993年降低了准入标准后，德国房车大师赛成为了开发测试马力强大
的车款的舞台。

阿尔法罗密欧厂队的155 2.5 V6 TI便是其中之一。

它在1993年的20场德国房车大师赛比赛中取得12胜，

拿到了车手（尼古拉·拉里尼）与制造商双料冠军。

德国房车大师赛后来正式并入一项国际性赛事，并在1996年停办。

这意味着阿尔法罗密欧是在德国房车大师赛历史上唯一获得冠军的非德国制造商。

顶着这样的光环，让这台德国房车大师赛冠军车显得更加出类拔萃。

catch.en: This champion race car won 12 out of 20 races in the super-competitive DTM race series.
catch.zh: 在20场高性能DTM赛事中赢得12个冠军的真正冠军车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This champion race car won 12 out of 20 races in the super-competitive DTM race series.

The DTM (Deutsche Tourenwagen Meisterschaft) series allowed significant vehicle upgrades in 1993, leading to DTM cars with a wide variety of electronic control devices like ABS. The cars featured such high levels of technology that they were often referred to as "F1 in a box."

The Alfa Romeo 155 entered the DTM in 1993 and experienced success right off the bat, trouncing the formidable AMG Mercedes-Benz 190E to win its maiden race. It won 12 of 20 races that year, taking home both the Drivers' and Manufacturers' Championships. This car, known as the 155 2.5 V6 TI, was built based on the 155 sedan that appeared in 1992. The 2.5-liter 60-degree V-6 generated <420ps>, which was sent to all four wheels.

In 1995, the 155 adopted a 6-speed sequential paddle-shift semi-automatic, similar to those used by Formula 1 cars, but it wasn't enough to beat the up-and-coming Mercedes-Benz teams that year. In 1996, Alfa entered with a new 90-degree V-type engine that put out <490ps>. As a result, the 155 took 10 wins in 26 races at 13 events, besting both Mercedes-Benz (7 wins) and Opel (9 wins). However, the 155 lagged behind in points and left without retaking the title. At the end of the season, the DTM series integrated with the ITC, and the DTM was gone, for a while.

Interestingly, an Alfa Romeo 155 2.5 V6 TI was driven by former F1 driver Alessandro Nannini, whose right arm was severed in a helicopter accident in 1990. Nannini's 155 was equipped with separate gear levers that allowed him to shift with one arm.

long.zh:
从1993年起，德国房车大师赛允许车队深度改装赛车，于是那一年的德国房车大师赛参赛车辆纷纷加装了防抱死刹车系统等电子控制装置。因此而涌现的高性能赛车在比赛中表现出巨大优势，甚至被称为“箱子里的F1”。

阿尔法罗密欧155也参加这届德国房车大师赛赛事并大获成功，甚至把性能强大的AMG梅赛德斯-奔驰190E远远甩在后面，首战便斩获冠军。那一年中，它在总共参加的20场比赛赢得了12个冠军，最终拿下车手和车厂双料冠军。

这款赛车名为155 2.5 V6 TI，是在1992年面市的四门155轿车基础上改装而成。它采用全时四驱系统，搭载的2.5升60度V6引擎可输出<420ps>。

1995年，155把原本的6速序列式变速箱替换为F1赛车所使用的带换挡拨片的6档半自动变速箱，却只能对同年参赛的梅赛德斯-奔驰赛车望尘莫及。1996年，阿尔法罗密欧带着拥有<490ps>的全新90度V型引擎杀回赛场，志在重夺冠军。

最终，155在13场赛事的26场比赛中拿下10胜，战绩领先于梅赛德斯-奔驰（7胜）和欧宝（9胜）。但因为积分落后，155错失了冠军宝座。在本赛季末，由于德国房车大师赛被并入国际房车锦标赛，这项赛事就此终结。

这里有一件趣事：前F1车手亚历山德罗·南尼尼也曾驾驶过一辆阿尔法罗密欧155 2.5 V6 TI。南尼尼在1990年的直升机事故中被切断右臂，为了方便用受损的右手换挡，他的那台155的升挡杆与降挡杆是分开设置的。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 4C Gr.3 is a Gran Turismo original model based on Alfa Romeo's new-generation mid-engine sports car, the 4C, modified to meet Gr.3 standards. To boost stability and aerodynamics, its wheelbase has been lengthened by 4.3 inches and its revised front overhang grew 1.2 inches. The Gr.4 4C is essentially a refined, tuned variant of the base model. Although less powerful, it exploited its light weight and small footprint to remain competitive in corners.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 4C Gr.3基于Alfa Romeo新一代中置跑车4C制造，是一款经改装后满足Gr.3组别标准的赛事认证车型。该车在稳定性和空气动力学方面得到了精心考量，轴距延长了110毫米，前悬延长约30毫米。4C Gr.3在蜕变成一款能够承受强大动力的赛车的同时，仍保留了原版出色的过弯能力。
officialDetails.heroEn: The launch edition of the 4C, limited to 1000 units, sold out almost immediately after going on sale.

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo exclusive is a Gr.3 race car based on the
Alfa Romeo 4C.

The 4C's wheelbase was extended by <110mm> for this car
to improve stability.

Also, the car's front overhang was lengthened
by around <30mm>.

Most of the changes resulted in improved aerodynamics, so you
can be sure this machine remained stable at very high speeds.
brandCentral.zh:
这款跑车浪漫旅专属的组别3级别赛车基于阿尔法罗密欧4C开发。

它与4C的差异之一在于延长了<110mm>的轴距。

另一项不同在于前悬架，也拓宽了大约<30mm>。

这辆车的调校着重于稳定性和空气动力学性能的提升，
以保证高速时的顺畅行驶。

vehicleCollection.en:
The launch edition of the 4C, limited to 1000 units, sold out almost immediately after going on sale.

While Alfa Romeo produced a number of mid-engine race cars in its day, the 4C, introduced in 2013, represents the marque’s first mass-production car that features the performance-minded layout.

Alfa Romeo engineers stressed weight reduction when developing this high-performance sports car. They installed a carbon monocoque structure that weighs only <65kg>, and combined it with a lightweight aluminum subframe. Also helping to keep the car’s curb weight low is the <1742cc> aluminum engine block that’s <22kg> lighter than its steel counterpart found in the Giulietta. As a result, the 4C tips the scales at a lean <895kg>.

The 4C’s turbocharged direct-injection inline-4 produces <240ps> and a peak torque of <35.7kgm>. It comes combined with a quick-shifting dual-clutch 6-speed gearbox that helps the 4C run from 0-<100km/h> in 4.5 seconds and reach a top speed of <258km/h>.

One would assume that performance figures from a car with such a modest engine output would be improbable, but the lightweight nature of the 4C makes it possible. It also looks the part of an exotic car, sporting a design theme based on the famous Tipo 33/2 Stradale.

Alfa Romeo included a limited-edition model, whose production run was 1000 units, in the 4C lineup. This car, which commemorated the launch of the 4C, came equipped with special carbon headlight bezels, door mirrors and a rear spoiler, as well as a sports suspension system and sports exhaust. This model sold out immediately. As for the base 4C, well, potential customers had to endure a long waiting list as the car’s production couldn’t meet the high demand.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo._

long.zh:
阿尔法·罗密欧4C于2013年面市，是阿尔法·罗密欧的第一款量产型中置引擎跑车。

这款车最大的亮点在于其追求极致轻量化的设计以及由此带来的卓越驾驶性能。车身的基本结构由碳纤维车壳与铝制副车架结合而成。车壳重量仅为<65kg>，极为强韧又十分轻巧，使用碳纤半固化片制成，制造工艺极其困难且成本高昂。虽然采用了与Giulietta相同的直列4缸<1742cc>直喷涡轮增压引擎，但缸体材质改为了铝制，进一步减少了<22kg>的重量。因此，该车型的意大利国内版的自重极轻，总重仅为<895kg>。

引擎输出功率为<240ps>，最大扭矩为<35.7kgm>。配置虽然不算特别惊艳，但较轻的重量加上6档双离合变速箱，使这款车的0-<100km/h>加速用时达到了惊人的4.5秒，而最高时速则达到<258km/h>。

其独特的中置引擎造型基于历史名车Tipo 33/2 Stradale，使这款车无愧于小型超跑的名号。

为了纪念本款4C车型的面市，厂家还发售了1,000台限量款。限量款搭载了特制的碳纤维头灯镶框、后视镜和后扰流板，以及跑车悬挂与跑车排气管。4C刚面世就大受欢迎，供不应求，而首发限量款据说一上市就被销售一空。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

引擎输出功率为<240ps>，最大扭矩为<35.7kgm>。配置虽然不算特别惊艳，但较轻的重量加上6档双离合变速箱，使这款车的0-<100km/h>加速用时达到了惊人的4.5秒，而最高时速则达到<258km/h>。

其独特的中置引擎造型基于历史名车Tipo 33/2 Stradale，使这款车无愧于小型超跑的名号。

为了纪念本款4C车型的面市，厂家还发售了1,000台限量款。限量款搭载了特制的碳纤维头灯镶框、后视镜和后扰流板，以及跑车悬挂与跑车排气管。4C刚面世就大受欢迎，供不应求，而首发限量款据说一上市就被销售一空。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Alfa Romeo’s first mass-produced mid-engine sports car, the 4C made its debut in 2013. Its design paid tribute to the timeless lines of the Tipo 33/2 Stradale. The 1742 cc 4-cylinder engine, producing 236.7 HP and 253.2 ft-lb of torque, was paired with an exceptionally lightweight body, enabling the car to accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 4.5 seconds and reach a top speed of 160.3 mph. A special "Launch Edition" was also released, limited to just 1,000 units worldwide.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Alfa Romeo于2013年发布的首款量产中置引擎跑车。该车从经典的Tipo 33/2 Stradale的造型中汲取了大量灵感。1,742 立方厘米的4缸引擎可输出240 PS/35.7 公斤力米，与极致轻盈的车身相结合，使该车能够在4.5秒内加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速达258 公里/小时。“Launch Edition”是一款特别版车型，全球限量1000台。

The 4C is Alfa Romeo's first ever mass-produced mid-engined
sports car.

It uses a carbon monocoque that helps brings its entire
weight down to a mere <900kg>!

You'll find the rigidity of its body also improves the
precision of its handling.

Its design references the Alfa Romeo Tipo 33/2 Stradale—
a car once called 'the most beautiful in the world'!
brandCentral.zh:
4C是Alfa Romeo有史以来第一次大规模量产的中置引擎跑车。

碳纤维单体结构帮助其将车身的整体重量降至仅有<900kg>！

同时其车身的刚性提高了操控时的精准性。

这款车的设计还大量参考了Alfa Romeo Tipo 33/2 Stradal——

catch.en: The launch edition of the 4C, limited to 1000 units, sold out almost immediately after going on sale.
catch.zh: 1000台车瞬间销售一空。4C的限量版，性能达到超级跑车水平。

vehicleCollection.en:
The launch edition of the 4C, limited to 1000 units, sold out almost immediately after going on sale.

While Alfa Romeo produced a number of mid-engine race cars in its day, the 4C, introduced in 2013, represents the marque’s first mass-production car that features the performance-minded layout.

Alfa Romeo engineers stressed weight reduction when developing this high-performance sports car. They installed a carbon monocoque structure that weighs only <65kg>, and combined it with a lightweight aluminum subframe. Also helping to keep the car’s curb weight low is the <1742cc> aluminum engine block that’s <22kg> lighter than its steel counterpart found in the Giulietta. As a result, the 4C tips the scales at a lean <895kg>.

The 4C’s turbocharged direct-injection inline-4 produces <240ps> and a peak torque of <35.7kgm>. It comes combined with a quick-shifting dual-clutch 6-speed gearbox that helps the 4C run from 0-<100km/h> in 4.5 seconds and reach a top speed of <258km/h>.

One would assume that performance figures from a car with such a modest engine output would be improbable, but the lightweight nature of the 4C makes it possible. It also looks the part of an exotic car, sporting a design theme based on the famous Tipo 33/2 Stradale.

Alfa Romeo included a limited-edition model, whose production run was 1000 units, in the 4C lineup. This car, which commemorated the launch of the 4C, came equipped with special carbon headlight bezels, door mirrors and a rear spoiler, as well as a sports suspension system and sports exhaust. This model sold out immediately. As for the base 4C, well, potential customers had to endure a long waiting list as the car’s production couldn’t meet the high demand.#

Classical yet elegantly refined,
this car is truly a stunning work of art.

Carrozzeria Touring, were experimenting with an
advanced design called the "pontoon,"

where the front and rear fenders were connected.

However, this 8C 2900 has...

...a classic design where
the large fenders are enhanced.

Of course, other Alfa Romeos had this design element.

Undoubtedly a very beautiful car that caught people's

conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
抛开经典复古的内核不谈，这款车在设计中
将优雅与犀利融为一体，造就了一件毋庸置疑的美妙作品。

Carrozzeria Touring在打造此车身时，
正在实验当时被称作“浮船”的先进设计：

即车身的前后挡泥板连贯为一个整体。

然而，这辆8C 2900还呈现了……

另一种经典设计：上拱的巨大挡泥板。

当然，这一设计元素也被其他阿尔法罗密欧车型所采用。

毫无疑问这是一辆非常优美的汽车，
甚至比当今的许多法拉利还要吸睛。

cars.nameZh: 阿尔法罗密欧8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta '38

officialDetails.descriptionEn: As its name suggested, the Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta was a stunning coupe, its body hand-shaped by Carrozzeria Touring using the lightweight superleggera method. The "8C" badge referred to the car’s 8-cylinder engine. Designed by the legendary Vittorio Jano, the water-cooled inline-8 delivered performance that placed the machine firmly in race-car territory. It's believed that only five examples were ever produced.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 顾名思义，Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta是由Carrozzeria Touring用超轻结构技术打造的精致双门轿跑。“8C”指的是引擎的8个气缸。液冷直列式8缸引擎出自天才设计师维托瑞·加诺之手，性能表现直逼赛车。据说这台车总共仅生产了5台。
officialDetails.heroEn: Equipped with DOHC V-8, this exquisite coupe was produced by Alfa Romeo in the pre-war period.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款精致的双门跑车配备了双顶置凸轮轴8缸引擎，由Alfa Romeo在战前时期生产。

collection.en:
The 8C name refers to the engine's eight cylinders, and
these cars are the iconic pre-war Alfa Romeos.

The inline-8 was designed by the genius Italian
engineer Vittorio Jano.

The “Berlinetta” body was made by famed coachbuilder
Touring.

There were only five Berlinettas made in total.

This particular one, from 1937, appeared in many motor
shows and catalogues.

It also won "Best of Show" at the Pebble Beach
Concours d'Elegance in 2018.

It then won the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este
the following year...

...before winning the Louis Vuitton Classic Concours Award.

I doubt many other cars have won prizes at three of the
world's biggest concours.

Needless to say, its current value is nothing short of
astronmialű
collection.zh:
8C的名号不仅对应了引擎的8个气缸，也致敬了Alfa Romeo
战前生产的标志性车型。

直列八缸引擎由意大利天才工程师维托里奥·亚诺设计完成，

“Berlinetta”车身则由著名车身制造商Touring打造，

而且，Berlinetta只生产了五辆。

这辆1937年下线的8C在圈内声名远播，曾在许多车展和拍
卖目录中现身。

它还在2018年的圆石滩经典车展中赢得了“最佳巡展”
的名号，

并在第二年的埃斯特别墅车展中再次斩获殊荣。

它还赢得过路易·维登经典车展奖。

我怀疑有多少其他车型能包圆世界三大展会的奖项！

毋庸置疑，它现在的售价已经是个天文数字了。~

vehicleCollection.en:
Equipped with DOHC V-8, this exquisite coupe was produced by Alfa Romeo in the pre-war period.

Before World War II, Alfa Romeo was a small automotive manufacturer that specialized in creating race machines and upscale road cars. The most notable model from this era was the 8C that appeared in 1931.

The name 8C actually refers to the company's 8-cylinder powerplant. Designed by renown engineer, Vittori Jano, this water-cooled engine featured the latest technology of its day, including dual overhead cams (DOHC) and a hemispherical combustion chamber. The 1937 8C 2900B, the last in the 8C line, had 2.9 liters of displacement and came equipped with twin superchargers, enabling the engine to produce <180ps>. Two different versions of the chassis were available, with varying wheelbases, allowing customers to choose a number of different body styles from their favorite Carrozzerias.

The Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta is a gorgeous coupe created by Carrozzeria Touring, utilizing the company's Superleggera (Superlight) technology. Thanks to its engine, it boasted race car performance, making it one of the most heralded super sports cars of its day. Rumor has it that only five of these cars were ever produced.

The name 8C actually refers to the company's 8-cylinder powerplant. Designed by renown engineer, Vittori Jano, this water-cooled engine featured the latest technology of its day, including dual overhead cams (DOHC) and a hemispherical combustion chamber. The 1937 8C 2900B, the last in the 8C line, had 2.9 liters of displacement and came equipped with twin superchargers, enabling the engine to produce <180ps>. Two different versions of the chassis were available, with varying wheelbases, allowing customers to choose a number of different body styles from their favorite Carrozzerias.

The Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta is a gorgeous coupe created by Carrozzeria Touring, utilizing the company's Superleggera (Superlight) technology. Thanks to its engine, it boasted race car performance, making it one of the most heralded super sports cars of its day. Rumor has it that only five of these cars were ever produced.

conversation.en:
This car is one of the most legendary creations
in Alfa Romeo's storied history.

Alfa Romeo was once a purveyor of the world's foremost
race cars and premium GT vehicles.

What we have here is a modern rendition of the cars
from that period.

From its name to its styling, it conjures up memories
of the company as it was in the 1930s and 1940s.

Although it employs a FR drive system, the transmission
has been mounted at the rear.

The transaxle assembly was meant to improve
weight distribution.

While the name and legacy are enough to give you chills,
wait until you get behind the heel and drive it!

这款车则是用现代手法
来演绎那段时期的代表之作。

Alfa Romemo在20世纪30和40年代的记忆。

虽然采用前置后驱系统，
不过变速器却置于后方……

采用跨轴布局，目的是改善重量分布。

不仅在称谓和外观上令人振奋，
这款车的驾驭感受也非常梦幻！

This car was introduced at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show.
I know because I was there.

Even if somebody were to cover its distinctive shield,
I would still know it from its voluminous design.

The round taillights on its short rear overhang
are reminiscent of the TZ.

And, well, it simply feels like an Alfa Romeo!

While Alfa Romeo sports models are usually designed
by Italian carrozzerie and stylists...

...this 8C was different.

It was penned by Wolfgang Egger’s own design department,
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo.
'

这辆车在2003法兰克福车展上首次亮相。
我之所以知道，是因为当时我也在场！

即便把它特点鲜明的盾形车标挡住，我也能
从它宽大的车身设计分辨出来。

其短车尾凸出部分的圆形车尾灯让人回想起了经典车型TZ……

不过说实话……这才是纯正的Alfa Romeo！

Alfa Romeo的跑车车型多由意大利的
车身制造商和外观设计师操刀……

但这辆8C却并非如此。

它是由沃夫冈·埃格尔自己的设计部门——
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo所执笔设计。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The original 8C took its name from the 8-cylinder engine designed by the legendary Vittorio Jano. Beneath its timeless bodywork lay a 4.7-liter V-8, tuned by Alfa Romeo to deliver 443.8 HP. With a top speed of 180.2 mph and a 0–62.1 mph sprint time of under 4.2 seconds, it rivaled—and in some cases surpassed—contemporary supercars. Limited to just 500 units worldwide, the car sold out almost immediately upon its release.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 初代8C得名于维托瑞·加诺设计的8缸引擎。在其经典造型下，隐藏着Alfa Romeo调校的4.7升V8引擎，动力输出达450 PS，最高时速可达290 公里/小时，0-100 公里/小时加速时间不到4.2秒，让不少同期的超级跑车都相形见绌。这台车全球限量仅500台，发售的一瞬间便被抢购一空。
officialDetails.heroEn: This car marked Alfa Romeo's return to the rear-drive coupe and possessed a top speed of 180.2 mph plus.
officialDetails.heroZh: Alfa Romeo后轮驱动双门轿车回归，最高速度超过290 公里/小时。

brandCentral.en:
This is Alfa Romeo's supercar, the 8C Competizione.

It sports a mighty V8 engine that was actually built
at a Ferrari factory.

Not only does it feel powerful—it sounds powerful, too!

An FR car with a transaxle gearbox mounted in the rear...

You'll find it handles like a dream thanks to its excellent
weight distribution.

Also of note: its beautiful proportions were inspired by the
classic racing Alfa Romeos of the thirties and forties.;

8C Competizione是Alfa Romeo推出的超级跑车。

这台车上搭载的强劲V8引擎实际上是在Ferrari工厂制造的。

不仅动力十足，声音也非常威猛！

这是一辆跨轴变速箱安装在后部的前置后驱车……

您会发现，由于其出色的重量分布，这辆车操控起来如
梦幻般流畅。

另外值得一提的是：其曼妙的车身比例深受30和40年代
的Alfa Romeo经典赛车的启发。;

usedCar.en:
Of all Alfa Romeo cars in the past few decades, I would
rate this 8C Competizione at the top of the list.

Race car manufacturer Dallara collaborated with Alfa Romeo
in this car's design and development...

...with the assembly of the precious few units overseen
by none other than Maserati.

And the constructor of the V-8 engine? Ferrari.

Also, its front-engine/rear-drive layout included a transaxle.

With such a dream team working behind the scenes, this car
was destined to be the quintessential Italian exotic.<

赛车车厂Dallara与Alfa Romeo合作设计、

它的有限生产是交给Maserati

光听起来就非同凡响！

梦幻般的操控性。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car marked Alfa Romeo's return to the rear-drive coupe and possessed a top speed of <290km/h> plus.

The first FR Alfa Romeo coupe since the SZ was given a very traditional and legendary name. The 8C is the name of the engine which had made Alfa Romeo famous for their technical excellence in the 1920s, that was designed by the famous Vittorio Jano. This was a famous and revolutionary 8-cylinder power unit that was not only used in the red racing machines of the Alfas in that era, but also by many different manufacturers at the time.

The front dashboard's classic look brings to mind its background and has been applied to all models coming after the 8C as the new family trademark of Alfa Romeo. The very Alfa-esque emotional design is a major identifier, and the orders for the limited run of 500 cars worldwide was full almost as soon as it was announced.

The car weighs <1585kg> and the weight distribution is slightly towards the rear at 49 to 51. To achieve this, the body combines a steel frame with carbon. Many aspects of the power unit are shared with Maserati, but Alfa Romeo has tuned its performance and sound. The 4.7-liter <450ps> V8 engine is matched with a trans-axle Q select 6-speed semi automatic. Alfa Romeo states that its exciting sound is compliant with all of the sound regulations set in various countries around the world.

With a top speed of over <290km/h> and a 0-<100km/h> acceleration of 4.2 seconds or less, its styling may be classic, but its performance is nothing short of a modern-day super sports car.

long.zh:
在SZ之后，阿尔法罗密欧的第一款前置后驱双门轿车获得了一个即传统又富有传奇色彩的名字—8C。这个名字来自于维托里奥·亚诺设计的一款引擎，正是这款引擎让阿尔法罗密欧在1920年代凭借强大的技术名声大振。那是一套久负盛名、革命性的8缸动力单元，它不仅被用于那个年代的红色阿尔法赛车，也被当时很多不同的车身制造厂采用。

它经典的前脸能让人自然而然地联想起它的强大背景，并被沿用到了8C之后的所有车型身上，成为阿尔法罗密欧家族的新标志。它那激动人心的设计极具阿尔法风格，更是其重要的标志。8C刚一公布，全球限量500台的订单几乎立即被抢购一空。

这款车的重量为<1585kg>，重量配比为49：51，略向后侧偏移。为了达到这一点，车身采用了钢框架与碳纤维混合打造。动力单元的很多参数都与玛莎拉蒂相同，但阿尔法罗密欧对性能和声音都做出了调校。<450ps>，4.7升V8引擎搭配Q-Select 6速半自动驱动桥变速箱，让阿尔法罗密欧既能发出激动人心的轰鸣，又不会违反世界上任何一个国家的噪音管理条例。

它的最大时速超过<290km/h>，0-<100km/h>加速最多需要4.2秒，但它的性能绝不逊色于当今的任何一台超级跑车。

cars.nameEn: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
cars.nameZh: 阿尔法罗密欧朱丽叶TZ2 carrozzata da扎加托'65

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This racing machine was the result of a collaborative effort between Alfa Romeo and Carrozzeria Zagato. Based on the TZ, its body shell was replaced with lightweight FRP, while the nose and roof were lowered to enhance aerodynamic performance. Under the hood, it featured the twin-ignition cylinder head from the Giulia GTA, allowing it to produce 162.7 HP and reach a top speed of 152.2 mph.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这辆赛道机器是Alfa Romeo和Carrozzeria Zagato联手打造的产物。它的车身设计借鉴了经典车型TZ，但外壳换用了纤维强化塑料，为了优化空气动力学性能，还降低了车头和车顶的高度。在动力方面，它采用了一部由Giulia GTA打造的双火花塞点火引擎，能够输出165 PS的动力，最高时速更是达到了245 公里/小时。
officialDetails.heroEn: Both in style and substance, this car represented all that was good about sports cars in the 1960s.
officialDetails.heroZh: 来自60年代的优美经典车型。

collection.en:
You'd be hard pressed to find a wilder, more bewitching
street-legal car than the Alfa Romeo Giulia TZ.

It's also incredibly rare, with only around
12 ever built.

And what’s truly noteworthy is that this race car...

...has no history of crashes and has never undergone
any restoration work.

You can see why it has become a collector's item.

It should come as no surprise that this TZ2 won the Gran Turismo
Trophy at the 2009 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
collection.zh:
您很难找到哪辆车能像Alfa Romeo Giulia TZ这般狂野、迷人，
同时还能在路上合法行驶。

不仅如此，它也非常的稀有，
总共只制造了12辆左右！

它的存在简直就是一个奇迹……

也从未接受过修复。

这样的无伤历史，想要不出名也难！

锦上添花的是，TZ2还在2009年的圆石滩经典车展获得了
Gran Turismo奖杯。

vehicleCollection.en:
Both in style and substance, this car represented all that was good about sports cars in the 1960s.

Established just north of Milan, Italy, in a town called Monza in 1919, Carrozzeria Zagato became one of the most heralded coach-builders of its day. It was primarily known for producing lightweight car bodies that borrowed technology from aircraft manufacturing. Alfa Romeo, which had been producing sports cars since before World War II, met with amazing racing success with Zagato-built bodies. This collaboration continued even after the war, and together they went on to create many significant cars that have now become part of automotive history.

One of the notable examples was the TZ introduced in 1962. The TZ, whose name stands for Tubolare Zagato, was a road car that could also double as a race car. It featured an aerodynamic aluminum body on a steel tubular space frame, helping it to weigh in at a lean <660kg>. Supplying the power was a DOHC 1.6-liter engine from the Giulia that produced <112ps> at <6500rpm>.

Unlike the original TZ, the 1965 TZ2 was a pure race car, with a production run of only 10 to 12 units. Rumor has it that many original TZ owners preferred a pure race version of their cars, so they returned them to the factory to be refitted as the TZ2.

What differentiated the TZ2 from the TZ was its fiber glass body that made it <40kg> lighter. It also sported a lower nose and roof that resulted in better aerodynamics. Its engine was also upgraded using the same twin-ignition head from the GTA. The result was 170 HP at <7500rpm> and a top speed of <245km/h>, up from the TZ's <215km/h>.

long.zh:
意大利车身制造厂扎加托于1919年在米兰城外的小镇蒙扎成立。这家工厂擅长将航空制造技术应用到汽车上，生产出轻量化的车身外壳。在二战前就开始生产跑车的阿尔法罗密欧便是其受益者之一，借助扎加托制造的车身外壳，他们在赛车场上大获成功。双方在战后继续保持合作，共同创造出了多款汽车史上有名有姓的热门车型。

在这些车型当中，最引人瞩目的要属1962年亮相的TZ。正如其名Tubolare Zagato所示，这是一款剑指赛车场的作品。它采用了钢管空间车架搭配符合空气动力学的铝制车身，安装在极致轻量化底盘（仅重<660kg>）之上的是一台借用自朱丽叶系列的1.6升双顶置凸轮轴引擎，可在<6500rpm>转速下输出<112ps>动力。

而在1965年亮相的TZ2更进一步，带来更强的竞争力。据说TZ2总计只生产了10到12台，还有传闻说部分TZ车型返厂后改装成了TZ2。与出厂时即符合公路行驶标准的TZ不同，TZ2从设计之初就是一款彻彻底底的赛事车辆。

TZ2的主要不同之处包括车身改用纤维强化塑胶材料，将车重再次降低了<40kg>。前鼻和车顶的高度进一步降低，以提升空气动力学效果。引擎升级后用上了GTA同款的双火花塞点火，<7500rpm>转速之下的动力达到了<172.4ps>，而且其最高时速也相应大幅攀升，从<215km/h>提高到了<245km/h>。

GTA is an acronym for "Gran Turismo Alleggerita," the legendary
race version of the 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint.

It dominated the Touring Car championships
in Italy and Europe.

This limited, "mean" version of the new Giulia sedan fully
captures its original spirit and exuberant performance.

The design also shows its sportiness with a big front grille,
wide fenders and carbon-fiber aerodynamic elements.

Even the Alfa shield is made of carbon-fiber!

And the huge 20-inch alloy wheels have a single central nut,
like on real race cars.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
GTA是“轻量版超级跑车”的缩写，
它是传奇的1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint的公路赛车版本。

后者曾主宰了意大利乃至全欧洲的房车锦标赛。

这款“用料节省”的全新限量版Giulia轿车完全把握住了
原车型的精髓和卓越的性能。

在外观设计上，更是以巨大的前格栅、宽挡泥板和一大堆
美观的碳纤维空气动力学组件忠实再现了Sprin的运动感

——甚至连阿尔法·罗密欧车标的盾徽也是由碳纤维制成的！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 2020, Alfa Romeo marked their 110th anniversary with the release of the special Giulia GTA and GTAm models. The twin-turbo 2.9-liter V-6 saw its output raised to 532.5 HP, accompanied by weight reduction and a wider track for enhanced performance. The GTAm, built with circuit driving in mind, featured a large front splitter, carbon fiber rear wing, and integrated roll bars—delivering a truly hardcore setup.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2020年，Alfa Romeo为庆祝品牌成立110周年，特别推出了Giulia的“GTA”和“GTAm”特别版车型。2.9升V6双涡轮增压引擎的功率提升至540 PS，同时通过减重和加宽轮距进一步强化性能表现。GTAm车型专为赛道使用而设计，配备了大型前定风翼、碳纤维尾翼和防滚架等极致的硬核配置。
officialDetails.heroEn: The top-of-the-line model in the Giulia lineup celebrated 110 years of Alfa Romeo.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款车是Giulia系列的巅峰之作，也是对Alfa Romeo 110年历史的纪念。

brandCentral.en:
The Giulia GTA and modified GTAm are the highest-performing
Alfa Romeo four-door sedans of all time.

This model has its origin in the Giulia Sprint GTA,
a legendary racer from 1965.

‘GTA’, by the way, is short for ‘Gran Turismo Alleggerita’.

Italian for ‘lightened’, ‘Alleggerita’ is an apt descriptor
for the GTA, which traded in brawn for speed.

In addition to sporting an upgraded engine,
capable of <540ps>, this new Giulia GTA...

Makes use of lightweight carbon panels across its roof,
bonnet, fenders and bumpers.

The GTAm is the modified version of the GTA.

The addition of a massive carbon-fibre wing, and the lack
of rear seating, push its lightness to the limit.
brandCentral.zh:
Giulia GTA和其官方改装车型GTAm是
Alfa Romeo史上性能最强的4门轿车。

其研发原型为Giulia Sprint GTA，生产于1965年的
传奇跑车。

顺便一提，“GTA”是“Gran Turismo Alleggerita”的缩写。

“Alleggerita”是意大利语的“轻量化”的意思，用来描述这辆
牺牲重量、换取速度的GTA再合适不过。

除了装载一台马力高达<540ps>的升级版引擎外，
这辆新的Giulia GTA……

将车顶、引擎盖、挡泥板和保险杠都换成了
轻质碳纤维板。

GTAm则是GTA的官方改装车型。

不仅加装了巨大的碳纤维尾翼，还彻底拆除了后座，
将轻量化推向了极致。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line model in the Giulia lineup celebrated 110 years of Alfa Romeo.

In 2020, special editions of the Alfa Romeo Giulia were introduced to celebrate the 110th anniversary of the historic company. The cars were called the Giulia GTA and GTAm, which were based on the high-performance Quadrifoglio model.

For these cars, the power output of the twin-turbocharged 2.9-liter V-6 was increased to <540ps>, while curb weight was reduced by <100kg>. Also, the front and rear track were widened by <50mm> to enhance the car's stability, while the cars' aerodynamics were significantly enhanced in the form of new front and rear fenders, as well as other redeisgned body parts, thanks to help from Alfa Romeo's Formula 1 partner, Sauber.

The GTAm offers a more hardcore setup designed for circuit use. In addition to a larger front splitter and carbon fiber rear wing, a roll-cage was installed and the rear seats were removed.

2.9L V6双涡轮增压引擎的动力输出提高到<540ps>。全车均使用轻量化材料，将车重再次降低<100kg>。前后轮距则增加<50mm>，缩短有效轴距。所有这些改进都使操控性得到显著改善。

此外，纪念版车型还采用了加宽的前挡泥板和尾部的拱形挡泥板，以及与阿尔法罗密欧的F1合作伙伴索伯共同开发的部分空气动力学套件。

GTAm的配置则更硬核，专为赛道而设计。不仅加装有巨大的前定风翼和碳纤维后翼，同时用防滚架代替了后排座椅。

Alfa Romeo ever produced.

Because the Sprint also came as a 4-door sedan,
this car was also called the Giulia coupe.

It became a world-famous sports car, penned by genius car designer
Giorgetto Giugiaro.

to compete in grand prix races.

to bild high-performance engines.

thrill to ride.

TA model, too.֚ scmd"GTCafe_Top" />I

由于竞速所属的车系下还有一台四门轿车，所以

阿尔法罗密欧从创立之初就致力于制造用于参加
大奖赛的高速赛车。

因此长期积累了制造5性能引擎所需的技术知识。

这辆朱丽叶竞速虽然个头不大，但它由一台强大的
直列四缸双凸轮轴引擎驱动。

加上后轮驱动的加持，绝对能够带来刺激的驾驶体验

而且这辆车也是超轻量级GTAM的开发基
K车w之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
An iconic 1960s high-performance coupe from Alfa Romeo

The first generation Giulia was marketed from the 1960s to the 1970s and proved to be a huge hit for Alfa Romeo. The Giulia was available only as a 4-door sedan when it went on sale in 1962, but a coupe version was added to the line up in 1963. This first coupe was called the Sprint GT.

It was designed by a young Giorgetto Giugiaro, who was with Carrozzeria Bertone at the time. The car's body consisted of smooth lines and soft curves, with a characteristic edge at the front. The beauty of the car has made it popular among classic-car enthusiasts to this day.

The Giulia Sprint GT came powered by a 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4. Producing <106ps> and <14.2kgm> torque, it propelled the lightweight <950kg> body to a top speed of <180km/h>.

The car was extremely popular with driving enthusiasts because of its compact lightweight body, which translated to exceptional handling and acceleration. All of this allowed the Giulia Sprint GT to overcome the test of time, being produced until 1977.

long.zh:
从1960到1970年代销售的第一代朱丽叶系列是阿尔法罗密欧极具影响力的产品。朱丽叶在1962年发布，最初只供应四门版，但很快在1963年增加了双门版本。首款双门跑车车型被命名为Sprint GT。

它是由当时尚在车身制造公司 博通工作的年轻设计师乔盖托·乔治亚罗设计的。车身主体以流畅的线条和柔和的弧度组成，只在车头处拉出一道棱角分明的独特线条，多年来备受广大车迷的喜爱。

该车由1.6升双凸轮轴直列四缸引擎驱动，能够提供<106ps>的动力和<14.2kgm>的扭矩，可将<950kg>的轻盈车身推到<180km/h>的极速。

作为一款高性能的双门跑车，朱丽叶Sprint GT在面市后大受欢迎。紧凑的轻质车身提供了良好的操控性，再加上跑车引擎的动力，让它成为一个经久不衰的车型，持续生产到了1977年，并且推出了为数众多、名称和细节各不相同、五花八门的衍生车型。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This 3-door hatchback was released in the B-segment as a replacement for Alfa Romeo’s previous entry-level model, the 147. Its name was inspired by Milan and Torino—two cities central to Alfa Romeo’s history. The standard powerplant was a turbocharged 1.4-liter DOHC, with the 1.4 Sport variant producing 152.9 HP and 166.4 ft-lb of torque, paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. With a top speed of 133.6 mph and a zero-62.1 mph time of 8.0 seconds, it delivered more than respectable performance for its class.

vehicleCollection.en:
Alfa Romeo's MiTo hatchback brings a dash of Italian flair to the compact car segment.

Since its debut in 2000, the 147 had served as Alfa Romeo’s entry-level model, but in 2008, the 3-door MiTo took over this role in the lower B-segment.

The "Mi" in MiTo stands for Milan, where Alfa Romeo's design studios are located. The "To'" refers to Turin (Torino in Italian), where the car was manufactured. And the word "mito" in Italian translates to "myth" or "legend," adding a layer of meaning to the name.

One size smaller than the 147, the MiTo was crafted at Alfa Romeo’s design center. The car's overall styling, particularly the front and rear, invoke the spirit of the 8C Competizione. Alfa Romeo fans embraced the MiTo’s appearance, which they felt exuded an ideal balance of charming, classic styling and modern, cutting-edge aesthetics.

While the MiTo shared components with the FIAT Grande Punto, it was tuned to deliver the unmistakable flavor of an Alfa Romeo. When it was introduced, many hailed the MiTo as the best in its class, praising its blend of responsive handling and exceptional controllability.

Under its hood resided a turbocharged 1.4-liter DOHC inline-4. The 1.4 Sport model, which came with a 6-speed manual gearbox, produced <155ps> and <23.5kgm> torque. The MiTo sprinted from 0 to <100 km/h> in 8.0 seconds and hit a top speed of <215 km/h>, making it among the sportiest cars in its class.,

long.zh:
自2000年首次亮相以来，147一直都是阿尔法罗密欧的入门级车型，但从2008年起，三门掀背式轿车MiTo取代了它在低价B级车中的位置。

MiTo中的“Mi”代表着米兰，米兰与阿尔法罗密欧有着密切的联系，而他们的设计工作室就坐落在米兰。“To”则取自都灵的前两个字母，那里是意大利的汽车工业与制造中心。在意大利语中，MiTo一词有着“神话”与“传奇”的意思。

MiTo由阿尔法罗密欧设计中心设计，比147小一号。MiTo的前/后端与整体造型都在向8C Competizione致敬。这款车的设计在可爱、传统风格与顶尖设计之间取得了平衡，深受阿尔法罗密欧车迷们的喜爱。

这款车与菲亚特朋多使用了同样的部件，但经过调校，加入了阿尔法罗密欧的独特品味。在这款车初次亮相时，因其灵活而又直接的操控性以及卓越的可控性，许多人称其为同级车中的最佳车型。

这款车的动力系统采用1.4升双顶置凸轮轴涡轮引擎与主流的1.4型跑车级引擎，与6档手动变速箱结合在一起，可提供<155ps>的输出与<23.5kgm>的扭矩。同时，这款车的最高时速为<215km/h>，而0-<100km/h>加速时间为8.0秒，此等表现堪称同级车中的典范。

MiTo中的“Mi”代表着米兰，米兰与阿尔法罗密欧有着密切的联系，而他们的设计工作室就坐落在米兰。“To”则取自都灵的前两个字母，那里是意大利的汽车工业与制造中心。在意大利语中，MiTo一词有着“神话”与“传奇”的意思。

MiTo由阿尔法罗密欧设计中心设计，比147小一号。MiTo的前/后端与整体造型都在向8C Competizione致敬。这款车的设计在可爱、传统风格与顶尖设计之间取得了平衡，深受阿尔法罗密欧车迷们的喜爱。

这款车与菲亚特朋多使用了同样的部件，但经过调校，加入了阿尔法罗密欧的独特品味。在这款车初次亮相时，因其灵活而又直接的操控性以及卓越的可控性，许多人称其为同级车中的最佳车型。

这款车的动力系统采用1.4升双顶置凸轮轴涡轮引擎与主流的1.4型跑车级引擎，与6档手动变速箱结合在一起，可提供<155ps>的输出与<23.5kgm>的扭矩。同时，这款车的最高时速为<215km/h>，而0-<100km/h>加速时间为8.0秒，此等表现堪称同级车中的典范。

conversation.en: Are you familiar with the WRC? It stands for "World Rally Championship," and features rally races that take place on a variety of road surfaces. It was formed in 1973 when rally championships held in various countries were unified. The new international race series was christened the World Rally Championship, and the rest is history. This is the Alpine A110, the winner of the very first WRC series. Its compact body came with an <1800cc> engine mounted at the rear, ensuring excellent traction. The A110 won the first race of the 1973 season, held in Monte Carlo. In fact, Alpine A110s took all three podium places, defeating entries orm Porsche and Lancia. The car now occups a page in thhistoy books as the car that won the first WRC race and series.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
你对WRC熟悉吗？

它是“世界拉力锦标赛”的缩写，在公共道路上举行拉力
赛是其独有的特色。

它设立于1973年，将在不同国家举行的拉力锦标赛整合
到了一起。

这就是WRC的开端，并延续至今。

这一辆Alpine A110正是第一届WRC的冠军。

它的车身紧凑，后置发动机确保
后轮产生足够的牵引力。

它在蒙特卡洛赢下了1973年赛季的第一场比赛。

事实上，Alpine A110一路上击败了Porsche和Lancia，
包揽了领奖台！

A110就此踏上了赢得WRC首季比赛的道路，并通过比
赛造成AOo轰动效应！
V

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Alpine A110 was a classic French sports car with a celebrated heritage in rally racing. With its rear-engine layout and lightweight construction, it delivered superb traction and quickly rose to prominence in international rally events, claiming numerous victories. First introduced in 1963 with a 1.1-liter engine, the A110 saw gradual increases in displacement to remain competitive over time. The pinnacle of the lineup was arguably the 1600S, which came equipped with a 1.6-liter engine.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Alpine A110这台经典法国跑车在拉力赛领域拥有辉煌的历史传承。凭借后置式引擎布局带来的卓越牵引力与超轻车身，它席卷国际拉力赛事，斩获无数胜利。A110在1963年首次出战时搭载的是1.1升引擎，此后为应对竞争，引擎排量逐年提升。终极型号当属采用1.6升引擎的1600S。
officialDetails.heroEn: The swoopy rear-engined Alpine was powered by a Renault engine.
officialDetails.heroZh: Alpine汽车的典范，超轻后驱跑车的巅峰。

usedCar.en:
Although Alpine isn't well known in the U.S., this French
company has built some great cars, notably the A110.

This vehicle was one of the great rally cars of the 1970s.

Its RR layout made it an instant rival of the Porsche 911,
which it beat on multiple occasions.

Its fiber-glass construction made it extremely lightweight,
which was the secret to its speed and handling.

And it was instantly recognizable by its unique face.

Take the time to study its cockpit and the exquisitely
arranged five gauges mounted on its dashboard.
usedCar.zh:
这款雷诺Alpine A110跑车是汽车史上最闪耀的明星之一。

它的名气很大程度上归功于其在拉力赛中的表现。

更具体地说，它曾多次击败另一款备受
赞誉的后置后驱跑车——保时捷911。

由纤维强化塑料制成的轻量化车身结构
可以说是它最大的优势之一。

而它在弯道上的表现也首屈一指。

它的驾驶舱和仪表盘上精致排列的五个仪
表也非常值得花些时间去研究。

catch.en: The swoopy rear-engined Alpine was powered by a Renault engine.
catch.zh: Alpine汽车的典范，超轻后驱跑车的巅峰。

vehicleCollection.en:
The swoopy rear-engined Alpine was powered by a Renault engine.

When it came to high-performance lightweight vehicles, the A110, created by French car maker Alpine, had few equals. The svelte coupe, which was produced from 1961 to 1977, featured a rear-engine/rear-drive layout (RR) that translated to amazing cornering prowess and incredible traction.

In 1963, the A110 was powered by a 1.1-liter engine, and for the next few years, displacement was incrementally increased. Then in 1968, the 1600S was introduced, equipped with a <1565cc> powerplant that came from the Renault 16. In 1973, this engine was swapped out for a <1605cc> unit from the Renault 17. During this time, the car's handling capabilities saw upgrades as well, going to a double wishbone rear suspension and smaller-diameter tires.

There were many variations to the 1600S, but three models are worth noting: the 1600SC, a French domestic model with twin Weber 45DCOE carburetors; an export version called the 1600SI with fuel injection, and the easy-to-drive 1600SX. The first two models possessed engines that delivered <140ps>/<6000rpm> and mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox. The top speed for both vehicles was rated at <210km/h>, quite impressive for a car with only a <1600cc> engine. The secret was its lightweight nature; it tipped the scales at around <700 kg>. As for the 1600SX, sold from 1976, it was a tamer model than its predecessors, with a de-tuned engine that produced <95ps>/<6000rpm>, enabling it reach a modest top speed of <190km/h>. That said, the 1600SX was easier to drive and was popular with people with no interest in motorsports.

Speaking of motorsports, the A110 was a successful rally car, winning a number of races in the 1970s. During the 1970-1972 seasons, it participated in the International Championship for Manufacturers, winning several races in Europe. As a result, it was considered one of the greatest rally machines of its day. The A110 remained popular even after its successor, the A310 debuted in 1971. A total of 7160 cars were produced until the end of its production in 1977.

That said, the 1600SX was easier to drive and was popular with people with no interest in motorsports.

Speaking of motorsports, the A110 was a successful rally car, winning a number of races in the 1970s. During the 1970-1972 seasons, it participated in the International Championship for Manufacturers, winning several races in Europe. As a result, it was considered one of the greatest rally machines of its day. The A110 remained popular even after its successor, the A310 debuted in 1971. A total of 7160 cars were produced until the end of its production in 1977.
long.zh:
阿尔派A110是一款划时代的跑车，所采用的超轻车身和后置引擎、后轮驱动布局，为其提供了卓越的牵引力。A110于1963年在伦敦亮相时，只配备了1.1升的引擎，此后逐年提升排量，但该系列的顶峰是1968年亮相的1600S。

1600S最初配备雷诺16采用的<1565cc>的引擎，但1973年，被替换为雷诺17所采用的<1605cc>的引擎。同时，后悬挂改为双叉臂式悬挂，并且缩小了轮毂，带来与以往车款完全不同的驾驶体验。

当时，阿尔派接连赢得国际拉力赛事，但为了绕过针对排量的限制，他们故意选择了只比<1600cc>高一点点的排量，即<1605cc>。这样一来，就能对车辆进行大量的调试改装，代价是必须面对排量更大的对手。但A110在面对这些对手时表现十分出色。

1600S有许多改款，但有3个主流的型号：采用双Weber 45DC0E化油器的法国国内版1600SC，以及采用燃料喷射技术的出口版1600SI。这两个车型的马力输出均为<140ps> /，配备5速变速箱，最大速度为<210km/h>。对于<1600cc>排量的车来说，这是令人难以置信的数字。但<700kg>级的超轻级车体对此有很大的贡献。

剩下的第三个车型是自1976年开始销售的1600SX。1600SX采用了一款降低性能的引擎，马力为<95ps> /<6000rpm>，最大速度也降至<190km/h>，但也使得此车更容易驾驶，因此受到非赛车用户的喜爱。

A110甚至在其继任者A310于1971年发布后仍然受到喜爱。在1977年生产结束之前，该车款各个车型一共生产了7160辆。#

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The original Alpine A110 proved itself across the globe, performing admirably in rally competition. In 2017, Renault revived the Alpine name to carry the torch forward, revealing the modern Alpine A110. This new version, clad in an aluminum body echoing the original, featured a mid-mounted turbocharged 1.8-liter 4-cylinder engine producing 248.5 HP and 231.5 ft-lb of torque. A special Première Édition was created, with production limited to 1,955 units worldwide.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 经典的Alpine A110在全球拉力赛中表现出色。2017年，Renault重振Alpine品牌，推出新一代Alpine A110，延续这一传奇。这款新车型采用的铝制车身让人联想到经典的A110，中置1.8升4缸涡轮增压引擎可输出252 PS/32.0 公斤力米。特别版“Première Édition”全球限量1955台。
officialDetails.heroEn: This lightweight sports car from the reborn Alpine brand combined elegance with performance.
officialDetails.heroZh: Alpine品牌复活后出品的轻型跑车杰作，兼具优雅的外观和高超的性能。

brandCentral.en:
If you consider yourself a connoisseur, then this car
is for you.

It's the legendary Alpine A110, reborn for the modern age.

Power is supplied by a mid-mounted inline-4 that pumps
out an impressive <250ps>.

Thanks to its aluminum chassis, it weighs in at a
lean <1100kg>, making it agile and quick.

All in all, this car is worthy of the A110 name.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一件专为鉴赏家打造的艺术品！

这辆传奇的Alpine A110在现代得以重生。

其动力由一台中置直列四缸引擎提供，可以输出<250ps>的马力。

因为采用了全铝合金底盘，它的车重惊人的轻，精简到
了只有<1100kg>。

其杰出的操控性绝对配得上A110的盛名。

catch.en: This lightweight sports car from the reborn Alpine brand combined elegance with performance.
catch.zh: Alpine品牌复活后出品的轻型跑车杰作，兼具优雅的外观和高超的性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight sports car from the reborn Alpine brand combined elegance with performance.

Renault revealed the new Alpine A110 at the 2017 Geneva Auto Show, signaling the spiritual return of the iconic brand that celebrated driving excitement and high performance.

The new A110’s aluminum bodywork came ripe with the latest aerodynamic technologies, as it sat wide and low to the ground. Thanks to a lightweight and rigid aluminum chassis, the A110 tipped the scales at a lean <1100kg>. Mounted amidships was a new turbocharged 1.8L inline-4 that produced <252ps> and 320Nm (<32.6kgm>) of torque. It came mated to a Getrag 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. officialDetails.descriptionEn: While Alpine earned fame through rallying success with the A110, the 1960s also saw the marque build competitive prototype racers that achieved results on the track. Among them, the A220 stood as Alpine’s strongest contender for overall victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, making its debut in 1968. Although the car was beset by mechanical issues and failed to deliver the expected result, it remained a fan favorite and a cherished part of Alpine’s legacy.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 得益于A110的卓越表现，Alpine作为拉力赛品牌广为人知。而到了20世纪60年代，Alpine还研发过原型赛车，这些车型在赛道上同样战绩斐然。其中，1968年首秀的A220最具问鼎勒芒24小时耐力赛总冠军的潜力。尽管正赛中该车故障频发，成绩未达预期，但至今仍被车迷视为Alpine经典车型之一。
officialDetails.heroEn: Not only a maker of dominant rally cars, the noted French car company also forayed into road machines.
officialDetails.heroZh: Alpine的另一面：搭载3升V8引擎的LeMans赛车。

collection.en:
It's hard to believe that a Le Mans prototype
also competed in rallies.

Well, it really did happen.

Let me introduce you to the Alpine A220.

It's a successor to the Alpine M Series, which performed well
at Le Mans in the 1960s.

It features a mid-mounted 3L V8 engine designed by Gordini...

but unfortunately it never made much of a mark at Le Mans.

However it would go on to compete in the world of rallying
which was a fairly unique challenge for such a car.

This specific car has a dramatically shortened tail for rallying
which makes it especially rare.
collection.zh:
一辆勒芒原型车也能参加拉力赛，是不是很难以置信？

其实，这事确实发生过。

让我向您隆重介绍Alpine A220吧！

Alpine A220是1960年代在勒芒比赛中表现极其出色的
Alpine M Series的继任者，

它采用了由Gordini设计的中置3L V8引擎……

遗憾的是。它从未在勒芒赛场上取得过什么值得大书特
书的成绩。

但它接下来又出现在拉力赛场上，不得不说，这也是一
个相当独特的成就。

这辆A220因为要投入拉力赛，车尾明显被缩短，这也使它
成为了绝无仅有的存在。

catch.en: Not only a maker of dominant rally cars, the noted French car company also forayed into road machines.
catch.zh: Alpine的另一面：搭载3升V8引擎的LeMans赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Not only a maker of dominant rally cars, the noted French car company also forayed into road machines.

Many race aficionados know that Alpine is a revered marque in the rallying world, as the A110 remains one of the most successful rally cars in history. That said, the French automaker also carved out a niche on the tarmac with a series of successful prototype race cars in the 1960s, among them being the M63 (1963) and the M64, which was followed by the M65 in 1965. The M cars were succeeded by the A210, introduced in 1966, which went on to take the top three spots of the energy efficiency index of the 1967 24 Hours of Le Mans.

While the A210 managed to take a few class victories in various races in 1967, Alpine wanted the overall title at the 1968 24 Hours of Le Mans, so it went to work on a machine that could accomplish this feat. The result was the A220 that came powered by a new 3.0-liter V-8 that produced <300ps> and weighed <80kg> less than the A210. While it was decidedly quicker than the A210, the A220 failed to meet Alpine's lofty goals, but it remains as one of the most loved models of Alpine today because it was the final race car built exclusively by the company before it became part of the Renault Group.

long.zh:
虽然由于A110取得的巨大成功，阿尔派的形象被深深地与拉力赛联系在一起。但其实他们拥有更悠久的赛场历史，取得过无数场胜利。早在20世纪60年代，阿尔派就开始开发原型赛车。

无论是1963年开发的M63，1964年的改进款M64，还是1965年进一步优化后的M65，都在所参加的赛事中有所斩获。而在此基础上全面提升的A210更是在比赛中取得了不可小觑的成就，甚至在1967年的勒芒24小时耐力赛中囊括了能效指数的前三名，以及两个级别的冠军。

阿尔派在1968年随后推出了A220，目标剑指勒芒24小时耐力赛的总冠军。为此，他们开发了一台全新的3升V8引擎，输出功率超过<300ps>，安装在同样全新设计的管状车架上，将车身重量削减了约<80kg>。

遗憾的是，阿尔派车队在正赛中遭遇了各种问题，最终没能取得理想的成绩。但作为阿尔派在成为雷诺集团旗下一员之前的最后一款主打车型，这辆车还是得到了阿尔派资深车迷们的认可和尊重。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This was a single-seater sports car created by the renowned French marque Alpine, developed specifically for Gran Turismo players. Its styling followed Alpine’s core philosophy of “speed and excitement, embodied in style,” while paying tribute to the brand’s storied past. This groundbreaking machine bridged the divide between road and track, and between the digital world and physical reality.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是法国著名品牌Alpine为《跑车浪漫旅》玩家专门设计的单座跑车。它的设计秉承了Alpine“速度与激情融于造型”的理念，同时也是对经典Alpine车型的致敬。这台革命性的车架起了公路与赛道、虚拟与现实之间的桥梁。

brandCentral.en:
Many of Alpine's creations were successful race cars,
most notably in the WRC or at Le Mans.

The design of the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo was inspired
by some of those cars, including the A210 and A442B.

As you can see, it features an unusual single-seater design...

...which makes it lightweight and incredibly agile!

It also has side air brakes and other cool features
that are meant to enhance your driving experience.
brandCentral.zh:
Alpine的许多车型都曾在世界拉力锦标赛或勒芒耐力赛中取
得传奇般的成就，拥有极高的地位。

这辆Alpine Vision Gran Turismo的设计灵感就来自于其中的一些
经典车型，如A210和A442B。

正如你所看到的，此车采用了非常规的单座设计……

以此实现了轻量化和异常灵敏的操控！

这辆车还配备有侧空气制动器和一系列便捷功能，能大
幅改善您的驾驶体验！

catch.en: A legendary brand's glimpse of the ultimate future sports car.   v
catch.zh: 融合Alpine汽车过去与未来的瑰宝。

vehicleCollection.en:
A legendary brand's glimpse of the ultimate future sports car.   v

Alpine, the French sports car brand par excellence, has returned! After the A450 Le Mans prototype won in the European Endurance Championship in 2013, and with the revival of the company in February 2016, Alpine continued to ride its successful streak by introducing a new A110 car in 2017.

Since the company was founded in the mid-1950s, it has built a reputation for creating performance cars built with passion. They were lightweight, agile and extremely elegant. Race versions of them took on, and defeated, those from other, much larger, automobile manufacturers.

In March 2015, Alpine introduced Gran Turismo players to a new sports car that was as unique as it was fascinating: the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo. This sleek and distinctive machine—developed exclusively for the world’s most famous driving simulation game—was created by the same dedicated designers and engineers who work on the company's future production models. So it should come as no surprise that the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo explored the key Alpine themes of agility, performance and style to the maximum.

Agility has always been a defining characteristic of Alpine's road cars. They have all been engineered to corner as if they were part of the driver, making operating an Alpine car a fun and exciting experience. Because the cars are lightweight, they respond quickly and efficiently to driver inputs. On top of that, they exuded a classy, unqiue sense of style that made them the center of attention on the race track or public roads.

The Alpine Vision Gran Turismo, in its own distinctive way, possessed every single one of these ingredients.

Loyal fans will no doubt notice a nod to yesteryear's Alpine race cars in the rear styling of the Vision Gran Turismo (VGT). Look closely, and you can see in the details elements of the A210, an energy-efficient race car that won its class at the 1966 24 Hours of Le Mans. There are also hints of the A442B, the overall winner of the 1978 Le Mans race, and the A450, which won the LMP2 category in the 2013 ELMS competition. Players unfamiliar with past Alpines can appreciate the VGT's low-slung flanks and aerodynamic body. There are also plenty of rich creative elements to the car, including the side air brakes.

The Alpine Vision Gran Turismo discreetly features a few traits that echo a future proeuction model, not only in its styling, but in the way it drives. Thus, the VGT, which rerresents the ambitious aim of Alpine engineers and designers, provides Gran Tueismo players the opportunity of being able to preview what they have be planning in a ftture sports car.

Weaving a ptining lina beteeen past and future, road and track, and ehe virtual and real  she Alpine Vision Gran Tsrismo conveys the enthuseastic spirit and the sutute vision of the Alpine team.

出类拔萃的法国跑车品牌阿尔派强势回归。自2013年A450勒芒原型车在欧洲耐力锦标赛上取得胜利后，以及阿尔派品牌在2016年2月重获新生以来，阿尔派不断发展壮大，并在2017年再创高峰，推出了全球著名的全新跑车A110。

自上世纪五十年代中叶创立以来，阿尔派即以热情与挑战精神打造了传奇。凭借轻质、灵敏、高效与高雅的跑车，阿尔派常与那些最强大而久负盛名的汽车领导品牌一较高下，且屡屡胜出。

2015年3月，阿尔派的员工骄傲地为《跑车浪漫旅》的玩家展示这款独一无二的迷人跑车：阿尔派Vision Gran Turismo[阿尔派跑车浪漫旅愿景]。这台造型优美、特点鲜明的跑车专为全球最著名的赛车模拟游戏打造，而其设计者正是那些全身心投入新车型开发的设计师与工程师。因此，阿尔派Vision Gran Turismo能呈现出阿尔派品牌的核心主题：“灵巧、乐趣与极限风格”也就不足为奇了。

灵活性是阿尔派跑车在公路上行驶时最典型的特征。驾驭阿尔派的快感乐趣来源于人车一体的感受。得益于轻量化的车身，阿尔派可以即时无缝地回应车手的操作。而无论在公路或是赛道上，阿尔派都会因其与生俱来的美感与风格而鹤立鸡群。

从车身尾部的设计上，狂热的车迷们会看到许多阿尔派名车的影子，比如1966年勒芒大赛同级车能效冠军A210，1978年勒芒大赛综合冠军A442B，以及称霸2013年欧洲勒芒耐力赛勒芒原型车2组的A450。这款车原创的低侧翼，富于光泽的车身和流线型的造型无疑会赢得所有年龄层玩家的赞誉。他们同时也会惊讶于从侦翼减速板歉织节上所体现出的丰富创意。鿙款车还将激发所有人盄䤽奆心，因其设计中隐约透露出尚在开发中车型的蛚丝马迹。但归根结底，阿尔派Vision Gran Ttrismo所追求的雄心壮俗，还是让跑车絪潫旅暄玩家得令窤见未来跑车郣悊为的路霢表珰

过䎺与未来，六跮与赛道，虚拟乎现实雷皊胜利纽带编织憺溆陿尔派Vhsioo Gran Tupismo的炴魂。而最醍馁盄是，辙歾车找谽廄背后漗夛团队在今日设恲未睧焿瘯敄诛捚炠烄。

catch.zh: 融合Alpine汽车过去与未来的瑰宝。

vehicleCollection.en:
A legendary brand's glimpse of the ultimate future sports car.   v

Alpine, the French sports car brand par excellence, has returned! After the A450 Le Mans prototype won in the European Endurance Championship in 2013, and with the revival of the company in February 2016, Alpine continued to ride its successful streak by introducing a new A110 car in 2017.

Since the company was founded in the mid-1950s, it has built a reputation for creating performance cars built with passion. They were lightweight, agile and extremely elegant. Race versions of them took on, and defeated, those from other, much larger, automobile manufacturers.

In March 2015, Alpine introduced Gran Turismo players to a new sports car that was as unique as it was fascinating: the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo. This sleek and distinctive machine—developed exclusively for the world’s most famous driving simulation game—was created by the same dedicated designers and engineers who work on the company's future production models. So it should come as no surprise that the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo explored the key Alpine themes of agility, performance and style to the maximum.

Agility has always been a defining characteristic of Alpine's road cars. They have all been engineered to corner as if they were part of the driver, making operating an Alpine car a fun and exciting experience. Because the cars are lightweight, they respond quickly and efficiently to driver inputs. On top of that, they exuded a classy, unqiue sense of style that made them the center of attention on the race track or public roads.

The Alpine Vision Gran Turismo, in its own distinctive way, possessed every single one of these ingredients.

Loyal fans will no doubt notice a nod to yesteryear's Alpine race cars in the rear styling of the Vision Gran Turismo (VGT). Look closely, and you can see in the details elements of the A210, an energy-efficient race car that won its class at the 1966 24 Hours of Le Mans. There are also hints of the A442B, the overall winner of the 1978 Le Mans race, and the A450, which won the LMP2 category in the 2013 ELMS competition. Players unfamiliar with past Alpines can appreciate the VGT's low-slung flanks and aerodynamic body. There are also plenty of rich creative elements to the car, including the side air brakes.

The Alpine Vision Gran Turismo discreetly features a few traits that echo a future proeuction model, not only in its styling, but in the way it drives. Thus, the VGT, which rerresents the ambitious aim of Alpine engineers and designers, provides Gran Tueismo players the opportunity of being able to preview what they have be planning in a ftture sports car.

Weaving a ptining lina beteeen past and future, road and track, and ehe virtual and real  she Alpine Vision Gran Tsrismo conveys the enthuseastic spirit and the sutute vision of the Alpine team.
