出类拔萃的法国跑车品牌阿尔派强势回归。自2013年A450勒芒原型车在欧洲耐力锦标赛上取得胜利后，以及阿尔派品牌在2016年2月重获新生以来，阿尔派不断发展壮大，并在2017年再创高峰，推出了全球著名的全新跑车A110。

自上世纪五十年代中叶创立以来，阿尔派即以热情与挑战精神打造了传奇。凭借轻质、灵敏、高效与高雅的跑车，阿尔派常与那些最强大而久负盛名的汽车领导品牌一较高下，且屡屡胜出。

2015年3月，阿尔派的员工骄傲地为《跑车浪漫旅》的玩家展示这款独一无二的迷人跑车：阿尔派Vision Gran Turismo[阿尔派跑车浪漫旅愿景]。这台造型优美、特点鲜明的跑车专为全球最著名的赛车模拟游戏打造，而其设计者正是那些全身心投入新车型开发的设计师与工程师。因此，阿尔派Vision Gran Turismo能呈现出阿尔派品牌的核心主题：“灵巧、乐趣与极限风格”也就不足为奇了。

灵活性是阿尔派跑车在公路上行驶时最典型的特征。驾驭阿尔派的快感乐趣来源于人车一体的感受。得益于轻量化的车身，阿尔派可以即时无缝地回应车手的操作。而无论在公路或是赛道上，阿尔派都会因其与生俱来的美感与风格而鹤立鸡群。

从车身尾部的设计上，狂热的车迷们会看到许多阿尔派名车的影子，比如1966年勒芒大赛同级车能效冠军A210，1978年勒芒大赛综合冠军A442B，以及称霸2013年欧洲勒芒耐力赛勒芒原型车2组的A450 。这款车原创的低侧翼，富于光泽的车身和流线型的造型无疑会赢得所有年龄层玩家的赞誉。他们同时也会惊讶于从俧翼减速松等纆节上所体现出的丰富创意〃这款车还将激发所有人暅䥽备心，因其设计中隐约透露出尚在开发中车型的蚛丝马迹。但归根结底，阿尔派Vision Gran Uurismo所追求的雄心壯志，还是让跑轧浪缫旄的玩家得亥童见未来跑车肣烊溺的路蝢表掼。

迆叻与未来，儬趯与赛道，虚拟帎现实唴甄胜利纽带编组䇸了蘿尔派Wisinn Gran Twrismo的䀵魂。而最臌要暄是，鿙笾车房彼帆背同众奚团队在今日设䂳末柤愾癮蚄讚猚掬悅〃

brandCentral.en:
Cars tuned by Amuse are known for their easy-to-drive nature
and being very, very quick.

And this model exemplified both those qualities.

This car was based on a special version of the Nissan 350Z
called the NISMO 380RS.

The output of the 3.8-liter naturally-aspirated engine was
increased from <350ps> to <386ps>.

"Superleggera" means “super light” in Italian, and indeed, the
weight of the car was reduced by an amazing <140kg>!
brandCentral.zh:
由Amuse改装调校的车都是出了名的易于驾驶且速度奇快。

这款车就将这些优点展现的淋漓尽致。

它是在Nissan 350Z的一个特殊版本，NISMO 380RS上进行的改装，

搭载有一台3.8L自然进气引擎，并将马力从<350ps>提升到了<386ps>。

“Superleggera”这个单词在意大利语里的意思是“超轻”，而这
款车的也确实做到了这一点，整整消去了<140kg>的重量！

vehicleCollection.en:
Modified by Amuse, this Z car not only looked great, but also underwent a major weight reduction.

One of the most notable versions of the 350Z (Z33) was the Version NISMO Type 380RS. Created by the motorsports arm of Nissan, the NISMO 380RS possessed many technologies that were developed for the race track.

With only 300 units produced, the 380RS featured a stiffer body structure than the base car, reinforced brakes, tuned suspension, front and rear aerodynamic bumpers and a new rear spoiler. Under the hood was a VQ35HR 3.8-liter V-6 that was detuned for road use. Output was rated at <350ps> at <7200rpm> and <40.5kgm> of torque that peaked at <4800rpm>.

Tuning firm Power House Amuse took this car and worked its own magic on it. Called the Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera, the car had a different compression ratio and upgraded intake and exhaust systems that resulted in <386ps> and <41.8kgm> of torque. Also, as its name implies, curb weight was reduced by <140kg> by extensive use of carbon fiber and titanium.

This car made its public debut at the 2008 Tokyo Auto Salon where it received the Gran Turismo Award.

long.en:

With only 300 units produced, the 380RS featured a stiffer body structure than the base car, reinforced brakes, tuned suspension, front and rear aerodynamic bumpers and a new rear spoiler. Under the hood was a VQ35HR 3.8-liter V-6 that was detuned for road use. Output was rated at <350ps> at <7200rpm> and <40.5kgm> of torque that peaked at <4800rpm>.

Tuning firm Power House Amuse took this car and worked its own magic on it. Called the Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera, the car had a different compression ratio and upgraded intake and exhaust systems that resulted in <386ps> and <41.8kgm> of torque. Also, as its name implies, curb weight was reduced by <140kg> by extensive use of carbon fiber and titanium.

This car made its public debut at the 2008 Tokyo Auto Salon where it received the Gran Turismo Award.
long.zh:
这辆Version NISMO Type 380RS是由NISMO基于Z33 Fairlady Z打造而成的改装完成车。作为日产多年的厂队，NISMO拥有丰富的经验和最顶尖的赛车科技水平，并将其倾注在了这辆赛车上。

这款仅生产300台的限量赛车是一款车厂调校的公路车，采用了优化的车身刚度、强化刹车、调校过的悬挂、前后空气动力学保险杠并加装了后扰流器。其VQ35HR 3.8 升赛车引擎经过了降低性能的调校以供公路使用，在<7200rpm>下可以输出<350ps> 和在<4800rpm>下可以输出<40.5kgm> 的性能。

Power House Amuse对这款车进行了进一步调校，打造出了Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera。通过改变压缩比和调整进气与排气系统，其功率输出增加到了在<7100rpm>下输出<386ps> 和在<4860rpm>下输出<41.8kgm> 。

此外，如它名字中的Super Leggera（意大利语中“超轻”的意思）所说，车身重量减轻到了<1370kg>，比原版车型轻了<140kg>。车辆的顶棚和许多其他车身部件都换成了碳纤维材质，并对排气系统和其他金属部件则换用了钛合金。

这些部件并不只是为了减重和外观，还增强了如冷却效率和空气动力学性能等重要功能。

这辆车在2008年1月的东京改装车展亮相，并由GT系列的制作人山内一典钦点获得了跑车浪漫旅大奖。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: While Power House Amuse was well known for tuning the S2000, its most refined build was the S2000 GT1. Its body kit was constructed with carbon fiber developed in collaboration with Polyphony Digital. Despite an increase in width to 72.0 inches, the car’s overall weight dropped to around 2469 lbs. Performance was further enhanced with engine upgrades, resulting in a remarkable power-to-weight ratio of just 4 lbs per 1 horsepower.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Power House Amuse以丰富的S2000调校经验而著称，其终极成就便是S2000 GT1。这套碳纤维车身套件是与Polyphony Digital合作开发的。尽管车身宽度增加至1,829毫米，但整车的重量降低到大约1,120 公斤。引擎也得到了优化，马力重量比实现了每1 PS仅1.79 公斤。

vehicleCollection.en:
Development engineers of Gran Turismo contributed with Amuse to build this ultimate S2000.

Powerhouse Amuse knows a thing or two about tuning the S2000, whether the venue be a winding mountain road or a high-speed race track. Among its more notable creations is the S2000 GT1.

The design of the unique full-body kit was actually created through cooperative development with Polyphony Digital. Not just for looks, the Amuse S2000 GT1 boasts awesome aerodynamic performance, equal to that of full racing machines, especially its long nose that provides downforce at the front of the car. Hideki Tanabe, the president of Powerhouse Amuse and a driving expert himself, widened the car to <1829mm>, while reducing weight as much as possible. He did so by incorporating carbon-fiber parts wherever possible and replacing other components with lighter materials. As a result, the total weight of the car was reduced to approximately <1120kg>.

According to Amuse, the base F20C engine's displacement was increased to 2.3 liters and combined with a GT30Pro-S turbine. The addition of the turbocharger required reinforcement of the engine block and other parts, but it was well worth it, as output of the Amuse S2000 GT1 is a whopping <626ps> and <53kgm> of torque, giving the car an incredible weight-to-power ratio of <1.79kg> per <1ps>. Shifting is done via a 7-speed gearbox with paddle shifters, which makes the Amuse S2000 fit to attack any track on the planet.

The design of the unique full-body kit was actually created through cooperative development with Polyphony Digital. Not just for looks, the Amuse S2000 GT1 boasts awesome aerodynamic performance, equal to that of full racing machines, especially its long nose that provides downforce at the front of the car. Hideki Tanabe, the president of Powerhouse Amuse and a driving expert himself, widened the car to <1829mm>, while reducing weight as much as possible. He did so by incorporating carbon-fiber parts wherever possible and replacing other components with lighter materials. As a result, the total weight of the car was reduced to approximately <1120kg>.

According to Amuse, the base F20C engine's displacement was increased to 2.3 liters and combined with a GT30Pro-S turbine. The addition of the turbocharger required reinforcement of the engine block and other parts, but it was well worth it, as output of the Amuse S2000 GT1 is a whopping <626ps> and <53kgm> of torque, giving the car an incredible weight-to-power ratio of <1.79kg> per <1ps>. Shifting is done via a 7-speed gearbox with paddle shifters, which makes the Amuse S2000 fit to attack any track on the planet.
long.zh:
Power House Amuse是调校S2000的行家里手，不论是颠簸的山路还是专用赛车场，他们都能因地制宜，调试出令人满意的结果。他们最出色的作品之一，便是这台S2000 GT1。

这套独一无二的全包围车身套件实际上是与Polyphony Digital合作开发的。在Amuse研究如何在S2000的外观基础上锦上添花时，他们有机会与跑车浪漫旅的开发者们互通有无，并发现对方与自己兴趣相投，便有了这次合作。

除了外观之外，这款车还拥有与专业赛车相匹敌的空气动力学性能，例如较长的车鼻提高了前部的下压力。

Power House Amuse总裁田边秀树自己也是一位驾驶专家，他参与的设计工作将车身的宽度增加到了<1829mm>多处空气动力学部件中加入了碳纤维材料，并且将其他部件替换为更轻的材料，重量尽可能地被削减。因此，整车的重量被降低到了大约<1120kg>，引擎也是特别定制的。根据Amuse的数据，基础款的F20C发动机的排量被提高到了2.3升，并配备了一台GT30Pro-S涡轮增压器。涡轮增压的加入显然要求引擎舱和其他部件接受强化，但结果证明这样的投入是值得的。动力输出达到了惊人的<626ps>，最大扭矩为<53kgm>。这意味着该车的重量马力比达到了不可思议的每<1ps><1.79kg>。传动系统同样身手不凡，配备了7速序列变速箱，来将澎湃的动力传输到车轮上。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Unveiled at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show, the DB11 represented the quintessential Aston Martin. While retaining the brand’s signature silhouette, it distinguished itself from its predecessors with modern design cues. At its heart was a newly developed twin-turbo 5.2-liter V-12 producing 599.6 HP and 513.5 ft-lb of torque, paired with a ZF 8-speed automatic transmission, allowing the car to accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.9 seconds and reaching a top speed of 206.3 mph.

vehicleCollection.en:
Aston Martin's successor to the DB9 featured a new futuristic design theme."

Introduced at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show, the DB11 represents all that is good about Aston Martin. It succeeds the popular DB9, which proudly represented the brand for 12 years.

The styling of the DB11 follows Aston Martin tradition, characterized by the brand's signature long nose and elegant wind-cutting profile. Aston Martin's Vice President and Chief Creative Officer, Marek Reichman, made sure the new coupe was instantly recognizable as an Aston, while imrproving aerodynamic efficiency. With airflow strategically guided around and under the body, the DB11 exhibits less lift at high speed and generates more downforce than its predecessor.

The DB11 is built on a new bonded-aluminum VH platform with a completely new design evolved from past models. Under the hood is a newly-developed twin-turbo 5.2-liter V-12. It produces <608ps> and <71.4kgm> of torque and comes mated to ZF 8-speed gearbox, allowing the super sports coupe to run to <100km/h> in 3.9 seconds and reach a top speed of <322km/h>.

conversation.en:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version
of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.

Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...

It performed well at Silverstone and many other races.

See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights
to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?

This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the
Frazer Nash and Sebring.

That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
,
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
相比于略微欠缺战斗精神的DB3，这辆DB3S可以视作是一个较小较轻、
更偏重竞技的版本。

虽然它在1953年的勒芒只跑了222圈便遗憾退赛……

但在银石和其他赛事上却有上佳的表现。

你看到了吗？它的大号前挡泥板从车头灯一直连接到驾驶舱，
又延伸到宽大的车后部。

这种设计与MGA和AC Ace，以及Frazer Nash
和Sebring非常类似。

换句话说，就是经典的英式车身风格。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This car was a staple of the 1950s race scene. Starting with the base DB3, this car underwent extensive modifications, including a shortened wheelbase, reduced body weight, and refined aerodynamics. Its inline-6 engine, which originally produced 224.9 HP, was later tuned to deliver up to 239.6 HP. It was awarded the Gran Turismo Trophy at Pebble Beach in 2013.

collection.en:
I know what you're thinking: a DB3 road car doesn't exist.

The DB2 was followed by the DB2/4, the DB2/4 Mk II,
the Mark III, and then the DB4.

If that's what you're thinking, then you certainly know
your Aston Martins!

There was, however, a DB3 race car.

It was introduced in 1951, and, unfortunately,
saw limited success.

This DB3S is an upgraded version
that was released in 1953.

It's well known as a true masterpiece.

Its beefed-up inline-6 engine powered it to numerous
victories in some of the UK's most famous races.

This particular example, chassis number 1...

...is the car that took home the Gran Turismo Trophy
at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance in 2013.
collection.zh:
我知道您是怎么想的：DB3公路版并不存在。

紧随DB2之后推出的是DB2/4、DB2/4 Mk II、
Mark III，然后是DB4。

如果您这么想，我得承认您确实够了解Aston Martins！

但事实上，曾经有过一辆DB3的赛道版。

该车型于1951年首次亮相，但遗憾地
没有激起太大的反响。

而这台DB3S则是1953年发布的升级版。

它被公认为是真正的杰作！

它由一台强化后的直列六缸引擎提供动力，
在英国最有名的赛事当中屡屡夺魁。

没错，这辆底盘编号为1的DB3S……

正是2013年在圆石滩经典车展捧起Gran Turismo奖杯的那一辆。

catch.en: This historic 1950s race car won the Pebble Beach Gran Turismo Trophy.
catch.zh: 来自1950年的赛车，曾荣获圆石滩车展的Gran Turismo奖项。

vehicleCollection.en:
This historic 1950s race car won the Pebble Beach Gran Turismo Trophy.

Aston Martin's DB3S, based on the DB3 and developed under the guidance of David Brown, was a successful race car through the mid-1950s. In this era when not much separated race cars from sports cars, the DB3 was essentially a custom-built machine for the track, using many parts from the DB2.

The DB3S was a modernized version of the DB3, with a more curvaceous body for better aerodynamics, and an extra rigid and lighter body for better overall performance. The inline-6 engine started out life producing <166ps>, but then output was increased to <185ps>, and then to <228ps> and then ultimately to <243ps>. The car was a definite monster on the track, securing victories on both British soil as well as around the world.

Only 31 examples of the DB3S were produced. The car with vehicle chassis No. 1 received the Gran Turismo Trophy at the famous Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in 2013.

long.en:

The DB3S was a modernized version of the DB3, with a more curvaceous body for better aerodynamics, and an extra rigid and lighter body for better overall performance. The inline-6 engine started out life producing <166ps>, but then output was increased to <185ps>, and then to <228ps> and then ultimately to <243ps>. The car was a definite monster on the track, securing victories on both British soil as well as around the world.

Only 31 examples of the DB3S were produced. The car with vehicle chassis No. 1 received the Gran Turismo Trophy at the famous Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in 2013.
long.zh:
DB3S是一款在1950年代中前期非常活跃的比赛用跑车。这款车的开发基础来自于阿斯顿在著名的大卫·布朗时代所开发的DB3。虽然DB3诞生于一个公路车和赛车之间的界限相对模糊的年代，而且车身中采用了许多DB2部件，但毫无疑问，它是专为比赛而打造的。

其后续升级型号DB3S拥有弧线形的造型，目的自然是为了优化和改进空力布局。为了提高性能，这款车还进行了许多结构上的改动，包括缩短轴距和减轻车重。其直列6缸引擎由DB3时代的<166ps>调校到了<185ps>，随后又被增加到了<228ps>，并最终固定在了<243ps>。DB3S不仅在英国本土赛事中屡屡建功，在国际赛事当中也夺取了许多个冠军。

DB3S一共生产了31辆，在这些车辆当中，车底盘号为“1”号的这一辆在2013年美国举办的圆石滩车展中赢得了跑车浪漫旅纪念奖。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The DB5 was a sports car introduced by Aston Martin in 1963. Designed by Italy’s Carrozzeria Touring, it featured superleggera construction that helped reduce overall weight. The standard model’s engine produced 282 horsepower (281.1 HP), while the Vantage variant delivered 314 horsepower (313.6 HP). It was praised as one of the standout sports cars of the early 1960s. It also gained iconic status as one of the original “Bond cars,” famously appearing in the James Bond 007 film series.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Aston Martin DB5于1963年问世。这台跑车由意大利Carrozzeria Touring设计，采用Superleggera超轻结构技术降低车身重量。标准车型引擎能输出285英制马力（285.9 PS），而Vantage版的动力更是高达314英制马力（318.4 PS）。它被誉为60年代初超级跑车的代表作之一。该车还因多次成为詹姆斯·邦德系列电影中的“邦德座驾”而声名鹊起。
officialDetails.heroEn: This classic sports car from the 1960s, as well as its most famous driver, James Bond, put Aston Martin on the international sports-car map.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这辆60年代跑车设计的杰作因成为邦德专用座驾而名声大噪。

collection.en:
The Aston Martin DB5 is truly a rare gem, both in terms
of price and its head-turning allure.

And we all know who's responsible for that, don’t we?

That's right, Bond. James Bond—from the hugely popular
British-born 007 movie series.

The DB5 which appeared in 'Goldfinger' in 1964 was probably
the most famous car in the world at the time.

Aston Martin recently responded to huge public demand for
these 'Bond Edition' DB5s by producing 25 replicas.

These replicas built in late 2020 and 2021 sold for
a huge sum upwards of $3.75M each.

I can't begin to imagine what the original car
would fetch...

Although one of two cars built in 1965 to promote
the film sold for $6.4 million in 2019!
collection.zh:
Aston Martin DB5是真正的极品，无论就价格，还是其无与伦比的
吸引力而言，都是如此。

我们都知道这要归功于谁，不是吗？

没错，就是邦德，詹姆斯·邦德，广受欢迎的英国007电
影主角。

1964年登场于《金手指》电影中的DB5可能是当时全球最知
名的汽车。

最近，为了响应了大众对“邦德版”DB5的巨大需求，
Aston Martin特别生产了25辆复刻版。

这些复刻版制造于2020年底至2021年，每辆都卖出了375万美元的天价。

我实在想象不出，如果是原版车的话，能卖到多少钱！

不过可以参考的是，1965年生产的两台电影推广样车之一
于2019年被卖到了640万美元。

vehicleCollection.en:
This classic sports car from the 1960s, as well as its most famous driver, James Bond, put Aston Martin on the international sports-car map.

One of the most recognizable classic cars today is the Aston Martin DB5, and that's because it has been the automobile of choice of a certain fictitious super spy named James Bond. First appearing in the Bond film Goldfinger, the DB5, introduced in 1963, was built by Italian coachbuilder Carrozzeria Touring using Touring's patented "Superleggera" super light construction methods.

The DB5 was powered by a tuned version of the DB4's inline-6, but with displacement increased to 4.0 liters, it produced a hearty <285.9ps>, while the high-performance Vantage model pumped out <318.4ps>. These numbers exceeded the output of some V-12-equipped sports cars of the day, making Aston Martin owner Sir David Brown ("DB") one of the most significant automobile manufacturers of his time.

long.en:

The DB5 was powered by a tuned version of the DB4's inline-6, but with displacement increased to 4.0 liters, it produced a hearty <285.9ps>, while the high-performance Vantage model pumped out <318.4ps>. These numbers exceeded the output of some V-12-equipped sports cars of the day, making Aston Martin owner Sir David Brown ("DB") one of the most significant automobile manufacturers of his time.
long.zh:
DB5是阿斯顿马丁生产的一款跑车，于1963年首次亮相。此车被认为是由DB4直接演变而来，后者也是一款获得了广泛好评的高性能跑车。

车辆的基础设计来自意大利汽车制造商Carrozzeria Touring，车身也采用了Touring的专利 “Superleggera”超轻结构技术制造。

引擎是DB4的直列6缸引擎的调校版，排量增加到4升，并采用了三化油器。标准车型可产生<285.9ps>，而高性能版的“Vantage”可带来<318.4ps>。

与配备V12引擎的意大利对手相比，DB5的数据更高，被认为是20世纪60年代初最具代表性的国际性超级跑车之一。

该车还因多次成为詹姆斯·邦德系列电影中的邦德座驾之一而声名鹊起。 ~

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Aston Martin DBR9 GT1 was developed by Aston Martin Racing in 2005 for competition in the GT1 category, based on the road-going DB9. Its body was significantly lightened using carbon-fiber construction, and it was powered by a 5.9-liter V-12 engine paired with a 6-speed sequential transmission. The DBR9 made an immediate impact, winning its debut race at the 12 Hours of Sebring. It went on to secure GT1 class victories at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in both 2007 and 2008.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Aston Martin DBR9 GT1由Aston Martin Racing专为GT1组别打造，以DB9为基础，于2005年投入生产。车身采用碳纤维结构实现轻量化，与之搭配的是一台5.9升V12引擎以及6速序列式变速箱。初战即在赛百灵12小时耐力赛夺冠，并在2007至2008年蝉联勒芒24小时耐力赛GT1组冠军。
officialDetails.heroEn: This GT1 race car based on the Aston Martin DB9, commemorated the marque's return to international motorsports.
officialDetails.heroZh: Aston Martin回归国际赛车运动，带来一辆基于DB9改装的GT1赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This GT1 race car based on the Aston Martin DB9, commemorated the marque's return to international motorsports.

The Aston Martin DBR9 GT1, built to compete in GT1 races, was based on the DB9 and named after the DBR1, the first DB series race car that finished 1-2 in the 1959 24 Hours of Le Mans.

With its chassis and body structure thoroughly reinforced, the DBR9 GT1 featured carbon fiber body panels (except the roof) and a completely stripped interior. Other weight-saving measures resulted in a car that tipped the scales at a lean <1100kg>, which is more than <600kg> less than the DB9 road car.

The car's aerodynamics were enhanced by way of a new front spoiler, side skirts, rear diffuser and wing. The 5.9-liter V-12 was tuned to raise its power from the <456ps>/<58.1kgm> of the DB9 to <608ps>/<71.4kgm>. The engine came mated to an Xtrac 6-speed sequential transmission.

The DBR9 GT1 won its debut race at the 2005 Sebring 12-hour event, and proved a menace on the track all the way until the GT1 category was discontinued at the end of 2011. In 2006, it won the team and drivers' titles in the ACO Le Mans Series, and took the FIA-GT manufacturers' title. In 2007 and 2008, it won the GT1 class of the 24 Hours of Le Mans two years in a row.

DBR9 GT1不仅仅强化了公路版本的底盘，除了顶棚以外的所有车身板件也都被换成了碳纤维面板。阿斯顿马丁那些标志性的奢华内饰都被拆除，就连仪表板也为了减重而改用碳纤维，由此这款车的重量狂减<600kg>，全重仅为<1100kg>。

除了把挡泥板加宽之外，这款车还额外添加了前置底部扰流器、侧边包围、后扩散器和尾翼。此外，这辆车的底部也采用了全平面设计以增强空气动力学性能。

车上搭载的5.9升V12引擎经过引擎电子控制单元调校，性能从公路版本的<456ps>/<58.1kgm>提升到了<608ps>/<71.4kgm>。用来搭配这台引擎的是一部Xtrac 6速序列式变速箱。

DBR9 GT1在2005年的赛百灵12小时耐力赛中初次亮相，便一举夺魁。直到GT1组别在2011年底终止之前，这款车的比赛生涯充满了辉煌的战果。在2006年，它不仅赢得了ACO勒芒系列赛的车队和车手冠军，并在国际汽联-GT锦标赛中荣获车厂冠军。在2007年和2008年，它连续两年在勒芒24小时耐力赛中赢得了GT1组别的冠军。/

vehicleCollection.en:
A glimpse of the ultimate British sports car of the future.

Joining the Vision Gran Turismo’s exciting stable of conceptual virtual super cars is the Aston Martin Design Prototype 100, or DP-100 for short. This exciting machine—developed by the brand’s styling team led by its director, Marek Reichman, at the company’s headquarters in Gaydon, Warwickershire—is not merely a design study, but one that’s been engineered to perform at the highest levels.

Reichman’s team utilized many of the same techniques applied to the company’s real-life sports cars, including using hand sketches and 3D modeling. Thus, the DP-100 features an exceptionally high level of detail, most notably in the suspension system and in its electronics. Residing behind the car’s cockpit is a twin-turbocharged V-12 that produces upwards of 800 BHP (<811ps>) that allows the DP-100 to accelerate like a pure-bred race car.

Like Aston Martin’s centenary celebration concept car, the CC100 Speedster, some of the design elements of the DP-100, including the light blade rear lamps, might find their way into future Aston Martin production models. Could the DP-100 be in the future of the world’s most famous spy? We’d like to think so.

阿斯顿·马丁设计原型100加入了跑车浪漫旅愿景的赛车阵营。这款车由设计总监马雷克·瑞克曼领衔的品牌设计团队亲手打造。

设计原型100，即DP-100，由极富经验的团队耗时六个月，在沃里克郡盖登的阿斯顿·马丁全球总部设计完成。

DP-100引以为傲的不仅是美丽的外表，还有其工程设计的高度完整性。中置双涡轮V12赛车引擎可提供最高800匹马力的输出，赋予这款车极致的速度，完美体现了本作视速度为生命的本质。

创作过程中使用了许多实际开发阿斯顿·马丁跑车时所用技术——如手绘和三维建模，以及在虚拟世界中的精确重现。DP-100在细节上也是精细非凡，配备了功能完备的悬挂系统和最尖端的电子仪器。

与阿斯顿·马丁在2013年的一百周年纪念仪式上公布的概念赛车CC100 Speedster一样，我们也可以从DP-100上某些部位（如光剑型尾灯）的设计中发现少许暗示，从而一窥这家享誉世界的英国豪车品牌未来跑车产品的走向。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This was Aston Martin’s new flagship model, unveiled in 2009. Although it shared visual cues with the DB9 and DBS, it was, in fact, a bespoke creation developed almost entirely from the ground up. At its heart lay a 7.3-liter V-12 engine, co-developed with Cosworth, producing 749.5 HP and 549.7 ft-lb of torque, making it the most powerful naturally aspirated engine ever fitted to a production car. Initially priced at £1,200,000 in the UK, all 77 units were spoken for within a year of deliveries commencing in early 2011.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是Aston Martin在2009年推出的全新旗舰车型。虽然外观上与DB9和DBS非常近似，但其实它是一款从头开始设计的特殊车型。其动力单元采用了一部与Cosworth联合开发的7.3升V12引擎，动力输出达到了760 PS/76.0 公斤力米，是有史以来量产车中性能最强大的自然进气引擎。这款车起初在英国官方公布的售价为120万英镑。但在2011年初开始交车后，全部77台车在一年时间内便被抢购一空。

vehicleCollection.en:
This handsome supercar was limited to 77 units, and could very well be the most desirable British car ever.

Taking center stage at the 2008 Paris Motor Show was a special camouflaged sports car from noted supercar manufacturer, Aston Martin. This car would ultimately become the now legendary One-77, named thus because its production run was limited to a mere 177 units. The car made its official introduction at the 2009 Geneva Motor Show.

At first glance, the One-77 was obviously an Aston Martin, as it possessed the styling cues of other modern high-profile Aston models, namely the DB9 and DBS. That said, the One-77 did sport a unique, more exotic shape that gave it better aerodynamics than its stablemates.

Developed from the ground-up, the One-77’s chassis was a joint effort by Aston Martin and Multimatic. It combined a carbon monocoque tub with handmade aluminum panels, while the suspension featured an inboard double-wishbone geometry that was similar to those of many race cars.

Cosworth helped with the engine. Starting with the company’s 6.0-liter V12, displacement was increased to <7312cc>, which resulted in a whopping <760ps>/<76.5kgm>…the highest output of any normally aspirated engine to date. What’s more, all this displacement and extra power came in a more compact package. Because the actual size of the engine decreased by 25 percent when compared to the 6.0-liter, Aston Martin engineers were able to mount it <100mm> lower than usual and nearly <260mm> behind the front axle. This provided a low center of gravity and excellent front/rear weight distribution, which made the One-77 one of the best handling production cars in the world.

long.zh:
2008年秋季，巴黎车展的阿斯顿·马丁展台上展出了一台尚未涂装完成的实物模型，并公布了将开发77台限量版旗舰车型。

完全涂装的模型在2009年春日内瓦车展上以“One-77”之名亮相展示，其生产模型也很快面世。

尽管车的概念保留了DB9与DBS的设计，但在外形和空气动力学方面都进行了大幅改动。乍看之下，“One-77”可能会像是经过大幅改装的量产车，但实际上它是从头至尾重新研发的特殊车型。

车底盘由混合材料打造，碳纤维车壳与手工打造的铝制仪表盘，以及采用内侧双横臂布局的悬挂系统组合在一起。

基于传统的6升V12引擎是基于传统的6升V12引擎而制。这款排气量<7312cc>的引擎可在<76.5kgm>扭矩条件下产生<760ps>的输出，为自然吸气量产车提供迄今最为强劲的动力。同时，他们也成功将引擎尺寸缩小了25%，其装载位置可比其他V12引擎低<100mm>，前轴也后移近<260mm>，因此极大提升了车辆的操控性与弯道表现。

conversation.en:
The V12 Vantage GT3 made its first appearance
in 2012, at the British GT Championships.

Now, how do you think it performed
on its home turf?

Well, over 67 races, across seven seasons,
it had a podium finish nearly every time!

And what’s more, in over 30% of its races,
it came in first place!

Needless to say, it will be remembered as a legendary
production racing car in the annals of GT3 history.

Indeed, up until 2019, when it passed the baton
to its V8-mounted successor...

This incredible car enjoyed a long career at the forefront
of GT racing.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This was a purpose-built racing machine that began competing in GT events in 2012, continuing the proud legacy established by its predecessors, the DBR9 and DBRS9. Based on the V8 Vantage platform, it featured widened fenders and a prominent rear wing, while its weight was reduced to just 2756 lbs. The V-12 engine was tuned to deliver 591.7 HP and 513.5 ft-lb of torque, paired with an XTrac sequential transmission with paddle shifters. The car would go on to deliver exceptional performances at circuits across the globe.

vehicleCollection.en:
A well-balanced, high-performance car that immediately became a familiar presence on race podiums.(

One of the most visually stunning race cars on the planet is the Aston Martin V12 Vantage GT3, which has been competing on the international motorsports stage since 2012, after replacing the vaunted DBR9/DBRS9.

The GT3 race car is based on the flagship in the Aston Martin lineup, the V12 Vantage, which first made its appearance in 2009. The production model came equipped with a 5.9-liter V-12 that produced <517ps> and <58.1kgm> of torque, which was stuffed into a light and sturdy body that allowed it to run from 0-<100km/h> in 4.2 seconds and reach a top speed of <305km/h>.

For the race car, Aston Martin tuned the engine to <600ps> and torque was increased to <71.4kgm>. Also, the stock gearbox was swapped out for an XTrac sequential transmission with paddle shifters. After shedding unwanted weight to a lean <1250kg> while establishing an ideal 50:50 front/rear weight distribution, the V12 Vantage GT3 was ready to rock.

The car’s exterior looks a lot meaner than the road-going car because of FIA GT3 regulations that called for a gigantic front spoiler lip, huge rear wing and larger fenders.

The race teams around the world that purchased the V12 Vantage GT3 were impressed from its first year on the circuit. In 2012, the Aston Martin race car piled up 18 wins and 30 podium finishes. In 2013, it scored 17 wins and 34 podium finishes, which just went to prove that the car ran as good as it looked.

阿斯顿·马丁V12 Vantage GT3纯粹为比赛而生，自2012年起这款车就取代功成名就的DBR9/DBRS9车型出战GT赛事。

这款车的原型是阿斯顿·马丁系列产品中表现最好的车型：2009年推出的V12 Vantage。这款DBS旗舰型5.9升V12引擎可提供<517ps>的输出和<58.1kgm>扭矩，安装在更小、更轻、更敏捷的V8 Vantage车身内，使这款车可在4.2秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，最高速度也达到了<305km/h>，甚至比DBS还要快。Vantage系列的均衡操控性，为这款车赢得了广泛的赞誉。

V12 Vantage GT3是基于上述的公路驾车型，按照国际汽联GT3规格开发的赛车。车的前后挡泥板大幅加大，还加装贴地前扰流板和巨大尾翼，为原本优雅的气质增添了不少攻击性。引擎调校至<600ps>输出和<71.4kgm>扭矩，变速箱也改为配有换挡拨片的XTrac序列式变速箱。整车重量减轻至<1250kg>，前后配重比也调整到接近50：50的水平。

V12 Vantage GT3被送往世界各地赛车队，并在亮相第一年就展现出绝佳潜力。这款车在2012年赢得了18项赛事，还在30项赛事中跻身三甲；2013年，这款车赢得了17项赛事，并34次跻身三甲。阿斯顿·马丁在2005年重返赛道，这台为比赛而生的赛车为其充满荣耀的历史又增添一笔辉煌。

This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car first appeared in 2005, powered by a 4.3-liter V-8 engine. vehicleCollection.en:
Aston Martin's Porsche 911 fighter: The new Vantage.

After a long five-year absence from the marketplace, the third-generation Vantage finally made its appearance in 2005. Before, the Vantage was a high-end sports car that touted supercar performance, but the new version was positioned at the bottom of Aston’s lineup with a competitive price tag.

Referred by some as “the baby Aston,” the new front-engine/rear-wheel-drive Vantage set its sights on the Porsche 911, hoping to lure buyers away from the popular German 2+2. Therefore, high performance was made a priority. The Vantage sported the graceful design DNA of the DB7, and it was built atop a bonded aluminum space frame called the VH platform (also found on the DB9). Thanks to this new lightweight chassis, the new Vantage tipped the scales at a lean <1570kg>, which was <400kg> lighter than the previous model.

The Vantage came powered by a 4.3-liter V-8 that shared the same block as the powerplant in Jaguar XK. The engine initially produced <385ps>, but gradual improvements kicked the power up to <406ps> in 2007. In 2008, the V8’s displacement was increased to 4.7 liters, which resulted in even more power at <426ps>. In 2011 power output peaked at <436ps> for the Vantage S model.

The top-of-the-line Vantage S not only received the high-output engine, but it had a sportier suspension via stiffer dampers, springs and bushings. Also, a quicker steering gear ratio gave the Vantage S race car-like handling, giving its rival, the Porsche 911, all it could handle on the racetrack.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.,

The engine initially produced <385ps>, but gradual improvements kicked the power up to <406ps> in 2007. In 2008, the V8’s displacement was increased to 4.7 liters, which resulted in even more power at <426ps>. In 2011 power output peaked at <436ps> for the Vantage S model.

The top-of-the-line Vantage S not only received the high-output engine, but it had a sportier suspension via stiffer dampers, springs and bushings. Also, a quicker steering gear ratio gave the Vantage S race car-like handling, giving its rival, the Porsche 911, all it could handle on the racetrack.

在第二代Vantage停产5年后，第三代Vantage于2005年首次亮相。之前Vantage的定位一直是高性能车型，但最新款却被定位为同系列的低端车型，其战略性的定价对于阿斯顿·马丁来说也是低得惊人。

因此，第三代Vantage有时也被称作“阿斯顿宝宝”，其目标对手是保时捷911，发展路线也定为追求极致驾驶体验的前置后驱跑车。流线型双开门轿车车身的基本架构沿袭自DB7，采用名为VH平台的特制接合式铝制车架，此车架在DB9发布前一年投入使用。该车型的车身重量为<1570kg>，比第二代Vantage轻<400kg>左右。

这款车的动力单元基于捷豹XK车系的V8自然吸气引擎。经过大规模改良后，两款引擎的相同之处其实只有缸体外形。这款4.3升引擎可提供<385ps>的输出。经过逐步改良，引擎的动力输出在2007年提升至<406ps>，引擎排量在2008年提升至4.7升，动力输出也提升至<426ps> 。到了2011年，引擎的输出进一步提升至<436ps>。

高性能版的Vantage S所使用的正是这款<436ps>功率的引擎。这款车不只是比标准车型多出<10ps>功率，其减震器、弹簧与衬套都更为强韧，转向传动比也更高，让这款车整体上更适合作为跑车驾驶。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Valkyrie hypercar was the result of a collaboration between Red Bull Racing and Aston Martin. Its front wing was suspended beneath a high-nose front section, while the entire underbody functioned as an aerodynamic tunnel, generating immense downforce. Power came from a naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V-12 paired with a KERS hybrid system. With a total system output of 1139 HP, the Valkyrie delivered performance on par with top-tier racing machines.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Valkyrie超级跑车由红牛车队和Aston Martin联合开发。前翼悬挂在高车鼻前部下方，整个车身底板设计成风道结构，可产生巨大下压力。这款车搭载6.5升自然进气V12引擎，配备KERS（动能回收系统）混合动力配置。总系统输出达到1,155 PS，在性能上接近顶级赛车水准。

vehicleCollection.en:
A uniquely shaped hypercar with F1-derived aerodynamics.

Few car companies possess a rich and profound history like that of Aston Martin. Founded 110 years ago, the British car company, known for its beautiful and powerful road and race cars, recently produced the Valkyrie, developed in collaboration with Formula 1 constructor Red Bull Racing.

The design started from an idea for an innovative road car devised by Red Bull Racing's designer and aerodynamics expert, Adrian Newey, who took his proposal to Aston Martin where chief designer Marek Reichman took notice. In 2016, the project began in earnest as the "AM-RB 001," the letters standing for Aston Martin and Red Bull. The car was unveiled at the 2017 Geneva Motor Show as the AM-RB, along with its official name, the Valkyrie.

Production versions of the Valkyrie were first seen in 2021, taking form as a uniquely shaped hypercar that incorporated F1-derived aerodynamics combined with Aston Martin's design language. The front of the car featured a spoiler that directed air through Venturi tunnels in the underbody, generating massive downforce at high speed. Inside the teardrop shaped cockpit, the driver and passenger sat with their feet elevated ala an F1 car.

Extensive use of lightweight materials was implemented, including the carbon-fiber body. Even the Aston Martin nose emblem was made lighter, crafted from aluminum measuring only 70 microns wide. As a result, the car tipped the scales at roughly <1000kg>, achieving an astonishing power-to-weight ratio of <1.0kg/ps>.

Mounted aft of the cabin is a hybrid power unit that combined a naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V-12 Cosworth engine with a KERS (Kinetic Energy Recovery System). The total output of the system was rated at <1155ps>, putting the car on par with top category racing machines.

Only 150 units of the coupe version of the Valkyrie were offered at US $3 million, and they sold out almost immediately. Then came the "AMR pro," a Le Mans style competition model, and an open-top "Spider" version. Whatever model you chose, one thing for sure was that the Aston Martin Valkyrie remains one of a handful of hypercars to boast the performance levels of an LMP1 machine.

long.zh:
阿斯顿马丁是英国最受欢迎的豪华跑车制造商之一。这款终极跑车Valkyrie是他们在该领域近110年的制造经验与F1车队红牛车队的专业知识相结合的产物。

该设计始于红牛车队的设计师和空气动力学专家阿德里安·纽维提出的一个公路车创新点子。纽维把他的提案带到了阿斯顿马丁公司，与该公司的首席设计师马雷克·莱克曼取得了联系。2016年，该项目以“AM-RB 001”为代号正式启动。2017年，这款开发代号AM-RB 001的汽车在日内瓦车展上首次亮相，同时正式命名为Valkyrie。

Valkyrie的量产版在2021年首次公开，它是一辆造型独一无二的终极跑车——将来自F1的空气动力学理念与阿斯顿马丁的设计语言合二为一。该车的高车鼻配备了一个下垂翼，并通过车身下方的文丘里风道产生强大的下压力。在两者之间是水滴形的驾驶舱，以方程式赛车的方式让驾驶员和乘客抬脚躺坐在驾驶舱内。

整个碳纤维车身都进行了广泛的轻量化处理，甚至连阿斯顿马丁的车头标志也被减重为70微米厚的铝片。因此，该车的重量约为<1000kg>，达到了惊人的<1.0kg/ps>重量推动比。

混合动力单元安装在座舱的后部，一台带有克斯（动能回收系统）的考斯沃斯 6.5升自然进气V12引擎。该动力单元的总输出达到<1155ps>，使该车甚至可以与顶级类别的赛车相媲美。

Valkyrie首先推出了限量150辆的双门车型，尽管售价超过200万英镑，但还是几乎立即售罄。在双门跑车之后，又推出了“AMR pro”勒芒风格的赛车车型和敞篷的“Spider”车型。这款站在性能巅峰的车型作为首扸达到勒芒䎟垊车1级水平的终极跑车之一耍备受关注。@

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Vantage proved to be a success as a performance-focused, rear-wheel-drive sports car. The model introduced in 2017 shared much of its construction with the DB11 V8, but featured a shorter wheelbase and was approximately 265 lbs lighter. These changes earned it widespread acclaim, with many praising it as the best-handling Aston Martin to date. The engine was a Mercedes-AMG–derived twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8, capable of reaching a top speed of 195.1 mph (195 mph).

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight cornering machine has been hailed as the finest Aston Martin ever.

The name "Vantage" had long been synonymous with Aston Martin's high-performance variants, but in 2005, it emerged as its own distinct model. Relatively compact for an Aston Martin and equipped with a V-8 engine, the car would become a hit as the best handling front-engine/rear-wheel-drive car in the lineup.

The next-generation Vantage, unveiled in 2017, carried forward the fundamental principles that defined its predecessor. While sharing its platform with the DB11 V8, the Vantage featured a shorter wheelbase and shed <120kg>, transforming it into a precise cornering machine celebrated as the finest handling car in Aston Martin's storied history.

The powerplant came in the form of a Mercedes-AMG 4.0-liter V-8, producing <510ps>. Its 0-62 mph time of 3.7 seconds and top speed of 195 mph placed it in the elite supercar category.

vehicleCollection.en:
Aston Martin's Porsche 911 fighter: The new Vantage.

After a long five-year absence from the marketplace, the third-generation Vantage finally made its appearance in 2005. Before, the Vantage was a high-end sports car that touted supercar performance, but the new version was positioned at the bottom of Aston’s lineup with a competitive price tag.

Referred by some as “the baby Aston,” the new front-engine/rear-wheel-drive Vantage set its sights on the Porsche 911, hoping to lure buyers away from the popular German 2+2. Therefore, high performance was made a priority. The Vantage sported the graceful design DNA of the DB7, and it was built atop a bonded aluminum space frame called the VH platform (also found on the DB9). Thanks to this new lightweight chassis, the new Vantage tipped the scales at a lean <1570kg>, which was <400kg> lighter than the previous model.

The Vantage came powered by a 4.3-liter V-8 that shared the same block as the powerplant in Jaguar XK. The engine initially produced <385ps>, but gradual improvements kicked the power up to <406ps> in 2007. In 2008, the V8’s displacement was increased to 4.7 liters, which resulted in even more power at <426ps>. In 2011 power output peaked at <436ps> for the Vantage S model.

The top-of-the-line Vantage S not only received the high-output engine, but it had a sportier suspension via stiffer dampers, springs and bushings. Also, a quicker steering gear ratio gave the Vantage S race car-like handling, giving its rival, the Porsche 911, all it could handle on the racetrack.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.,

long.zh:
在第二代Vantage停产5年后，第三代Vantage于2005年首次亮相。之前Vantage的定位一直是高性能车型，但最新款却被定位为同系列的低端车型，其战略性的定价对于阿斯顿·马丁来说也是低得惊人。

因此，第三代Vantage有时也被称作“阿斯顿宝宝”，其目标对手是保时捷911，发展路线也定为追求极致驾驶体验的前置后驱跑车。流线型双开门轿车车身的基本架构沿袭自DB7，采用名为VH平台的特制接合式铝制车架，此车架在DB9发布前一年投入使用。该车型的车身重量为<1570kg>，比第二代Vantage轻<400kg>左右。

这款车的动力单元基于捷豹XK车系的V8自然吸气引擎。经过大规模改良后，两款引擎的相同之处其实只有缸体外形。这款4.3升引擎可提供<385ps>的输出。经过逐步改良，引擎的动力输出在2007年提升至<406ps>，引擎排量在2008年提升至4.7升，动力输出也提升至<426ps> 。到了2011年，引擎的输出进一步提升至<436ps>。

高性能版的Vantage S所使用的正是这款<436ps>功率的引擎。这款车不只是比标准车型多出<10ps>功率，其减震器、弹簧与衬套都更为强韧，转向传动比也更高，让这款车整体上更适合作为跑车驾驶。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

vehicleCollection.en:
With a mere 24 units produced, this hypercar shined on the track and became an instant collector's item.

Talk about your super exclusive exotic cars. After creating the One-77 in 2009 that was limited to a production run of 77 units, Aston Martin introduced the Vulcan at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show, which unlike the One-77 was intended only for the race track, but like its predecessor extremely limited in production. Only 24 cars were made available.

The Vulcan was built around a full carbon-fiber monocoque and body, with a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout. Under its hood was Aston Martin’s signature naturally-aspirated V-12, whose displacement was raised to 7.0-liters and tuned to pump out <811ps>. It was mated to an XTrac 6-speed sequential transaxle. Power was routed through a magnesium torque tube and carbon fiber drive shaft. And like a true race car, it featured a push-rod-type suspension with variable shock absorbers. It also sported carbon ceramic brake discs and driver-adjustable ABS system. The traction-control system could also be adjusted by the driver to fit his or her tastes.

Every part of the car has been optimized for lightness and strength, as it tipped the scales at a lean <1350kg>. This gave the Vulcan an amazing weight-to-power ratio of <1.66kg/ps>. A

long.zh:
Vulcan是阿斯顿·马丁在2015年日内瓦车展上公布的特殊车型。虽然阿斯顿·马丁在2009年推出了限量77台的限量版车型“ONE-77”，但那只是公路用车。Vulcan的研发汲取了ONE-77的经验，而且是专为赛道而生的特殊车型，限量仅24台。

公司从头开始专门打造的车体，采用了纯碳纤维车壳与车身，以及前中置后驱的布局。悬挂系统采用推杆式，外加可变式减震器。刹车采用碳陶刹车盘，并有可供车手调节的防抱死刹车系统。牵引力控制系统同样为可变式，可依据车手喜好与赛道特性进行调校。操控性与引擎输出特性也可进行微调。

引擎采用阿斯顿·马丁标志性的V12引擎，排量提升至7升并经过微调，可在自然吸气状态下提供<811ps>输出。变速箱为XTrac 6档序列式，采用变速驱动桥布局装载。

扭矩管为镁制，传动轴则为碳纤维制。车中每个部件都经过轻量化与强化处理，将车体总重降至<1350kg>。这也使得这款车的功率重量比达到了惊人的<1.66kg/ps>。

扭矩管为镁制，传动轴则为碳纤维制。车中每个部件都经过轻量化与强化处理，将车体总重降至<1350kg>。这也使得这款车的功率重量比达到了惊人的<1.66kg/ps>。

Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.

Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class,
where it performed exceedingly well.

In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen
consecutive years!

But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place
for most of the race.

People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three,
breaking its long streak of poium finishes

But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota,
experienced a mechanical problem.

This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish
its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!

Ultimatey, the streak came to an end when Audi announced
its withdrawal from Le Ma the followingʓear.< scmd="GTCafe_Top" />

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Audi R18 was engineered to compete in the 2016 World Endurance Championship (WEC). Its aerodynamics underwent a complete redesign, adopting a F1-inspired narrow nose with integrated wing, while the hybrid system’s regenerative energy capacity was increased from 4MJ to 6MJ. Although Audi secured 2nd place in the Constructors’ Championship, the brand made the difficult decision to withdraw from the WEC at year’s end.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Audi R18是专为参加2016世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）所开发的车型。它的空气动力学外形得到了全面重塑，改为了F1样式的带前翼长车头，而它的再生动能释放量由4兆焦耳提高到了6兆焦耳。尽管在车厂冠军的争夺中锁定了第二的好成绩，但Audi仍在赛季临近收官时决定从WEC退赛，令人扼腕。

brandCentral.en:

top prize at the 2016 FIA World Endurance Championship.

It features a mid-mounted 4L turbo diesel engine
and high-powered electric motors at the front.

The version we see here was raced by Audi Sport Team Joest.

It achieved second place in the Manufacturers' Championship
in the 2016 season.

vehicleCollection.en:
Audi's history-making LMP1 car dominated the World Endurance Championship in the 2010s.

The Audi R18 is a LMP1 class race machine developed by Audi to compete in the FIA World Endurance Championships (WEC).

The first appearance of the race machine dubbed the “R18” was in 2011. This later evolved into the “R18 Ultra” in 2012, and “R18 e-tron quattro” from 2013-2015, continually evolving over its years in competition. The Audi R18 is the successor to this series, but while it carries over the R18 name, this was a very different machine from the past iterations, developed from scratch.

First, the aerodynamics were greatly revised. The front center section looks like a very narrow version of the high nose section of an F1 machine. Between this and the left and right fenders there is a wing, also like that of a formula car. The shapes of the front and rear fenders were also changed, with positions and sizes of the wheel housing air outlets changed as well. This car had a very different style from that of the previous R18 e-tron quattro.

Another major difference is the engine. While still a 4L turbocharged diesel, the regenerative energy storage device was changed from an electric flywheel to a lithium-ion battery, and the amount of regenerative energy discharge was increased from 4MJ to 6MJ. The output of the front MGU was also greatly increased from 200 kW (<272ps>) to 350 kW (<476ps>)

In the 2016 World Endurance Championship Series, 2 cars were entered from Audi Sport Team Joest. The R18 raised constant good results by winning 2 races, placing 2nd in 5 races, and 3rd in 2 races. Ultimately they achieved a respectable 2nd place in the Constructors point rankings for the year. However Audi decided to withdraw from the World Endurance Championship Series at the end of this season.

long.zh:
奥迪R18是奥迪开发的勒芒原型车1级级别赛车，用于参加国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛。

编号“R18”的赛车首次亮相于2011年。后来于2012年推出了“R18超级”版，2013-2015年的版本则是“R18 e-tron四驱”。在多年来的竞争中，该车型一直不断进化。奥迪R18是此系列的继承者，但仅只是继承了“R18”的名号，与前代车款仍然有很大的不同，可以说是从无到有全新开发出来的。

首先，其在空气动力学上进行了重大的改进。车头中部看起来很像F1赛车高耸的车头，只是更为狭窄。在车头中部和左右挡泥板之间各有一片风翼，这也和方程式赛车十分类似。前后挡泥板的形状进行了改动，车轮罩排气口的位置和尺寸也发生了变化。这款车与前代的R18 e-tron quattro风格差异很大。

另一个主要区别在于引擎。虽然仍配备4升涡轮增压柴油引擎，再生储能装置由调速轮改为了锂离子电池，再生动能释放量由4兆焦耳提高到了6兆焦耳。前电机发电机单元的输出马力也大大增加，从200千瓦（<272ps>）提高到了350千瓦（<476ps>）。

在2016世界耐力锦标系列赛上，两辆奥迪R18作为奥迪Joest车队的战车参赛，并取得了一系列佳绩：获得两场比赛冠军，在五场比赛中取得亚军，另有两场比赛中取得季军。最终，他们在当年的车厂积分榜上荣获亚军。然而，奥迪决定从该赛季结束起退出世界耐力锦标赛。

conversation.en:
The 2011 Audi R18 TDI LMP1 marked a return to a closed-coupe
body again for the first time since the 1999 R8C.

This, to me, is when design, engineering, and motorsport
came to the perfect intersection for Audi!

Seeing these ‘Star Wars’ coupes in the rain at night,
with wipers and headlights, running at high speed...

Is exciting to watch!

I see them as advanced concepts for the road
that I can relate to.

They are truly a tour de force of technology!
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
2011款奥迪R18 TDI勒芒原型车1级标志着自1999年推出的R8C以来，
奥迪再次引入封闭式双门跑车车身。

对我来说，这款车是奥迪的设计、工程学技术
和赛车运动知识的完美结合！

在漆黑雨夜中，看到这些“星球大战”风格的跑车
顶着独特的雨刷和大灯高速奔驰的身影……

令我激动万分！

我认为这台车体现出了先进的道路交通工具理念，
引发了我的共鸣。

这样的车才是站在技术巅峰的作品！

conversation.en:
This Audi takes me back to the 2011 Le Mans 24-hour race.

Incredibly, it crossed the finish line and won
the competition...

A nail-biting 13.845 seconds before
the second-place Peugeot.

Rarely has Le Mans had such a close race!

Although Audi bested Peugeot in terms of speed,
the same couldn't be said about fuel efficiency.

Peugeot tried to use this to their advantage
by taking as few pitstops as possible.

So while Audi was making excellent time,
it couldn’t quite shake Peugeot.

But in the end, Audi’s speed won out, eking out
a victory against its competitor.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
看着这辆Audi，我仿佛回到了2011年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。

它以非同凡俗的姿态越过终点线并赢得了冠军……

只领先了第二名的Peugeot13.845秒，令人捏了一把汗。

在勒芒，很少能见到这样针尖对麦芒的比赛！

虽然Audi在速度上胜过了Peugeot一筹，但是在
燃油效率方面就一言难尽了。

Peugeot充分利用这一优势，尽量减少了进站加油的次数。

所以，单圈时间极其优秀的Audi始终没能将Peugeot甩开。

但最终，还是Audi的速度胜出，惊险击败了对手。

vehicleCollection.en:
This diesel-powered R18 TDI scored yet another victory for Audi at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2011.

The Audi R18 TDI is a prototype race car developed by Audi to run in endurance races such as the famed 24 Hours of Le Mans. This model takes its heritage from a series of diesel-powered race cars such as the R10 in 2006 and the R15 in 2009. However, the major difference compared to previous Audi LMP1 machines is that the car features a closed body again for the first time since the 1999 R8C.

While the previous R15 produced <600ps> from its 5.5-liter V10 turbo powerplant, the R18 produces <540ps> from a 3.7-liter turbocharged V6. The closed-body design was utilized to alleviate this loss of power by improving aerodynamics. The necessity for these changes was due to the car's chief design directive: to incorporate a futuristic hybrid system, which required the car to be as light as possible. This was the main reason for choosing a lighter V6 over a more powerful V8, the cylinder count of which was perfectly allowed by race regulations. The body is, of course, a carbon monocoque, and even the gearbox housing is made of carbon fiber, to save weight. Much thought was also given to designing the 120 degree V6 that mounts a single turbo between the cylinder banks; in doing so, Audi was able to lower the center of gravity and increase airflow on both the intake and exhaust sides of the engine.

The car's racing debut was in the second race of the LMS (Le Mans Series) in May 2011. In the pinnacle of the series—the 24-hour race—the car from Team Joest, driven by Benoît Tréluyer, André Lotterer and Marcel Fässler achieved the ultimate goal, an overall win.

long.zh:
奥迪R18 TDI是奥迪专为参加著名的“勒芒24小时耐力赛”等耐力比赛而研发的。

这台车承袭了一系列柴油赛车血脉，如2006年的R10与2009年的R15。这台车与之前的奥迪勒芒原型车1级赛车最大的不同点在于其采用了封闭式车身，这是自1999年的R8C车型以来的第一次。

前代R15的5.5升V10涡轮引擎能输出<600ps>的功率，而R18搭载的3.7升V6涡轮引擎的输出为<540ps>。采用封闭式车身的目的在于减小空气阻力以抵消对功率降低的影响。之所以要进行这些改动，是因为设计这款车时计划搭载先进的混合动力系统，因而要求车身尽可能的轻量化。之所以放弃比赛规则上限的强力V8引擎，转而选择更轻的V6引擎也主要是出于这层考虑。车体为碳纤维车壳，甚至变速箱外罩也使用碳纤维材料以减去更多重量。

引擎的设计中也融入了不少精巧的构思。利用将单涡轮夹在气缸组中间的120度V6引擎，设计师得以降低这台车的重心，并增强引擎两侧的气流。

这款车在2011年5月勒芒系列赛杯的第二场比赛中首次亮相。在系列赛的压轴大戏——勒芒24小时耐力赛中，Joest车队的伯努瓦·戚路亚、安德烈·洛特勒以及马塞尔-法斯勒驾驶这款车在赛事中成功加冕。

vehicleCollection.en:
Engineered to the finest detail, this Audi supercar features welds measured in microns.

The Audi R8 sports car, whose foundation was based on the "Le Mans quattro" concept car shown in 2003, was a special supercar not only because it was the company's first exotic, but because it was named after the prototype race car that successfully won several consecutive championships at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The body incorporated Audi's ASF technology (Audi Space Frame), a space-frame structure made of aluminum. This helped the weight of the body and shell of the car to weigh a mere <210kg>. Audi cut no corners when it came to quality; most of the body was built by hand, and an X-ray inspection device was used to check all welds at the micron level. The center section of the rear spoiler rose at speeds above <100km/h>, improving the car's aerodynamics at high speed, while dissipating heat from the exhaust when the car was sitting still.

The 4.2 FSI engine, mounted behind the cockpit, is a direct-injection 4.2-liter V8 that produces <420ps>. The power is transferred to all four wheels via the "quattro" all-wheel-drive system, which has now become a hallmark of Audi. A viscous-coupling unit utilized for the center differential distributes 10 to 35 percent of the drive force to the front wheels.

Audi poured all of its latest technology into this supercar, implementing the Magnetic Ride system, which included dampers that utilized magnetic particles, and the R-Tronic gearbox that shifted using hydraulic pressure.

车身采用了奥迪的ASF（奥迪空间框架结构），全铝结构底盘，车身和外壳的总重量仅<210kg>。在质量方面毫无妥协，车身大部分采用手工打造，利用X射线检查仪，在微米级别上检查所有焊缝。

后扰流板的中央部分采用格构格栅，在速度高于<100km/h>时会立起，不仅不影响空气动力学性能，收回时还能够消散排气管热量。

4.2升的FSI引擎是一款的4.2升直喷V8引擎，能够产生<420ps>。用于传递如此庞大马力的是奥迪标志性的四驱全时四驱系统。中心差速器采用粘性联轴器，可变动力总成将驱动力的10-35%传递到前轮。

此外，奥迪在他们的超级跑车上运用了大量最新的技术，运用磁性微粒减震的奥迪磁流变减震器，以及采用液压换挡技术的R-tronic系统。

vehicleCollection.en:
Audi's second-generation sports car based on the Le Mans-conquering R8.

The R8 was originally a Le Mans Prototype race car. Its name and much of its technology were incorporated into a road-going version of the car, which made its debut in 2006. The R8 road car met with worldwide critical acclaim, prompting the arrival of a second-generation model in 2016.

The new R8 adopted the original car's basic formula, but there were key changes, including a new version of the lightweight Audi Space Frame constructed from lightweight materials. It also had an updated version of the quattro AWD system. While the new car's exterior styling appeared similar to that of its predecessor, most of its details here were completely new.

Inside the engine bay was the same 5.2-liter V-10 as before, but the one in the second-generation R8 produced <15ps> more, bringing total output to <540ps>. Also, the new model lineup featured the "R8 V10 Plus," which increased power to <610ps>, while adding a fixed rear wing and mechanical LSD as standard fare. The newly tuned engine allowed the R8 V10 Plus to run from zero to <100km> in a scant 3.2 seconds and reach a top speed of <330km/h>.

long.en:
The R8 was originally a Le Mans Prototype race car. Its name and much of its technology were incorporated into a road-going version of the car, which made its debut in 2006. The R8 road car met with worldwide critical acclaim, prompting the arrival of a second-generation model in 2016.

The new R8 adopted the original car's basic formula, but there were key changes, including a new version of the lightweight Audi Space Frame constructed from lightweight materials. It also had an updated version of the quattro AWD system. While the new car's exterior styling appeared similar to that of its predecessor, most of its details here were completely new.

Inside the engine bay was the same 5.2-liter V-10 as before, but the one in the second-generation R8 produced <15ps> more, bringing total output to <540ps>. Also, the new model lineup featured the "R8 V10 Plus," which increased power to <610ps>, while adding a fixed rear wing and mechanical LSD as standard fare. The newly tuned engine allowed the R8 V10 Plus to run from zero to <100km> in a scant 3.2 seconds and reach a top speed of <330km/h>.

新车型沿袭了上一代的核心概念设计，并且使用了用轻量化材料制作的新版奥迪空间车架和其标志性的全时四轮驱动“四驱”系统。虽然在设计美学上的许多方面与前代车型十分类似，但车身几乎所有的外观细节与上一代相比都做了改动。

This R8-based GT3 machine was unveiled at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2015.

Honestly, who doesn’t know of its
illustrious history?

Why, only two months after its debut, it competed
at the Nürburgring 24-hour race.

This was its first competition, mind you,
and it went straight for the top!

In the end, the Audi R8 LMS managed to clinch
an impressive debut win...

With the BMW Z4 trailing behind it by a mere 40 seconds!
It was a real nail-biter!

And it proved that races are not just won by performance,
but by stability and reliability also.

conversation.zh: 这台基于R8打造的GT3赛车在2015年3月的 日内瓦车展上首次亮相。 说实话，还有谁没听说过它的辉煌事迹吗？ 在亮相后仅两个月，它就参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛。 我提醒一句，这可是它的第一场比赛！它的首秀就直奔 冠军而去！ 不用猜，奥迪R8 LMS最终成功地取得了令人印象深刻的首 场胜利…… 而第二名的BMW Z4落后它足足40秒之多！ 这样的胜利简直令人瞠目结舌！ 这也证明了一点——想要赢下比赛不仅仅要依靠性能， 也要靠稳定性和可靠性。

This new generation brought significant advancements in both safety and aerodynamics, while the transmission and traction control systems were replaced with newly developed, race-focused components. Mere moments after its unveiling, the R8 LMS proved its capabilities by taking overall victory in its debut outing at the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

vehicleCollection.en:
This updated version of a champion race car won the Nürburgring 24 Hour Race immediately after its debut.

The Audi R8 generated one of the most successful GT3 race cars ever, in the form of the R8 LMS and R8 LMS Ultra. When it came time for a new production R8 to be introduced, in March 2015, Audi took this opportunity to improve the R8 GT3 car, most notably in the safety department.

The second-generation R8 LMS featured crumple zones in front and rear, the “PS1” Audi Protection Seat from LMP machines, and a roof escape, the first ever for GT machine. With all the new safety measures, the new R8 LMS actually exceeded the safety standards of FIA-GT3 regulations for 2016.

The car’s performance was also improved, starting with aerodynamics. The new race car boasted an underbody that was almost completely flat, and came with an enlarged diffuser. Even the air circulation within the cockpit was engineered to minimize wear on the driver.

Despite the fact that the race car shared 50 percent of the parts with its production car sibling, the R8 LMS was a much meaner animal. The R8 LMS was built using the same spaceframe as the production model, but it weighed <25kg> less, thanks to new lighter materials used in the chassis. The powerful V-10, which came off the same line as the production car’s engine, was significantly retuned, and the suspension system was completely replaced. Also, the car’s 6-speed gearbox and traction control were newly developed.

The new R8 LMS made its debut at the Nürburgring 24 Hour Race, and to the surprise of almost no one, it took the overall win in the race.)

long.zh:
R8勒芒系列赛/R8勒芒系列赛超级是以奥迪R8为原型开发的国际汽联-GT3规格赛车，这款车在世界各地的GT赛事中捷报频传。但在2015年3月，随着市售版R8车型的全面升级，R8勒芒系列赛赛车车型也进行了相应的更新换代。

第二代R8勒芒系列赛的着眼点在于安全性。车体前后部设置了撞击缓冲区，内部采用了勒芒原型车车型所使用的“PS1”型奥迪保护座椅，再配上首次在 GT 赛车上采用的车顶救援口，这款车型的安全性已远远超出将于2016年开始实行的新GT3规则中的安全标准。

空气动力学方面也进行了大幅改动。先从下压力方面的改动开始说起：底盘几乎完全平滑，经过改良设计的扰流翼也进行了增大，甚至车内的空气循环系统也重新进行设计以降低车手的疲劳感。在GT3规则严格的限制之内，这款车进行了尽可能多的改进。

虽然使用了量产的奥迪空间车架，以及与量产引擎出自同一条生产线的V10引擎，但是这款车还是由于重新考虑材料构成而减轻了<25kg>的重量。悬挂系统经过重新设计，6档换挡拨片与牵引力控制系统也都是全新开发的。虽然全车大概50%的部件与量产车相同，但这款车经历了所有必要的调校。

第二代R8勒芒系列赛上市后不久，就在纽博格林24小时耐力赛中亮相并夺得总冠军。

Some have also noted that the red winglets look a little bit
like whiskers.

This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the 'Evo'
name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!

Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my
perfect car!
]

vehicleCollection.en:
This evolved version of Audi's R8 LMS competed in various GT3 events across the globe.

As the name implies, the Audi R8 LMS Evo is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, a GT3-regulation race car based on the production R8 code named the Type 42. Introduced in 2009, it shined on the race track for six years, until an all-new R8 production car, the Type 45, made its debut.

What separated the R8 LMS from its production-car sibling was its superior cooling and improved aerodynamics. The front grille and rear bumper were enlarged, while air channels were added next to the headlights to provide extra cooling for the engine. The front canard wings were enlarged to provide extra downforce.

The 5.2-liter V-10 of the previous car was carried over, producing <585ps> and <56kgm>, but with curb weight reduced by <25kg> to <1200kg>, the new R8 LMS Evo was quicker and more agile than its predecessor.

Introduced at the 2018 Paris Motor Show, the R8 LMS Evo competed in and won the Gulf 12-hour race at the end of that same year.

顾名思义，奥迪R8勒芒系列赛进化版是R8勒芒系列赛的升级版本。R8勒芒系列赛是一款符合GT3参赛规格的赛车，基于中置引擎的R8跑车所开发。这款车在2009年首次公布，在2015年前赢下了无数座奖杯。直到公路车型进行全面改款，从Type 42全面升级到Type 4S。

R8勒芒系列赛最大的提升在于散热和空气动力学设计。前格栅的开口和后保险杠都得到进一步扩大，在前头灯旁也增加了额外的风道，前鸭翼也进行了加大。为了提高稳定性，还整体优化了传动系统。

5.2升V10引擎的动力输出并没有改变，依然是<585ps>和<56kgm>扭矩，不过整车的基础重量减轻了<25kg>，降到<1200kg>，在赛事中更便于平衡重量。

R8勒芒系列赛进化版在2018巴黎车展上首次亮相，随即在年底的海湾12小时耐力赛勇夺冠军。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This was a 2019 Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) machine. In line with the series’ engine downsizing rules, the previous 4.0-liter V-8 was replaced with a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4. Remarkably, the new engine produced more power than its predecessor, while also weighing less, with improved weight distribution. In the 2019 season, Audi’s ace driver René Rast captured the championship title, alongside securing the team championship.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是一款2019年德国房车大师赛（DTM）赛车。根据一级赛车（Class 1）引入的引擎小型化规则，引擎从4升V8改为2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。但后者实际上能产生比前代更强的动力，在车重和重量分布方面也更具优势。2019赛季，王牌车手雷内·拉斯特夺得车手总冠军，同时也为车队赢得团体冠军。

The Audi RS5 Turbo DTM had an incredible showing at
the Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) in 2019.

A regular participant at DTM events, Audi had been

与此同时，车队也以排行榜头名之姿结束了赛季，

vehicleCollection.en:
A DTM machine with two victories in the Class 1 era.

The year 2019 marked a pivotal time of reform for the German Touring Car Championship (DTM). The series adopted the new Class 1 regulations, including the downsizing of engines, allowing for the possibility of shared race events with Japan's Super GT Championship.

Audi's entry in this new arena was this RS 5 DTM, powered by a brand-new engine. While the exterior retained the familiar look from the previous season, beneath the body, the naturally-aspirated 4.0-liter V-8 was replaced with a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 engine. This change resulted in a dramatic reduction in weight and improved weight distribution, while also delivering more than 600 hp, far exceeding the output of its predecessor. It was a completely new machine on the inside.

Audi entered six of these RS 5 DTM cars in 2019 through its factory DTM teams. With additional support from customer teams, the Audi RS 5 DTM was a dominant force on the grid. Among this impressive lineup, one car stood out above the rest: Car No. 33, piloted by ace driver René Rast. From the opening rounds, the car proved unstoppable, clinching victory after victory. In the final race at Hockenheim (Race 2), it achieved a pole-to-win finish, besting fellow Audi driver Nico Müller. Audi Sport Team Rosberg, with Rast at the helm, also claimed the team title, making car No. 33 a historic double-title winner.

The final round at Hockenheim was a special mixed-class event featuring Japan's Super GT500 cars, and an interleague exhibition race followed in Japan. However, the emergence of the COVID-19 pandemic led to Audi's withdrawal from the DTM. With one of its key manufacturers stepping away, the Class 1 regulations were retired after just two seasons.

Despite its short lifespan, the Audi RS 5 DTM stands as a shining representation of the ambition and innovation embodied by Class 1 regulations and has become a vital part of motorsports history. m

long.zh:
2019年是德国房车大师赛（DTM）迎来变革的一年。这项赛事开始采用1级规则，其中包括缩减引擎排量，使得它与采用同一规则的日本Super GT联合办赛成为了可能。

奥迪派出参加这一新组别赛事的汽车就是这辆由全新引擎提供动力的新款RS 5 DTM。其外观和上个赛季保持不变，不过引擎却由常规的4升V8自然进气引擎改为了一部2L直列4缸涡轮增压引擎。这项改动可以大幅减轻车重，优化配重平衡，同时还能提供远超其前代车型动力的600+马力。换而言之，它的内在已经焕然一新。

在2019年，奥迪为他们的厂队投入了6辆RS 5 DTM。再加上其他客户车队的采购，让RS 5 DTM成为了赛事中一股势不可挡的力量。其中表现最出色的还是王牌车手雷内·拉斯特驾驶的33号赛车。从赛季初轮起，就赢下了一场又一场的比赛，并在霍肯海姆最后一轮的第2场比赛中赢得了杆位和最后的胜利，击败了同样驾驶RS 5的尼科·穆勒，为这个赛季圆满收官。雷内拿下了这一年的车手冠军，他效力的车队奥迪运动罗斯伯格车队也拿到了车队总冠军头衔，让这辆33号赛车成为了传奇的双料冠军。

德国房车大师赛的最后一轮与日本的Super GT联合举办，成为一场与后者的GT500组别赛车同场竞技的混合比赛，随后又移师日本举办了同样的特别交流战。遗憾的是，新冠（Covid-19）疫情的爆发加速了奥迪的退出。这也让1级规则失去了意义，仅持续了2个赛季便告终结。

作为真正体现短暂但辉煌的1级规则的抱负和光芒的载体，奥迪RS 5在赛车运动历史上为自己留下了不可磨灭的匰记。@

德国房车大师赛的最后一轮与日本的Super GT联合举办，成为一场与后者的GT500组别赛车同场竞技的混合比赛，随后又移师日本举办了同样的特别交流战。遗憾的是，新冠（Covid-19）疫情的爆发加速了奥迪的退出。这也让1级规则失去了意义，仅持续了2个赛季便告终结。

作为真正体现短暂但辉煌的1级规则的抱负和光芒的载体，奥迪RS 5在赛车运动历史上为自己留下了不可磨灭的匰记。@

The Audi Quattro was a landmark achievement
in the history of automotive design.

Introduced in 1981, it revolutionized the world
of rally racing.

And, it has remained a benchmark for production-car
technology ever since.

Most of its outer panels are crafted from a blend of
resin and Kevlar.

And its steeply raked windshield provides better visibility
than many of its peers.

With wide fenders, a short wheelbase, and somewhat awkward
proportions, it may not have been the prettiest machine.

But as a purpose-built competition car,
it delivered outstanding results.

Audi Quattro是汽车设计史上的一个里程碑。

它于1981年首次亮相，便彻底改变了拉力赛的世界……

并从此成为赛车技术下放量产车的典范。

其大部分外部面板是由树脂和凯夫拉混合材料制成……

挡风玻璃的角度经过调整，相比原型车
可提供更大的可视范围。

然而，作为一款专为比赛设计的汽车，
它以极其出色的成绩做出了回应。

conversation.en:
The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race held in
Colorado, USA.

It is a race in which drivers compete for the fastest time
up a long and treacherous mountain road.

The course measures <20km>, climbing <1440m> to the finish
at <4302m>—higher than Mount Fuji in Japan!

This Audi S1 shattered records with its victory at
the storied event.

Based on a WRC mahine, it featured large wings at the
front and rear, ensuring maximum downforce.

But who was the driver behind the wheel on that winding
“Race to the Clouds?"

Why, it was none other than WRC champion
Walter Röhrl!< scmd="GTCafe_Top" />

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
派克峰爬坡赛是在美国科罗拉多州举办的比赛。

这是一场车手们需要在漫长而险峻的山路上
达成最快时间记录的赛事。

这条赛道长达<20km>，海拔始于<1440m>，终于<4302m>——比日本的富士山还要高！

这辆奥迪S1以破纪录的成绩在这场著名赛事中获得了胜利。

基于一辆世y拉力锦标赛赛车，这辆车前后
都配备了巨大的定风翼，以获得最大的下压力。

那么驾驶这辆车，沿着蜿蜒的山路，
勇敢地“冲上云霄”的人是谁呢？

这个人正是界拉力锦标赛的冠军沃尔特·罗尔！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Audi shook the rallying world in 1981 with the debut of its full-time 4-wheel-drive system in the World Rally Championship. This particular variant, a modified version of the Sport quattro S1, was tailored specifically for hill climb competitions, equipped with radical ground effects that pushed the limits of aerodynamics. In 1987, Walter Röhrl piloted this machine to a record-breaking triumph at the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 当Audi在1981年世界拉力锦标赛上派出运用他们的全时四驱技术的赛车出战时，如同一股风暴一般席卷了整个拉力世界。而这辆车是专为爬坡赛所改装的Sports Quattro S1拉力赛车特别版本，其设计实现了极具侵略性的地面效应。1987年，沃尔特·罗尔驾驶这辆车参加派克峰国际爬坡赛，拿下了破纪录的胜利。

collection.en:
The 4WD Sport quattro S1 revolutionized the automotive
industry in the 1980s.

You only have to look at its achievements in the
World Rally Championship for proof of that!

The Sport quattro S1 was developed
for homologation in Group B rallying.

As a result, only 200 were ever built.

But that's not the whole story to this particular
Sport quattro S1.

This is an S1-E2, a further evolved version of the S1.

It won the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb in 1987,
with Walter Röhrl at the wheel.

This victory would prove to be the last hurrah for the
Sport quattro, as Audi pulled out of Group B rallying in 1986.

Without a doubt, this is one of the greatest among greats.
collection.zh:
Audi 4WD Sport quattro S1在1980年代彻底革新了汽车工业。

它在世界拉力锦标赛上的成绩就已经足以证明这一点。

Sport quattro S1是为满足B组别拉力赛事认证规范而进行开发的
原型车，

因此只生产了200辆。

但关于这一台车的故事到这还没结束！

这辆S1-E2实际上是原版S1的改进版本。

在1987年，Walter Röhrl驾驶这台车赢得了派克峰国际爬坡赛。

这也是Sport quattro最后一次赢得冠军。
因为在1986年，Audi就退出了B组别。

毋庸置疑，这款车是传奇中的传奇。

catch.en: The 1987 winner of the Pikes Peak that also set a new record that year.
catch.zh: 1987年派克峰国际爬坡赛的冠军，并在同一年创下了当时的赛事纪录。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 1987 winner of the Pikes Peak that also set a new record that year.

When Audi introduced AWD technology to the World Rally Championships (WRC) in 1981, it changed the face of rally racing forever. Having all four wheels provide grip and traction over off-road courses gave its cars a distinct advantage over the competition. That was validated in 1982 when the company won both the Manufacturers Title and the Drivers Championship. The following year, an Audi driver won the Drivers Championship and in 1984, the company claimed both titles yet again.

The race car at the center of this amazing run was the Sports quattro. In the fall of 1983, Audi sold 200 of the 2133cc turbocharged inline-5-powered Sports quattros for Group B homologation. In the 1985 Tour de Corse, an improved version of the car, called the Sports quattro S1, also known as the Sports quattro E2 in some countries, made its debut. The car's engine was basically a carryover from the previous car, incorporating some improvements such as a misfiring (anti-lag) system, but output was increased to a staggering <600ps>. The big change came to the transmission, a 6-speed semi-automatic with a clutch sensor in the shifter. Later that year, it was also given a revised body with front spoilers and large front fenders that improved the car's aerodynamics and made it look meaner. Along with rear fenders incorporating air inlets, plus a rear wing, the car by this time had matured into the ultimate rallying quattro.

During this time, Audi also modified a WRC-spec Sports quattro S1 to hill-climb specifications and entered it in the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb. The result: Overall wins and track records in 1985 and 1987, with Michèle Mouton and Walter Röhrl behind the wheel, respectively.

The following year, an Audi driver won the Drivers Championship and in 1984, the company claimed both titles yet again.

long.zh:
在1981年的世界拉力锦标赛上，奥迪引入了全时四轮驱动技术，在开赛阶段就发挥出惊人的实力。1982年，他们赢得了车厂与车手双料冠军头衔，1983年他们获得了车手冠军，并在1984年再次荣获双料冠军。

车辆在年复一年地改进，1983年秋季他们为了获得B组赛事认证而售卖了200台2133立方厘米5缸涡轮增压运动版四驱，这款车从次年开始进入比赛。

在1985年的法国科西嘉岛拉力赛中，经过进一步改良的运动版四驱首次登场亮相。这款车便是运动版四驱S1，在某些国家也被称为运动版四驱E2。

引擎本身基本没有改动，但加装了偏时点火系统等改良，而引擎的最大功率也提升至<600ps>。另一处重要改动便是换挡杆上带有离合感应的6档半自动变速箱。同年晚些时候，车身也进行了空气动力学层面的优化，加装了前扰流板和配套的大型前轮拱罩，以及后进气孔拱罩和尾翼。此时，这款车已成长为顶级的拉力赛四驱车。

在同一时期，奥迪也将一台世界拉力锦标赛规格的运动版四驱S1改造为爬坡用车，并参加了派克峰国际爬坡赛。这款车的表现十分亮眼，米歇尔·穆顿和沃尔特·罗尔驾驶它在1985年和1987年分别获得优胜并刷新了赛道记录。

conversation.en:
The design of the original Audi TT Coupe is
very close to my heart.

My intent was to be
"absolute" and "pure" in a holistic concept.

My inspirations for the TT concepts were...

...Erwin Komenda's 356 Speedster and 550 LeMans Coupe...

...along with
Ecola Spada's Giulietta SZ "round tail" Coupe.

The short round front and rear overhangs arch up geometrically...

...into th belt-line with the fender arches repeating
the motion.

The upper spear-line served to shave
the surface and light reflection...

...and connect the headlamp/taillamp graphics.

This creates an energy that als communicates
"quattro" by visually connecting the wheels!
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
我对初代奥迪TT轿跑的设计
仍记忆犹新！

我当时的整体设计理念是
“绝对”和“纯粹”。

TT的灵感来自于

艾尔文·柯曼达的356 Speedster和550勒芒轿跑，

以及艾可拉·斯帕达的
吉里耶塔 SZ “圆尾”轿跑。短小的圆拱形车头和车尾

，其形状一直延续至车腰，连挡泥板也沿用这一几何形状

车体上部的线条起到了

dialogues.en:
The design of the original Audi TT Coupe is
very close to my heart.

My intent was to be
"absolute" and "pure" in a holistic concept.

My inspirations for the TT concepts were...

...Erwin Komenda's 356 Speedster and 550 LeMans Coupe...

...along with
Ecola Spada's Giulietta SZ "round tail" Coupe.

The short round front and rear overhangs arch up geometrically...

...into th belt-line with the fender arches repeating
the motion.

The upper spear-line served to shave
the surface and light reflection...

...and connect the headlamp/taillamp graphics.

This creates an energy that als communicates
"quattro" by visually connecting the wheels!

TT的灵感来自于

艾尔文·柯曼达的356 Speedster和550勒芒轿跑，

以及艾可拉·斯帕达的
吉里耶塔 SZ “圆尾”轿跑。短小的圆拱形车头和车尾

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Audi TT was a sports coupe introduced in 1998. The base model came equipped with the same 177.5 HP turbocharged 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 found in the Audi A3 and A4, while higher trims featured more powerful versions of the same powerplant. In 2003, the 3.2 quattro variant joined the lineup, powered by a 3.2-liter V-6 engine producing 246.5 HP. It was paired with Audi’s next-generation two-pedal manual, the DSG (Direct Shift Gearbox), offering lightning-fast gear changes.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Audi TT是1998年发布的运动型轿跑车。基础版搭载与Audi A3和A4相同的180 PS 1.8升直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，高级版本则采用同款引擎的高调校版本。2003年，3.2 quattro加入车系，搭载输出250 PS的3.2升V6引擎。匹配新一代双踏板手动“DSG”（直接换挡变速箱）变速箱。
officialDetails.heroEn: With its ground-breaking exterior design, this agile coupe took the sports car world by storm.
officialDetails.heroZh: 绝无仅有的未来风格设计让这款运动双门跑车吸引到了老中青车迷的目光。

brandCentral.en:
Even after several generations, the original Audi TT
still manages to look and feel fresh.

It shared its chassis with the Audi A3, although the
wheelbase was shortened by <90mm>.

Its compact nature made it incredibly agile.

Here is the 3.2 quattro, which was added to the lineup
in 2003.

Its smooth 3.2-liter V-6 engine sent <250ps> to
all four wheels.
brandCentral.zh:
即使经历了数代的更迭，原版Audi TT的地位并未受到影响。

TT的底盘来自于Audi A3，但轴距缩短了<90mm>……

从而获得了出类拔萃的操控性能！

这里展示的是2003年加入产品线的3.2 quattro，

其强大的3.2L V6引擎能够提供<250ps>的动力。

usedCar.en:
For those who wanted to drive a sporty German car, but didn't
want a sedan or boxy coupe, Audi created the TT.

The round compact body made it stand out in a crowd,
blending sportiness with elegance.

And when you stepped into its cabin, you were
greeted with a stylish interior.

Under the car's hood was a smooth-revving 3.2-liter V-6
that produced <250ps>.

The torquey engine sent power to either the front wheels
or all four tires via Audi's signature quattro system.

This version is one of the most popular of the first-gen TTs.
usedCar.zh:
初代奥迪TT是奥迪历史上厥功至伟的杰作。

它是奥迪第一款真正的跑车，车厂在它的
研发中倾注了大量的心血。

一言以蔽之，他们研发出的这款双门跑车
是一台绝对的上品...

而奥迪在工艺上的极致追求也在这其中
得到了充分体现。

搭载的3.2L V6 quattro是一款令人
生畏的引擎，能够产生高达<250ps>的马力。

这是初代TT中最受欢迎的版本之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its ground-breaking exterior design, this agile coupe took the sports car world by storm.

Audi was hesitant at first in producing a compact 2+2, but when the TT concept was greeted enthusiastically at the 1995 Frankfurt Motor Show, the company went to work in making the car a reality, and the TT 1998 bowed to a waiting public.

The base engine was a <180ps> 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4, the same engine that powered the A3 and A4. But the choice for enthusiasts was a retuned version with dual intercoolers that pumped out <225ps>. Because of the compact size of the TT, it was one of the most nimble cars in the marketplace. Built on the A3's platform, with the wheelbase shortened <9cm>, the TT displayed excellent cornering balance with a slight penchant for understeer. The choice for enthusiast was the all-wheel-drive version because of a more neutral turning character, helped in part by the car's double wishbone rear suspension.

The TT's popularity was increased even more by an attractive convertible version in 2000 and the addition of a 3.2-liter DOHC V-6 in 2003. With <250ps> on tap and mated to the company's revolutionary DSG twin-clutch semi-automatic gearbox, the TT became the luxury 2+2 of choice for discerning enthusiasts.

long.zh:
对于是否生产紧凑型的2+2车型，奥迪最初颇是犹豫。但随着TT的概念赛车在1995年法兰克福车展引起热烈反响，公司终于开始着手将这辆车付诸实现。直到1998年，TT才在苦等数年的大众车迷面前现身。

他的内核是一台可输出<180ps>的1.8升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎。同款引擎也应用在了A3及A4车型上。不过车迷们可以选择另一款加装双中冷的调校版引擎，输出动力提高了<225ps>。

TT基于A3平台开发，而且又将轴距缩短了<9cm>，相对迷你的尺寸让它成为了市场上最灵活的车型之一，展现出上佳的过弯平衡能力，唯一的瑕疵是时不时出现的转向不足问题。TT的全驱版本则加入了双叉臂后悬挂，采用更均衡的调校。

随着2000年夺人眼球的敞篷版以及2003年的3.2升双顶置凸轮轴V6引擎版本加入，TT的受欢迎程度与日俱增。其中的V6版本可以随时随地输出高达<250ps>的动力，并搭载了奥迪革命性的DSG双离合半自动变速箱，这也使得TT成为了众多眼光独到的爱车人士心目中2+2豪华车的首选。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This racing machine was based on the Audi TT and developed specifically for the Audi Sport TT Cup one-make series. Sections of the body shell were replaced with carbon fiber, and all driver comforts were stripped away, reducing the car’s weight to just 2480 lbs. It was powered by a 305.7 HP 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine, the same unit found in the standard TTS, but enhanced with a "push to pass" system that temporarily boosted output by an additional 29.6 HP.

vehicleCollection.en:
These TTs were produced specifically for the "Audi Sport TT Cup" one-make race.

The TT Cup is a purpose-built race car developed by quattro GmbH, based on the Audi TT. It was engineered specifically for the Audi Sport TT Cup, an exclusive one-make racing series launched in 2015.

While the road-going TT Coupé featured aluminum in its outer panels and upper frame, the Cup car took weight reduction even further with the use of carbon fiber in parts of its body shell. Stripped of comfort amenities, it tipped the scales at <1125kg>, more than <100kg> lighter than the lightest production version.

Both front and rear fenders were widened to accommodate 260/660R18 tires.
Aerodynamics were further refined with specially designed low-profile front and rear bumpers, while a large adjustable rear wing added significant downforce.

Under the hood resided the familiar 2.0-liter TFSI inline-4, the same engine used in the production model in Germany. While the base output remained at <31ps>, the TT Cup car featured a push-to-pass system. With the press of a button, drivers received a temporary boost of <30ps>, encouraging bold overtakes and keeping the racing fiercely competitive. It was paired with the same 6-speed S tronic dual-clutch gearbox found in the road-going TT.

The front axle was fitted with an electronically controlled Haldex hydraulic limited-slip differential, allowing the driver to fine-tune the locking ratio directly from the cockpit.

Although positioned as an entry-level racing series, the Audi Sport TT Cup often served as a support race for the prestigious DTM. Its popularity soared in 2016, when the series attracted a total of 125 participating drivers.

这些TT跑车是专为“Audi Sport TT杯”单一车种赛而生产的。

TT Cup是四环有限公司以奥迪TT为原型开发的一款赛车。这款车是专为2015年开始的单一车种赛“奥迪运动TT杯”打造的。公路版TT双门轿车的外部壁板与上半部车架采用铝合金材料，但TT Cup车型的部分车壳则使用了碳纤维。在进一步移除舒适性部件后，车身重量降至<1125kg>，比最轻的市售版本还要轻<100kg>以上。为配合260/660 R18轮胎，前后挡泥板都进行了加大处理。前后保险杠也采用了特殊的压低设计来降低空气阻力，车尾部还装配了可调整的大型尾翼。引擎采用德国本土版2.0升涡轮增压缸内直喷4缸引擎。虽然功率维持原来的<310ps>，但为了增加超车机会，让比赛更有看头，这款车装备了冲刺按钮，可在短时间内使动力临时提升<30ps>。变速箱采用与公路版相同的S tronic 6档变速箱。前轴装配了电子控制的瀚德液压防打滑差速器，车手可在座舱内调整锁定比率。尽管“奥迪运动TT Cup”的定位仅为入门级赛事，这项比赛有时也会作为德国房车大师赛的揭幕赛。该赛事非常热门，在2016年共计有125名选手参赛。/

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The TTS was the high-performance variant of the TT series, introduced in 2008. Its powertrain featured a 2.0-liter direct-injection turbocharged engine paired with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed S-Tronic transmission. The engine block, pistons, and connecting rods were uniquely developed for the TTS, and the turbocharger was upgraded to handle the increased output. Power was delivered through Audi’s proprietary full-time 4-wheel-drive system, enabling a zero-62.1 mph acceleration time of 5.2 seconds with the S-Tronic model, and 5.4 seconds with the manual.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: TTS是2008年首次亮相的TT系列中的高性能版本。动力系统采用2升直喷涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动或6速S-Tronic变速箱。引擎缸体、活塞和连杆均为TTS专用设计，涡轮增压器也经过升级以承受更大动力输出。传动系统采用Audi专有的全时四驱系统，S-Tronic版本0-100 公里/小时加速时间为5.2秒，手动版本为5.4秒。

officialDetails.heroZh: 代表更高性能的车型，相比师出同门的TT，性能突飞猛进。

The turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder delivers <70ps> more

vehicleCollection.en:
A high-performance model, aggressively evolved from the TT.

The Audi TTS, the high-performance version of the TT, first made its debut at the North American International Auto Show in January 2008.

The powertrain combined a turbocharged 2.0-liter direct injection engine with either a 6-speed manual or 6-speed S-Tronic dual-clutch transmission. Power was rated at <272ps> and <35.7kgm> of torque. Although it possessed the same displacement as the standard turbocharged 2.0-liter model, the TTS featured a bespoke engine block, pistons and connecting rods, while the turbocharger was enhanced to increase performance. It produced <72ps> more power and <7.2kgm> more torque than the base turbocharged 2.0-liter unit found in models such as the 2.0 TFSI quattro. As a result, its 0-<100km/h> acceleration time was impressive: 5.2 seconds for the S-Tronic and 5.4 seconds for the 6-speed manual.

Aside from the standard coupe body, a convertible "Roadster" model was released in certain regions. The car came equipped with the Audi Magnetic Ride variable dampers system as standard. When selecting the sports mode from the switch on the console, the ride height dropped by <10mm>, improving handling. It also provided a more aggressive ride befitting the TTS name.

In terms of design, the exterior kept the flavor of the TT series, with special bumpers at both ends giving the car a sportier appearance. It also featured the same variable rear wing as the standard models. Inside, the seats were upholstered with a combination of Alcantara and leather, which along with the unique instrument panel, gave the car a modest yet definite look of a special grade model.

long.zh:
TTS是TT的高性能版本，首次亮相于2008年1月的北美国际车展。

动力系统搭载了一台<272ps>@<35.7kgm>、排量为2升的直喷涡轮增压引擎，可搭配6档手动或6档S-Tronic双离合变速箱。尽管与标准版涡轮增压车型排量相同，TTS却配备了为其量身定做的引擎缸体、活塞和连杆，涡轮增压器也经过改进以提升性能。相比诸如2.0 缸内直喷四驱等车款使用的常规2升涡轮增压引擎，它产生的马力提高了<72ps>，扭矩提高了<7.2kgm>。从而使得S-Tronic车型的0-<100km/h>加速时间达到5.2秒，6档手动档也能跑出5.4秒的成绩。

除了标准的双门跑车车身，奥迪还在部分地区推出了敞篷的“跑车”车型。在机械方面，该车标配奥迪磁流变减震器”。在控制台上切换至运动模式后，车身高度可下降<10mm>，使得操控更具动态感。外观也更具攻击性，无愧于TTS之名。

在外观方面，虽然大体上保持了TT系列出色的设计风格形象，但造型别致的前后保险杠使车辆看起来更具运动感。它还配备了与标准型号相同的可变后扰流板。在内饰方面，座椅采用阿尔卡塔纳和皮革组合，与独特的仪表板组合在一起，使这款特别车型看起来既低调，又极具辨识度。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The third-generation TT made its debut in 2014. While it retained the core design philosophy of its predecessors, it adopted a more aggressive look, highlighted by a larger single-frame grille and headlights inspired by the R8. At the top of the range sat the TTS, the flagship sports variant, equipped with a 2.0 TFSI turbocharged 4-cylinder engine tuned to produce 309.7 HP and 274.9 ft-lb of torque in the German domestic model. Paired with a 6-speed manual transmission and Audi’s quattro all-wheel-drive system, it delivered a truly exhilarating driving experience.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第三代TT于2014年公布。尽管其整体设计概念与前两代并无不同，但这款新车的外观采用了更大尺寸的单体框架格栅和R8风格的头灯，呈现出更凶猛的面貌。TTS是整个产品线中最高档的跑车型号，配备了一部4缸涡轮增压2.0 TFSI引擎，而德国本土型号还进行了精细调校，将动力输出提升到了314 PS/38.0 公斤力米。再加上连接到Quattro系统的6速手动变速箱，提供令人不可置信的驾驶体验。

officialDetails.heroZh: 简洁又不乏动力。第三代TT的跑车级别车型。
