long.zh:
SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo[SRT Tomahawk 跑车浪漫旅愿景]是一款在技术上领先20年的车型，其性能堪称精益求精，潜力无穷。它是极佳驾驶感与震撼性设计的完美融合。Tomahawk是单座式的MR-AWD（中后置引擎，全轮驱动）车，底盘采用专门开发的复合材料，搭配上强劲的动力系统。

Tomahawk有两个动力来源：

•　主动力来自倾角144度的6.98升V10引擎，能够产生1,000多马力。

•　辅助动力引擎储存在与轮距长度几乎等长的两具组合式气动缸内。两个前轮都连接着可变鳍式四段空气动力单元，能够迅速储存和释放空气动能。V10引擎也连接了相似装置。当后轮的牵引力不足时，该系统能为Tomahawk提供全轮驱动力，以提高过弯和加速的能力。

Tomahawk的超轻复合材料底盘采用极为先进的材料，包括空心纳米碳纤维和石墨烯微型格。Tomahawk上所有透明的部分都由石墨烯制成，包括挡风玻璃和引擎罩窗。石墨烯制的挡风玻璃能依据需要清晰地在车手面前投影仪表信息和通讯信息。复合材质的空气压缩气缸卷上纤维，并经过层积加工，与底盘合为一体。该车型的整体车身设计，从较低的车手驾驶座到V10引擎的大倾角，都是为了尽量降低重心。

尾翼与前端辅助分流器。依据车辆的状况和车手指令，这些空气动力元件会持续调整运作，以便车辆能在需要时获得最大下压力和最小的风阻。空气动力系统会根据车体前方的激光扫描系统传来的前旹路况数据做出相应调整。计算机控制糺统会预测底盘高度、俯仰角和偏航角的变化，并据此调整分流器。

V10引擎通过一系列管路将排气引导臱后扰流翼，杤自排气系统的气流与主动式空气动力学系统结合在一起，可加快车辆后部下方暄空气流动ￌ产生热吹扰流效应，在不增加空阻的前提下提高抓圱力。

Tonahawk的悬挃幟在亨下旹面运甫久气动装置ﾚ可䱃节弹力倍率的气动潻簧厯发挥可调式减振器搅彜用。此外，车辆还使用了靨呼怦的主动住妖倾角系纟ｎ齦迮转䐑芀会佼车齆霝瓀弯道傽疜－搄齮肎幜鎮勬構君内弧燛外侧轫犢，伾车迯接圱面榮伜匀鑀娧䀼，从而尽鄈揑髙车辅雅眺碰腞靳䋛ぃ
S车䞋汆Tnncgaud Conaepu概濲鱦僣滤纸僊彂的瀧能带䄧了儤藯级凬﷯车垆〃P也震“Start Hereｈ膩桥醌嫋）⌝的悏〄Tcmaeavo S很僂弟踺奄騴GTS>R忖X鿛駏彺傍罦垇蹊才㚄剥閨彦型。Tomaoawk S的䅔掆臍醎毛地玺圮看来乔盹当佸励㰴伌暒丝需覲穿着加压赜车䟍驾䩷鸑胼发挥债儶儫胩瀧能　然而若悰卑傫Zamahisk S的噥脩实喛跐堺漃俲圉鸝ｏ淥狌礷隃要储琔躮樥地阾鮶㺀

officialDetails.descriptionEn: A Gran Turismo Original, this Gr.1-spec version of the Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo was the result of a collaboration between Gran Turismo and Dodge. To ensure that its 700 horsepower-plus was effectively translated to the ground, the car was outfitted with aerodynamic enhancements. These included an extended front splitter, a prominent rear wing, and four canards.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo是《跑车浪漫旅》和Dodge合作开发的概念车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是它的Gr.1规则改装版本。这辆车采用了全新的空气动力学部件，确保它超过700马力的输出能够完全施加在路面上。这些部件包括了由Dodge Design部门设计的一部拓宽前定风翼和尾翼，以及4片前翼。
officialDetails.heroEn: A mid-engine rear-wheel drive version of the Tomahawk for Gr.1 competition.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一款专用于Gr.1竞赛，配备中置引擎及后轮驱动的Tomahawk。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.1 race car was based on
the Dodge SRT Tomahawk VGT.

The compressed air system was removed so it conformed to
Gr.1 racing regulations.

Also, a fixed wing and shark fin were added to enhance
the car's aerodynamics.

But the biggest change of all was converting the once-all-wheel
drive car layout to rear-wheel drive.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一辆基于Dodge SRT Tomahawk VGT所打造的Gr.1赛车。

为了符合Gr.1赛事规范，它的空气压缩系统被移除。

另外还加上了固定式尾翼和鲨鱼鳍，以增加空气阻力。

最后，它的传动系统也从四轮驱动更换为后轮驱动。

A mid-engine rear-wheel drive version of the Tomahawk for Gr.1 competition.	n

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo is a near-future supercar created by Dodge's in-house tuning department, SRT (Street and Racing Technology). This mean machine features next-generation automobile technologies that includes high-tech materials throughout the chassis and a road-surface-sensing active aerodynamics system. Providing the muscle is a 1000-hp V-10 engine mated to pneumatic power units.

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo (Gr.1) adopts the core concepts and dynamic nature of the Tomahawk and modifies them for Gr.1 classification.

This version is based on the race spec GTS-R, the lightest model in the series. After overhauling the body, the stock car’s active aero parts were scrapped in favor of a fixed rear wing and an aero fin mounted aft of the cockpit.

To reduce weight, the pneumatic power units were removed, while the engine was tuned to produce <703ps>. The power train layout has also been changed from all-wheel drive to rear-wheel drive to comply with regulations.

While it is no longer capable of extreme speeds that transcends the limits of the human body, its superb handling and aerodynamic control remain intact. In endurance races, this model will no doubt put great fear into your opponents.(

long.zh:
SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo是一款近未来的超级跑车，由道奇的前沿特殊开发团队SRT打造。这个庞然大物是下一代汽车技术的愿景，底盘使用高科技材料，采用路面传感主动空气动力系统，并装有由气动动力单元支持的1,000马力V10引擎。

SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo (组别1) 重新使用Tomahawk的核心概念和动力特征，并将修改成一辆符合跑车浪漫旅组别1组别规范的改装车。

这一版本基于赛车规格GTS-R，即该系列中最轻盈的型号。但在全面改装车身尺寸的过程中，开发人员摒弃了那款车的一大特征，也就是主动空气动力学部件，取而代之的是在车身后方安装了大型固定式尾翼和垂直鳍片。

为了减轻重量，气动动力单元已被移除，V10引擎现已调校为产生<703ps>的动力。为了遵守法规，动力传动布局也已从全轮驱动改为后轮驱动。

虽然它不再能够以极限速度测试人体极限，但是其卓越的操控性与空气动力学控制系统仍然完好无损。在长距离耐力赛中，这款车型无疑会让对手望而生畏。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This was a car of the future, blending uncompromising, unrestrained performance with a striking, futuristic design. A mid-engine, 4-wheel-drive single-seater, its body was crafted from cutting-edge composite materials. The engine was a 6.98-liter V-10 producing 1,000 horsepower, supported by a pneumatic sub-system. The "X" was the ultimate expression reserved only for drivers deemed capable of handling its 2465.5 HP total output.

Power exceeding 2500 horsepower and with unrivaled handling, this machine belongs in the hands of only a chosen few.

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo is a 20-year-forward vision of uncompromising, unrestricted performance. It is the virtual fusion of extreme motoring and stunning design. The Tomahawk is a single seat MR-AWD (mid-rear engine, all-wheel-drive) vehicle constructed on a custom-built composite chassis and designed around an aggressive powertrain.

The motivation for the Tomahawk is provided from two sources:

•　The main power plant is a nearly flat, 144-degree 6.98-liter V10 engine generating in excess of 1000 horsepower.

•　Auxiliary power is stored in two composite pneumatic cylinders that run nearly the length of the wheelbase. Each of the front wheels is connected to a Variable-Fin Quad-Stage Pneumatic Power Unit that can rapidly store and release pneumatic energy. A similar Pneumatic Power Unit is connected to the V10 engine. This system provides the Tomahawk with All-Wheel-Drive capability to improve cornering and acceleration when grip at the rear wheels is traction limited.

The Tomahawk’s lightweight composite chassis uses emerging advanced materials including hollow carbon nanofibers and graphene micro-lattice structures. All of the transparent elements of the Tomahawk are made from graphene skins including the cockpit and the engine-cover windows. The graphene windscreen allows a clear digital overlay of all vehicle instrumentation and communications in front of the driver as needed. The filament-wound pneumatic cylinders are integral structural elements laminated into the chassis. The entire vehicle design, from the low driver position to the nearly flat layout of the V10 engine, is intended to achieve the lowest possible center of gravity.

The handling dynamics of the Tomahawk are enhanced by a continuously active aerodynamic system which deploys multiple pneumatically driven elements, including a rear wing and a secondary front splitter. These aero panels are constantly adjusting to the track conditions and driver inputs in order to provide the highest level of downforce and the lowest levels of drag when required. The Tomahawk’s aerodynamic system reacts to inputs provided by a forward scanning laser system that detects surface changes in front of the car. The computer controls anticipate changes in vehicle ride height, pitch and yaw and adjust the splitter accordingly.

long.zh:
SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo[SRT Tomahawk 跑车浪漫旅愿景]是一款在技术上领先20年的车型，其性能堪称精益求精，潜力无穷。它是极佳驾驶感与震撼性设计的完美融合。Tomahawk是单座式的MR-AWD（中后置引擎，全轮驱动）车，底盘采用专门开发的复合材料，搭配上强劲的动力系统。

Tomahawk有两个动力来源：

•　主动力来自倾角144度的6.98升V10引擎，能够产生1,000多马力。

•　辅助动力引擎储存在与轮距长度几乎等长的两具组合式气动缸内。两个前轮都连接着可变鳍式四段空气动力单元，能够迅速储存和释放空气动能。V10引擎也连接了相似装置。当后轮的牵引力不足时，该系统能为Tomahawk提供全轮驱动力，以提高过弯和加速的能力。

Tomahawk的超轻复合材料底盘采用极为先进的材料，包括空心纳米碳纤维和石墨烯微型格。Tomahawk上所有透明的部分都由石墨烯制成，包括挡风玻璃和引擎罩窗。石墨烯制的挡风玻璃能依据需要清晰地在车手面前投影仪表信息和通讯信息。复合材质的空气压缩气缸卷上纤维，并经过层积加工，与底盘合为一体。该车型的整体车身设计，从较低的车手驾驶座到V10引擎的大倾角，都是为了尽量降低重心。

Tomahawk的操控动力学借助连续主动式空气动力学系统得到了提升，该系统使用了多个气动元件，包括尾翼与前端辅助分流器。依据车辆的状况和车手指令，这些空气动力元件会持续调整运作，以便车辇能在需要时获得最大下压力和最小的风蘻。空气动力系统会根据车体前方的激光扫描系统传来的前方路况数据做出相应调整。计算机控制系统会頄测底盘高度ぁ俯仰角和偏航角的变化，并据此调整分流器。

V10引擎通过一系列管路将排汔引导至后扳流翼，来自排气系统的气流与主动式空气动力学系统滓合在一趷，可加快鼦辆吏䃨上方的空尗嵁动，产甝热圸扰流效应，在不增剡婺阺的前提下提高抓地勑⁂

Tomahawk的悬挂也在以下方蝢鿐攨了气勩裇置：可谂芃罹劙倍珇的䰔动漹籤倯叟挥可谁潏减珯嘨皅伜䘩₂欨外弌輤迉忘使用㸆㝩呼瀧皆帻动伏套䀽餒漶结ｌ车轮转向芁㼚彿齦辆咜最彯鏜茿嗝－䑂轮胎幟掯犯夋矑内澧爖姖㿫豭刨ￌ澿轧轮揥地面禮濝挀着⤧倾ﻌ从而谽脏揟饘车辆的机棰拐吱䌛㌂

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Dodge Super Bee was introduced in 1968 as a performance-focused yet affordable muscle car. It offered a range of powerful engine options, with the 7.0-liter V-8 producing 425 HP at the top of the lineup. True to its purpose, the car came with minimal comfort features. A facelifted version appeared in 1970, followed by the second-generation model in 1971, which was based on the Charger.

officialDetails.heroEn: A Coronet, equipped with a 7.0-liter V8 Hemi, this was one of the standout cars in the muscle-car era.

usedCar.en:
If you're looking for something that'll give you a sense of what
a muscle car was, then give the Dodge Super Bee a look.

The size of the car was modest compared to its rivals,
billed back then as an "intermediate sedan."

But there was nothing intermediate about its power.
It came with a massive 6.0-liter V-8!

The thing rumbled like thunder when provoked, making the car
one of the fastest of its day.

vehicleCollection.en:
A Coronet, equipped with a 7.0-liter V8 Hemi, this was one of the standout cars in the muscle-car era.

The Dodge Super Bee, introduced by Chrysler in 1968, was created to compete in the growing muscle-car marketplace. Priced at the lower end of the segment, the Super Bee was all about performance. It was not equipped with some of the creature comforts that its rivals possessed.

Based on the mid-size Dodge Coronet, the Super Bee was really a rebadged Plymouth Roadrunner, complete with a lightweight 2-door body and exterior design that looked menacing from every angle. In 1969, a convertible version of the car was added to the lineup.

The Super Bee’s performance on the road matched its mean looks, thanks to a powerful engine lineup. The base powerplant was a <340ps> 6.8-liter V8, followed by the upgraded version’s <395ps> 7.2-liter V8. The top-of-the-line model came with a <431ps> 7.0L Hemi. To handle all of this power, Chrysler equipped the car with a reinforced suspension system, a Mopar A833 4-speed manual transmission and high-performance tires.

In 1970, the Super Bee received a facelift that included a two-section grille and a revised chrome bumper. The following year, an all-new Super Bee was introduced; this one was based on the Dodge Charger.

long.zh:
道奇Super Bee是克莱斯勒在1968年推出的肌肉车。面对为数不少的高价位、高性能车竞品，摈弃了除驾驶性能之外所有修饰的Super Bee以性价比杀出重围，成为了热卖车款。

第一辆Super Bee于1968年初次亮相。这款车基于道奇Coronet开发，但车身改为中等尺寸。最先推出的是重量最轻的双门跑车，紧接着1969年又推出了双门硬顶敞篷车型号。

让Super Bee备受瞩目的是它强大的引擎阵容。这款车只提供高性能引擎配置，包括<340ps>的6.8升引擎、<395ps>的7.2升引擎或是<431ps>的7.0升Hemi引擎。

为了配合其强大的动力，这款车还标配强化加固后的悬挂系统，并可以选择多个专注于跑车驾驶体验的选项和性能套件。虽然这款车拥有一台昂贵的高性能引擎，但几乎所有的可选配件和舒适用途的设备都被省略了。最终呈现在驾驶者眼前的就是这样一台简朴、务实、专为驾驶体验所打造的车型。

在1970年，这款车换掉了镀铬保险杠，并改用双联进气格栅，完成了“改头换面”。在接下来的1971年，这款车又全面升级为了基于Charger的二代型号。

In the transition of automotive design, fenders were originally
just mud flaps that attached to the tires.

Just before and after World War II, fenders started to be
integrated into the bodies.

And eventually the body sides came to be
cut out in the shape of the tires.

In relation to this, the rear fenders of the Viper...

...is structured as a large volume that completely
integrates the fender and doors.

And t shows the enormous traction to accommodate
the 8.0-liter V-10 engine.

It changed the flow and direction of car design, which was
moving towards abstract, multiple surfaces in the 1980s.

The soul of the American car guy is jam packed in these
glamorous fders.

Thiis ho an American Sports car should be!

conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

为此，车身的侧面被切割出了轮胎的形状。

不过拿那种设计对照一下Viper的后挡泥板！

它们变成了车门的一部分，
更加突出了它相当大的体积……

以此展示出8升V10引擎无比强:的牵引力。

这项设计给80年代原本抽象、几何形的车身设计带来了
新的变化。

Viper在这些迷人的巨型挡泥板里灌注了美国汽车人的灵魂e

这才是美国跑车应该有的样子！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This coupe was developed to fully exploit the Viper’s performance potential. While its basic structure, suspension, and V-10 engine remained largely unchanged from the RT/10 roadster, power output was increased to 449.7 HP. The addition of a fixed roof allowed the car to reach a top speed of 185 mph—approximately 183.9 mph—surpassing the roadster’s 165-mph limit. Introduced alongside it, the GTS-R race version appeared in endurance events across the globe, where it consistently demonstrated its superior capabilities.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款双门轿跑的设计宗旨是为了发挥出Viper的全部潜力。它原封不动地沿用了RT/10敞篷跑车的基础架构、悬挂和V10引擎，但动力输出增强到了456 PS。但因为改为了硬顶，这款车能够跑出185英里/小时（约296 公里/小时）的最高时速，较敞篷版的165英里/小时有了较大提升。于同一时间亮相的GTS-R版本参与了全球范围内的多项耐力赛，展示了其优越的性能。

The first generation Dodge Viper made a splash in the

It was a stylish FR sports car with a potent V-10 engine.

Some were so awed by its prowess that they began calling it

Did you know that Lamborghini was involved in developing

That's because back then, Dodge and Lamborghini

那是因为Dodge和Lamborghini在当时都是Chrysler的子公司。

execs in the U.S. that many considered a real "car guy."

He worked for each of America's "Big Three" car companies, but
his claim to fame was the Corvette-conquering Dodge Viper.

It had a front-mounted 8.0-liter V-10, sourced from

The Viper saw plenty of action in endurance races at Le Mans
and the Nürburgring. The thing was a monster!

catch.en: With its monstrous levels of power and grip, this venerable machine could arguably be called America's first supercar.
catch.zh: 打破束缚的车型，推动Viper跑车进入超跑领域。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its monstrous levels of power and grip, this venerable machine could arguably be called America's first supercar.

Dodge introduced the Viper concept in 1989 to an awe-struck public to show that Chrysler was capable of producing something that could dethrone the Chevrolet Corvette as America's sports car. America's supercar war officially began in 1992 when Dodge released the 2-seat convertible to the public.

The Viper was as raw as sports cars came, with a loud, powerful engine and wide, menacing body that reminded many of the Shelby Cobra. For some, the car was too over-the-top. Dodge, hearing these comments, produced a fixed-roof version of the Viper called the GTS in 1996. At the same time, a race version of the GTS was also introduced, called the GTS-R. The GTS-R was created to contest in the world's GT races that included Le Mans and the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

The GTS didn't just get a fixed roof, but also got more power. The massive V10 under its long hood now produced <456ps>, as opposed to <400ps> in the RT/10 roadster, which made the car quicker off the line.

The aerodynamic shape created by the fixed roof accounted for a better top speed, one that eclipsed the RT/10's top speed of <165mph> at <185mph>. The GTS's handling was also sharper, thanks to the car's added structural rigidity. The FR (front-engine, rear-wheel-drive) sports car set record-breaking slalom and skidpad records, thanks in part to its meaty tires.

The original Viper was a nostalgic and primitive-feeling sports car. However, with the release of the GTS, the Viper joined the ranks of the supercar.

long.zh:
Viper于1989年首次作为概念赛车亮相，并于1992年上市。虽然性能规格非常高，但仍有人诟病其风格太过复古。1996年，这些负面评论随着Viper GTS的诞生而平息，这是一款具有刚性封闭车身的真正跑车，并与双座敞篷跑车划分出明确的界线。

为了真正强调这辆车的跑车取向，在GTS发布的同时，还公布了其赛车版本GTS-R。这是一款量产型赛车，旨在参加勒芒和纽博格林24小时耐力赛等耐力挑战赛，以及全球的其他GT汽车比赛。

GTS的基本机械部件，包括V10引擎、车架和悬挂等，都和RT/10双座敞篷跑车相同。然而引擎的最大输出马力已从<400ps>升级到了<456ps>。

虽然GTS的加速性能和RT/10几乎没有太大的区别，但最高时速得到了显著的提高。双门跑车的车身风格拥有很大的优势，使得GTS的最大速度从双座敞篷版的<265km/h>提高到了<298km/h>。

采用封闭式车身后，车身刚度也得到大大改善，在蛇形穿桩和溜滑路试车场上的计时成绩都有明显的提升。此外，封闭式车身还可以省略一些在双座敞篷车上必须采用的加固措施，从而使得车身更轻盈。

原版的Viper是一款带有怀旧和原始情怀的跑车。然而，GTS的发布使得Viper跻身超跑行列。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The third-generation Viper made its debut in 2012. A key highlight of this new model was that it was released under SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance brand. Although the V-10 engine retained its 8.4-liter displacement, numerous internal upgrades boosted output to 640 HP and 600.3 ft-lb of torque. As with previous generations, the chassis featured a steel tube frame, though torsional rigidity was improved by 50 percent. At the top of the range, the GTS offered an active suspension system.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第三代Viper于2012年公布。这款新车型的主要亮点在于它将由Chrysler的高性能品牌SRT打造。尽管它的V10引擎依然保持8.4升的排量不变，但SRT对其内部进行了多项改良，让这部引擎能够输出649 PS/83.0 公斤力米。和前代车型相同，它采用了一套钢管空间车架，但刚性提升了50%。最高档的车型GTS还换用了主动式悬挂。

officialDetails.heroZh: 第三代Viper，获得SRT的极限性能支持。

vehicleCollection.en:
This third-generation Viper is now marketed under Dodge's extreme performance SRT brand.

For years, Americans had only one real sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette. That all changed when the Dodge Viper arrived on the scene in 1991. The two became immediate rivals, and in a classic battle of one-upmanship, both Chevrolet and Dodge kept trying to outdo one another in an all-out performance race. As a result, both cars became such formidable sports machines that their on-road and on-track prowess eclipsed high-priced European supercars of their day.

In 2012, Dodge kept the tradition going with a new model that would transcend the others that came before it. The 3rd-generation Viper was tuned by the folks at SRT, Chrysler's high-performance factory tuning division. They kept the spirit of the American supercar intact, but raised the performance level so high that even Chevrolet engineers were scratching their respective heads. Built on the square steel space frame as before, this Viper featured aluminum cross bracing that improved rigidity by 50 percent. Also, thanks to the extensive use of lightweight materials such as carbon fiber, the car weighed <45 kg> less than the previous model. The heart of the Viper, the massive 8.4-liter V10 powerplant, received new pistons, as well as a new intake, exhaust and engine management system, allowing it to produce <649ps> and <83kgm> torque. The upper grade GTS was equipped with active suspension.

The new specs allowed the Viper to hit a top speed of <330km/h>, higher than most race cars. When you consider that the price of the 2013 model was still under the $100,000 mark, it's easy to see why many people, even today, regard the Viper as the best bang-for-the-buck supercar of all time.

long.zh:
Viper在美国汽车业中创造了举世瞩目的成就。很长的时间里，科尔维特都是美国超跑市场的唯一选择，但是在1991年，初出茅庐的Viper发起了对科尔维特的挑战并成功将它击败。

这造成了两款车型之间日渐升级的研发竞争，并最终导致了美国跑车性能标准迅速攀升，甚至在某些方面超越了欧洲的主流超跑。因此，第二代Viper于2010年停售的消息招致了众多粉丝的失望情绪。

但是Viper其实并未消亡，其第三代车型于2012年荣耀登场。

第三代的Viper由SRT推出，SRT是克莱斯勒的专属跑车品牌。尽管第三代基本保持了自身的原始理念，它的性能却得到了极大的提升。该平台依然保留了此前所使用的方形钢制空间框架，但是借助铝制十字撑杆，其刚度获得了50%的提升。

通过在各类零件中采用诸如碳纤维等轻量材料，该车的重量较此前减轻了45公斤。前置的V10引擎排量依然是8.4升，但是通过对活塞、进气、排气、以及引擎管理，该引擎现在可产出<649ps>功率和<83kgm>扭矩的动力。此高配车型GTS还自配了主动悬挂。

它的最高时速可达<330km/h>。考虑到该车2013款基本版的售价低于10万美元，这款第三代Viper的尖牙和毒液将毋庸置疑地对它的竞争对手产生影响。

dialogues.en:
Designed and built by Chrysler's Advanced Design Studios
over the course of 1988 and ’89...

The Viper was dubbed the ‘second-coming’
of the Shelby Cobra.

It was co-production by then-president Bob Lutz
and designer Tom Gale.

Heralding a new era at the New York Auto Show in 2012,
the SRT GTS-R marked the series’ return to racing.

Distinguished by a long nose and short deck body...

Its flat bottom and wing addition promised dramatically
improved aerodynamics.
j
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.zh:
这台由Chrysler的高级设计工作室于1988年至1989年

设计和制造的Viper又被称作Shelby Cobra的“再现”。

它是由品牌当时的总裁鲍勃·鲁茨和设计师汤姆·盖尔协手打造。

2012年纽约车展上，Chrysler带着Viper重出江湖，
而SRT GTS-R的命名则代表系列车型回归竞速比赛。

该车具有标志性的长车头和短小平坦的车身……

扁平的底盘和额外的风翼也使得空气动力学效应得到了长足的改进。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: When the third-generation Viper appeared in 2012, it was accompanied by the announcement of a racing variant—the GTS-R. From that foundation, the GT3-R was developed as a customer-focused race machine for private teams. Created through a collaboration between SRT, Chrysler’s high-performance division, and Riley Technologies, it featured significant weight reduction and a host of aerodynamic upgrades. It quickly demonstrated its competitiveness, proving its racing potential in GT events across America and around the world.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 当第三代Viper于2012年首次亮相时，官方还公布会推出一款赛车车型，GTS-R。而GT3-R则是基于GTS-R，专为私人车队开发的一款GT3赛车。这个车型由Chrysler的高性能车开发团队SRT和Riley Technologies联合打造，他们对车重进行了大幅削减，还添加了许多空气动力学性能强化件。这辆车在北美和全球其他地区的GT比赛中证明了自己的竞速潜力。
officialDetails.heroEn: A machine for private racers, carrying on the bloodline of the GTS-R.
officialDetails.heroZh: 为私人赛车手打造的赛车，延续了GTS-R的血统。

brandCentral.en:
The Viper SRT GTS-R served as the starting point for this
FIA GT3 class vehicle.

The car is the product of a collaboration between two of the
leading experts at the top of their respective fields:

Chrysler's high-performance automobile division, SRT, and Riley
Technologies. Together they created a real track monster.

They reduced the car's weight to a mere <1200kg> and enhanced
aerodynamics to provide more downforce.

It's a formula that'll always produce results, and this Viper
did not disappoint, running at the top in numerous GT races.
brandCentral.zh:
Viper SRT GTS-R是这辆FIA GT3组别赛车的基础车型。

这台车由两个各自领域内顶尖的专家团队：

Chrysler的高性能汽车部门SRT
以及Riley Technologies携手打造。

总体车重被控制在<1200kg>以下，空气动力学性能也得到了进
一步加强。

这些改装取得了极大的成功，这辆车在GT赛事中的优异
表现就足以证明！

vehicleCollection.en:
A machine for private racers, carrying on the bloodline of the GTS-R.

The Dodge Viper evolved into its 3rd-generation model at the 2012 New York Motor Show. With the appearance of this iconic American sports car, the development of a GTS-R competition model was also announced, and it became clear that the Viper would return once again to the 24 Hours of Le Mans and the American Le Mans series after a 10 year hiatus. The Viper GT3-R is a GT3 machine created for private teams, based on the GTS-R works machine.

In the development of this machine, SRT, the high performance car development division of Dodge, and Riley Technologies, a major racing constructor in the U.S., worked together to instill the car with their know-how for victory.

The traditional long nosed, short deck body had improved aerodynamics with a flat bottom and the addition of a wing. Weight had also been reduced to <1295kg>. The 8.4-liter V10 with a dry sump was powered up to <680ps> (507kW) unrestricted, and this power was transferred with a X-Trac 6 speed sequential transmission. It was also equipped with 6 piston front/4 piston rear brake calipers with large diameter discs for stopping power.

The Viper GT3-R was priced at $459,000, with orders received from the latter half of 2013. Its level of performance was already proven in various GT Car races in the U.S. and other parts of the world.

The Viper GT3-R is a GT3 machine created for private teams, based on the GTS-R works machine.

In the development of this machine, SRT, the high performance car development division of Dodge, and Riley Technologies, a major racing constructor in the U.S., worked together to instill the car with their know-how for victory.

The traditional long nosed, short deck body had improved aerodynamics with a flat bottom and the addition of a wing. Weight had also been reduced to <1295kg>. The 8.4-liter V10 with a dry sump was powered up to <680ps> (507kW) unrestricted, and this power was transferred with a X-Trac 6 speed sequential transmission. It was also equipped with 6 piston front/4 piston rear brake calipers with large diameter discs for stopping power.

The Viper GT3-R was priced at $459,000, with orders received from the latter half of 2013. Its level of performance was already proven in various GT Car races in the U.S. and other parts of the world.
long.zh:
道奇Viper在2012年纽约车展上发布了其第三代车型。随着这台美国标志性的跑车一同登场的，还有GTS-R竞赛车型的开发计划。Viper明确表示会在时隔10年后重返勒芒24小时耐力赛以及美国勒芒系列赛。Viper GT3-R是基于GTS-R车型，并专为私人车队打造的GT3车型。

在开发该车型的过程中，道奇高性能车辆开发部门以及莱利科技（美国的一家大型竞速赛车生产商）通力合作，将他们的获胜理念渗透进了开发过程里。

传统的长前鼻搭配较短的车体，并凭借平底盘和附加的尾翼，提高了该车型的空气动力学性能。该车型的重量也被降低至<1295kg>（2855磅）。配备干滑油槽的8.4升V10引擎可轻松提供高达<680ps>（507KW）的功率，而动力通过X-Trac的6档序列式变速箱传递。此车还配备了6个前置活塞及4个后置活塞卡钳，以及大直径碟刹来保障制动力。

Viper GT3-R的售价为45.9万美元，并在2013年下半年开始接受订单。此车的性能水平在美国、以及全球的众多GT竞速赛事中已经得到充分的证明。

It also carried the SRT badge, a symbol shared across many of Chrysler’s high-performance offerings. With its lightweight body and an 8.3-liter V-10 producing 509.9 HP, the car possessed the performance to compete against its international rivals.

This second generation Viper was released in 2002.

Its 8.4L V10 engine offers <400cc> more displacement

And packs more than <600ps> of power!

vehicleCollection.en:
The much-anticipated fixed-roof version of the supercar featured better aerodynamics and lighter weight.

When the original Dodge Viper was introduced in 1992, the sports car world immediately took notice. Its sleek body, mean-looking design and powerful V-10 engine put it on par with the most exotic cars of its day. The breed improved in 2003 with the arrival of the second-generation model, and in 2006 a new model joined the lineup: a hard-top version called the SRT10 Coupe.

The SRT (Street and Racing Technology) in the car's name refers to Chrysler/Dodge's specialty sports division in charge of spicing up the company's vehicles. For the new Viper, it took its 8.3-liter OHV V10 and tuned it so it would produce <517ps> and an asphalt-shredding peak torque of <73.96kgm>, much more powerful than before.

The crew at SRT also improved the Viper's handling, by lowering the curb weight and testing it on the demanding Nürburgring circuit, not just to take the "America's Sport Car" moniker away from its main rival, the Chevrolet Corvette, but to challenge the likes of Ferrari and Lamborghini, which it succeeded in doing on the world stage.

Though its unique exterior tends to grabs everyone’s attention first, the Dodge Viper remains one of the most powerful and fastest sports car in history.

long.zh:
随着Viper SRT10在2003年北美国际车展中正式发布，早在1992年就粉墨登场的Viper终于迎来了它的第二代车型。和第一代推出时一样，Viper SRT10在头两年只销售敞篷版本，直到2005年才宣布将在次年推出Viper SRT10轿跑。车名中的SRT对应的是克莱斯勒公司内专门负责研发高性能车款的专业团队。

团队为SRT10准备的V10 顶置气门引擎，排量高达8.3升，可输出<517ps>，最大扭矩高达<73.96kgm>，动力输出远超以往。略有不同的是，Viper的顶级速度并非来自强大的动力，而更多得益于它无与伦比的扭矩。

二代车型的车重远远轻于一代产品，自然为操控带来更多助力。克莱斯勒对这款车的市场目标不再是追求直线冲刺的传统美国跑车市场，而是世界级别的超跑市场。他们直接选择在纽博格林进行研发，并与科尔维特在赛道上一较高下。

尽管独特的外观先入为主，抓住了所有人的眼球，但Viper追逐的最终目标是一辆真正的跑车，更轻盈也更强大，在超跑世界中留下浓墨重彩的一笔。

conversation.en:
If my memory serves me right, I used to be called
the Ford Mustang Mach 1.

I’d was dormant for a long time, but when I awoke
everything had changed.

I can't sit still. How I wish to burn rubber,
driving with all my might!

The power my heart pumps is twice what it used to be.

My tires are larger, and my width, increased.

Now I can hardly recall who I am!

Cherished fragmentsof my former self remain, in my window
shield, headlights, tail, and door.

People say that this is what they love about me.

But I am also a monster, so filled-up with parts that
my heart had to be moved back.

The ach 40... Yes, that is the name of my new self.
conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
conversation.zh:
如果我没有记错的话，我曾经被人们称为
“福特Mustang Mach 1”。

我曾在沉寂中度过了很长一段时间，但当我重新苏醒时，
我发现一切都已完全不同。

我不能置身事外。我多么渴望尽情释放自己的力量，
全力行驶，让车轮橡胶冒出阵阵青烟！

我心脏的跳动力量是过去的两倍。

我的轮胎变得更加宽大，我的车身变得x加宽阔。

现在我几乎忘记了自己的本来模样！

代表过去的细微特征只在挡风玻璃、前灯、尾部和车门上得以保留。

人们说这些是他们喜欢我的地方。

但我v变成了一辆动力怪兽，身体里被塞入了各种新的零部件，以至于我n脏
得不重新找地方安置。

“Mach 40”h…Ea，Z就D我Zuerh

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This is a wild Mustang build crafted by one of Oregon’s most respected custom shops. Everything from the rear seats to the trunk was stripped out to make room for a mid-mounted supercharged 5.4-liter V-8 from a Ford GT—an engine capable of producing up to 850.1 HP. vehicleCollection.en:
This Mustang, a 2012 GT Award Winner, possessed the heart of a Ford GT.

The Grand Turismo Awards take place every year during the SEMA Show in Las Vegas. In 2012, the GT crew awarded their 10th anniversary prize to a 1969 Ford Mustang customized by Eckert's Rod & Custom.

Based in Oregon, U.S., Eckert's Rod & Custom has worked on the restoration and customization of classic and muscle cars for more than 25 years. Its creation, called the Mach Forty, is a beautifully-restored first-generation Mustang Fastback, with plenty of added attitude underneath its sheet metal. Most of the flawless bodywork was completely rebuilt, and the floor, from the rear seats to the trunk, has been cut out to make room for an engine, making this Mustang a mid-engine sports car.

Ford's supercharged 5.4L V-8 was tuned to pump out <862ps> and includes a control fitted inside the cabin that allows the driver to adjust engine output from approximately <608ps> to <862ps>. To handle the substantial increase in power, the chassis has been thoroughly reinforced, and the Chevrolet Corvette C6's suspension and traction control system have been installed.

Sure, Eckert's Rod & Custom tampered with the Mustang's traditional front-engine/rear-drive formula, but in doing so, it created a car even the most ardent Mustang fan would love.

long.zh:
美国改装车协会车展是美国最大的定制车展之一，并主持颁发跑车浪漫旅年度奖项。2012年，十周年年度奖被颁给了埃克特定制车坊的1969年款福特Mustang。

埃克特定制车坊位于美国俄勒冈，25年来一直从事老爷车和肌肉车的修复和改装。

获奖车辆名为Mach 40，乍一眼看上去可能会被认为是一款修复精美的初代Mustang快背。但既然能够获奖，就代表在外表之下藏有许多看不见的秘密。大部分车身得到了重新搭建，从后排座位到行李箱的地板都被切除，以便留出空间安装重制后的福特GT传动系统，将布局改变为中置引擎式。

5.4升机械增压V8引擎经过改装后最大马力可达到<862ps>，车内安装的转盘能让马力输出在<608ps>到<862ps>之间进行调节。车身经过大量强化，以便承受引擎传来的强劲动力。其他改装部分借用自科尔维特C6的悬挂系统和牵引控制系统。

埃克特定制车坊大胆地将历史上两款著名的福特车型合二为一，完成了一款令人惊叹的作品，当之无愧地获得了十周年年度奖。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This limited-production supercar, with only 399 units built, was launched in 2002 to commemorate Ferrari’s 55th anniversary. Its sharp-nosed, Formula 1-inspired design was the work of Ken (Kiyoyuki) Okuyama, then a designer at Pininfarina. The car was constructed with extensive use of carbon composites for both the body panels and much of the framework. At its heart was a specially developed 6.0-liter V-12 producing 650.9 HP and 484.6 ft-lb of torque, allowing the car to reach a top speed of more than 217.5 mph.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2002年，Ferrari为了庆祝成立55周年发布了这款限量399台的超级跑车。其酷似F1赛车的尖鼻车身是当时任职Pininfarina的设计师奥山清行的杰作。车身板件和大部分车体框架都是采用碳纤维复合材料制成。定制开发的6升V12引擎可输出660 PS/67.0 公斤力米，最高时速可超过350 公里/小时。
officialDetails.heroEn: Christened with the name of the founder, this car celebrated the company's 55th anniversary and had a limited 399-production run.

vehicleCollection.en:
Christened with the name of the founder, this car celebrated the company's 55th anniversary and had a limited 399-production run.

The Enzo Ferrari is an ultra premium sports car with a limited production of 399 cars, built in commemoration of the 55th anniversary of Ferrari.

The Enzo was designed by Ken (Kiyoyuki) Okuyama, a Japanese designer in Pininfarina at the time. The highly aerodynamic body is reminiscent of F1 machines of the day. It is notable that not only the body panels, but most of the frame is built of carbon composites.

The 6-liter V12 engine was specially designed for the Enzo, and produces a massive <660ps> of power, and <67.04kgm> torque. The suspension is double wishbone in front and rear, and combined with Brembo carbon ceramic disc brakes, it can withstand full speed runs on the circuit. With its powerful engine and lightweight body, its maximum speed is in excess of <350km/h>.

Though it mounts the high power engine midship as in the F40 and the F50, it is also given gullwing doors, air conditioning, and a semi automatic transmission called the F1-matic. Measures have been taken against noise and vibration by mounting the engine to the subframe that is buffered by bushings, and it is designed to be more of a road than the F50, which was closer to a pure race car. E

long.zh:
Enzo Ferrari是一款超豪华跑车，限量生产399部，是纪念法拉利55周年的车款。

Enzo由当时任职于宾尼法利纳设计公司的日本设计师奥山清行所设计。空气动力学的车身令人想起当时的F1赛车。值得注意的是，不止车身面板，大部分的车体框架都是采用复合碳纤维材料制成的。

Enzo所配备的6升V12引擎是专为这款车而设计的，并能输出<660ps>的强劲马力和<67.04kgm>的扭矩。前部和后部采用了双叉臂悬挂，搭配布雷博的碳纤维-陶瓷碟刹，可承受赛道上的全速奔驰。凭借其强大的发动机和轻量化的车身，这款车的最大时速超过<350km/h>。

和F40、F50一样，这款车搭载了大马力的中置式引擎，并且还配备了鸥翼门、空调以及被称为F1-matic的半自动变速箱。引擎被安装在采用轴衬缓冲的副车架上以减少噪音和振动。相比更纯粹的赛车F50，这款车在设计上与公路车更接近。

Expressing character in automotive design
is no easy task.

colour, and they would each look unique!

真的，它对前继车型的各方面优化都完成得相当漂亮。

在汽车设计中，表达个性从来都不是一件容易的事。

但这辆车绝对是一个正面例子！

睁着一双“圆眼睛”的前脸看着就很是友好。

就算在一个停车场里停满相同颜色的这台车，
你依然会感觉它们每一台都有自己的个性！

不同的颜色为菲亚特500注入了个性与情绪。

考虑到它的经典复古造型，
复古怀旧的涂装更相得益彰。

dialogues.en:
I love the 2008 FIAT 500! It's so
whimsical and fun.

Really, it does a masterful job of improving upon
its forebear.

Expressing character in automotive design
is no easy task.

But here's an example that truly inspires!

The face is friendly, with its round eyes.

You could have a parking lot full of them, all in the same
colour, and they would each look unique!

Colour plays a huge emotional role in the 500.

Given its retro design, the retro colouring suits it
very well.
k
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.zh:
我可爱2008款菲亚特500了！这辆有趣的小车太脑洞大开了。

真的，它对前继车型的各方面优化都完成得相当漂亮。

在汽车设计中，表达个性从来都不是一件容易的事。

但这辆车绝对是一个正面例子！

睁着一双“圆眼睛”的前脸看着就很是友好。

就算在一个停车场里停满相同颜色的这台车，
你依然会感觉它们每一台都有自己的个性！

不同的颜色为菲亚特500注入了个性与情绪。

考虑到它的经典复古造型，
复古怀旧的涂装更相得益彰。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Thanks to its affordable pricing and endearing styling, the original FIAT 500 sold more than four million units over its 20-year production run starting in 1957. Half a century after the second-generation model, the third-generation FIAT 500 arrived. Making its debut at the 2004 Geneva Motor Show, the new Fiat 500 launched to widespread acclaim in the summer of 2007. It was affectionately known around the world as the Cinquecento—Italian for “500."
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 得益于亲民的价格与迷人的造型，Fiat 500自1957年推出后的20年间累计售出400万台。第2代发布50年后，第3代Fiat 500问世。这台车在2004年日内瓦车展上迎来首秀，并在2007年夏季上市后迅速风靡全球。全球汽车爱好者亲切称其为“Cinquecento”——意大利语“500”之意。
officialDetails.heroEn: The Italian version of the people's car makes a comeback after a 50-year hiatus.
officialDetails.heroZh: 阔别50年的第3代Cinquecento，保留了2代的可爱造型。

brandCentral.en:
This third generation FIAT 500 is the quintessential
Italian compact car.

Not only did it inherit its design from the hugely popular
second generation model...

But like its predecessor, it too proved to be
a massive worldwide success!

With a 1.2L <70ps> engine that feels great on the road...

From handling to acceleration, it's simply a joy to drive!
brandCentral.zh:
第三代菲亚特500是一辆典型的意大利紧凑型汽车。

此车不仅继承了大受欢迎的第二代车型的设计思路……

而且也和前代一样在全世界范围内获得了巨大的成功！

此车配备一台动力为<70ps>的1.2升引擎，驾驶感受十分出色……

从操控到加速，驾驶这辆车简直是一种享受！!

usedCar.en:
The FIAT 500 is the quintessential Italian compact.

The design is based on that of the famed 1950s
second generation model of the same name.

It utilises a traditional FF—or front-engine,
front-wheel drive—system...

And its FIRE engine is one in a long line of straight-four
engines in use since the first Pandas.

To be sure, it may not look like much...

But it handles well, and offers up an engine note that's
truly pleasing to the ear.
usedCar.zh:
FIAT 500是意大利小型车的代表作。

它的设计基于20世纪50年代著名的
同名第二代车型。

这辆车采用了传统的前置
前驱系统……

它搭载的直列四缸FIRE引擎是从第一代
Panda车型上沿用下来的。

确实，这辆车看起来中规中矩……

但是它的操控性不错，
而且引擎声浪非常悦耳。

vehicleCollection.en:
The Italian version of the people's car makes a comeback after a 50-year hiatus.+

With its irresistibly charming design and remarkably low price, the second-generation FIAT 500 sold four million units between 1957 and 1977, playing a pivotal role in Italy’s automotive revolution. With its endearing round "eyes," smooth curves, and unmistakable charm, the spirit of the second-generation FIAT 500 was reborn 50 years later in the third generation.

Unveiled at the 2004 Geneva Motor Show, the concept car immediately captivated the world. When it finally hit the market in 2007, its popularity soared. Its appeal was so overwhelming that backorders continued in most markets worldwide, even two years after its launch.

The available engines under the hood came in the form of a 1.2-liter and 1.4-liter gasoline engine and a 1.3-liter diesel. The 1.2-liter engine produced only <69ps> and <10.4kgm> of torque, but revved quite smoothly. Weighing just <1010kg>, even in the luxury-grade Lounge model, the FIAT 500 boasted a finely tuned chassis that delivered a surprisingly sporty driving experience, belying its cute appearance.

Pronounced “cinquecento” in Italian, the FIAT 500 carries this affectionate nickname worldwide.

Unveiled at the 2004 Geneva Motor Show, the concept car immediately captivated the world. When it finally hit the market in 2007, its popularity soared. Its appeal was so overwhelming that backorders continued in most markets worldwide, even two years after its launch.

The available engines under the hood came in the form of a 1.2-liter and 1.4-liter gasoline engine and a 1.3-liter diesel. The 1.2-liter engine produced only <69ps> and <10.4kgm> of torque, but revved quite smoothly. Weighing just <1010kg>, even in the luxury-grade Lounge model, the FIAT 500 boasted a finely tuned chassis that delivered a surprisingly sporty driving experience, belying its cute appearance.

Pronounced “cinquecento” in Italian, the FIAT 500 carries this affectionate nickname worldwide.
long.zh:
由于价格极低、造型可爱，第2代菲亚特500在1957年到1977年期间卖出了400万台，为意大利的汽车普及率做出了极大贡献。在第2代菲亚特500诞生的50年后，它那圆圆的小“眼睛”、圆润的线条和可爱的气质又在第3代菲亚特500身上重现。

它的概念车在2004年日内瓦车展上刚一亮相，就立即吸引到了全世界的目光。2007年上市后，它的人气爆炸式膨胀。由于实在太受欢迎，直到上市2年后，依旧在全世界大部分市场上供不应求。

它娇小的前置前驱车身上搭载1.2升和1.4升的汽油引擎，或1.3升的柴油引擎。1.2升引擎只能输出<69ps>的动力和<10.4kgm>扭矩，但加速很快。它身材轻盈，豪华的尊享版车型也仅重<1010kg>，经过精心调整的底盘让它能发挥出与外表不符的强悍性能。

车名中的500在意大利语中读作“cinque cento”，这也成为了它在世界各地的昵称。

This rare beauty is an icon of Italian car manufacturing.

The FIAT 500 made its debut in 1957.

It is considered one of legendary FIAT car designer
Dante Giacosa's most enduring masterpieces.

Giacosa contributed to the fabulous engineering legacy
of FIAT for many, many years.

At under <3m> in length, it's compact in nature, but can snugly

got its good looks from!

conversation.en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you.
It showcases a high level of product design.

In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.

No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.

Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...

...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

He then took on the challenge of...

...creating an even better minimally-packagedcar.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.

Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.

The yawning hood lid is also qite appealing,
not to mention functional.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The car symbolized FIAT’s original mission of delivering accessible, everyday mobility. The first 500, born in 1957, featured an extremely compact body housing a 497 cc engine with just 14.8 HP, mounted at the rear. Despite its modest power, the car offered surprising practicality and affordability, quickly gaining popularity and spawning numerous Abarth-tuned variants. The F model introduced front-hinged doors for the first time.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款车标志着FIAT公司实现了为大众市场制造汽车这一目标。诞生于1957年，这款车以极其紧凑的车身在尾部搭载了15 PS的497 立方厘米引擎。这台车虽然小巧，但非常实用，且凭借低廉的价格广受欢迎，甚至催生了众多Abarth的改装版本。F车型首次采用前铰链式车门。
officialDetails.heroEn: Small, versatile and inexpensive, this minimalist car could also be raced.
officialDetails.heroZh: 功能全面，价格合理，还能用于竞速。一款充满乐趣的极简原创车型。

usedCar.en:
The FIAT 500 F is one of the most recognisable Italian cars
in history.

and hauls an air-cooled two-cylinder engine.

vehicleCollection.en:
Small, versatile and inexpensive, this minimalist car could also be raced.

Introduced in 1957, the FIAT 500 was a compact car that carried forward the legacy of the pre-war Topolino. But it was more than just a successor, it was a new design that redefined the essence of a functional passenger car.

Certainly, there are many differences between the Topolino and the FIAT 500. Although compact, the FIAT 500 offered seating for four adults—an improvement over the two-seat Topolino. Furthermore, unlike the front-engine/rear-drive layout of the Topolino, the FIAT 500 featured a rear-engine/rear-drive configuration within a full monocoque body.

The FIAT 500's engine was a <479cc> air-cooled 2-cylinder OHV that produced <15ps>, enabling a top speed of <90km/h>. The standard front-half canvas-top was designed primarily for improved ventilation and noise reduction, rather than just open-air driving appeal.

Even though it was compact, it was highly practical. Of note, the affordable FIAT 500, with its immense popularity in Italy, inspired a variety of tuning models over the years. Among them, the model tuned by Carlo Abarth—hailed as the god of engine tuning—was unmatched in the compact class, making the 500 a formidable force in motorsports.

Naturally, the FIAT 500 itself evolved. In 1959, the sport model was introduced, with engine displacement increased to <499cc> and power raised to <18ps>. This sports engine came as standard fare in the 500D, introduced in 1961. And, for safety reasons, the original front-opening doors were replaced with rear-hinged ones in the 1965 FIAT 500F.

As a pioneer of the "minimum car" concept—some call it the original mini—this iconic vehicle remains beloved to this day.

long.zh:
菲亚特500是一款于1957年面世的紧凑型车，继承了战前车款Topolino的理念。但更重要的是，它是一辆全新乘用车，追求最基础的功能性。

诚然，Topolino和菲亚特500之间有许多不同之处。与双座的Topolino相比，菲亚特500虽然紧凑，但可供4个成年人乘坐。此外，Topolino的引擎为前置后驱，菲亚特500则采用全单体车壳和引擎后置前驱式布局。

菲亚特500的引擎为一款<479cc>的风冷双缸顶置式气门引擎，马力为<15ps>，最高速度可达到<90km/h>。标配前半开式、帆布车顶。这样的设计主要考虑噪音控制和通风的需求。

虽然属于一款紧凑型车，但菲亚特500非常实用。这款价格亲民的菲亚特500在意大利尤其受到欢迎，多年来也诞生了许多调校版车型。其中由当时的引擎调校之神卡洛·阿巴斯调校的车型在当时紧凑型车款中无可匹敌，在各种赛车比赛中也非常有竞争力。

当然，菲亚特500自身也在发展。1959年，跑车车型首次亮相，引擎排量增加到<499cc>，最大马力输出也上升到<18ps>。跑车引擎在1961年发布的500D上成为了标配。之后，前开门设计由于安全原因被替换，在1965年的500F上被改为后开门。

作为“小型车”或“迷你车”的先驱，这款车在今天仍然享有高人气。

An even more potent variant of the 595 later emerged as the 595 Esseesse. While it retained the same engine displacement, engineers raised compression to boost output to 31.6 HP. usedCar.en:
Many consider the early 1960s as Abarth's golden era.

A big part of the reason is because of the 500 Esseesse.

Although it only produces a mere <32ps>, which might
lead you to think it's underpowered...

...but in fact, its small, light construction gave it
a surprising amount of pep.

In fact, its performance is nothing short of incredible.

Esseesse, incidentally, is the Italian pronunciation
of SS, which stands for Super Sport.

马力不足。

然而，这样小型而轻量的构造却会产生

顺便说一句，Esseesse是意大利语

vehicleCollection.en:
A hardcore sports version of the FIAT 500.

Introduced in 1963, the FIAT Abarth 595 was a high-performance version of the second-generation FIAT 500 tuned by Abarth.

While the base FIAT 500 featured a <496cc> air-cooled 2-cylinder engine, the Abarth version received comprehensive upgrades. Displacement was increased to <594cc>, complemented by enhanced intake and exhaust flow. These upgrades delivered a significant performance boost, with peak output rising from <18ps> to <27ps> and top speed increased from <95km/h> to <120km/h>. The transformation made the Abarth variant a favorite among young enthusiasts who craved more power.

Then, in 1964, Abarth introduced an even more finely tuned version of the 595. This car was called the 595 Esseesse.

The 595 Esseesse utilized the same basic engine as its predecessor, but compression ratio was increased and a larger diameter carburetor was installed, resulting in <32ps> and a top speed of <130km/h>.

Thanks to the newfound power, the 595 series enjoyed great success in the under-<600cc>-class of racing all over Europe.

long.zh:
菲亚特阿巴斯595于1963年推出，是第二代菲亚特500的高性能版本，接受过阿巴斯的调校。

作为调校基础的菲亚特500车型拥有一台<496cc>的风冷双缸引擎。在阿巴斯版本中，这台引擎得到了全面改进，排量增加到了<594cc>，同时优化了进气和排气量。这让车辆的性能得到了巨大提升，最大输出功率从<18ps>增加到<27ps>，极速从<95km/h>增加到<120km/h>，立即受到众多渴望获得动力的年轻车迷的青睐。

在1964年，阿巴斯紧接着就发布了595的进一步调校版本。这便是595 Esseesse。

虽然引擎的排量没有变化，但提高了压缩比，并安装了一个更大直径的化油器，再加上重新设计的歧管，使得最大输出功率达到了<32ps>，最高速度更是达到了<130km/h>。

595系列旗下的各种车型在欧洲各地的多项<600cc>级以下房车比赛中取得了辉煌的胜利。

Since its debut in 1980, this first-gen Fiat Panda went on to
become a best-seller with a 20-year-plus production run.

The basic car par excellence, it remains beloved by drivers
all over the world.

The original Panda is perhaps the car most associated
with the world-class car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Fiat entrusted him with designing the next generation
of the compact car.

The obective was a car combining intuitive handling
with cost-effective production.

Drawing on his deep knowledge of automotive design, Giugiaro
came up with solutions to all sorts of problems...

...such as the economical ue of flat glass
for all of the car's window surfaces.

Ined, tis masterpiece is simply brimming with hallmarks
of his inimitable genius!

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The FIAT Panda is a front-wheel-drive hatchback introduced in 1980, born amid the compact-car boom that followed the oil crises. Its design was penned by the master stylist Giorgetto Giugiaro. To keep costs low, the body was crafted with straight lines and flat panels, achieving a look that was both practical and modern. At launch, buyers could choose between an air-cooled 652 cc 2-cylinder engine or a water-cooled 903 cc 4-cylinder unit. The model featured in Gran Turismo is the former.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: FIAT Panda是一款前轮驱动掀背车，于1980年第二次石油危机后的小型车热潮中推出。其外观设计由设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗操刀完成。为控制成本，车身采用直线线条和平整面板设计，呈现出简洁、现代且实用的外观。该车首发时提供两种引擎选项：风冷652 立方厘米双缸引擎或水冷903 立方厘米四缸引擎。这款在《跑车浪漫旅》游戏中登场的车型采用的是前者。

usedCar.en:
Perfect timing! I just received this little Italian gem—
a first-generation 1985 FIAT Panda.

This car debuted in 1980, during the global oil crisis,
when small, economical cars were in high demand.

Intended as a replacement for the 126, it was penned by
none other than master designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

To keep costs low, Giugiaro opted for a simple, boxy shape
that still managed to get across a modern sense of luxury.

The Panda came in a choice of <652cc> and <903cc> engines.
This is powered by the former, making it light and zippy.

Giugiaro’s self-proclaimed masterpiece, the Panda is one car
you can’t do without!'

vehicleCollection.en:
This jewel of a compact car is the one designer Giugiaro called his greatest work.

In 1980, as demand for smaller cars rose in the wake of the oil shock, Fiat introduced a bold new compact to replace the aging 126. In a stark departure from its predecessor, the Panda was a front-wheel-drive hatchback with a transverse, front-mounted engine.

Although relatively simple, its design was both modern and practical. The packaging of the Panda was entrusted to design maestro Giorgetto Giugiaro. To reduce costs, the body panels were shaped with flat surfaces and straight lines, while the windows were made of flat glass. The seats followed suit, using a basic hammock layout with fabric stretched over a pipe frame. Yet the overall look of the car was fresh, and the interior proved surprisingly spacious.

At its debut, the Panda was powered by either a <652cc> 2-cylinder air-cooled engine or a <903cc> 4-cylinder water-cooled engine. At the time, Fiat named its engines according to output, with the former designated the 30 and the latter the 45. In 1983, a part-time 4-wheel-drive 4x4 version appeared. It marked a world first for a vehicle with a transverse-engine/front-wheel-drive layout.

The Panda became an immediate success upon release, quickly emerging as one of the driving forces behind Fiat's resurgence. Giugiaro himself declared at the time that this compact masterpiece was the greatest work of his career.

1980年，石油危机后市场对小型车的需求不断增长，菲亚特随即推出一款大胆创新的紧凑型车型，以取代跟不上时代的126车型。与126车型截然不同的是，这款“Panda”采用前轮驱动掀背式设计，以及横置前引擎布局。

尽管结构相对简单，其设计却兼具现代感与实用性。Panda的整车布局由设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗亲自操刀设计。为控制成本，车身板件采用平面与直线元素构成，车窗也使用平面玻璃。座椅同样采用简易的吊床式绷布座椅，以织物覆盖钢管框架，但整车外观造型新颖，且内部空间意外宽敞。

Panda车型首发时提供两种引擎选项：<652cc>双缸风冷引擎或<903cc>四缸水冷引擎。当时，菲亚特往往根据引擎功率为车型命名，两台Panda分别被称为“30”型和“45”型。1983年，菲亚特推出了首款分时四轮驱动“4x4”车型。开创了基于横置前引擎前轮驱动平台的四驱系统全球先河。

Panda车型一经推出便大获成功，成为推动菲亚特取得市场成功的主要动力之一。这款紧凑型轿车设计中的瑰宝，还曾被乔治亚罗本人称为自己最杰出的作品。(

collection.en:
Ferrari's 250 GT series owes much of its renown to this car,
the 250 GT Berlinetta.

The model was announced by Ferrari in 1959, and marked a
decisive shift away from previous 250s.

One of the most notable differences was the <2400mm> wheelbase,
which was <200mm> shorter than its predecessors.

This gave the car better handling, and led to the name
"SWB," which stands for "short wheelbase."

The V12 engine was also more powerful,

and driven by great drivers including Stirling Moss Graham Hill,
and Carroll Shelby,

 the model proved to be an outstanding success.

The total production of the Ferrari 250 Berlinetta was
around 160 cars in total.

Some of these featured an aluminum body for racing, while
others like this onehad steel bodies for street use.

vehicleCollection.en:
A predecessor to the 250 GTO, this car racked up numerous wins in the world of endurance racing.

Styled by Pininfarina, the 250 GT Berlinetta made its debut at the 1959 Paris Motor Show, equipped with a 3.0-liter 12-cylinder engine that had 250 cc of displacement in each of its cylinders, as the name implied.

There was a definitive difference between this car and previous models. The car's wheelbase, which measured <2600mm> long, had been chopped down to <2400mm> in order to improve cornering agility. It was also to give it an edge in GT category racing. Years later, the car came to be known as the "250 GT Berlinetta passo corto," or 250 GT Berlinetta SWB (the abbreviation for Short Wheelbase in English) to distinguish this version from previous models.

The 250 GT Berlinetta passo corto began production in 1960, a year after its public unveiling, and came with an all-aluminum racing body, as well as a steel body for road-going models. The <2953cc> SOHC V12 produced between <220ps> to <280ps>, depending on its degree of tuning, and was the first mass production vehicle by Ferrari to be equipped with 4-wheel disc brakes.

The immediate racing success that was to follow was largely attributed to the car's shorter wheelbase: Nearly unstoppable, it won the Tour De France Automobile three years in a row from 1960 to 1962 and the GT category at Le Mans in 1960 and 1961. It also won the Nürburgring <1000km> race two years in a row, from 1961 to 1962. Thereafter, the 250 GT passed the baton to the 250 GTO, which was based on the 250 GT Berlinetta passo corto. In the end, only 162 examples of this beautiful grand touring machine were built.

long.zh:
全新的250 GT Berlinetta于1959年的巴黎车展上公布，它的造型源自宾尼法利纳的设计，名字中的250则来自3.0L 12缸引擎中每个气缸的容积250 cc。

这款车型与早期型号有一个根本性的不同：它把250 GT系列的底盘从传统的<2600mm>缩短到了<2400mm>，目的是提升过弯的灵敏性，以在超跑比赛中取得优势。接下来的几年里，它也常常被称为250 GT Berlinetta passo corto，或是250 GT Berlinetta SWB（“短轴距”的英语缩写），以便与早期型号区别开来。

1960年，250 GT Berlinetta passo corto投入生产，有竞速用途的全铝车身版和公路用途的钢车身版可供选择。根据调校，它的<2953cc>顶置单凸轮轴V12引擎能够输出<220ps>到<280ps>区间的动力。它是法拉利第一款采用四轮碟刹的量产车型。

通过缩短底盘获得的性能提升使这台双座在各项比赛中所向披靡。它从1960年到1962年连续3年赢得了环法汽车赛，并在勒芒的GT组别中将1960和1961年的桂冠收入囊中。它还在1961年到1962年连续两次赢得纽博格林1000公里耐力赛。在此之后，它将接力棒交给了自己的升级车型250 GTO。

这款车总共只生产了162辆。

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra-popular car was built to win the GT Class International Championship title.

When you think of multi-million-dollar classic exotics, the first name that usually comes to mind is Ferrari. And among all the valuable Ferrari cars through history, the 250 GTO stands out as the “collectable Ferrari.” Built in the early 1960s, the 250 GTO, the original Testarossa, made an immediate impact on the world sports car scene.

The “250” in the name indicates its engine displacement of 250cc per cylinder. And the car had 12 cylinders, which meant it was a total displacement of 3.0 liters. The “GTO” stands for Gran Turismo Omologato, a reference to it being a homologation model for GT racing. And as such a name implies, it was introduced in 1962 specifically to win the GT class in international production sports car racing.

The car was based on the agile 250 GT SWB, but with a lighter curb weight. Covering its steel tubular frame was an all-aluminum body, and the nose was long and low in order to boost aerodynamic performance. The rear of the car was characterized by a coda tronca, with bulging rear fenders to allow space for large tires. The ride height of the car is <90mm> lower than the SWB. Power comes from a Testarossa engine with a dry oil sump and six carburetors, delivering an output of <300ps>. It helped enable the car to reach a top speed of <300km/h>.

Only 39 250 GTOs were ever produced, which by itself was not enough for homologation. But Ferrari stated that the car was simply a variation of the SWB, and once this was accepted, the car started racing in '62. The 250 GTO won the international championship three years in a row.

All 39 of these cars still exist today. The 3729GT included in the game is a right-hand drive model delivered to the UK in '62. It was once raced by a Ferrari semi-works team, and achieved podium finishes in many British races. 8

long.zh:
对车迷来说，任何一台法拉利都是最想拥有的对象。但250 GTO是一款特别的车，此车问世于60年代早期，当时赛车和公路车之间的界限十分模糊。这款车是当时最受欢迎的车款。

其名称中的“250”是指每个汽缸排量为<250cc>，12缸共计3升。GTO代表跑车浪漫旅认证车型，是指用于GT比赛的认证车型。如名称所示，该车开发于1962年，用于参加国际量产跑车比赛中的GT级别比赛。

此车基于灵巧的250 GT SWB开发，对其钢管车架进行了轻量化改造。车身为全铝制，车头长而低，以提高空气动力学性能。车尾为“断尾”的形式，后挡泥板加宽并凸起，为大轮胎留出了空间。车辆的行驶高度也降低了<90mm>。采用带干式润滑油槽和6个渗碳器的Testarossa引擎，马力高达<300ps>。在8速可用的最终齿轮比中选择最快的组合时，最高时速可达到<300km/h>。

250 GTO一共只生产了39辆，未能满足接受认证的数量。因此法拉利将此车称作250 GT SWB的改款，从而绕过了这一问题。250 GTO通过认证参加比赛后，自1962年起连续三年蝉联了国际系列赛的冠军。

法拉利所生产的39辆车全都保存至今，游戏中的3729GT是1962年交付到英国的右侧驾驶型号。此车曾在一支法拉利半厂商车队中效力，并在一系列英国比赛中登上领奖台。

法拉利在纽博格林24小时耐力赛斩获首个全场冠军！

缔造这一历史性突破的正是法拉利296 GT3。

这场载入史册的比赛以创纪录的162圈完成。

但296 GT3的成就远不止于此。

三台参赛赛车全部顺利完赛，充分证明了其优异的可靠性。

此后，296 GT3更在全球耐力赛场上连战连捷！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Derived from the 296 GTB, the 296 GT3 was a purebred race machine that shed the plug-in hybrid system of the road car, relying solely on a 600-horsepower twin-turbocharged V-6 engine. Built by world-renowned constructor Oreca, the car was crafted with meticulous precision—from chassis construction and assembly to customer support. After its debut at the 24 Hours of Spa in July 2022, it quickly demonstrated its exceptional racing prowess, achieving 100 victories in less than two years.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 作为基于296 GTB开发的GT3赛车，296 GT3摒弃了公路版车型的插电混动系统，仅搭载可输出600匹马力的V6双涡轮增压引擎，成为了一辆纯种赛车。该车由世界级赛车制造商Oreca打造，其业务涵盖从底盘制造、整车组装到客户服务。该车于2022年7月首次在斯帕24小时耐力赛亮相，随后在不到两年的时间里赢得了100场比赛，展示了其高性能的赛车能力。
officialDetails.heroEn: This elegant GT3 machine is also known as the "Racing Queen."
officialDetails.heroZh: 一款被誉为“赛道女王”的优雅GT3赛车。

brandCentral.en:
Making its debut in 2022, the mid-engine 296 GTB
was Ferrari’s first V-6 plug-in hybrid.

Praised for its compact dimensions and featherweight
agility, it was a road car built for the track.

The 296 GTB would go on to serve as the foundation for the
296 GT3, successor to the storied 488 GT3.

To meet GT3 regulations, Ferrari replaced the hybrid system
with a pure twin-turbo V-6, producing 591.7 bhp.

Assembly was entrusted to the legendary French outfit Oreca,
which also provided maintenance and after-sales support.

Since its debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona, the 296 GT3
quickly proved itself as a relentless competitor.

By the end of 2024, with 100 victories to its name,
it had become the undisputed star of GT3 racing.
brandCentral.zh:
2022年推出的中置引擎296 GTB是
Ferrari首款V6插电混动跑车。

它以紧凑尺寸与极致轻量化著称，
堪称为赛道而生的公路猛兽。

事实上，296 GTB正是296 GT3的研发基础，
后者接替488 GT3成为新一代战驹。

为使该车符合GT3赛事规范，Ferrari将其混动系统更换为
纯双涡轮V6引擎，输出动力达591.7 BHP。

组装由传奇法国赛车制造商Oreca操刀，
并提供后续维护和售后支持。

自2023年戴通纳24小时赛首秀以来，
296 GT3不断证明其纯正血统，展现出不可撼动的实力。

截至2024年底就已豪取100胜，
当之无愧地成为了GT3赛事的耀眼明星。

vehicleCollection.en:
This elegant GT3 machine is also known as the "Racing Queen.")

Ferrari had long produced racing machines derived from its road-going super sports cars, achieving remarkable results in endurance and GT race championships. The 296 GT3 was one such car to carry on that tradition, developed from the 296 GTB.

As a pure racing machine, the 296 GT3 dispensed with the plug-in hybrid system of the road car, relying solely on a 600-horsepower twin-turbo V-6 engine. This unit employed a 3.0-liter 120-degree V-6, extensively modified for weight reduction and reliability. Drivetrain, cooling components, and aerodynamic parts were all replaced with dedicated race versions.

Unlike earlier racing Ferraris, traditionally constructed by Michelotto, the 296 GT3 was built by legendary race-car specialists Oreca. From chassis construction to assembly and after-sales service, Oreca provided full end-to-end support. The car was first unveiled at the 2022 24 Hours of Spa in July, before making its racing debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona.

The 296 GT3 was not confined to the current international endurance championships; its design continued to evolve toward the future. An Evo version, with enhanced aerodynamic efficiency and improved endurance, had already been announced for the 2026 season.

By blending the sophistication of its road-going sibling with the raw speed of a track machine, the 296 GT3 became the new standard-bearer of Ferrari’s motorsports strategy.

long.zh:
法拉利基于其公路版超级跑车，研发了多款专业赛车，并在耐力赛与房车锦标赛中屡创佳绩。296 GT3正是承袭这一品牌传统的车型，基于296 GTB平台开发。

作为纯种赛车，296 GT3摒弃了公路版车型的插电混动系统，仅搭载输出600匹马力的V6双涡轮增压引擎。该动力单元采用120度3升V6中后置引擎，经过全面优化改进，专注于实现轻量化与可靠性提升。传动系统、冷却组件以及空气动力学套件均已更换为专用赛车版本。

与米奇洛托打造的经典法拉利赛车不同，这款车型由传奇赛车制造商奥雷卡操刀打造。从底盘制造到整车组装，再到售后服务，奥雷卡提供覆盖全产业链的一站式支持。该车于2022年7月首次亮相斯帕24小时耐力赛，随后在次年2023年的戴通纳24小时耐力赛完成竞技首秀。

296 GT3不仅着眼于当前的国际耐力锦标赛，其设计理念亦持续演进，始终面向未来赛道需求。法拉利已宣布将于2026赛季推出空气动力学与耐久性能全面进阶的Evo版本。

该车完美融合公路版跑车的精湛工艺与赛车的纯粹速度，成为法拉利赛车运动战略的全新标杆。_

with its engine.

for several models between 1970 and 1990.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 296 GTB itself was a plug-in hybrid and the first Ferrari to feature a V-6 engine since the iconic Dino series. The smallest member of Ferrari’s current lineup, its beautifully sculpted body paid homage to the 250 LM of the 1960s. Power came from a mid-mounted twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine paired with a 123 kW electric motor, producing a combined output of 830 horsepower. Capable of accelerating from 0-62.1 mph in just 2.9 seconds and reaching 205.1 mph at full stride, the 296 GTB delivered the breathtaking performance worthy of the Ferrari name.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 296 GTB是一款插电式混合动力跑车，同时配备了自Dino系列以来首款V6引擎。经典风格的车身设计致敬1960年代的经典车型250 LM，同时也是当前Ferrari产品线中最小的车型。该车采用中置布局搭载3升V6双涡轮增压引擎，结合123千瓦电机，系统综合输出功率达830马力。该车仅需2.9秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高速度能达到330 公里/小时，性能当之无愧于Ferrari之名。
officialDetails.heroEn: Here's a mid-engine sports car with a revolutionary V-6 + PHEV system.
officialDetails.heroZh: 采用革命性V6+PHEV系统的中置引擎跑车。

brandCentral.en:
Ferrari was an early adopter of hybrid technology, as
evidenced by the LaFerrari and the SF90 Stradale.

The 296 GTB was also a plug-in hybrid, but it was powered
by a V6, which Ferrari first adopted for the Dino.

This 3L twin-turbo V6, when combined with an electric motor,
boasts an output of <830ps>.

Not only does this hybrid technology reduce CO2 emissions,
but it also offers drivers a high output.

The car’s exterior, with its low nose, is another big draw,
making nods to the classical forms of the legendary 250 LM.

Measuring <4565mm> in length, it’s surprisingly compact, and
its light V6 only adds to its advantages on the track.

Without a doubt, this is one car that shows Ferrari’s desire
to make electrification hene secret weapon in motorsport.
brandCentral.zh:
Ferrari是混动技术的先行者，
LaFerrari和SF90 Stradale便是例证。

296 GTB也是一款插电混动车型，不同的是它
搭载了V6引擎——Ferrari最初为Dino采用的配置。

这款3升双涡轮增压V6引擎结合电机，
综合输出功率可达<830ps>。

混动技术不仅有助于降低二氧化碳排放，
更能提供强劲动力输出。

车辆外观的另一大亮点是其低鼻锥设计，
向传奇车型250 LM的经典造型致敬。

车身长度仅<4565mm>，极为紧凑，
轻量化V6引擎在赛道上更有优势。

毫无疑问，这款车彰显了Ferrari
将电气化作为赛车运动新型秘密武器的决心。

catch.en: Here's a mid-engine sports car with a revolutionary V-6 + PHEV system.
catch.zh: 采用革命性V6+PHEV系统的中置引擎跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Here's a mid-engine sports car with a revolutionary V-6 + PHEV system.

There is a long-standing tradition within the Ferrari line-up in which its super sports models have relied on a mid-mounted V-8s. With a lightweight, high-revving engine placed behind the driver, this layout delivered sharp response and agile maneuverability, and it became emblematic of the brand. The 296 GTB carried forward parts of that legacy while opening the door to new possibilities.

It was the first Ferrari to adopt a twin-turbo V-6 engine. And it was the first time in more than a half century that a V-6 block had been used by the marque—last seen on the 206 and 246 under the Dino name. With a displacement of <2992cc>, the engine employed a 120-degree bank angle with IHI turbochargers positioned within the vee.

One of the key reasons behind the move to a V-6 powertrain was the integration of a plug-in hybrid (PHEV) system. Combined with a 123kW electric motor, the system produced a total of 830 horsepower, allowing for blistering acceleration from zero to <100km/h> in just 2.9 seconds. With a top speed of <330km/h>, the 296 GTB offered performance truly worthy of the Ferrari name.

Its design paid homage to the legendary 250 LM of the 1960s, while also being the most compact model in the contemporary Ferrari line-up. The distinctive tunnel-back rear window enhanced both aerodynamics and elegance. Blending the classic mid-engine sports layout with groundbreaking technology, the 296 GTB stood as the epitome of Ferrari’s new generation.

long.zh:
法拉利产品系列秉承一项悠久传统：其超级跑车车型均采用中置V8引擎布局。此布局将轻量化高转速引擎置于驾驶舱后方，带来敏锐的响应特性与卓越的操控性能，现已成为该品牌的标志性特征。296 GTB在延续这一传统精髓的同时，也为新技术的可能性开辟了道路。

首先，296 GTB是法拉利首款搭载V6双涡轮增压引擎的车型。这也意味着V6引擎时隔半个多世纪后首次回归——上一次应用还需追溯至Dino旗下的206与246车型。创新设计的引擎排量达<2992cc>，采用120度V型夹角结构，并将石川岛播磨重工业涡轮增压器集成于V型夹角空间内。

296 GTB采用V6动力总成的关键因素之一，在于引入了插电式混合动力系统。传统引擎协同这部能产生123千瓦的电机，该系统综合输出功率达830匹马力，仅需2.9秒即可完成0-<100km/h>加速，表现令人惊叹。极速高达<330km/h>，整体性能表现完美契合法拉利品牌精髓。

车身设计致敬1960年代的经典车型250 LM，同时也是当前法拉利产品线中最为紧凑的车型。内凹式后窗设计兼顾空气动力学性能与优雅气质。296 GTB将经典的中置跑车布局与革命性技术相融合，堪称新一代法拉利车型的典范之作。

Not only is the 308 the forebear of all modern 8-cylinder
Ferraris, it is undoubtedly the most popular of them all.

It may also be the longest-lasting.

If one includes the 328 variant, its production run
spanned from 1975 to 1989.

The car's success is due to its pure and timeless design.

It is also said to be very well balanced...

And serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s
design philosophy.

It even revives classic themes from the Dino 246,
such as the flared wheel arches...

The iconic side air intake, the dynamic rear pillars...

And the truncated tail with four round taillights.

Indeed, all of these elemnt wre transformed to express
a very odern form for its day.<next id=22509 typ=9

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 1975, the 308 GTB replaced the Dino 246 GT and launched Ferrari’s long-running series of V-8-powered two-seaters. Its elegant body, laid over a steel-tube frame, was designed by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina, the mind behind many of Ferrari’s most celebrated shapes from the 1960s through the early 1990s.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1975年亮相的308 GTB接替Dino 246 GT，开启了经久不衰的双座V8车型风潮。管状车架之上覆盖的优雅车身出自Pininfarina的列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂之手，他在1960年代末至1990年代初设计了一系列Ferrari车型。
officialDetails.heroEn: This successor to the Ferrari Dino 246 GT features a V-8 mounted amidships.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款Dino 246 GT的继任者采用中置布局，容纳一台V8引擎。

usedCar.en:
The tradition of Ferrari's mid-engine V-8 began with
the 308.

The car's elegant wedge-shaped design, penned
by Pininfarina, made it instantly popular.

And its basic proportions were inherited by later V-8 models.

Thanks to its head-turning looks, the 308 also appeared
in many movies and TV series.

Its compact body made it lightweight and agile, while
the V-8 let out a truly melodic roar.

This 1975 model came equipped with both fuel injectors and
carburetors.

The wonderful engine and the responsive chassis
made this car as fun to drive as it was to look at.
usedCar.zh:
传统的法拉利中置引擎V8车型始于
308系列。

确实，这一车型无疑具有真正的
历史价值。

它的设计正是出自Pininfarina之手。

随后的V8车型继承了其
时尚的比例。

它的紧凑型车身轻盈而敏捷，
性感的引擎音非常悦耳。

这款1975年的车型同时采用燃油喷射和
化油器。

灵敏的油门使得这款车型更趋完美，
让你真正享受引擎的咆哮。;

vehicleCollection.en:
This successor to the Ferrari Dino 246 GT features a V-8 mounted amidships."

Making its debut in 1975 was the successor to the very popular Ferrari Dino 246 GT called the 308 GTB. This svelte sports car represented one of the first of a long line of V-8-powered mid-engine Ferraris that would the exotic-car genre for years to come.

The wedge-shaped exterior was penned by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina, who was responsible for a number of Ferrari designs from the late 1960s to the early 1990s.

Under the sheet metal, the 308 GTB was equipped with a 3.0-liter DOHC V-8, the same powerplant as the Dino 208 GT4, which produced <255ps>. In 1980, new emissions regulations brought output down to <215ps>, but two years later Ferrari increased it back up to <240ps> after it adopted a 4-valve system for the engine. The new car was called the 308 GTB Quattrovalvole. In 1977, a targa top GTS was added to the mix, setting the stage for the 328 that was introduced in 1985.

long.en:

The wedge-shaped exterior was penned by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina, who was responsible for a number of Ferrari designs from the late 1960s to the early 1990s.

Under the sheet metal, the 308 GTB was equipped with a 3.0-liter DOHC V-8, the same powerplant as the Dino 208 GT4, which produced <255ps>. In 1980, new emissions regulations brought output down to <215ps>, but two years later Ferrari increased it back up to <240ps> after it adopted a 4-valve system for the engine. The new car was called the 308 GTB Quattrovalvole. In 1977, a targa top GTS was added to the mix, setting the stage for the 328 that was introduced in 1985.
long.zh:
308GTB是法拉利制造的一款引擎中置跑车，于1975年首次在众人面前亮相。作为Dino 246 GT的继任者，此车被认为是双座中置V8引擎风潮的滥觞，并在之后成为了法拉利阵容的主打。

管式车架之上覆盖的优雅外观是由宾尼法利纳的列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂设计的，他负责了从60年代末到90年代初的一系列法拉利车型设计。

此车使用了与Dino 308 GT4相同的3升V8双顶置凸轮轴引擎，初期型号可产生<255ps>的动力。然而在1980年，为了满足新的排放法规，引擎改为燃油喷射，该车摇身一变，变成了308 GTBi。1982年，为了解决动力输出不足问题（已降至<215ps>），引擎的气缸盖换用了4气门设计，创造出了<240ps>的308 GTB四气门。

从1977年起，法拉利还追加推出了采用Targa顶篷的GTS车型。在1985年接替此车的328车型上，308 GTB的车身外观风格也得到延续。

conversation.en:
There never was a more stylish and sleek
thoroughbred than the 330 P4.

Not before or since.

It may have been built for racing, but it doesn't feel
like ‘winning’ was the absolute objective.

You could say that it is the ultimate expression of
a style that goes back to the 250 P of the ‘60s.

In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces
are very expressive...

Giving it its Italian flavour.

After the 330 P4, Ferrari racers went a bit dry,
prioritising performance and function.

Indeed, this masterpiece comes from an era when race cars
were still works of art.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
我的观点是，330 P4是最时尚、最具魅力的纯血赛车，

前无古人，后无来者。

尽管这辆车是严格按照竞赛标准设计的，
但如果你只看外观，赢得比赛似乎并不是它的最高设计准则。

可以说330 P4就是Ferrari在1960年代
中置引擎赛车设计的终极体现。

从设计美学的角度分析，它的侧面线条和轮廓
既流畅，又充满力量感……

……呈现出独有的意大利风貌。

在它之后，就连Ferrari的赛车都开始变得
不那么重视美感，而是将优先级放在性能和功能上。

这款杰作代表了JBp车也可以很美的时代。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 330 P4 was Ferrari’s answer to the dominance of the Ford GT. Although only four units were ever made, a berlinetta version for high-speed tracks and a roofless spider for reduced weight were produced. It won its debut race at the 24 Hours of Daytona. While Ford ultimately triumphed at Le Mans, Ferrari secured the World Sportscar Championship title.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 330 P4诞生的目的是为了击败当时风头正盛的Ford GT。尽管总共仅生产了4台，但依旧分出了针对高速赛道的berlinetta版本和为减重而移除车顶的spider版本。它在戴通纳24小时耐力赛中首秀即夺冠。虽然Ford在勒芒获胜，但Ferrari随后就还以颜色，赢得了世界跑车锦标赛。
officialDetails.heroEn: This V12-powered P Series race car was known as "the most beautiful machine ever."
officialDetails.heroZh: 采用V12引擎的P系列车型中最美丽的一款。

collection.en:
The Ferrari 330 P4 is, without a doubt, one of the
most beautiful race cars in the world.

And one of the rarest also.

The Ferrari P series are sports cars with a mid-mounted
V-12 engine.

First developed in 1963, they have an amazing track record,
with many historic wins over the years.

The development of the P series was stepped up
to challenge Ford at Le Mans...

...and it reached its pinnacle with the P4 in 1967.

At the 1967 Daytona 24-hour race, two 330 P4s and one 412P
pulled off a spectacular 1-2-3 finish.

Even if you include the P3 modified to P4 specifications,
only four 330 P4s were ever produced.
collection.zh:
Ferrari 330 P4无疑是世界上最美、

也是最稀有的赛车之一。

Ferrari P系列是搭载中置V12引擎的跑车，

首次开发于1963年，并在当时的许多比赛中书写了辉煌的
历史。

为了在勒芒24小时耐力赛中与Ford对抗，P系列的开发力量
得到了补强，

并在1967年的“P4”中达到了巅峰。

在1967年的戴通纳24小时耐力赛中，两辆330 P4和一辆412P技
惊四座，包揽了前三。

即使算上改装成P4规格的P3，330 P4总共也只生产了4辆。

vehicleCollection.en:
This V12-powered P Series race car was known as "the most beautiful machine ever."f

When thinking of Ferrari's motorsports activities, the first thing that comes to mind are their feats in the F1 Grand Prix. However from the 1950s to the 1960s, they also enjoyed great success in sports car racing. Though they withdrew from sports car racing in 1973, the 330 P4 is one car that left its name in history for being the most beautiful machine out of the "P series" V12 midship engine prototype racers, that left a glorious record from the '60s to the '70s.

330 stands for the displacement per cylinder, in other words signifying a 4-liter displacement engine, and the name stands for the fourth version of the P series equipped with a 4-liter engine.

The 330 P4 debuting in 1967 was developed by improving upon the 330 P3, in order to defeat the Ford GT which was on top at the time. Though with the same displacement as the previous version, it was given a <450ps> engine of an almost brand new design, with 3 valves per cylinder consisting of two intake and 1 exhaust on the heads. The nose of the body was slightly extended to the front, and a separate spoiler was added to the rear, to improve its aerodynamic capabilities.

In actual racing, it started off by winning its debut race in the 24 hours of Daytona, and in the Monza 1,000 km race. Unfortunately it was defeated by Ford in the 24 Hours of Le Mans, but it was successful in defeating Porsche in the sports car world championships, and became series champion.

long.en:
When thinking of Ferrari's motorsports activities, the first thing that comes to mind are their feats in the F1 Grand Prix. However from the 1950s to the 1960s, they also enjoyed great success in sports car racing. Though they withdrew from sports car racing in 1973, the 330 P4 is one car that left its name in history for being the most beautiful machine out of the "P series" V12 midship engine prototype racers, that left a glorious record from the '60s to the '70s.

330 stands for the displacement per cylinder, in other words signifying a 4-liter displacement engine, and the name stands for the fourth version of the P series equipped with a 4-liter engine.

The 330 P4 debuting in 1967 was developed by improving upon the 330 P3, in order to defeat the Ford GT which was on top at the time. Though with the same displacement as the previous version, it was given a <450ps> engine of an almost brand new design, with 3 valves per cylinder consisting of two intake and 1 exhaust on the heads. The nose of the body was slightly extended to the front, and a separate spoiler was added to the rear, to improve its aerodynamic capabilities.

In actual racing, it started off by winning its debut race in the 24 hours of Daytona, and in the Monza 1,000 km race. Unfortunately it was defeated by Ford in the 24 Hours of Le Mans, but it was successful in defeating Porsche in the sports car world championships, and became series champion.
long.zh:
每当人们念及法拉利的赛车活动时，首先想到的往往是它们在F1大奖赛中取得的成就。然而在二十世纪五十年代到六十年代，它们在跑车比赛中同样获得了巨大的成功。虽然从1973年起，它们就退出了该类赛事，但330 P4仍然作为P系列中最美的一款V12中置式引擎原型车而青史留名。这款车在六十年代和七十年代曾创下了一系列辉煌的纪录。

330代表每个汽缸的排量，换言之，也就是排量为4升，因此，这个车名意味着装备了4升引擎的P系列第4代车款。

330 P4于1967年首次亮相，是330 P3的改进版，目标是击败当时的霸主——福特GT。虽然其排量与前一车款相同，配备的却是几乎全新设计的<450ps>引擎，每个汽缸有三个位于顶部的气门，包括两个进气口和一个排气口。车身前端略微向前伸出，并在车尾增加了独立扰流板，以改善其空气动力学性能。

在真实比赛中，这款车在戴通纳24小时耐力赛中首战告捷，在随后的蒙扎1000公里耐力赛中亦取得了胜利。不幸的是，该车在勒芒24小时耐力赛中惜败于福特，但在世界跑车锦标赛中成功击败保时捷，夺得系列赛冠军。

Known as the “Daytona," it is the epitome of

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 365 GTB/4—aka Daytona—was the last Ferrari to have a front-mounted V-12 and made its debut at the 1968 Paris Motor Show. It wore sleek bodywork penned by Leonardo Fioravanti, with a 4390 cc DOHC V-12 powerplant residing underneath. With a top speed of 174 mph, it matched the Lamborghini Miura as the fastest production car of its time.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 作为Ferrari最后一款搭载前置12缸引擎的车型，365 GTB/4（又名“Daytona”）于1968年巴黎车展首次亮相。列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂设计的流线性车身下，隐藏着一台4,390 立方厘米的双顶置凸轮轴V12引擎。其最高时速可达280 公里/小时，与竞争对手Lamborghini Miura并列成为当时最快的车。
officialDetails.heroEn: The ultimate super sport, this front engine, rear-wheel drive machine rivaled the Miura for the highest top speed of its day.
officialDetails.heroZh: 最最顶级的前置后驱超级跑车，与对手Miura争夺最高速度的极致。

collection.en:
The 365 GTB4 remains one of the most memorable Ferraris.

It made its debut in 1968...

...as the successor to iconic 1960s Ferraris
like the 250 GT Lusso and the 275 GTB.

It is a front engine/rear-wheel-drive model,
powered by a 4-cam <4390cc> V-12.

Like all Ferraris of the period, the first number indicated
the displacement per cylinder.

The "GT" stood for "Gran Turismo."

The "B" designated it as a "Berlinetta,"
meaning that it was a coupe.

And the "4" represented th 4-cam engine with
double overhead cams on each cylinder bank.

Most people know this car as the
Ferrari Daytona.

A name inspired by the company's historic 1-2-3 finish at
the Daytona 24 Hours in '67, a year prior to its release.

A major acievement indeed!
collection.zh:
365 GTB4是真正的旗舰车型。

它于1968年首次亮相，

是1960年代法拉利指标性车款
250 GT Lusso和275 GTB的后继者。

这款前置引擎、后轮驱动的车型由一台前置的<4390cc>4凸轮V12
引擎驱动。

像那个时期的所有Ferrari一样，名字中的数字表示每个气缸
的排量，

“GT”则代表“gran turismo”。

B代表“Berlinetta”，
表明这是一台双门跑车。

最后的“4”则代表每个气缸组都装有双顶置凸轮的四
凸轮引擎。

此外，法拉利365 GTB4又普遍被称为
“法拉利戴通纳”，

因为在其发布的前一年，Ferrari在1967年戴通纳24小时耐力赛
中取得了独占前三的历史性战绩。

这GvD一项一重大成就。*

catch.en: The ultimate super sport, this front engine, rear-wheel drive machine rivaled the Miura for the highest top speed of its day.
catch.zh: 最最顶级的前置后驱超级跑车，与对手Miura争夺最高速度的极致。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate super sport, this front engine, rear-wheel drive machine rivaled the Miura for the highest top speed of its day.

Following the debut of the 1973 Berlinetta Boxer, Ferrari’s V-12-powered supercars transitioned to mid-engine layouts, which would define the marque’s flagship models for many years to come. The final front-engine rear-wheel-drive Ferrari before this hiatus was the 365 GTB4, more widely recognized by its popular nickname, “Daytona.”

The nickname stemmed from Ferrari’s commanding performance at the 1967 Daytona 24-hour race, where the 330 P4 and 412 P sports prototypes secured a 1-2-3 finish, sweeping the podium.

The first to reportedly refer to the car as the “Daytona” was Luigi Chinetti, owner of the Ferrari dealer and semi-works racing outfit, the North American Racing Team (N.A.R.T.), at the time of the prototype’s initial delivery.

The Daytona was developed with a strong focus on the North American market. Its sleek silhouette penned by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina. Initially fitted with quad headlights housed beneath Plexiglas covers, the design was updated to retractable units after 1970 to comply with North American safety regulations.

Under the hood, the <4390cc> DOHC V-12 engine was fed by six Weber carburetors, producing <352ps> and <44.0kgm> of torque. Its claimed top speed of <280km/h> matched that of its chief rival, the Lamborghini Miura, making it the fastest road car of its era.

At Daytona, it went on to dominate the Le Mans GT class for three consecutive years, cementing its legacy in motorsports history.

long.en:
Following the debut of the 1973 Berlinetta Boxer, Ferrari’s V-12-powered supercars transitioned to mid-engine layouts, which would define the marque’s flagship models for many years to come. The final front-engine rear-wheel-drive Ferrari before this hiatus was the 365 GTB4, more widely recognized by its popular nickname, “Daytona.”

The nickname stemmed from Ferrari’s commanding performance at the 1967 Daytona 24-hour race, where the 330 P4 and 412 P sports prototypes secured a 1-2-3 finish, sweeping the podium.

The first to reportedly refer to the car as the “Daytona” was Luigi Chinetti, owner of the Ferrari dealer and semi-works racing outfit, the North American Racing Team (N.A.R.T.), at the time of the prototype’s initial delivery.

The Daytona was developed with a strong focus on the North American market. Its sleek silhouette penned by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina. Initially fitted with quad headlights housed beneath Plexiglas covers, the design was updated to retractable units after 1970 to comply with North American safety regulations.

Under the hood, the <4390cc> DOHC V-12 engine was fed by six Weber carburetors, producing <352ps> and <44.0kgm> of torque. Its claimed top speed of <280km/h> matched that of its chief rival, the Lamborghini Miura, making it the fastest road car of its era.

At Daytona, it went on to dominate the Le Mans GT class for three consecutive years, cementing its legacy in motorsports history.
long.zh:
1973年Berlinetta Boxer问世后，在接下来的几年搭载V12引擎的法拉利超级跑车全部采用了中置引擎布局的设计。前置后驱布局的车型暂停生产，最后一款采用该布局的车型是365 GTB4，不过它的昵称“戴通纳”或许更为人熟知。

这个昵称之所以流传开来，是因为在1967年的戴通纳24小时耐力赛上，法拉利运动车队的原型车330 P4和412 P包揽前三，霸占了领奖台。

据说，当第一台原型车出厂时，第一个用“戴通纳”称呼它的人是路易吉·基内蒂。他既是法拉利的经销商，同时也是半厂队北美赛车的老板。

戴通纳主攻北美市场。它时髦的造型由宾尼法利纳的列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂所设计。车头灯原本有4个，安装在有机玻璃灯罩之后，但1970年后，为了满足北美的安全标准，车头灯改为上翻式。

它的<4390cc>双顶置凸轮轴V12引擎内安装了6台沃柏化油器，能输出<352ps>和<44.0kgm>扭矩。官宣的最高速度更是高达<280km/h>，与它的对手兰博基尼Miura持平，同为当时最快的汽车。

戴通纳连续3年称霸勒芒GT组别赛事，留下了无愧于它的名字的传奇故事。

这个昵称之所以流传开来，是因为在1967年的戴通纳24小时耐力赛上，法拉利运动车队的原型车330 P4和412 P包揽前三，霸占了领奖台。

据说，当第一台原型车出厂时，第一个用“戴通纳”称呼它的人是路易吉·基内蒂。他既是法拉利的经销商，同时也是半厂队北美赛车的老板。

戴通纳主攻北美市场。它时髦的造型由宾尼法利纳的列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂所设计。车头灯原本有4个，安装在有机玻璃灯罩之后，但1970年后，为了满足北美的安全标准，车头灯改为上翻式。

它的<4390cc>双顶置凸轮轴V12引擎内安装了6台沃柏化油器，能输出<352ps>和<44.0kgm>扭矩。官宣的最高速度更是高达<280km/h>，与它的对手兰博基尼Miura持平，同为当时最快的汽车。

戴通纳连续3年称霸勒芒GT组别赛事，留下了无愧于它的名字的传奇故事。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Revealed at the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show in September, the Ferrari 430 Scuderia reflected the brand’s Formula 1 expertise. Compared to the base F430, it featured enhanced aerodynamics, weight reduction, and more power. The result was a 0–62.1 mph sprint in just 3.6 seconds and a top speed of 198.8 mph.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 430 Scuderia于2007年9月在法兰克福车展上亮相，是Ferrari在F1上的技术经验的集大成之作，也是其史上最快的V8 Berlinetta。相较于基础款F430，它的引擎经过了深度调校，车重更轻，空气动力学表面得到了优化。最终造就了它令人咋舌的320 公里/小时最高速度和3.6秒的0-100 公里/小时加速。
officialDetails.heroEn: A road-going racer that greatly improved upon the performance of the F430.
officialDetails.heroZh: 对F430的性能进行大幅改进的合法上路车。

brandCentral.en:
The 430 Scuderia is one of the best cars out there
for tearing up the track.

Building on the formidable foundation of the F430 series...

...this variant was both more powerful and lighter,
benefiting from an engine upgrade and a stripped-down interior.

Adding to its prowess was an advanced electronic suspension system,
designed to allow drivers to push the car to its limits.

Its performance was so exceptional that it recorded lap times
rivaling those of the V-12-powered Enzo Ferrari!
brandCentral.zh:
430 Scuderia堪称征服赛道的顶级利器。

这款车型以臻于至善的法拉利F430系列为基础……

通过引擎升级和精简内饰设计，实现了更高的动力输出
和更轻的车身重量。

此外，430 Scuderia还配备了电子控制悬挂系统，使驾
驶者能够在赛道上充分发挥车辆的极限性能。

其惊人的速度令人瞠目结舌——它在赛道上创下的单圈
记录甚至能与搭载V12引擎的顶级超跑Enzo Ferrari比肩！!

usedCar.en:
The Ferrari 430 Scuderia represented the epitome
of driving exhilaration...

...whether it was tasked with a scenic coastal road
or attacking a racetrack.

Building on the performance of the F430 series, the Scuderia offered
a better experience with reduced weight and improved dynamics.

This incredible sports machine is an advanced evolution of the
F430's electronic stability system, tuned for track performance.

The 430 Scuderia was a genuine road-going racer
that really took its special concept to heart.
