430 Scuderia是追求驾驶乐趣或渴望征服赛道的车迷们
的理想之选。

这款车型基于超高性能的Ferrari F430系列打造，在大幅
减轻车重的同时提供了更强劲的动力输出。

此外，它还搭载了专为赛道优化的F430电子稳定系统
的升级版。

值得一提的是，在430 Scuderia之前，360系列就曾推

而430 Scuderia则是一款真正意义上的公路赛车，它将
这一特殊理念贯彻到了极致。

vehicleCollection.en:
A road-going racer that greatly improved upon the performance of the F430.

The Ferrari 430 Scuderia was unveiled in September 2007 at the Frankfurt Motor Show, introduced as a high-performance version of the F430. It also served as the successor to the 360 Challenge Stradale, a road-legal version of the 360 Challenge one-make race car from the 360 Modena era.

It came powered by the same 4.3-liter DOHC V-8 as the standard F430, further tuned to produce an additional <20ps> and <0.5kgm> of torque, resulting in a total output of <510ps> and <47.9kgm> of torque. Streamlined interior fittings contributed to a weight reduction of approximately <100kg>, bringing the total weight down to a lean 2975 lbs. These improvements resulted in an impressive power-to-weight ratio of just <2.45kg/ps>.

The transmission came in the form of the two-pedal manual "F1 Superfast 2," allowing gear changes to be performed as quick as 0.06 seconds. The running gear itself also significantly impacted driving and lap times, with several F1-derived technologies implemented into the car, including the F1-Trac combined traction and stability control system, and the electronically controlled E-Diff differential.

The front bumper and rear diffuser were modified to enhance aerodynamics, resulting in blistering performance with a top speed of <320km/h> and a 0-<100km/h> acceleration time of less than 3.6 seconds. Surprisingly, this car achieved lap times that rivaled those of the Enzo at Ferrari's test course.

long.zh:
430 Scuderia是在2007年9月在法兰克福车展上公布的，作为法拉利V8系列“F430”的高性能版本。它也被视作是360 Challenge Stradale的继任者，后者则是360 Modena时代诞生的360 Challenge单一车种赛车的合法上路版。

此车和标准版F430一样，由一台4.3升V8 双凸轮轴引擎驱动，经过进一步调试，能够产生额外的<20ps>/<0.5kgm>，从而使总输出达到<510ps>/<47.9kgm>。流线型的内饰使得车身重量再度减少了约<100kg>，使总重降至<1350kg>。这些改进的成果便是仅<2.45kg/ps>重量比。

变速箱是双踏板手动挡“F1 Superfast  2”，可以实现快至0.06秒的换挡速度。框架、底盘和悬挂等对操控和圈速也有直接影响，此外还采用了多项源自F1赛车的技术，如F1-Trac联合牵引力和稳定控制系统，以及支持电子控制的“E-Diff”差速器。

前保险杠和后扩散器经过改装以提高空气动力学效果，从而实现了令人咋舌的性能表现，最高速度达到<320km/h>，0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需不到3.6秒。更加令众人震惊不已的是，这款车型竟然能够刷新法拉利测试赛道上的圈速纪录，与当时人们最为重视的特别车型Enzo相比都不遑多让。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 458 Italia, introduced at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, succeeded the F430. Built on a new aluminum space frame, it housed a 4499 cc V-8 producing 562.1 HP and 398.5 ft-lb of torque. The upgraded Manettino system allowed seamless control of engine, transmission, and suspension settings. With F1-derived aero design, it hit 0–62.1 mph in 3.4 seconds and topped out at 201.9 mph.

usedCar.en:
Mechanical music for the soul. Yeah, that's what Ferrari V8s
are all about. No sound is more pleasant to the ears.

The beautiful 458 Italia introduced in 2010 came equipped
with one of Ferrari's sweetest-sounding engines.

Equipped with direct injection, the naturally-aspirated 4.5-liter
produced <570ps> and redlined at an incredible <9000rpm>.

It came mated to an F1-inspired 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox.

The rest of the car handled like a dream, with amazing cornering
balance befitting of a mid-engine/rear-drive exotic.

Taking on a race track with that Ferrari V8 singing behind
your ear is as close as you'll get to automotive nirvana.

catch.en: With an astonishing <570ps> under the hood, this V8 mid-engine machine took its heritage from the F430.

vehicleCollection.en:
With an astonishing <570ps> under the hood, this V8 mid-engine machine took its heritage from the F430.

With a new version of Ferrari's mid-engine V-8 car appearing every five years (starting from 1989), the successor to the popular F430 arrived in 2009. Called the Ferrari 458 Italia, the sleek supercar was introduced at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, succeeding the likes of the 348 (1989), F355 (1994), 360 Modena (1999) and F430 (2004).

The 458 Italia was built upon a newly designed aluminum space frame, which made it lighter than its predecessor. Behind the cockpit resided a direct-injection V-8 that pumped out <570ps>/<55.1kgm>, astonishing figures from a normally-aspirated engine. Power was transferred to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox whose shift speeds were significantly improved over the F355's. The Manettino system that unified the engine, gearbox, suspension, E-DIFF, F1 Trac, ESP and high-performance ABS controls was also improved, allowing the driver to choose one of five different modes: Low Grip, Sports, Race, CT cut, and CST cut.

The 458 Italia was a menace on the asphalt, running to <100km/h> in just 3.4 seconds, and hitting a top speed of <325km/h>. Considering that the final and very special grade model of the F430 Scuderia accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in 3.6 seconds, and registered a top speed of <320km/h>, you can see the definite and distinct evolution in this Ferrari species.

long.zh:
F430的继任者，法拉利458 Italia，于2009年的法兰克福车展上公布。法拉利的V8系列每5年就会升级一次，从1989年的348开始，到1994年的F355，以及1999年的360 Modena和2004年的F430；458则是该系列中的又一款绝世佳作。

它的车体采用全新设计的铝制空间框架，而它的直喷V8引擎可以在<55.1kgm>扭矩条件下产出<570ps>的输出，这对于自然吸气发动机来说是一个惊人的数值。它的变速箱是一款7档双离合手动变速箱，而且它的换挡速度也较此前的车型获得了很大的提升。它们的Manettino驾驶模式系统，整合了引擎、变速箱、E-DIFF、F1 Trac、ESP、以及高性能防抱死刹车系统控制，也获得了长足的进步，并可以从5种模式中选择：低抓地力、运动、竞速、关闭牵引力控制系统模式和关闭所有的牵引力和稳定控制系统模式。现在驾驶者可以有机会享受比以前任何时候都更为安全和有趣的驾驶体验。它的悬挂利用了前部的双叉骨以及后部的多连杆，同时在599中首次应用的磁力悬挂也升级到了第二代。

该车型的空气动力性能也出现了很多创新，还野心勃勃地加入了一线F1赛事中所使用的最新竞速技术。该车的性能指数也因此变得非常凶猛，从0到<100km/h>的加速时间仅需3.4秒，且最高时速可达<325km/h>。它的车身设计则是Enzo和F430的直接进化版，保持了宾尼法利纳的流线型设计。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 458 Italia GT3 was a regulation-compliant race version of the road-going 458. It featured a lower front bumper functioning as an air dam and a prominent rear wing. Although the engine remained the same, a restrictor limited output to 542.4 HP. Making its debut in 2011, it immediately made its mark by winning the FIA GT3 European Championship.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 458 Italia GT3是基于458 Italia开发的满足GT3规格的赛车。前保险杠位置进一步压低来充当气坝，同时还增设了一个大尾翼。尽管与公路车型使用的是相同的动力单元，但由于安装了限流器，动力被限制在550 PS。该车在2011年首次亮相，并在同年夺得FIA-GT3欧洲锦标赛冠军。
officialDetails.heroEn: This car, which generates more downforce than any Ferrari before it, won the FIA-GT European Championship title.

杯带回了家！

catch.zh: 史上下压力最强的Ferrari车型，FIA-GT欧洲锦标赛冠军得主。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car, which generates more downforce than any Ferrari before it, won the FIA-GT European Championship title.

Many of Ferrari’s most memorable cars were powered by V-8 powerplants. Following in the footsteps of the 360 Modena and F430, the latest examples of these amazing V-8-powered machines is the 458 Italia. Designed and developed completely from scratch, the 458 Italia pays homage to the home country of Ferrari, christened by Ferrari’s then-chairman Luca Cordero di Montezemolo.

As with its predecessor, the main components of the 458 Italia’s chassis, body, engine, and suspension are composed of aluminum; however, the torsional rigidity of the 458 is improved by 15 percent when compared to the F430.

The body incorporates winglets inside the front grille and fender “chimney” outlets, allowing the 458 Italia to achieve amazing aerodynamic performance. The car produces <140kg> of downforce at <200km/h>, and more than <360kg> of downforce at top speed.

At the heart of the mid-engine/rear-drive machine is a fire-breathing 4.5-liter naturally-aspirated V-8 that produces <570ps> and <55.1kgm>. It comes mated to a dual-clutch 7-speed F1-matic gearbox whose shift speeds are on par with that of a F1 machine. The 458 Italia accelerates from 0-<100km/h> in 3.4 seconds and reaches a top speed of <325km/h>.

The on-road prowess of the supercar was so impressive that Ferrari decided to produce a race car version of it called the 458 Italia GT3.

The major changes made to the GT3 are to generate more downforce. The front bumper features a low air dam, while a large rear wing helps keep the rear tires planted to the driving surface. The car looks meaner than its production counterpart, thanks mainly to enlarged front and rear fenders. That said, engine power is a bit lower at <550ps> via a restrictor.

The car bowed in 2011 and won the series title that year in the FIA-GT European Championships.

法拉利458 Italia是法拉利V8系列的延续，它追随着360 Modena和F430等前辈的脚步。但是，这台车是完全从零开始设计和开发的。你可以从本车的命名了解他们在此所投入的激情，它由法拉利的主席蒙特泽莫罗以他们的祖国命名。

该车采用4.5升自然吸气中置V8引擎，可提供<570ps>功率和<55.1kgm>扭矩动力。配合双离合及7档换挡拨片，该车从0到<100km/h>的加速时间仅需3.4秒，且最高时速可达<325km/h>。

458 Italia GT3就是以该车为基础开发出来的。

前保险杠带有一个低位气坝特性，同时后方还带有一个大尾翼。它的外观经过改良以适应赛道环境，并大幅增大了的前后挡泥板。它的引擎和量产车型相同，但是动力输出被限制在<550ps>之内。

该车在2011年首次亮相，并在该年的国际汽联-GT3欧洲锦标赛中夺冠。

Considering that the final and very special grade model of the F430 Scuderia accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in 3.6 seconds, and registered a top speed of <320km/h>, you can see the definite and distinct evolution in this Ferrari species.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

long.en:
With a new version of Ferrari's mid-engine V-8 car appearing every five years (starting from 1989), the successor to the popular F430 arrived in 2009. Called the Ferrari 458 Italia, the sleek supercar was introduced at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, succeeding the likes of the 348 (1989), F355 (1994), 360 Modena (1999) and F430 (2004).

The 458 Italia was built upon a newly designed aluminum space frame, which made it lighter than its predecessor. Behind the cockpit resided a direct-injection V-8 that pumped out <570ps>/<55.1kgm>, astonishing figures from a normally-aspirated engine. Power was transferred to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox whose shift speeds were significantly improved over the F355's. The Manettino system that unified the engine, gearbox, suspension, E-DIFF, F1 Trac, ESP and high-performance ABS controls was also improved, allowing the driver to choose one of five different modes: Low Grip, Sports, Race, CT cut, and CST cut.

The 458 Italia was a menace on the asphalt, running to <100km/h> in just 3.4 seconds, and hitting a top speed of <325km/h>. Considering that the final and very special grade model of the F430 Scuderia accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in 3.6 seconds, and registered a top speed of <320km/h>, you can see the definite and distinct evolution in this Ferrari species.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
long.zh:
F430的继任者，法拉利458 Italia，于2009年的法兰克福车展上公布。法拉利的V8系列每5年就会升级一次，从1989年的348开始，到1994年的F355，以及1999年的360 Modena和2004年的F430；458则是该系列中的又一款绝世佳作。

它的车体采用全新设计的铝制空间框架，而它的直喷V8引擎可以在<55.1kgm>扭矩条件下产出<570ps>的输出，这对于自然吸气发动机来说是一个惊人的数值。它的变速箱是一款7档双离合手动变速箱，而且它的换挡速度也较此前的车型获得了很大的提升。它们的Manettino驾驶模式系统，整合了引擎、变速箱、E-DIFF、F1 Trac、ESP、以及高性能防抱死刹车系统控制，也获得了长足的进步，并可以从5种模式中选择：低抓地力、运动、竞速、关闭牵引力控制系统模式和关闭所有的牵引力和稳定控制系统模式。现在驾驶者可以有机会享受比以前任何时候更为安全和有趣的驾驶体验。它的悬挂利用了前部的双叉骨以及后部的多连杆，同时在599中首次应用的磁力悬挂也升级到了第二代。

该车型的空气动力性能也出现了很多创新，还野心勃勃地加入了一线F1赛事中所使用的最新竞速技术。该车的性能指数也因此变得非常凶猛，从0到<100km/h>的加速时间仅需3.4秒，且最高时速可达<325km/h>。它的车身设计则是Enzo和F430的直接进化版，保持了宾尼法利纳的流线型设计。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

The Ferrari 499P is the kind of machine built for the history books.
Who could forget its stunning run at Le Mans in 2023?

On the grand stage of the race’s historic centenary...

...Ferrari returned to the top flight after a 50-year absence.

Just imagine coming back on a milestone year like that.
The pressure must have been enormous!

And yet, in an all-out fight against opponents all chasing
the oveted overall championship title...

...it was the No. 51 Ferrari 499P that rose above them all.

The first overall victory for Ferrari in 58 years wasn't just a win,
it was one of the geat comeback in motorsports history!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
法拉利499P是一台注定载入史册的终极跑车，
它在2023年勒芒比赛上的惊艳表现至今让人难以忘怀。

在这项赛事迎来百年纪念的盛大赛场上，

法拉利暌违五十载后强势回归最高组别赛场。

想想便知——选择在这样一个极具纪念意义的年份复出……
压力绝对超乎寻常。

然而，在各路强敌全力以赴争夺总冠{的激烈鏖战中……

51号法拉利499P成功杀出重围夺得冠军。

这是法拉利时隔58年再度登顶勒芒总冠军。
这场胜利意义非凡，成就了一段王者T来的传奇篇章。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Ferrari 499P was a prototype developed for the Le Mans Hypercar (LMH) category. Its advanced hybrid all-wheel-drive system combined a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine with a front-mounted MGU to produce a total output of 500kW. Upon Ferrari’s return to Le Mans in 2023, the car went up against a field of its strongest rivals and came out on top, securing overall victory. This would mark Ferrari’s first victory at Le Mans in 58 years.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Ferrari 499P是一款为“勒芒终级跑车”（LMH）组别打造的原型赛车。这款先进全轮驱动赛车的混合动力系统由一台3.0升V6双涡轮增压引擎和一台前置电机发电单元（MGU）组成，总输出功率达500 kW。2023年，Ferrari重返勒芒赛场，与一众劲敌展开激烈角逐，最终脱颖而出，拿下了全场冠军。这是Ferrari 58年来在勒芒赛场上的首场胜利。
officialDetails.heroEn: The glorious Prancing Horse that returned Ferrari to the top category and delivered victory at Le Mans after a 50-year absence.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一匹承载荣耀的奔马，不仅带领品牌重返顶级赛事，更在阔别50年后，再次在勒芒赛场上夺得胜利。

brandCentral.en:
The Le Mans Daytona h regulations reduced the cost of racing
prototypes, but also introduced restrictions on components...

So Ferrari decided to return to the top class of the WEC
after 50 years with a car designed for Le Mans regulations.

This was the 499P, built in the tradition of the 312 P.
An AWD with a 3-litre V6 twin turbo and a hybrid motor.

The 499P took pole position in its debut race in 2023,
and stunned the world by finishing in third place.

The climax of its season was the 4th race, however, where Ferrari
won at Le Mans for the first time since the 250 LM in 1965.

This race also marked Le Mans 100th anniversary, and the 499P
became the car that won that historic race.
brandCentral.zh:
勒芒-戴通纳混合动力规则降低了
原型跑车的赛事成本，但也对部件施加了诸多限制……

于是，法拉利在阔别50年后决定重返世界耐力锦标赛
顶级组别，其出战的赛车正是针对勒芒规则而专门设计。

这款车便是499P，沿袭312 P基因的全轮驱动车型，
搭载一台3升V6双涡轮增压引擎与一台混动电机。

2023年，499P在首场比赛中便夺得杆位，
并最终荣获第三名，令世界为之震惊。

该赛季的高潮出现在第四场比赛中，
499P帮助法拉利自1965年以250 LM夺冠后首次问鼎勒芒。

这场比赛见证了勒芒赛事成立一百周年，
也见证了499P拿下历史性的一冠。

catch.en: The glorious Prancing Horse that returned Ferrari to the top category and delivered victory at Le Mans after a 50-year absence.
catch.zh: 一匹承载荣耀的奔马，不仅带领品牌重返顶级赛事，更在阔别50年后，再次在勒芒赛场上夺得胜利。

vehicleCollection.en:
The glorious Prancing Horse that returned Ferrari to the top category and delivered victory at Le Mans after a 50-year absence.

The 2023 edition of the 24 Hours of Le Mans was a special one, marking the 100th anniversary of the world’s premier endurance race. With glory waiting for the winner, teams brought their most cutting-edge technology and their best cars to the Circuit de la Sarthe.

It was a high-powered showdown, but even in this storied field, most eyes were on Ferrari. After all, Ferrari was returning to the top category for the first time in 50 years, following the 312 P’s appearance in the 1973 race. The car tasked with carrying that legacy was the prototype 499P. The 499P was a hypercar developed to Le Mans Hypercar regulations for the World Endurance Championship’s top category. The “499” in its name referred to the displacement per cylinder, while the “P” stood for “prototype.” Its hybrid system combined a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 with a front-mounted MGU, producing up to 500 kilowatts.

Its styling was shaped by more than pure speed. It is futuristic, but also unmistakably Ferrari. That is a large part of the 499P’s charm.

The race itself was closely fought, but in the end, car No. 51 came out on top. The 100th edition of the 24 Hours of Le Mans saw Ferrari make a spectacular return to the Circuit de la Sarthe, claiming its first overall victory in 58 years.

long.zh:
2023年的勒芒24小时耐力赛意义非凡——这项举世瞩目的顶级耐力赛事迎来了一百周年。各参赛车队深知本年度冠军的荣耀非比寻常，纷纷倾其所有，将最尖端的技术与最顶尖的战车悉数送上了萨森赛道。

这是一场群雄逐鹿的高水平巅峰对决，但即便置身于如此星光熠熠的参赛阵容之中，法拉利依然是最多人关注的焦点。毕竟，这是法拉利时隔整整50年后首次重返最高级别赛场——上一次还要追溯到312 P征战1973年勒芒的岁月。肩负使命，用于续写传奇的，正是原型赛车499P。499P严格依照勒芒终极跑车规则开发，专为征战世界耐力锦标赛最高组别赛事而生。车名中的“499”代表单缸排量，而字母“P”则是“原型车”的首字母缩写。混合动力系统由一台3升V6双涡轮增压引擎与前置电机发电单元协同构成，系统综合最大功率高达500千瓦。

它的造型设计所承载的，远不止对极速的追求。它充满未来感，骨子里却又透着无可置疑的法拉利气质。而这，正是499P独特魅力的精髓所在。

比赛的进程可谓扣人心弦、激烈异常，但最终51号车笑到最后，夺得了冠军。就这样，在第100届勒芒24小时耐力赛历史性的时刻，法拉利以王者之姿强势回归萨森赛道，时隔58年再度登顶！

The classical proportions and simple shape without needless
frills make this car essentially a sculpture.

Until then, carrozzerie such as Vignale, Ghia
and Zagato produced Ferrari bodies.

In the mid-1950s, the association with Pininfarina deepened,
and their work together increased.

This is a product from that time period.

It's powered by a 4-cylinder engine,
which is mounted well back...

allowing for a long bonnet and the cabin's placement right
in front of the rear wheels.
o

经典的比例和简单的形状，无需多余的装饰，
这辆车简直就像是一座雕塑。

在此之前，Ferrari的车身大多交由Vignale、Ghia
和Zagato等车身制造商打造。

从1950年代中期起，Ferrari与Pininfarina深化了合作，

这辆车就是来自那个时代的产品。

它由一部后置安装的4缸引擎提供动力……

因此可以采用更长的引擎罩，座舱则恰到好处地
位于后轮的前方。

collection.en:
The 500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe was one of the great
Ferraris of the 1950s.

There are a few different types of the Ferrari Mondial.

This is one of two coupés that were built to race
the 1954 Tour de France!

Unfortunately, it retired out of the race.

But this may have been best, given how well it was
taken care of throughout the years.

The car was bought by a French collector and safely stored
away in a chateau for several decades.

So when John Shirley acquired the car in 2002...

Everything from the engine to the paint finish
was in perfect condition!

After only minor work was he able to enter it in
the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance in 2012.

Unsurprisingly, it went home with the Gran Turismo
Trophy.<

500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe是50年代最伟大的Ferrari之一。

Ferrari Mondial有几种不同的型号，

而这辆是为1954年的环法汽车赛而制造仅有的两辆之一！

遗憾地是它并未完赛，

vehicleCollection.en:
A priceless unrestored example of a Gran Turismo Award winner.

For some years after its establishment in 1947, now-legendary Ferrari would only develop and produce the chassis and engines of its cars, while outsourcing production of the exterior bodies to other Carrozzerias. The 500 Mondial produced in 1953 is a car from that era, and the model's most famous body style is the Barchetta, designed by Pininfarina, who also produced two special coupe bodies for the model. These were called the 500 Mondial Pininfarina Coupe, built to participate in the 1954 Tour de France Automobile.

The 500 Mondial is an extreme sports car, as were many Ferraris of that era, powered by a detuned F2 race car engine that dominated the 1952 and 1953 Grands Prix. The '500' stands for the engine’s per-cylinder displacement within the lightweight DOHC 2.0-liter inline-4, designed by Aurelio Lampredi. Although detuned, it manages to squeeze out <170ps> from just <1985cc>.

The powerplant is mounted in a small, lightweight steel tube space frame and connected to an advanced de Dion axle. The name Mondial loosely translates to “World,” and it was given to the car in commemoration of the Grand Prix victory by Alberto Ascari. Unfortunately, the Pininfarina Coupe was unable to complete the Tour de France Automobile,

but one of these cars still exists in its pristine original condition, never once undergoing a restoration. It received the Gran Turismo Award at the 2012 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.

法拉利成立于1947年。此后的一段时间内，法拉利只有底盘和引擎是自己研发并生产的，车体的其他部分都外包给其他车身制造厂。1953年生产的500 Mondial就是一款来自那个年代的车型。这些车型中最著名的是由宾尼法利纳设计的Barchetta，该厂商还生产了2款特殊的双门轿车车体。这就是为参加1954年环法汽车赛而制造的500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe。

500 Mondial是一款极端侧重于竞速的车型，那个年代许多法拉利汽车都是如此。它的引擎来自于称霸1952年和1953年大奖赛的F2赛车，但性能有所下调，安装在小而轻的钢管空间车架中。它还采用了先进的德·迪翁车轴。

它名字中的Mondial大意为“世界”，也是为了纪念阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里赢得大奖赛。“500”是指奥雷里奥·兰普瑞迪设计的轻量化双顶置凸轮轴2升直列4缸引擎的气缸排量。尽管性能有所下调，它仍然能用<1985cc>的排量输出<170ps>。

不幸的是，宾尼法利纳轿跑并未在环法汽车赛取得期待的成功。好在其中的一辆车以完好状态保存至今。这辆车还在2012年的加州卵石湾汽车巡展比赛中荣获“跑车浪漫旅大奖”。在本游戏中，它以完全未经历翻修的状态登场。

For many fans who still adore its essential and compact
shape designed by Pininfarina...

The 512 BB has achieved a near-mythical status.

Its design was inspired by...

The 1968 P6 Berlinetta Speciale prototype.

This is particularly evident in the front and cabin.

Although few people are aware of this.

You may also notice details derived from the Modulo,
The 1970s Ferrari concept car.

about the 512 BB are...

bonnet grille, the small NACA side air vents...p/
nd the lower bodywork painted matt black.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This modified version of Ferrari’s 365 GT4/BB was notable for being the brand’s first mid-engine 12-cylinder road car. The most significant revision was the enlargement of the engine to 5.0 liters; however, due to emissions regulations, power output was reduced by 19.7 HP, bringing the total to 355 HP. Torque was increased by 28.9 ft-lb, resulting in a formidable 332.7 ft-lb. One of Ferrari’s most iconic creations, this car—along with Lamborghini’s Countach—came to symbolize the exotic Italian supercars of the 1970s.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是365GT4/BB的改装版，是Ferrari的12缸公路车，也是品牌首款采用中置引擎布局的车型。此次升级的主要亮点是将12缸引擎排量扩容至5升，不过为符合排放法规所做的改动导致动力输出减少20 PS至360 PS。但扭矩还是增加了4.0 公斤力米至46.0 公斤力米。作为Ferrari最令人难忘的经典车型之一，这款车与Lamborghini Countach一起，成为20世纪70年代意大利超级跑车的象征。

vehicleCollection.en:
One of the cars that defined the supercar boom in the 1970s, this car was considered the world's fastest, along with the Lamborghini Countach.+

Ferrari launched its first mid-engine production car, the 365 GT4 BB, at the Turin Motor Show in 1971 as an answer to Lamborghini's now-legendary Muira model. The letters “BB” in the new car's title stood for “Berlinetta Boxer,” a reference to the car's coupe body style and its horizontally-opposed “boxer” engine; the pistons of each cylinder bank were positioned exactly opposite of each other on a flat plane.

The 365GT4/BB started delivery in 1973, but was not well received in the marketplace. So, just three years later, Ferrari produced an evolved version of the car called the 512 BB.

The major change was an engine that was enlarged by 600 cc, giving it 5.0 liters in displacement (the name 512 refers to the engine, a 5.0-liter, 12-cylinder). It pumped out <360ps>, which was actually <20ps> less than the 365 GT4 BB's power plant, while torque was <4kgm> higher at <46.0kgm>.

The 512 BB featured a steel tube space frame; the body was composed of steel, aluminum and reinforced fiberglass. The car's svelte shape was penned by both Pininfarina and Scaglietti. Ferrari claimed both the 365GT4/BB and 512 BB had an official top speed of <302km/h>, a response to the <300km/h> top speed of the Lamborghini Countach.

There was a major supercar boom in Japan at the time, and popularity was split roughly 50/50 between the 512 BB and the Countach; making them fierce rivals in the Japanese marketplace as well as the world stage.

long.zh:
1971年，法拉利的旗舰车型中首次加入了采用中置式引擎布局的车款。

这款车就是在都灵车展上发布的365GT4/BB。车名BB有两个含义。其一为“Berlinetta”，代表双门跑车车身，另一个为“Boxer”，代表水平对置引擎。之所以这样命名，是因为这款车采用了新开发的180度倾斜角V型引擎，也就是说，这款引擎中每个汽缸的活塞都是水平相对布置的。

365GT4/BB于1973年开始交付，但仅仅三年后的1976年，其进化版512BB就面世了。主要的改动集中在引擎上，排量提升了600立方厘米，成为了5升引擎。车名512意为5升12汽缸引擎。最大马力为<360ps>，比365GT4/BB要少<20ps>，但最大扭矩要高<4kgm>，提升到了<46.0kgm>。底盘为钢管框架，车身由宾尼法利纳设计公司和斯卡列帝共同设计。车身采用钢材、铝材和玻璃钢制成。

365GT4/BB和512 BB官方公布的最高速度均为<302km/h>，据说是以1971年发布的时速最高为<300km/h>的兰博基尼Countach为对手。

在这款车服役期间，日本爆发了大规模的超级跑车热潮，512 BB和Countach在受欢迎程度上平分秋色，关于哪款车在速度上更胜一筹引发了大量的讨论。

vehicleCollection.en:
Adopting the classic V-12 FR layout, this Ferrari possesses remarkable performance while retaining practicality.	h

Unveiled in 2017, the Ferrari 812 Superfast continued the marque’s proud lineage of front-engine V12 grand tourers. Its name—a combination of “800 PS, 12 cylinders”—paid tribute to the output of its naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V12, while “Superfast” came from the legendary 500 Superfast of 1964.

The design was shaped by Ferrari’s in-house Styling Center. It exuded classical proportions with a long nose and short rear deck—hallmarks of a front-mid-engine V12 layout. Yet, its sculpted aerodynamics and refined detailing placed it in the realm of modern Ferrari elegance.

Producing <800ps> and 718Nm (<73.3kgm>) of torque, the V12 delivered its power to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch transaxle. The 812 also marked a technological milestone as the first Ferrari to feature electric power steering.

Its dynamics were further enhanced by the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system—an evolution of the 4-wheel steering setup from the F12berlinetta. The prime benefit of this system was that it resulted in razor-sharp turn-in even on tight, hairpin corners, despite its <2720mm> wheelbase.

With usable cargo space behind the seats and a generously sized rear luggage area, the 812 Superfast offered grand touring capabilities wrapped in pure supercar body.

long.zh:
法拉利的前置12缸引擎车型拥有辉煌的历史，而2017年推出的812 Superfast就是这一传统的继承者。数字812来源于这款引擎的动力和布局，即“800 PS，12缸”，而Superfast这个名号则继承自1964年生产的传奇车型“500 Superfast”。

其车身造型是由法拉利内部的造型设计中心所构思。整体采用了长车鼻+短车尾风格，车身比例呈现出典型的12缸前中置布局，而优化改良的空气动力学外形和丰富的细节也为其晕染上一层现代法拉利设计的优雅感。

它的6.5升V12自然进气引擎拥有<800ps>和718牛·米（<73.3kgm>）的强大性能，并通过一套驱动桥布局7档双离合变速箱将动力传输到后轮。需要着重指出的是，812还是第一款采用了电动助力转向系统的法拉利车型。

此外，它还配备了前代F12berlinetta的4轮转向系统的升级版，被称为“虚拟短轴距2.0”技术。这套系统的主要优点在于，尽管轴距较长（<2720mm>），但在通过窄弯时仍能让车身跟随长车鼻进行急转弯。

与此同时，812 Superfast还在座椅后方和车身后部提供了宽敞的行李空间，可谓是最适合休旅出行的超级跑车。_

vehicleCollection.en:
This collector's car took the nickname of Enzo Ferrari's son, Alfredo "Dino," who passed away at the age of 24.

Ferrari had experienced plenty of success in motorsports with its mid-engine layout machines, but in 1968, the company decided to finally release a road-going car incorporating this tried-and-true racing technology. The result was the Dino 206 GT, a beautiful Berlinetta with a flowing all-aluminum body and a <1987cc> aluminum V-6 under the hood, which marked a change from Ferrari's traditional use of V-12s. Another fact worth noting is the car was not marketed with the Ferrari name, being sold simply as the "Dino," as if it were a model from a different brand.

"Dino" was the nickname of founder Enzo Ferrari's eldest son, the engineer Alfredo Ferrari, who tragically died at the tender age of 24. The 65-degree DOHC V6 found in the car that bears his name was an idea he proposed while in the hospital. It proved successful in race cars from 1957 on, and part of the reason the Dino 206 GT was created was to homologate the F2 engine.

Receiving a makeover in 1969, the Dino GT became the 246 GT. Because of the high cost and difficulty to produce the aluminum body, the new one was made of steel, while the engine and block construction were now made of cast iron. To compensate for the increase in weight, displacement was increased to <2418cc>, with output and torque improved from <185ps>/<17.9kgm> to <195ps>/<23.0kgm>. Thus, the car achieved a top speed of <235km/h>. Another major improvement was a longer wheelbase that improved stability and handling performance.

In 1971, a Targa-top 246 GTS was added to the lineup. Along with the Berlinetta, a total of 3761 cars were produced until 1974.

long.zh:
随着法拉利的中置布局赛车在赛车领域取得成功，他们决定在1968年推出一款采用同样布局的公路车型。最终的成品Dino 206 GT是一款极其漂亮的双座，拥有流畅的全铝车身，并配以<1987cc>排量的铝制V6引擎，而非法拉利传统的V12引擎。有意思的是，Dino 206 GT并没有使用法拉利的品牌，而是直接以Dino的名字进行销售，就如同来自一个完全不同的品牌。

Dino一词来自法拉利的创始人恩佐·法拉利的长子。他的儿子兼工程师阿尔弗雷多·法拉利在24岁的年纪英年早逝，Dino正是他的小名。这款车所采用的65度角斜置双顶置凸轮轴V6引擎是他在住院期间提出的想法。这项设计理念在从1957年起打造的赛车上取得了成功。与此同时，206 GT也是为了通过F2引擎认证而生产的车型。

Dino GT在1969年进行了小改款，升级为246 GT。高成本、高难度的全铝车身被改为了钢制，引擎和缸体的材质也改为铸铁。为了抵消因此增加的重量，排量被提高到了<2418cc>，输出马力和扭矩也从<185ps>/<17.9kgm>提高到了<195ps>/<23.0kgm>，能够达到<235km/h>的最高时速。其他方面的改进还包括为了提高操控性而加长了轴距。直到今天，Dino的操控性能依然广受好评。

在1971年，一款可拆卸车顶的246 GTS加入到了产品线中。到1974年为止，加上Berlinetta，这款车型总共生产了3761辆。/

conversation.en:
Designed by Pininfarina together with Ferrari Design,
the F12 was awarded the Compasso d'Oro 2014.

As you can see, it represents a huge change in
design from the previous 599.

Its sculptural forms are extremely compact and "dense."

The front is very aggressive, with the large central grille
and two active air intakes for brake cooling...

...while the back is recogized by the "T" theme, visually
separating the extractor into two parts.

But the most characteristic elements
are the Aero Bridges...

Channelling the air from the hood towards the flanks,
improving the overall aerodyamic efficiency.

整体的空气力学效率。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The F12berlinetta was introduced in 2012 as Ferrari’s new flagship grand tourer, succeeding the 599 GTB Fiorano. Built around an all-new aluminum space frame and body shell, it featured a front-mid-mounted V-12 engine. With its optimized layout, it accelerated from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.1 seconds and reaching a top speed of 211.3 mph. It also claimed the lap record at Ferrari’s Fiorano test track.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: F12berlinetta是Ferrari于2012年公开的599 GTB Fiorano的后继旗舰车型。该车采用新型铝制空间车架与车壳，配备一台前中置式V12引擎。优化后布局带来性能上的提升：0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.1秒，最高速度达340 公里/小时。这台车还一举刷新Fiorano试车赛道的圈速纪录。

brandCentral.en:
Ferrari is known for making the sweetest-sounding V-12s ever.

In fact, the company's very first production car in 1947
came equipped with a V-12.

This F12berlinetta continued the trend with its 12-cylinder
powerplant mounted up front.

It boasted more than <700ps> sending power to the rear wheels,
and its exterior design was stunning indeed.

The design was a collaboration between Ferrari's internal
design department and Pininfarina.

They're efforts led to the car winning the prestigious
Compasso d'Oro international design award in 2014.
brandCentral.zh:
法拉利以其激动人心的V12引擎而闻名于世。

就装载了一台V12引擎。

将V12引擎安装在车前部的F12berlinetta是款大热车型，

拥有超过<700ps>的动力和经典的前置后驱传动系统，十分引
人注目！

该设计来自法拉利内部设计部门和宾尼法利纳的合作。

显然，这是一次富有成效的合作——F12berlinetta在2014年赢得了著
名的金圆规奖！=

vehicleCollection.en:
The flagship model of Ferrari wasn't just fast, it was a technological marvel.

Ferrari unveiled its mighty new flagship, the F12berlinetta, in 2012 at the Geneva Motor Show. The successor to the 599 GTB Fiorano featured a newly-designed base structure whose space frame and body shell combined 12 different types of aluminum alloys. The front mid-mounted engine came in the form of a naturally aspirated <6262cc> V-12 producing <740ps> and <70.5kgm> of peak torque, making it the most powerful Ferrari road car to date.

Impressive numbers, to be sure, but Ferrari spent a majority of its development effort on the car’s architecture. The F12berlinetta was <47mm> shorter, <20mm> narrower and <63mm> lower than its predecessor, with a wheelbase that measured <30mm> less. The engine sat <30mm> lower than the 599, and the dual clutch 7-speed F1-matic gearbox utilized a transaxle layout—both of these features helped to lower the center of gravity by <25mm> and established a nearly ideal front/rear weight ratio of 46:54.

On the road, the F12berlinetta, despite its elegant good looks, was an absolute beast. It ran from zero to <100km/h> in a phenomenal 3.1 seconds, getting to <200km/h> in just 8.5, and topping out at a blurring <340km/h>. With its improved handling balance, it set a new fastest road car lap around the Fiorano test track, besting the 599 GTO by a full second.

With refined aerodynamics, advanced electronic devices and a brake cooling system that trickled down from its Formula 1 race car, this prancing horse deserved to be the flagship for what is arguably the most revered and recognized company in automotive history.

long.zh:
F12berlinetta是法拉利于2012年公开的599 GTB Fiorano的后继旗舰车型。

其全新设计的空间车架和车壳总共使用了12种不同的铝合金。中置引擎为一台<6262cc>自然进气V12引擎，最大动力输出为<740ps>，最大扭矩<70.5kgm>，这也是法拉利有史以来性能最强的公路车款。

但法拉利并未将过多的精力投入到车架和引擎上，而是将研发重点放在了车身布局上。相比599，整车短了<47mm>，窄了<20mm>，车高也降低了<63mm>，轴距则缩短了<30mm>。引擎的安装位置也比599低了<30mm>。双离合7速F1-matic变速箱充分利用跨轴布局，使得整车重心降低了<25mm>，前后车重配比为46:54，是提升驾驶性能的最优配比。

也因此，F12berlinetta展现出了令人惊叹的性能，0-<100km/h>加速只需3.1秒，0-<200km/h>加速为8.5秒，最高时速可达<340km/h>。它将599 GTO保持的Fiorano测试赛道纪录缩短了整整一秒之多。这个纪录也证明了它在操控和弯道性能上的长足进步。

空气动力学套件进行了优化，并加入了F1使用的刹车冷却技术，这款法拉利跑车无愧于其旗舰车款的名号。#

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This special model was created to commemorate the 40th anniversary of Ferrari’s founding. Developed using the same construction techniques as the race cars of its era, it featured a steel tubular frame combined with composite materials, including carbon-Kevlar and aluminum honeycomb structures. Its powerplant was derived from the twin-turbocharged V-8 used in the 288 GTO, tuned to produce 478.3 HP and 419.5 ft-lb of torque. This car would become the final road-going project overseen by Enzo Ferrari, and it continues to enjoy enduring admiration around the world.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是为纪念Ferrari成立40周年而推出的特别版车型。全车开发完全参照当时的赛车制造方式，采用了钢管车架和碳纤维凯夫拉及铝质蜂窝结构等复合材料。动力单元基于288 GTO的V8双涡轮增压引擎调校，输出可达485 PS/58.0 公斤力米。它也是恩佐·法拉利参与开发的最后一款公路车，至今仍拥有极高的人气。
officialDetails.heroEn: This special exotic machine was the last one produced under the guidance of company founder Enzo Ferrari.
officialDetails.heroZh: Ferrari创始人Enzo Ferrari参与设计的最后一款公路车。

collection.en:
The F40 was the last Ferrari to have been personally
approved by the company's founder, Enzo Ferrari.

The development codename for the F40 was 'LM',
standing for 'Le Mans'.

This goes to show that it was designed as a road car
with the look of a race car.

There's a widely held impression that the F40 suffers
from turbo lag and a peaky engine.

But I consider it to be a very refined example
of Ferrari engineering.

Many a professional driver has assured that the peakiness
is not an issue if the turbo is properly controlled.

So if you have the driving skill, I'm sure
you’ll be able to handle it./
collection.zh:
F40是最后一辆由公司创始人Enzo Ferrari亲自批准生产的Ferrari。

F40的开发代号是“LM”，勒芒的英文缩写。

它是一辆按照公路车来设计，但具有赛车外观的车。

外界有一种普遍的说法，认为F40的涡轮迟滞明显，引擎
的输出曲线也偏高。

但我个人认为这是一款代表着法拉利车辆工程技术水平
的车型。

多位职业车手证实，只要对涡轮的控制得当，
引擎的转速曲线就不是问题。

所以如果您的驾驶技术不错的话，我相信您一定可以驾驭它。

vehicleCollection.en:
This special exotic machine was the last one produced under the guidance of company founder Enzo Ferrari.

A very special Ferrari was announced by company founder, Enzo Ferrari, in July 1987. Dubbed the F40, this car was to mark the company's 40th anniversary, billed as Ferrari's first "street legal racing car."

Signore Ferrari spared no costs when building this dream machine. The F40's structure utilized a steel tube-frame in the same manner as other Ferrari road cars of the 1980s, but various internal and external chassis components were composed of carbon-fiber and Kevlar, the newest lightest, high-tech composite material available at the time.

The car's body panels were a structural part of the chassis, and its tube frame foundation was constructed from Kevlar and aluminum honeycomb sections, the preferred manufacturing method for racing cars at the time.

Powering the lightweight car was a twin-turbocharged, 3.0-liter DOHC V8 with a 90 degree bank angle, based on the power plant for the Ferrari's Group B 288 GTO; however, the one in the F40 had a larger displacement and altered boost pressures. As a result, the F40 produced an amazing <485ps> and <58.8kgm> of torque. The <1100kg> car could run to <100km/h> in about 4 seconds and reach a top speed of <324km/h>, making it the fastest production car in the world at the time.@

1987年7月，法拉利的创始人恩佐·法拉利公布了一个特别车款。即他们的四十周年纪念车款，F40。这款车的理念是打造能够合法上路的赛车，具象化地体现了恩佐·法拉利创办公司时所秉持的理念。

其基本结构采用了与法拉利其他20世纪80年代的公路车型相同的钢管车架，但在各种内部和外部构件上采用了当时最轻的材料碳纤维凯夫拉。

与钢管车架共同构成底盘的板材也采用了复合凯夫拉和铝质蜂窝结构，这些都是当时制造赛车时才会采用的方案。

这款车的动力单元是一台3升双顶置式凸轮轴引擎，呈90度倾斜角放置。该引擎以1984年日内瓦车展上发布的组别B 288 GTO搭载的引擎为基础进行开发，经过进一步调校，增大了排量并调整了增压压力。这款引擎的马力比288 GTO引擎的马力<400ps>/<50.6kgm>更大，达到了<485ps>/<58.8kgm>。据称，这款车的最高时速可达<324km/h>，成为当时世界上最快的量产车。>

vehicleCollection.en:
The rolling piece of mechanical art was capable of reaching a top speed of <315km/h>.

When one utters the phrase "entry-level cars," it's usually meant to describe an inexpensive automobile whose sole purpose is to get people from Point A to Point B. But when you're talking about Ferrari, all conventional definitions go out the proverbial window.

Replacing Ferrari's "entry-level" 360 Modena in 2004 was the F430. The car's styling was mesmerizing, with flowing lines influenced by the company's legendary Formula 1 racers and Le Mans prototypes of the 1960s.

Mounted amidships was a sweet-sounding V8 powerplant. Unlike the 350 Modena's engine, which evolved from that of the 1973 Ferrari 308 GT4 in 1973, the F430's 4.3-liter naturally aspirated unit was completely new. Output was impressive, as it was rated at <490ps>/<8500rpm>, eclipsing the output of the legendary F40's turbocharged V8. It came mated to a high-tech new twin-clutch transmission that allowed the driver to manually select gears via paddles on the steering wheel.

The F430's chassis was a heavily reworked version of the 360 Modena's that featured a frame composed of extruded and forged aluminum. Part of the structure was altered to meet new, more stringent collision safety standards, and the floor board was made of an exceptionally strong aluminum alloy used in aerospace called extra super duralumin. With available carbon-ceramic brake rotors and a top speed of <315km/h>, the Ferrari F430, whose base price was about $180,000, was perhaps the most desirable "entry-level" car in the world.

long.zh:
F430是法拉利在2004推出，用于参加超级跑车联赛的最新中置引擎车型。为这款车提供动力的V8引擎并不是在1973年随308 GT4一同亮相的老款引擎，而是一款全新开发的4.3升新引擎。

其最大动力输出甚至超过了F40的引擎，达到了<8500rpm>时的<490ps>。传递这股动力的变速器使用一套双踏板离合，并提供6速手动以及F1 Matic双踏板6速手动离合器两种选择。

F430的底盘是1999年推出的360 Modena所采用的底盘的升级版，沿袭了以铸铝连接的挤压铝型材车架。在对F430的改造过程中，为了符合碰撞安全标准，法拉利对车体结构进行了改动，车辆底板由一种被称为“超高强度钢铝”的航空航天级超强铝合金制成，底盘下方扩散器的形状也有所调整。相比于360 Modena，其下压力提高了50%。

外观由宾尼法利纳按照法拉利的传统设计，并由当时的总设计师弗兰克·斯蒂芬森最终完善。

这款车不仅汲取了360 Modena的设计理念，还参考了1960年代的F1赛车和勒芒赛车的设计。值得一提是，其尾灯形状采用了2002年推出的Enzo Ferrari的设计。

官方公布的最高时速为<315km/h>。除此之外，F430还提供可选的碳化陶瓷碟刹。在这些强大配置的支持下，这辆车毫无疑问将跻身顶级超级跑车的行列。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This special model was created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Ferrari’s founding. Developed under the concept of a “road-going F1 car,” it featured an engine derived from the V-12 in Ferrari’s 1990 "641" F1 machine, enlarged to 4.7 liters and mounted directly to the chassis. With an output of 512.8 HP and 347.2 ft-lb of torque, the car could accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.87 seconds and reach a top speed of 201.9 mph.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是为纪念Ferrari成立50周年推出的特别版车型。打造一台“公路版F1赛车”便是这台车的开发理念，它选择了1990年“641” F1赛车的V12引擎，扩容至4.7升后直接安装在底盘上。在520 PS/48.0 公斤力米的动力驱动下，该车能够在3.87秒内从0加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速可达325 公里/小时。
officialDetails.heroEn: This Italian masterpiece, equipped with a naturally-aspirated V-12 and Formula 1 technology, celebrated Ferrari's 50th anniversary.
officialDetails.heroZh: 装备了F1惯用的自然进气V12引擎，专为庆祝法拉利50周年而打造。

collection.en:
The F50 was the successor to the F40, and was one of
the most Spartan cars Ferrari ever produced.

The idea came from Enzo Ferrari's son, Piero,

who wanted to create a road car similar to an F1 race car
for the company's 50th anniversary.

This is reflected in things like the F50's V12 engine being
mounted in the same structure as the Ferrari F1 machine.

The V12 engine in-house is also based on the V12 used in
the Ferrari F1 racers.

So if you're in the mood to drive a Ferrari F1 around town,
the F50 is the car for you!
collection.zh:
F50是F40的继任者，也是法拉利制造过的最“朴素”的汽车之一。

它的设计理念来自于恩佐·法拉利的儿子皮耶罗，

后者希望打造一款接近一级方程式赛车的公路车来庆祝
公司成立50周年。

这一理念反映在了F50的V12引擎上。这台V12引擎是基于法拉利
的一级方程式赛车设计的，

然后安装在同款一级方程式赛车结构打造的车架上。

如果您有兴趣想要开着法拉利的“F1”赛车招摇过市，F50就
是您的不二之选！~

catch.zh: 装备了F1惯用的自然进气V12引擎，专为庆祝法拉利50周年而打造。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Italian masterpiece, equipped with a naturally-aspirated V-12 and Formula 1 technology, celebrated Ferrari's 50th anniversary.

As the successor to the amazing F40 sports car, the F50 represented the latest and greatest from renowned auto maker and race team, Ferrari. The car also commemorated the 50th anniversary of the company. The F50 became an instant classic, as only 349 units were built, following in the the tradition established by other limited-edition models, the 288 GTO and the aforementioned F40.

The basic philosophy behind the F50 was to produce a Formula One car for the road. And the sleek sports car was exactly that, realizing a long-standing dream of Piero Ferrari (the second son of Ferrari founder Enzo) of making a road car with an F1 engine.

Designed by Pininfarina, the F50 featured a carbon-fiber body and an open-air cockpit like that of an F1 race machine (although the F50 did come with a removable hard top for rainy days). Also mimicking F1 cars was the F50's chassis whose front suspension was mounted directly to the carbon monocoque tub, while the rear suspension connected directly to the gearbox. The V-12 engine was based on the power unit from the 641, Ferrari's 1990 F1 race car. For the F50, it was tuned for road use, such as increasing displacement from 3.5 to 4.7 liters for smoother power delivery and mating it to a 6-speed manual gearbox. Top speed for the F50 was rated at <325km/h> and its 0-<100km/h> time came in at 3.87 seconds, which far exceeded the best sports cars of its day.@

long.zh:
F50是一款纪念法拉利成立50周年的特殊型号，其初衷是要打造一款适合公路驾驶的F1赛车。为了实现这个理念，宾尼法利纳选择了碳纤维材料，并设计出独具超级跑车美感的外形。由于F1赛车全都采用开放式座舱，这款车也成为了法拉利第一款采用硬顶的特殊型号敞篷车。

在F50的车身里，最具F1特征的部分当属其基础结构。前悬挂直接安装在碳纤维单体车壳的前部。引擎也是直接用螺钉连接到车壳后部，然后再连接到变速箱。后悬挂就直接安装在了变速箱上。这辆车采用了与当时F1赛车相同的动力系统框架，这在公路车中属于首创。

其V12引擎也是直接对标F1赛车规格：基于1990年F1比赛使用的641动力单元，在开发过程中进行调整以适配公路驾驶。这些调整包括为了提高操控性而将排量从3.5升提高到4.7升，以及为了提高耐用性而增加了气缸之间的间隔。这款车配置了一台6速手动变速器，最高速度可达<325km/h>，从0到<100km/h>加速仅需3.87秒。这辆车的性能已经全面超越了在1987年亮相并盛行一时的F40。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Ferrari F8 Tributo was unveiled in 2019 as the successor to the 488 GTB. While it retained a shape similar to its predecessor, significant changes to the aerodynamic elements gave it a refreshed, aggressive character. Its twin-turbo 3.9-liter V-8 produced 710.1 HP, resulting in a zero-to-62.1 mph of 2.9 seconds and a top speed of 211.3 mph—making it the fastest V-8-powered road car Ferrari had ever produced. Equipped with the latest in body control systems, the F8 Tributo also offered remarkable ease of drivability.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Ferrari F8 Tributo在2019年接替488 GTB首次亮相。外观上虽与488颇为相似，但围绕空气动力学的诸多细节设计上的重大变化，重塑了这款车的形象。3.9升V8双涡轮引擎动力输出达720 PS，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为2.9秒，最高速度达340 公里/小时，为V8车型之最。搭载的最新车身控制技术使其驾驭起来格外轻松。
officialDetails.heroEn: At the heart of this exotic, an update to the 488GTB, is a powerful V-8 that was also in the 488 Pista.
officialDetails.heroZh: Ferrari的V8巅峰之作，拥有一颗488 Pista的心脏。

brandCentral.en:
Ferrari's long history of producing cars with midship
V8 engines began in the 1970s with the 308 GTB.

This Ferrari F8 Tributo is a modern version of that classic.

As you would expect, its 3.9L V8 engine is mounted
midship.

This is an improved version of the engine used in its
predecessor, the 488 GTB, packing 710 BHP of power.

What's more, the response time is excellent for a turbo
engine, with no discernible lag at all.

This is down to the fact that the Tributo uses an electronic
turbo system first seen in Ferrari race cars.
brandCentral.zh:
以1970年推出的308 GTB为开端，Ferrari开启了使用中置V8引擎的
悠久历史。

这款Ferrari F8 Tributo就是那款经典车型的现代版本。

毫无意外，它的3.9L V8引擎也采用了中置布局。

作为前一代车型488 GTB所采用的引擎的升级版，它可以输
出<720ps>的动力。

以一款涡轮增压引擎而言，它的响应速度非常出色，几
乎感觉不到任何延迟。

这都要归功于为Tributo引入的电子涡轮增压系统，这是从Ferrari
赛车上下放的技术。

catch.en: At the heart of this exotic, an update to the 488GTB, is a powerful V-8 that was also in the 488 Pista.
catch.zh: Ferrari的V8巅峰之作，拥有一颗488 Pista的心脏。

vehicleCollection.en:
At the heart of this exotic, an update to the 488GTB, is a powerful V-8 that was also in the 488 Pista.

Ferrari introduced the F8 Tribute in 2019 to succeed the 488GTB. While the silhouettes of the two cars were quite similar, they exuded a different ambience altogether.

The F8 Tribute was essentially an update of the 488GTB; therefore, the engine, which was mounted amidships, was carried over from the 488 Pista. This powerplant was a twin-turbocharged 3.9-liter V-8 that produced <720ps> and <78.5kgm> of torque. For the exterior, the body was slightly restyled to improve aerodynamics and redirect air flow to optimize engine cooling. Inside the cockpit, the dashboard, instrument cluster, and door panels were replaced to give the car a fresh look and feel for the driver.

The performance of the F8 Tribute was nominally better than its predecessor with a 0-<100km/h> time of 2.9 seconds, a 0-<200km/h> time of 7.8 and a top speed of <340km/h>.

long.en:

This powerplant was a twin-turbocharged 3.9-liter V-8 that produced <720ps> and <78.5kgm> of torque. For the exterior, the body was slightly restyled to improve aerodynamics and redirect air flow to optimize engine cooling. Inside the cockpit, the dashboard, instrument cluster, and door panels were replaced to give the car a fresh look and feel for the driver.

The performance of the F8 Tribute was nominally better than its predecessor with a 0-<100km/h> time of 2.9 seconds, a 0-<200km/h> time of 7.8 and a top speed of <340km/h>.
long.zh:
F8 Tributo是法拉利于2019年推出作为488GTB后续车型的V8中置引擎车型。你可以将之视作一次重大的中期改款，就像328之于308，F430之于360 Modena一般。

虽然轮廓造型与488颇为相似，但给人留下的印象却截然不同。主要是因为围绕空气动力学的诸多细节设计发生了重大变化，例如空气如何在车身表面流动，如何被引导到车底并抽出，以及如何将引擎的热量从引擎室内引导出来。

动力单元方面继承了被视为488终极公路版的488皮斯特所搭载的引擎。输出功率为<720ps>和770牛·米（<78.5kgm>）的3.9升V8双涡轮增压引擎无论是在街道上还是在赛道上都表现得游刃有余。

这也是法拉利有史以来最快的V8车型。0-<100km/h>加速比488GTB快0.1秒，为2.9秒，最高时速也快了约<10km/h>，达到了<340km/h>。电子稳定系统的大幅应用在多方面提供了辅助，其优异的操控性能收获了广泛好评。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The FXX K, a track-only evolution of the LaFerrari, was produced in a limited run of just 32 units in 2014. It pairs the LaFerrari’s 6.3-liter V12 with a 187.4 HP electric motor, delivering a combined output of 1035.5 HP. With enhanced aerodynamics—further amplified by the optional EVO kit, which adds 75 percent more downforce. Free from the constraints of racing regulations, this car delivers pure, uncompromised driving performance at its highest level.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: FXX K是基于LaFerrari开发的一款赛道专用车型，在2014年限量生产了32台。该车采用LaFerrari的6.3升V12引擎以及可产生190 PS的电机，综合动力输出达1,050 PS。车辆的空气动力学也同步得到了升级，加装EVO套件后下压力提升75%。这台车摆脱了赛事规则的限制，带来终极驾驶体验。

It's a where Ferrari asks its car owners to test drive its
various models to help develop new technologies.

The FXX-K was developed from this unique program.

The car was developed for track use and came equipped with a
<1000ps>-plus hybrid propulsion unit.

Testing from the XX Programs provided valuable data that
also helped the company's race car development.

您了解法拉利的XX计划吗？

FXX-K就是专为XX计划的试驾活动而制造的。

这辆以赛道驾驶为目的的车型安装有超过<1000ps>的混动
动力单元。

巨大的作用。

vehicleCollection.en:
The production run of this Ferrari was limited to only 32 units. v

Only 32 examples of the Ferrari FXX K were produced, meaning that it became an instant collector's item when it was introduced in 2014. Developed for track use only by Corso Clienti, the FXX K was based on the LaFerrari super car with various improvements to .

The "K" on its name stood for "HY-KERS," Ferrari's Hybrid Kinetic Energy Recovery system, similar to the KERS systems used on Ferrari's Formula 1 cars. Under the FXX K's hood was LeFerrari's 6.3-liter V-12 tuned to produce <860ps> combined with a <190ps> HY-KERS electric motor, totaling an output of <1050ps>.

In 2017, Ferrari introduced the FXX K Evo, whose aerodynamics enhancements resulted in 23 percent more downforce than the standard FXX K and 75 percent more than the La Ferrari. It generated up to <640kg> of additional weight at 200 km/h, making it one of the most potent supercars ever created by the company.

“K”代表“HY-KERS”，即法拉利自己的混合动能回收系统，类似于F1赛车上使用的KERS系统。

LaFerrari搭载的6.3升V12引擎经过调校，可产生<860ps>动力，与<190ps>的HY-KERS电机结合，总功率输出达到<1050ps>。

车辆的空气动力学性能也得到了全面优化，在与2017年发布的EVO套件合体后，产生的下压力比LaFerrari多出75%。

在摆脱了赛事认证或锦标赛规则的限制后，无需做出任何妥协的FXX K成为了车手的终极之车。

conversation.en:
A legend among supercars of the 1980s,
the Ferrari GTO...

...combined the most advanced performance, technology
and style of its era.

Despite the nominal nod to the iconic 250 GTO from 1962...

...this car actually incorporated the design of the popular 308 GTB,
though slightly stretched to match its longer wheelbase.

Its main character came from the big front-spoiler
and four rectanguar daylights...

...as well as the wide fenders covering its big wheels.

The gearbox hanging below the bumper
was framed by four round exhausts.

It was always a wonderful sight to see.

The only details recallig the vintage GTO...

...were the famous three slanted side vents behinthe rear wheel
and he enlarged "duck-tail" spoiler.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
法拉利GTO是80年代超级跑车中的传奇之作……

它集合了当时最先进的性能、技术和当代设计品味。

尽管名字向1962年经典的250 GTO致敬……

and designing for Ferrari...

..remains one of the greatest periods in the company's history.

Starting with the Dino 246 and culminating with this 288 GTO,

vehicleCollection.en:
At first glance, this monster car appears to be an offshoot model, but it's 100% custom-built on the inside, and produces over 394 horsepower. %

With the introduction of the Group B category in 1982, a number of auto makers brought new limited-run super sports cars to the market. This was because in order to compete in the Group B class, 200 units of production cars based on the race car were required to be produced. One of these cars was the Ferrari GTO, which bowed at the 1984 Geneva Motor Show. Some people referred to this car as the 288 GTO, although it is not the car's official name.

The "O" in GTO stands for omologazione, the Italian word for homologation. Upon first glance, it is obvious that the GTO gets its styling cues from the classic 308 GTB, but despite their similar looks, the GTO was an entirely different beast altogether. Unlike the 308 GTB, it featured a longitudinally-mounted engine, a <110mm> longer wheelbase, and body panels made from carbon fiber and other lightweight materials.

Leonardo Fioravanti, who was with Pininfarina at the time, penned the exterior styling. Flared front and rear fenders, additional fog lights, passing lights in the nose, a rear duck tail reminiscent of the 250 GTO, and three-lined louvers gave the GTO a wonderful balance of aggressiveness and elegance. Power came from a revamped Lancia LC2 engine, which was turned from a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter to a twin-turbocharged 2.6-liter, then later into a 2.8-liter, the maximum displacement allowed in Group B. With <400ps> and <50.6kgm> of torque on tap, the <1160kg> sports car was the fastest Ferrari in its day, with a top speed of <305km/h>.

Only 272 examples of the 288 GTO were manufactured, and it never actually ran a race. The GTO eventually led to the development of the 288 GTO Evoluzione test vehicle, which in turn became the foundation for the now-legendary F40.

long.zh:
1982年前后，B组别被增加到了赛车运动的规则当中。为了满足产量200台的赛事认证标准，各车厂不得不开足马力，生产出各种各样的赛车。在1984年日内瓦车展上亮相的GTO就是其中之一。由于大家在称呼这款车时经常加上288，所以它也叫做288 GTO，但这并非官方命名。

GTO中的O代表omologazione，即意大利语的“认证”。这款车型是在308GTB的基础上改装而成，造型与308GTB几乎别无二致，但引擎改为纵向安装，轴距增加<110mm>，外部车身板件换成了碳纤维和其他轻型材料。在这个过程中，这款车基本上从头到尾都经历了重新设计，几乎可以说是一款全新车型。

它的外观由当时正在宾尼法利纳工作的列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂设计。外扩的前后轮拱罩，外置的雾灯和前指示灯，仿250GTO的鸭尾尾翼，以及3块垂直百叶挡板——这些设计将这台战斗机器的激进外观和法拉利传统的优雅风格相融合，诞生出了优美的流线造型。

它的引擎是经过改造的蓝旗亚LC2引擎（在308所使用的3升引擎基础上改造而成的2.6升双涡轮引擎）。随后，为了追求B组别规格所允许的极限，它又被进一步改造为2.8升双涡轮引擎。<1160kg>的轻盈车身在<400ps>和<50.6kgm>扭矩的推动下，能够达到<305km/h>的最高速度。GTO籍此成为当时最快的法拉利。

288 GTO一共生产了272台，但尚未投入比赛就停产了。不过，它的基本理念被延续到了288 GTO进化版试验车型上，后来又被F40继承，因此并没有白费。

Ferrari’s first hybrid car, built with the same materials and processes as an F1 racing machine.(

When Ferrari creates a “limited edition” model, the result is often something historic. In the past, now-legendary models such as the 288, GTO, F40, F50, and the Enzo Ferrari have rocked the exotic-car world, but the latest special-edition car from the revered marque will definitely go down in the annals of automotive history as the most special of them all: the LaFerrari.

In the same manner as its predecessors, the LaFerrari, introduced in 2013, represents grace, glamor and unprecedented performance, but two things in particular make this machine special. One of them is its carbon monocoque structure that’s composed of the same materials as Ferrari’s F1 machines, and built using the same processes. In comparison to the Enzo Ferrari, torsional rigidity of the LaFerrari is better by 27 percent, while beam rigidity has been improved by 22 percent. The car's other special feature is its hybrid drivetrain, a first for Ferrari. The 6.3-liter V-12 is tuned to <800ps> and matched to Ferrari’s HY-KERS system from F1 racing. The total output with the added <163ps> provided by the electric motor is rated at a whopping <963ps>, the most from any Ferrari road car…ever.

Also, the LaFerrari features an aerodynamics system that produces optimum performance by actively moving the front/rear diffusers, spoilers, and underbody in relation to driving conditions.

The performance specs include a 0-<100km/h> acceleration of less than 3 seconds, 0-<200km/h> acceleration of under 7, and a top speed of more than <350km/h>. At the Fiorano test track, the LaFerrari’s 1-minute-19.9-second lap was 5 seconds faster than the Ferrari Enzo and 3.1 seconds faster than the F12.

The production run of the LaFerrari was a mere 499 cars, and naturally, all of them have been spoken for, not surprising when you consider that there were more than 1000 inquiries to buy the super exotic three days after it was introduced.

法拉利多年以来生产了为数不少的限量版车型，譬如288、GTO、F40、F50以及Enzo Ferrari。而2013年公布的LaFerrari车型，则是这个特殊系列的延续。

和过往的其他特殊车型一样，LaFerrari与法拉利的量产版车型相比具有更高的性能，但是还是有两个显著的区别。

其一是该车的碳纤维结构采用了法拉利F1赛车相同的制造工艺。和Enzo Ferrari相比，该车架的抗扭刚度提高了27%，同时它的梁刚度也提高了22%。

另一个特点是这是法拉利历史上首台配备了混合动力系统的车。它的6.3升V12引擎被调校至<800ps>，并可以和法拉利F1赛车的HY-KERS动能回收系统比肩。其动力输出，在获得电机的<163ps>额外动力的帮助下，将达到<963ps>的总动力；这也是法拉利历史上的另一个高峰。

在空气动力学方面，该车采用了主动式空气动力系统，它会根据行驶条件主动移动前后扰流翼、扰流板以及底板，从而获得最佳空气动力学性能。

官方宣称的性能指标包括小于3秒的0-<100km/h>加速时间、小于7秒的0到0-<200km/h>加速时间，以及超过<350km/h>的最高时速。在费奥那罗的测试赛道内，它的1分19.9秒的单圈记录比法拉利恩佐快5秒，也比F12快3.1秒。

官方宣布LaFerrari将全球限量499台，但是他们也同时宣布在它面世的3天内就已经有超过1000个申购者询价了。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Unveiled in 1984, the Testarossa stood as Ferrari’s flagship mid-engine masterpiece. Its heart was a 5.0-liter 180-degree V-12, delivering a maximum output of 384.6 HP and torque of 361.6 ft-lb. Acceleration from zero to 62.1 mph took just 5.8 seconds, with the car ultimately achieving a top speed of 180.2 mph. With its sculpted form—defined by signature 5-fin strakes and rear fenders that flared boldly from the tight cockpit—the Testarossa captivated a new generation of enthusiasts.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1984年亮相的Testarossa是Ferrari的旗舰中置引擎车型。引擎为平卧放置的5升V12引擎，最大动力高达390 PS，峰值扭矩50.0 公斤力米。0-100 公里/小时加速时间为5.8秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。这款车拥有艺术化的优雅车身设计，采用标志性的5片式侧边条翼和从紧凑座舱异军突起的后挡泥板，赢得了全新一代车迷的青睐。
officialDetails.heroEn: This historic Ferrari flagship impressed all with its vivid design.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款历史悠久的Ferrari旗舰车型以其出格而细致的设计令车迷们惊叹不已。

usedCar.en:
The Ferrari Testarossa was a V-12-powered exotic that was
introduced in 1984.

It's considered one of the company's great creations, along
with its contemporaries, the GTO and the F40.

The Testarossa inherited its basic layout from Ferrari's
512BB.

This included the engine, dubbed a 'flat-12' because the pistons
are horizontally opposed, but technically it's a V-12.

The Testarossa name, which means "red head" in Italian,
came from Ferrari's legendary 250 Testa Rossa race car.

The car's styling was penned by none other than Pininfarina.

The distinctive strakes on the body sides made this car
instantly recognizable on both the road and track.
usedCar.zh:
Ferrari Testarossa是一款高端车型，
首次问世于1984年。

被认为是公司最伟大的杰作之一，与之其名的
还有其80年代同期车型、GTO和F40。

Testarossa继承了Ferrari的BB 512系列的
基本布局。

最重要的是搭载了V12中置引擎。

此款车根据公司的传奇性跑车
250 Testa Rossa而命名。

由最具盛名的意大利公司
Pininfarina所设计。

Testarossa车门两侧独特的边条翼
是法拉利V8车型所继承的设计特色。

vehicleCollection.en:
This historic Ferrari flagship impressed all with its vivid design.

The Ferrari Testarossa (Type F110) was introduced as the company's mid-engine flagship in 1984, replacing the popular 512BB in the lineup. Penned by Pininfarina, the car boasted a wild exterior design that was highlighted by its signature side strakes.

At first glance, the strakes may appear to be just a wild design element, but in reality, they directed air to the car's Formula 1-style radiators. The cooling air was necessary to keep the car's 5.0-liter 180-degree V-12 running smooth. This mid-mounted engine produced <390ps> and <50.0kgm> of torque, allowing the car to run from zero to <100km/h> in just 5.8 seconds and reach a top speed of <290km/h>.

Production of the Testarossa, which translated to "red head" in Italian, halted in 1992, making the way for the 512 TR.

1984年推出的特斯塔罗萨是法拉利的旗舰中置引擎车型。此车也是绵延了11年的Berlinetta Boxer系列的继任者。

这款车最令人过目不忘的地方便是外观了。从狭窄车身中段突然向外突起的后挡泥板与5个几乎如同雕塑般的侧边条翼创造出高度艺术化和充满活力的形象，为该车赢得了无数的粉丝。

虽然乍一看只是个外观设计上的亮点，实际却是为了纳入F1风格的侧边散热器。侧边散热器解决了车厢内热量过剩的问题，同时也创造出了前车身的行李空间，从而整体提升了作为高性能豪华旅行车型的舒适性。

引擎为180度放置的5升V12引擎，最大动力输出为<390ps>，最大扭矩为<50.0kgm>。该车的0-<100km/h>成绩为5.8秒，最高速度达到<290km/h>。

特斯塔罗萨直到1992年才被512 TR取而代之，而且一直是深受车迷欢迎的历史车型。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo marks Ferrari’s first-ever virtual-only single-seater concept, drawing design cues from the marque’s legendary sports prototypes of the 1960s and 1970s. Its turbocharged 3.0-liter V-6 hybrid powertrain, working in concert with three electric motors, delivers a total system output of 1015.8 HP. Blending the DNA of Ferrari’s past icons with a bold vision of endurance racing’s future, the design is both a tribute and a statement.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo是Ferrari首款纯虚拟单座概念车，设计灵感来自于60年代和70年代的一众赛车原型车。3升涡轮增压V6混动引擎与3台电机配合，综合动力输出达1,030 PS。这台车的设计传承了经典赛车的基因，并昭示了耐力赛在未来的重磅发展方向。

brandCentral.en:
This is the Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo.

It's a single-seat concept car with a futuristic design—
Ferrari's first foray into the virtual motorsports world.

This model is inspired by sports prototypes from the
1960s and 1970s...

...and it shares some of its DNA with legendary race cars,
such as the Ferrari 330 P3 and the 512S.

This is a car that builds on Ferrari's racing pedigree to
make its mark in the endurance races of the future.

The Ferrari VGT's body construction...

It stands to reason, therefore, that its aerodynamic
properties are cutting-edge.

Its powertrain is a turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 hybrid, just like
the one used in Ferrar's LMH.

Because the FIA's regulations don't actually apply to the
VGTit is in fact re poerful than the LMH!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆车叫做法拉利Vision Gran Turismo。

它是一辆采用未来主义设计的单座概念赛车
——是法拉利对虚拟赛车领域的首次尝试。

它的灵感来自于二十世纪六十年代和七十年代的原型跑车……

并融入与法拉利330 P3和512S等传奇赛车相同的DNA。

这是一辆传承法拉利赛车血统，并渴望在未来的耐力赛中
留下印记的车。法拉利VGT的车身结构……

从国际汽联的勒芒超级跑车规则&汲取灵感，

无怪乎能将空气动力学的效应实现至巅峰水平。

它的动力系统来自一台3升涡轮增压V6混合动力引擎，
和法拉利LMH上使用的引擎完全相同。

由于国际汽联的规则并不适用于VT，
因此，它事实上比LMH还要动力强劲！

vehicleCollection.en:
A single-seat concept that pushes the boundaries of the hypercar genre.

The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo is the first Ferrari single-seater concept car dedicated to the world of virtual motor sport, with a spectacular and futuristic design founded in the Prancing Horse's unequalled racing heritage. The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo draws its inspiration from the fascinating world of Ferrari's hugely successful 1960s and '70s sports-prototypes. Below hyper-modern bodywork and dramatic proportions, the car hides the DNA of masterpieces such as the Ferrari 330 P3 and the 512S. It is a nod to the past, yet a powerful hint of the future of endurance racing.

The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo's architecture is crafted around an advanced aerodynamic design and is equipped with the same engine architecture that powers the Ferrari 499P. Here, though, the engine has been made more extreme to develop no less than 1,030 CV (<1030ps>) at <9000rpm>, with an additional 240 kW (<326ps>) available through three electric motors, one on the rear axle and one on each of the front wheels.

long.en:
The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo is the first Ferrari single-seater concept car dedicated to the world of virtual motor sport, with a spectacular and futuristic design founded in the Prancing Horse's unequalled racing heritage. The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo draws its inspiration from the fascinating world of Ferrari's hugely successful 1960s and '70s sports-prototypes. Below hyper-modern bodywork and dramatic proportions, the car hides the DNA of masterpieces such as the Ferrari 330 P3 and the 512S. It is a nod to the past, yet a powerful hint of the future of endurance racing.

The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo's architecture is crafted around an advanced aerodynamic design and is equipped with the same engine architecture that powers the Ferrari 499P. Here, though, the engine has been made more extreme to develop no less than 1,030 CV (<1030ps>) at <9000rpm>, with an additional 240 kW (<326ps>) available through three electric motors, one on the rear axle and one on each of the front wheels.
long.zh:
法拉利Vision Gran Turismo是首款专门为虚拟赛车运动世界设计的法拉利单座概念赛车，其美轮美奂的未来主义设计继承了法拉利“骏马”无与伦比的赛车传承风范。 Vision Gran Turismo的灵感来自于60年代和70年代大获成功的一众赛车原型车。在这辆车超现代的车身和超乎常理的比例之下，蕴含着法拉利330 P3和512S等杰作的DNA。它不仅是对过去的缅怀，同时也为未来的耐力赛指明了方向。

法拉利Vision Gran Turismo的架构围绕前沿的空气动力学设计而打造，并配备了为法拉利499P提供动力的同款引擎系统。但在游戏里，这台引擎的调校显然更加追求极致——它能在<9000rpm>下产生不少于1,030马力（<1030ps>）的出力，并可通过三个分别位于后轴和左右前轮的电机额外获得240千瓦（<326ps>）的动力。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆突破终极跑车界限的单座概念车。

法拉利Vision Gran Turismo是首款专门为虚拟赛车运动世界设计的法拉利单座概念赛车，其美轮美奂的未来主义设计继承了法拉利“骏马”无与伦比的赛车传承风范。 Vision Gran Turismo的灵感来自于60年代和70年代大获成功的一众赛车原型车。在这辆车超现代的车身和超乎常理的比例之下，蕴含着法拉利330 P3和512S等杰作的DNA。它不仅是对过去的缅怀，同时也为未来的耐力赛指明了方向。

法拉利Vision Gran Turismo的架构围绕前沿的空气动力学设计而打造，并配备了为法拉利499P提供动力的同款引擎系统。但在游戏里，这台引擎的调校显然更加追求极致——它能在<9000rpm>下产生不少于1,030马力（<1030ps>）的出力，并可通过三个分别位于后轴和左右前轮的电机额外获得240千瓦（<326ps>）的动力。

cars.nameEn: Fittipaldi EF7 Vision Gran Turismo by Pininfarina
cars.nameZh: 宾尼法利纳制Fittipaldi EF7 Vision Gran Turismo

brandCentral.en:
Emerson Fittipaldi is one of the true legends of motorsports.
His credentials include...

...two-time Formula 1 champion...

...two-time Indy 500 winner...

...and now, car designer. This Vision Gran Turismo model is
his take on the perfect race car.

Its official name is the Fittipaldi EF7 VGT by Pininfarina.

The concept was to create a car that anyone could drive,
but one that could also be a serious racing contender.

And as anyone taking the wheel will see, that concept
has become reality.=
brandCentral.sourceName: Fittipaldi EF7 Vision Gran Turismo by Pininfarina
brandCentral.zh:
Emerson Fittipaldi是一位赛车运动领域的传奇人物。

拥有两个一级方程式冠军头衔……

两届印地500冠军得主……

而现在，他又成为了一名汽车设计师。这辆Vision Gran Turismo
让他的赛车梦想成为现实。

这辆车的全称是Fittipaldi EF7 VGT，由Pininfarina负责打造。

其设计理念是打造一辆任何人都能驾驶，但同时又具备
强大的赛事竞争力的车。

握住它方向盘的人想来都会认同，这个理念已经实现了。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 1992, the Escort RS Cosworth was a homologation model built to support Ford’s campaign in the WRC. It inherited the 2.0-liter twin-cam engine from the Sierra, producing 223.9 HP, and featured a 4-wheel-drive system that delivered exceptional rally performance. The car proved its capability with a 1-2 finish at the Rally de Portugal, followed by back-to-back victories in the Tour de Corse and Acropolis Rally, firmly reestablishing Ford as a force in the world of rallying.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1992年推出的Escort RS Cosworth是Ford为征战世界拉力锦标赛而打造的认证车型。承袭自Sierra的双凸轮轴2升引擎（227 PS）搭配上四驱系统，让这台车在拉力赛场展现出惊人性能。这台车在葡萄牙拉力赛中取得了一二带回的成绩，并在科西嘉岛拉力赛与雅典卫城拉力赛中连续获胜，重振了Ford的拉力赛豪门地位。

usedCar.en:
You seem like a rally car enthusiast. If so, then this
is definitely the car for you!

The Ford Escort RS Cosworth was the successor
to the legendary Sierra Cosworth 4x4.

While the Escort had its heyday in the late 1960s and 1970s,
this car adopted the engine and 4WD layout from the Sierra.

The two-tier rear wing made quite the impression!

Needless to say, this car was fast, claiming five of 13 wins
at the 1993 World Rally Championship.

It certainly played a major role in restoring Ford to its
former rally glory.
usedCar.zh:
看来你是位拉力赛车爱好者。那么这款车
一定会让你心动！

福特福睿斯RS Cosworth继承了
传奇车型Sierra Cosworth 4x4的衣钵。

福睿斯在上世纪60年代末和70年代就曾登上巅峰，
而这款车又继承了塞拉的引擎与四驱系统。

其标志性的双层尾翼更是令人印象深刻！

这款性能出众的车型在1993年世界拉力锦标赛上

它无疑为福特重返拉力赛车之巅立下了汗马功劳。`

vehicleCollection.en:
A WRC homologation special with a unique double-decker wing design.

Ford began their 1990s World Rally Championship (WRC) campaign fighting in the Sierra RS Cosworth 4x4. Then, in 1992, came the Escort RS Cosworth, a homologation special developed for even higher performance.

The original Escort was a masterpiece in itself, having been widely used in rally races in the late 1960s and early 1970s. Years later, Ford Europe took the compact body of the fifth-generation Escort, installed a highly tuned version of the 4WD powertrain from the Sierra, and added a large dual level rear wing to create a fearsome race machine.

At the heart of the beast was a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.0-liter twin-cam engine built by Cosworth, as per the car's name. The bore-stroke ratio was tweaked, resulting in <1993cc> of displacement and an output of <227ps>/<30.4kgm> in stock form. For the 4WD system, the central differential utilized a combination of a viscous coupling and planetary gears for maximum reliability.

The Escort RS Cosworth began production in 1992 and gained homologation status the following year when it began competing in the WRC's Group A category.

The "Cossie," as fans called it, finished 1-2 in Round 3 of the Portugal Rally before going on to achieve two consecutive victories in Rounds 5 (Tour de Corse) and 6 (Acropolis). It won again in Rounds 11 and 12 (San Remo and Spain), solidifying Ford's reputation as a strong contender on the rally circuit.

long.zh:
福特在20世纪90年代初期以Sierra RS Cosworth 4x4参加世界拉力锦标赛（WRC）。随后在1992年推出了福睿斯RS Cosworth，这是一款为提升竞技性能而开发的特殊赛事认证车型。

其原型福睿斯是20世纪60年代末和70年代拉力赛场上的王者之作。针对福睿斯RS，福特欧洲选用第五代福睿斯的紧凑车身，搭载了经过高度调校的Sierra四轮驱动系统，并加装了大型双层尾翼，实现全面的性能升级。

这头猛兽的核心动力系统是一台由Cosworth打造的纵置2升涡轮增压双顶置凸轮轴引擎，这也是其命名的由来。通过优化缸径行程比，使引擎排量达到<1993cc>，在原厂调校状态下即可输出<227ps>/<30.4kgm>的动力。四轮驱动系统采用粘性耦合器与行星齿轮组合的中央差速器设计，以确保最佳的可靠性。

福睿斯RS Cosworth于1992年投产，并在次年通过认证后开始参加世界拉力锦标赛的A组赛事。

这款被车迷亲切称为“Cossie”的赛车在第3轮葡萄牙拉力赛中取得了一二名的成绩，并在第5轮（科西嘉岛拉力赛）和第6轮（雅典卫城拉力赛）中连续获胜，更是在第11轮和第12轮（圣雷莫拉力赛和西班牙拉力赛）中再度上演这一连冠壮举，重振了福特作为拉力赛强者的声誉。

conversation.en:
Ford's F-Series is the most popular line of pickup trucks
in North America.

And the Raptor is by far the highest performance model
of the bunch.

One design objective was to optimize it for off-road racing,
therefore, the truck possesses sports-car-like handling.

The Raptor boasts a wide body, reinforced suspension and a
6.2-liter V-8 capable of producing more than <400ps>.

Put this beast in its element, and it'll shatter your notion
of how fast a truck can go.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
Ford的“F系列”车型是北美最流行的皮卡。

Raptor是该系列中迄今性能最强大的一款车型。

它的设计理念之一便是强化在越野赛中的性能表现，
这使得它与其他贴地的跑车截然不同。

Raptor不仅有宽车体、强化的悬挂系统，
还有一台能输出<400ps>以上的6.2升V8引擎。

只要将这头野兽的本领发挥出来，
您对于卡车能跑多快的认识一定会被击碎。
J

unique DNA.

=
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
Raptor的外形充盈着侵略性和力量感！
这就是我爱这辆卡车的原因！

它不仅拥有Ford血统的优点，还有许多独到之处！
形成了一套性能全面的设计方案。

它拥有宽大的车架和大外径尺寸的轮胎，
因此获得了出色的操控性和充分的离地间隙。

极大的上坡角增大了车架前后部分与地面的空间，
使其能够轻松搞定起伏坎坷的地形。

另外，这辆初代Raptor搭载的可是一台V8引擎，
无论是个性还是侵略性，都更上一层楼！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The F-Series is Ford’s line of full-size pickup trucks, introduced in 1948. Over the decades, it became a staple of American roads and has held the title of the best-selling vehicle in the U.S. for more than 30 years. The F-150 SVT Raptor, developed by Ford’s Special Vehicle Team (SVT), was a purpose-built off-road variant of the F-150, using the same 4-wheel-drive system as its base model, for high-speed desert racing.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: F系列是Ford自1948年起销售至今的全尺寸皮卡系列车型。30多年来，该广受欢迎的车款一直是美国最为畅销的皮卡车。由Ford特殊车辆开发团队“SVT”开发的F-150 SVT Raptor是一款基于相同四轮驱动系统打造的特殊越野车型，专为沙漠赛车而生。
officialDetails.heroEn: With 411.2 HP on tap, this was one of the most potent pickup trucks ever created, thanks to Ford's Special Vehicle Team.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款出自Ford的Special Vehicle团队之手的高性能皮卡有着417 PS的超强马力。

vehicleCollection.en:
With <417ps> on tap, this was one of the most potent pickup trucks ever created, thanks to Ford's Special Vehicle Team.

The F series is a line of full size pickup trucks sold by Ford since 1948. This is a model that has stayed on top of the pickup truck segment for over 40 years, and has also been the best selling car across all car categories for over 30 years in the United States.

The F-150 has always been the core of the series since being introduced in 1975. It is a model that has been the backbone of Ford throughout the years.

The F-150 Raptor is a special off-road model based on the 12th generation F-150, which started sales in the fall of 2008. It was developed by Ford's special vehicle development team "SVT" to be fit for racing in the desert and was added to the lineup in 2010.

The body is <18cm> wider with its enlarged fenders that house considerably thicker aluminum suspension arms supported by Fox Racing dampers, which are known to be the first off-road competition dampers to come equipped on a production car. The suspension travel in the front has been extended to <284.5mm> and <307.3mm> in the rear. The clearance under the car is also large, with an approach angle of 30 degrees and a departure angle of 22.7 degrees.

The engine is a 6.2 litre supercharged V8 producing <417ps> and <60.9kgm> of torque, and is combined with a 6 speed automatic transmission.|

The body is <18cm> wider with its enlarged fenders that house considerably thicker aluminum suspension arms supported by Fox Racing dampers, which are known to be the first off-road competition dampers to come equipped on a production car. The suspension travel in the front has been extended to <284.5mm> and <307.3mm> in the rear. The clearance under the car is also large, with an approach angle of 30 degrees and a departure angle of 22.7 degrees.

The engine is a 6.2 litre supercharged V8 producing <417ps> and <60.9kgm> of torque, and is combined with a 6 speed automatic transmission.|

自1975年推出以来，F-150一直是该系列的核心，这个车款一直是福特的主力车款。

福特F-150猛禽是在第十二代F-150基础上开发的越野特别版车款，于2008年秋季开始销售。这款车是由福特的专用车辆开发团队“SVT”开发，作为一款适应沙漠地形的赛车上市，并加入了2010年的车款阵容中。

车身采用更大的挡泥板并加宽<18cm>，能够容纳更厚的铝制悬挂臂，悬挂臂由狐狸赛车避震支撑，这是量产车上首次装备越野赛车避震。车辆前悬挂的行程增大到了<284.5mm>，后悬挂则增大到了<307.3mm>。车辆离地高度也较高，接近角可达30度，离去角则为22.7度。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: A Gran Turismo Original, Ford’s Focus global hatchback has been reimagined to meet the demands of Gr.B regulations. To accommodate the changes, air intakes have been added just ahead of the rear fenders, channeling airflow to a rear-mounted radiator. Relocating the radiator to the trunk improved weight distribution, making it one of the most easy-to-drive machines in the Gr.B category.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 作为跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，Ford Focus全球掀背车已按照Gr.B组别规则进行了改装。该车在后挡泥板前方增加了能将空气输送到后置散热器的进气口。散热器移至后备箱后，车身重量分配得到了相应改善，使其成为Gr.B组别中最容易操控的车型之一。
officialDetails.heroEn: The chassis performance of the late third-generation model shines in this rally special.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款最新的第3代拉力特别款车型将底盘性能发挥得淋漓尽致。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on the
Ford Focus ST.

The drivetrain has been converted from powering only the
front wheels to 4WD.

Various changes have also been made to alter the weight
distribution, such as moving the radiator to the rear.

The handling is considerably sharper as a result.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于Ford Focus ST开发。

其传动系统从标准的前置前驱改为了四轮驱动。

为了调整配重比，这台车经历了翻天覆地的改装，例如
将散热器挪到了车身后部。

这辆车的操控性也因此得到了大幅强化，容错率更高。

vehicleCollection.en:
The chassis performance of the late third-generation model shines in this rally special.

Ford saw performance potential in its affordable sedan, the Focus, so it created the Focus ST, a souped-up version that made its debut in 1998. The third-generation Focus ST (the ST stands for Sports Technology) debuted at the 2010 Paris Motor Show equipped with a brand new engine.

The previous Focus ST came powered by a Volvo-based turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-5, but the new car featured an “EcoBoost” turbocharged direct-injection 2.0-liter inline-4 that boasted better fuel economy and reduced emissions. Despite being smaller by <500cc>, the new engine delivered <25ps> more power, up to <250ps>. While many models had moved on to 2 pedal transmissions, this stoic model only came with a 6-speed manual.

The car thrilled enthusiasts for years, and in 2014, in addition to a mild facelift, Ford engineers made some drastic changes under the sheet metal. They completely revamped the suspension system, changed the variable ratio of the power steering, updated the stability program, and installed a torque vectoring system. As a result, the new Focus ST’s boasted class-leading handling, impressing even hardened race car drivers with its quick reactions and road-holding ability. And with a price that undercut its rivals in the competitive C segment, the Ford ST is still the talk of performance-car aficionados, even at the tail-end of its model run.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.B regulations by Gran Turismo./

FoxST是Fox系列中备受推崇的运动车型，从1998年Fox面世的时候开始它就出现在该系的阵营中。ST是“运动科技”的英文缩写。

第三代FoxST在2010年巴黎车展中首次被宣布推出。该款车型设计的最大改变当属它的引擎从沿袭自沃尔沃的2.5升涡轮增压直列式5缸引擎降格至带有“节动”的2.0升涡轮增压直喷4缸引擎。这个改动当然是为了减少二氧化碳排放并提高燃油效率，但是在减少了<500cc>排量之后，它的动力却获得了<25ps>的提升，达到了<250ps>。尽管很多新款车型已经开始采用双离合变速箱，这款经典车型却依然只提供6档手动变速箱。

该车在2014年进行了一次车型翻新，成为了最新的款式。与此同时，悬挂设置也被完全改造，动力转向的可变比率经过调整，稳定系统被更新，同时还加入了扭矩控制系统。尽管从一开始就获得了不俗的评价，福特还是花时间对底盘进行了整体更新。

正因如此，它的操控性在车手中评价很高，同时还由于其低于竞争对手的亲民价格，使其在C级小型跑车中名列前茅。尽管该车型临近停产，但是依然最后一次吸引了许多欧洲车迷的关注。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别B规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 2018, the fourth-generation Ford Focus included a high-performance RS variant in its lineup. This iteration marked the first time the RS featured 4-wheel drive, complete with adjustable torque distribution for enhanced handling. New selectable drive modes, such as "Track" and "Drift," were introduced, complementing an improved chassis and damping system. At its core was a 2.3-liter inline-4 EcoBoost engine producing 345.2 HP. With a zero–62.1 mph time of 4.7 seconds and a top speed of 165.3 mph, the car delivered remarkable performance in a compact package.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2018年推出的第4代Ford Focus系列包含高性能“RS”车型。这台第4代RS首次配备四驱系统并支持扭矩分配调节。该车新增“赛道”与“漂移”等驾驶模式，底盘与避震器也得到了同步优化。其搭载的是一台2.3升直列4缸“EcoBoost”引擎（350 PS）。0-100 公里/小时加速时间为4.7秒，最高速度达266 公里/小时，性能极其卓越。
officialDetails.heroEn: The RS model of the third-generation Ford Focus was the first to get 4-wheel drive.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款第三代Focus的RS车型是首款使用四轮驱动的车型，已获得更高的比赛性能。

brandCentral.en:
The RS is the top-of-the-line Focus and is
particularly popular with rally fans.

Previous RS models were front-wheel drive...

But this fourth iteration, which appeared in 2018, had
AWD for the first time in the model's history.

The torque distribution was adjustable from full FWD
to full RWD and everything in between.

This allows you to even drift the car if you wanted to. [
brandCentral.zh:
这款RS傲立于整个Focus产品线的巅峰，在拉力赛爱好者中
尤其受欢迎。

之前的RS型号都是前置前驱布局设计……

而这款于2018年亮相的第四代型号却破天荒的采用了四轮
驱动配置，

其扭矩分配可以进行从100%前轮到100%后轮的全面调整。

这项功能使其可以满足任何条件下的驾驶，甚至连漂移
也不例外。

catch.en: The RS model of the third-generation Ford Focus was the first to get 4-wheel drive.
catch.zh: 这款第三代Focus的RS车型是首款使用四轮驱动的车型，已获得更高的比赛性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
The RS model of the third-generation Ford Focus was the first to get 4-wheel drive.

While the Focus is mostly known as a friendly everyday commuter, Ford has traditionally mixed in a high-performance version called the RS that catered directly to enthusiasts.

The fourth-generation model, which made its debut in 2018, was no different, but this time, the Focus RS was offered with AWD. With the new RS, drivers could adjust the torque distribution between the front and rear wheels, from 0:100 to 100:0, meaning it could be driven in pure front-drive or rear-drive form. Thanks to the rear axle's twin-clutch system that functions as an LSD, the driver could choose from several driving modes, including "Track" and "Drift."

Under the hood was the company's EcoBoost 2.3-liter inline-4 tuned to produce an impressive <350ps> and <44.8kgm>, thanks to new turbocharger and larger intercooler. This allowed the car to run to <100km/h> in 4.7s and reach a top speed of <266km/h>, making this Ford one of the hottest American hatches of all time.

福特福克斯的型号种类繁多，但每次都会推出一款运动版本。第四代福克斯也延续了这一传统，在2018年推出了高性能的RS车型。

在此前几代中，RS代表运动型的前轮驱动款式，而2015款的RS则变更为四轮驱动。扭矩分配可在前轮100%和后轮100%之间进行调节，后轴为双离合设计，同时也起到限滑差速器的作用。除了赛道模式之外，福特还在驾驶模式中增加了漂移模式。悬挂系统也得到了重点关照，配备了双模式避震器。

动力单元采用Mustang同款的2.3升直列4缸智能动力引擎，通过引入全新的涡轮增压器和大号中冷器，调校为可输出<350ps>和<44.8kgm>。0-<100km/h>加速仅需4.7秒，极速为<266km/h>的福克斯RS可不只是一台“小钢炮”而已。

正因如此，它的操控性在车手中评价很高，同时还由于其低于竞争对手的亲民价格，使其在C级小型跑车中名列前茅。尽管该车型临近停产，但是依然最后一次吸引了许多欧洲车迷的关注。

It is really a clever design in that it is larger

 If you put an original next to it, you won't

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Built to commemorate Ford’s 100th anniversary, the Ford GT drew both its silhouette and spirit from the iconic GT40—a legend born from its sweep of the top three positions at the 1966 24 Hours of Le Mans, and its unprecedented four-year winning streak that followed through 1969. With a 0–60 mph time of just 3.3 seconds and a top speed of 205.1 mph, the GT delivered performance worthy of its heritage. A total of 4,038 units were produced over a three-year span, concluding in 2006.

vehicleCollection.en:
The final-year model of this potent supercar came right after the company's 100th anniversary.

The Ford GT40 became an instant icon in the GT racing world by dominating the famous 24 Hours of Le Mans endurance race, taking the top three spots on the podium in 1966 and winning the next four in a row. In celebration of Ford's 100th anniversary in 2002, the company elected to recreate the legend by producing the spiritual successor to the classic race car of the sixties, the Ford GT.

The concept model was presented at the 2002 North American International Auto Show, followed by the unveiling of the production car at the same show in 2004. Its beautiful styling closely resembled that of the original GT40, but the new machine came armed with the latest technological features. The car measured <457mm> longer and <102mm> taller than the original, but its larger size was effectively veiled by the stunning exterior styling.

Placed amidships, immediately behind the cabin, was a longitudinally-mounted supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 that pumped out <558ps>/<6500rpm> with <69.13kgm> of torque at <3750rpm>. It came with a 6-speed gearbox. The new GT boasted remarkable performance, running from 0 to 60 mph (about 100km/h) in 3.3 seconds, while reaching a top speed of <330km/h>.

A total of 4038 Ford GTs were unleashed onto the streets during its three-year production run, and, by all accounts, this revived version of the GT40 will be just as collectable as the original.

long.zh:
福特GT40是一款传奇跑车，在1966年勒芒24小时耐力赛上包揽了前三名，并在此后直至1969年的连续四年间蝉联冠军。为庆祝公司成立一百周年，福特开发了新款福特GT，试图重现当年的传奇形象与精神。其概念赛车型公布于2002年北美国际车展，正式发布则是在2004年的同一车展上。

此车优美的造型与六十年代的GT40十分相似，但包裹铝制空间框架的车身完全按照现代标准和规范重新设计。车身长<457mm>，高<102mm>，所有部件都运用了表面冲洗技术以提高制造质量。富有艺术气息的内饰兼顾了旧日形象与现代风格，使得两名乘客能够以放松的心情来乘坐。

纵向放置的中置引擎为一款5.4升双顶置式凸轮轴V8机械增压引擎，最大马力为<558ps> /，最大扭矩为<69.13kgm> / <3750rpm>。变速箱没有采用当时逐渐成为流行的双踏板半自动变速箱，而是采用了传统的三踏板6速手动变速。0-60英里/小时的加速只需3.3秒，最高速度为<330km/h>。

从这些规格参数中可以看出，福特不仅关注造型，同时也努力重现与GT40相当的性能，并使其能够合法上路行驶。

福特GT一直服役到2006年，三年间一共生产了4,038辆。其中大多数有两条从车身前部一直延伸至后部的赛车条纹，但也有少量车辆上没有。

conversation.en:
The Mini, Beetle and Cinquecento of today...

Are more than just products of their manufacturers.
They have become unique brands unto themselves.

Well, the Ford GT that appeared in 2005 is
a sports car example of this phenomenon.

Nine years later, a slew of hypercars
would appear, stirring fierce rivalry.

This 2017 Ford GT returned to its origins while,
at the same time, adopting innovation.

Viewed from a low angle, it bears traces of
the 1960s car that raced at Le Mans.

And from a higher angle, one can clearly make out
its innovative three-dimensional design.
g
