officialDetails.descriptionEn: Between 2005 and 2006, Ford produced the GT, a modern homage to the legendary GT40. A decade later, in 2015, a second-generation model was unveiled. While retaining the unmistakable lineage of the GT40, it introduced an aggressively aerodynamic form and cutting-edge engineering. Built around a carbon-fiber monocoque with aluminum subframes, it was significantly lighter and delivered a top speed of 216.2 mph.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Ford在2005和2006年间复刻了GT40，推出Ford GT，并在2015年宣布推出第2代车型。该第2代车型延续了GT40神韵的同时，在空气动力学设计上做到了极致。碳纤维单体车壳配合铝制副车架减轻车重，让最高时速来到了348 公里/小时。
officialDetails.heroEn: The second-generation Ford GT came complete with reengineered aerodynamics.
officialDetails.heroZh: Ford GT的回归，空气动力学性能经过了大幅改善。

brandCentral.en:
This third generation Ford GT continues the legacy
begun so many years ago by the famed GT40.

Equipped with a 3.6L V6 twin-turbo engine, it boasts an
output of <656ps>, with maximum torque of <76kgm>.

These supreme specs make it the highest-powered road car
Ford has ever put into production.

The race version was earning plaudits as early as 2016,
finishing top in its class at Le Mans.

This was no insignificant victory, coming as it did exactly
50 years after a GT first won the very same race.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆第三代Ford GT继承了传奇车款GT40在许多年之前开创的
优良传统。

它搭载有一台3.6L V6双涡轮增压引擎，可以输出<656ps>的动力，
最大扭矩为<76kgm>。

这些超乎想象的参数也让它成为了Ford的量产公路车中动
力最强劲的型号。

其赛车版本更是早在2016年就在勒芒捧起了所属组别的冠
军奖杯，赢得了无尽的赞扬。

而在50年前，同样是一辆GT赢得了同一项赛事。这绝对
是不可小觑的伟大成就。

vehicleCollection.en:
The second-generation Ford GT came complete with reengineered aerodynamics."

The original Ford GT, which was produced from 2005 to 2006, brought back the glory of the renowned GT40, whose exploits in the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1960s are now legendary. At the 2015 North American International Auto Show, Ford introduced the second-generation GT that boasted even more performance and technical savagery than its predecessor.

While the first Ford GT's styling strongly resembled that of the GT40, the new 2016 car featured a number of aerodynamic improvements that included an active rear spoiler and a large underbody tunnel that directed air from the side through to the rear. Underneath the sheet metal, there were aluminum front and rear subframes that provided a remarkably rigid body structure, while the body panels themselves were composed of lightweight carbon fiber.

Mounted aft of the cockpit was not the V8 of yore, but a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V6 that produced a whopping <656ps> and <76kgm>. It came with a 7-speed DCT transmission that sent the power to the rear wheels. This combination enabled the new Ford GT to run from 0 to 60 mph in a scant 3.2 seconds, while reaching a top speed of <348km/h>.

在2005至2006年间，福特以在1960年代在勒芒24小时耐力赛中大放异彩的车型GT 40为基础，重新打造了一台福特GT。到了2015年的底特律车展上，福特宣布推出经过大幅改进的第二代车型。

在造型方面，第一代福特GT几乎与原版GT 40别无二致，而9年之后的第二代虽然依旧继承了GT 40的风貌，但大量空气动力学方面的提升使得车身设计概念已大相径庭。新车款包括了主动式的后扰流板，从车顶下延到后轮拱的隐藏挡板形成巨大的进气风道，从侧面一直深入到车尾。

车身的主要结构由铝合金材质的前车架和后副车架组合而成，车身板件则考虑到减重因素，使用碳纤维板制成。

动力单元不再是传统的V8引擎，而是换上了一台3.5升双涡轮增压V6引擎，可以输出<656ps>和<76kgm>的扭矩，再搭配上7速双离合变速箱，最高时速可达<348km/h>。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This LM-spec machine represented a Le Mans–style reinterpretation of the Ford GT—an evolution of the 1960s GT40 legacy, infused with modern technology. Under the rear deck sat a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V-8 producing 591.7 HP. It also featured a double wishbone suspension and a race-ready 6-speed gearbox.

vehicleCollection.en:
Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

As a stunning new take on a legendary racing car, the new Ford GT supercar was launched in the summer of 2004 to commemorate the company's 100th anniversary. As a reinterpretation of the classic 1960s GT40 that won four straight 24 Hours of Le Mans races, this new version featured the latest and greatest automotive technology. With that in mind, Grand Turismo decided to make a good thing even better by creating its own Ford GT to contemporary Le Mans specs, we call it the Ford GT LM Race Car.

The powertrain remains the same as that found in the production Ford GT, a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 mounted amidships behind the seats. But the <558ps> output from the stock version has been boosted to a whopping <600ps> in this race car model. A 6-speed manual race-spec gearbox has also been added.

The LM Race Car has the identical proportions as that of the stock Ford GT, measuring <4.61m> from bumper to bumper and <1.95m> wide. The chassis is an aluminum space frame design incorporating all of the latest automotive technologies, and the body is composed entirely of carbon-fiber. A large rear wing for increased downforce has also been added. The suspension system consists of a double-wishbone configuration fore and aft. Total curb weight: just <1150kg>.'

long.zh:
2004年夏发布的福特GT是为了纪念福特一百周年而打造的超级跑车。此车被认为是采用最新的汽车技术重新诠释了福特六十年代的经典车型GT40。因此我们抱着将福特GT调试到勒芒比赛规格的想法，创造了这款LM赛车，看看会有怎样的成果。

原版GT40是为夺取勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军而开发的，这也是福特长久以来的梦想。在60年代，勒芒耐力赛的鼎盛时期，当法拉利和保时捷这样的顶级欧洲车厂针锋相对，争夺冠军的时候，这款奇迹般的赛车横空出世，自1966起连续四年蝉联冠军，展现了福特的实力。所以，我们认为福特GT作为“重生版”的GT40，自然要在勒芒赛场上一显身手。考虑到这一点，此车是按照现已停止使用的勒芒GTS级别规则设计的，这个级别曾是科尔维特C5-R和Viper GTS-R等车型的舞台。

引擎仍然是福特标志性的5.4升双顶置式凸轮轴机械增压V8引擎，采用中置式安装在座位后方，和普通的福特GT一样只使用后轮驱动，但赛车款将公路车型的<558ps>提高到了惊人的<600ps>。前后均采用双叉臂式悬挂，变速箱为赛车规格的6档变速。

catch.en: Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

vehicleCollection.en:
Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

As a stunning new take on a legendary racing car, the new Ford GT supercar was launched in the summer of 2004 to commemorate the company's 100th anniversary. As a reinterpretation of the classic 1960s GT40 that won four straight 24 Hours of Le Mans races, this new version featured the latest and greatest automotive technology. With that in mind, we decided to make a good thing even better by creating this Ford GT to contemporary Le Mans specs and calling it the Ford GT LM Race Car.

The powertrain remains the same as that which is found in the production Ford GT, a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 mounted amidships behind the seats. However, the <558 ps> output from the stock version has been boosted to a whopping <600 ps> in this race car model. A 6-speed manual race-spec gearbox has also been added.

The LM Race Car has the identical proportions as that of the stock Ford GT, measuring <4.61 m> from bumper to bumper and <1.95 m> wide. The chassis is an aluminum space frame design incorporating all of the latest automotive technologies, and the body is composed entirely of carbon-fiber. A large rear wing for increased downforce has also been added. The suspension system consists of a double-wishbone configuration fore and aft. The total curb weight is just 2535 lbs.

long.zh:
2004年夏发布的福特GT是为了纪念福特一百周年而打造的超级跑车。此车被认为是采用最新的汽车技术重新诠释了福特六十年代的经典车型GT40。因此我们抱着将福特GT调试到勒芒比赛规格的想法，创造了这款LM赛车，看看会有怎样的成果。

原版GT40是为夺取勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军而开发的，这也是福特长久以来的梦想。在60年代，勒芒耐力赛的鼎盛时期，当法拉利和保时捷这样的顶级欧洲车厂针锋相对，争夺冠军的时候，这款奇迹般的赛车横空出世，自1966起连续四年蝉联冠军，展现了福特的实力。所以，我们认为福特GT作为“重生版”的GT40，自然要在勒芒赛场上一显身手。考虑到这一点，此车是按照现已停止使用的勒芒GTS级别规则设计的，这个级别曾是科尔维特C5-R和Viper GTS-R等车型的舞台。

引擎仍然是福特标志性的5.4升双顶置式凸轮轴机械增压V8引擎，采用中置式安装在座位后方，和普通的福特GT一样只使用后轮驱动，但赛车款将公路车型的<558ps>提高到了惊人的<600ps>。前后均采用双叉臂式悬挂，变速箱为赛车规格的6档变速。

conversation.en:
At the 1966 Le Mans, the first-generation Ford GT
beat its archnemesis, Ferrari.

This victory made the Ford GT the first American car to win
the 24-hour race.

Fast-forward 50 years to 2016.

The Ford GT returned to beat Ferrari
once again at Le Mans.

It was an amazing feat 50 years in the making.
It’s what makes racing so much fun!

Indeed, the long history of motorsports is filled
with such iconic battles.
S

catch.en: This race car claimed numerous World Endurance Championship titles.
catch.zh: 赢得世界耐力锦标赛的Ford车厂车队专属赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This race car claimed numerous World Endurance Championship titles.

The second-generation Ford GT, introduced in 2015, came equipped with compact twin-turbo V-6 that allowed the car to spring to 60 mph in about 3.0 seconds and reach a top speed of <348km/h>, making it a legitimate super car and a worthy successor to the classic GT40 of yesteryear.

Like the GT40, the GT shined on the race track. Under the Chip Ganassi Racing and Ford factory team banner, it scored several victories in the World Endurance Championship (WEC) that included the 2016 24 Hours of Le Mans, as well as winning in IMSA, taking three race wins in 2016, two in 2017, five in 2018 and three in 2019. In 2018, after winning the 24 Hours of Daytona, the GT's strong performance that season handed Ford the manufacturers title in the GT-LM class.

long.zh:
新生的福特GT第二代于2015年推出，比前代车型更加强调速度。

新的车身设计在空气动力学效能上有了更长足的进步，并配备了一款紧凑型的V6双涡轮增压引擎，使这一切成为可能。0-60英里/小时的加速时间为3.0秒，最高速度为<348km/h>，性能远胜过欧洲同类车型。

毫无意外，福特也将它投入到了赛车界的拼杀中。著名的美国赛车队纳斯卡甘纳西车队从2016年起作为福特车厂车队参加了多项系列赛事，包括国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛和美国的国际汽车运动协会赛事。

虽然从勒芒24小时耐力赛开始，该车队在世界耐力锦标赛赛事中的胜场寥寥，但在国际汽车运动协会中却奉上了绝佳的表现。2016年赢得了3场比赛，2017年2场，2018年5场，2019年3场。2019年也是车厂赞助车队的最后一年。

此外，在2018年赛季的戴通纳24小时耐力赛中，以赛季首胜作为开端，福特GT又在赛季中多次登上领奖台，最终帮助福特获得了GT-LM级别的车厂冠军。

conversation.en:
This is the road version of the Mark I that raced at Le Mans
in 1966.

The Ford GT40 Mk I was introduced in 1964.

It was developed specifically to beat Ferrari at Le Mans,
where the Italian company had dominated.

Three Mk Is participated in the 1964 Le Mans race, but they all
retired without making it to the finish line.

In 1965, Ford put Carroll Shelby in charge of everything
from development to strategy, with thesame result...

Then, Shelby completely overhauled the chassis and engine,
creating the Mk II in 1966.

Eight Mk IIs and five Mk Is waged war at Le Mans
that year.

It was an overwhelmin show of strength in numbers!

This determination brought home the Le Ms title for Fo,
fnally putting an end to Ferrari's run.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这辆车是参加了1966年勒芒耐力赛的Mark 1的公路版。

福特GT40 Mark 1公布于1964年。

这辆车是专门为了超越当时称霸勒芒的法拉利而开发的。

1964年，有三辆Mark 1参加了勒芒耐力赛，但全部中途退赛了。

1965年，福特任命卡罗尔·谢尔比负责从开发到战略的一切工作，
但比赛结果还是一样……

1966'，对底盘和发动机进行了完全改造的Mark II开发完成。

一共八辆Mark II和五辆Mark I参加了当年的勒芒耐力赛。

那可是压倒性的数量优势！

因此，福特也毫无意外地A那年首次夺得了勒芒耐力赛冠军宝座！

collection.en:
When most people think of the Ford GT40, they think of
Carroll Shelby, and they wouldn't be wrong.

But it's worth mentioning that Shelby wasn't actually
involved with the first GT40 Mark I, debuted in 1964.

The Mark I was a car with a fantastic concept.

I think the way it retains the look of a classic GT car
makes it especially beautiful.

The only thing the Mark I was missing was the reliability
required for endurance racing.

That's why Ford decided to hand a large part of its
racing programme over to Carroll Shelby.

The rest of GT40's glorious story is, of course, history.

But the GT40 Mark I is where it all began, and obviously
it's considered a prized collector's item.
collection.zh:
大多数人听到Ford GT40时，都会想到卡罗尔·谢尔比，
他们这样想没有错。

但值得一提的是，谢尔比本人其实与1964年登场的首款GT40 Mark I
并无关系。

GT40 Mark I是一款有着杰出概念设计的跑车。

因为它保留了传统GT赛车的外形，我认为这一点令其
尤为惊艳。

Mark I唯一缺少的是耐力赛所需的可靠性。

所以Ford才将他们的赛车项目中相当大的一部分事务交给
了卡罗尔·谢尔比掌管。

此后GT40的光辉事迹，史册上早有公论。

但GT40 Mark I才是传奇的开端，而其作为稀有的汽车收藏品，
自然也是实至名归。

vehicleCollection.en:
This historic machine achieved a much-desired Le Mans victory with an incredible 1-2-3 finish.

In 1963, Ford attempted to buy Ferrari in order to improve its brand image through racing. The talks did not go well, to say the least. The deal didn't happen, and Henry Ford II went on a mission to beat Ferrari at its own game, expanding a collaboration with British race car constructor Lola Cars (to whom Ford was already providing engines) to develop a brand-new racing car.

In 1964, based on a race chassis designed by Lola, the Mark I was completed and the Ford GT was born. The commonly known name "GT40" was originally a nickname given by a reporter who was surprised by the low 40-inch height of the car.

A lightweight aerodynamic body of fiberglass was mounted on a steel monocoque chassis, powered by an all-aluminum 4.7-liter OHV V8 mounted amidships. The car made its debut at a 1964 Nürburgring race. Later that year, three Mark I's began the assault on Ferrari. The cars showed incredible speed at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, breaking the lap record and achieving the first run in Le Mans history over <186mph>, but the Fords failed to win due to reliability issues.

From 1965, Ford commissioned race activities to Carroll Shelby, and though the GTs again set new top speed and lap records at Le Mans, all of the cars were again forced to retire from the race. At the 1966 Le Mans race, 8 out of 13 Ford GTs in the race were advanced Mark IIs, with improved chassis and Shelby-made 7-liter OHV V8s. In addition to many other refinements, the power of the engines skyrocketed from <350ps> to <475ps>.

Mr. Ford himself came to the circuit to watch this race, and Ford not only achieved a much-sought victory, they dominated the podium with an incredible 1-2-3 finish. From 1966 through 1969, the Ford GT devastated the competition, winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans four years in a row.

1963年，福特曾经希望收购法拉利，并通过赛车活动来提高他们的品牌形象。然而谈判并不顺利，收购未能成功。于是，福特决定与英国赛车车厂罗拉赛车合作，他们曾向这家车厂供应过引擎。两家共同启动了全新赛车开发计划。

1964年，以罗拉设计的比赛用跑车为基础开发的Mark I车型完成，并被命名为福特GT。广为人知的名称“GT40”其实是一位记者起的昵称，后者因为总车身高度仅有40英寸而惊讶万分。

玻璃纤维制成的空气动力学轻量化车身安装在钢制单体底盘上，同时配备了中置式安装、全铝制的4.7升顶置式气门V8引擎。此车在1964年的纽博格林1000 km耐力赛上亮相，同年参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛，共有三辆Mark I车型参加角逐。在勒芒耐力赛上，这款车展现出了惊人的速度，创下了单圈纪录，并在勒芒历史上首次跑出<300km/h>以上的速度，但由于车辆可靠性原因，最终所有车辆颗粒无收。

自1965年起，他们将赛车活动委托给著名的Shelby美国公司，虽然他们再次在勒芒24小时耐力赛上创下了最快单圈纪录和最高速度纪录，但依然没有车辆完赛。

在1966年勒芒耐力赛上，参赛的13辆福特GT中有8辆是经过改进的Mark II车型，拥有改进后的底盘和由Shelby制造的7升顶置式气门V8引擎。在众多改进之外，引擎的马力也由<350ps>提高到了<475ps>。

亨利·福特二世本人也亲临赛场观看比赛。最终，福特不仅获得了他们追求已久的胜利，而且还取得了包揽前三名的压倒性胜利。从这一年起直到1969年，福特GT连续4年蝉联勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军 @

vehicleCollection.en:
This race car represented Ford's last effort to challenge for the 24 Hours of Le Mans title.

The year was 1966, and Ford was on a roll, especially at the world's most famous endurance race, the 24 Hours of Le Mans. The company realized its goal of winning the historic contest on its third try, dominating the competition with the Ford GT Mark II. With their eyes set on winning future Le Mans races, the engineers from Ford began work developing a new race car in 1965, one that would eclipse the prowess of the GT Mark II. The GT Mark IV was built according to changes in Article J of the FIA vehicle regulation.

The new car possessed an aluminum honeycomb chassis, which replaced the previous car's steel monocoque one. The profile of the car was characterized by its long, low body that curved from the center section to the rear end. The side air intakes utilized NACA ducts for less drag. The car was subjected to intense wind tunnel testing, and as a result, the Mark IV was one of the most aerodynamically-proficient vehicles in the world.

Although the Mark IV's engine was carried over from the Mark II, its power was increased to <530ps>. The chassis was also updated. The result was a race car with an improved top speed of <347km/h> and a better overall stability than its predecessor. In 1967, the Mark IV won the 12 Hours of Sebring and claimed the checkered flag at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, beating its rival, Ferrari, by five laps. This victory marked the last time the Ford works team participated at Le Mans. The main reason for its departure was the adoption of a new rule in 1968 that restricted maximum displacement, which seemed directly aimed at the Ford GT because, simply put, the car was too fast for the competition.

long.zh:
福特的GT Mark II统治了1966年的勒芒24小时耐力赛，在参赛的第三年终于达成了梦寐以求的目标。但这也意味着该车的基础设计已经是3年前的了，他们需要尽快研发出该车的后继者。

这正是福特如此关注国际汽联车辆技术规范J条款，并在1965年开始全力研发的主要原因。在对他们的测试原型车“J款赛车”进行了多处最终调整后，福特GT Mark IV就此诞生。

全钢一体式车身被废弃，取而代之的是铝制蜂窝结构车架。前车身加长并压低高度，中部到尾端设计为弧形，两侧的进气口使用了NACA式设计来降低阻力。这是一款经过大量的风洞测试而设计出的高度符合空气动力学的车辆。

动力单元基本继承自Mark II，但经过精心调校，动力输出提升到了<530ps>。底盘的基础结构没有变化，但同样接受了精心调整。

这款车的极速提高到了<347.2km/h>，并有着更加出色的稳定性，Mark IV在1967赛季的赛百灵12小时耐力赛上夺魁，在勒芒24小时耐力赛中更是以5圈的优势领先死敌法拉利完赛。不幸的是，这也是福特最后一个以厂队身份夺得的冠军。原因之一便是1968年起增加的对车辆最大排量的限制，可以说是专门针对在当时看来速度太快的福特GT的。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This enhanced variant was exclusively offered on the 1969 and 1970 model years of Ford’s original Mustang. Built for NASCAR homologation, this Mustang housed the largest engine ever fitted to the model—a 7.0-liter V-8 known as the 429. Easily identified by its prominent hood scoop, it is often hailed as the most powerful Mustang in the model’s storied history.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款高性能车型仅在1969年和1970年款Ford初代Mustang上提供。为满足NASCAR赛事认证要求而生产，搭载Mustang历史上最大排量的7L V8 429引擎。那标志性的大型引擎盖进气口极易辨认，常被誉为史上最强的Mustang。
officialDetails.heroEn: This special high-performance Mustang was produced for only two years.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这是符合NASCAR赛事认证的Mustang，仅仅只生产了两年。

collection.en:
This is a legendary Mustang packing the Boss 429 Ford
racing engine.

You may have heard of the 427 'side oiler' engine
used by Ford in the 1960s.

It's what powered classic models like the GT40 and the
Shelby 427 Cobra.

Well, the 429 engine is the successor to that 427 unit.

Historically speaking, it was developed as part of Ford's
push into NASCAR racing.

While the street-legal Boss 429 produced a conservative
<380ps>, its racing version boasted around <560ps>.

NASCAR entry regulations required 500 of these engines to
be mass-produced.

After the Mustang Boss 429 fulfilled the homologation
requirement, it ended production in a short two years.
collection.zh:
这是一辆装有Boss 429 Ford赛车引擎的传奇Mustang。

您可能听说过Ford在20世纪60年代使用的427“侧油器”引擎。

它是为GT40和Shelby 427 Cobra等经典车型提供动力的核心。

在历史上，429引擎作为427的后继型号，

是Ford为了进入NASCAR赛车运动而专门开发的。

虽然合法上路版BOSS 429的动力输出相对保守，仅有<380ps>，
而其赛车版本的动力则高达<560ps>。

NASCAR参赛条件规定这些引擎必须生产至少500台。

也因此，Mustang BOSS 429在满足认证要求后，
在短短两年内就结束了生产。

vehicleCollection.en:
This special high-performance Mustang was produced for only two years.

The Ford Mustang has always included high-performance versions in its lineup with many examples created especially for racing.

One of the first special Mustang versions to be specifically used in motorsports was the GT350, developed by Shelby American for SCCA races. Then, there was the BOSS series, produced in 1969 and 1970, a high-performance Mustang for the street that also possessed a racing heart because it was primarily created for NASCAR homologation purposes. Among these, the BOSS 429 stands out as perhaps the most impressive Mustang ever.

Under its hood was a 7.0-liter V-8, the largest engine to ever grace a Mustang. While officially rated at <375ps>, its true output was said to be closer to <600ps>. And the car's signature hood scoop came only on the Boss 429.

long.zh:
每一代的福特Mustang都会推出高性能的跑车款。而在其悠久的历史中，还有专门为了赛车运动而设计的型号。

其中最为人所熟知的一款赛车就出自品牌的第一代，准确说就是GT350。这款车由Shelby美国专门为了美国赛车俱乐部赛事而打造，创下了辉煌的赛车运动生涯记录，并因此举世闻名。

除此之外，仅在1969至1970年间生产的Boss系列也具有相当的历史价值。Boss 429这款车是为了符合纳斯卡赛车赛事认证规则中的引擎生产数量要求而推出的产品，并被许多车迷评价为是Mustang历史上最伟大的车款。

其7升V8 429引擎是Mustang使用过的全部引擎中排量最大的一款。其官方标称功率为<375ps>，不过有鉴于当时公布的赛车引擎功率通常都会比实际情况要低得多，坊间传闻说这款引擎的实际输出功率基本达到了<600ps>上下。

其标志性的超大型引擎盖进气口也仅在Boss429上可以得见。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 2014, marking the 50th anniversary of the Mustang’s debut and amid unprecedented global demand, Ford unveiled the sixth-generation model after an intensive development effort. This new iteration featured more aggressive styling and introduced 4-wheel independent suspension for the first time in the car’s lineage. Among many variants in the lineup, it is the Mustang GT that captures the hearts of true enthusiasts, thanks to its iconic V-8 powerplant.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 在经过漫长而艰巨的开发周期之后，2014年，Ford推出了第六代Ford Mustang。这款经典车型不仅迎来了50周年纪念，在全球市场上的销量也攀至顶峰。这辆车采用了更具侵略性的外观风格，还配备了一套四轮独立悬挂系统。这一代的产品谱系中包含了多个版本，而采用了标志性V8引擎的Mustang GT是最受关注的一款。
officialDetails.heroEn: The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.
officialDetails.heroZh: 在该车型50周年亮相的第6代Mustang，这款备受期待的产品在全球120个国家销售。

in the model's evolutionary process.

suspension system.

Base models were equipped with a peppy turbocharged

的扭矩。

catch.en: The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.

vehicleCollection.en:
The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.

America’s premier pony car celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2014, and Ford celebrated this occasion by introducing the all-new sixth-generation model. Unlike previous versions of the Mustang that were only available in limited markets, Ford decided to share the wealth and marketed the new car to more than 120 countries.

The designers at Dearborn took extreme care in styling the new Mustang, making it appear more aggressive than any model before it, but making sure that it would still be instantly recognizable as a Mustang upon first glance. The engineers took the same tack, giving the car a great balance of efficiency and power. They brought back the inline-4 of Mustangs past, but after bolting on a turbocharger, the base 2.3-liter engine pumped out a hearty <314ps>/<32.6kgm> to the delight of sports car fans worldwide. However, the star of the show was the thundering Mustang GT's 5.0-liter V-8, which people expected from a powerful American muscle car. It didn’t disappoint, delivering a whopping <441ps>/<40.8kgm>, making it among the most powerful Mustangs ever.

The new pony car also featured a fine-tuned fully independent suspension system (previous models came with a rear beam axle). It was clear to see from this rebirth of the modern-day pony car that the Mustang was no longer only an American icon, but an international one.

long.en:
America’s premier pony car celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2014, and Ford celebrated this occasion by introducing the all-new sixth-generation model. Unlike previous versions of the Mustang that were only available in limited markets, Ford decided to share the wealth and marketed the new car to more than 120 countries.

The designers at Dearborn took extreme care in styling the new Mustang, making it appear more aggressive than any model before it, but making sure that it would still be instantly recognizable as a Mustang upon first glance. The engineers took the same tack, giving the car a great balance of efficiency and power. They brought back the inline-4 of Mustangs past, but after bolting on a turbocharger, the base 2.3-liter engine pumped out a hearty <314ps>/<32.6kgm> to the delight of sports car fans worldwide. However, the star of the show was the thundering Mustang GT's 5.0-liter V-8, which people expected from a powerful American muscle car. It didn’t disappoint, delivering a whopping <441ps>/<40.8kgm>, making it among the most powerful Mustangs ever.

The new pony car also featured a fine-tuned fully independent suspension system (previous models came with a rear beam axle). It was clear to see from this rebirth of the modern-day pony car that the Mustang was no longer only an American icon, but an international one.
long.zh:
福特Mustang于2014年改款成为了第六代车型，这一年也是它首次面世的50周年纪念。尽管这台车过去仅仅在美国以及其他有限的几个国家中销售，但它现在已在120个国家/地区的市场中销售。

为了准备好这次扩张，该车型的改造也受到了非常大的重视。

车辆外形经过了大幅改造，比此前任何一款都更有冲击力，但是它著名的前格栅和大灯及其强烈的流线型设计均得以沿用，从而让任何看见它的人都能立刻认出这是一台Mustang。

该车的工学设计也经历了重大的变动。老式的刚性车桥终于被彻底抛弃，所有4个轮子都换上了独立的悬挂系统。

在引擎方面，第二及第三代中出现过的直列式四缸引擎则卷土重来。尽管为了保护环境而选择了此款降档的直喷引擎，它依然是能提供<314ps>功率与<32.6kgm>扭矩的2.3升涡轮增压引擎，并依然在世界各地大受欢迎。

不过，对于该系列的粉丝来说，人们聚焦的依然是Mustang GT，配备其标志性的V8引擎。这台5升的V8引擎能提供<441ps>功率与<40.8kgm>扭矩的动力，无论低速还是高速均能提供稳定的动力来源，但是V8系列的顶配车型还数Mustang GT豪华版。该豪华车型配备了丰富的配套产品，包括语音识别车载导航系统以及Recaro真皮座椅。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This particular version serves as a homologation model of the Mustang Gr.3—a Gran Turismo Original that reimagines Ford’s legendary coupe to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. With its roots in motorsport, the car’s performance has been finely tuned, placing particular emphasis on cornering prowess. A true all-rounder, it excels equally in circuit time attacks and controlled drifting alike.

This road car was designed as a homologated
Ford Mustang Gr.3.

There is absolutely nothing standard about its acceleration
or cornering capabilities.

It's a powerful FR, making it a great choice for anyone

这是一辆性能强大的前置后驱车，也是所有漂移爱好者

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Mustang Gr.3 is a Gran Turismo Original creation, transforming Ford’s legendary Mustang coupe into a machine built to meet Gr.3 race regulations. Its fenders have been dramatically widened to accommodate broader tires, while large rear air outlets were integrated to efficiently channel airflow. This modern muscle car excels through the stability offered by its long wheelbase and boasts an exceptional top speed that’s hard to match.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Mustang Gr.3是为了符合Gr.3组别规则而对传奇跑车Ford Mustang改装而来的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。为了容纳更宽大的轮胎，它的挡泥板得到了外拓，而为了将气流高效地排出，车身后部也相应地添加了大尺寸出气口。这辆肌肉车优点众多，比如它较长的轴距能够提供优秀的稳定性，更不必说它无人可敌的极速性能。
officialDetails.heroEn: The sixth-generation Mustang marked the model’s 50th anniversary and was sold in 120 countries around the world.
officialDetails.heroZh: 诞生于该车型第50周年的第6代Mustang，Ford的这款杰作广销至全球120多个国家。

brandCentral.en:
The sixth-generation Mustang served as the foundation
for this Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car.

One of the Mustang's great attributes was its speed.

That said, its improved handling made it a well-rounded
race car.
brandCentral.zh:
这款原创的跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车采用第六代Mustang
作为其基础车型。

令人难以置信的最高时速是其最突出的优势，

而长轴距则提供了卓越的稳定性。

Built upon the inherently stable platform of the production model, this touring car is an ideal choice for newcomers. Visually, it commands attention with the timeless appeal of classic Ford racing stripes adorning its exterior.

The sixth generation Mustang was the base model used for
this original Gran Turismo Gr.4 racing car.

The peerless stability of the Mustang is retained in
this variant as well.

Naturally, the livery incorporates Ford's traditional
racing stripe.
brandCentral.zh:
第六代Mustang是这款原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车的

理所当然的，车身涂装中也加入了Ford的传统赛车条纹。

vehicleCollection.en:
With more muscle than others in its class, this pony car set a new standard for aggressiveness.

In the postwar era, American cars were widely seen as large and expensive, but that perception shifted dramatically in the early 1960s with the debut of the Ford Mustang in 1964. With its sporty attitude and impressive performance—offered at an affordable price—the Mustang immediately won over the American public. It became a financial triumph for Ford Motor Co., and its popularity only grew in the years that followed.

In 1969, Ford gave the Mustang a major redesign, but it retained its signature long nose and short rear deck. Otherwise, nearly everything else about the car changed so dramatically that many saw it as a completely new machine. The updated Mustang was larger but kept its core structure and layout.

It was during this refresh that the formidable Mach 1 arrived in 1969. Launched as part of the Mustang’s fastback lineup known as the "SportsRoof," its sweeping roofline didn’t just enhance aerodynamics, it inspired sports-car designers around the world.

Ford offered a wide range of engines under the Mustang’s hood, from high-powered big-block V-8s capable of matching race cars in performance to more accessible options. The most common was the small-block 351-cubic-inch V8. In its 1970–1971 Ram Air configuration. It produced an impressive <304ps>, making the 351 Mustang one of the quickest and most thrilling street cars of its time.

战后美国车给人的印象是大而昂贵，但二十世纪六十年代早期，随着1964年福特Mustang的上市，这种潮流发生了剧烈的变化。这款车主打动感的风格和高性能，同时价格又相对低廉，很快受到了美国大众的青睐。原版的Mustang立刻令福特汽车公司赚得盆满钵满，这款车在之后的几年内仍然长盛不衰。

1969年，福特对其小马车进行了重大改款，仅仅保留了标志性的车型特征，即长车头和短车尾。除此之外，其他的一切都进行了改进，事实上，改动如此之大，以至于许多人认为改款后的Mustang是一款全新的汽车。新车款更大，但基本的配置和构成仍然没有变。

这次改款后，“不祥”的Mach 1于1969年登场。这款跑车级汽车属于Mustang名为Sports Roof的溜背车产品线，动感的车顶设计给全世界的跑车制造商带来了启示。

Mustang包含多种引擎版本，包括和许多跑车不相上下的大排量V8引擎，但最常见的是小缸的351-cu.-in.V8引擎。1970至1971年推出的351 Mustang采用冲压空气引擎，马力为<304ps>，是当时合法上路的轿车中最具运动感和速度最快的类型。

Mustang包含多种引擎版本，包括和许多跑车不相上下的大排量V8引擎，但最常见的是小缸的351-cu.-in.V8引擎。1970至1971年推出的351 Mustang采用冲压空气引擎，马力为<304ps>，是当时合法上路的轿车中最具运动感和速度最快的类型。

vehicleCollection.en:
This high-performance model of the seventh-generation Mustang takes its name from a legend.

The roots of the Shelby GT350R date back to 1965, when Ford commissioned Carol Shelby to build a car to compete in the SCCA (Sports Car Club of America). Based on the first-generation Mustang, the GT350R was sold as a road car because the SCCA allowed only minor modifications for its competition cars. Still, the car dominated its class, gaining instant recognition.

Fast forward to 2016, when the Shelby 350R based on the seventh-generation Mustang, made its debut as road car that was race ready, like the original model. Its naturally-aspirated 5.2-liter V-8 was tuned to produce <533ps> and <59.3kgm> and was mated to a 6-speed manual transmission.

The reinforced chassis featured Ford's MagneRide suspension system, which detected road conditions and adjusted damping strength using magnetorheological fluid. Also, to reduce weight, the 2+2 layout of the stock Mustang was converted into that of a two-seater.

The GT350R enjoyed a loyal following and great success, thanks in part to it exclusivity. It was sold as a special model available through a limited number of dealers.

Shelby GT350R的起源可以追溯到1965年，当时的福特委托卡罗尔·谢尔比为参加美国赛车俱乐部的赛车活动而打造一辆赛车。GT350R的开发基于初代Mustang，但由于美国赛车俱乐部的赛事规则只允许最低限度的改装，例如对原厂车进行减重，所以它最终作为一款可以直接参加比赛的公路车上市。这款车在比赛中大放异彩，很快便成就了传奇。

2016款的Shelby 350R基于第7代Mustang开发，同样是一款可以直接开上赛道，享受风驰电掣感觉的公路车。

其5.2升自然进气V8引擎经过调校，可以输出<533ps>和<59.3kgm>扭矩，并搭配了一部6速手动档变速箱。其底盘为了支持引擎的强大性能，也经过了加固处理。悬挂系统方面应用了福特的磁驾系统，可以主动检测路面状况，并使用磁流变液来调整减震器应力强度。除此之外，这款两座车还下了很大功夫来减轻车身重量。

GT350R的销售基于标准型GT350，不过由于接受了各种特殊调校，仅作为特殊车型在少数几家经销商处限量销售。

vehicleCollection.en:
A Cosworth tuned masterpiece that dominated touring car racing.

The Sierra was a relatively standard family car with an aerodynamic hatchback body produced by Ford Europe from 1982.

But in 1985, the impression of car enthusiasts regarding the Sierra took a big turn. This was because the famed Cosworth added the Sierra RS Cosworth to the selection, known affectionately as the "Cossie" among enthusiasts. The Sierra RS Cosworth was powered by a 2.0-liter inline 4 tuned to <206ps> with DOHC and a turbocharger. The chassis was reinforced, and the exterior was upgraded with fender extensions and a large rear spoiler.

A year later, power was further increased to <227ps>, and a 500-unit limited Sierra RS 500 Cosworth was added to the lineup, with an engine reinforced for race use and better aerodynamic details.

And, of course, all of these improvements were developed for touring car racing. From 1988 to 1990, the Sierra won a number of series championship titles in the international Group A category in countries such as Germany, UK, Australia, Japan and New Zealand.

Sierra是一款具有空气动力学掀背式车身、相对标准的家庭用车，由福特欧洲公司从1982年开始生产。

1985年，汽车爱好者对Sierra的印象发生了很大转变。这是因为著名的考斯沃斯公司将Sierra RS Cosworth加入了阵容，车迷亲切地将它称作“Cossie”。Sierra RS Cosworth由一台2升的直列4缸发动机驱动，并采用双顶置凸轮轴和涡轮增压器，令马力提升至<206ps>。底盘得到了加强，而外部也装上了挡泥板和大号后扰流板。

一年后，它的马力被进一步提升至<227ps>，只生产500台的限量版Sierra RS 500 Cosworth也加入了阵容，这个版本拥有经过强化的赛事专用发动机，以及更好的空气动力学设计。

这所有的改进自然是为了房车赛而开发。从1988年到1990年，Sierra在德国、英国、澳大利亚、日本和新西兰等国家的国际A组别赛事中赢得了许多系列赛冠军头衔。

conversation.en:
The Fugu Z is a very fine car indeed.

I especially like the intentionally spartan interior, which
uses few added parts for nearly double the power.

The original 240Z was simple, with beautiful proportions,
and this car has respected that.

Take the original fender mirrors—they're in the
original Kilimanjaro White colour.

It’s as if a young Californian came upon a Z
that was a bit rough around the edges...

And polished it with the admiration he had
for the car of his memories.

Now the raw spirit of the 1973 Z shines brightly
in the Fugu Z.

Thank you, Sung Kang!

vehicleCollection.en:
This "poisonous" 240Z, which won the 2015 GT Award, packed a naturally-aspirated RB26 engine.

The big winner of the 2015 Gran Turismo Awards at SEMA was this S30 Datsun Z, nicknamed the “Fugu Z.” The car was built by actor Sung Kang, known for his role in "The Fast and the Furious” movie franchise. When he purchased the car, it was a stock 1973 240Z, but it soon became something quite different and very special.

The "Rocket Bunny" body kit gives the reborn Z aggressive good looks, consisting of wide fender flares and stylish front and rear spoilers. Not just for show, the car comes equipped with a naturally-aspirated version of the RB26DETT engine, pulled from a Skyline GT-R. Thanks to some fine tuning, the inline-6 produces <220ps>, but feed it E85 IndyCar fuel, and that total jumps to more than <300ps>.

To handle this newfound power, a roll cage was installed to strengthen the body. Weight-saving measures were implemented to the car's dashboard and console, which were custom made by CarbonSignal.

The name of the car, “Fugu,” refers to the Japanese poisonous blow fish. Its organs are so toxic that anyone not taking proper precautions when handling the fish may die... and, we suppose, the same can be said about this car.

When he purchased the car, it was a stock 1973 240Z, but it soon became something quite different and very special.

The "Rocket Bunny" body kit gives the reborn Z aggressive good looks, consisting of wide fender flares and stylish front and rear spoilers. Not just for show, the car comes equipped with a naturally-aspirated version of the RB26DETT engine, pulled from a Skyline GT-R. Thanks to some fine tuning, the inline-6 produces <220ps>, but feed it E85 IndyCar fuel, and that total jumps to more than <300ps>.

To handle this newfound power, a roll cage was installed to strengthen the body. Weight-saving measures were implemented to the car's dashboard and console, which were custom made by CarbonSignal.

The name of the car, “Fugu,” refers to the Japanese poisonous blow fish. Its organs are so toxic that anyone not taking proper precautions when handling the fish may die... and, we suppose, the same can be said about this car.
long.zh:
在2015年美国汽车用品改装车展览会上，跑车浪漫旅大奖的获胜者是一辆S30 Datsun Z，昵称为“Fugu Z”。这辆车是由《速度与激情》系列电影中的知名演员姜成镐一手打造。这辆车的原型是他以原厂状态购入的一辆1973年款240Z，并按照他指定的规格进行了定制改装。

外观方面最引入注目的特征自然是一套包含超宽挡泥板和前后扰流板的“火箭兔”宽体套件。当然了，这款车并不只有外表。它的内在核心是一台久负盛名的Skyline GT-R RB26DETT引擎，改成自然进气后通过机械调校将动力提高到了<220ps>。当使用E85印地赛车燃油时，这台引擎可以输出约<300ps>。

为了承受庞大的动力，车身内部不得不焊接上防滚架。而为了减轻车身重量，这辆车的仪表板和控制面板都由CarbonSignal进行了定制。

这辆车的名字“Fugu”在日语里是河豚的意思。这种鱼毒性极强，如果不经过妥善处理就食用的话，可能会致死。对于这台车来说，也是如此。

vehicleCollection.en:
This concept car for the virtual world was developed in collaboration with Citroën.

The GT by Citroën announced at the 2008 Paris Motor Show was the first sports concept car created from a collaboration between Citroën and Gran Turismo. This approach succeeded in establishing an image of a new concept car that does not just end at the show floor. This is because a 21st century sports car imagined by Citroën is accurately expressed in both real and virtual forms.

Based on the GT by Citroën, the GT by Citroën Gr.4 is a race spec car modified for racing in the Gr.4 category.

To meet the Gr.4 regulations in which the range of modifications is limited, the exterior changes are minimal. However, because the original car is already very unique, its sense of presence is overwhelming. The armor-like front and rear fenders and the sharp visage of the fascia that remind the viewer of a medieval Japanese warrior’s mask, are maintained in this model.

The unique aspect of this car is that the modifications to make it a Gr.4 car were performed by none other than Takumi Yamamoto himself, who created the original design for the base car. The 6 variations of the livery and newly added rear wing express the intent of Yamamoto. The addition of required racing equipment such as hood pins, towing hooks, and air jack valves give the car the look of a serious circuit fighting machine.

The interior has also been modified for weight reduction, and the steering wheel and HUD are made in a functional design befitting of a race car. The dashboard material has been changed from copper to carbon, and the HUD displays speed, engine RPM, steering angle, and horizontal Gs to assist the assessment of the car’s state by the drivers on the track.

With its avant-garde styling and performance of a competition machine, the GT by Citroën Gr.4 is a groundbreaking combination of these aspects.

在2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙 GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。雪铁龙创想的这种同时以真实与虚拟形式表现21世纪跑车的方法，成功地树立了一个并不仅仅止步于展台的新概念赛车形象。

GT by 雪铁龙组别4是一款以雪铁龙 GT为原型的专用赛车，为参与组别4比赛而进行了改装。

为满足组别4对改装范围的限制，外观改变被限制在了最小程度。然而由于原车本身就已经非常独特，它依旧拥有压倒性的存在感。这一车型拥有盔甲般的正面和后挡板以及外观刚毅的前脸，令人联想到中世纪的日本武士面具。

这款车型的独特之处在于，其改装由原型车的设计者山本卓一亲自操刀。六种不同的涂装和新增的后翼充分表达了山本设计师的意图。此外，由于添加了引擎盖和拖钩以及气阀这样的必需赛车设备，该车型看上去如同一名严肃的赛道杀手。

为减轻重量，该车型的内饰同样进行了改装。方向盘和抬头显示都进行了适用于赛车的功能性设计。仪表盘的材料从铜变更为碳。抬头显示能够显示速度、发动机转速、转向角度和横向重力加速度，以帮助赛道上的车手对赛车状态进行评估。

GT by 雪铁龙组别4将前卫的外观和竞速赛车的出色性能突破性地结合在了一起。

vehicleCollection.en:
This concept car for the virtual world was developed in collaboration with Citroën.

The GT by Citroën announced at the 2008 Paris Motor Show, is a sports concept car in which Citroën and Gran Turismo collaborated for the first time.

The car attracted much attention as a new type of concept car, an expression of real and virtual. And it was in the spring of 2009, that a decision was made to run a racing spec version of this machine in the world of GT.

The exterior was designed by Takumi Yamamoto, the designer who created the original. Many sketches were sent to Polyphony Digital (PDI) day after day, and as a result, the original fenders were widened, and with the addition of air ducts and other aerodynamic parts, the design took an extremely aggressive turn.

Based on this, the details to make it more racing-car like was left to PDI. Details like the hood pins and tow hooks you would normally see on race cars, the valves for the air jacks, and the layout of sponsor stickers, were all set by PDI.

The other major piece of work left to PDI was the design of the interior. The motif was a modern jet fighter, and while being extremely high tech, it is balanced with the gritty feel of a real racing car.

All parts aside from the dashboard have been replaced, and the steering wheel and HUD (heads-up display) are functional in design as befitting a racing car, while still being as eccentric as the exterior. Though not changed in design, the dashboard is made of carbon, instead of copper.

The HUD displays things like speed, engine rpm, steering angle, and horizontal Gs.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
在2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。

作为融合真实和虚拟世界的新型概念赛车，这一车型吸引了各界的关注。并于2009年春季决定在GT的数字世界中制作该车型的赛车车型。

外观设计依旧由原型设计师山本卓一操刀。日复一日，无数的草图被送往Polyphony Digital。结果，原有的翼片被拓宽，并增加了空气导管和其他空气动力组件，使得该车的外观设计变得极具攻击性。

适应赛车比赛需要的细节问题交由Polyphony Digital处理。像是引擎盖和拖钩这样的细节和赛车上常见的东西——比如气阀及赞助商标签的布局等设计工作都由Polyphony Digital设计师来完成。

其余由Polyphony Digital负责的工作主要是内饰设计。车内环境和整体感觉令人联想到现代的喷气式战斗机，既有着极致的高科技感，也与真实赛车的质感进行了平衡。

除仪表盘外所有的部件都进行了更换。尽管在设计上并无改动，仪表盘的材料由铜换成了碳。方向盘和抬头显示在功能设计上更适合赛车，同时保有和外观同样的风格。抬头显示能够显示速度、发动机转速、转向角度和横向重力加速度。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

The GT Concept Car by Citroën has a very intriguing design.

Its center fuselage disappears behind
its very bold fender shapes.

This gives the car a sleek and aggressive look and helps
to manage air flow and cooling in a unique way.

The windshield and side glass are like slits, giving the
GT by Citroën a very private, sinister look.

dialogues.zh:

vehicleCollection.en:
From dream to reality, the supercar concept developed by Citroën and Gran Turismo becomes a V8-powered mid-engine sports car.

The GT by Citroën was a concept car created through a collaboration between Citroën and Gran Turismo. It was the hit of the 2008 Paris Motor Show, with many impressed by its avant-garde styling, penned by Citroën designer Takumi Yamamoto.

This super sports car came to life after numerous travels between Japan and France. It went from a show model to a running model, which we called the GT by Citroën Road Car. The major difference between the show car and road car was the former was an electric vehicle with a high-power motor, while the latter came powered by a mid-mounted V-8 engine.

The elegant exterior of the car was largely left intact. The slits between the rounded inner body and outer cowling effectively dissipate heat from the engine, keeping it cool.

Also, the replacement of the heavy, high-capacity drive battery with a smaller gasoline tank made the car much lighter.

A sturdy rear cowl completely covered the engine bay, but it provided extra rigidity, which made the GT by Citroën an awesome handling machine. ~

2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。在2008年巴黎车展上公布后，该车立刻吸引了各界关注。由雪铁龙设计师山本卓一设计的前卫外观更是大受好评。

这台超级跑车在制作中几经波折，在日本和法国之间往返数次。此次在跑车浪漫旅进行复刻，并将其由展览车型改为公路车型，算是彻底完成了这台雪铁龙GT公路赛车。最大的不同之处是概念赛车采用了大功率电机设计，而在公路赛车款式中则改为使用中置V8引擎的跑车式配置。

如同盔甲般的外形几乎未进行改动，而车体内的圆弧形线条和直线式的整流罩搭配所形成的沟槽，还具有引入空气以便进行冷却与散热的功能。该车在设计上就考虑到了加装高马力大排量引擎的可能性。

不仅如此，装载在概念赛车中的大容量驱动电池被移除，改为容量小得多的小型油箱，以便大幅减轻重量。

这种引擎室被后罩完全遮蔽的做法简单地确保了车身后半部的刚性，打造出超级跑车的操驾感。

vehicleCollection.en:
A time attack Civic customized in the classic JDM style.

The overwhelming popularity of Japanese performance cars on the international circuit led to the creation of the JDM (Japanese Domestic Market) category. Among these machines was a Honda Civic, a JDM-inspired creation that took home the Gran Turismo Award in 2017—an accolade bestowed upon the best custom vehicles at the SEMA Show.

In 2006, Philip Robles acquired a largely unmodified 1992 EG Civic, and together with his son Jesse, transformed it into a formidable track machine. Their goal was to compete in Time Attack and Time Trial events across circuits in the American Southwest. Over the course of a decade, marked by countless weekends at the track, their Civic secured multiple championships in both disciplines. In 2017, Robles was invited to showcase his creation at SEMA, under the banner of Mackin Industries, a leading importer of tuning parts. In preparation for the event, the Civic underwent an extensive aesthetic transformation for the show.

The most striking visual enhancement was the aggressive wide-body kit from Japanese aero specialists PANDEM, complemented by a front splitter and a rear wing. Adding even more pop to the car's appearance was a carbon-fiber hood, inspired by a signature design from J’s Racing of Japan. Inside, the cockpit was stripped to its bare essentials—only a full roll cage and a single racing bucket seat remained.

The original engine was replaced with a Honda K24 inline-4 powerplant. When the car appeared at SEMA in 2017, the engine was still naturally aspirated. However, in pursuit of greater performance, it was later turbocharged, unleashing a significant increase in power. It came mated to a Quaife 5-speed sequential gearbox, purpose-built for Honda's revered K-series engines.

High-capacity brake systems with Brembo calipers were installed at both front and rear. Also, the suspensions system was enhanced to circuit-tuned specs to further sharpen its handling characteristics.

long.zh:
日本高性能跑车在各大国际赛道上一炮走红后，“JDM”（日本国内市场）这一类别也应运而生。这辆JDM风格的改装版本田思域在2017年一举拿下了当年的Gran Turismo大奖，这一奖项专门颁发给美国改装车协会车展上的最佳改装车辆。

在2006年，飞利浦·罗伯斯购买了这辆保持出厂状态，接近全新的1992年“EG”思域，随后便与儿子杰西一起开始改装他们的爱车。父子二人的目标是开着这台座驾在西南地区的赛道上参加地区计时赛和计时挑战赛。连续10年驰骋在周末比赛的赛道上，他们夺得了多个计时赛和计时挑战赛冠军。2017年，飞利浦受邀出席美国汽车用品改装车展览会，在美国改装零部件进口商Mackin Industries的展位上展示这台思域。为了这次车展，他们进一步改装和翻新了这台车。

这台车上最显眼的改装便是来自日本空气动力学品牌“PANDEM”的宽体套件，以及前扰流器和尾翼。另一个引人注目的改动则是大胆换用了碳纤维引擎盖，后者的灵感来源于日本改装车厂“J's Racing”的作品。这辆车的内饰已被拆得一干二净，仅保留了一个桶椅，同时加装了防滚架以提供额外的稳固性。

原厂引擎被换成了一台本田K24直列四缸引擎。这辆车在2017年美国改装车协会车展亮相时，引擎还是自然进气设计，但在之后的大量改装过程中加装了能够极大提升引擎功率的涡轮增压器。该车搭载了一台由Quaife专为K系列引擎而设计的5速序列变速箱。

原本的前后刹车则升级成带布雷博卡钳的高性能制动系统。当然，悬挂系统也被升级为了赛道专用扈本。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 2017, the Genesis G70 sports sedan marked the brand’s entry-level offering. It came with three powertrain options: a 3.3-liter twin-turbo V-6 producing 364.9 HP, a turbocharged 2.0-liter gasoline, and a 2.2-liter turbodiesel. A major facelift followed in 2020, incorporating design cues from Genesis’ flagship models. In 2021, a shooting brake variant—offered exclusively in Europe—further elevated the G70’s appeal.

vehicleCollection.en:
An AWD Genesis sports sedan powered by a potent twin-turbo V-6.

The G70 is a sports sedan developed as part of Hyundai's high-performance Genesis brand. A standard D-segment vehicle, it was released in 2017 and intended as an entry-level model.

Despite sharing most of its features, including the platform, with the KIA Stinger (KIA are also part of the Hyundai group), the G70 was designed from the ground up as a luxury sedan.

Three engines were made available for the G70: a twin-turbocharged 3.3-liter V-6, a turbocharged 2.0-liter gasoline turbo, and a 2.2-liter diesel turbo. The twin-turbo V-6 was capable of <370ps>. Like the other cars in the Genesis lineup, rear-wheel drive and AWD versions of the G70 were offered.

The G70's styling was an instant hit, widely praised for its elegant outline. In 2020, however, the car underwent a major redesign, intended to make it more similar to the luxurious G90 and G80. As a result, the G70 looked more polished and even more striking.

In 2021, a shooting brake model, based on the sedan was produced for the European market. Its stunning style made it an instant hit.

G70是一款运动型轿车，作为现代的高性能品牌捷尼赛思旗下的车型而开发。这是一款标准的D级车。它于2017年首次发布，定位为入门级的捷尼赛思车型。

尽管与起亚斯汀格（起亚也是现代集团的一部分）共享了包括平台在内的大部分功能，但G70从一开始就是按照豪华轿车的标准设计的。

G70有三种引擎可选：3.3升V6双涡轮增压引擎、2升汽油涡轮增压引擎和2.2升柴油涡轮增压引擎。其中V6双涡轮增压发动机能够输出<370ps>的动力。与捷尼赛思产品线的其他车型一样，G70会同时生产后轮驱动和全轮驱动版本。

G70的造型一经问世，就因其优雅的车身轮廓而广受赞誉。然而，在2020年，该车又经历了一次重大的改款设计，目的是让造型与同为豪华车型的G90和G80更加相似。改款之后，G70显得愈发耀眼、引人注目了。

2021年，捷尼赛思在轿车的基础上向欧洲市场推出了猎装车型，其令人惊叹的外观风格使之立即成为热门车款。

vehicleCollection.en:
A Gr.3 machine that combines luxury with competition performance.

In April 2021, Hyundai's new premium brand, Genesis, unveiled its Genesis X concept, the brand's interpretation of how GT cars could look in the future.

The front fascia features the shield-shaped crest grille that has become the brand's signature design element. Two lines stretch from the grille to past the front wheel arches and reappear again at the rear of the car to form the taillights. This new-generation example of car styling is part of Genesis calls its "Athletic Elegance" design language.

This car was more than a concept, as Genesis also created a racing edition for Gran Turismo that was inspired by the Genesis X. The Genesis X Gr.3 is a serious Gr.3-spec machine designed to compete in Gran Turismo's fierce championship competition.

The X concept was originally designed as an electric vehicle, but the Genesis X Gr.3 is equipped with a conventional gasoline engine. Thanks in part to forced induction, it produces <550ps>. To house the race car's larger tires, the body was widened to <1992mm>, while aerodynamic improvements were added to the underside. Also, a larger rear wing helps make this machine look race-ready.

A combination of luxury and performance, the Genesis X Gr.3 is a radical new type of Gr.3 machine, the likes of which have never been seen before.

long.zh:
2021年4月，现代的高端品牌捷尼赛思发布了捷尼赛思X concept，作为对近未来GT跑车形态的探索。

前脸采用了已经品牌家族化设计的盾形徽章格栅，两侧伸出的两条线勾勒出头灯，并延伸过前轮拱，然后在车尾再次出现，构成尾灯的轮廓。新一代的外观设计风格是对捷尼赛思的“运动优雅”设计语言的创新诠释。

不过，这款概念赛车型的使命并未就此止步。捷尼赛思还为跑车浪漫旅专门设计了一款赛道版，它采用了捷尼赛思X的相同概念和设计精髓。捷尼赛思X组别3是一款顶级的组别3规格赛道机器，专为在激烈的锦标赛中杀出重围而生。

虽然捷尼赛思X concept最初被设计为电动车，但这台捷尼赛思X组别3依然采用传统的内燃机提供动力。加装增压装置以后，最大输出功率可达<550ps>。为了适配加宽后的轮胎，车体也相应加宽至<1992mm>，同时在车底、车尾都安装了空气动力学优化部件。尾部的大型扰流板使得整辆赛车气势非凡。

捷尼赛思X组别3是奢华气质与竞赛级性能的结合，也是组别3组别前所未见的新生代竞争者。

vehicleCollection.en:
A sports coupe that embodies the athletic elegance sought by Genesis.

The Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept embodied Genesis’ “Athletic Elegance” design philosophy. The design combined cab-rearward proportions with the brand’s signature anti-wedge stance, structured around a virtual parabolic tension theory seen across the Genesis lineup.

Its form was both pure and muscular, with volumes centered around the wheels. It introduced a new front fascia that abstracted the crest grille and integrated it with the quad lights, while the brand’s signature two-line lighting motif visually connected the car from front to rear. The fuselage extended rearward into an elliptical concave volume, a theme shared with other Genesis models. It was framed by a rear spoiler and lateral trailing edges to enhance high-speed stability.

The interior followed Genesis’ “Beauty of White Space” philosophy, creating a minimalist, driver-focused environment. Essential functions were prioritized to support track performance. A digital panoramic interface served as the central information hub, linked to a surround digital monitoring system. Steer-by-wire controls enabled precise inputs. The quilted, padded bolsters provided protection for the driver during high-speed driving and facilitated quicker ingress and egress during pitstops.

Aerodynamically, the X Gran Berlinetta Concept achieved notable efficiency. It boasted a drag coefficient of 0.34 through the integration of active aerodynamic elements and carefully managed airflow.

The powertrain featured a front-mid-mounted Lambda II V6 engine, supported by Genesis E-SC hybrid technology. The hybrid race-spec system delivered a total output of 1,071 HP and 986 lb.-ft. of torque. The V-6 produced 870 HP and 790 lb.-ft. of torque, revving to <10000rpm>, while the Yasa E-SC motor contributed an additional 201 HP and 196 lb.-ft. of torque.

long.zh:
捷尼赛思X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept在其设计中以充沛的热情融入捷尼赛思的“运动优雅”设计哲学。概念车沿袭了整个捷尼赛思产品线中普遍运用的虚拟抛物线理论，打造捷尼赛思代表性的反楔形姿态，配合驾驶舱后移的设计，形成精致的车身比例。

X Gran Berlinetta Concept的设计语言讲求纯粹和力量感，主要车体围绕轮毂构建。这款车还展现了捷尼赛思的全新前脸风格，对盾徽形格栅进行了抽象化设计，顺滑地过渡到两侧的四盏条状大灯，并以品牌标志性的双“抛物线”线条元素将前后体量进行有机衔接，共同构成统一的整体。车身沿椭圆形凹面结构从前向后收拢，这一造型在其他捷尼赛思车型上也非常常见。车尾的后扰流板和多处侧面后缘加入封闭包边，以提升高速下的空气动力学稳定性。

其内饰设计衍生自捷尼赛思的“留白之美”理念，为驾驶者打造出最简练及纯粹的环境。——所有核心功能都得到了优先凸显，以便车手专注于提升赛道表现。其数字全景界面连接到车身四周的数字监控系统，起到了信息集成的作用；而其线控转向控制命令系统也有助于让驾驶者获得更精确的操纵。装有衬垫的支撑座椅可在赛道上以及在快速进出维修站时为车手提供有效保护。

X Gran Berlinetta Concept拥有引人瞩目的空气动力学流畅外形。设计师们整合了多种空气动力学辅助部件，并巧妙地协调了车内气流和外部层流，实现了低至0.34的阻力系数。

X Gran Berlinetta Concept由一部前中置Lambda II V6引擎提供动力，并以捷尼赛思E-SC技朮进行电子龅动。其比赛级的混动传动系统䏯以输出高达1071 HP（1070 CIP（和986 ft-lb（<136.3kgm>）的扭矩，确保这辆车内外儼修，秀外慧中。这款V6引擎最高转速可迾<10000rpm>，能够输出眀大870 HP (870 BHP(的䊨劚和790 ft-lbｈ<009.2kgm>）的扬矨．而E-SC畵机肽餟额外仧攟201 HP (201 CHP(的动力和196 ft-mb（<27kkn>ﲉ的扭矩。

vehicleCollection.en:
The racing version of the Gran Berlinetta adorned with aerodynamic parts.

The Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept is the most emotional expression of Athletic Elegance in the Genesis portfolio.

It is a racing derivative of the Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept, with increased downforce achieved by the effective wings, active aerodynamic flaps, flat floor, front and rear diffusors, canards and gurneys. While the drag coefficient increases according to wing configurations, the increased downforce allows better lap times.

The X Gran Racer Concept is powered by a front mid-mounted race-spec Lambda II V-6 engine, electrically assisted by Genesis E-SC technology. The hybrid race-spec drivetrain delivers a combined 1,540 HP and 1,015 ft-lb. of torque. The V-6 redlines at <10000rpm> while delivering a maximum output of 870 HP and 790 ft-lb. of torque while the front E motor generates an additional 670 HP and 225 ft-lb. of torque.

long.zh:
捷尼赛思X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept是捷尼赛思产品阵容里对“运动优雅”设计理念最感情充沛的表达。

作为捷尼赛思X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept的赛车衍生款，通过增加令人过目不忘的前后翼、主动式空气动力学襟翼、平板底盘、前后扩散器、前翼和格尼襟翼，有效地增加了车辆下压力。还可根据不同的扰流翼配置来提高阻力系数，从而增加其下压力以大幅提升圈速。

X Gran Racer Concept由一部前中置比赛级拉姆达II V6引擎提供动力，并以捷尼赛思E-SC技术进行电子辅助。比赛级的混动传动系统可以输出高达1540马力（<1561ps>）的动力和1015英尺-磅（<140.3kgm>）的扭矩。这款V6引擎最高转速可达<10000rpm>，能够输出最大870马力（<882ps>）的动力和790英尺-磅（<109.2kgm>）的扭矩，而前置电机能够额外产生670马力（<679ps>）的动力和225英尺-磅（<31kgm>）的扭矩。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Gran Turismo F1500T-A was a modern tribute to the mid-1980s era of Formula 1, widely regarded as the golden age of F1 design. Its carbon-fiber chassis measured 166.7 inches in length, 84.5 inches in width, with a wheelbase of 107.0 inches. Power came from a turbocharged 1.5-liter V-6, a hallmark of 1980s F1, producing a staggering 986.2 HP at 11,000 rpm.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Gran Turismo F1500T-A是对20世纪80年代中期F1赛车设计的现代诠释，该时期常被称为F1造型的黄金时期。碳纤维制成的底盘长4,235毫米，宽2,146毫米，轴距为2,718毫米。来自20世纪80年代F1赛车经典的1.5升V6引擎在11000转/分时可输出1,000 PS。
officialDetails.heroEn: This original formula car adopted the spirit and performance of the mid-1980s Formula 1 race cars.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一款原创方程式汽车，重现了80年代中期一级方程式赛车的性能。

brandCentral.en:
There's nothing quite like a 1980s Formula 1 car.

They were stylish, powerful and downright raw, with
gobs of power and incredible sound.

Gran Turismo thought of bringing back the mystique
of that golden era with this car.

Powering this machine is a turbocharged 1.6-liter V-6
that recalls the classic engines of the day.

And it packs some serious Formula 1 heat, too.
How's <1000ps> at <11000rpm>?

If you want to feel a pure Formula 1 race car,
give this one a try.
brandCentral.zh:
俗话说，英雄所见略同……

如果您对外观设计略有心得，您一定也同意80年代的一
级方程式赛车是最美的！

这辆车就是跑车浪漫旅尝试将那个黄金年代再现的
产物。

它使用一台1.6L V6涡轮增压引擎，能让您再次体验到那个
时代的经典动力。

这款F1赛车能够输出非常强大的动力，在<11000rpm>的转速时能
够输出<1000ps>马力。

在我看来，没有一款车比它更值得推荐了。

catch.en: This original formula car adopted the spirit and performance of the mid-1980s Formula 1 race cars.
catch.zh: 一款原创方程式汽车，重现了80年代中期一级方程式赛车的性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
This original formula car adopted the spirit and performance of the mid-1980s Formula 1 race cars.

F1 machines in the mid-80’s were characterized by a compact V6 turbo engine and their stoic, well cut appearance. The Gran Turismo F1500T-A is a machine that brings back the style still considered to be the best form in F1 history, with its own unique interpretation.

While maintaining the basic concepts from 30 years ago with a slightly forward cockpit and a simple aerodynamic package, this car also incorporates the performance of a front line formula racing machine.

The carbon fiber chassis is <4235mm> long, <2146mm> wide, and has a wheel base of <2718mm>. The 1.5 liter turbocharged V6 is symbolic of F1 engines from the 1980’s, and produces approximately <1000ps> at <11000rpm>.

The aerodynamic design of the wings and other components also follow the trends from the 80's, but as a result of increased cooling performance of the turbocharger and the engine, the opening of the air outlets on the side pontoons were minimized, improving the aerodynamics on the body sides.

Formula cars are a different type of beast compared to touring cars. Get a taste for Formula level performance with this machine.

long.en:

While maintaining the basic concepts from 30 years ago with a slightly forward cockpit and a simple aerodynamic package, this car also incorporates the performance of a front line formula racing machine.

The carbon fiber chassis is <4235mm> long, <2146mm> wide, and has a wheel base of <2718mm>. The 1.5 liter turbocharged V6 is symbolic of F1 engines from the 1980’s, and produces approximately <1000ps> at <11000rpm>.

The aerodynamic design of the wings and other components also follow the trends from the 80's, but as a result of increased cooling performance of the turbocharger and the engine, the opening of the air outlets on the side pontoons were minimized, improving the aerodynamics on the body sides.

long.zh:
80年代中期的F1赛车给人留下的最突出印象，是紧凑的V6涡轮增压引擎，以及线条简练的造型。跑车浪漫旅F1500T-A正是一款力求还原这种普遍被认为是F1史上最棒造型的车辆，并有着自己对这一风格独特的解读。

这款车保持了30年前方程式赛车的基本概念，即略微前置的驾驶舱和简练的空气动力学造型，同时还具备了前沿的方程式赛车的性能。

由碳纤维打造的车身长<4235mm>，宽<2146mm>，轴距为<2718mm>。1.5升涡轮增压V6引擎是1980年代F1赛车的标志性配置，在<11000rpm>时可输出约<1000ps>的动力。

前翼、尾翼和其他部件的空气动力学设计同样遵循了80年代的风潮，不过因为涡轮增压器和引擎如今更优秀的散热性能，侧箱的进气口得到了最大程度的缩减，从而改善了两侧的空气动力学效应。

方程式赛车和旅行房车相比，是完全不同级别的体验，通过这款车型来感受一下方程式级别的性能吧。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The F3500-A, a Gran Turismo original, was born from a deep admiration for early 1990s Formula 1 machines. It was built around a carbon-fiber chassis and equipped with pushrod suspension. Its naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12 screamed to 15,000 rpm and was paired with a 6-speed semiautomatic transmission. Formula cars continue to evolve. The F3500-A stands as a benchmark—an idealized representation of just how far performance and design had advanced during that era.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: F3500-A是一款跑车浪漫旅原创的方程式赛车，源自团队对上世纪90年代初F1赛车的深切景仰和致敬。车辆采用碳纤维底盘与推杆悬挂。3.5升自然进气V12引擎能够达到15,000 转每分的转速，搭配6速半自动变速箱。方程式赛车始终在不断进化。F3500-A完全可以被视为衡量方程式赛车发展的标杆。
officialDetails.heroEn: An original formula car created in the image of classic F1 cars.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一款以经典F1赛车为灵感打造的原创方程式赛车。

brandCentral.en:
F1 machines of the early 1990s were technologically simple
yet remarkably elegant.

Gran Turismo’s very own formula machine, the F3500-A
was born from a deep admiration of this bygone era.

Like actual F1 race cars of the time, the chassis
is made from negative molded carbon fiber.

The car's naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12, with pneumatic
valves, is capable of reaching up to 15,000 revs.

It's got a 6-speed semi-automatic gearbox with paddle shifters
and a pushrod suspension, jus like the classic cars of yesteryear.

The body features a distinctive high-nose design, with front wings
from the nose rather than being underslung.

Proving there's no end to the evolution of F1 machines,
the F3500-A serves as a benchmark for whatis possible.
brandCentral.zh:
1990年代初的F1赛车虽然技术上相对简单，却是
极具优雅和艺术感的经典之作。

Gran Turismo中的F3500-A
脱胎于团队对这一时代赛车的深切景仰和致敬。

它模仿了当时的F1赛车，采用负压模成型的碳纤维材料
打造车架。

搭载一台使用气动气门的3.5L自然进气V12引擎，
最高转速可达15000转。

与换档拨片结合的是一款6速半自动变速箱，
悬挂方面采用了当时的经典推杆式悬挂系统。

单体车壳采用高鼻设计，前鼻翼并非下悬挂式，
而是直接与鼻锥相连，向两侧展开。

F3500-A可以视作是这一领域发展的模板，
展现了F1赛车不断进化的可能性。

catch.en: An original formula car created in the image of classic F1 cars.
catch.zh: 一款以经典F1赛车为灵感打造的原创方程式赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
An original formula car created in the image of classic F1 cars.

The F3500-A is a Gran Turismo original formula car inspired by a profound admiration for early 1990s F1 machines.

Its chassis was crafted from negative-molded carbon fiber, which was a hallmark of the era. The suspension employed a classic configuration, with horizontally mounted shock absorbers operated through pushrods and bell cranks.

The power unit is a compact naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12. Fitted with pneumatic valves, it can rev to an impressive <15000rpm>, while its variable-length intake funnels deliver consistent torque across the entire rev range. The high-pitched wail of its exhaust at peak RPMs—a signature trait of naturally aspirated engines—remains an irreplaceable hallmark, unmatched by turbocharged systems. The drivetrain features a 6-speed semi-automatic transmission with paddle shifters, positioned laterally to preserve the aerodynamically optimized rear diffuser design.

Focusing on aerodynamics, the monocoque adopts a high-nose design. In contrast to modern front wings, which are often suspended by struts, this design features an anhedral configuration, with the wing angling diagonally outward from beneath the nose. A variety of options are available, including multiple front and rear wing designs, along with interchangeable engine cowl shapes, allowing you to tailor the car to suit your personal preferences.

long.zh:
F3500-A是一款跑车浪漫旅原创的方程式赛车，源自团队对上世纪90年代初F1赛车的深切景仰和致敬。

车体方面，底盘采用负模碳纤维，这种材料在当时非常流行。悬挂系统沿用了经典布局，采用横向安装的减震器，通过推杆和摇臂进行调节。

动力单元是一台轻便紧凑的3.5L自然进气V12引擎，配备气动气门，能够达到<15000rpm>的转速。进气系统上的可变长度喉管则确保了各转速区间的充足扭矩输出。自然进气引擎在高转速下发出的排气声浪有着涡轮增压系统无法复制的独特音质。变速箱为6速半自动变速箱，配有换挡拨片，横向安装设计旨在避免与后扩散器相冲突。

空气动力学方面，单体壳车身采用高鼻设计。与现代F1前鼻翼常用的主翼片下悬挂设计不同，这款车的前翼则采用了反翼布局，翼板从鼻锥底部斜向展开。此外，玩家可以在游戏中根据个人需求，选择不同的前后翼和引擎罩形状，对车辆进行定制。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The F3500-A was conceived as a tribute to the early 1990s Formula 1 race cars, and the F3500-B proudly carries that legacy forward. Its most significant evolution lies in the powertrain. While the F3500-A was powered by a V-12, the F3500-B adopts a compact, lightweight V-8. Although smaller in displacement, this engine revs to an astonishing 13,800 rpm, generating more than 700.2 HP in the process. The F3500-B also offers three distinct front wing configurations for its high-nose layout.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: F3500-A是一款向90年代初期的F1赛事致敬的原创赛车，F3500-B则为其继任者。两者最大的变化在于动力总成。与F3500-A搭载的V12引擎不同，F-3500-B采用了更轻量化、结构更紧凑的V8引擎。虽然V8引擎通常功率较低，但这台引擎的转速最高可达13,800 转每分，从而实现超过710 PS的动力输出。F3500-B还为高鼻锥提供了三种不同的前翼选择。
officialDetails.heroEn: Here's a V-8 version of the GT original formula car.
officialDetails.heroZh: GT系列原创方程式赛车的V8版本。

brandCentral.en:
Gran Turismo players may already have been familiar with
the special formula machine known as the F3500-A.

The F3500-B was its variant, although both cars were
born of the same admiration for 1990s F1 racing.

The key difference lay in their power units. Where the F3500-A
employed a V-12, the B model carried a V-8.

Although less powerful, the V-8 delivered an output of <710ps>.
Light and compact, it carried advantages of its own.

Note the newly added front wing, crafted specifically or the
car’s high nose and offered in three unique designs.

Beyond showcasing an evolution of the hanging wing concept,
it was a visual delight.

Setting the benchmark for formula machines, the F3500-B
delivered an experience that only a V-8 coud provide.
brandCentral.zh:
《跑车浪漫旅》的玩家或许早已对
名为F3500-A的特殊方程式赛车耳熟能详。

这款F3500-B是其衍生型号，两款车均
源于对90年代一级方程式赛车的致敬。

二者的主要区别在于动力单元：
F3500-A采用V12引擎，而B型则搭载V8引擎。

V8的动力虽稍逊，但最大输出仍达<710ps>，
紧凑且轻量化的引擎结构更增独特优势。

注意观察新增的前翼，专为匹配该车的高鼻锥设计，
并提供了三种独特款式。

它不仅展现了悬吊式前翼设计的演进，
更带来视觉上的享受。

作为方程式赛车的标杆之作，F3500-B
带来了独属于V8引擎的驾驭体验。

catch.en: Here's a V-8 version of the GT original formula car.
catch.zh: GT系列原创方程式赛车的V8版本。

vehicleCollection.en:
Here's a V-8 version of the GT original formula car.

Gran Turismo introduced the F3500-A, an original formula machine created as a tribute to the golden age of early 1990s Formula 1. It captured the speed and technology of that era, giving players a breathtaking taste of top-level racing.

To continue that lineage, we now present the F3500-B. The most significant change lies in its power unit. Where the F3500-A was powered by a naturally-aspirated V-12, the F3500-B turns to a lighter, more compact V-8.

Although devoid of cutting-edge systems such as variable intakes or pneumatic valves, it retains the same electronic fly-by-wire throttle of its predecessor. This engine revs to <13800rpm>, and despite the inherent limitations of the V-8, it produces more than <710ps>. A transverse 6-speed gearbox ensures the best possible packaging.

The body remains faithful to the F3500-A, but the front end has been refined. Three different high-nose wings are available, each with its own aerodynamic philosophy.

The sharp responses and direct feel of the F3500-A remain, but with the F3500-B, you will also discover the “lightness” of this V-8-powered machine.

long.en:

To continue that lineage, we now present the F3500-B. The most significant change lies in its power unit. Where the F3500-A was powered by a naturally-aspirated V-12, the F3500-B turns to a lighter, more compact V-8.

Although devoid of cutting-edge systems such as variable intakes or pneumatic valves, it retains the same electronic fly-by-wire throttle of its predecessor. This engine revs to <13800rpm>, and despite the inherent limitations of the V-8, it produces more than <710ps>. A transverse 6-speed gearbox ensures the best possible packaging.

The body remains faithful to the F3500-A, but the front end has been refined. Three different high-nose wings are available, each with its own aerodynamic philosophy.

The sharp responses and direct feel of the F3500-A remain, but with the F3500-B, you will also discover the “lightness” of this V-8-powered machine.
long.zh:
在《跑车浪漫旅》系列登场的F3500-A是一款原创方程式赛车，其设计初衷是向90年代初期的一级方程式赛事致敬。这款赛车堪称那个时代速度与技术的结晶，致力于为玩家带来令人心潮澎湃的方程式赛车体验。

为延续这一传承，我们推出了全新的F3500-B。两款车型的核心差异在于动力单元。与F3500-A搭载的自然进气V12引擎不同，F3500-B采用了更轻量化、结构更紧凑的V8引擎。

尽管不再搭载可变进气系统或气动阀门等高科技配置，该引擎仍沿用与F3500-A相同的电子线控油门技术。其转速可达<13800rpm>，这意味着即使V8结构存在固有的功率短板，该引擎仍能输出超过<710ps>的强劲动力。变速箱采用6速横向布置设计，以实现最优的空间布局。

车身造型与F3500-A保持一致，但前脸部分进行了若干调整。高鼻锥设计提供三种不同的前翼选择，每种都采用了独特的空气动力学设计思路。

该车沿袭了F3500-A的方程式赛车响应特性与直接路感，但V8引擎所带来的那份“轻盈”驾驶感受，仍需您亲身体验才能领略其精妙之处。#

officialDetails.descriptionEn: While racing karts are typically viewed as the gateway to motorsports, the Shifter Kart is more akin to a sub-formula race car. Equipped with a 125 cc water-cooled two-stroke engine mated to a 6-speed gearbox and featuring front-only braking, it is capable of reaching speeds up to 124.3 mph. This is a racing machine that hones the skills of race drivers.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 尽管卡丁车通常会被视作是赛车竞技领域的入门级车辆，但这款Shifter Kart更该被称为是一辆“迷你版”方程式赛车。它采用了一台125 立方厘米水冷2冲程引擎，连接到一套6速变速箱，而且仅配备了前轮刹车，可以达到时速200 公里的惊人极速。这是一部真正的比赛机器，通常被用于训练顶级车手。
officialDetails.heroEn: With its tremendous performance and 6-speed gearbox, this kart proves fast enough for full-size tracks.
officialDetails.heroZh: 拥有能在全尺寸赛道飞驰的速度：拥有6速变速箱的完整赛道车型。

brandCentral.en:
This go-kart-style vehicle is a Gran Turismo original!

Equipped with a sequential six-speed manual transmission
and front brakes...

It feels a lot like a formula car to drive!

In fact, it can even reach speeds of up to <200km/h>,
depending on its gear ratio.

So don't let its appearance fool you—this is one zippy ride!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆卡丁车模样的赛车是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型！

搭载序列式六速手动变速箱和前轮刹车……

事实上，此车的驾驶感觉更像一辆方程式赛车！

在进行齿轮比设置后，其时速甚至可以达到<200km/h>。

因此，不要被这辆车的外表迷惑了——这是一辆活力四
射、灵活迅捷的车！

catch.en: With its tremendous performance and 6-speed gearbox, this kart proves fast enough for full-size tracks.
catch.zh: 拥有能在全尺寸赛道飞驰的速度：拥有6速变速箱的完整赛道车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its tremendous performance and 6-speed gearbox, this kart proves fast enough for full-size tracks.

A steel pipe frame with simple mechanisms. A tiny seat and exposed engine. A racing go-kart is often seen as the most basic form of a race car. However, these karts can be quite complicated, coming in a number of shapes and sizes; some, like the Shifter Kart featured here, are virtually mini versions of formula cars.

The Shifter Kart is basically the same as a standard racing kart, but the major differences are that the former is equipped with a 6-speed transmission and front brakes. The gearbox is combined with a dry clutch, requiring the driver to operate the clutch whenever stopped, including after a spin. Gear-shifting is usually accomplished by pushing or pulling a lever next to the steering wheel. Depending on the gear ratios, top speed can reach up to <200km/h>, so Shifter Karts are often raced on full-size auto circuits.

The front brakes are primarily to control this high-speed range, but they also allow changes in brake balance between front and rear, which in turn changes control characteristics. A Shifter Kart can be set up with much more precision than a standard kart with only rear brakes.

The Shifter Kart is a full-fledged race machine, used to train top drivers. Drive one and feel for yourself the level of performance. It is sure to change your opinion about these tiny machines.

一个带有简易机械机构的钢管车架，加上一台裸露引擎和一个小座椅。从它们的外观来看，卡丁车经常会被视为赛车运动的入门车型。可是，事实上这个名称包含了各种各样的外形和大小，而且还有一些仅次于方程式的车辆也被包含在内。而此处介绍的变速卡丁车就是其中的一种。

变速卡丁车基本上和标准卡丁车相同，但是它们最主要的区别在于其还配备了一个6档变速箱和前刹车。这个6档变速箱与干式离合器相搭配，需要车手在停车或者打转之后才能操作。换挡则通过推拉方向盘旁边的拉杆实现。根据传动比而定，这种车的最高时速最高可达到<200km/h>，所以它们也经常用来在标准赛道上竞技。

安装前刹车的原因就是要在这样的高速中实现操控性，但是现在也可以将刹车平衡从前部变换到后部。通过这样的调整，可改变车辆的控制特性，相比只带后刹的普通卡丁车，能够设置更多细节。

这是一台被用来训练顶尖车手的成熟赛车。驾驶并亲身感受一下它的性能吧，这会颠覆你对于卡丁车的传统认知。

vehicleCollection.zh:

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The X2014 Series was the result of a collaborative “fan car” project between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo. The entry-level X2014 Junior model combined a compact body with a similarly compact engine producing approximately 246.5 HP, making it the ideal platform for learning the fundamentals of formula driving.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: X2014系列诞生于Red Bull Racing和《跑车浪漫旅》合作的一次“车迷赛车计划”。入门级的X2014 Junior采用了紧凑型车身设计，安装了一台同样较为收敛的引擎，动力输出仅为大约250 PS，使其成为了学习方程式驾驶基础的完美平台。
officialDetails.heroEn: A beginner level machine for learning the basics of formula cars.
officialDetails.heroZh: 入门级车型，用于熟悉方程式赛车。

This hypothetical fan car was developed by Gran Turismo
in partnership with Red Bull Racing.

Considered an entry-level model, as opposed to the
higher-performing X2014 Standard...

Its highly aerodynamic body makes it a great choice for
anyone looking to learn how to drive a formula car.

联合开发的。

vehicleCollection.en:
A beginner level machine for learning the basics of formula cars.

The fan car project that started with the collaboration between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo continued even after the release of Gran Turismo 5. Adrian Newey, the chief technical officer of Red Bull Racing, and Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi further refined the concept of the "fastest racing car on earth, untouched by any and all regulations," and pursued the optimization of the design even further. What came as the result, was the X2014 series announced at the end of 2013 in Gran Turismo 6.

The entry level model for beginners to the X series is the X2014 Junior. A conventional aerodynamic, compact body is matched to an equally compact naturally aspirated <2000cc> inline 4 cylinder engine that produces approximately <250ps>. This is an optimal machine for learning the basics of driving a formula car, with high grip and high downforce characteristics.

cars.nameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The X2014 Series was the result of a collaborative “fan car” project between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo. The mid-tier X2014 Standard followed as a more advanced model, developed as a conventional Venturi car. Its design minimized aerodynamic drag through front and rear wheel covers and a glass canopy, while simultaneously increasing downforce.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: X2014系列诞生于Red Bull Racing和《跑车浪漫旅》合作的一次“车迷赛车计划”。X2014 Standard是系列中的中档型号，被开发成一款常规的文丘里效应车型。它采用了前后轮罩和玻璃顶篷，既可以降低风阻，又产生了更大的下压力。
officialDetails.heroEn: A traditional venturi car with the axial flow fan and skirts removed from the X2014.
officialDetails.heroZh: 继承Venturi传统的车型，但加装了X2014的轴流风机和包围。
officialDetails.nameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard
officialDetails.nameZh: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard

en.nameLong: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard

zh.nameLong: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard

brandCentral.en:
This hypothetical fan car was developed by Gran Turismo
in partnership with Red Bull Racing.

But don’t let name 'Standard' fool you—it's actually
the higher-performing sibling of the X2014 Junior.

Under its bonnet is a 2L straight-four turbo engine
that can generate <810ps> of power.

Employing a Venturi car design, the Standard boasts
increased downforce...

Which essentially means that air pressure on the car
adapts to changes in its speed.

It’s fascinating! In fact, you might learn a thing or two
about aerodynamics just driving this beauty!
brandCentral.zh:
这款架空的爱好者车型是由跑车浪漫旅与红牛车队
联合开发的。

但不要被名称中的“Standard”字样所迷惑了，它可是红牛
X2014 Junior的兄弟车，而且是高性能版本。

其引擎盖下安装着一台2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎，可以
产生<810ps>的动力。

这辆Standard还安装了文丘里管扩散器，以提供更大的下压力……

这意味着车身所受的空气下压力会因为速度而发生变化，

是相当惊人的设计！事实上，试着驾驶一下这台美丽的
车，您或许能对空气动力学有所体会！

catch.zh: 继承Venturi传统的车型，但加装了X2014的轴流风机和包围。

vehicleCollection.en:
A traditional venturi car with the axial flow fan and skirts removed from the X2014.

The fan car project that started as a collaboration between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo continued at full speed after the blockbuster release of Gran Turismo 5. Red Bull Racing’s Chief Technical Officer Adrian Newey and Gran Turismo Producer Kazunori Yamauchi continued to refine their premier concept of creating the fastest race car on earth, no holds barred.

The result was the groundbreaking X2014 series, announced at the end of 2013 in Gran Turismo 6.

The X2014 Standard, the mid-range model of the X2014 series, features conventional suspension and aerodynamics, without the axial flow fan and ground-effect skirt of the X2014 Fan Car that serves as the flagship of the lineup.

The X2014 Standard features the same streamlined front and rear wheel covers and glass canopy as the Fan Car, but to achieve the desired downforce, the Standard gets a dual-plane front wing. The contour of the rear floor has also been optimized for this configuration.

Downforce is governed by the universal rules of racing aerodynamics — increasing as the inverse square of vehicle speed. The engine is a 2.0-liter turbocharged
V-6, a liter less than the Fan Car but still delivering a massive <810ps>. When piloting this version of the X2014, the driver must keep in mind that the downforce available during cornering changes greatly as speed increases and decreases.

cars.nameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 25th Anniversary

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The X2019 Competition was developed at the inception of the Gran Turismo Championship, with the goal of creating a race car that was as thrilling to watch as it was to drive. Based on the X2014 Standard, it featured revised design elements, including new front wheel styling, a reworked rear body structure, and reshaped rear wheel covers. Also, the powertrain was updated from a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine to a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter unit, and the throttle system was replaced with a more conventional mechanical setup.

brandCentral.en:
The X2019 Competition is a virtual racer created
specifically for Gran Turismo.

It represents the pinnacle of race car design.

Development began with the X2014 Standard serving as
the base model.

catch.zh: X2014的演化版，专为FIA的Gran Turismo锦标赛而打造。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is an evolution of the X2014 created for the FIA Gran Turismo Championships.

Imagine a race car that can unleash its full unbridled potential, free of any restrictions or regulations. That's exactly what Gran Turismo and Red Bull did when they created the X2010, followed by the X2014 a few years later. This project of creating the ultimate performance machine was updated for the 2019 FIA Gran Turismo Championship, and thus, the X2019 Competition was born.

Based on the X2014 Standard, the X2019 Competition features a front wing and a slightly modified rear end that produces less downforce to minimize aerodynamic changes to the car during close battles. The rear wheel covers have been altered to allow fast tire changes. Under the hood, the turbocharged 2.0-liter engine was swapped for a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter powerplant, equipped with a more conventional throttle system to provide a more attractive exhaust note.

The X2019 Competition will be painted in the national colors of the Nations Cup finalists and will no doubt bring added excitement to this year's championships.

long.zh:
“世界上最快的赛车，不受规则束缚”：红牛车队和跑车浪漫旅联手打造的车迷计划源自山内一典一贯秉承的梦想，迄今为止已经打造出两款终极赛车X2010和X2014。随着国际汽联GT锦标赛的开幕，需求一款能同时取悦车手和观众的终极赛车的呼声又一次涌现出来。X2019 Competition应运而生。

这款跑车以X2014 Standard为基础，通过改进车身的前翼和后段来减少下压力，避免与其他赛车贴身肉搏时产生急剧的空力变化。对前轮盖和后轮盖的改造是为了快速更换轮胎。2.0升的涡轮增压引擎被换成了3.0升自然进气引擎。这款赛车依然应用传统油门系统，以便在比赛中产生更吸引人的音效。

X2019 Competition将根据国家杯决赛车手的国籍上色。这款赛车将以无与伦比的性能让锦标赛更加激动人心。

conversation.en:
A Gran Turismo Championship icon
and the ultimate racing car.

Inaugural series champion Igor Fraga and
2019 champion, Mikail Hizal...

Raced this machine at the 2018 GTC finals in Monaco
to a near dead heat.

I’ll never forget the explosive energy in the venue
when the winner was announced!

The responsiveness of its 3L NA engine is incredible...

And its exhaust note is like music!

Because of its sharp handling, it requires
comprehensive driving skill to master.

But if you can tame this beast, you’re well on
your way to becoming Gran Turismo royalty!
~

的顶级赛车，

代表了赛车设计的巅峰水平。

它以X2014 Standard为基础原型进行开发，

稍稍降低了下压力，并将原版引擎换成了一台自然进气
的3升V12引擎。

catch.en: This is an evolution of the X2014 created for the FIA Gran Turismo Championships.
catch.zh: X2014的演化版，专为FIA的Gran Turismo锦标赛而打造。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is an evolution of the X2014 created for the FIA Gran Turismo Championships.

Imagine a race car that can unleash its full unbridled potential, free of any restrictions or regulations. That's exactly what Gran Turismo and Red Bull did when they created the X2010, followed by the X2014 a few years later. This project of creating the ultimate performance machine was updated for the 2019 FIA Gran Turismo Championship, and thus, the X2019 Competition was born.

Based on the X2014 Standard, the X2019 Competition features a front wing and a slightly modified rear end that produces less downforce to minimize aerodynamic changes to the car during close battles. The rear wheel covers have been altered to allow fast tire changes. Under the hood, the turbocharged 2.0-liter engine was swapped for a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter powerplant, equipped with a more conventional throttle system to provide a more attractive exhaust note.

The X2019 Competition will be painted in the national colors of the Nations Cup finalists and will no doubt bring added excitement to this year's championships.

long.zh:
“世界上最快的赛车，不受规则束缚”：红牛车队和跑车浪漫旅联手打造的车迷计划源自山内一典一贯秉承的梦想，迄今为止已经打造出两款终极赛车X2010和X2014。随着国际汽联GT锦标赛的开幕，需求一款能同时取悦车手和观众的终极赛车的呼声又一次涌现出来。X2019 Competition应运而生。

这款跑车以X2014 Standard为基础，通过改进车身的前翼和后段来减少下压力，避免与其他赛车贴身肉搏时产生急剧的空力变化。对前轮盖和后轮盖的改造是为了快速更换轮胎。2.0升的涡轮增压引擎被换成了3.0升自然进气引擎。这款赛车依然应用传统油门系统，以便在比赛中产生更吸引人的音效。

X2019 Competition将根据国家杯决赛车手的国籍上色。这款赛车将以无与伦比的性能让锦标赛更加激动人心。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 1971 Ford Maverick, winner of the 2018 SEMA “Best of Show,” was crafted by Greening Auto Company into a striking custom build. Its ride height was dropped to the limit for maximum visual impact. The 7.0-liter Windsor V-8 was equipped with twin turbochargers to generate 1199.2 HP, yet it also offered flexibility—its engine control logic could be adjusted for a more relaxed, street-friendly cruise.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这辆荣获2018年SEMA车展“最佳巡展”奖项的1971年Ford Maverick由Greening Auto Company精心打造。车身高度被降至极限，营造出极具视觉冲击力的外观效果。7升Windsor V8引擎搭载双涡轮增压系统，输出功率达1,216 PS，同时保留了一定的灵活性，可调节引擎控制逻辑，适应城市悠闲驾驶。

brandCentral.en:
This 1971 Ford Maverick was built by Greening Auto Company
(GAC), a custom car builder in the U.S.

It made history when it took the GT Award...

...at the 2018 SEMA Show, the world’s largest event for
automotive aftermarket products.

The original Ford Maverick was an affordable and practical
compact coupe.

But for this custom job, the chassis was rebuilt
with genuine racing architecture.

The car's 7.0-liter Windsor V-8, widely considered
to be a Ford masterpiece...

...has been tuned to deliver an unbelievable
1,200 horsepower!

In 2019, this GAC Maverick registered a top speed
of <326km/h>.?

这辆1971福特翼虎是由美国定制汽车制造商
Greening Auto Company（“GAC”）制造的。

这是一台创造了历史的车……

它在2018年的世界顶级定制汽车年度盛会
——美国汽车用品改装车展览会上获得了跑车浪漫旅大奖。

福特翼虎原本只是一款经济实用的紧凑型双门轿车。

但这辆改装车就不一样了，它的底盘按照
真正的赛车结构重新打造……

并安装了一台经过调校的7升Windsor V8引擎，
后者是公认的福特引擎杰作。

我可不是信口雌黄，要知道它可以输出
高达1200马力的动力！

在2019年，这辆GAC Maverick跑出了
令人折服的<326km/h>最高速度记录。?
