vehicleCollection.en:
A vicious hot rod with 1200HP and a nostalgic body

The SEMA Show takes place every year in November in Las Vegas, Nevada. At the world’s largest automotive aftermarket festival, Gran Turismo handpicked standout vehicles for its prestigious Gran Turismo Awards. In 2018, the "Best of Show" honors went to the 1971 Ford Maverick, created by Greening Auto Company (GAC).

The Maverick was originally an affordable compact coupe built on the Ford Falcon chassis. GAC transformed the Maverick into a monster hot rod that blended extreme performance with street-friendly drivability.

The exterior's lowered ride height and flared fenders immediately turned heads, but the real showstopper was found under the hood. In the engine compartment resided Ford's famous 7.0-liter small-block Windsor V-8. Packing not one, but two turbochargers, GAC claimed the engine unleashed a staggering <1216ps>. But it wasn't all about raw, unadulterated power—adjustable engine control logic allowed for the car to cruise comfortably around town.

In the spring of 2019, this Maverick took on a top speed challenge, setting a record of 202.748 mph (approximately <326km/h>). This car was truly a rare masterpiece where nostalgia and cutting-edge technology seamlessly blended together.

long.zh:
美国汽车用品改装车展览会每年11月在美国的拉斯维加斯举办。在这场世界上最大的定制汽车盛会上，《跑车浪漫旅》会评出获得“跑车浪漫旅大奖”的汽车。而2018年的“最佳巡展”得主就是这辆由格林宁汽车公司（GAC）制造的1971年福特翼虎。

这台车的原型是一辆廉价的紧凑型双门跑车，基于福特猎鹰的底盘打造。但格林宁汽车公司却将这辆翼虎改造成了可在城市街道上合法行驶的“怪物级”改装车。

在外观上，最先抓住所有人眼球的是降低后的车身以及外扩的挡泥板。但它最大的亮点藏在引擎盖下——里面安装的是一台福特鼎鼎大名的7升Windsor V8 Small Block引擎。此外，它的涡轮增压器不是一个，而是两个！据介绍，这套动力单元能产生高达<1216ps>的动力。但它却不是一匹无法驾驭的马力怪兽，通过引擎开闭控制，你甚至可以在城市悠闲地巡航。

在2019年春天，这辆翼虎接受了一次最高速度的挑战，创造了202.748英里/小时的纪录。通过将怀旧审美和尖端技术结合，格林宁汽车公司创造出了这样一台绝无仅有的车型。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Created to commemorate Hyundai’s 50th anniversary, this model also embodied the spirit and ambition of the company's high-performance "N" division. It was powered by hydrogen fuel cells paired with supercapacitors that stored energy recovered through regenerative braking, delivering a combined output of 650 kW (871.8 HP) via electric motors at each wheel. Thanks to compact, lightweight fuel-cell stacks and a CFRP monocoque chassis, the car tipped the scales at just 2143 lbs.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款车是专为Hyundai的50周年纪念所打造，也代表了Hyundai高性能部门“N”对汽车研发倾注的热情。它采用了氢燃料电池供能，还配备了超级电容，能够储存由再生制动系统产生的能量，四个车轮上的电机能够输出总计650千瓦（884 PS）的动力。此外，得益于它的紧凑车身和轻量化燃料电池组，以及碳纤维复合材料单体车壳框架，这辆车仅重972 公斤。

Weighing in at just north of one ton, the N 25 Gran Turismo
is lightweight and quite nice to look at.[

vehicleCollection.en:
An extreme monster machine that embodies the passion and future of Hyundai's "N".

The HYUNDAI N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo was designed to embody the passion and spirit of "N," Hyundai’s high-performance sub-brand, in celebration of the company’s 50th anniversary in 2017. This exhilarating concept provides a glimpse into the company's future high-performance vehicles, highlighting the philosophy of "N," which delivers "the most thrilling winding road fun."

While hybrid powertrains dominate today’s performance landscape, the N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo introduces a groundbreaking alternative—one poised to become the next major innovation in the automotive industry: the hydrogen fuel cell system. This cutting-edge system gives the concept sports car both eco-conscious efficiency and track-ready performance. With instant torque delivery, it transforms into an impressive cornering machine.

While the high-performance fuel cell system was developed at the Namyang R&D Center—Hyundai Motors’ main engineering facility—the staff at Hyundai’s American Design Center took this cutting-edge technology and transformed it into a formidable powerplant, one that delivers the high performance worthy of the "N" badge. Also, Hyundai Motors’ Sound Design Research Lab developed a one-of-a-kind FCEV sport sound system, enhancing the emotional engagement of this high-spirited yet eco-friendly model. Equipped with this innovative technology, the N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo is a bold glimpse into Hyundai Motors’ high-performance future.

The N 2025’s powertrain is based on the world’s first mass-produced Hyundai hydrogen fuel cell from 2013. Its total output is 650 kW (<883ps>). The dual fuel cell stacks produce 500 kW (<680ps>), while the supercapacitor system adds another 150 kW (<204ps>) by harnessing regenerated energy during braking. This impressive power output comes from an eco-friendly system, optimally distributed through four high-powered independent in-wheel motors, ensuring uncompromised traction. The compact, lightweight fuel cell stacks and flexible CFRP monocoque structure keep the car’s weight down to a lean 972kg, resulting in a power-to-weight ratio that rivals the world’s most elite supercars. And its low center of gravity and IIDC (Independent In-wheel motor Drive Control) make it a machine built for the track, especially those with tight chicanes—the kind of driving bhallenge that defines the "N" brand’s DNA.

long.zh:
HYUNDAI的N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo是为了展现其高性能子品牌“N”的热情所开发的，同时也是为了庆祝2017年Hyundai创立50周年。这台让人热血澎湃的赛车向人们展示此品牌的下一代高性能车辆以及“N”的独特性，即“极致刺激的弯道乐趣”。

尽管混合动力是当今的性能发展趋势，但是这台N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo却采用了一种全新的动力传动系统，它毫无疑问将成为汽车工业的下一场革命：氢燃料电池系统。这个革命性的新系统让这台概念跑车不仅环保，更借助于快速的瞬态响应，成为了弯道上的猛兽。

虽然高性能燃料电池系统是由Hyundai Motors的主要技术中心——南阳研发中心开发的，却是Hyundai美国设计中心的设计师们将这项技术转化为极具潜力的高性能动力单元，是一项能配得上“N”标志的杰作。此外，Hyundai Motors的声学设计研究所设计了一款独特的FCEV运动声响系统，使这台本就让人兴奋不已的环保车型更为激动人心。有了所有这些未来科技，N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo完美展现了Hyundai Motors在未来赛车领域的潜力。

cars.nameZh: 现代N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo（组别1）

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Originally created through a collaboration between Hyundai and Gran Turismo, the N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo has been reworked to meet Gr.1 regulations in this original model. In accordance with Gr.1 rules, the variable rear wing is fixed in place. The 4-wheel-drive system remains unchanged, giving the car exceptional grip and allowing it to handle as if it were glued to the tarmac.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo原本是Hyundai和《跑车浪漫旅》合作打造的车型，而这个原创版本则按照Gr.1组别规则对其进行了改装。按照Gr.1规则，其可变式尾翼被改成了固定式。它的传动系统也与四轮驱动配置配合良好，让这辆车能够像被粘在地上一样行驶。
officialDetails.heroEn: This extreme car embodies the passion and future of Hyundai's "N" brand.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款奔逸绝尘的赛车代表着Hyundai的N系列赛车的热忱与未来。

vehicleCollection.en:
This extreme car embodies the passion and future of Hyundai's "N" brand.

The HYUNDAI N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo was designed to embody the passion and spirit of "N," Hyundai’s high-performance sub-brand, in celebration of the company’s 50th anniversary in 2017. This exhilarating concept provides a glimpse into the company's future high-performance vehicles, highlighting the philosophy of "N," which delivers "the most thrilling winding road fun."

While hybrid powertrains dominate today’s performance landscape, the N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo introduces a groundbreaking alternative—one poised to become the next major innovation in the automotive industry: the hydrogen fuel cell system. This cutting-edge system gives the concept sports car both eco-conscious efficiency and track-ready performance. With instant torque delivery, it transforms into an impressive cornering machine.

While the high-performance fuel cell system was developed at the Namyang R&D Center—Hyundai Motors’ main engineering facility—the staff at Hyundai’s American Design Center took this cutting-edge technology and transformed it into a formidable powerplant, one that delivers the high performance worthy of the "N" badge. Also, Hyundai Motors’ Sound Design Research Lab developed a one-of-a-kind FCEV sport sound system, enhancing the emotional engagement of this high-spirited yet eco-friendly model. Equipped with this innovative technology, the N 2025 Vision Gran Turismo is a bold glimpse into Hyundai Motors’ high-performance future.

The N 2025’s powertrain is based on the world’s first mass-produced Hyundai hydrogen fuel cell from 2013. Its total output is 650 kW (<883ps>). The dual fuel cell stacks produce 500 kW (<680ps>), while the supercapacitor system adds another 150 kW (<204ps>) by harnessing regenerated energy during braking. This impressive power output comes from an eco-friendly system, optimally distributed through four high-powered independent in-wheel motors, ensuring uncompromised traction. The compact, lightweight fuel cell stacks and flexible CFRP monocoque structure keep the car’s weight down to a lean <972kg>, resulting in a power-to-weight ratio that rivals the world’s most elite supercars. And its low center of gravity and IIDC (Independent In-wheel motor Drive Control) make it a machine built for the track, especially those with tight chicanes—the kind of drivinf challenge that defines the "N" brand’s DNA.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Launched in 1991, the Honda Beat helped spark the boom in lightweight two-seat sports cars. Tipping the scales at just 1675 lbs, it also delivered near-perfect balance with a 43:57 front-to-rear weight ratio. Its engine, infused with F1-derived technology and paired with a short-stroke transmission, delivered a driving experience like no other. And you didn’t need mountain roads to enjoy it—the Beat brought pure sports car fun to your everyday drive.

officialDetails.heroZh: 可爱的2座轻型车，开起来乐趣十足。

vehicleCollection.en:
This wonderful kei sports car offered style and driving excitement never before seen in Japan.

The Beat defied every kei-car convention and was an instant "classic in the making" for Honda. Not only was it a convertible — a very rare attribute for kei cars — it had a mid-engine layout, making the Beat totally unique.

The little Honda measured <3295mm> from bumper to bumper, sat <1395mm> wide and <1175mm> tall. What's especially notable is the Beat's curb weight of only <760kg>. The mass was distributed front and rear just like a large exotic car, with 43 percent of its weight over the front wheels and 53 over rear. The engine, which was situated immediately behind the cabin, was a <656cc> naturally-aspirated inline-3 that produced <64ps>. Despite being classified as a kei engine, it was quite high-tech, featuring a multi-joint throttle and an engine control system that trickled down from the company’s Formula 1 program. A 5-speed manual gearbox managed the power sent to the rear wheels.

The Beat's handling was in a league of its own. The suspension was tuned for sporty driving, and Honda incorporated different size wheels for the front (13 in.) and rear (14 in.). The brakes were excellent, being fitted with discs at all four corners, the first for a kei car.

Despite the somewhat pricey nature of the Beat, Honda ended up selling 33,672 of this svelte convertible until production was halted in 1996.

long.en:
The Beat defied every kei-car convention and was an instant "classic in the making" for Honda. Not only was it a convertible — a very rare attribute for kei cars — it had a mid-engine layout, making the Beat totally unique.

The little Honda measured <3295mm> from bumper to bumper, sat <1395mm> wide and <1175mm> tall. What's especially notable is the Beat's curb weight of only <760kg>. The mass was distributed front and rear just like a large exotic car, with 43 percent of its weight over the front wheels and 53 over rear. The engine, which was situated immediately behind the cabin, was a <656cc> naturally-aspirated inline-3 that produced <64ps>. Despite being classified as a kei engine, it was quite high-tech, featuring a multi-joint throttle and an engine control system that trickled down from the company’s Formula 1 program. A 5-speed manual gearbox managed the power sent to the rear wheels.

The Beat's handling was in a league of its own. The suspension was tuned for sporty driving, and Honda incorporated different size wheels for the front (13 in.) and rear (14 in.). The brakes were excellent, being fitted with discs at all four corners, the first for a kei car.

Despite the somewhat pricey nature of the Beat, Honda ended up selling 33,672 of this svelte convertible until production was halted in 1996.
long.zh:
1991年登场的本田Beat与铃木Cappuccino和马自达AZ-1等车款一起，开创了轻量型两座跑车的风潮。

该车的尺寸为<3295mm>长，<1395mm>宽，<1175mm>高，整车重量仅有760公斤。该车为两座配置，没有配备防滚架。尽管车顶蓬需要手动折叠，但因为整车轻量化的特性，即便一个人也可以轻松打开或者关闭。

车身的重量分配也相当理想，43%位于前部，57%位于后部，后部尾翼配备了进气道来冷却发动机。为了追求完美的操控性，前后轮采用了不同尺寸的轮胎，前轮为13英寸，后轮为14英寸。刹车也按照性能级别车进行了配置，首次在轻量型车款上配备了四轮碟刹。

<656cc>直列三缸自然吸气引擎可输出<64ps>的动力，并配备了来自F1技术的多段油门和动力控制系统。变速箱为5速手动，档位行程调校得很短。内饰也相当特别，加入了三个摩托车式样的仪表，和玩心浓厚的斑马条纹配饰座椅。

用户对该款车的评价是令人心悦的。不需要去找蜿蜒颠簸的路段，在熟悉的街道上驾驶同样能享受跑车的行驶乐趣。本田Beat的生产持续到了1996年，总销量达到了33672辆。尽管售价不菲，本田Beat仍然是一辆闪耀的优秀跑车，有不少人希望本田能够继续生产它。

vehicleCollection.en:
The fifth-generation model of this popular SUV is the first to feature a hybrid system.

In the 1990s, Honda embarked on creating vehicles tailored for leisure, coining the term “Creative Movers” to define this new category. The first of these was the Odyssey, launched in 1994 to widespread commercial acclaim. A year later, the Creative Movers concept expanded with the debut of a crossover SUV. This was the first-generation CR-V.

From that point onward, the CR-V established itself as a perennial favorite, particularly in the North American market. The model featured here is the 2021 iteration, an evolution of the fifth-generation CR-V that first appeared in 2016.

A defining feature of this generation was the introduction of a hybrid powertrain—the first such offering for the series. The system paired a 2.0-liter Atkinson-cycle engine with two electric motors, capable of operating in both series and parallel modes. Its efficiency shone particularly at cruising speeds, where the gasoline engine took over. The availability of 4-wheel drive further broadened its appeal, offering versatility across a wide range of driving conditions.

While the styling retained many cues from the previous generation, the body was slightly enlarged to enhance rear-seat legroom and passenger comfort. Practicality remained a hallmark of the CR-V, with more than 1,100 liters of cargo space available when the rear seats were folded down. A gasoline-powered variant also offered 3-row, 7-seat configuration.

Beyond its practicality and efficiency, the fifth-generation CR-V was equipped with a comprehensive suite of driver assistance features, including collision mitigation braking and adaptive cruise control. All of this made the CR-V an ideal companion for both weekend adventures and everyday life.

long.zh:
时间来到1990年代，本田开始致力于打造以休闲出行为定位的车型，并将这一类汽车称为“创行者”。该类别的第一款车就是在1994年推出，并立刻获得广泛商业成功的奥德赛。然后本田又在95年推出了一款高离地间隙的SUV车型，这便是第一代CR-V。

自此，CR-V就成为了一款热销的常青产品，特别是在北美市场。至于这里介绍的车型，这辆2021款是基于2016年首次推出的第五代CR-V升级而来。

第五代车型最受人关注的特点就是在系列中首次采用了混动单元。这套动力系统结合了一部2升阿特金森循环引擎和2部电机，能够串联或并联运行。在高速巡航时，这套高效节能的系统还允许仅使用燃油引擎提供动力。厂商还提供了四轮驱动选项与之搭配，进一步抬高了CR-V的人气。

它在外观上继承了许多前代车型的特征，还稍微拓展了车身尺寸，为后排乘客提供了更多的腿部空间，提升了乘坐舒适性。此外，通过折叠后排座椅，这款车还能腾出超过1100L的货物空间，用于运载大量的行李。其油车车型还提供了一套3排7座布局选项。

第五代CR-V不仅仅是一款设计精良的SUV，还配备了多种驾驶辅助系统，例如碰撞缓解制动和自适应巡航控制等等。CR-V综合了各种优点，使其成为休旅出行和日常代步的最优选。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 1987, Honda introduced the all-new fourth-generation Civic. It was known as the Grand Civic, with the model code EF. Its most significant advancement was a complete platform overhaul, bringing double wishbone suspension to all four corners. The sporty Si model and the more luxurious Si Extra both featured the 1.6-liter DOHC ZC inline-4 engine. These models also found success on the track, competing in the Japan Touring Car Championship and securing championship titles.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1987年，Honda Civic迎来全面换代，第4代车型正式登场。这一代被称为Grand Civic，车型代号为EF。最显著的变化在于平台升级，四轮均采用双叉臂独立悬挂系统。运动版“Si”和豪华版“Si Extra”均搭载1.6升直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴“ZC”引擎。Si和Si Extra还征战日本房车锦标赛，并成功夺得冠军头衔。

usedCar.en:

EF Civic Si, also known as the 'Grand Civic'.

Civics are often associated with VTEC systems, but this
Si is powered by an older ZC engine.

This was Honda’s first DOHC engine since the S800, which
debuted fourteen years prior.

Though its 130 horsepower isn’t all too astounding,

of the most iconic hot hatches of the 1980s.{

vehicleCollection.en:
A dominating force on the touring car circuit, this fourth-generation Civic features the famous ZC engine.

In 1987, the Civic underwent a full model change, ushering in its fourth generation. It was known as the Grand Civic or simply by its model code "EF."

While retaining the key design elements of its predecessor, the exterior featured modern refinements on a slightly larger body. One of the most notable updates was the new platform, which introduced a 4-wheel double-wishbone suspension system. The wheelbase was also substantially extended, enhancing stability and delivering a sportier handling experience.

The lineup remained diverse, offering four body styles: a 3-door hatchback, 4-door sedan, 5-door shuttle, and the "Pro" commercial model. The Si sport variants, powered by 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4, were also carried over from the previous generation. A new "Si Extra" grade was introduced, combining the Si's sporty essence with an enhanced suite of equipment.

The ZC engine received extensive tuning, including a higher compression ratio, improved intake and exhaust flow, and reduced piston friction. The result was a maximum net output of <130ps> and <14.7kgm> of torque. The previous "Wonder Civic" era boasted <135ps> and <15.5kgm>; however, these were gross figures. However, when adjusted for the 15% difference between gross and net measurements, the new ZC engine proved to be more powerful.

The Si and Si Extra models also made a strong impression in motorsports, such as the Japan Touring Car Championship (JTC). Making its debut in the 1988 season, the Civic claimed its first victory in Round 3 and went on to secure both the drivers and manufacturers titles. The following year, the car repeated its success, capturing the manufacturers title once again.

外观设计保留了前代的主要特征，在略微增大的车身上融入了现代化元素。最显著的改变之一是全新的底盘平台，配备了四轮双叉臂悬挂系统。轴距的显著加长，让驾驶者在享受运动化操控的同时获得更出色的稳定性。

车系阵容延续了此前的组合，推出四大车型，包括三门掀背车、四门轿车、五门旅行车以及“Pro”商用版本。承袭自上一代的还有搭载1.6L DOHC直列四缸引擎的“Si”运动版本。在此之上，这一代还新增了“Si Extra”级别，在Si的基础上增添了丰富的配置。

ZC引擎经过全面调校，包括提高压缩比、改善进排气流通性、降低活塞摩擦等多项改进。最终实现了<130ps>的最大动力输出和<14.7kgm>的扭矩净值。虽然上一代“Wonder Civic”就曾宣称达到<135ps>和<15.5kgm>的数据，但那是总动力输出值。由于净值通常比总值低15%，这意味着新款ZC引擎实际上更为强劲。

Si和Si Extra车型还在日本房车锦标赛等赛事中大显身手。在首次参赛的1988赛季，该车在第3站首次夺魁，并摘得当年的车手总冠军和制造商总冠军。在1989赛季，这款赛车再次展现硬实力，成功卫冕制造商总冠军。

conversation.en:
I know this Civic very well!

It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s
—the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.

The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast,
but its engine design and sound are second to none.

You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.

What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?

The engine swaps, of course!

Fo example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement
will give you great sound, speed, and power.

But my favorite would have to be the Type R
B-engine.

It might not offer as much power as the K-engine,
but its ror is simply unforgettable!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
我对这种类型的思域非常熟悉！

准确来说，这是一辆1990年代生产，被称为“运动思域”
的第五代“EG”思域。

从其昵称中的“运动”二字就能看出它的速度有多快，
此外它的引擎设计和声浪也无出其右。

你经常会看到这款车被调校成各种不同的形态。

你知道关于运动思域的调校，我最爱哪一方面吗

当然是更换改装引擎啦！

比如说，大排量的本田K-引擎可以给你澎湃的声浪、
风驰电掣的速度和充沛的动力。

不过我的最爱还是Type R B-引擎。

虽然动力d如K-引擎，但它的咆哮声绝对令人
终生难忘！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Civic is Honda’s longest-running model line. The fifth-generation EG Civic, introduced in September 1991, was promoted as the “sports Civic.” At the top of the range sat the SiR grade, equipped with a 1.6-liter DOHC VTEC engine. Building on the success of the previous SiR, which had already achieved the benchmark of 100 horsepower per liter, this model delivered an additional 9.9 HP, bringing total output to 167.7 HP.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Civic是Honda最长青的车型。1991年9月推出的第5代“EG” Civic以“运动Civic”之名为人所知。运动Civic车系中的明星车型当属搭载了1.6升双顶置凸轮轴VTEC引擎的SiR级别车型。这款车型在前代SiR每升排量输出100匹马力的基础上，动力提升了10 PS至170 PS。
officialDetails.heroEn: The top-of-the-line fifth-generation Civic balances speed with comfort.
officialDetails.heroZh: 在速度和舒适性之间取得完美平衡的第5代Civic顶配版本。

usedCar.en:
Compact, lightweight and low to the ground, with an
aggressive yet attractive body style...

...the fifth-generation Civic, introduced in 1991, is the
quintessential compact performance car.

Many consider this model to be one of the best handling FF
(front engine/front-wheel drive) cars on the planet.

The top-of-the-line SiR･II came equipped with a naturally
aspirated 1.6-liter DOHC VTEC engine.

It featured a double-wishbone suspension and quick-ratio steering
system that made the car efficient through corners.

It was, and remains, the pride of Japan. The Civic is still popular
today, thanks to predecessors like this 1991 model.
usedCar.zh:
小巧、轻灵、贴地，采用了高转速、自然吸气引擎

——如果你想寻找一辆特别适合运动驾驶的车，
那么这辆思域运动版就是首选！

1991年推出的第5代思域
是一款前置引擎、前轮驱动（或简称前置前驱）运动型轿车。

产品线中的顶配版本SiR･II装备了
一部1.6升双顶置凸轮轴可变气门正时和升程电子控制系统引擎……

并采用了双叉臂设计，在悬挂和转向性能之间取得了精确的平衡。

这辆紧凑型运动车款是日本的骄傲，更得到了广大车迷的青睐。
放到如今这个时代，可谓独步天下。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line fifth-generation Civic balances speed with comfort.

Honda introduced the fifth-generation Civic in 1991. Its VTEC engine made it much faster than the outgoing model. It came as a 3-door hatchback, the "Ferio" 4-door, and the 5-door shuttle.

Thanks to the evolution of the VTEC system, more variants were added to the engine mix. The base models came with a carbureted 1.3-liter and 1.5-liter inline-4, while more upscale cars had a 1.5-liter SOHC VTEC and a fuel efficient 1.5-liter VTEC-E. The top-of-the-line car, SiR, boasted the high-performance 1.6-liter DOHC VTEC.

All Civics featured Honda's new double wishbone suspension. The SiR model, which epitomized the "Sports Civic," produced <10ps> more power than the previous car, totaling <170ps>.

The SiR's suspension system had a revised spring rate biased towards better performance. As with previous models, the SiR came in at a lower weight because many luxury amenities were deleted. However, the SiR･II catered to those who enjoyed comfort, with such things as air conditioning, power windows, and a genuine leather wrapped steering wheel as part of its equipment.

New for the SiR･II was the addition of a 4-speed automatic transmission. While the 5-speed manual gearbox's close gear ratios were tuned for winding roads, the new 4-speed automatic model was developed to deliver more torque at low to medium speeds. The automatic transmission scored big with fans, attracting a wider range of users.

long.zh:
在1991年9月，思域的接力棒交到了第5代车型手中。它装备了VTEC引擎，速度也更上一层楼。整个产品组合中包含了3门掀背车和全新命名的“Ferio”4门轿车。而前一代中的5门旅行车版本也得到了保留。

由于VTEC系统得到了长足的发展，引擎种类也变得五花八门。基础车型配备了1.3升和1.5升汽化器引擎。而更高一档的车型配备了驾驶感更佳的1.5升顶置单凸轮轴VTEC引擎，以及燃油效率更高的1.5升VTEC-E引擎。车系中的顶配车型被冠以了SiR之名，采用了高性能1.6升双顶置凸轮轴VTEC引擎。

全系车型均采用了本田全新标配的双叉臂悬挂。作为“运动思域”品牌的门面，SiR版本能够输出的动力比前代车型提高了<10ps>，达到了<170ps>。

另外在悬挂方面，其弹簧刚度和悬挂行程拉伸量等参数也得到了改进，更加强调运动性。和前代车型相同，SiR也致力于通过简化配置来减轻车重，而SiR･II版本则提供全套的舒适性配置，例如全自动空调、电动车窗和真皮包裹方向盘等。

SiR･II车型的新装备包括了可选的4速自动变速箱。其5速手动变速箱版本使用了针对蜿蜒道路调校的密齿轮比，而全新的4速自动变速箱版本则为了在中低速下提升扭矩进行特别调校，降低了最大功率和扭矩参数。不论定位如何，这款全新自动挡型号的推出取得了巨大的成功，而思域的运动形象也被推广到了更广大的用户群体之中。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: First introduced in 1972, the Civic is Honda’s longest-running model. In 1997, the first Civic Type R made its debut, based on the sixth-generation Civic. At its heart was the B16B—a 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated inline-4 DOHC engine that delivered an impressive 182.4 HP. True to the Type R philosophy, the car featured extensive weight reduction and upgraded suspension components. The result was a car that found success across the spectrum of motorsport, from professional racing series to grassroots competition.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 自1972年初代车型问世以来，Civic是Honda销售时间最长的车型。1997年推出了基于第六代Civic的首款Type R车型。B16B 1.6升直列四缸DOHC引擎虽为自然进气，但仍可输出185 PS。秉承Type R的传统，车身轻量化和悬挂升级等改进同样得到应用。该车深受欢迎，广泛活跃于各种专业赛事和业余比赛中。
officialDetails.heroEn: This car represented the first Type R model that eventually dominated circuits around the world.
officialDetails.heroZh: 第一款称霸全球赛道的Type R。

usedCar.en:
Many different models of Honda Civic have proved popular
over the years.

But when it comes to sheer driving pleasure, this EK Type R
is hard to beat.

Its super high-torque, naturally aspirated VTEC engine is
one of Honda's greatest achievements.

The displacement was only 1.6L, but it packed an incredible
<185ps> of power!

Even the way the engine turned over was amazing—
sharp and light, almost like a sports bike!

The lightweight body and low height make this
a model that handles beautifully.
usedCar.zh:
很多不同型号的Honda Civic受欢迎程度
经年不衰。

但是说到纯粹的驾驶体验，
这辆EK Type R就少有对手。

它的超高扭矩自然进气VTEC引擎是
Honda最伟大的成就之一。

排气量只有1.6L，
却提供足足<185ps>的马力！

即使是引擎转动的方式都令人着迷：
锋利又轻盈，几乎像是越野摩托！

轻量级的低高度车身使得它成为一款
操控性优良的车型。

catch.en: This car represented the first Type R model that eventually dominated circuits around the world.
catch.zh: 第一款称霸全球赛道的Type R。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car represented the first Type R model that eventually dominated circuits around the world.

When you talk about hot Honda Civics, surely the 6th iteration of this compact-car icon that first appeared in 1972 would take the forefront of the conversation. The car known in-house as the "EK" and dubbed by Civic loyalists as the "Miracle Civic" arrived in 1995. It boasted excellent fuel economy, high output three-stage VTEC, and a CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission) called the Honda Multimatic.

It came in 3-door hatchback and sedan forms, the latter called the Ferio in Japan. This Civic won Japan's prestigious Car of the Year award, as well as racking up a number of different honors all over the world. In August 1997, Honda introduced a "Type R" variant, which was based on the Civic hatchback. It was the first "Type R" model in Civic's history.

The engine of the Civic Type R was a B16B, a 1.6-liter DOHC 16-valve inline-4, equipped with VTEC. The engine cranked out an amazing <185ps>/<8200rpm>, figures previously unheard of in a naturally aspirated engine. Also, it was lighter than the other Civics, making it that much quicker off the line.

The car was also an excellent handling machine thanks to a lowered body and firmer suspension. Naturally, the Type R made for an exceptional racer, with many victories in Grassroots Motorsports and in Japan's Super Taikyu endurance series. Even after all these years, the car still has a loyal following.

enhanced rigidity and weight reduction.

the first Integra Type R model.

and light detailing differ slightly from earlier designs.

vehicleCollection.en:
The first Type R model tuned by Gran Turismo.

This is an original tuned model created by Gran Turismo, based on the Honda Civic Type R (EK) '97.

The following is the description of the base model:

The Civic has been a long-standing Honda staple since its debut in 1972. It reached new heights with the sixth-generation EK model in 1995. Often referred to as the “Miracle Civic,” it featured a high-output, fuel-efficient 3-stage VTEC engine and introduced the Honda Multimatic.

It was offered as a sporty 3-door hatchback and a more refined 4-door sedan known as the Ferio. Praised for its innovation and well-rounded performance, this Civic won Japan’s Car of the Year.

Then, in August 1997, Honda unveiled a true game-changer—the very first Civic Type R. Based on the 3-door hatchback, this high-performance variant captured widespread attention.

At the heart of the Civic Type R was the B16B—a 1.6-liter inline-4 DOHC 16-valve engine featuring Honda’s signature VTEC system. Remarkably, despite being naturally aspirated, it delivered an impressive <185ps> at a <8200rpm>. True to the Type R philosophy, the body was lightened for sharper performance, and the chassis was upgraded with stiffer, lower suspension, enlarged 4-wheel disc brakes, and sport-tuned ABS.

It also came standard with Recaro bucket seats, perfectly contoured for spirited driving, and a compact MOMO steering wheel with an integrated airbag. Finished in the iconic Championship White, it featured distinctive touches like the red Honda emblem and a machined titanium shift knob—styling cues that proudly broadcast its motorsports DNA.

Lightweight, compact, and built for performance, the Civic Type R sparked dedicated one-make race series and actively competed in events like the Super Taikyu endurance championship. Even a decade after its debut, it remained a beloved choice among amateur racers.

车型有3门掀背款和4门轿车款可选（后者叫做Ferio），收获了众多不错的评价，甚至当选日本年度风云车。

Type R思域使用的是B16B，这是一台1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸16气门引擎，配合VTEC技术，这台自然进气引擎在<8200rpm>时能输出惊人的<185ps>。和其他Type R一样，它的车身接受了减重，悬挂系统更硬也降得更低，并配置了加大版四轮碟刹和竞速型防抱死刹车系统。

此外，它还标配竞速向的Recaro赛车桶椅和加装安全气囊的小尺寸MOMO方向盘。它的“冠军白”车身涂装、本田红头标和钛合金换挡杆头大大凸显了它的竞速形象。

轻盈、紧凑、高性能的思域Type R在赛场上表现十分活跃，甚至催生了思域单一车种赛的举办。它还积极参加日本超级耐久赛等多项赛事。在最初发售的10年后，这款Type R仍然受到大量业余车手的喜爱。

vehicleCollection.en:
One of the world's most beloved pocket rockets comes back with a vengeance."

When most people hear the name “Honda Civic,” they tend to envision an efficient compact people hauler known for its great fuel economy, but for people like us, we immediately think of the Type R, one of the best little pocket rockets in the world.

The Civic Type R was first introduced in 1997 and immediately developed a loyal following, thanks to its powerful high-revving engine and remarkable handling character. It went away in 2012, only to return in 2015, with the introduction of the fourth-generation Civic.

The European 5-door model served as the foundation for the car, but the Type R was a completely different animal, as attested by its exterior appearance. It sported a large front spoiler, rear wing, side skirts and rear diffuser, all of which not only spiced up the car’s appearance, but were functional aerodynamic parts. Honda engineers spent months perfecting these pieces in the wind tunnel to minimize the Civic Type R’s air resistance and improve downforce. Also, wider front and rear fenders were adopted to make room for wider tires.

Under the hood was a dedicated direct-injection turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with VTEC. This rev-happy engine delivered a whopping <310ps> and <40.8kgm> of torque, making it the most powerful Type R ever. It was the quickest and fastest Civic ever too, as it ran from zero to <100km/h> in 5.7 seconds, and reached a top speed of <270km/h>.

The fourth-generation Type R lapped the Nürburgring Nordschleife in 7 minutes, 50.63 sec., setting a record for front-wheel-drive production cars.

long.zh:
思域Type R是一台源于本田思域家族的跑车，自从在1997年首次亮相以来，它一直都让全球的跑车爱好者兴奋不已。

它的历史在2012年被划上了休止符，但是在2015年重生的第四代思域又卷土重来。

它的原始车型是欧洲的第九代5门款。其外部带有一个大尺寸的前扰流板、尾翼、侧围板、以及尾翼扰流翼。这些设置不仅仅是为了酷炫，这些都是在不断的风洞测试和路试之后进行的改进，它们可以尽量减少车辆的风阻，从而提高下压力。就连前后挡泥板都是为了更好地配合宽轮胎而设置的。

该车的动力系统配备了2.0升直喷涡轮增压直列式VTEC 4缸引擎，它能产出<310ps>功率与<40.8kgm>扭矩的动力，为Type R系列带来前所未有的动力输出水平。该车的0-<100km/h>加速时间仅为5.7秒，最高时速可达<270km/h>，是思域历史上性能最高的一款车。

悬挂系统使用了前轮双轴支柱，与标准思域相比，其扭矩转向降低了50%左右，该车还配备可调节的减震系统。

这台第四代Type R在纽博格林北侧赛道上的单圈时间为7分50.63秒，成功刷新了该赛道上市售前驱车的最高纪录。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The sixth-generation Honda Civic Type R was unveiled in September 2022. It was based on the FL 5-door hatchback variant of the 11th-generation Civic. Powering the car was a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 K20C engine, delivering 325.4 HP and 309.6 ft-lb of torque, surpassing the previous generation in both output and response. Updates to the 4-wheel independent active damper system further enhanced chassis performance, sharpening the car’s dynamic capability on both road and track.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Honda Civic Type R历史上的第六代车型于2022年9月发布。该车基于已经发布的第十一代Civic FL五门掀背版打造。动力系统为一台2升直列四缸涡轮增压“K20C”引擎，动力和扭矩均超越第五代Type R，分别达到330 PS和42.8 公斤力米。四轮独立主动避震器系统的控制参数同样经过调整，带来更出色的底盘性能。

brandCentral.en:
If you like sports cars at all, you can’t help but get
excited at the unveiling on a new Honda Type R.

I actually got to test-drive the predecessor to this model—
the FK8 Civic Type R.

The track was a high-speed winding road, with sharp
corners that seemed to distort my field of vision.

But in spite of the strong vertical and lateral Gs, I was
able to brake hard into each corner with ease.

I remember thinking to myself, ‘Wow! The Honda Civic Type R
is really next-level stuff!’

But just when I thought the Civic Type R had hit its peak...

Out came this FL5, which far surpassed the FK8, both
technically and in terms of driving experience.
brandCentral.zh:
如果你喜欢跑车，肯定会情不自禁地为
新款Civic Type R的亮相而振奋。

我实际试驾过这款车型的前身——FK8 Civic Type R。

测试赛道是一条蜿蜒的高速路，有不少
视野十分受限的急弯道。

尽管垂直和横向的G力都很大，我还是能够完成大力刹车，
顺畅地转过每个弯道。

我记得自己当时在想：“哇！
这款Honda Civic Type R的性能真是一流！”

结果就在我以为Civic Type R已经站在巅峰时……
这辆FL5闪亮登场。

无论是在技术规格上还是在驾驶体验上，
它都远远超越了FK8。

vehicleCollection.en:
Driving feel comes first. The legendary R badge returns for the 11th generation Civic.

The sixth version of the Civic Type R was introduced one year and three months after the world premiere of the base model, the 11th-generation "FL" Civic, which was introduced as the "Sokai (Exhilarating) Civic."

The Type R is based on the 5-door hatchback configuration. Compared to previous standard models, the FL has done away with flashy tuning car stylings. While it retains the essential elements of a sports model, such front and rear aero parts and widened fenders, it has adopted simpler, refined design.

The power unit is the definitive Type R engine, a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 K20C unit, which after an overhaul of its turbo system and other improvements, now produces <10ps> and <2kgm> more than the previous model for a maximum output of <330ps> and <42.8kgm> of torque. The engine ECU map has also been meticulously tuned to improve throttle response and low-end torque.

The suspension uses an evolution of the same 4-wheel independent Adaptive Damper System first introduced in the 2015 FK2 model Civic Type R. On the FL5, the system controls not only pitch and roll, but also introduces considerations for the vertical acceleration of unsprung components. Through this system, Honda aims to offer the same direct handling feeling on the smooth surfaces of the racing circuit as it does on uneven public roads.

Additionally, by linking the car with their smartphone, drivers can review their drive data and share videos of their trips allowing them to enjoy the Type R experience even when they're not behind the wheel.

long.en:
The sixth version of the Civic Type R was introduced one year and three months after the world premiere of the base model, the 11th-generation "FL" Civic, which was introduced as the "Sokai (Exhilarating) Civic."

The Type R is based on the 5-door hatchback configuration. Compared to previous standard models, the FL has done away with flashy tuning car stylings. While it retains the essential elements of a sports model, such front and rear aero parts and widened fenders, it has adopted simpler, refined design.

The power unit is the definitive Type R engine, a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 K20C unit, which after an overhaul of its turbo system and other improvements, now produces <10ps> and <2kgm> more than the previous model for a maximum output of <330ps> and <42.8kgm> of torque. The engine ECU map has also been meticulously tuned to improve throttle response and low-end torque.

The suspension uses an evolution of the same 4-wheel independent Adaptive Damper System first introduced in the 2015 FK2 model Civic Type R. On the FL5, the system controls not only pitch and roll, but also introduces considerations for the vertical acceleration of unsprung components. Through this system, Honda aims to offer the same direct handling feeling on the smooth surfaces of the racing circuit as it does on uneven public roads.

Additionally, by linking the car with their smartphone, drivers can review their drive data and share videos of their trips allowing them to enjoy the Type R experience even when they're not behind the wheel.
long.zh:
在追求“爽快”设计理念的第11代“FL”思域基础车型全球首发的一年零三个月后，六代目思域Type R也闪亮登场。

Type R版本基于思域的5门掀背车车型开发。与上几代车型相比，“FL5”思域摈弃了华而不实的改装车风格，保留了运动车型的基本元素，如前后空气动力套件和加宽挡泥板，但采用了更加简洁和精炼的设计。

动力单元更不用说，采用了Type R产品线最新的2升直列4缸涡轮增压引擎K20C。经过对涡轮系统的全面改动和引擎其他方面的优化，比早期型号又多了<10ps>出力，扭矩提高<2kgm>，使得最大动力输出和扭矩分别来到了<330ps>和<42.8kgm>。引擎电子控制单元的脉谱图也得到了专业调校，只为提高油门响应度和低扭。

悬挂方面，用于2015年“FK2”思域Type R的四轮独立自适应避震器再度进化。在“FL5”车款上，这套系统不仅兼顾对前后摇摆和左右晃动的控制，还加入了对无弹动部件的垂直加速的考量。无论是行驶在赛道的平整路面还是坑洼不平的公共道路时，本田希望这套系统都能提供同等标准的、直接的操作手感。

此外，驾驶者可以将智能手机与汽车相连，直观查看驾驶数据并分享行程视频。即便不在车中，也可以畅享Type R世界所带来的乐趣。

conversation.en:
The Type R is an aggressively styled 4-door
hatchback coupe.

This segment was popularized by the original VW Golf GTI.

What sets this one apart is like an action movie with lots
of special effects!

First you notice the big rear wing...

...then the aggressive front flares.

The front is emphasized by huge side nostrils
and a NACA duct on the hood!

The great stance is set up by the tires set out to the
edges and special suspension.

You'll also spot the big red Brembo brake calipers
behind the glossy black wheels.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The fifth-generation Civic Type R made its debut in 2017. While previous models focused on enhancing the base Civic’s performance, the fifth-generation Type R was developed in parallel with the standard model from the ground up. In 2020, the lineup was further refined with the introduction of the Limited Edition model. Weight was reduced by 44 lbs through the removal of soundproofing materials and the adoption of specially forged wheels. Subtle suspension tweaks were also made to sharpen handling. With only 1,000 units produced worldwide, the Limited Edition sold out almost immediately.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第五代Honda Civic Type R于2017年发布。以往车型只是单纯提升基础版Civic的性能，但第五代Type R是与基础车型同步从零开发的。2020年发布的“限量版”车型在性能上得到了进一步提升。通过拆除隔音材料并采用特殊锻造轮毂，整车减重20 公斤。悬挂系统也经过了细微调校。全球限量生产的1000台车几乎瞬间售罄。
officialDetails.heroEn: What will no doubt be a collector car someday, the limited-edition Civic Type R sold out in minutes.
officialDetails.heroZh: 经过特殊调校的限量版Civic Type R。

catch.en: What will no doubt be a collector car someday, the limited-edition Civic Type R sold out in minutes.~

vehicleCollection.en:
What will no doubt be a collector car someday, the limited-edition Civic Type R sold out in minutes.~

In 2017, Honda took its rich history in racing and incorporated it into its popular compact sports coupe, the Civic Type R. Unlike Civic Type Rs before it, this fifth-generation model was not merely an upgraded version of the base Civic, but a car that had been developed from the ground up as a pure Type R performance machine.

The new Civic Type R's turbocharged, direct-injected 2.0-liter inline-4 was carried over from the previous model with power increased by <10ps> to <320ps>, thanks to the fine tuning of the engine control system. The front suspension was totally redesigned, while the rear multilink setup was significantly stiffened. All of these changes resulted in a car that set the fastest FWD lap time at the Nürburgring with a blistering time of 7 minutes 43.80 seconds.

The 2020 model took things a step further with the addition of special forged wheels and a lighter curb weight by <20lb>. With a limited production run of 1000 units, the 2020 Civic Type R sold out in a matter of minutes.

The new Civic Type R's turbocharged, direct-injected 2.0-liter inline-4 was carried over from the previous model with power increased by <10ps> to <320ps>, thanks to the fine tuning of the engine control system. The front suspension was totally redesigned, while the rear multilink setup was significantly stiffened. All of these changes resulted in a car that set the fastest FWD lap time at the Nürburgring with a blistering time of 7 minutes 43.80 seconds.

The 2020 model took things a step further with the addition of special forged wheels and a lighter curb weight by <20lb>. With a limited production run of 1000 units, the 2020 Civic Type R sold out in a matter of minutes.
long.zh:
第五代本田思域Type R的首次亮相要追溯到2017年。与前几代Type R最大的差别在于，这次的车型不再是基于标准版本思域进行性能提升后的产物，而是从一开始就专为Type R量身定制的一款车。

这样一来，各项核心技术零部件都得以采用与标准车型迥异的专项设计方案。

引擎虽然沿袭自上一代，但通过对引擎控制系统的微调，额外挤出了<10ps>，总动力输出提高到了<320ps>。这些改变有效地提升了Type R的整体速度，帮助它重新夺回了纽博格林北侧赛道量产前驱车的最速纪录：7分43.80秒。

2020年发售的限量版Type R对性能做了进一步优化。通过配备特制的锻造轮毂并拆除隔音材料，限量版又轻了<20kg>。性能方面则通过专属减震器和电动助力转向系统调校做了进一步完善。毫无意外，这款全球限量1000辆的车型一经面世，立即售罄。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The original Fit Hybrid debuted in 2010, drawing considerable attention as the first hybrid offering in the B-segment. In 2013, the second-generation Fit Hybrid arrived, built upon the third-generation Fit platform. This updated model featured the Sport Hybrid i-DCD system, paired with a 1.5-liter i-VTEC engine to deliver a combined 137.1 HP. In Japan’s JC08 fuel efficiency cycle, it achieved an impressive rating of 85.7 MPG.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2010年推出的初代Fit Hybrid作为B级车中首款混动车型而备受关注。2013年基于第3代Fit打造的第2代混动版上市推出。搭载Sport Hybrid i-DCD系统，配合1.5升i-VTEC引擎能输出139.5 PS的动力。在日本JC08模式燃油经济性测试下，其油耗低至2.8 升/百公里。

在你踩下油门的瞬间扭矩就会开始运转，

catch.en: The third-generation hybrid Fit utilized i-DCD to maximize energy efficiency.!
catch.zh: 第3代Fit混合动力车型，使用了i-DCD，节能效果更好。

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation hybrid Fit utilized i-DCD to maximize energy efficiency.!

It was natural for Honda to offer a hybrid version of its popular compact vehicle, the Fit, for its lightweight nature made it an exceptional candidate to take full advantage of the company's excellent hybrid system. While the first-generation Fit Hybrid was a great hit, the second-generation model was even better, equipped with a completely new hybrid system.

The Honda IMA (Integrated Motor Assist) in the first generation model had a motor connected directly to the engine--using the engine as the main power source as the motor provided assist as necessary--but the second-gen Fit Hybrid separated the power units. Called the new Sport Hybrid i-DCD (Intelligent Dual Clutch Drive), this new system had a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission with a built-in electric motor that connected the motor to the gasoline engine, which prevented energy loss during regenerative power generation. Also, it allowed the vehicle to be driven in engine, Hybrid, or EV modes, depending on the driving conditions.

This i-DCD system combined with a 1.5-liter i-VTEC engine produced a combined output of <139.5ps>, offering powerful, sporty driving while also achieving the excellent fuel efficiency of <36.4km/l> in JC08 mode.

Aside from the hybrid system, the rest of the Fit was no different than any other third-generation model, with the choice of four trim levels, but the most sporty S package was the only one available with a paddle shifter.

long.en:

The Honda IMA (Integrated Motor Assist) in the first generation model had a motor connected directly to the engine--using the engine as the main power source as the motor provided assist as necessary--but the second-gen Fit Hybrid separated the power units. Called the new Sport Hybrid i-DCD (Intelligent Dual Clutch Drive), this new system had a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission with a built-in electric motor that connected the motor to the gasoline engine, which prevented energy loss during regenerative power generation. Also, it allowed the vehicle to be driven in engine, Hybrid, or EV modes, depending on the driving conditions.

This i-DCD system combined with a 1.5-liter i-VTEC engine produced a combined output of <139.5ps>, offering powerful, sporty driving while also achieving the excellent fuel efficiency of <36.4km/l> in JC08 mode.

Aside from the hybrid system, the rest of the Fit was no different than any other third-generation model, with the choice of four trim levels, but the most sporty S package was the only one available with a paddle shifter.
long.zh:
第二代飞度混动使用的混合驱动系统与第一代截然不同。第一代车型搭载的本田智能电机辅助系统直接连接了电机与引擎。使用引擎作为主要动力来源时，电机会视需要提供动力辅助。第二代飞度混动则采用全新智能双离合驱动系统，以引擎搭配内置电机和新型的七速双离合变速箱。引擎和电机分离的i-DCD系统有很多优势，包括可以回收动力，防止能量流失，并根据驾驶情况在引擎、油电混合及纯电模式间切换。

这套i-DCD系统搭配1.5升i-VTEC引擎，共可输出<139.5ps>。这样的条件让本车得以发挥强悍跑车性能，同时在JC08模式下也能达到<36.4km/l>的高燃油效率。

除了这套特殊的系统外，本车其他配置都与第三代飞度的标准燃油车款相同。本车共推出四种不同配置等级的车型，但只有跑车款的S配置能配备换档拨片。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This high-performance version of the Integra was introduced in 1995. Its B18C engine, derived from the Si model, was enhanced with high-compression pistons, reinforced connecting rods, and dual valve springs, all assembled by hand for maximum precision. The body saw increased rigidity alongside weight reduction, while the suspension was completely reworked to deliver sharp, balanced handling with virtually no understeer. It earned the nickname “the road-going race car.”
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1995年推出的Integra高性能车型。Si版本的B18C引擎经过全面升级，采用高压缩比活塞、强化连杆以及双气门弹簧，所有部件均为纯手工精密装配。在减轻车身重量的同时大幅提升车身刚性，悬挂系统经过彻底改造，实现了稳健精准的操控表现，完全消除了转向不足的倾向。此车也作为可上路的赛车而广为人知。

vehicleCollection.en:
The first Type R model of the Integra, this car was built to be the ultimate front-wheel drive sports car.

The Honda Integra was sold as the Acura Integra in the US.

People didn't call the third-generation Acura Integra the "100 meter eye catcher" for no reason. This term meant that it was instantly recognizable from as far away as 100 meters, a testament to the car’s unusual four round headlights. The new-look Integra proved to be a hit in the U.S. when it arrived in May 1993, but it proved too radical for the Japanese public. So in response to its less-than-stellar sales in Japan, the Japan-market version returned to more conventional-looking trapezoidal headlights two years later.

The second most noteworthy thing about the new Integra was the inclusion of a Type R model. By this time, sports car enthusiasts were already familiar with the "Type R" moniker, thanks to the emergence of the NSX Type R in 1992. In the Integra's case, the engine was based on the Si's 1.8-liter VTEC B18. This high-compression motor featured high-pressure piston heads, special control rods and two-fold valve springs. Each component of this inline-4 was meticulously tuned, resulting in <200ps>, or <111ps> per liter. Honda chassis engineers refortified the Integra's chassis, at the same time making it lighter by removing sound insulation and installing a smaller battery. Switching to lightweight aluminum wheels also shaved off <40kg>. The Type R became the poster child for the ultimate front-wheel-drive sports machine, and spurned the 98spec. R in 1998 that came with equal-length exhausts and 16-in. wheels.

long.zh:
形格Type R于1995年面市。就赛车爱好者而言，对“Type R”的认知来自于92年推出的NSX Type R，意味着“开上街头的赛车”。随着形格的发售，Type R的售价不再高不可攀。

它的引擎是在Si.红线的1.8升B18 VTEC引擎基础上改装而来。高压缩活塞头、高强度连杆和双气门弹簧的使用提高了引擎的压缩性能。所有引擎的组装都由手工完成，能够提供<200ps>，相当于每升排量对应<111ps>。车身经过加固，并降低了车重。尽管增加了高性能连杆和螺旋限滑差速器等分量较重的零件，但还是通过缩小电池尺寸、去除隔音材料、采用轻型铝制轮毂等方式减掉了40公斤的车重。它的基础悬挂设置在经过调整后彻底消除了转向不足的情况。

形格Type R刚一上市，就俨然成为了高性能前轮驱动车的代表。

Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest
compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.

At its release, this first-gen Integra Type R came with a
price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.

It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their
skills as only a Type R could.

The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up
version usedin the base model...

...producing <20ps> more output.

The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted

engineering.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This car introduced the concept of the Type R, a road-going race car. At its heart was the 1.8-liter VTEC B18C engine, hand-built with a high-compression head and carefully matched connecting rods to produce 197.2 HP. While performance parts like the helical LSD added weight, it was offset by stripping out comfort features, resulting in pure speed.

When it comes to front-drive performance cars, Honda is
among the world's elites.

One of its FF jewels was the Integra Type R, the second 'Type R'
to ever appear after the incredible NSX Type R.

Under its hood is a 1.8-liter naturally-aspirated inline-4,
that revs all the way up to an incredible <8500rpm>!

Did you know the technology that went into this engine trickled
down from Honda's participation in Formula 1 racing?

It possesses a special undercarriage too, making the car
super stable at high speeds.

Thanks to its power and razor-sharp handling, this 1998 Spec R
is totally at home at the race track.;

这辆车有能力攻克任何急弯。

这款车型是98年Spec R，该晚期车款的底盘得到了改进，
稳定性更佳。

vehicleCollection.en:
This third-gen Integra Type R received more power and hand-crafted tuning.

The legend of the "Type R," which was designated to the highest-performance Honda vehicles began in 1992 with the NSX Type R; however, Honda decided to bring the brand to the masses by creating a lower-priced version, which came in the form of the Integra Type R in 1995.

The engine was based on the 1.8-liter B18 VTEC equipped in the Si. Redline and engine compression was increased using high-compression piston heads, high-strength connecting rods, and dual-valve springs. Each engine was assembled by hand, and what a piece of work it was. It produced <200ps>, which equals <111ps> per liter of displacement. The body was reinforced and, despite the use of heavy parts such as performance rods and a helical LSD, the car weighed <40kg> less, thanks to a smaller battery, the lack of soundproofing material, and lightweight aluminum wheels. The suspension was retuned for sharper handling, minimizing the car's tendency to understeer.

When it was released to the market, this Integra Type R became the golden standard of high-performance front-wheel drive-cars.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Honda’s N-ONE was a retro-inspired kei-car that paid homage to the company's first entry into the segment, the classic N360. The second-generation model retained the charming silhouette of the original, but rode on a completely new chassis that brought modern refinement to its compact dimensions. Among the highlights of the lineup was the RS trim, a sporty variant that borrowed close-ratio gearing from the S660 sports car. It featured reinforced synchronizers for second and third gear, and a heavy-duty clutch to handle spirited driving. While the RS badge had been offered on the first-gen N-ONE, the new RS stood out as the first kei-car to pair a turbocharged, front-wheel-drive layout with a 6-speed manual transmission — a groundbreaking move in the world of Japan’s smallest cars.

vehicleCollection.en:
This performance-focused model is a first kei-car with front-wheel drive, a turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual transmission.

The N-ONE was introduced as a new basic model, taking design cues from the original N360—Honda’s first kei-car. Launched in 2012, the first-generation N-ONE quickly earned praise for its charming looks and fun-to-drive nature.

By 2020, it had entered its second generation. Although the platform was redesigned, strong fan demand for continuity meant the body panels from the original model were carried over. Instead, Honda refined the shape of the grille and bumper, subtly signaling the model’s evolution.

The second-generation sports variant was named the RS, short for Road Sailing. While the RS badge also appeared on the first-generation model, the new version introduced a key upgrade: a front-mounted turbocharged engine paired with front-wheel drive and a 6-speed manual gearbox—one that made it even more enjoyable to drive.

The RS also featured exclusive styling with black trim pieces, but the standout element remained the 6-speed manual transmission. Geared for enthusiasts, the transmission used close ratios similar to the S660. Second and third gears benefited from heavy-duty synchros, and the clutch system was similarly reinforced.

Despite its performance focus, the RS also included modern driving aids. A peak torque limiter smoothed out clutch engagement, while auto brake hold helped during hill starts—features that made the car more approachable in daily use.

Weighing in at under <1000kg> and with compact dimensions, the N-ONE RS delivered sharp, responsive handling not typically expected from a car in this class. The result was a well-balanced package that brought the fun and excitement of sports driving to the masses.

long.zh:
N-ONE作为一款全新的基础车型推出，融入了本田首款轻型车规格乘用车N360的经典设计元素。第一代车型于2012年上市，凭借俏皮的外观设计和出色的驾驶性能赢得了业界好评和市场认可。

2020年，N-ONE迎来了第二代车型。虽然车身框架经过了全面革新，但应广大车迷保持外观不变的强烈要求，第一代车型的车身面板得以延续使用。取而代之的是对前格栅和保险杠造型的细微调整，以可爱的都市品味诠释车型的进化升级。

第二代运动版本被命名为“RS”，寓意“公路巡航”。虽然第一代也有RS版本，但第二代车型首次采用前置涡轮增压引擎配前轮驱动，搭配6速手动变速箱的组合，驾驶乐趣更上一层楼。

RS版本采用专属的外观设计搭配黑色边饰件，但最引人注目的特色当属那台6速变速箱。专为驾驶爱好者打造的传动系统采用了与S660相同的密齿比档位，2档和3档配备重载同步器，离合器同样使用强化部件。

另一方面，它也像其他现代手动挡车型一样配备了丰富的辅助功能，包括峰值扭矩限制器（减少急抬离合时的换挡顿挫）和自动驻车功能（让坡道起步等操作更加轻松）。

得益于紧凑的车身尺寸和不足<1000kg>的轻盈重量，驾驶感受比同类车型更加直接纯粹。总而言之，此车可以说是一个极具吸引力的整合方案，让普通人也能感受运动驾驶的乐趣。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Making its official debut 25 years after the original, the second-generation NSX emerged as a true supercar, equipped with an advanced electric all-wheel-drive system called the Sports Hybrid SH-AWD, which employed independent electric motors on the front wheels. By enhancing both acceleration and deceleration, it enabled torque vectoring that provided exceptional stability through corners across the entire speed range.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 在初代上市的25年之后，第二代NSX也千呼万唤始出来。这款超级跑车采用了一套被称为“运动混动SH-AWD”的电动四驱系统，左右前轮也分别安装了独立的电机。这次更新换代的提升不仅在于加速和刹车性能，这套系统还提供了扭矩矢量控制功能，能够在各种不同的速度范围下确保稳定过弯。

vehicleCollection.en:
Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.

The Acura NSX became an icon after only several years on the market, and although it was gone in 2005, it was hardly forgotten. To the delight of performance-car enthusiasts everywhere, Honda introduced a concept of a second-generation car in 2012, and then gave us a production version of it at the 2015 North American International Auto Show.

The new NSX came in the form of a mid-engine supercar that combined aluminum, high tensile steel and other advanced materials in the chassis, covered by a lightweight carbon-fiber body. The engine, mounted behind the cockpit, came in the form of a twin-turbo V-6 with a dry sump, mated to 9-speed dual-clutch transmission with a built-in motor. There were also electric motors powering the front wheels to make the new NSX an all-wheel-drive machine. The AWD system, called the Sports Hybrid SH-AWD, allows torque vectoring that controls deceleration as well as drive force, enhancing the car’s ability to corner.

The NSX also featured an Integrated Dynamic System that possessed four modes—the lowest one allowed driving with electric power alone at low speeds, while the highest one combined the gasoline engine and electric motors to provide the highest performance, intended for use on the racetrack.

long.zh:
第一代NSX于2005年停产，但是第二代NSX则在2012年以概念赛车的形式亮相。三年后，在2015年的底特律车展，该车的量产型号终于正式发布。

第二代本田NSX，也是美国讴歌品牌的一部分，是一台中置引擎超跑。它结合了铝合金、高强抗拉钢、以及走在时代前列的各类高端材料，搭配上使用了碳纤维和其他复合材料的轻量化车身，以及全铝独立悬挂。

驾驶室后方安置的引擎是一台双涡轮V6干式油底盘引擎，还配备了9档双踏板离合器以及内置电机。此系统与左前和右前轮的电机相结合，形成了一套完整的电力四驱系统。此系统名为Sports Hybrid SH-AWD，可进行扭矩矢量分配，从而可以对减速和传动力进行控制，提升了该车在使用各种速度过弯的时候依然紧贴理想线路的能力。

本车还配备了一套整合式动力系统，其包含了4种模式，既有在低速时仅依靠电动机提供动力的模式，也有在赛道上释放其极限动力性能的模式。

vehicleCollection.en:
This race machine claimed the Super GT championship in 2016 equipped with a conventional gasoline engine.

The NSX CONCEPT-GT was Honda’s entry into the GT500 class of the Super GT series, competing from 2014 to 2016. It was based on the NSX concept car unveiled by Honda in 2012, which previewed the forthcoming production model of the new-generation NSX. The concept employed a hybrid powertrain that combined a mid-mounted V-6 engine with electric motors.

Like other GT500 machines, the NSX Concept GT was built under the 2014 regulations that aligned with DTM technical standards. Unlike its rivals, however, it featured a midship-mounted turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection—developed within a unified format across manufacturers. It also incorporated a hybrid system similar to the production car. However, to prevent the system from providing an unfair advantage, a minimum weight was imposed, and strict limits were placed on both the electric assist output and energy usage.

While the car faced numerous challenges during its debut season in 2014, performance improved significantly in 2015. In 2016, however, Honda encountered supply issues from its battery manufacturer, forcing the team to compete without the hybrid system. The Raybrig NSX CONCEPT-GT was one of the standout cars in this program. In 2014, with Takashi Kogure and Hideki Mutoh at the helm, it finished 11th in the team rankings. long.en:
The NSX CONCEPT-GT was Honda’s entry into the GT500 class of the Super GT series, competing from 2014 to 2016. It was based on the NSX concept car unveiled by Honda in 2012, which previewed the forthcoming production model of the new-generation NSX. The concept employed a hybrid powertrain that combined a mid-mounted V-6 engine with electric motors.

Like other GT500 machines, the NSX Concept GT was built under the 2014 regulations that aligned with DTM technical standards. Unlike its rivals, however, it featured a midship-mounted turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection—developed within a unified format across manufacturers. It also incorporated a hybrid system similar to the production car. However, to prevent the system from providing an unfair advantage, a minimum weight was imposed, and strict limits were placed on both the electric assist output and energy usage.

While the car faced numerous challenges during its debut season in 2014, performance improved significantly in 2015. In 2016, however, Honda encountered supply issues from its battery manufacturer, forcing the team to compete without the hybrid system. The Raybrig NSX CONCEPT-GT was one of the standout cars in this program. In 2014, with Takashi Kogure and Hideki Mutoh at the helm, it finished 11th in the team rankings. In 2015, driven by Naoki Yamamoto and Takuya Izawa, it climbed to an impressive 3rd place in the series standings. However, 2016 proved difficult for all Honda teams, with the season ending in a disappointing 12th place.

NSX Concept GT是本田推出的一款赛车，于2014年到2016年参加超级跑车系列赛的GT500级别比赛。这款车的原型NSX是本田于2012年发布的概念车，这款车是作为新一代NSX量产车而开发的。概念车型采用了中置式V6引擎与电机相结合的混合动力系统。

和其他GT500车型一样，NSX Concept GT根据2014年新颁布的规则开发，该规则中加入德国房车大师赛的车辆规则。车辆的不同之处在于采用中置式安装的2升涡轮增压直列式4缸直喷引擎，由不同公司各自按照统一规格专门开发，并配置有和量产公路车相同的混合动力系统。然而，为了避免从这些配置中获得不公平的优势，车身最小重量、电力辅助输出和能量使用都受到了限制。

NSX Concept GT在参赛的第一年发生了各种问题，好在从2015年开始，这款车渐渐跟上了节奏。然而在2016年，车厂遇到了电池供应商方面的问题，因此参赛车辆都没有使用混合动力系统。Raybrig NSX Concept GT是参赛车辆之一。2014年，由小暮卓史和武藤英纪担任车手的车队取得了车队排名第11名的成绩，在2015年，山本直树和伊泽拓为车队取得了系列赛第3名的成绩。然而，2016年对本田车队来说并不是个好年头，他们最终仅位列系列赛的第12名。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new design with a lower center of gravity was the key to victory for this JGTC champion.

During the 2000 All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC), Japan's Big Three automakers—Honda, Toyota and Nissan—engaged in an unprecedented war for the GT500-class title.

he NSX development team made major changes to the 2000 model, going as far as repositioning the transverse mounted engine. Installing the V-type engine in a transverse layout helped to shorten the length of the vehicle, but the layout created problems in routing the exhaust pipes from the two cylinder banks. Previously, the NSX's exhaust pipes ran under the engine, but the development team decided to re-route them to the sides to lower the engine itself.

In this configuration, the gearbox, which was mounted on the side of the engine, was in the way. Therefore, to make space for the exhaust pipes, the team set about redesigning a smaller gearbox. The result was a completely bespoke transmission that employed formula car gears, which are thinner and more compact than normal.

Five NSX cars entered the 2000 season. Among them, the Castrol Mugen NSX, along with Takata Dome NSX, took on the role of advanced-development "works cars" inside the NSX camp.

The Takata Dome NSX delivered an impressive performance, winning two races. However, due to the weight handicap system of the JGTC, it fell short of the series title. The Castrol Mugen NSX emerged in its shadow. Ryo Michigami drove it, and Osamu Nakako drove it until he was replaced by Hidetoshi Mitsusada halfway through the season.  Despite the extra weight from its first-place finish, the Castrol Mugen NSX drove away with the championship.

Installing the V-type engine in a transverse layout helped to shorten the length of the vehicle, but the layout created problems in routing the exhaust pipes from the two cylinder banks. long.zh:
在2000年的全日本GT锦标赛上，三家巨头制造商本田、丰田和日产为了争夺豪华旅行车500组别的冠军头衔展开了史诗般的拼搏。

NSX开发团队决定对2000型号进行重大改进，甚至大刀阔斧地调整了横置引擎的位置。将V形引擎进行横置安装可以有效缩短车身长度，不过这种布局也增加了从两个气缸组向外布置排气管的难度。之前车型的排气管多从引擎下方通过，不过这一次开发团队决定将排气管挪到侧面，进而降低引擎的高度。

不过若采用这种配置，原本安装在引擎侧面的变速箱就会挡住排气管。为了给排气管腾出空间，团队开始着手设计一款体积更小的变速箱，最后为其打造出了一套定制传动系统，其采用的方程式赛车齿轮相比于普通齿轮更薄、更紧凑。

总共有五支NSX车队参加了2000赛季的比赛。而在整个NSX阵营中，嘉实多无限NSX车队和高田童梦NSX车队的赛车扮演了领衔开发“厂队车”的角色。

高田童梦NSX展现出了压倒性的性能优势，拿下了比赛胜利。然而全日本GT锦标赛赛事规则中独有的车重限制成为了极大的不利因素，导致车队最终未能登上锦标赛冠军宝座。反而是嘉实多无限NSX异军突起，拿出了一场又一场稳定的表现。这辆车由道上龙和中子修驾驶，中子修在赛季半程时被替换成了光贞秀俊。嘉实多无限NSX车队巧妙地化解了因第1名完赛而受到的车重限制，势如破竹地夺得了系列赛的冠军头衔。

conversation.en:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model
of this EPSON NSX?

It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist
Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.

It’s entirely made of cardboard, including
the tires and all of the other intricate parts.

It looks like the real thing, as if it could
drive off at a moment’s notice.

But I digress.

The real NSX competed under EPSON colors
in Japnese GT races from 2004 to 2009.

At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship
was evolving into the Super GT Series.

The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008
season, where it came in 2nd place in ound 8 race.

你知道吗？这款ESPON NSX居然还有一套全尺寸的纸模呢。

这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出

dialogues.en:
The prototype and final production model
of the original NSX...

...was designed by my friend and former chief
designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.

The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...

...so you know it had plenty of fighting power.

The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and that
year, this car took the title, winning five of nine races

Because of its incredible speed, you can almost say
that the series imposed a weight-handicap system.

The next year, in 2008, the NSX's main highlight was a 2nd-place
finish in the eighth race of the season at Autoplis.
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.zh:
这辆初代NSX的原型和最终量产型……

都是由我的朋友、前Honda首席设计师中野正人所设计的。

NSX的性能目标是要超越Ferrari 328和348，

所以可想而知，它的战斗力极其惊人。

GT500组别的赛事在2007年采用了阶梯式淘汰规则，

在这一年里，这辆NSX不仅赢得了冠军，还拿下了
九场比赛中的五场胜利。

因为它所向无敌的速度，甚至会让人们怀疑这项系列赛
是否对其他参赛车辆采用了加重平衡制度。

在接下来的2008年，NSX最亮眼的表现则出现在奥托波里斯赛道，
它AsH的第八场比赛中以第二名G赛。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This is a version of the NSX that competed in the 2008 Super GT championship. Despite facing disadvantages that season—including running with the previous year’s chassis, weight handicaps, and a restricted air intake—the car remained competitive thanks to significant improvements in both engine performance and aerodynamics. In Round 8 at Autopolis, the EPSON NSX secured a 2nd-place finish.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这台车是参加过2008年Super GT锦标赛的NSX的一个版本。在那个赛季，NSX需要面对重重不利条件，除了连续两年使用相同的主车架，还要安装配重和更小的引擎限制器，但引擎和空气动力学上的改进让其依旧保持竞争力。Epson NSX在第8轮的AUTOPOLIS/奥托波里斯赛道中斩获第2名。
officialDetails.heroEn: The special race NSX brings to mind the bold driving styles of racers Loic Duval and Katsuyuki Hiranaka.
officialDetails.heroZh: 看到这台车，就让人联想起Loic Duval和平中克幸勇敢无畏的驾驶风格。

brandCentral.en:
The Super GT is Japan's most prestigious GT car racing
series, and it wouldn't be the same without the NSX.

This particular model is the EPSON NSX, which was raced
by Nakajima Racing in the 2008 season.

Production of first generation NSXs ceased in 2002...

But versions produced for the Super GT continued
to be developed independently.

This model was the only one of the NSXs of its time to be
equipped with Dunlop tyres...

Meaning it couldn't benefit from data-sharing with other NSX
teams—but that didn’t stop it from dominating the track!
brandCentral.zh:
GT是日本最负盛名的GT车型赛事，而如果没有NSX的参
与，这项锦标赛就不会如此成功。

这款特殊的车型是EPSON NSX，曾由中岛车队驾驶在2008赛季出赛。

第一代NSX的生产虽然早在2002年就停止了……

但为超级跑车生产的赛车版本仍在继续独立开发。

这款车型是当时的NSX中唯一使用邓禄普轮胎的车型……

这意味着此车无法从与其他NSX车队的数据共享中获益，
但这并没有妨碍其在赛道上占据主导优势。

catch.zh: 看到这台车，就让人联想起Loic Duval和平中克幸勇敢无畏的驾驶风格。

vehicleCollection.en:
The special race NSX brings to mind the bold driving styles of racers Loic Duval and Katsuyuki Hiranaka.

The Super GT Series has been the most popular touring car racing series in Japan, even when it was operating under its former name, the JGTC (Japanese Grand Touring Championship). In 2007, new regulations for top-tier GT500 cars called for a skidplate measuring <30mm> to be added beneath the car in an effort to reduce cornering speeds.

This new rule hardly had an effect on the Honda NSX as it went on to win five of that year's nine races. The following season, while the NSX teams were allowed to use the same successful chassis as the previous year (thanks to a regulation that required the main frame be used two years in a row), the rules committee decided to allow other cars to catch up by imposing a <50kg> weight handicap to the NSX (this was reduced to <40kg> from Round 3 on). In addition, the committee imposed smaller engine restrictors for the cars, which slowed the NSXs down even more.

In response, Honda revised the specifications of its <3494cc> 32B V-6 for added throttle response, improved the car's aerodynamics, and made it even lighter.

There were five NSXs competing that year, and the EPSON NSX of Nakajima Racing was the only one running with DUNLOP tires, making them the odd man out when it came to data sharing with the other NSX teams.

Drivers Loïc Duval and Katsuyuki Hiranaka exceeded everyone's expectations, finishing 2nd in the eighth round at Autopolis, which was their highest placing of the year./

long.zh:
Super GT是日本最受欢迎的房车赛事。从2007年起，这项赛事的GT500组别中加入了一项阶梯式底盘规则。在此之前，规则要求使用平滑的底盘，而新规则要求在车辆底部加入一个<30mm>的防滑板，进而降低过弯速度。

本田NSX巧妙地解决了规则问题，并展现出了他们的惊人速度，在总共9轮比赛中赢得了5轮，称霸了这项赛事。在第二年里，他们遵守规定，连续两年使用相同的主车架。但因为前一年的速度太快，从系列赛开始时，赛事方要求使用特殊的性能调节器，在NSX的车上增加一个<50kg>的障碍配重（从第3轮开始改为<40kg>），并且要求他们将引擎限制器改得更小。

为了应对要求，本田修改了他们的<3494cc>排量32B V6引擎的细节规格，提高了驾驶操控性。另外，他们还额外改良了空气动力学外形，减轻了车身重量，以将横摆惯性影响最小化。

2008年的赛事中共有5辆NSX出征，只有中岛赛车派出的EPSON NSX使用了邓禄普轮胎。因此他们在数据共享方面处于不利地位，好在有卢里克·杜瓦尔和平中克幸挺身而出，在奥托波里斯赛道举办的第8轮比赛中取得了第二名的好成绩，这也是他们在当届赛事中取得的最高名次。

在这一年的Super GT中，日产GT-R展现出了超强的性能，而上述两名车手则在年度总排名中位居第10。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX sports car has been reengineered to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. It features a range of aerodynamic enhancements, including a large front splitter with precision cutouts to manage airflow, and a swan-neck rear wing.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.3规则进行改装而来。这款车为了提升空气动力学性能而加装了若干部件，例如大尺寸前定风翼和天鹅颈尾翼，其中前者还为了平稳气流而刻有沟槽。
officialDetails.heroEn: Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.
officialDetails.heroZh: 自第一代车型推出以来，经受住了25年的考验，打开了SH-AWD跑车的新天地。

brandCentral.en:
This original Gran Turismo Gr.3 vehicle was built using the
second generation NSX as its base.

The large front splitter and swan-neck rear wing are just
two of many new additions.

These custom components are designed to improve the car's
aerodynamic profile, and grant it a clear advantage.

The base model's 4WD system has been converted to a rear-
wheel drive one in accordance with Gr.3 regulations.
brandCentral.zh:
这款原创跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车使用第二代NSX作为
基础车型。

并加入了若干项新部件，比如大尺寸的前定风翼和天鹅颈
尾翼。

这些定制化组件可以有效提升车辆的空气动力学性能，
为其赋予了极大的优势。

为了符合组别3规范，基础车型的四驱系统也被更改成一套
后驱系统。

catch.en: Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.
catch.zh: 自第一代车型推出以来，经受住了25年的考验，打开了SH-AWD跑车的新天地。

vehicleCollection.en:
Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.

The Acura NSX became an icon after only several years on the market, and although it was gone in 2005, it was hardly forgotten. To the delight of performance-car enthusiasts everywhere, Honda introduced a concept of a second-generation car in 2012, and then gave us a production version of it at the 2015 North American International Auto Show.

The new NSX came in the form of a mid-engine supercar that combined aluminum, high tensile steel and other advanced materials in the chassis, covered by a lightweight carbon-fiber body. The engine, mounted behind the cockpit, came in the form of a twin-turbo V-6 with a dry sump, mated to 9-speed dual-clutch transmission with a built-in motor. There were also electric motors powering the front wheels to make the new NSX an all-wheel-drive machine. The AWD system, called the Sports Hybrid SH-AWD, allows torque vectoring that controls deceleration as well as drive force, enhancing the car’s ability to corner.

The NSX also featured an Integrated Dynamic System that possessed four modes—the lowest one allowed driving with electric power alone at low speeds, while the highest one combined the gasoline engine and electric motors to provide the highest performance, intended for use on the racetrack.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
第一代NSX于2005年停产，但是第二代NSX则在2012年以概念赛车的形式亮相。三年后，在2015年的底特律车展，该车的量产型号终于正式发布。

第二代本田NSX，也是美国讴歌品牌的一部分，是一台中置引擎超跑。它结合了铝合金、高强抗拉钢、以及走在时代前列的各类高端材料，搭配上使用了碳纤维和其他复合材料的轻量化车身，以及全铝独立悬挂。

驾驶室后方安置的引擎是一台双涡轮V6干式油底盘引擎，还配备了9档双踏板离合器以及内置电机。此系统与左前和右前轮的电机相结合，形成了一套完整的电力四驱系统。此系统名为Sports Hybrid SH-AWD，可进行扭矩矢量分配，从而可以对减速和传动力进行控制，提升了该车在使用各种速度过弯的时候依然紧贴理想线路的能力。

本车还配备了一套整合式动力系统，其包含了4种模式，既有在低速时仅依靠电动机提供动力的模式，也有在赛道上释放其极限动力性能的模式。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: A Gran Turismo Original, Honda’s flagship NSX sports car has been adapted to meet Gr.4 regulations. This design prioritizes preserving the character of the base car, adding only a subtle front splitter, compact canards, and a rear wing. To enhance structural rigidity, a rear bulkhead has been added, accompanied by a rear camera.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Honda的旗舰跑车NSX针对Gr.4规则进行改装而来。它的设计注重于利用基础车型的优势，只加装了小尺寸定风翼、前翼和尾翼。为了提升刚性，车身上还加装了后隔板，以及一部后方摄像头。
officialDetails.heroEn: This second-generation NSX with SH-AWD was modified for Gr.4 competition.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一款专为Gr.4竞赛而改装的SH-AWD四驱系统2代NSX。

brandCentral.en:
The second generation NSX was the base model for this
Gran Turismo Gr.4 original racing car.

The replacement of the rear bulkhead has dramatically
improved the rigidity of its frame...

And a rear-wheel drive layout has been used
to meet Gr.4 regulations.
brandCentral.zh:
第二代NSX是这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车的基础
车型。

它的后隔板进行了整体更换，以大幅增加车身框架的刚性……

另外为了符合组别4规则，改成了使用后轮驱动。

catch.en: This second-generation NSX with SH-AWD was modified for Gr.4 competition.
catch.zh: 一款专为Gr.4竞赛而改装的SH-AWD四驱系统2代NSX。

The Acura NSX became an icon after only several years on the market, and although it was gone in 2005, it was hardly forgotten. To the delight of performance-car enthusiasts everywhere, Honda introduced a concept of a second-generation car in 2012, and then gave us a production version of it at the 2015 North American International Auto Show.

The new NSX came in the form of a mid-engine supercar that combined aluminum, high tensile steel and other advanced materials in the chassis, covered by a lightweight carbon-fiber body. The engine, mounted behind the cockpit, came in the form of a twin-turbo V-6 with a dry sump, mated to 9-speed dual-clutch transmission with a built-in motor. There were also electric motors powering the front wheels to make the new NSX an all-wheel-drive machine. The AWD system, called the Sports Hybrid SH-AWD, allows torque vectoring that controls deceleration as well as drive force, enhancing the car’s ability to corner.

The NSX also featured an Integrated Dynamic System that possessed four modes—the lowest one allowed driving with electric power alone at low speeds, while the highest one combined the gasoline engine and electric motors to provide the highest performance, intended for use on the racetrack.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

第二代本田NSX，也是美国讴歌品牌的一部分，是一台中置引擎超跑。它结合了铝合金、高强抗拉钢、以及走在时代前列的各类高端材料，搭配上使用了碳纤维和其他复合材料的轻量化车身，以及全铝独立悬挂。

驾驶室后方安置的引擎是一台双涡轮V6干式油底盘引擎，还配备了9档双踏板离合器以及内置电机。此系统与左前和右前轮的电机相结合，形成了一套完整的电力四驱系统。此系统名为Sports Hybrid SH-AWD，可进行扭矩矢量分配，从而可以对减速和传动力进行控制，提升了该车在使用各种速度过弯的时候依然紧贴理想线路的能力。

本车还配备了一套整合式动力系统，其包含了4种模式，既有在低速时仅依靠电动机提供动力的模式，也有在赛道上释放其极限动力性能的模式。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The second-wave NSX Type R made its debut in 2002. In addition to the original Type R’s weight-saving measures and increased rigidity, this model underwent a full aerodynamic redesign, generating remarkable levels of downforce rarely seen in a road car. Carbon fiber was employed extensively, including for key components such as the hood and rear wing. During a time attack at the Nürburgring Nordschleife, the car shattered expectations by breaking the eight-minute barrier, a feat once thought unattainable for a road car.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款第二代NSX Type R于2002年发布。在继承初代Type R的轻量化和刚性提升基础上，这款车型还进行了全面的空气动力学改进，作为一款公路车达成了惊人的下压力。引擎盖和尾翼等部位大量采用了碳纤维部件。在纽博格林北侧赛道的计时圈中，这款车成功突破了此前被视为公路车极限的8分钟大关。
officialDetails.heroEn: Thanks to advancements in aerodynamics, the 2nd-gen NSX had more downforce than the original.

brandCentral.en:
This improved Honda NSX Type R, also known as the 02R,
was released in 2002.

Its lightweight body and sport-tuned suspension made it
a monster on the track.

Part of the reason was an excellent aerodynamic shape
that allowed the car to generate gobs of downforce.

You'll be hard-pressed to find a car that feels as good to
drive as this one.
brandCentral.zh:
这款改进后的NSX Type R也被称为02R，于2002年发布。

其轻巧的车身和坚硬的悬挂大大提升了其在赛道上的表现。

此车还拥有出色的空气动力学设计，可产生强大的下压力。

您很难找到像这款车一样易于驾驶的车了！

Released in 2002, this baby is an updated version of the
first-generation NSX Type R.

It uses the NA2 model NSX as a base, which means that it
came powered by a 3.2-liter V-6.

One of this car's charms was its refined aerodynamic profile.

Modifications were made to its underside to improve air flow,
and several major aerodynamic components were added.

So you can bet that its handling and stability at high speeds
were impressive, to say the least.

The naturally-aspirated V-6 revs like a dream — and its power
will have you comfortable attacking any circuit.

于2002年上市。

它以NA2型NSX为基础，
搭载了3.2升V6引擎。

它的主要卖点是经过优化的空气动力设计。

经过改造的底盘获得了更优秀的空气流动性，
并装上了数个轻量化组件。

这些改进使此型号的高速操控性和稳定性达到了
优越的水准。

大马力自然吸气V6引擎
有着令人满意的动力，并赋予了这辆车足以攻克任何赛道的性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
Thanks to advancements in aerodynamics, the 2nd-gen NSX had more downforce than the original.

Beginning in November of 1992, the first-generation NSX Type R was available over the course of a limited three-year-period run, and then became an icon. Seven years later, a new NSX-R was shown as a concept car at the 2001 Tokyo Motor Show, reviving the legend. Not long after, the NSX Type R once again became available to the public when it went on sale in May of 2002.

Why such a long period between Type R models? With the base NSX's performance threshold already so high, engineers elected to wait for new cutting-edge automotive technology to incorporate into their creation rather than just carry over pre-existing packages.

Special emphasis was placed not on the engine, which was addressed when the second-generation NSX's power plant had its displacement increased and was fitted with a new 6-speed manual transmission, but in the area of aerodynamics. The work done in this area resulted in a rare feat for a commercially available vehicle: a shape that not only produced negative lift but generated downforce.

In order to achieve this newfound aerodynamic efficiency, a newly-shaped hood and rear wing were created; lightweight carbon-fiber was used unsparingly in these vital components. The final result was a new NSX Type R that became the first street-legal road car to lap the famed Nürburgring course in less than 8 minutes, an unheard of feat for a full-fledged production car at the time.

long.zh:
第一代NSX Type R发售于1992年11月，只销售了3年便宣告停产，却在坊间成为了一代传说。7年之后，NSX-R的概念赛车在2001年东京车展上发布，2002年5月的发售版本也几乎和车展版别无二致。

早些年的时候，标准版NSX曾提升引擎排量，并换用了6速变速箱。也因此，Type R回归的传闻不胫而走。不过最终在97年亮相的高性能车型却是一台Type S Zero。开发团队之所以没有在97年就将Type R带回大众视线，原因其实很简单，当时的技术尚不足以配置出一台合格的Type R。

第一代Type R所追求的轻量化、高刚性是1992年备受追捧的理念。而要重新复活“R”的金字招牌，不只是继承旧的理念那么简单，需要引入革命性的、更前沿的新技术。

最终，本田找到了能与R的盛名匹配的改进方向—空气动力学。在第二代Type R身上，对空气动力学的调整几乎深入到了每一个细节，也为我们带来一台别具一格的商业车款：可以提供负升力的车体，或者换个更简明的说法，制造下压力。

为了实现效果，前引擎盖和尾翼都毫不吝啬地用上了碳纤维材质。当然，新款Type R并未放弃奠基之作所追求的减重与刚性要求。车内的其他设备也得到了更新，以符合新时代的配置标准。

追随着前代，新一代NSX Type R再次挑战纽博格林赛道，甚至跑进了8分钟。时至今日，仍是公路车纪录中不可逾越的一道高墙。

vehicleCollection.en:
The first of the Honda Type R series, only 500 cars of this rare model were produced.

The NSX proved to be a major hit with both automotive enthusiasts and the media alike, but the limited-edition NSX Type R (NSX-R) that went on sale in Japan in November 1992 took Honda's mid-engine sports car formula to the extreme limits. This ultimate sports car was so well received that the "R" designation eventually made its way into the lineup of Honda's more mainstream cars, namely the Civic and Integra.

Honda's engineering philosophy for its Type R vehicles followed two main principles: "less weight" and "increased rigidity." In the case of the NSX, this meant removing the car's air-conditioning unit and sound system hardware, not to mention all of its sound absorbing insulation. Other changes included installing lightweight seat and wheels. The result was a lean performance machine that tipped the scales at a low <1230kg> (the stock NSX weighed <1350kg>), improving the Type R's weight-to-power ratio from the base car's <4.82kg/ps> to <4.39kg/ps>.

Complementing its new lean body was improved structural rigidity that came via additional bracing throughout its aluminum monocoque chassis. Stiffer shocks and springs on the suspension system were also key contributors. Overall, the Type R behaved like an entirely different animal when compared to the base NSX, especially on the racetrack where the car belonged. Less than 500 NSX Type Rs were produced during the car's limited three-year run, with all of them now considered collector items by many Honda fans.

Complementing its new lean body was improved structural rigidity that came via additional bracing throughout its aluminum monocoque chassis. long.zh:
对于备受车迷青睐的跑车来说，持续进化是必需项。NSX当然也遵循着这样的原则，通过每年推陈出新的改装来完善其车型。1992年11月发售的NSX Type R是其进化历史当中极其重要的一款车。

NSX本就是一款性能卓越、配置完善的车型，而Type R则向完美又迈进了一大步。虽然大家对Type R的认知大多来自于之后几年里陆续推出的形格和思域，但最初的理念践行者，是这台NSX Type R。

本田在这台NSX身上投注的是轻量化与高刚性的理念。为了尽可能降低重量，空调、车内音响系统，乃至保温层都可以舍弃，只留下驾驶性能相关的部件。随着座椅、方向盘和轮毂都换成轻量化的版本，本田终于将标准版本的1350kg降到了1230kg。重量马力比从标准车款的<1ps>对应4.82kg，降到了<1ps>对应4.39kg。

为了与提升后的动力匹配，NSX Type R采用了高刚性的车架。单体车壳的各处加入了铝管作为加固，与刚性结构连接的避震器、弹簧乃至衬套的性能全都用到了极限。

虽然引擎没有变化，但车重的减轻可以视作动力的提升。车速自然也获得了提升。每一台Type R的引擎在出厂前都接受了一对一的调校，使得高转速下的引擎表现让人欲罢不能。截至1996年停产前，NSX Type R仅只生产了不足500台，被送到翘首以盼的车主手中。>

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The "Honda Project 2&4 powered by RC213V" was the result of a collaboration between Honda’s design team and Gran Turismo. It combined the 212 HP engine from the Honda RC213V-S with an ultra-lightweight 893 lbs body, creating a unique form of mobility that offered the open-air freedom and agility of a motorcycle, combined with the handling precision and lateral G-forces of a 4-wheeled vehicle.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款“Honda Project 2&4 powered by RC213V”诞生自Honda设计团队和《跑车浪漫旅》的合作项目。它的设计结合了215 PS的Honda RC213V-S引擎和仅重405 公斤的超轻量车身，实现了一种新形态的运动体验，结合了摩托车的开放性与敏捷性和四轮汽车的操控性及横向重力加速度。
