brandCentral.en:
This ultra-lightweight pure sports car concept was born from
the collaboration between Honda and Gran Turismo.

The design theme drew inspiration from Honda's first
Formula 1 race cars in the 1960s.

Its power unit incorporates technologies developed
for superbikes.

The engine is normally used in the Honda RC213V-S,
which is a MotoGP class motorcycle.

The car demonstrates the company's ability to compete in
all manner of races, be it on two wheels or four.
brandCentral.zh:
这款超轻量级的纯正跑车的概念设计来自于
Honda和跑车浪漫旅的合作项目。

其设计主题源自Honda 60年代的第一批F1赛车。

动力单元部分采用的是为超级摩托车特别开发的技术。

确切地说，它的车身上安装了一台MotoGP摩托车的专用引擎
——Honda RC213V-S。

它也是Honda纵横两轮及四轮赛事的实战能力的充分体现。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new species with the openness of a motorcycle and the handling of an automobile.

A new driving experience has been created through a collaboration between the Honda design team and Gran Turismo. What makes this possible is the Honda Project 2&4 powered by RC213V.

At the heart of this car that was born from a design competition project involving Honda’s 2-wheel and 4-wheel divisions, is a V-4 motorcycle engine. Thus, the car is a new form of fun mobility that combines the openness and agility of a motorbike with the dynamic performance of a 4-wheeled vehicle.

The working theme of the car's development was "'Exposure," and indeed, drivers of the vehicle can feel the sun and wind all around them, giving them an incredible sense of freedom.

Perhaps the most noteworthy element of the Honda Project 2&4 is the structure, which is a fusion of 2- and 4-wheeled vehicles powered by a motorcycle engine that's mounted amidships on an aluminum carbon composite backbone frame.

The combination of the <999cc> V4 engine producing <215ps> and the car's low <405kg> curb weight results in an incredible weight-to-power ratio of <1.88kg/ps>. The rear wheels are driven through a 6-speed DCT controlled with paddle shifters on the steering wheel. If you remove the assistant side body cowling it is also possible to add a passenger seat that makes it a two-seater.

long.zh:
在本田设计团队与跑车浪漫旅的通力合作下，为我们带来了全新的驾驶体验，这款车型就是“Project 2&4 powered by RC213V”。

通过本田的二轮和四轮部门之间的激烈设计竞争，该车的动力核心最终选用了竞速摩托车的V4引擎。它结合了摩托车的开放性、敏捷性和四轮汽车的动力性能，让你能真正感受到它的横向重力加速度。

它的设计理念“展露”得到了很好的展现，车手在体验驾驶的极致自由时还能享受到太阳和疾风的真实存在。

本田Project 2&4的最重要亮点之一是它的架构，它融合了二轮和四轮车的特性，并由摩托车引擎提供动力，该引擎被安装于铝碳复合材料的车架上。

这台紧凑的<999cc> V4中置引擎可提供<215ps>功率的动力，结合了超轻量化的<405kg>车身，实现了惊人的<1.88kg/ps>重量马力比。它的后轮由6档双离合变速箱驱动，并在方向盘处设置了换挡拨片。如果移除侧面的整流罩，你还可以添加一个乘客座位，使其成为一台双座赛车。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 1965, this legendary machine delivered Honda its first-ever F1 victory. Building upon the foundation of the RA271—Honda’s first F1 challenger—this car achieved greater performance through weight reduction across its components, the adoption of outboard rear suspension, and refined tuning of its 1.5-liter V-12. Although early in the season it grappled with stability issues, significant improvements were introduced midway through the campaign. These efforts culminated in a hard-fought and celebrated triumph at Round 10, the Mexican Grand Prix.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1965年，这台传奇赛车为Honda带来了F1历史上的首场胜利。这款赛车沿用了Honda首款F1赛车RA271的基本框架，但通过全方位轻量化、改用外置后悬挂系统，以及对“如钟表般精准”的1.5升V12引擎进行了精密调校，使得性能得以提升。虽然赛季初期饱受稳定性问题困扰，但经过中期的重大改进，最终在第10轮墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了来之不易的胜利。
officialDetails.heroEn: The F1 machine that scored Honda its first F1 victory.
officialDetails.heroZh: 为Honda斩获了第一场胜利的F1赛车。

collection.en:
One of the most iconic cars in Honda's history
is this Formula 1 machine, the Honda RA272.

Honda was the first Japanese automaker to
compete in F1 racing.

In 1965, this car earned Honda its first F1 win at the
Mexican Grand Prix in the final round of the season.

With an aluminum monocoque chassis up front
and a space-frame towards the rear...

...it was powered by a horizontal 1.5-liter V-12 mounted amidships.

The RA272 was developed and driven by Richie
Ginther, an American racer of the 1960s.

Honda has since earned many victories as an engine
supplier, and it all began with the RA272.
collection.zh:
本田是第一家参加F1赛事的日本制造商。

其历史上最具有标志性的车型就是
这款F1赛车——本田RA272。

这辆赛车在1965年的最后一站比赛——墨西哥大奖赛
上夺魁，为本田赢得了第一座F1分站赛冠军奖杯。

它的前半部分采用铝制单体车壳底盘，
而后部则采用了空间框架……

并由一部横中置1.5升V12引擎提供动力。

这辆RA272由活跃于1960年代的美国车手
里奇·金瑟尔参与开发以及驾驶。

自那之后，本田作为一家引擎供应商赢得了无数F1胜利，
但一切辉煌都始于这辆RA272。

catch.en: The F1 machine that scored Honda its first F1 victory.
catch.zh: 为Honda斩获了第一场胜利的F1赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The F1 machine that scored Honda its first F1 victory.

Honda has always been at the forefront of innovation. This dates back to the company's early days, a precedent established by founder Soichiro Honda. An example of its technical prowess was its Formula 1 race car in 1964. Called the RA271, it featured an aluminum shell over a space frame body and a 1.5-liter V-12 engine mounted transversely in an unusual fashion amidships. Unfortunately, the car did not fare well in its debut season.

The following year, Honda radically changed the RA271, resulting in the RA272. The RA272E engine was a more efficient version of the previous V-12 with lighter components. The construction of the rear suspension was changed from an inboard to an outboard setup, which allowed the weight to be reduced from <525kg> to <498kg>, signifying a drastic decrease. The drivers for the new, improved Honda race car were Ronnie Bucknum, in his second year, and new arrival Richie Ginther.

At the start of the 1965 season, the extra power from the RA272's engine showed great potential, but the car suffered from poor stability. The team opted to skip Round 7's German Grand Prix to address the issue. The engineers moved the engine <100mm> rearward, while also making adjustments to the body, suspension and exhaust.

In the final race of the season—Round 10's Mexican Grand Prix—the RA272 finally showed its true potential. After starting in 3rd place, Ginther grabbed the lead and stayed there until the finish, giving Honda its first F1 victory. Teammate Bucknum finished 5th.

Since then, Honda has won many F1 races and several championships, and it was the RA272 that started it all for the forward-thinking Japanese car manufacturer.

long.zh:
在创新性思维和前瞻性工程技能的加持下，本田实现了大量的技术革新。其中最杰出的例子当属他们在1964年首次参与F1比赛。当时，他们还只是一家名不见经传的不知名车厂。他们开发的赛车就是RA271，这款车采用了铝制车壳和空间车架，并以与众不同的横中置布局安装了一部1.5升V12引擎。遗憾的是，这样的独创设计也成为了它的软肋，这款车未能在参赛首年取得任何成绩。

在1965年，本田对这部赛车进行了激进的全面重新设计，其成果就是RA272。它的RA272E引擎采用了轻量化部件，效率优于前款V12引擎，后悬挂的设计由一体化内构改为了外置，成功将车重从<525kg>削减到了<498kg>，这是一项重大的优化。连续第二年出战的罗尼·巴克纳姆与新车手里奇·金瑟尔搭档驾驶这辆新赛车。

在1965赛季伊始，拥有更强动力的RA272新引擎展现出了巨大的潜力，却又受到稳定性较差的问题所掣肘。车队选择不参加第7轮的德国大奖赛，挤出时间来优化他们的赛车。他们将引擎向后方移动了<100mm>，并对车身、悬挂和排气等部分进行了其他调整。

在该赛季的最后一场比赛、也就是第10站的墨西哥大奖赛中，RA272全面展现出它真正的潜力。金瑟尔从第三位发车，然后很快提升到了领跑位置，并一直保持到了终点线，为本田赢下了他们的第一个F1分站冠军。他的队友巴克纳姆则以第5名完赛，为车队首次实现了双车积分完赛。

自那之后，本田拿到了无数的F1比赛胜利，不过为他们打开通向辉煌之路的RA272永远是拥有重要历史意义的无价之宝。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Honda's beloved 'S' series of the 1960s made a return in 1999. Every element of the S2000 was engineered from the ground up to deliver pure, focused driving performance. True to its name, it was powered by a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 engine. Its 6-speed manual transmission was a purpose-built unit, incorporating a secondary reduction gear to optimize shift feel while minimizing weight. Details like these offered a clear window into the passion and precision that defined the S2000's development.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Honda 1960年代的经典“S”系列在1999年重新复活。S2000的每个部件都经过专门开发以提供最佳运动性能。正如其名称所示，搭载2升直列4缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎。6速手动变速器同样为量身打造，采用副减速齿轮确保出色的换挡手感和轻量化。这些细节充分展现了设计师的用心与专注。
officialDetails.heroEn: The FR open top sports car debuted for the 50th anniversary of Honda.
officialDetails.heroZh: Honda推出的50周年款S2000，这辆前置后驱敞篷跑车很好地融入了公司的设计哲学。

usedCar.en:
Honda was nice enough to celebrate its 50th birthday
by giving us the S2000 sports car.

It was the company's first front-engine/rear-drive roadster, or
FR as we say in the biz, since the S800 we last saw in 1970.

Born from the company's Formula 1 experience was the car's
amazing 2.0-liter inline-4 engine.

It is naturally aspirated and revved to an incredible <9000rpm>,
but some complained that it lacked low-end torque.

That wasn't enough to deter fans from owning this wonderful
convertible, because Honda sold the car for 10 years.

Another cool tidbit about the S2000 is that it was one of the
first production cars to feature an "Engine Start" button.
usedCar.zh:
S2000车型发布于Honda公司50周年庆之际。

它是该公司自S800以来推出的第一台前置后驱双座敞篷跑车，
堪称呕心沥血之作。

该车采用顶级的自然进气直列四缸引擎。

它的专属定制配置使其转速能在眨眼间
达到惊人的<9000rpm>之高。

在当时，这款早期版本的汽车引擎曾一度
被一些人批评为“太过极端”...

但在其停产后的数年里，S2000标志性的
灵敏反应性让它收获了很多粉丝。

vehicleCollection.en:
The FR open top sports car debuted for the 50th anniversary of Honda. Z

The Honda S2000 was a revolutionary car that symbolized the company’s future direction in sports cars. It possessed technology that trickled down from its deep association with motorsports, thus, the S2000 was like a Formula 1 car for the road, from its high-revving engine to its engine-start button. The S2000’s true roots came from Honda’s S series from the 1960s. The S500, S600 and S800 were the S2000’s forefathers, all two-seat convertible sports cars with FR (Front engine, Rear drive) configurations.

The S500, released in 1963, embodied Honda’s philosophy of the engine and suspension working together harmoniously for maximum results and pleasure. Honda revived this philosophy for the modern age and instilled it into the S2000. Every component of the car was custom-built, including the super-rigid open monocoque “X-bone frame” chassis. The engine was as race-oriented as they came in a production car. The F20C, a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 featured an amazing 9000-rpm redline, with power rated at <250ps>. It also boasted excellent fuel economy. Mated to the engine was a sturdy 6-speed manual gearbox whose throws were short and well-defined. In July 2000, the S2000 Type V was added to the lineup, featuring the VGS system that electrically controlled the steering ratio according to speed and turning angle. Aerodynamics and suspension were reworked in 2007, giving birth to the Type S with enhanced drivability on winding roads.

long.zh:
本田的经典车型S习惯在命名中用3位数字来标明其排量，例如S500、S600和S800。在1999年4月，S800推出的28年之后，本田复活了S系列，并带来了一款4位数编号的产品：S2000，作为庆祝其50周年的纪念车型。

为了最大体现运动车型的操控感，S2000的每个零件都是专门研发的。

虽然是一款敞篷车，但它所采用的“高X-骨”单体车壳可以提供与封闭式车身同等乃至更优秀的刚性。高达9000转的转速上限在量产车中也是凤毛麟角。车上搭载的2.0L自然进气直列4缸F20C引擎可以输出<250ps>最大马力，却拥有相当经济的油耗。在日本的10-15排放测试中，S2000得出的燃油效率比仅为<12.4km/L>。6速手动变速箱同样是定制产品。为了强化换档手感和减轻重量，研发团队倾注了无数心血在二级齿轮减速箱上。

2000年7月，本田在产品线中添加了以VGS系统为卖点的S2000 Type V，该系统支持根据车速和转向角度来调节转向比。2007年面世的Type S为空气动力学和悬挂系统带来全面提升，从而大幅增添了弯道方面的驾驶乐趣。

Its all-new body design delivered exceptional rigidity while maintaining a featherweight curb mass in the low 1764 lbs range. Adding to its dynamic prowess, the S660 featured a torque vectoring system that enabled cornering performance previously unimaginable for a kei-car, offering neutral, engaging handling.

brandCentral.en:
The Honda S660 was a mid-engine sports car that was
classified as a "kei car" in Japan.

Its compact nature and low price made it one of the most
affordable MR sports cars in the world.

Thanks to its mid-engine layout, the S660 boasted a
front/rear weight distribution ratio of 45/55.

Its suspension system was also tuned to
provide a MR sporty feel.

Despite its diminutive size, I would challenge you to find
a more fun to car to drive than this one.
brandCentral.zh:
Honda S660是一辆中置引擎的跑车，其设计完全符合日式“轻
型车”的规范。

这款车的设计思路是打造一辆更易于驾驶的跑车。

其中置引擎布局使得前后重量分布比例达到了优秀的45/55。

其侧倾中心和重心也进行了调优……

让这辆车的驾驶体验非常顺滑、稳定，操控性也数一数二。

vehicleCollection.en:
The spiritual successor to the Beat was this small-yet-unadulterated mid-engine kei sports car.

While kei-cars aren’t necessarily known to be fun to drive, there are a few exceptions, such as the Honda S660, which was introduced to the Japan market in 2015. This super compact convertible was the spiritual successor to the popular Honda Beat that was discontinued back in 1996.

Like the Beat, the new S660 sports a mid-engine layout. The exterior is characterized by an entirely new look, with sharp lines and smooth curves. Ultra-high-tensile steel comprises 60 percent of the car, including the center tunnel, side sills and side frame. The rear subframe is composed of die-cast aluminum. All this helps keep the S660’s curb weight down to a low <800kg>, while maintaining the twisting rigidity that surpassed even that of the S2000.

The roof is a variation of a targa top, where only a portion of it can be removed. The soft top can also be rolled and removed, to be stored in a box under the front hood.

Powering the S660 is a turbocharged <660cc> DOHC inline-3 that produces <64ps> and <10.6kgm> of torque. It comes mated to a close-ratio 6-speed manual gearbox or a paddle-shift CVT with sports mode. Stopping the car are disc brakes at both front and rear.

The suspension consists of struts at all four corners. A torque vectoring system reduces understeer by slightly applying the brakes on the inside front wheel. Thanks to the lightweight and the S660’s remarkable chassis, it’s one of the best handling cars, kei or otherwise, in the world.

long.zh:
S660是本田于2015年推出的开顶跑车，这款敞篷跑车被归入超轻量级轻型车的范畴，承袭了本田Beat的精神。后者已经在19年前的1996年停产了。

机械布局方面，这款车采用了中后置引擎双座的布局。车体则是从零重新设计的，结构主要由直线和平顺的弧线构成，整车的60%，从中心通道、侧边门槛到侧边框均由超高拉伸度钢材制造，后部副框架则使用压铸铝材。尽管整车重量被很好地控制在<800kg>较轻范围内，但车体的静态扭转刚度甚至超过了S2000。

车顶的设计近似于保时捷Targa，也就是说只有乘坐者头顶的部分可以移除。软式顶篷可以拆除并卷起，存放在前引擎盖下的盒子里。

该车的动力基于N-BOX等车款所使用的<660cc>双顶置凸轮轴直列3缸涡轮增压引擎，可输出<64ps>/<10.6kgm>的动力。传动系统为6速手动变速箱，1至5档齿轮比较密，提供了排挡杆、无段变速功能，带有运动模式。

四轮的悬挂均使用了支撑杆，且配备了碟式刹车。在转向时，扭矩向量系统将通过对内侧前轮施加轻微制动的方式抑制转向不足。轮胎则是与横滨轮胎合作开发的特别型号，提供了平衡的前后抓地力。这一系列的细节，使得该车可达到一般微型车上所罕见的弯道速度，且可保持较为均衡与有趣的操控体验。

conversation.en:
My buddy had bought one when it came out.
I was impressed with how beautiful the engine looked.

It possessed all the right components that make a sports car.

But it was scaled proportionally to match the
body size of a kei-car...

...just like the original FIAT 500.

I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter.
It had a tight mechanical feel to it.

However, it became notchy often.

That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...

...without the notchiness, of course.

它具备一台真正跑车的所有要素，

只是在设计时按照轻型车的尺寸需要被按比例缩小了。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Honda’s lineage of sports cars began in 1963 with the ultra-compact, two-seat S500. It was followed by the S600, which delivered more power through a larger engine, and then by the S800, which featured 4-wheel independent suspension. Equipped with a more robust engine than the S600 and a short-throw shift lever positioned within easy reach of its low-slung seats, the S800 earned international praise.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Honda跑车系列始于1963年推出的超紧凑双座S500。随后推出了搭载更大引擎、动力更强的S600，接着是主打四轮独立悬挂的S800。S800相比S600引擎排量更大，短小的换挡杆在低矮座椅上轻松可及，赢得了全球赞誉。
officialDetails.heroEn: With a larger displacement than its predecessor, this car represented the pinnacle of the "S" line.
officialDetails.heroZh: Honda S系列的巅峰之作，更佳的性能，更大的排量。

usedCar.en:
Not many people know that Honda has been in the sports car
business for a long time, since the 1960s actually.

Back then, the company produced the S600, which evolved
to become the S800, a compact open-top sports car.

Under its hood is a DOHC 4-cylinder engine that sends power
to the rear wheels, meaning that it has an FR layout.

Beginning with the S600, the size of the engine grew over time,
from the prototype's <360cc> to <500cc>, then to <600cc>.

As you might guess from the S800's name, this one came with
a <791cc> engine that produced <70ps>.
usedCar.zh:
S系列跑车是Honda跑车的起源。

它是一款后轮驱动的敞篷双座跑车，
配备了直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎。

随着时间的推移，S车系的引擎排量逐渐
增加，从原型车的<360cc>到<500cc>再到<600cc>。

S800的排量还要更大一些，达到了<791cc>，
使其能够拥有<70ps>马力。

显然，它是S2000车型的灵感来源，
且在本质上一脉相承。

catch.en: With a larger displacement than its predecessor, this car represented the pinnacle of the "S" line.
catch.zh: Honda S系列的巅峰之作，更佳的性能，更大的排量。

vehicleCollection.en:
With a larger displacement than its predecessor, this car represented the pinnacle of the "S" line.

Having dominated the world of two-wheeled racing at the Isle of Man TT, World GP, and more, Honda moved into to the world of four-wheeled cars in 1963. The company's first example was an ultra compact, two-seat sports car called the S500. Soichiro Honda, the founder of Honda Motors, shocked the world by building a sports car from scratch.

But this decision made sense because it was easier for a motorcycle manufacturer to to build a sports car than a sedan because it was much simpler in structure. So the company utilized all the know-how they gained in producing motorcycles into building the S500, a car that lined up with the company's already-established sporty image.

After the debut of the S500 in 1963, Honda produced the S600 the following year, equipped with a more powerful engine. That was followed by a special fastback coupe that performed well in racing. Back then, and even today, the world had never seen a car that could rev up to <10000rpm> in stock form. Two years later, the S800 with an even larger engine was added, and when the improved S800M made its appearance, the Honda sports car had finally come into its own, now equipped with a true automotive 4-wheel suspension system.

Starting with the S800, the Honda Sport series featured an exceptionally short shifter, only <10cm> in length, which allowed effortless shifting from the low seating position. Delivering a true sports car experience and driving feel, these cars would become popular classics the world over."

long.en:
Having dominated the world of two-wheeled racing at the Isle of Man TT, World GP, and more, Honda moved into to the world of four-wheeled cars in 1963. The company's first example was an ultra compact, two-seat sports car called the S500. Soichiro Honda, the founder of Honda Motors, shocked the world by building a sports car from scratch.

But this decision made sense because it was easier for a motorcycle manufacturer to to build a sports car than a sedan because it was much simpler in structure. So the company utilized all the know-how they gained in producing motorcycles into building the S500, a car that lined up with the company's already-established sporty image.

After the debut of the S500 in 1963, Honda produced the S600 the following year, equipped with a more powerful engine. That was followed by a special fastback coupe that performed well in racing. Back then, and even today, the world had never seen a car that could rev up to <10000rpm> in stock form. Two years later, the S800 with an even larger engine was added, and when the improved S800M made its appearance, the Honda sports car had finally come into its own, now equipped with a true automotive 4-wheel suspension system.

Starting with the S800, the Honda Sport series featured an exceptionally short shifter, only <10cm> in length, which allowed effortless shifting from the low seating position. Delivering a true sports car experience and driving feel, these cars would become popular classics the world over."
long.zh:
在赢下马恩岛TT和世界大奖赛等多项世界知名赛事，统治了两轮竞速世界后，1963年，本田在万众期待的目光中完成了在四轮汽车世界的首秀，公布了一款极其紧凑的两座跑车：S500。这辆由日本战后汽车工业的领军人物本田宗一郎亲手打造的车让业界为之侧目。

本田的运动赛车产品线随着这台S500起航。仅仅半年后，排量和动力都有所提升的斜背双门轿车S600被加入到了敞篷车产品线中。它在赛车场上的成绩也相当优异。无论是在当时，还是在现在，都鲜少有原厂量产车能将转速提升至<10000rpm>。听到女高音般的引擎轰鸣声时，你就知道，本田S开过来了。

两年之后，S800带着更大的引擎加入了S家族的行列。等到提升版的S800M亮相时，本田的跑车已日趋完美。悬挂系统也变成真正的四驱车布局，高速过弯全不在话下。

从S800开始，短换挡杆成为了本田运动车型的特色。只有<10cm>的拨杆便于低坐姿的车手进行换挡。携着真正的赛车体验和驾驶感受，这几款车很快就在全球市场上成为了热门经典车型。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo is a two-seater coupe born from a collaboration between Honda’s design team and Gran Turismo. It embodies Honda’s "Human Centered Design" philosophy, featuring a driver-focused package that prioritized engagement and usability. With bold, athletic proportions, the car delivers the striking presence and excitement expected of a true sports car.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: “Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo”是一款Honda设计团队与《跑车浪漫旅》合作开发的双座轿跑。这款车采用了以驾驶者为中心的整体设计，让Honda“以人为本”的设计理念得到了清晰的体现。设计师还力图打造出带来强烈视觉冲击、令人兴奋不已的车身比例，呈现地道的跑车外观。
officialDetails.heroEn: This lightweight mid-engine sports car embodied Honda's "Power of Dreams" philosophy.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这辆轻型中置引擎跑车传达着Honda“极致马力”的理念。

brandCentral.en:
The Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo is a compact
mid-engined sports car.

Everything about it has been designed with the driver in
mind, an approach for which Honda is well-known.

The design team put this model through real-life tests when
developing its aerodynamic features.

Under its bonnet is a <410ps> 2L
straight-four turbo engine...

Accompanied by a 8-speed dual-clutch transmission.

Amazingly, the whole thing only weighs <899kg>!
brandCentral.zh:
Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo是一款中置引擎的紧凑型跑车。

在这辆车上，所有的设计都以驾驶者为中心，这也是Honda
赖以成名的设计理念。

设计团队在进行该车的空气动力学特性研发时，直接进
行了实车测试。

其引擎盖下装载了一台<410ps>的2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎……

搭配8速双离合器变速箱。

最令人称道的是，整部车的重量仅有<899kg>！

catch.en: This lightweight mid-engine sports car embodied Honda's "Power of Dreams" philosophy.
catch.zh: 这辆轻型中置引擎跑车传达着Honda“极致马力”的理念。

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight mid-engine sports car embodied Honda's "Power of Dreams" philosophy.

The "Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo" midship-engined 2-seater coupe was born from a collaboration between the Honda design team and Gran Turismo.

This is a true sports model that takes to heart the Honda corporate spirit of "doing it because it's fascinating," and pursues the fun of driving as well as authentic realism befitting the "real driving simulator," Gran Turismo.

The "Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo" was the winner of the global design competition. For further design refinements after the competition, designers from both Japan and the US had their input in the process, with each applying their own unique strengths into project. The design progressed globally, with the quarter model built in the US, and the modeling data and hardware decisions made in Japan. Staff from each region were closely connected in the process, and the designers enjoyed participating in the project.

The "Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo" brings to life the design direction of Honda, "Human Centered Design". This is a human-centric way of thinking that is brought to life in the package design, where the position of the passengers, engine, and tires determines the shape of the car’s structure. The proportions of the car that makes it look as though it is about to propel itself forward, the clean cut body and the powerful front and rear fenders that spreads wide with air intakes, and wheels that combine function and beauty; all these things that are expected of a sports car, are expressed in the strong sense of presence emitted by the car.

Carbon fiber is utilized in many parts of the body, achieving a weight of just <899kg>. The <1998cc> engine is mounted midship, and combined with an L4 turbo and DOHC-VTEC, it produces <410ps> at <7500rpm>. This power is then efficiently transferred to the road through an 8-speed dual clutch transmission.

The aerodynamics simulations for the car of course involved wind tunnel testing, as it would be for a real life car. Through this process, the flow and exhaust of air passing through the body, underfloor, cabin, and engine room have been fully optimized.

The "Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo" is a car that exemplifies Honda's "Power of Dreams," and is a car that we believe is a true to life machine that can be enjoyed by many.

long.zh:
本田Vision Gran Turismo运动特别版中置引擎双座双门跑车诞生于本田设计团队和跑车浪漫旅的合作。

这是一台融入了“引人入胜的卓越驾驶感”这一本田企业精神的真正跑车，并借助不断追寻着真实感和驾乘乐趣，它完美契合了跑车浪漫旅所倡导的“真实驾驶模拟”理念。

本田Vision Gran Turismo运动特别版还获得了全球设计大赛的冠军。为了对获胜后的车型进行进一步改良，日本和美国的设计师们都在这个过程中作出了贡献，并将他们各人自身的优势应用到此项目之中。本田在全球的各个分公司都参与了此设计流程，美国负责制造1:4的模型，而数据分析和硬件则由日本决定。各地区成员通力合作，设计师们也很享受参与项目的过程。

本田Vision Gran Turismo运动特别版孕育了本田“以人为本”的设计理念。这是一个在整车研发设计中诞生的以人为本的思维方式，乘员位置、引擎、以及轮胎决定车身结构布置。这台车的独特比例让它即使在静止时依然让人觉得马上就要向前疾驰，干净利落的车身以及宽阔且带有进气口的前后挡泥板，还有融合性能和美学的车轮；一台跑车所应该拥有的品质均在该车上淋漓尽致地展现了出来。

通过在车身多处使用碳纤维，本车实现了仅<899kg>的自重。中置<1998cc>引擎，搭配上L4涡轮以及双顶置凸轮轴-VTEC，它可以在<7500rpm>的转速下产生<410ps>的动力。动力再通过8档双离合变速箱传导至路面。

这台车的空气动力学模拟当然也包含了风洞测试，因为这将是一款投入实际使用的车型。经过一系列测试之䐎，通过輦身 底盘、以及驾驶室和引擎寤的气流和排气都被全斸伌优䌖。

这台“本田Vision Gran Turismo运动特别版”景本田“梦想力量”的代表作品，我们相忡它将来会被投入实虅使用并被大众牀嗜爱

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced as the high-performance model of the seventh-generation ELANTRA, the ELANTRA N was developed to embody the N brand philosophy of “making cornering fun.” Powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine producing 276.1 HP and 289.3 ft-lb of torque, it accelerated from 0-62.1 mph in just 5.3 seconds, despite its front-wheel-drive layout. It was offered with either a 6-speed manual transmission or an 8-speed DCT. Its running gear featured electronically controlled dampers and an eLSD, complemented by a robust braking system.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 作为第七代ELANTRA的高性能车型，ELANTRA N的开发理念秉承N品牌“弯道顽童”的精神。该车搭载可输出280 PS动力与40.0 公斤力米扭矩的2升涡轮增压引擎，尽管为前驱布局，其0-100 公里/小时加速仅需5.3秒。车型提供6速手动和8速双离合两种变速箱选择。此外，其底盘配备电子控制减震器和eLSD电子限滑差速器，并搭载了高性能刹车系统。
officialDetails.heroEn: This track-ready Elantra is brought to you by the letter "N."
officialDetails.heroZh: 以“N”为名的ELANTRA，专为赛道而生。

brandCentral.en:
The letter 'N' is a special marking for Hyundai cars,
designating the company’s know-how and passion.

The ELANTRA N is one such car—the ultimate high-performance
FF sports sedan.

Encased in its sleek body is a 2L turbo boasting <280ps>
of power, and capable of going 0-<100km/h> in 5.3 seconds.

The car is offered in 6-speed MT and 8-speed DCT, the latter
of which is equipped with an N Grin Shift overboost feature.

The suspension uses electronically controlled dampers
and an eLSD that allows for next-level high-speed cornering.

But the cherry on top is an N Sound Equaliser that lets
the driver enjoy their ideal exhaust sound while driving.

A sporty yet practical 4-door sedan, the ELANTRA N makes
everyday life exciting!
brandCentral.zh:
字母“N”是Hyundai为旗下汽车打造的特殊标识，

ELANTRA N也是如此——这是一台终极高性能前驱运动轿车。

流畅的车身内搭载了一台2升涡轮增压引擎，

该车提供6速手动与8速双离合变速箱两项选择，

悬挂采用电子控制减震器与eLSD电子限滑差速器配合，
能实现前所未有的高速过弯。

而点睛之笔在于N Sound Equalizer，让驾驶者
能按个人喜好定制排气声浪。

这台兼具运动性与实用性的四门轿车ELANTRA N

catch.en: This track-ready Elantra is brought to you by the letter "N.")
catch.zh: 以“N”为名的ELANTRA，专为赛道而生。

vehicleCollection.en:
This track-ready Elantra is brought to you by the letter "N.")

Since its debut in 1990, the Elantra had been a cornerstone of Hyundai’s lineup. In 2020, the seventh generation was introduced, earning wide acclaim for the bold “Parametric Dynamics” of its exterior design. At the top of this seventh-generation range stood the Elantra N.

Created to embody the N philosophy of “making cornering fun,” the Elantra N was powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine producing <280ps> and <40.0kgm> of torque. Despite its front-wheel-drive layout, it accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in just 5.3 seconds.

The car was offered with either a 6-speed manual or an 8-speed DCT. The manual came equipped with rev-matching, while the DCT added advanced features such as N Grin Shift for overboost, N Power Shift to enhance shifting characteristics, and N Track Sense Shift, optimized for race-track driving.

The suspension featured electronically controlled dampers, an eLSD, and a large braking system, ensuring sharp handling and confidence at speed. With its reinforced chassis and Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tires, it achieved a fine balance between cornering agility and stability. Inside, the Elantra N offered a custom steering wheel, supportive bucket seats, and the N Sound Equalizer, which allowed drivers to tailor the exhaust note to their liking for a heightened sports-driving experience.

Hyundai even developed a TCR touring car variant of the Elantra, a machine that earned respect on the track and underscored the car’s deep ties to motorsports."

Since its debut in 1990, the Elantra had been a cornerstone of Hyundai’s lineup. In 2020, the seventh generation was introduced, earning wide acclaim for the bold “Parametric Dynamics” of its exterior design. At the top of this seventh-generation range stood the Elantra N.

Created to embody the N philosophy of “making cornering fun,” the Elantra N was powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine producing <280ps> and <40.0kgm> of torque. Despite its front-wheel-drive layout, it accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in just 5.3 seconds.

The car was offered with either a 6-speed manual or an 8-speed DCT. The manual came equipped with rev-matching, while the DCT added advanced features such as N Grin Shift for overboost, N Power Shift to enhance shifting characteristics, and N Track Sense Shift, optimized for race-track driving.

The suspension featured electronically controlled dampers, an eLSD, and a large braking system, ensuring sharp handling and confidence at speed. With its reinforced chassis and Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tires, it achieved a fine balance between cornering agility and stability. Inside, the Elantra N offered a custom steering wheel, supportive bucket seats, and the N Sound Equalizer, which allowed drivers to tailor the exhaust note to their liking for a heightened sports-driving experience.

Hyundai even developed a TCR touring car variant of the Elantra, a machine that earned respect on the track and underscored the car’s deep ties to motorsports."
long.zh:
自1990年问世以来，伊兰特始终是现代主力车系中的中坚力量。2020年推出的第7代车款因外观设计中运用的“参数动力学”理念而广受赞誉。伊兰特N则是第7代中的性能最强版本。

为体现N品牌“弯道顽童”的理念，伊兰特N搭载了一台2升涡轮引擎，可输出<280ps>功率与<40.0kgm>扭矩。此外，尽管采用了前驱布局，其0-<100km/h>加速时间仍能达到5.3秒。

该车提供6速手动和8速双离合变速箱两种版本。前者支持降档补油，后者配备了N驾趣增强模式（超增压功能）、N动力换挡模式（改变双离合变速箱特性）及N赛道感知换挡（赛道驾驶优化）等多项功能。

悬挂方面，伊兰特N配备了电子控制减震器、电子限滑差速器及大号碟刹。与之搭配的强化底盘与米其林Pilot Sport 4S轮胎帮助其在弯道表现与高度稳定性之间取得完美平衡。车内配备定制方向盘与桶形座椅，并配有N声浪均衡器，让驾驶者可随心调节排气声浪，进一步提升运动驾驶体验。

同期开发的还有一款伊兰特的TCR赛车版本，以其卓越性能而备受赞誉。这也充分体现出伊兰特是现代车系中与赛道有着紧密联系的一款车型。

该车提供6速手动和8速双离合变速箱两种版本。前者支持降档补油，后者配备了N驾趣增强模式（超增压功能）、N动力换挡模式（改变双离合变速箱特性）及N赛道感知换挡（赛道驾驶优化）等多项功能。

悬挂方面，伊兰特N配备了电子控制减震器、电子限滑差速器及大号碟刹。与之搭配的强化底盘与米其林Pilot Sport 4S轮胎帮助其在弯道表现与高度稳定性之间取得完美平衡。车内配备定制方向盘与桶形座椅，并配有N声浪均衡器，让驾驶者可随心调节排气声浪，进一步提升运动驾驶体验。

同期开发的还有一款伊兰特的TCR赛车版本，以其卓越性能而备受赞誉。这也充分体现出伊兰特是现代车系中与赛道有着紧密联系的一款车型。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Hyundai ELANTRA N TC was a special model built for racing. Based on the ELANTRA N, which could accelerate from 0–62.1 mph in just 5.3 seconds despite using a front-wheel-drive layout, the TC model was specially outfitted according to touring-car race regulations. The wide body was equipped with a carbon-fiber splitter and a large rear wing to greatly improve high-speed cornering stability. This model was also fitted with a 6-speed sequential gearbox, with the braking and cooling parts upgraded to endurance-racing standards.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Hyundai ELANTRA N TC是一款专为赛道竞速而打造的特殊定制车型。其基础车型ELANTRA N虽然使用了前驱布局，仍能在5.3秒内完成0-100 公里/小时的加速。TC版本则按照房车赛规则进行了特殊定制改装。其宽体车身配备了碳纤维分流板和大型尾翼，以显著提升高速过弯稳定性。此车型还换装了6速序列式变速箱，并对刹车和冷却部件进行了升级，以满足耐力赛标准。

brandCentral.en:
Ever heard of the “TCR” racing category? It’s where
2.0-liter FF touring cars battle it out on the track.

Ever since this perennially popular category began, Hyundai
has been actively developing cars to compete in it.

This ELANTRA N TC is the third-generation successor to
the i30 N and Veloster N.

Exploiting the full potential of the ELANTRA N, it becomes
the ultimate lightweight, aerodynamic machine.

Although its power and torque remain within regulation limits,
its advanced chassis settings deliver superior handling.

Already carrying several victories from around the globe, it has
earned a stellar reputation among racing privateers.

Thanks to its unique design, this is one car that truly
stands out on the track!<

自从这项经久不衰的赛事诞生以来，

通过精密的底盘调校，实现了卓越的操控表现。

此车目前已揽获全球多项赛事桂冠，在私人车队中
赢得了极高的声誉。

凭借独到的设计，这无疑是一台能在赛道上

vehicleCollection.en:
This track-oriented Elantra was meticulously crafted to achieve victory.

The ELANTRA N is a high-performance sedan from Hyundai’s N brand. There was also a special edition of this car built specifically for motorsports, called the ELANTRA N TC.

The base-model ELANTRA N was already an excellent choice for the circuit, featuring a turbocharged 2.0-liter direct-injection engine producing <280ps> and <40.0kgm> of torque, and capable of accelerating from 0–<100km/h> in 5.3 seconds in a front-wheel-drive layout. With these strong fundamentals, the TC variant was specially modified to meet international touring-car regulations and was imbued with the capability to win.

The aerodynamic wide body, carbon-fiber splitter, and large rear wing generated substantial downforce, dramatically improving high-speed cornering stability. The drivetrain incorporated a sequential 6-speed gearbox, while the dedicated racing suspension and adjustable dampers allowed it to adapt instantly to varying track conditions. The braking and cooling systems were also upgraded with endurance-spec components.

Efforts to reduce weight and increase rigidity were evident throughout, with the cockpit featuring a regulation roll cage and racing seat. The steering and pedal layout were engineered for immediate response to driver inputs. Carefully crafted into a machine built for victory, the ELANTRA N TC carried the competitive spirit of its road-going counterpart while retaining its agility and reliability.

“伊兰特N”是现代“N”品牌下的一款高性能轿车。此外，现代还为赛车运动打造了该车型的特别版——伊兰特N TC。

基础款伊兰特N本身已经堪称赛道利器了，它配备一台2.0升的直喷涡轮增压引擎，可产生<280ps>的动力和<40.0kgm>的扭矩，基于前驱布局，0-<100km/h>加速仅需5.3秒。伊兰特N TC则在这个坚实的基础上，严格遵循国际房车赛规则进行了深度改装，为其赋予了决胜赛场的实力。

宽体空气动力学车身、碳纤维前分流板和大型尾翼共同作用，产生强大的下压力，使其高速过弯性能得到了显著的提升。传动系统采用6速序列式变速箱，以及特殊定制的赛车悬挂和可调减震器，使其能够即时适应不同路况。刹车和冷却系统也经过了全面升级，采用了耐力赛规格的配件。

整车致力于减重和提升刚度，座舱内配备符合赛事规则的防滚架和赛车座椅。转向系统和踏板布局也进行了优化，确保车手的操作即时得到反馈。伊兰特N TC经过细致改装，成为了一台能够决胜赛场的利器，同时又保留了公路车型的灵巧操控和可靠品质。

带来长轴距的前舱（从仪表盘到车头）、修长的引擎盖

vehicleCollection.en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

The Genesis Coupe is a sporty 2-door that shared a platform with the Genesis luxury coupe.

The Genesis Coupe was shorter than the sedan by <345mm>, with a wheelbase that was also shorter, by <115mm>. These dimensions, combined with the front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout and four-wheel independent suspension, gave the car excellent agility. The engine choices were a 3.8-liter V-6 or a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline 4. Thanks to the car's excellent power delivery and agile rear-drive handling, the Genesis Coupe quickly gained popularity.

A minor change was implemented in 2012 that gave the coupe sharper looks, but the focus was on increasing engine output across the board. Power for the 3.8-liter V6 was increased to approximately <350ps>, making it one of the most powerful cars in its class. Also, in addition to the previous 6-speed manual gearbox, a paddle-shift 8-speed unit was added as an option.

The high-performance model was the 3.8 Track. Springs, dampers and stabilizers were changed to race track-developed, heavy-duty parts, with an adjustable front camber and Torsen LSD. Also, Brembo four-piston calipers were added to the car, emphasizing its pure sport focus. In well-respected tests carried out by unbiased organizations, the Genesis Coupe easily outperformed class rivals.

Also, in addition to the previous 6-speed manual gearbox, a paddle-shift 8-speed unit was added as an option.

The high-performance model was the 3.8 Track. Springs, dampers and stabilizers were changed to race track-developed, heavy-duty parts, with an adjustable front camber and Torsen LSD. Also, Brembo four-piston calipers were added to the car, emphasizing its pure sport focus. In well-respected tests carried out by unbiased organizations, the Genesis Coupe easily outperformed class rivals.
long.zh:
捷尼赛思Coupe是一款与捷尼赛思豪华双门轿车共享平台开发的跑车。

其车身比轿车款短了<345mm>，并缩短了<115mm>的轴距。再搭配上前置引擎、后驱布局以及四轮独立悬挂，赋予了这台车卓越的敏捷性。引擎可使用3.6升V6引擎，或者2.0升直列四缸涡轮引擎。由于世界上后驱双门跑车车型日渐凋零，此车迅速地吸引了公众的目光。

该车于2012年进行中期小改款，为其带来了更酷炫的造型，而内在最主要的改变则是其引擎整体动力得到了相当程度的提升。3.8升V6引擎的动力输出提升到<350ps>之后，该车终于能够进入超跑的行列。与此同时，除了此前使用的6档手动变速箱之外，此车还提供了拨片式8档自动变速箱的选项。

该车的高性能版本为3.8赛道版。弹簧、避震器、以及平衡杆都变更为专为赛道所开发的高强度零部件，并包含了可调前车外倾角以及托森限滑差速器。该车上还加装了布雷博的4活塞刹车卡钳，使其能更专注于竞速。

在广受认可的汽车材料表征研究所测试中，捷尼赛思Coupe轻松击败了同级别的其他竞争对手。

The Genesis Coupe served as the foundation for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car.

And what a well-balanced machine it is, because the car already
possessed many race car attributes.

The most notable thing about the original was its handling,
which was both stable and predictable.

Its long wheelbase allowed for a spacious interior, while its
profile provided excellent downforce at high speed.

作为一款全面的赛车，其稳定性和操控性都极其出色。

vehicleCollection.en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

The Genesis Coupe is a sporty 2-door that shared a platform with the Genesis luxury coupe.

The Genesis Coupe was shorter than the sedan by <345mm>, with a wheelbase that was also shorter, by <115mm>. These dimensions, combined with the front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout and four-wheel independent suspension, gave the car excellent agility. The engine choices were a 3.6-liter V-6 or a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4. Thanks to the car's excellent power delivery and agile rear-drive handling, the Genesis Coupe quickly gained popularity.

A minor change was implemented in 2012 that gave the coupe sharper looks, but the focus was on increasing engine output across the board. Power for the 3.8-liter V6 was increased to approximately <350ps>, making it one of the most powerful cars in its class. Also, in addition to the previous 6-speed manual gearbox, a paddle-shift 8-speed unit was added as an option.

The high-performance model was the 3.8 Track. Springs, dampers and stabilizers were changed to racetrack-developed, heavy-duty parts, with an adjustable front camber and Torsen LSD. Also, Brembo four-piston calipers were added to the car, emphasizing its pure sport focus. In well-respected tests carried out by unbiased organizations, the Genesis Coupe easily outperformed class rivals.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.

In the real world, this car earned a strong reputation in the drifting scene, and this Gr.4 version proves just as capable for racing as it was for sliding sideways.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型Hyundai后驱Genesis跑车已按照Gr.4组别规则进行了改装。尽管外观上酷似一台房车，但它拥有许多与Gr.3组别对标的特征，如拨片式换挡变速箱。在现实世界中，Genesis是漂移赛车运动的热门选择，而这款Gr.4同样擅长漂移，不只为赛道而生。

brandCentral.en:
Based on the Genesis Coupe, this is a Gran Turismo Gr.4
racing car original.

Its long wheelbase and traditional FR layout have won it
praise for achieving balanced and responsive handling.

Extensive tuning, including weight reduction and paddle
shifters, have put it on par with Gr.3 standards.
brandCentral.zh:
此车以捷尼赛思Coupe为基础改装，是一款原创的跑车浪漫旅
组别4级别赛车。

长轴距和传统的前置后驱布局带来均衡且灵敏的响应，
赢得了口碑。

在进行更重度的改装，包括减重和加装换挡拨片后，此
车基本达到了组别3标准。

cars.nameZh: 现代捷尼赛思组别B拉力车

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Hyundai’s rear-wheel-drive Genesis sports car has been reengineered to meet Gr.B regulations for this Gran Turismo Original. A 4-wheel-drive conversion has been added, along with design elements inspired by modern rally machines. The front fenders feature smooth, organic curves to maximize downforce, while the wide track, measuring more than 80.7 inches, enhanced maneuverability, complementing the car’s long wheelbase.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型Hyundai后驱Genesis跑车已按照Gr.B组别规则进行了改装。除了四轮驱动改装，该车还融入了许多现代拉力赛车的潮流设计。前挡泥板的有机曲线能最大化下压力，而超过2,050毫米的宽轮距为长轴距车身提供了额外的操控性。
officialDetails.heroEn: Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.
officialDetails.heroZh: 配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

brandCentral.en:
This Gr.B rally car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on the
Hyundai Genesis Coupe.

It's been adapted for dirt-driving perfection, with the FR
drivetrain being replaced by a 4WD system.

The wheel treads have been enlarged to a whopping <2050mm>.

Despite a relatively long wheelbase, it makes no
compromises at all about manoeuvrability.

The organic undulations of its front bumper and rally-
ready aerodynamics make it a cutting-edge contender.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于
Hyundai Genesis Coupe开发，

针对泥地赛道驾驶进行了完备的改装：将前置后驱传动
系统替换为一套四轮驱动系统，

轮距也拓宽到了惊人的<2050mm>。

尽管轴距较长，但它在操控性方面没有做出任何妥协。

前保险杠那流畅起伏的外廓和适合拉力赛的空气动力学
外形让它一跃成为赛场上当仁不让的竞争者。<

Also, in addition to the previous 6-speed manual gearbox, a paddle-shift 8-speed unit was added as an option.

The high-performance model was the 3.8 Track. Springs, dampers and stabilizers were changed to racetrack-developed, heavy-duty parts, with an adjustable front camber and Torsen LSD. Also, Brembo four-piston calipers were added to the car, emphasizing its pure sport focus. In well-respected tests carried out by unbiased organizations, the Genesis Coupe easily outperformed class rivals.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.B regulations by Gran Turismo.

捷尼赛思Coupe是一款与捷尼赛思豪华双门轿车共享平台开发的跑车。

其车身比轿车款短了<345mm>，并缩短了<115mm>的轴距。再搭配上前置引擎、后驱布局以及四轮独立悬挂，赋予了这台车卓越的敏捷性。引擎可使用3.8升V6引擎，或者2.0升直列四缸涡轮引擎。由于世界上后驱双门跑车车型日渐凋零，此车迅速地吸引了公众的目光。

该车于2012年进行中期小改款，为其带来了更酷炫的造型，而内在最主要的改变则是其引擎整体动力得到了相当程度的提升。3.8升V6引擎的动力输出提升到<350ps>之后，该车终于能够进入超跑的行列。与此同时，除了此前使用的6档手动变速箱之外，此车还提供了拨片式8档自动变速箱的选项。

该车的高性能版本为3.8赛道版。弹簧、避震器、以及平衡杆都变更为专为赛道所开发的高强度零部件，并包含了可调前车外倾角以及托森限滑差速器。该车上还加装了布雷博的4活塞刹车卡钳，使其能更专注于竞速。

在广受认可的汽车材料表征研究所测试中，捷尼赛思Coupe轻松击败了同级别的其他竞争对手。

*此型号经过跑车浪漫旅特殊调校，符合组别B规范。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This performance model was introduced two years after the original launch of the IONIQ 5. It featured a 4-wheel-drive system powered by electric motors on the front and rear axles, allowing for freely adjustable torque distribution. When set to a rear-wheel bias, the system enabled the over two-ton SUV to be drifted with ease. In an effort to preserve the excitement of traditional combustion-engine cars, this unique electric SUV also offered a simulated 8-speed dual-clutch transmission and synthetic exhaust sounds.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款IONIQ 5的高性能版本在其首发两年后正式推出。四驱系统采用前后轴双电机布局，可实现扭矩的自由调节和分配。当调节为偏向后驱时，即便是这台超过2吨的车也能轻松实现漂移驾驶。这款独特的电动SUV力图保持传统燃油车的驾驶激情，特别配备了模拟8速双离合变速箱以及仿真排气声效。

brandCentral.en:
EVs might not have the most exciting image, but there is
one example that shatters all preconceptions.

I’m talking about the Hyundai IONIQ 5 N.

The "N" at the end of its name refers to Hyundai’s two
testing grounds, Namyang and the Nürburgring.

The IONIQ 5 N is a true embodiment of driving pleasure.

In addition to a total output of 478 kW (<650ps>), it has
fully variable front and rear torque distribution.

When set to rear-bias, this car can drift, and its sound delivers
the excitement of a naturally-aspirated engine.

No doubt, the IONIQ 5 N will change your mind about EVs.
It’s a beast that has raised the bar for electric cars!

两个测试基地——南阳和纽博格林。

艾尼氪5 N完美诠释了驾驶的乐趣。

前后轴均配备电机，其四轮驱动系统的总动力输出达到478千瓦（<650ps>）。

其模拟的排气声浪也能带来媲美自吸发动机的振奋感。

它是一款为电动汽车设立了新标杆的猛兽！

vehicleCollection.en:
A fearsome driving machine that challenges the preconceptions of BEVs.

The IONIQ 5 made its debut in 2021 as Hyundai's first full electric vehicle. From the outset, it impressed with its clean, modern design and outstanding practicality. But the true star of the lineup arrived in 2023 with the introduction of the high-performance N model.

The "N" badge carries deep significance, representing two iconic facilities where this car was developed: Namyang, Hyundai's global R&D hub in Korea, and the legendary Nürburgring. With this heritage, the IONIQ 5 N redefined what driving pleasure could mean in an electric vehicle.

At its heart was a dual-motor system that powered the front and rear axles individually, making the car all-wheel drive. The total power output of the vehicle was 478 kW (<650ps>) and 770 Nm (<78.5kgm>) of torque in overboost mode. This power could be distributed between the front and rear axles, allowing drivers to tailor the car's handling characteristics, including the ability to indulge in thrilling rear-biased drifts. The IONIQ 5 N also featured a virtual dual-clutch transmission, cleverly simulated using regenerative braking technology. Paired with an artificial exhaust sound, it elevated the experience to new heights.

Also, its exterior and interior came adorned with exclusive enhancements that underscored its athletic persona. As a whole, this electrified powerhouse redefines the boundaries of what battery-electric vehicles (BEVs) can achieve.

long.zh:
艾尼氪5于2021年作为现代品牌首款纯电车型正式亮相，拥有简洁现代的外观和出色的实用性。但直到2023年N版本的推出，才诞生了真正的明星车型。

对现代而言，N代表了该车的两大研发基地：韩国南阳和德国纽博格林——作为性能实力的最佳背书。有了“N”的加入，艾尼氪5蜕变为驾驶乐趣的完美诠释。

动力系统采用四轮驱动布局，前后轴各配备一台电机。在驾趣增强模式下，双电机系统可输出478 kW（<650ps>）的最大动力和770 Nm（<78.5kgm>）的峰值扭矩。此外，该系统支持调节前后动力分配比例。在设定为偏重后轮动力的情况下，这辆超过2吨的汽车也能实现漂移。借助制动能量回收系统，艾尼氪5 N可有效模拟双离合变速器的换挡效果，配合模拟排气声浪，进一步增强驾驶乐趣。

艾尼氪5 N还在内外部配备了众多专属装备，可供用户打造自己的爱车。整体而言，这款性能猛兽开创了纯电动车型的全新可能。

Equipped with a power unit with 770 Nm of torque and 641 HP of total system output, in a body tuned for aerodynamic performance, it accelerates from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.2 seconds. brandCentral.en:
There is a question looming over the modern age: Is the
sports car destined to go the way of the dodo?

The IONIQ 6 N is Hyundai N’s answer to that question,
redefining the sports car for the EV era.

Its sleek streamliner silhouette boasts a Cd of 0.27, blending
aerodynamic efficiency with striking design.

Beneath that shape is <609ps> and 740 Nm of torque.
But there is more here than mere brute force.

When N Grin Boost is activated, the IONIQ 6 N’s
0-<100km/h> sprint drops to just 3.2 seconds.

Its N e-Shift simulates a physical gearbox, backed
by the roar of its N Active Sound+ system.

Crowned 2026 World Performance Car, this machine
proves the electric sports car’s future has arrived.
brandCentral.zh:

其流线型车身拥有0.27的风阻系数，
将空气动力学效率与惊艳设计融为一体。

外壳之下蕴藏着<609ps>动力和740 Nm的扭矩。

0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3.2秒。

同时，N e-Shift系统模拟了传统变速箱的换挡感受，
配合N Active Sound+系统的引擎轰鸣，体验更加沉浸。

这款车荣获2026世界性能车称号，
标志着电动跑车的未来已经到来。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new paradigm for high-performance EV.

The IONIQ 6 N is the second high-performance EV from Hyundai’s high-performance N brand. It carries on the brilliant precedent set by the IONIQ 5 N, which shook the world with its spectacular debut at the 2023 Goodwood Festival of Speed.

The IONIQ 6 N was named 2026 World Performance Car, marking the second time in three years that Hyundai’s N brand had secured the award, following the IONIQ 5 N in 2024.

One of its most attractive points is its elegant exterior, which embodied the aerodynamic flow of the wind. This uniquely supple silhouette was not developed just for aesthetics, as it boasted a drag coefficient of 0.27 while also producing downforce for high-speed stability.

In terms of performance, N offered a new dynamic standard for the electrification era. With a total system output of <650ps> and 770 Nm of torque, it could accelerate from zero to <100km/h> in just 3.2 seconds. However, the true value of this machine could not be found in its figures alone. The N Active Sound+ system recreates different sounds, including the roar of an internal combustion engine, while N e-Shift created the sensation of gear shifting in an EV, giving the driver direct feedback.

The car came packed with numerous other features as well, including N Grin Boost, which unlocked full power for 10 seconds, the proprietary N Drift Optimizer, which enabled controlled slides, and a ceiling-mounted action camera mount to capture it all.

From driving at the limit on track to the winding roads of daily life, the IONIQ 6 N set out to accelerate driving pleasure. Ultimately, this epoch-making model represented the future shape of the sports car.,

long.zh:
艾尼氪6 N是现代“N”系列高性能品牌的第二款高性能电动车。它延续了艾尼氪5 N创下的辉煌先例，后者在2023年古德伍德赛车节上首次亮相便惊艳世界。

艾尼氪6 N被评为2026年度世界性能车，这是继2024年艾尼氪5 N之后，现代N品牌在三年内第二次获此殊荣。

它最吸引人的一点是优雅的外观，完美诠释了如风一般流畅的空气动力学美学。这套独特的流畅线条不仅为了美观而生，更拥有仅0.27的风阻系数，同时还能产生下压力，确保高速行驶的稳定性。

在性能上，N为电动化时代树立了新的动态标杆。凭借<650ps>的系统总动力输出和770 Nm的扭矩，它从0加速到<100km/h>仅需3.2秒。然而，这辆跑车的真正价值并不仅限于纸面数据。“N模拟声浪系统+”系统可模拟内燃机轰鸣等多种声浪，而“e-N动力换挡模式”则为电动车营造出换挡的质感，为驾驶者带来直接的反馈。

这款车还搭载了众多其他功能，例如可释放全部动力长达10秒的“e-N驾趣增强模式”、可以实现随心漂移的“N专属漂移优化模式”专利技术，以及车顶的运动相机支架，将你所有帅气的操作一个不落地记录下来。

无论是在赛道上挑战极限，还是在日常蜿蜒的道路上行驶，艾尼氪6 N都旨在提升驾驶乐趣。总而言之，这款划时代的车型代表了跑车未来的形态。

在性能上，N为电动化时代树立了新的动态标杆。凭借<650ps>的系统总动力输出和770 Nm的扭矩，它从0加速到<100km/h>仅需3.2秒。然而，这辆跑车的真正价值并不仅限于纸面数据。“N模拟声浪系统+”系统可模拟内燃机轰鸣等多种声浪，而“e-N动力换挡模式”则为电动车营造出换挡的质感，为驾驶者带来直接的反馈。

这款车还搭载了众多其他功能，例如可释放全部动力长达10秒的“e-N驾趣增强模式”、可以实现随心漂移的“N专属漂移优化模式”专利技术，以及车顶的运动相机支架，将你所有帅气的操作一个不落地记录下来。

无论是在赛道上挑战极限，还是在日常蜿蜒的道路上行驶，艾尼氪6 N都旨在提升驾驶乐趣。总而言之，这款划时代的车型代表了跑车未来的形态。

conversation.en:
When Yamauchi-san approached us about the Vision Gran
Turismo project, we were working on our next-gen Infiniti.

This design came from our recently-established
Beijing studio.

A team of young designers took the initiative
and completed the task in no time.

While admittedly simple, the design is
quite alluring.

For example, the floating A Pillar and overall form
are very expressive.

And because of its improvisational nature,
it has a strong sense of design.

Of course, this car was built to incorporate
the Infiniti's form language.

Therefore, it effectively connects to the production cars
that came after it.

当山内一典先生找我聊跑车浪漫旅愿景项目时……

……我们正在思考下一代车型应当采用什么样的设计策略。

这款设计来自于刚成立不久的英菲尼迪北京工作室。

团队的一名年轻设计师自告奋勇，
在很短时间内就完成了设计。

它的设计大繁至简，反而为这台车平添了一份魅力。

比如，A柱看上去像是游离在车厢z上，

更为后推出的英菲尼迪量产车型留下了许多启发。

brandCentral.en:
This concept car was the result of a collaboration between
Infiniti's design team and Gran Turismo.

While it has a very unique look, it clearly exhibits key
elements of Infiniti's design language.

Powered by an impressive 4.5-liter V-8 combined with
an electric motor...

...its hybrid system was based on those found
in Formula 1 race cars.

A front mid-engine transaxle gives it a sporty 45:55 front/rear
weight distribution, making it virtually race ready.

这款概念车是INFINITI的设计团队与跑车浪漫旅携手合作
的成果。

还搭载了通常用于F1赛车的混合动力技术。

前轮中置跨轴传动布局将前后配重比确定为45：55。

catch.en: High performance made possible with a V8 engine and electrical motor. A GT machine packed with the motorsport passion of Asia.

vehicleCollection.en:
High performance made possible with a V8 engine and electrical motor. A GT machine packed with the motorsport passion of Asia.

Infiniti made a big splash when it entered the luxury market in 1989. Its distinctive cutting-edge styling won it fans immediately, with vehicles such as the Q45, the G sedan/G coupe and the FX SUV. The brand continues to push the design envelope today, with products that include the Q50 and QX70.

The Infiniti Concept Vision Gran Turismo is a project that started as an ambitious global competition to "design a pure Infiniti GT car." In the end, the winning entry was submitted by Infiniti Design Beijing. Part beauty and part beast, the car's powerful and sensual shape suggested that it was made for the track, something that the Chinese design team wanted to express.

The process of creating the design for the Infiniti Concept Vision Gran Turismo started with a simple sketch that was then refined digitally. After this process, the image was sculpted into a 3D model, and then further refined digitally once again. One of the designers said that his vision and inspiration was to capture the rise of the young generation and the essence of Asian creativity that always sought to break new ground. This desire to consistently be on the very edge of possibilities may one day result in this GT car taking on a real track.

Needless to say, this project went beyond a mere design study and involved thorough examination of aerodynamic and engine performance. Power comes via a hybrid drivetrain. A naturally aspirated 4.5-liter V-8 gasoline engine, mounted aft of the front axle line, is mated to a transaxle. Also providing power is an electric motor, which provides a high level of instant torque. The use of a transaxle allows for an ideal front/rear weight distribution of 44/55, allowing you to drift the car when the need arises. Engineers with a high level of driving skill drove many virtual laps in this car to get the balance just right. As for aerodynamics, the underfloor airflow control, front and rear diffusers, and uniquely shaped rear spoiler enable this car to demonstrate high performance without compromising body design. In short, this is car that drives as good as it looks.

long.zh:
1989年，英菲尼迪作为高端品牌进入了市场。自初代英菲尼迪G系四门/双门轿车与初代英菲尼迪 FX起，就因其业界典范的设计而闻名。直到如今的英菲尼迪Q50、Q60和QX70，英菲尼迪的设计中始终体现着对工程性能与外观设计的精益求精。

英菲尼迪CONCEPT Vision Gran Turismo这一项目源于一场雄心勃勃地为“设计一款纯粹的英菲尼迪超级跑车”而开展的英菲尼迪全球内部竞赛。最终，北京设计中心的参赛作品在竞赛中摘得桂冠。这款概念赛车兼具优雅与野性，既威风气派又感性十足，设计风格大胆前卫，动力性能强劲澎湃，亦是中国设计团队倾注梦想，为英菲尼迪打造的理想赛车形象。

一半是艺术，一半是科学。英菲尼迪CONCEPT Vision Gran Turismo的设计开发始于设计师的手绘草稿，随后转入数字建模进行调整，再制作手塑模型进行调整，最终回到数字世界进行最后的调整。其中一位设计师将他的视野和灵感归功于灵巧捕捉到了年轻一代的崛起以及亚洲创意所特有的浪漫和感性，这也让其自身不断开拓出新的创意。这份开拓精神中包含了让这台GT有朝一日进入真正赛道的梦想。

毋庸置疑，这个项目所做的远不止对于外形设计的研究，还对空气动力学和引擎表现进行了充分的测试。变速驱动桥动力系统由前部中置的4.5升自然吸气V8引擎以及1个电机组成。在低速时，电机可为这只猛兽提供势不可挡的强劲扭矩，而在高速时，这台自然吸气V8引擎则可提供强大的动力输出与动听的排气声，就像其最高时速没有上限一般。其传动系布局带来了蝞常精确盄45ｚ55前后配重平衡，让车手能庫受后部主动漂移的驾丘弓骍。具备高超驾驶技术的年轻工程师们通过很多圉的虚拟测试来完善动力特性。在空气动勛学方面，底盘气流揧制、前后扩散嘨　以厊后部特殊耠䞋的扰流板讨诤轤展现击优弃疄性能－呌时并未因欤爺牲外形设计的䆲击力

This vehicle was created for Vision Gran Turismo by Zagato,
an Italian carrozzeria that was founded in 1919.

It's said to be styled after a sketch by Harada, the car's
designer, while he studied at ArtCenter College of Design.

Although the three-dimensional composition looks complicated
at first glance, each element is a very simple form.

Every module, one after another, intersects
to complete the entire design.

Its traditioal beauty as an FR sports car...

...exudes the feel from a traditional carrozzeria.

The power bulge on the hood
pays homage to the 7.0-liter engine of the Iso Grifo.

And, the tillights were inspired by the Red Torii Gate
at Miyajima of Aki in Japan.׊ext id=2001506ʞype=9

这台性能怪兽是由1919年成立于意大利的车身制造商扎加托
专为跑车浪漫旅愿景项目量身打造的。

尽管它具有令人望而生畏的复杂三维结构，
但其实每个构成元素的形状都很简单。

通过各个简单模块的交错形成完整的车体。

此外，它还体现$了作为一辆前置后驱跑车的传统美感……

充分展现以手工打造闻名的老牌车身制造商的底蕴。

注意引擎盖上的凸起，这是对伊索狮鹫的7L引擎的致敬。

另一方面，尾灯的灵感则来自日本宫岛o色鸟居。քext i=2001506 type=9>R

vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo machine pays tribute to the legendary manufacturer, Zagato. U

Inspired by the aerodynamic designs of great prototype endurance race cars, the ISO Rivolta Zagato Vision Gran Turismo is a contemporary gentleman driver’s sports car designed specifically to compete at the highest international levels. Virtually-built using realistic volume and base measurements, the ISO Rivolta Zagato Vision Gran Turismo evokes a fierce attitude and raw emotion through its sensorial coachwork proportions: low center point of gravity, voluptuous fenders and sleek, elegant lines.

Historically, ISO Rivolta became famous among sophisticated, international clients in the 1960s and 1970s for its innovative approach in marrying Italian design with an American powertrain, thus producing excellent and reliable performance cars. These classic Iso sports and racing cars participated in some of the world’s greatest sports car competitions, such as the 12 Hours of Sebring, 1000 km of Nurburgring, and 24 Hours of Le Mans. The marque bearing the mythological Griffin logo also joined Formula 1 in the early 1970s through a partnership with Marlboro, and successfully competed at the hand of legendary professional drivers Jacky Ickx, Gjis Van Lennep and Arturo Merzario, to name a few.

Zagato, a design atelier with 98 years of experience, has collaborated with many famous automotive brands and is renowned for creating iconic, competitive sports cars in limited numbers. Zagato Vice President of Design Nori Harada pays tribute to ISO Rivolta with the creation of the new ISO Rivolta Zagato Vision Gran Turismo to honor ISO Rivolta’s racing heritage and passion for performance. Once again the Griffin will compete against the Ferrari, Lamborghini and other motorsports titans, this time in the virtual world of Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
IsoRivolta扎加托Vision Gran Turismo的设计灵感来自于那些伟大的耐力赛车原型车，是为最高国际水平赛事而打造的当代车手专用跑车。IsoRivolta扎加托Vision Gran Turismo虽然是虚拟车型，但其采用了真实体积和基础数据构建，具有感官冲击力的车身比例、低重心、丰满的挡泥板和圆滑优雅的曲线，令人为之心绪激荡、迸发原始情感。

在20世纪6、70年代，IsoRivolta曾在有品位的国际客户中声名远扬。这款车创新地将意大利的设计与美国的传动系统相结合，制造出优秀可靠的高性能汽车。这些经典的Iso跑车和赛车曾经参加过一些世界上最伟大的赛车比赛，如赛百灵12小时耐力赛、纽博格林1000公里耐力赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛。该品牌采用神话中的狮鹫作为标志，还曾在20世纪70年代早期与万宝路合作参加过一级方程式大赛，并在杰克·伊克斯、吉斯·范·伦内普和阿图罗·梅萨里奥等传奇车手的驾驶下取得出色的成绩。

扎加托作为拥有98年丰富经验的设计工作室和车身制造商，曾为大部分世界著名汽车品牌打造过汽车车身，以其标志性的、有竞争力的限量系列跑车而闻名。扎加托主管设计业务的副总裁原田典通过打造新的IsoRivolta扎加托Vision Gran Turismo向IsoRivolta致敬，以表彰其赛车传统和对高性能的追求。在跑车浪漫旅愿景的虚拟现实中，狮鹫将再次与奔腾的骏马、愤怒的公牛以及其他当今赛车巨头一决胜负。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This Vision Gran Turismo came from a renowned Italian design house. Its name was derived from the Latin word xenium, meaning “gift for the guest.” Its design encases both driver and engine in layered carbon fiber and aluminum, resulting in a distinctive wrapped appearance. A V-10 engine has been mounted behind the cockpit, while two electric motors powered the front wheels. To adapt to various terrain conditions, the chassis can be adjusted into four different configurations.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 出自著名意大利设计工作室的Vision Gran Turismo概念车型。车名源自拉丁语“xenium”，意为“赠予宾客的礼物”，其设计理念是用碳纤维和铝材将驾驶员与引擎完美“包裹”其中。驾驶舱后方搭载V10引擎，前部则配置了双电机系统。底盘可调节为4种不同配置模式，以适应各种路况和地形。

vehicleCollection.en:
A high-performance luxury car prepared as a "beautifully wrapped gift."h

Italdesign, founded in 1968 in Turin, Italy, has designed and engineered more than 300 production cars and 100 concept vehicles, many of which have been displayed the world's most important auto shows. More than a few cars designed by Italdesign are featured in Gran Turismo.

Some Italdesign creations have gone on to become famous movie cars, such as the DeLorean DMC 12 featured in the hit film trilogy "Back to the Future," and who can forget the Lotus Esprit that turned into a submarine in the James Bond feature "The Spy Who Loved Me?"

The Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo continues the endearing relationship between Gran Turismo and Italian automobiles. Inspired by the 2013 mid-engine compact GT called the Italdesign Parcour, this concept machine features cutting-edge technology and four different chassis settings—track, snow, off-road and urban—thus, it's at home on both the race track and off-road trails.

The car comes powered by two 200 kW (<272ps>) electric motors mounted up front, and a V-10 engine placed amidships that produce a combined 910 kW (<1237.3ps>), allowing the EXENEO VGT to reach a top speed of <380km/h> and a zero-to-<100km> acceleration time of 2.5 seconds. The EXENEO also has a 7-speed gearbox, Individual Wheel Drive (IWD) and KERS recovery system. To ensure maximum stability, an intelligent suspension system adapts automatically to different types of terrain.

The crystal sphere cockpit was developed around the driver. A carbon-fiber and aluminum tape envelope the driver and engine as a "xenium." This Latin word translates to "gift for the guest," and what a gift the Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo is.

long.zh:
Italdesign于1968年在意大利都灵创立，至今已经设计和制造了超过300款量产汽车，并且在全世界最盛大的各个车展上发布了超过100款概念赛车。它的许多作品都有在《跑车浪漫旅》中亮相。

Italdesign所设计的部分车辆还成为了真正的电影明星，例如在《回到未来》三部曲中出演的德罗宁 DMC 12，以及在《铁金刚勇破海底城》中由罗杰·摩尔驾驶的莲花跑车Esprit。

这款Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo延续了《跑车浪漫旅》中悠久的意大利汽车传统，另外还辅以最尖端的科技升级。这辆概念赛车的设计灵感来源于2013推出的全地形中后置引擎紧凑型车GT Italdesign Parcour，提供四种不同的底盘设置（赛道、雪地、越野和城市），为专业赛道和越野赛道二者所特别设计。

EXENEO VGT安装了一台强力的V10中置引擎，外加两部200千瓦（<272ps>）电机，可以确保输出共计910千瓦（<1237.3ps>）的动力，让这款车可以实现<380km/h>的极速，以及在2.5秒内完成0到<100km/h>加速。其动力系统还包含一部7档变速箱、独立轮驱动技术以及动能回收系统。为了确保最大的稳定性，这辆车还使用了智能悬挂系统，可以自动适应不同的地形。

这辆VGT采用了一套水晶球驾驶舱，是真正的“围绕驾驶者打造”。它的V10引擎置于车手后方，进一步增强了汽车的整体感，而前置电机则可以在加速时提供最大推力。一条碳纤维和铝制的线条包裹住车手和引擎，将整车设计成了一份“礼物”……这可真是一份最棒的礼物！

Italdesign, founded in 1968 in Turin, Italy, has designed and engineered more than 300 production cars and 100 concept vehicles, many of which have been displayed the world's most important auto shows. More than a few cars designed by Italdesign are featured in Gran Turismo.

Some Italdesign creations have gone on to become famous movie cars, such as the DeLorean DMC 12 featured in the hit film trilogy "Back to the Future," and who can forget the Lotus Esprit that turned into a submarine in the James Bond feature "The Spy Who Loved Me?"

The Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo continues the endearing relationship between Gran Turismo and Italian automobiles. Inspired by the 2013 mid-engine compact GT called the Italdesign Parcour, this concept machine features cutting-edge technology and four different chassis settings—track, snow, off-road and urban—thus, it's at home on both the race track and off-road trails.

The car comes powered by two 200 kW (<272ps>) electric motors mounted up front, and a V-10 engine placed amidships that produce a combined 910 kW (<1237.3ps>), allowing the EXENEO VGT to reach a top speed of <380km/h> and a zero-to-<100km> acceleration time of 2.5 seconds. The EXENEO also has a 7-speed gearbox, Individual Wheel Drive (IWD) and KERS recovery system. To ensure maximum stability, an intelligent suspension system adapts automatically to different types of terrain.

The crystal sphere cockpit was developed around the driver. A carbon-fiber and aluminum tape envelope the driver and engine as a "xenium." This Latin word translates to "gift for the guest," and what a gift the Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo is.

long.zh:
Italdesign于1968年在意大利都灵创立，至今已经设计和制造了超过300款量产汽车，并且在全世界最盛大的各个车展上发布了超过100款概念赛车。它的许多作品都有在《跑车浪漫旅》中亮相。

Italdesign所设计的部分车辆还成为了真正的电影明星，例如在《回到未来》三部曲中出演的德罗宁 DMC 12，以及在《铁金刚勇破海底城》中由罗杰·摩尔驾驶的莲花跑车Esprit。

这款Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo延续了《跑车浪漫旅》中悠久的意大利汽车传统，另外还辅以最尖端的科技升级。这辆概念赛车的设计灵感来源于2013推出的全地形中后置引擎紧凑型车GT Italdesign Parcour，提供四种不同的底盘设置（赛道、雪地、越野和城市），为专业赛道和越野赛道二者所特别设计。

EXENEO VGT安装了一台强力的V10中置引擎，外加两部200千瓦（<272ps>）电机，可以确保输出共计910千瓦（<1237.3ps>）的动力，让这款车可以实现<380km/h>的极速，以及在2.5秒内完成0到<100km/h>加速。其动力系统还包含一部7档变速箱、独立轮驱动技术以及动能回收系统。为了确保最大的稳定性，这辆车还使用了智能悬挂系统，可以自动适应不同的地形。

这辆VGT采用了一套水晶球驾驶舱，是真正的“围绕驾驶者打造”。它的V10引擎置于车手后方，进一步增强了汽车的整体感，而前置电机则可以在加速时提供最大推力。一条碳纤维和铝制的线条包裹住车手和引擎，将整车设计成了一份“礼物”……这可真是一份最棒的礼物！

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic vintage

conversation.en:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist
Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...

...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced
a new dynamic form.

From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of
French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.

With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began
competing at Le Mans in 1954.

While it came up short in its first year, it won overall
victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.

A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over
to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.
~
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
得益于空气动力学专家马尔科姆·塞尔所提供的
技术专业知识，这辆捷豹D-Type……

与过去的捷豹截然不同，采用了全新的动力学外观。

从XK120到XK150，捷豹一直追求某种法式的优雅，
而D-Type的推出带来了一场全方位的革新。

在生产了70余辆后，D-Type于1954年开始参加勒芒比赛。

虽然第一年出师不利，但655年和56年却大获全胜，
在捷豹的历史上写下了厚重的一笔。

这是一辆真正标志性的赛车，它的动力学设置
后来在XJ13上得到沿用，并被此后著名的E-type所继承。
4

conversation.en:
This is the Jaguar D-Type from 1954. It was introduced as
the evolutionary successor to the C-Type.

Like its predecessor, it was specifically built
to win at Le Mans.

Although it set a top speed record at the 1954 race,
it was forced to retire.

But in 1955, after being involved in a horrendous accident,
it took the overall win with Mike Hawthorn behind the wheel.

The car won again in 1956 an 1957, giving Jaguar an
incredible three wins in a row.

By the way, did you know that hydrodynamic principles
were applied to the D-Type’s curved body?

At the time, it signaled the start of adopting advanced
aerodynmic principles to increase performance.
o

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
这是1954年出厂的Jaguar D-Type。
作为C-Type的继任者，它得到了全面进化。

与它的前辈一样，D-Type是专门为在勒芒比赛中获胜而制造的。

尽管它在1954年的比赛中创造了速度纪录，但没能完成比
赛就退赛了。

在1955年，迈克·霍索恩驾驶D-Type在躲过一次可怕的碰撞事
故后，取得了最终胜利。

在56年和57年，D-Type连番卫冕，实现了惊人的勒芒三连冠。

值得一提的是，你知道D-Type的弧线车身设计考虑了流体力
学原理吗？

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Jaguar D-Type was a racing sports car introduced in 1954 as the successor to the C-Type, with just 64 units produced in total. It's built on a tubular frame with monocoque construction. Its sleek bodywork, penned by Malcolm Sayer, was instantly recognizable by the aerodynamic fin positioned behind the driver’s seat. It made its debut at the 1954 24 Hours of Le Mans and went on to dominate the event, securing victory three years in a row through 1957.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1954年推出的Jaguar D-Type竞速跑车延续了C-Type的血统，总共生产了64台。这台车采用管状车架与单体车壳结构。驾驶座后方的竖鳍让人能轻易辨别出马尔科姆·塞尔的设计。它在1954年勒芒24小时耐力赛上迎来首秀，并在1955至1957年实现三连冠。
officialDetails.heroEn: With three consecutive victories at Le Mans, this racing Jaguar featured a large fin that helped lateral stability at high speed.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这辆在勒芒耐力赛中连夺三冠的Jaguar跑车辨识度极高，从车手位置向后延伸的后鳍曲线显得如此高雅且流畅。

collection.en:
The D-Type is one of the most important cars in the history
of Jaguar motorsport.

It is also one of my favourite driving cars of the 1950s.

While it shares components with the double
Le Mans-winning C-Type...

Its all-aluminium monocoque body was a radical departure
from that model.

Its straight-six engine was also significantly tuned for
both power and reliability.

C-Type designer Malcolm Sayer also worked his magic
on the D-Type...

Fitting a fin to factory team cars to enhance stability
at high speeds.

The D-Type retired on its Le Mans debut in 1954, but
returned in 1955 to win three consecutive races.

Just 68 of this legendary racing car were produced,
with the works cars being the most desirable.
collection.zh:
D-Type是Jaguar汽车运动史上最重磅的车型之一，

也是我最喜欢的50年代车型之一。

尽管它与两次赢得勒芒比赛的冠军赛车C-Type共享部件，

但全铝单体车壳带来了全新的巨变。

其直列六缸引擎也针对功率和耐用性进行了显著调校。

D-Type的外观设计由曾参与过C-Type设计的Malcolm Sayer完成，

并在车厂车队的赛车上专门安装了鲨鱼鳍翼片，以强化
高速行驶时的稳定性表现。

D-Type在1954年首次参加勒芒耐力赛时因故退赛，但在1955年王
者归来，取得了三连冠。

这款传奇之车仅仅生产了68辆，其中又属车厂车队的那
几台最受热捧。 2

catch.en: With three consecutive victories at Le Mans, this racing Jaguar featured a large fin that helped lateral stability at high speed.
catch.zh: 这辆在勒芒耐力赛中连夺三冠的Jaguar跑车辨识度极高，从车手位置向后延伸的后鳍曲线显得如此高雅且流畅。

vehicleCollection.en:
With three consecutive victories at Le Mans, this racing Jaguar featured a large fin that helped lateral stability at high speed.

One of the most heralded race cars to ever come out of England was the Jaguar D-Type, which made its debut in 1954 with only 68 models produced until 1957. As the successor to the C-Type, the D-Type shared many components with its predecessor; the only significant changes being the central part of the tubular frame was changed to a monocoque design, while the power of the 3.4-liter inline-6 engine was upped from 250 hp <253ps> to 270 hp <274ps>.

As with the C-Type, the flowing, curvaceous shape of the body was penned by Malcolm Sayer. The fin behind the driver seat was added after repeated wind tunnel testing and became a major design signature of the car.

The D-Type made its racing debut in 1954. However, its first showing at the 24 Hours of Le Mans was less than stellar, as it was forced to retire after running in the lead and even setting the fastest lap. But things would soon change for the Jaguar race car starting the following year. The Number 12 car is the works car from this race.

In 1955, a long nose version was built with revised aerodynamics, and fuel injection was added in 1956. These changes enabled the D-Type to win the next three Le Mans races, from 1955 to 1957.

long.en:
One of the most heralded race cars to ever come out of England was the Jaguar D-Type, which made its debut in 1954 with only 68 models produced until 1957. As the successor to the C-Type, the D-Type shared many components with its predecessor; the only significant changes being the central part of the tubular frame was changed to a monocoque design, while the power of the 3.4-liter inline-6 engine was upped from 250 hp <253ps> to 270 hp <274ps>.

As with the C-Type, the flowing, curvaceous shape of the body was penned by Malcolm Sayer. The fin behind the driver seat was added after repeated wind tunnel testing and became a major design signature of the car.

The D-Type made its racing debut in 1954. However, its first showing at the 24 Hours of Le Mans was less than stellar, as it was forced to retire after running in the lead and even setting the fastest lap. But things would soon change for the Jaguar race car starting the following year. The Number 12 car is the works car from this race.

In 1955, a long nose version was built with revised aerodynamics, and fuel injection was added in 1956. These changes enabled the D-Type to win the next three Le Mans races, from 1955 to 1957.
long.zh:
D-Type是捷豹在1954年推出的竞速跑车，截至1957年共生产了68辆。D-Type是C-Type的后继车型，采用的基础技术也由前代型号直接升级而来。不过原本的管状车架中央部分现在被换成了单体车壳结构，3.4升直列6缸引擎的早期版本可以产生<253ps>，最终版本的动力则提高到了<274ps>，从而极大地提升了性能。

和C-Type一样，D-Type的车身来自马尔科姆·塞耶。在经过反复风洞试验后，设计师又在驾驶座后方增加了竖鳍，并与流畅的车身细节完美融合，共同构成了这款车的标志性特征。

D-Type在1954年首次参加比赛。在勒芒24小时耐力赛中，来自捷豹厂队的12号赛车表现出色，一度成为领头羊，甚至还创下了最快圈速纪录，但最终却遗憾退赛，未尽全功。

在1955年，捷豹又发布了一款经过空气动力学优化的长车头版本，并在次年引入了燃油喷射系统。在持续多年的改进后，这款车在1955到1957年间连续三年赢得了勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

这辆在勒芒耐力赛中连夺三冠的Jaguar跑车辨识度极高，从车手位置向后延伸的后鳍曲线显得如此高雅且流畅。

D-Type是捷豹在1954年推出的竞速跑车，截至1957年共生产了68辆。D-Type是C-Type的后继车型，采用的基础技术也由前代型号直接升级而来。不过原本的管状车架中央部分现在被换成了单体车壳结构，3.4升直列6缸引擎的早期版本可以产生<253ps>，最终版本的动力则提高到了<274ps>，从而极大地提升了性能。

和C-Type一样，D-Type的车身来自马尔科姆·塞耶。在经过反复风洞试验后，设计师又在驾驶座后方增加了竖鳍，并与流畅的车身细节完美融合，共同构成了这款车的标志性特征。

D-Type在1954年首次参加比赛。在勒芒24小时耐力赛中，来自捷豹厂队的12号赛车表现出色，一度成为领头羊，甚至还创下了最快圈速纪录，但最终却遗憾退赛，未尽全功。

在1955年，捷豹又发布了一款经过空气动力学优化的长车头版本，并在次年引入了燃油喷射系统。在持续多年的改进后，这款车在1955到1957年间连续三年赢得了勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

vehicleCollection.en:
The masterpiece 2-seater sports car continues to inspire car designers around the world.

The origins of Jaguar trace way back to 1922, when Sir William Lyons began looking for partners to produce a motorcycle with sidecar known as the “Combination.”

By 1961, Jaguar had become Britain's premier car maker, thanks partly to a beautiful 2-seat sports car called the E-Type.

The E-Type was the final model that Lyons was involved with. Inspired by the C-Type and D-Type race cars, the newest Jag sported a long, svelte body that sat low to the ground. It came in both fixed-roof and open-top versions.

The car came powered by Jaguar's trusty <3781cc> DOHC inline-6 with triple SU carbs, which also powered the XK series since 1949. The E-Type's version produced <269 ps> at <5500 rpm>. With a lean curb weight of <1219kg>, the E-Type was quick, running from zero to <100km/h> in 7.2 seconds and reaching a top speed of <210 km/h>.

Given its performance, the high £2,630 price tag at the time was extremely reasonable. In all, 7820 E-Types were produced through 1964, and of those, about 90 percent came to the United States.

long.zh:
捷豹的起源可以追溯到1922年，当时威廉·里昂斯正在着手寻找合作者，共同生产一辆挎斗摩托车。到了1961年，捷豹为全世界带来了一款全新的双座跑车：E-type。

E-type的引擎采用了XK系列自1949年起便一直沿用的老版动力核心，不过其车架、悬挂和车身外观则采用了许多先进理念，引领了之后的新世代。

首款E-type也是当时已渐渐退居幕后的里昂斯直接参与研发的最后一款车型。其又长又宽又低的车身比例设计汲取了C-Type和D-Type等赛车的优良传统，并对后世全球范围的跑车设计风格造成巨大影响。

除了敞篷版外，E-type产品线中还包括一款带侧开式后背门的固定顶棚双门车型。其引擎采用的是<3781cc>的双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，共拥有三个SU化油器，在<5500rpm>时可以输出<269ps>。得益于其1219kg的超轻重量，这款车的最高时速可以达到<210km/h>，0-<100km/h>的加速时间仅为7.2秒。

所有四个车轮的刹车系统均采用了专为赛场打造和调校的伺服刹车碟。事实上，E-type也是最早采用碟刹的消费级车型之一。

与其极强的性能相比，这款车在当时2,630英镑的定价相当合理。在1964年，E-type一共生产了7820辆，其中超过90%都跨过大西洋，被运到了美国。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line version of Jag's pure sports car has a distinctive British flair.

It was the rebirth of a legend. When the Jaguar F-Type bowed at the 2012 Paris Motor Show, it was evident from first glance that it was the spiritual successor of the celebrated E-Type, arguably the most beautiful sports/grand touring car ever made. The E-Type was discontinued in 1975, and while the XK Series carried on Jaguar’s grand touring duties, the F-Type was slated to carry on the company’s high-performance tradition.

The stylish car first came out as a convertible with an electric soft top, but almost exactly one year later, Jaguar unveiled the coupe version, which, not coincidentally, looked similar to the C-X16 concept car (the forbearer of the F Type shown almost simultaneously at the Los Angeles Auto Show and the Tokyo Motor Show), and the high-performance model of the series was the F-Type R Coupe.

The “R” designation stood for “Race,” so it came as no surprise that this model possessed a stronger engine, tighter suspension and more aggressive styling than the base F-Type. Under its hood resided a <550ps> 5.0-liter supercharged V-8, the base F-Type pumped out a “mere” <485ps>, which was still enough to make it one of the most powerful drop tops in the industry.

The F-Type R Coupe ran from zero to <100km/h> in a sprite 4.2 seconds, and reached a top speed of <300km/h>, restricted by a limiter. Its electronic controls such as the adaptive suspension and torque vectoring differential were also tuned for better performance. All this, and more, made the F-Type Coupe the consummate gentleman’s sports car, armed with a powerful engine, amazing handling and a high level of class.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.

捷豹F-Type于2012年巴黎车展上首次亮相，这款车是于1975年停产的著名跑车E-Type的后继车型。尽管捷豹的车型中已经有了双门和敞蓬的XK系列，但XK系列和XJS系列一样，只是高性能的豪华旅行车，而F-type则是纯粹的高性能跑车。

该车系最开始发布的是带电动软顶的敞篷车，凭借其造型和性能赢得了很高的赞誉。一年后，一款优雅的双门车型在洛杉矶车展和东京车展上几乎同步亮相，和F-type的概念赛车型C-X16别无二致。F-Type R Coupé是该车型中的高性能车款。

型号中的R意味着该型号拥有整个系列中最强劲的引擎、最紧致的悬挂和最具运动感的外观和内饰。这一命名规律自然也适用于R Coupé，高性能5升V8机械增压引擎的动力输出从<495ps>调高至<550ps>。因此可以在4.2秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速。但因为限速器的限制，最高时速只能达到<300km/h>。这款车的电子控制装置，如自适应悬挂和扭矩矢量分配差速器等，也被调整为更加运动的风格。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line version of Jag's pure sports car has a distinctive British flair.

It was the rebirth of a legend. When the Jaguar F-Type bowed at the 2012 Paris Motor Show, it was evident from first glance that it was the spiritual successor of the celebrated E-Type, arguably the most beautiful sports/grand touring car ever made. The E-Type was discontinued in 1975, and while the XK Series carried on Jaguar’s grand touring duties, the F-Type was slated to carry on the company’s high-performance tradition.

The stylish car first came out as a convertible with an electric soft top, but almost exactly one year later, Jaguar unveiled the coupe version, which, not coincidentally, looked similar to the C-X16 concept car (the forbearer of the F Type shown almost simultaneously at the Los Angeles Auto Show and the Tokyo Motor Show), and the high-performance model of the series was the F-Type R Coupe.

The “R” designation stood for “Race,” so it came as no surprise that this model possessed a stronger engine, tighter suspension and more aggressive styling than the base F-Type. Under its hood resided a <550ps> 5.0-liter supercharged V-8, the base F-Type pumped out a “mere” <485ps>, which was still enough to make it one of the most powerful drop tops in the industry.

The F-Type R Coupe ran from zero to <100km/h> in a sprite 4.2 seconds, and reached a top speed of <300km/h>, restricted by a limiter. Its electronic controls such as the adaptive suspension and torque vectoring differential were also tuned for better performance. All this, and more, made the F-Type Coupe the consummate gentleman’s sports car, armed with a powerful engine, amazing handling and a high level of class.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
捷豹F-Type于2012年巴黎车展上首次亮相，这款车是于1975年停产的著名跑车E-Type的后继车型。尽管捷豹的车型中已经有了双门和敞蓬的XK系列，但XK系列和XJS系列一样，只是高性能的豪华旅行车，而F-type则是纯粹的高性能跑车。

该车系最开始发布的是带电动软顶的敞篷车，凭借其造型和性能赢得了很高的赞誉。一年后，一款优雅的双门车型在洛杉矶车展和东京车展上几乎同步亮相，和F-type的概念赛车型C-X16别无二致。F-Type R Coupé是该车型中的高性能车款。

型号中的R意味着该型号拥有整个系列中最强劲的引擎、最紧致的悬挂和最具运动感的外观和内饰。这一命名规律自然也适用于R Coupé，高性能5升V8机械增压引擎的动力输出从<495ps>调高至<550ps>。因此可以在4.2秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速。但因为限速器的限制，最高时速只能达到<300km/h>。这款车的电子控制装置，如自适应悬挂和扭矩矢量分配差速器等，也被调整为更加运动的风格。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 2012, this sports car was created as a spiritual successor to the legendary E-type, which ended production in 1975. Initially offered only as a convertible, a coupe version was added just over a year later. This particular model is the high-performance F-type R Coupé, unveiled alongside the hardtop variant. Powered by a supercharged 5.0-liter V-8 producing 542.4 HP, it could accelerate from zero to 62.1 mph in just 4.2 seconds, with an electronically limited top speed of 186.4 mph.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款2012年推出的跑车是1975年停产的著名跑车E-type的精神续作。该车一开始只有敞篷版可供选择，一年多后增加了轿跑车款。这款车型便是与之同期发布的高性能车款——F-type R Coupé。5升V8机械增压引擎可输出550 PS，能够在4.2秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速，不过最高时速被限制到300 公里/小时。

rear-wheel-drive sports car for the modern age.

released in 2012.
