officialDetails.descriptionEn: This Vision Gran Turismo was created by Jaguar Advanced Design. A fully electric model, it carries forward the legacy of Jaguar’s legendary race cars like the C-type, D-type, and E-type, not only in elegance, but also in engineering, with a low center of mass and near-perfect weight distribution. Inside the cockpit, all essential driving information has been seamlessly projected ahead of the driver, delivering a thrilling racing experience through advanced digital integration.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款Vision Gran Turismo概念车由Jaguar Advanced Design设计部门打造。这款纯电动车型传承了Jaguar经典赛车C-Type、D-Type和E-Type的设计血统，不仅外观优雅，更具备低重心和完美的前后配重。坐进驾驶舱，所有必要的驾驶信息都会无缝投射在前方路面上，通过数字化技术营造出身临其境的赛车体验。
officialDetails.heroEn: This fully electric sports car combines Jaguar's rich racing tradition with the latest in EV technology.
officialDetails.heroZh: 全电动跑车，结合了Jaguar的赛车理念和最新的技术。

brandCentral.en:
The Vision Gran Turismo Coupé is the ultimate expression of
Jaguar's impeccable pedigree and technological wizardry.

The experience centers on its fully electric powertrain.

Every lesson learned from Jaguar's Formula E and I-PACE
eTROPHY history has been worked into the car.

The beautiful interior and exterior draws inspiration
from the marque's rich motorsports history.

The past, the present and future;
they're all are here in this one exquisite vehicle.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo Coupé是捷豹那完美血统和技术魔力的
终极展现。

其驾驶体验主要围绕一套纯电动力系统打造。

所有从捷豹的电动方程式锦标赛和I-PACE eTROPHY杯纯电动车锦标赛赛事经验中积累的
宝贵知识都得到了充分利用。

充满美感的内饰和外观设计从整个赛车运动的历史中汲
取了灵感，

让赛车的过去和未来的精华，都凝结在了这一辆精美的
赛车上。

catch.en: This fully electric sports car combines Jaguar's rich racing tradition with the latest in EV technology.
catch.zh: 全电动跑车，结合了Jaguar的赛车理念和最新的技术。

vehicleCollection.en:
This fully electric sports car combines Jaguar's rich racing tradition with the latest in EV technology.

The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo has been developed from the ground up as a pure, all-electric race car that celebrates the beautiful designs from Jaguar’s illustrious racing heritage while providing an exciting glimpse into the future of Jaguar design and technology.

The state-of-the-art powertrain features powerful, light, compact electric motors and a lithium-ion battery pack developed from the race-proven technologies used in the Jaguar I-TYPE 4 Formula E car and the world’s first production battery electric vehicle race series – the Jaguar I-PACE eTROPHY championship.

Proportion is fundamental to the design of every Jaguar, and to enable the dramatic form of the Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo, the battery modules are packaged around the cockpit, contributing to the low center of gravity and near-perfect weight distribution.

Inspiration for the cockpit of the Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo, was drawn from the true icons in Jaguar’s rich racing bloodline: cars such as the revered C-, D-, and E-Type. Fused with a contemporary, driver-focused interior philosophy of pure, beautiful and intricate details, creating an ideal balance between analog and digital. Access via a powered roof hatch enriches the driver experience still further.

The car’s architecture is lightweight, simple, and dramatic, and is crafted from advanced and experimental materials and finishes. Sitting down low in the cockpit, the driver will feel enveloped by the car – echoing the feel of the three-time Le Mans-winning D-Type.

The perfectly-weighted controls, essential information displayed precisely in the driver's eye line, and a virtually seamless view of the road combine to deliver a precision racing experience. Features such as hologram technology add a further flourish. Looking out over the gracefully long bonnet of the Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo – a view that is unmistakably Jaguar – the player is fully immersed in the action.

Designed exclusively for Gran Turismo by Jaguar Advanced Design, players are taken on a journey into the future along with the designers for a purely digital yet visceral experience that will truly capture the imagination.

long.zh:
捷豹Vision Gran Turismo是拥有全新设计的纯电动赛车，结合了捷豹一脉相承的优美运动外观设计，同时带来令人兴奋的未来设计和技术。

顶尖的动力系统包括强大、轻便、紧凑的电机和锂电池组，都依托于经受过大赛考验的赛车技术开发，源自捷豹I-TYPE 4 方程式E赛车以及全球首款参加I-PACE e纪念版锦标赛的量产电池电动车。

捷豹的每一款设计都以比例为核心，为配合捷豹Vision Gran Turismo绝妙的外形，电池模块被安装在驾驶舱周围，在降低车辆重心的同时保持近乎完美的重量分配。捷豹Vision Gran Turismo驾驶舱的灵感从捷豹诸多赛车车型：备受推崇的C-Type、D-Type和E-type中汲取精华。

设计者秉持以驾驶者为中心的当代内饰理念，创造出了纯正、优美、精益求精的细节，在模拟和数字功能之间达到了理想平衡。电动掀顶车门更是进一步丰富了驾驶者的驾乘体验。

这款车型结构轻巧、简单但抓人眼球，采用先进的实验性材料和饰面打造。坐在低坐姿的驾驶舱中，驾驶者会感觉到被车身包裹，仿佛置身于三获勒芒大奖的D-Type。

凭借性能平衡的控件、在视野内精确显示的关键信息，以及几乎没有误差的道路视野，驾驶员可以尽享精确的赛车体验。全息技术等功能进一步提升了驾驶感受。从捷豹Vision Gran Turismo雅致修长的引擎盖（无疑是捷豹的风格）放眼望去，玩家可以完全沉浸在比赛之中。

驾驶着这款由捷豹Advanced Design专为跑车浪漫旅设计的车型，玩家将与设计师一道踏上通往未来的旅程，在数字世界中挥洒肾上腺素，尽享想谡的魅力〃

全电动跑车，结合了Jaguar的赛车理念和最新的技术。

顶尖的动力系统包括强大、轻便、紧凑的电机和锂电池组，都依托于经受过大赛考验的赛车技术开发，源自捷豹I-TYPE 4 方程式E赛车以及全球首款参加I-PACE e纪念版锦标赛的量产电池电动车。

捷豹的每一款设计都以比例为核心，为配合捷豹Vision Gran Turismo绝妙的外形，电池模块被安装在驾驶舱周围，在降低车辆重心的同时保持近乎完美的重量分配。捷豹Vision Gran Turismo驾驶舱的灵感从捷豹诸多赛车车型：备受推崇的C-Type、D-Type和E-type中汲取精华。

设计者秉持以驾驶者为中心的当代内饰理念，创造出了纯正、优美、精益求精的细节，在模拟和数字功能之间达到了理想平衡。电动掀顶车门更是进一步丰富了驾驶者的驾乘体验。

这款车型结构轻巧、简单但抓人眼球，采用先进的实验性材料和饰面打造。坐在低坐姿的驾驶舱中，驾驶者会感觉到被车身包裹，仿佛置身于三获勒芒大奖的D-Type。

凭借性能平衡的控件、在视野内精确显示的关键信息，以及几乎没有误差的道路视野，驾驶员可以尽享精确的赛车体验。全息技术等功能进一步提升了驾驶感受。从捷豹Vision Gran Turismo雅致修长的引擎盖（无疑是捷豹的风格）放眼望去，玩家可以完全沉浸在比赛之中。

驾驶着这款由捷豹Advanced Design专为跑车浪漫旅设计的车型，玩家将与设计师一道踏上通往未来的旅程，在数字世界中挥洒肾上腺素，尽享想谡的魅力〃

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Jaguar’s third Vision Gran Turismo paid homage to the iconic Jaguar D-type. This futuristic electric open single-seater with an aero screen is powered by three electric motors generating more than 986.2 HP. Behind the seat is a modern take on the D-type’s signature fin, while the focused, minimalist cockpit controls reflected Jaguar’s storied racing legacy.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Jaguar第三款Vision Gran Turismo概念车的设计灵感源自经典的Jaguar D-Type赛车。这款配备导流风挡的开放式电动单座赛车采用三电机驱动，最大功率超过1,000 PS。座椅后方采用了经典D-Type标志性尾鳍的现代化演绎，简洁专业的座舱控制系统也充分体现了Jaguar的历史底蕴与传统。
officialDetails.heroEn: A roadster that's an heir to the legendary D-Type.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一辆源于传奇D-type的跑车。

brandCentral.en:
This 'Roadster' is Jaguar's third Vision Gran Turismo car.

A fully electric vehicle, it follows the lead of
Jaguar's two previous VGT cars.

Its three electric motors are capable of outputting
over <1000ps>.

Indeed, it provides the pure driving experience racers
have come to expect from Jaguar.

The body design was inspired by Jaguar's iconic D-Type
racing car.

The D-Type competed in the 1950s, winning the 24 Hours
of Le Mans an impressive three times!

In terms of styling, it was best known for the huge
fin at the rear of the car.

Well, the VGT Roadster brings that rear fin back to life
for the modern day!

Now an active fin, it deftly responds to the speed
at which the car is travelling.
brandCentral.zh:
这款“Roadster”便是Jaguar的第三款Vision Gran Turismo跑车。

它沿袭了Jaguar前两辆VGT车的理念，是一辆纯电动汽车。

它由三个电动马达驱动，能够输出超过<1000ps>的动力。

它满足了车手们对Jaguar跑车纯粹驾驶体验的期待。

车身设计的灵感来自Jaguar标志性的D-Type赛车。

D-Type是曾在20世纪50年代出场的经典赛车，
曾三次夺下勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军！

从外观上讲，它最为人熟知的特色便是那位于车尾的巨大尾鳍……

这款VGT敞篷跑车令它的尾鳍设计在当下再次焕发出了生命力！

在新车上，尾鳍变成了活动式的，
并且会根据车速自动作出相应调整。

vehicleCollection.en:
A roadster that's an heir to the legendary D-Type.

The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Roadster is an all-electric single-seater which combines a race-proven, state-of-the art powertrain with a taut, sculpted form inspired by the iconic, timeless Jaguar D-type.

Following the success of the original Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Coupé and Vision Gran Turismo SV endurance racer, the Gran Turismo Roadster is designed to bring gamers the pure, visceral driving experience of an open-cockpit Jaguar sports car powered by three electric motors generating a total power output of more than <1000ps>.

The flowing surfaces, dramatic lines and perfect proportions of the first two Jaguar Gran Turismo Vision cars are instantly recognizable, but in place of a deployable canopy is a swept-back aero screen directly in front of the driver. Behind, a modern interpretation of the fin synonymous with the three-time Le Mans-winning D-type, is aerodynamically optimized using the latest computational fluid dynamics tools to be deployable at speed for enhanced stability with minimal drag.

The fin also features one of the beautiful details found on the Roadster, here in the form of a Union Jack etched into the fin itself, and subtly illuminated by LEDs. The theme continues with the hand-crafted leather straps on the front fenders and iconic roundel lights in the grille.

The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Roadster’s dramatic, driver-focused interior combines lightweight, luxurious materials and finishes with stunningly intricate details. Looking out onto the gracefully long hood, gamers will be fully immersed in the action._

long.zh:
捷豹Vision Gran Turismo Roadster是一款全电动单座跑车，它结合了久经考验的最先进动力系统和受标志性、永恒的 捷豹D-Type 启发的紧实造型。

继最初的捷豹Vision Gran Turismo Coupé和Vision Gran Turismo SV 耐力赛车取得成功之后，Vision Gran Turismo Roadster旨在为游戏玩家带来开放式驾驶舱捷豹跑车的纯粹、发自内心的驾驶体验，该跑车由三个电动机提供动力，总共产生超过<1000ps>的功率输出。

前两款 捷豹Vision Gran Turismo SV汽车流畅的表面、引人注目的线条和完美的比例让人一眼就能认出，但可展开的顶篷代替了驾驶员正前方的后掠式航空屏幕。背后是对三届勒芒 D 型车的同义词的鳍的现代诠释，使用最新的计算流体动力学工具进行空气动力学优化，可快速展开，以最小阻力增强稳定性。

尾翼还具有整个跑车中随处可见的美丽细节之一，这里以英国国旗的形式——使用 捷豹字母组合图案——蚀刻到尾翼本身，并由LED灯巧妙地照亮。前挡泥板上的手工皮革肩带和前格栅上的标志性圆形灯延续了这一主题。

捷豹Vision Gran Turismo Roadster以驾驶者为中心引人注目的内饰结合了轻质、奢华的材料和饰面以及令人惊叹的复杂细节。望着优雅的长引擎盖，玩家们将完全沉浸在动感中。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Jaguar’s second Vision Gran Turismo was developed with engineering input from Jaguar Special Vehicles (SV). While retaining its elegant silhouette, the car received a complete aerodynamic overhaul to maximize downforce. The powertrain features four electric motors, drawing from Jaguar’s Formula E expertise. The battery system utilizes state-of-the-art liquid nitrogen cooling.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Jaguar第二款Vision Gran Turismo概念车由Jaguar设计，并融合了Jaguar特种车辆部门（SV）的工程技术。在保持优雅车身设计的同时，空气动力学系统经过彻底重新设计，以获得最大下压力。动力系统充分运用了该公司在Formula E赛事中积累的技术经验，采用四电机驱动布局。电池组还配置了最先进的液氮冷却系统。
officialDetails.heroEn: This virtual electric race car provides a glimpse into the future of Jaguar.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这辆虚拟电动赛车是对Jaguar未来的一瞥。

brandCentral.en:
Launched in 2020, the Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo SV is the
racing version of the VGT Coupé.

With its wealth of experience in the pure EV-racing scene,
Jaguar's aim was to create a 24-hour race contender.

The power unit was the work of the race team, and its four
motors produce a whopping <1903ps>.

The top speed? Just north of <400km/h>.

Liquid-nitrogen cooling systems ensure hyper-accurate
battery temperature management.

All of which adds up to a car whose fearsome speed can be
brought to bear on every inch of the track.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo SV是VGT Coupé的赛车版本，
于2020年正式推出。

Jaguar运用自己在纯电动赛车领域的丰富经验，倾力打造了
一辆24小时耐力赛的冲冠赛车。

动力单元直接来自车队，四部电机总共可以输出令人咋
舌的<1903ps>动力。

想知道它的极限速度吗？只是将将超过<400km/h>……而已！

通过液氮冷却系统，实现了对电池温度的超精确管理。

所有这些特性集中到同一辆车上，令它在赛道上彻底发
挥出令人生畏的速度优势。

catch.en: This virtual electric race car provides a glimpse into the future of Jaguar.
catch.zh: 这辆虚拟电动赛车是对Jaguar未来的一瞥。

vehicleCollection.en:
This virtual electric race car provides a glimpse into the future of Jaguar.

The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo SV, an all-electric virtual race car created by Jaguar Special Vehicle Operations, was a radical interpretation of what an electric Jaguar of tomorrow could be.

Developed from the dramatic Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Coupé of 2019, and fusing the spirit of the iconic C- and D-Type, the Vision Gran Turismo SV artfully blends the new with old. The car's sweeping body and perfectly balanced proportions offer the ultimate in aerodynamics. Highlights include the prominent front splitter, a purposefully-sculpted underbody, rear Venturi and a large rear wing with deployable elements.

The state-of-the-art lithium-ion battery pack, packaged around the cabin to enable ideal front/rear weight distribution, is cooled by a liquid nitrogen system that ensures every cell delivers maximum performance even under the most extreme race conditions.

The engineers successfully integrated elements of Jaguar’s I-TYPE 5 Formula E race car to the Vision Gran Turismo SV. Four powerful, compact electric motors help the car reach a top speed of more than 255 mph (approximately <410km/h>). The car also gives off a mean, distinctive sound to convey its powerful nature, one that reflects its true racing DNA.

Authentically yet futuristically Jaguar, the Vision Gran Turismo SV was designed and engineered to take the performance of the already potent Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Coupé to the next level.

long.zh:
捷豹 Vision Gran Turismo SV是一辆由捷豹特种车定制部门设计，为了满足未来的耐力赛事所需的终极性能而打造的纯电动力虚拟赛车。

 Vision Gran Turismo SV的设计基于激动人心的2019款捷豹Vision Gran Turismo Coupé，并融合了来自标志性的C-Type和D-Type的灵感、以及久经考验的冠军科技，是对未来的纯电动捷豹最激进的解读。

这辆车继承了捷豹一贯的平顺弧线车身和完美的平衡，其流线型的合成材料车身结构更是经历了不厌其烦的空气动力学优化。博人眼球的前定风翼、特别塑形的车身底板结构、后排气管和带有可展开部件的大尺寸尾翼既可以提供维持牵引力和高速稳定性所需的下压力，同时还最大限度地减小了风阻。

包含最顶尖科技的锂离子电池组包裹于驾驶舱四周，从而实现近乎完美的前后配重比。电池组采用了液氮冷却系统降温，确保即便在最极端的比赛环境下每块电池也可以输出最大性能，为赛车提供长距离比赛所需的持久动力。

Vision Gran Turismo SV吸收了捷豹在开发I-TYPE 5 方程式E赛车中的全部经验，其总共四台高性能、轻量级的紧凑型电机可以让这款车达到超过255英里/小时（<410km/h>）的最高时速。相较于前款车型的三电机动力系统，Vision Gran Turismo SV在马力和扭矩上都有了极大的提高，并且带来了更加独特的声浪，显得果决而锋芒毕露，如实地反映出它纯正的赛车血统。

驾驶舱内简约、平滑的内饰安全地包裹住车手，所有的仪表和完美减重的操纵系统也放置在最合理的位置。每一个组件都采用了先进的轻量化材料，亥绝对精凇的覄格精心打造。

Vision Gran Ttrismo SV是一辆血统纯正职䎈其备未来风格的捷豹赛车，其设计和制造工艺将厞版捷豹Vision Gran Turismo Coupé的性能和动劚学推向新的高度，幷提供一种直观　充绡沈浸感且令仺捯奋的驾驶体誌 1

conversation.en:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued
to work on a successor to the D-Type.

While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT,
the base model for the GT40...

design language as the D-Type.

The result? A rfined and aerodynamic prototype
with a V-12 mounted amidships.

The XJ13.

Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...

...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as

collection.en:
Jaguar played a huge part in the history of the
24 Hours of Le Mans,

winning this famous race five times in the 1950s with the
C-Type and D-Type.

However Jaguar withdrew from competition at Le Mans after 1956,
and didn't show interest in racing again until the 1960s.

But development of a sports car to succeed the D-Type
had been secretly underway.

That successor of the D-Type, is the car you see before you,
the XJ13 with a midship mounted V12.

But unfortunately, this XJ13 never made it to Le Mans.

By the time the car was ready, management's priorities
had changed again.

We can only imagine what might have happened,

had Jaguar been part of the legendary Ford-Ferrari tussle
at the '67 Le Mans.

然而，这家公司于1956年后退出勒芒赛事，直到20世纪60
年代才重新表现出对比赛的兴趣。

不过，D-Type的后继者的设计开发一直在秘密进行。

它便是您眼前看到的这台配备中置V12引擎的XJ13。

当这辆赛车准备完毕的时候，管理层的优先战略目标又
发生了变化。

我们只能幻想，如果捷豹参与了1967年勒芒耐力赛
福特与法拉利那场堪称传奇的战斗，

最后会是什么样的结果。

vehicleCollection.en:
A dream car that never came to be, this beautiful V12 mid-engine race car disappeared.

When it comes to racing, there may not be any other marquee around with a richer historical heritage than Jaguar. Back in the day, Jaguar won the 24 Hours of Le Mans from 1955 to 1957, with the now legendary D-Type taking the checker three years in a row. The company's activity as a works team ended in 1956, but there were those within the company that still had a passion for racing. These men continued to develop racing cars, and one in particular was intended to succeed the D-Type. This car was dubbed the XJ13 and was completed in 1966. It was Jaguar's first mid-engine race car.

The body was similar to the road-going E-Type, often considered one of the most beautiful road cars in history; however, within the engine compartment sat a 5.0-liter DOHC V12 that pumped out <502ps>. This engine would serve as the basis for the company's 12-cylinder engines for years to come.

The engineers had high hopes for the XJ13 in actual competition, but the management team at Jaguar wasn't keen on seeing it race, and along with the fact that company brass wanted to keep the V12 engine a secret, the XJ13 project was canceled. It's too bad really, because the car was said to be the most beautiful in Jaguar's history. Although it never made it onto any racetrack, one car was actually produced, but it was severely damaged during filming of a promotional clip for the E-Type. Since then, the car has fortunately been restored to its original splendor.

捷豹是一家从诞生之初就活跃在赛场上的车厂，而且屡屡创下佳绩。自1955年至1957年的三年间，连续在勒芒24小时拉力赛中拔得头筹。

他们自1956年起就不再以车厂形式参与赛车活动，但捷豹的工程师团队中仍有许多人坚持着对赛车运动的热情。他们继续稳步开发一款纯粹的赛车，计划取代过去三年内在勒芒拉力赛中称霸的D-Type，成为新的霸主。

这款车最终完成于1966年，代号为XJ13，是捷豹的首款引擎中置跑车。此车具有流线型的低车身，外形与捷豹当时的量产跑车E-type相近，搭载了新设计的<502ps>5升双顶置凸轮轴V12引擎，该引擎也是捷豹后来开发的12汽缸引擎的原型。

工程师们对这款车在实际比赛中的表现寄予厚望，但当时的管理层并不热衷于参加赛车比赛，他们也不希望其他制造商知道他们的V12引擎的存在。项目最后还是被取消了，XJ13虽然据称是捷豹史上最优美的车型，但却从未在赛车场上现身。这款车只生产了一辆，且在拍摄E-type的宣传片时被严重损毁。此后，这辆车经过修复，被保管在仓库里。

vehicleCollection.en:
A road-going Group C car with breath-taking bodywork

In 1988, Jaguar showed a prototype of a super sports machine at the British International Motor Show called the XJ220. In 1991, it unveiled the final production version of the car at the Tokyo Motor Show. The XJ220 received its name from its maximum speed, which was 220 mph, the highest ever at the time for a commercially marketed car.

Jaguar entrusted production of the XJ220 to Jaguar Sports, a joint venture with TWR, which developed the Jaguar Group C car and was in charge of its race team. The prototype engine was a naturally-aspirated V-12, but the XJ220 that was shown in Tokyo came with a twin-turbo 3.5-liter V-6 engine from the XJR11 Group C car. The chassis was crafted from composite aluminum honeycomb and carbon Kevlar, not unlike that of a serious race car. Under the body, a panel that produced serious ground effects was added, again, just like a Group C racer. Setting the car apart from the race machine was a luxurious interior that was finished with the finest materials around, in the same manner as the company's notable luxury cars.

In 1993, Jaguar entered the XJ220 into the GT class of the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Taking the wheel were David Coulthard, David Brabham, and John Nielsen, who teamed up to successfully complete the endurance race and win in its class...or so everyone thought. A month later, the XJ220 was disqualified due to an exhaust violation, and its result was stricken from the books.

Later, the XJ220 was entrusted to the famous Team Chamberlain race team and continued to participate in GT races including the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

1988年，捷豹在英国国际车展上展示了一款超级跑车的原型车，但直到1991年，他们才终于在东京车展上为最终的成车，也就是XJ220，揭幕。XJ220的名字来源于它的理论极速，220英里/小时（<354km/h>），这是当时市场上所有商用车型中最快的。

捷豹将XJ220的生产工作委托给了他们与汤姆·沃金肖赛车成立的合资公司，捷豹运动。汤姆·沃金肖赛车曾经开发了捷豹的C组别赛车，并且负责运营捷豹的赛车车队。这款原型车的引擎采用一部自然进气V12引擎，不过在东京亮相的XJ220却换上了XJR11 C组别赛车使用的3.5升V6涡轮增压引擎。它的底盘采用了复合铝制蜂窝板和碳纤维凯夫拉材料，基本上与赛车别无二致，车身下方还添加了一块可以产生地面效应的底板。从机械方面来说，这款XJ220本质上就是一辆C组别赛车的公路版复刻。当然了，这辆车的内饰可以与捷豹的所有豪华车型相媲美，全面采用最优质的材料进行了最后加工。

在1993年，捷豹派出这辆XJ220参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的GT组别。参赛团队由大卫·库特哈德、大卫·布拉汉姆和约翰·尼尔森组成，他们安全地完成了比赛，并夺得了该组别的胜利。然而在一个月之后，XJ220因为违反了一项排放规则而被取消了资格，而其创下的记录也被剥夺。

之后，XJ220被托付给著名的张伯伦车队，并继续参加包括勒芒24小时耐力赛在内的各种GT赛事。

The Jaguar XJR-9 was penned by British racing car
designer Tony Southgate.

In 1988, it competed at the World Sports Prototype
Championship.

Among its six victories was a legendary show at the 24 Hours
of Le Mans...

Which was Jaguar’s first Le Mans victory since 1957!

The XJR-9 also won the Teams Championship...

And driver Martin Brundle won the Drivers title.

No doubt, the XJR-9’s purple paint job is now known
to one and all!

conversation.en:
The 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans was one for the history books.

Jaguar fans from the UK were showed up in force, with Union Jack
flags waving all around the track.

It was a sight I'll never forget.

This is the car that brought Jaguar the victory that day.

It finally got the better of the Porsches that had
dominated Le Mans for so long.

It certainly put a smile on the legions of Britsh fans.

But they first had to endure a stressful race.

It wasn't until the end that Jaguar was able to put away
the Porsche that was applying pressure all race.

Just thinking of it now sends  chill down my spine.
V

1988年的勒芒24小时耐力赛相当不平凡。

那年，大批来自英国的Jaguar车迷涌入赛场，
赛道上的米字旗四处可见。

我永远也忘不了那番景象！

而那天为Jaguar赢得胜利的，正是这辆车……

他们在那天终于打败了称霸勒芒已久的Porsche。

这也让英国车迷充满了自豪和喜悦。

萨森赛车场那时热闹非凡！

那场比赛非常激烈，获胜的Jaguar到最后
都一直面临着身后Porsche的压力！

光是想想那场景就让我背脊发凉！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Following its string of successes at Le Mans during the 1950s, Jaguar made a return to endurance racing in 1986 with a Group C prototype. Jaguar reached its peak in 1988 with the XJR-9. Thanks to its exceptional aerodynamics and durability, it claimed victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. That triumph secured its place in motorsports history, as Jaguar dethroned Porsche, the long-reigning champions of Le Mans.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 在1950年代的勒芒取得巨大成功后，Jaguar在1986年带着一款C组别赛车再度杀回这项赛事。这辆XJR-9帮助他们在1988年登上了巅峰。它简单的构造提供了优秀的空气动力学性能和耐用性，帮助这款车在勒芒24小时耐力赛上强势夺魁。凭借一场击败勒芒的常胜冠军Porsche的胜利，它为自己在赛车历史上留下了浓墨重彩的一笔。
officialDetails.heroEn: This iconic race car brought Jaguar many victories, notably against turbocharged competitors.
officialDetails.heroZh: Jaguar标志性的勒芒参赛车，打败了涡轮增压赛车。

collection.en:
Despite their early success in the 1950s, Jaguar didn't enter
a works team at Le Mans again for almost 30 years.

In fact, they wouldn't return to the race until 1986,
when they entered the XJR-6.

The XJR-6 was designed by Tony Southgate,
who had made his name in Formula 1,

and it was powered by a naturally aspirated V12 engine.

It was the heyday of turbocharged cars, and the XJR-6's uniquely
high-pitched exhaust note was instantly recognizable.

The sight and sound of a Jaguartearing around the track
once more certainly got the fans excited!

Two years later, Jaguar entered the XJR-9
and finally won at Le Mans,

 for their first new victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans since an
Ecurie Ecose D-Type won in 1957.

It ha been more than thirty years since their last win!

That alone is enougto secure thisʃconiccar's
place in the annals of racing history!
collection.zh:
尽管捷豹在20世纪50年代
就早早地创下辉煌战绩，

但在之后的将近30年时间里，
捷豹都再没有以厂队的身份参加过勒芒耐力赛。

一直等到1986年，他们才带着XJR-6重返赛场。

XJR-6由当时在F1声名遐迩的托尼·索思盖特设计，

配备了自然进气V12引擎。

当时涡轮增压车型的声势日渐浩大，而XJR-6爆裂清脆的排
气声夹在其中，获得了很高的辨识度。

一辆捷豹赛车在赛
上飞驰的景象和巨大的轰鸣声都能让
车迷兴奋不已！

两年后，捷豹带着XJR-9在勒芒重新登上领奖台。

这是自1957年Ecurie Ecose D-Type获胜以来，
他们在勒芒24小时耐力赛中的首次胜利。

距他们上次夺冠已经过去了30多年！

仅仅这一条，就X确保这款J志i汽车被载入赛车运
动的史册里！

catch.en: This iconic race car brought Jaguar many victories, notably against turbocharged competitors.
catch.zh: Jaguar标志性的勒芒参赛车，打败了涡轮增压赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This iconic race car brought Jaguar many victories, notably against turbocharged competitors.

In the golden era of racing, Jaguar was a force to be reckoned with, especially at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, where the classic marquee won five times from 1951 to 1957. And then, Jaguar took a long break, not returning to the Sarthe Circuit until 1986 when the company re-emerged with the Group C race car, the XJR-6, developed by TWR (Tom Walkinshaw Racing).

Designed by noted Formula 1 designer Tony Southgate, the XJR-6 was a bit different from other Group C cars in that it did not have a turbocharged powerplant. Most teams opted with small displacement turbocharged engines to improve fuel-efficiency, but Jaguar went with pure power, in the form of a naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V-12, which grew to 7.0 liters in the XJR-9, which produced about <700 ps>.

The XJR-9 competed with perennial powerhouses such as Nissan, Toyota, Mercedes-Benz and Porsche at the 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans. The XJR-9 took the checkered flag, with Jan Lammers, Johnny Dumfries and Andy Wallace sharing the driving duties. It was a historic moment for Jaguar, which returned to glory at the famed French circuit after a long absence.

long.en:

And then, Jaguar took a long break, not returning to the Sarthe Circuit until 1986 when the company re-emerged with the Group C race car, the XJR-6, developed by TWR (Tom Walkinshaw Racing).

Designed by noted Formula 1 designer Tony Southgate, the XJR-6 was a bit different from other Group C cars in that it did not have a turbocharged powerplant. Most teams opted with small displacement turbocharged engines to improve fuel-efficiency, but Jaguar went with pure power, in the form of a naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V-12, which grew to 7.0 liters in the XJR-9, which produced about <700 ps>.

The XJR-9 competed with perennial powerhouses such as Nissan, Toyota, Mercedes-Benz and Porsche at the 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans. The XJR-9 took the checkered flag, with Jan Lammers, Johnny Dumfries and Andy Wallace sharing the driving duties. long.zh:
在二十世纪五十年代，捷豹曾在勒芒24小时耐力赛中大获成功，但该公司直到1986年才重返比赛，派出XJR-6参加了C组比赛。

这款车由著名的F1设计师托尼·绍斯盖特设计，配备捷豹引以自豪的自然吸气式V12引擎。

在八十年代，C组允许采用任何形式的引擎，只要能够维持一定的燃油效率即可。它的许多竞争对手都采用了紧凑型的涡轮增压引擎，惟有捷豹坚持采用自然吸气引擎。

XJR6最初使用的是一款6.5升引擎，但后来扩容至7升，可以产生<700ps>左右的。其他采用涡轮增压引擎的车型已经开始冲击<800ps>，捷豹不得不采用其他方式对引擎进行了改进，以提高竞争力。于1988年亮相的XJR-9应运而生。

XJR-9的优势在于其卓越的空气动力学性能和非凡的控制稳定性，以及简单的结构带来的耐用性。XJR-9当时面对的对手是日本的日产和丰田，以及刚刚开始全力参与赛车制造的梅赛德斯，还有前年的冠军保时捷。但捷豹也拥有成群车迷的支持，他们不远万里越过多佛海峡来为他们心爱的汽车加油。

在1988年的勒芒24小时耐力赛上，赛道沿途都有许多人挥舞着英国国旗，XJR-9一路冲锋，由简·拉默斯、约翰尼·邓弗里斯和安迪·华莱士驾驶的车辆成功完成了24小时比赛，看到了方格旗。这是历史性的一刻，自然吸气引擎在对抗涡轮增压引擎的C组比赛中获得了胜利。

conversation.en:
This is where Jeep culture started.

A purely functional design to meet military needs.

Now, the form-follows-function approach doesn’t
always guarantee success.

Only on rare occasions does it work—and in this case
the vehicle became an icon.

The engineers who worked on this program...

Must have had a good sense of proportion
and high design standards.

They knew precisely where to work their magic.

In some cases, the depth of the flanges helped to strengthen
the panels so that thinner pieces could be used.

Truly impressive work!

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The roots of the SUV category could be traced back to this compact 4-wheel-drive vehicle, developed at the request of the U.S. military in 1940. Among the prototypes submitted by Bantam, Ford, and Willys, it was the Willys MB—an improved version of the MA—that proved to be the winner, ultimately leading to the production of over 360,000 units. Its straightforward yet durable construction, featuring a ladder frame, rigid axles, and 4-wheel drive, resulted in a truly historic vehicle whose legacy has endured for generations.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: SUV车型的起源可追溯到这款1940年应美军要求开发的紧凑型四轮驱动车辆。在Bantam、Ford和Willys生产的测试车型中，Willys MB表现最佳。作为MA的升级版本，最终生产了超过36万辆。其简单坚固的结构（采用边梁式车架和刚性车轴）与四轮驱动形成完美结合，成就了一款真正具有历史意义的汽车，其精神传承至今。

usedCar.en:
No historical account of 4WD vehicles would be
complete without mentioning the Willys MB.

It is, simply put, the granddaddy of
the modern-day Jeep.

The Willy MB was developed in 1940, at the start of WWII,
at the behest of the U.S. Army.

The task? To build a sturdy, compact machine
with superior off-road performance.

As you know by now, the Willys MB
successfully rose to the challenge.

After the war, Willys started selling the MB
as a general-purpose vehicles.

It was around this time that the term Jeep
came into common use.

Thanks to its efficiency off the beaten path, the original Jeep
remains the epitome of off-road vehicles to this day.
usedCar.zh:
如果要讲述四驱车的历史，Willys MB
绝对是绕不过去的存在。

事实上，它才是人气持久的Jeep车型的“鼻祖”。

这辆车于二次世界大战初期
按照美国陆军指定的规格开发。

开发的目的？当然是打造一辆具有超强越野性能，
但又皮实紧凑的车辆。

可以想象，Willys MB完美地达成了这一目标。

战后，Willys开始将MB作为“通用型”车辆投入市场。

也正是在这一时期，“Jeep”这个称呼开始被广泛接受。

由于出色的设计和越野性能，Jeep在今天
仍然是四驱车的典范。\

vehicleCollection.en:
The U.S. Army-commissioned vehicle that became the forefather of the modern SUV.+

The SUV genre may well have started with this vehicle, a compact 4-wheel-drive off-roader that was commissioned by the United States Army for use during World War II.

The United States asked Bantam, Ford and Willys to develop and produce prototypes of all-terrain vehicles based on a design by Bantam. Each company built more than 1500 examples that were immediately put to use on the battlefront. Here, the Willys MA shined the brightest, so the U.S. Army placed its order and Willy delivered the MB, of which 360,000 units were eventually manufactured.

When the war ended, Willys registered the Jeep trademark and offered a production-based MB for the general public. Because of its success and exposure during the war, it was an instant hit, thus the SUV was born and the MB's place in the annals of automotive history solidified.

Each company built more than 1500 examples that were immediately put to use on the battlefront. Here, the Willys MA shined the brightest, so the U.S. Army placed its order and Willy delivered the MB, of which 360,000 units were eventually manufactured.

When the war ended, Willys registered the Jeep trademark and offered a production-based MB for the general public. Because of its success and exposure during the war, it was an instant hit, thus the SUV was born and the MB's place in the annals of automotive history solidified.
long.zh:
如果要追溯现代SUV车型的根源，你最终会找到这辆紧凑的四轮驱动汽车，此车是在1940年第二次世界大战期间应美国军队的要求而开发的机器。

当时，美国陆军同时要求班腾公司、福特公司和威利斯公司在班腾公司的车辆设计基础上开发和生产自己的原型车。三家公司都生产了超过1500辆这样的车辆，送入军队服役。在这些原型车中，表现最好的当属威利斯公司的MA。在MA基础上进一步改进而成的MB车型最终被正式投入使用，总产量超过36万辆。

正是这款车型成为了后来每一款Jeep车的灵感来源。

战后，威利斯公司注册了Jeep商标，并发布了基于MB制造的民用车型。由于归国士兵对MB的性能和越野能力的广泛赞誉，该车为威利斯公司带来了巨大成功。

这款车以梯形车架和实心车轴为基础，向后人证明了简单、坚固的结构与四轮驱动系统相结合的优越性。

可以说，MB在四轮驱动汽车历史中占有无可比拟的重要性。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The X-BOW was the first sports car developed by Austrian motorcycle manufacturer KTM. Pronounced “Crossbow,” it drew inspiration from the mechanical bow weapon that shares its name. Stripped of doors and windows, this minimalist two-seater eliminated all superfluous features in pursuit of pure performance. With its precise handling, the car was capable of sustaining up to 1.5 lateral Gs through corners.

vehicleCollection.en:
The KTM X-Bow is a unique Audi turbo-powered track car from the Austrian motorcycle manufacturer.

The first sports car developed by Austrian motorcycle manufacturer KTM made its debut at the 2007 Geneva Motor Show. Its name X-BOW was pronounced "Crossbow," inspired by the weapon of the same name. What's more, the car was styled in the image of a crossbow itself. It's a 2-seater, with no doors or windows... in fact, there are no comfort or luxury items to speak of. It certainly is, however, street legal.

The car was styled by Kiska Design, who also designed KTM's 2-wheeled machines, so the chassis features a motorcycle-like design. The X-BOW is a mid-engine vehicle with a carbon monocoque structure, which was co-developed by Dallara, a top race car chassis designer. A pushrod type double wishbone suspension is mounted front and rear, giving it the setup like that of a pure racing car. It possesses a flat bottom and a large diffuser at the rear end that generates <200kg> of downforce at <200km/h>. This helps allow the car to register an insane 1.5g in lateral acceleration.

There is nothing on or in this car other than what is required to go really fast. Inside the simple cockpit, there is a single display that serves as the instrument panel. Mounted behind the seats is Audi's turbocharged direct injected 2.0-liter TSFI engine that produces <240ps>/<31.6kgm> of torque. It propels the <790kg> car from 0-<100km/h> in an amazing 3.9 seconds. Even in standard trim, the X-BOW rivals the performance specs of some respectable supercars. The top-of-the-line "R" model gets the same engine, but power is boosted to <300ps>/<40.8kgm>. And with an upgraded suspension to accompany the extra power, it's as fast as—perhaps faster—than many race cars around a track.

long.zh:
X-BOW是奥地利摩托车制造商KTM开发的首款跑车，在2007年日内瓦车展上亮相。

车辆的名称读作“Crossbow”，因为车的外型令人想起十字弓的形象而得名。这款车是一辆既没有门也没有窗的双座车，绝无任何附加部件。然而，这款车却是能够合法上路的。

其造型由基斯达设计事务所负责，该事务所同时也负责设计KTM的摩托车。与摩托车类似的外部面板之下是碳纤维单体式车身，采用中置式布局，设计部分由赛车制造商Dallara协助完成。

在车前和车后分别安装的推杆式双叉臂悬挂，使得其结构与纯粹的赛车相似。平坦的车底和更大的尾部扰流翼能在<200km/h>的速度下产生<200kg>的下压力。这些空气动力学设计使得车辆能够在过弯时承受1.5G的横向重力加速度。

车上除了驾驶必需的设备外别无一物，极简的驾驶舱中只配置了一块用做仪表板的显示面板。背后安装的是来自于奥迪的2.0升直喷TSFI涡轮增压引擎，标准车款输出<240ps>、扭矩<31.6kgm>，推动<790kg>的车身从0-<100km/h>加速用时为3.9秒。

即使是经过降低性能的标准版，在性能规格上也能与备受好评的超级跑车一较高下，而最高配置的“R”款还能更胜一筹，输出<300ps>和<40.8kgm>的扭矩。随着悬挂进一步升级，无需进行其他的改装，也可在赛道上跑出相当快的成绩。

就得到了Lexus LF-LC GT VGT！

catch.en: A beautiful high performance machine for participation in the Nürburgring 24 hour race.
catch.zh: 优雅的高性能赛车，参赛纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

vehicleCollection.en:
A beautiful high performance machine for participation in the Nürburgring 24 hour race.

For Lexus, the 2014 Super GT GT500 class was a historic season in which they fought hard for the class title until the very last race. And in 2015, Lexus added a new page to their ultimate challenge in the top category: They are planning an introduction of a car into the GT3 class, a class that is a gentlemen’s race but at the same time the ultimate international manufacturers’ championship. This comes from the hope of Lexus to fulfill the desires of gentlemen racers; to participate together with them in world class races in the car of their dreams.

With this background of Lexus’ involvement in racing, the LEXUS LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo” was developed in reply to the passions of Gran Turismo fans, to compete in world class races with their dream car. The design and development of the car targets entry in races such as the Super GT and the Nürburgring 24 hour race.

For Lexus, the 2014 Super GT GT500 season was one to remember because it took home the championship in the very last race. In 2015, Lexus entered the GT3 racing class, where it battled in the world's foremost international championships.

The brand's amazing success in motorsports paved the way for the creation of the Lexus LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo.” With this machine, Gran Turismo players were able to compete virtually in various world-class races in what can be called the quintessential gentleman's race car.

The LF-LC GT "Vision Gran Turismo" is based on the LF-LC concept vehicle, which was shown at the 2012 North American International Auto Show and created by Calty Design Research. Thus, the LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo” is a grand tourer that possesses both sculptured beauty and the highest levels of performance, with real world elements provided by Calty blended with the on-road prowess of Lexus Racing.

Born from a passion for racing, the Lexus LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo” is a car meant to probe the potentials of the ultimate Lexus race car._

long.zh:
对于雷克萨斯而言，2014年Super GT的GT500组是一个历史性的赛季，他们奋战至最后一场比赛，最终赢得了该组冠军。2015年，雷克萨斯对另一项顶级赛事发起了新的挑战，他们派出一款车型参加GT3组比赛，该组虽然是业余赛事，但同时也是顶级国际车厂的锦标赛。雷克萨斯此举是希望满足业余选手的梦想；让他们驾驶着他们所梦想的车型，与他们一起参加世界级的比赛。

雷克萨斯凭借其在赛车领域的专业背景，为了回应跑车浪漫旅玩家的热情，使他们能够驾驶自己梦想中的跑车参加世界级的赛事，专门开发了雷克萨斯LF-LC GT Vision Gran Turismo。在设计开发过程中，该车型预想征战的赛场包括Super GT和纽博格林24小时耐力赛等比赛。

该车的基本车型来自双门豪华概念赛车型LF-LC，这款车是2012年底特律车展上公布的雷克萨斯未来概念赛车型。这款由CALTY DESIGN所设计的车型有许多激动人心的设计特征，如模仿喷气式战斗机助燃器的尾灯等。

基于CALTY DESIGN提出的雷克萨斯设计哲学，这款车采用了革命性的表现手法，并且运用了雷克萨斯赛车在现实世界中的实践经验。雷克萨斯LF-LC GT "Vision Gran Turismo"是一款既富雕塑美感，又具备实际性能的超级跑车。

在每个时代，赛车都是人们为之倾注激情的运动。轰鸣的排气声令人们为之血脉偾张。雷克萨斯LF-LC GT Vision Gran Turismo的白色车身上的彩色笔刷纹样正是象征了这些永远令赛车运动爱好者着迷的精彩时刻。

雷克萨斯LF-LC GT Vision Gran Turismo诞生于对赛车运动的狂热，它是为实现了跑车浪漪旅玩家的碦惲而生的。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This Vision Gran Turismo concept was born from the passion and technical expertise of the team at Centro Stile Lamborghini. Built around Lamborghini’s signature design language, highlighted by bold "Y" elements and hexagonal forms, it also pays tribute to the iconic Stratos Zero with a side profile that echoed its striking silhouette. Power comes from a V-12 engine paired with a supercapacitor-based hybrid system, derived from the Sián FKP 37. In a refined detail, part of this advanced system is visible from the outside, blending high-performance engineering with unmistakable style.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款Vision Gran Turismo凝聚了Centro Stile Lamborghini团队的炽热激情与精湛技艺。虽然主要设计语言采用“Y”形和六边形元素，但侧面轮廓却与经典的Stratos Zero有着异曲同工之妙。动力系统采用V12引擎配合超级电容混合动力技术，技术源自Sián FKP 37。最为精妙的设计细节在于，这套系统的运作状态可以从车外清晰看到。
officialDetails.heroEn: This futuristic single-seat sports concept possesses the core concepts of Lamborghini's design DNA.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款近未来主义的单座运动概念车的核心设计理念带有深深的Lamborghini 基因。

brandCentral.en:
The Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo offers a glimpse
into the future of single-seat super sports cars.

Designed by Lamborghini's internal design department,
Lamborghini Centro Stile...

...the car features y-shapes and hexagons all over
its sleek body.

The drivetrain is a hybrid system, with electric motors
and a V-12.

The so-called "digital cockpit" has various augmented
reality features, providing a new experience for drivers.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo是一辆充满未来感的
单座超级跑车。

它出自Lamborghini的内部设计部门Lamborghini Centro Stile
的手笔……

它的主要造型元素由为数不少的y形和六边形轮廓组成，
遍布线条利落的纤细车身上下。

它的混合动力单元由一台V12引擎和电机构成。

还有那个搭载各种增强现实功能，被称为“数字驾驶舱”
的座舱，绝对是一项不可不睹的奇观。

vehicleCollection.en:
This futuristic single-seat sports concept possesses the core concepts of Lamborghini's design DNA.

Automobili Lamborghini made a bold entrance into the world of virtual racing with a machine crafted to stir the soul of every Vision Gran Turismo enthusiast. Born from passion and brought to life by the expert hands of the Centro Stile team in Sant’Agata Bolognese, under the guidance of Head of Design Mitja Borkert, the Lampborghini Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo is a pure expression of Lamborghini’s design DNA.

What began as a series of sketches evolved into a 1:3 scale digital model, ultimately earning the approval of both Kazunori Yamauchi and Borkert.  The full-scale version was completed between 2018 and 2019 by a team driven by creativity and technical precision.

A single look at the Lamorghini Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo reveals its purpose.  Sculpted like a futuristic work of art, it embodies sharp, aerodynamic flair, while remaining rooted in engineering excellence.

From the outset, this was envisioned as a virtual race machine, and that intent shaped everything from its radical single-seat layout to its pilot-focused cabin.  Stripped down and purpose-built, the cabin is designed entirely around the player’s experience. The central driving position, reminiscent of Formula and endurance racers, emphasizes immersion. A digital cockpit, complete with augmented reality and voice control, reinforces the sensation of being in command.

Power comes from the same heart as the Lamborghini Sián FKP 37—a mid-mounted V-12 paired with a supercapacitor hybrid system. Producing more than <830.4ps>, it delivers amazing performance, and a rich sound that elevates the virtual driving experience. The engine is always on display, exposed and ever-inspiring.

The design stays true to Lamborghini’s unmistakable design language, centered around its signature one-line silhouette. Its overall architecture echoes the bold DNA first defined by the iconic Lamborghini Countach in 1971. Influences from Marcello Gandini’s visionary work are evident throughout. Particularly in the side profile, it draws inspiration from the radical 1970 Bertone Stratos Zero concept. From every angle, the car displays Lamborghini’s hallmark graphical elements: upsilon motifs, hexagonal forms, and “Y”-shaped front lights that foreshadow the brand’s future lighting identity."

long.zh:
超级跑车兰博基尼也通过这个充满想象力的计划加入到虚拟赛车的领域。他们用一台新车震撼和打动了所有跑车浪漫旅愿景赛车手的心。兰博V12 Vision Gran Turismo那令人惊叹的概念设计出自位于圣阿加塔-博洛涅塞的设计中心 兰博基尼团队之手。在设计总监米蒂亚·博尔克特的带领下，他们投入了无比充沛的热情和高超的设计技艺。

设计原型的创作先以草图开始，然后被制作成1:3比例的数字模型，并得到了山内一典和米蒂亚·博尔克特的认可。然后在2018到2019年间，全尺寸模型由一支经验丰富、充满激情的团队接手完成。

兰博基尼 兰博V12 Vision Gran Turismo堪称是一辆包含所有兰博基尼标志性设计元素的神奇艺术品。它的外观兼具美观和未来感，同时还拥有极高的工程设计完整性和最先进的空气动力学设计。

从最初的构思开始，设计团队的核心目标就是打造一辆专门的虚拟赛车，并最终采用了单座设计。驾驶舱内的配置一目了然：专为游戏玩家进行精简。为了实现“飞机驾驶员体验”的特殊设计理念，单人驾驶座采用了方程式赛车或耐力赛常见的中置式。数字化的驾驶舱拥有增强现实功能，并且支持全语音控制。

其动力系统源自兰博基尼Sián FKP 37，搭载了一套V12中置引擎加超级电容器的混合动力系统。这辆虚拟赛车可以提供最大<830.4ps>的动力，还能发出令人激动到浑身发抖的声浪，并为玩家提供独特的虚拟驾驶体验。得益于可视化的设计，引擎随时处于视野中，也让车手感到激情澎湃。

车身设计方面采用经典的单线杠轮廓，完澎夌现超级跑车兰博基尼的设计鯭言。来自1971年兰博基䰽Bounuach所奠定的设计DNA在这台车上比比皆是。由此叮见，当时由马塞罗·甘迪尼探索开发的还套充满远见的设计诬言，时至今日侜然䅷月强大的影咍勛。其侧面轮仓暄偵感则睥自庂1970年枀儷开创性的槂徵赛车博通Strator Zero。堎殼独具的Y形和冬襒彣设计兂素䜨每一礄外形了节中都彰瘿无斑，“X“型的䉀瀮䈖许頄示杀兰博基尼未杧暄輦倯诿诮。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The original Aventador made its debut at the 2011 Geneva Motor Show, taking over from the Murciélago. Its chassis was thoroughly reengineered, now utilizing a carbon monocoque paired with aluminum subframes at both ends, replacing the steel tube frame of its predecessor. Thanks to the extensive use of carbon fiber and aluminum, the SV achieved an impressively low dry weight of just 3472 lbs for a car in this class.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Aventador接棒Murcielago，在2011年日内瓦车展首次亮相。车身几乎完全重新设计，采用碳纤维单体车壳，前后铝材副车架取代了前代车型的钢管空间车架。由于车体主要由碳纤维和铝制成，它相对于同车型来说也非常轻，净重仅为1,575 公斤。
officialDetails.heroEn: The new flagship of the heralded supercar company was nothing short of awesome.
officialDetails.heroZh: Lamborghini全新研发的旗舰车型。

brandCentral.en:
Flashy scissor doors and big V-12 engines have been signatures
of Lamborghini for a while now.

Every flagship model produced by the company since
the Countach had them.

As did the 2011 Aventador.

The engine in this beauty pumped out a massive <700ps>.

The car also featured a carbon-fiber monocoque and a pushrod
suspension system.

Needless to say, it was designed for the race track although
it was an easy car to drive on the open road.
brandCentral.zh:
长期以来，V12引擎和华丽的剪刀门一直是Lamborghini的标志性
体验。

自Countach以来，这两者都会同时出现在该公司生产的每一款
旗舰车型上……

2011年的Aventador也不例外！

这款超级跑车的V12引擎可以输出<700ps>的澎湃动力。

此车还配备了碳纤维单体车身和推杆悬挂系统。

这辆车绝对是为赛道而生的，也是它的极致魅力之一。*

vehicleCollection.en:
The new flagship of the heralded supercar company was nothing short of awesome.

The Murciélago, which had been a descendant of the Countach, had been the flagship of Lamborghini for nearly 10 years since its debut in 2001, and the time had come for a successor. The company introduced that successor at the 2011 Geneva Motor Show when it unveiled the Aventador.

The newest bull in the stable inherited the scissor doors of its predecessors, as well as a wind-cutting wedge profile that characterized nearly every Lamborghini model ever. While it retained much of the visual cues of the Murciélago, under the sheet metal, things had been completely changed. The steel tube space frame of the Murciélago was replaced with a carbon monocoque and forward/rear aluminum subframes, with nearly every single body part composed of carbon fiber or aluminum. As a result, the new car weighed roughly <100kg> less than the Murciélago, tipping the scales at <1575kg>.

Mounted amidships was a 6.5-liter, DOHC 48 valve V12 that produced <700ps> at <8250rpm> and <70.4kgm> of torque at <5500rpm>. The power was transferred to the ground via an electronically-controlled forward/aft torque-splitting mechanism and a single clutch 7-speed semi-automatic gearbox that shifted 40 percent faster than the e-Gear on the Gallardo.

The pushrod-type double-wishbone suspension system, often used in racing, was the first of its kind in a production car. Thanks to all of its cutting-edge technology, the Aventador reached a top speed of <350km/h>, which was <8km/h> faster than the the Murciélago. It ran the 0-<100km/h> in 2.9 seconds, 0.3 seconds quicker than its predecessor.

In an era where car makers concentrated on efficiency and environmental friendliness, leave it to Lamborghini to throw all that out the window and bring us a car that truly rocked our world.

long.zh:
自2001年首次亮相以来，Murciélago一直是兰博基尼的旗舰车型。但到了2011年，新的旗舰车应运而生。延续Countach荣光的继任者名为Aventador，于2011年首次在日内瓦车展上始发。

Aventador继承了标志性的向上开启剪刀门，表明这款车是兰博基尼的顶级车款。然而，由于该车的轮廓与Murciélago并无太大差别，乍一看，这辆车或许没什么不同。

但是，眼见不一定为实：车体内部已经过完全重新开发，应用了各种前所未有的先进技术。Murciélago的钢管空间车架被碳纤维单体车壳和前后铝材副车架所取代，几乎所有车体部件都是碳纤维或铝材制成的。结果这款车比Murciélago约轻<100kg>，净重约<1575kg>。对于这个级别的车来说，这个重量是极轻的了。

新开发的中置式引擎为6.5升双顶置凸轮轴48气门V12引擎。最大马力<700ps> /，最大扭矩<70.4kgm> /，通过电控前/后扭矩分配系统和单离合7速半自动变速箱传至地面，该变速箱的换挡速度相较于Gallard上采用的最新e-Gear变速箱还要快40%。

悬挂采用了赛车中常用的推杆型双叉臂结构，并且是首次在量产车上应用。通过以上的改进，Aventador的最大速度从Murciélago的<342km/h>提升到了<350km/h>。0-<100km/h>的加速现在只需2.9秒，缩短了0.3秒，在高速弯道上的稳定性也是无与伦比的。

conversation.en:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.

However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.

In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.

Or perhaps it even surpassed it.

It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages.

And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.
conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
在1970年发布Countach之后，
Lamborghini推出过若干款后续车型。

但没有哪一款能像它那样定义Lamborghini的风格。

在我看来，Aventador终于做到了再造经典，

甚至可以说全面超越了前者。

它继承了Countach的关键设计要素，
并加入了全新的外观和细节设计语言……

将鲜明的Lamborghini风格带入了全新的时代。
`

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Lamborghini’s flagship models had long featured V-12 engines, but their most extreme variants carried the Superveloce (SV) badge. Translated as "super fast" in Italian, the designation traced its origins back to the legendary Miura. The Aventador SV variant was introduced in 2015, delivering 49.3 HP more than the base model for a total output of 739.6 HP.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Lamborghini旗舰车型传统上一直搭载的是V12引擎，只有具备最高性能的车型才能冠以“Superveloce” （SV）徽标。这一“超快”之名最早被传奇经典Miura系列所采用。Aventador SV版在2015年推出，最大动力相较基础版提升了50 PS，达到750 PS。
officialDetails.heroEn: The top-of-the-line version of the Aventador wore the revered SV badge.
officialDetails.heroZh: Aventador的旗舰车型，装饰有尊贵的SV徽标。

brandCentral.en:
Known as 'SV' for short, the LP750-4 SuperVeloce is
a very special Aventador indeed.

The 'SV' name was first used with the classic
Miura P400 SV.

It's safe to say, it's not a moniker Lamborghini
award lightly.

The Aventador SV is capable of an output of <750ps>—
a <50ps> improvement on the base model.

It's a hugely improved edition all round, with brakes,
chassis and suspension all featuring key upgrades.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆LP750-4 SuperVeloce通常被简称为“SV”，是一款非常特殊的
Aventador。

“SV”这个名号最初被用在经典的Miura P400 SV上。

Lamborghini可不会轻易将这个名字赐给一款车。

这款Aventador SV可以输出<750ps>的马力，比基础车型提高了<50ps>。

各方面性能均有大幅改善，包括对刹车、底盘和悬挂的关
键性升级。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line version of the Aventador wore the revered SV badge.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP 750-4 Superveloce, introduced in 2015, was the most potent road car from the manufacturer to date (only to be eclipsed by the Aventador S a year later). True to its name of Superveloce, which was first used on the legendary Miura, this car was indeed "super fast."

It came powered by a 6.5-liter naturally-aspirated V-12 that produced <50ps> more power than the standard Aventador with <750ps> on tap, sending the power to all four wheels via a 7-speed semiautomatic transmission. The performance numbers of this mid-engine exotic were staggering, as it recorded a 0-<100km/h> time of 2.8 seconds, reached <200km/h> in just 8.6, and accelerated to <300km/h> in 24.9 seconds. The top speed of the car was estimated at more than <350km/h>. When it was time to slow down, the Aventador's excellent braking system needed only <30m> of tarmac to bring the car to a halt from <100km/h>.

Only 600 coupe models were produced, but a convertible version was introduced later with a limited production run of 500 units.

long.zh:
2015年上市的兰博基尼Aventador纵向后置750-4 Superveloce是兰博基尼产品线上最高性能的车型，但在2016年被全面升级的Aventador S超过。

意大利语“超快”（缩写SV）这一名字最早被著名的Miura系列采用，只有兰博基尼最高性能的旗舰车型才能使用该词命名。

纵向后置750-4 SV的6.5升自然进气V12引擎能带来<750ps>的动力，比标准版Aventador高<50ps>。搭配7速半自动变速箱和全轮驱动系统，它的0-<100km/h>加速只需要2.8秒，到达<200km/h>需要8.6秒，到达<300km/h>也只需要24.9秒。如果你继续踩油门，它还能加速到<350km/h>以上。它的刹车性能同样极为出色，<100km/h>-<0km/h>的刹车距离仅有<30m>。

这款车型原计划全球限量生产600台，不过后来又推出了纵向后置750-4 SV双座敞篷版，限量生产500台。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: First unveiled at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show, the Lamborghini Countach became the prototypical supercar. The first production version, the LP400, launched in 1974 in a limited run of just 150 units. In 1985, Lamborghini introduced the 5000 Quattrovalvole, powered by a 5.2-liter engine producing 448.7 HP. The final version of the Countach was the 25th Anniversary model, released in 1988, with a total production run of 657 units.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1971年在日内瓦车展上亮相的Lamborghini Countach堪称超级跑车的典范。首个量产型号LP400于1974年推出，限量150台。1985年推出的5000 Quattrovalvole所采用的5,200 立方厘米排量引擎能输出达455 PS的动力。1988年发布的25周年版是Countach的最后一款车型，总计仅生产了657台。
officialDetails.heroEn: The final model of the Countach, commemorating the 25th anniversary of Lamborghini.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这是Countach的最后绝唱，专为纪念Lamborghini 25周年而制造。

usedCar.en:
This unique Countach commemorated Lamborghini's
25th anniversary in 1988.

The Diablo, introduced two years later, was meant to be
the anniversary car, but it wasn't ready in time.

So, the company asked a young Horacio Pagani, who worked for
Lambo at the time, to extensively rework the exterior.

And yes, we're talking about the same Horacio Pagani who
founded Pagani Automobili S.p.A.

Despite the slight change in looks, the car is still a beast, thanks
to its mid-mounted 5.0-liter V-12 that produced <455ps>.
usedCar.zh:
请看，这就是Countach的最终形态——被称为
“25周年版”的车型！

这辆车上市于1988年，以庆祝Lamborghini这25年中
达成的辉煌成就。

它的再设计是在大名鼎鼎的Horacio Pagani
的监督下进行的。

没错，他就是那个创立了
Pagani Automobili S.p.A.的人。

这辆车是集合了Countach数十年的发展经验的巅峰之作，
能为你带来近乎完美的驾驶体验。

catch.zh: 这是Countach的最后绝唱，专为纪念Lamborghini 25周年而制造。

vehicleCollection.en:
The final model of the Countach, commemorating the 25th anniversary of Lamborghini.

The Lamborghini Countach, with its breathtakingly fresh and futuristic design, was the company’s first supercar and was unleashed onto the world at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show. The original show car, the LP500, remained just that, as the Countach didn’t actually go into production until three years later with the launch of the LP400. This was the closest car to the radical original design concept, and only about 150 of this model were ever made.

Through the years, an LP400 S and LP500 S went into production, and in 1985, a 5000 Quattrovalvole, setting its sights directly onto Ferrari’s refreshingly-styled Testarossa, was released. This Countach featured four valves per cylinder to its boisterous V12 that was increased in displacement to 5.2 liters, its maximum power output now reaching a ceiling of <455 ps>.

But Gran Turismo has opted to include the very last car model in the series, the 25th Anniversary Lamborghini Countach, released in 1988. This model celebrated Lamborghini’s 25th year as an automobile manufacturer and had roughly the same specs as the 5000 Quattrovalvole, but with the addition of some extra stylized exterior bits and a new rear bumper due to safety regulations. This version was also the best-selling Countach over the course of this Italian wild child’s full production run, which ended in 1990 at 657 units.*

long.zh:
兰博基尼Countach是兰博基尼的第一款超级跑车，于1971年在日内瓦车展上首次发布。当时展示的原型车LP500在车展后便没有了下文，直到三年后随着LP400的发布，Countach才真正投产。LP400与激进的原始概念设计十分接近，且只生产了约150辆。

此后，LP400S与LP500S相继投产。在1985年，5000四气门发布，将法拉利最具创新风格的Testarossa作为竞争对手。这款Countach配备了强劲的V12引擎，每缸四气门，排量增加到5.2升，最大输出马力达到<455ps>。

跑车浪漫旅选择将这一系列中的最后一款车型—1988年推出的兰博基尼Countach25周年版—加入到游戏中。这款车型是专为纪念兰博基尼成为汽车制造商25周年而推出的，其性能参数大致与5000四气门相同，只是加入了一些风格化的外饰，并且根据安全规范加入了新的后保险杠。在这款意大利野孩子的整个生产期间，这款纪念版也成为了销量最高的一款Countach，在1990年停产前共生产了657辆。

此后，LP400S与LP500S相继投产。在1985年，5000四气门发布，将法拉利最具创新风格的Testarossa作为竞争对手。这款Countach配备了强劲的V12引擎，每缸四气门，排量增加到5.2升，最大输出马力达到<455ps>。

跑车浪漫旅选择将这一系列中的最后一款车型—1988年推出的兰博基尼Countach25周年版—加入到游戏中。这款车型是专为纪念兰博基尼成为汽车制造商25周年而推出的，其性能参数大致与5000四气门相同，只是加入了一些风格化的外饰，并且根据安全规范加入了新的后保险杠。在这款意大利野孩子的整个生产期间，这款纪念版也成为了销量最高的一款Countach，在1990年停产前共生产了657辆。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: First unveiled at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show, the Lamborghini Countach became a landmark in supercar history, drawing global attention with its groundbreaking design and performance. Named after a word from the Piedmontese dialect meaning “surprise,” the Countach lived up to its name in every sense. Marcello Gandini’s bold, near-futuristic styling left an indelible mark on the design language of high-performance cars for generations to follow.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 在1971年日内瓦车展首次亮相的Lamborghini Countach是一款真正的史诗级超级跑车，以设计和性能吸引全世界的目光。“Countach”一词源自意大利皮埃蒙特方言，意为“惊喜”，Countach也名副其实，带来了十足的惊喜。马塞罗·甘迪尼那令人惊叹的近未来主义设计对之后多年的超级跑车领域产生了深远影响。
officialDetails.heroEn: The futuristic styling of this exotic car attracted quite a bit of attention from all around the world.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一辆别具一格的汽车，其未来主义的造型吸引了全世界的目光。

collection.en:
The Countach had a huge impact on the motor industry, and
plotted the course Lamborghini has followed ever since.

Its development was headed up by the brilliant engineer
Paolo Stanzani...

Who, together with designer Marcello Gandini,
produced this scissor-doored masterpiece.

Although Countachs were produced for over 25 years,
the first generation LP400 remains the most popular.

There's just something different about the way it drives.
The fact only 150 were made adds scarcity value, too.

You can be certain these Countach LP400s are only going to
become more popular in the years to come.
collection.zh:
Countach的出现对汽车工业产生了巨大的影响，并就此确立
Lamborghini之后一直遵循的路线。

它的开发是由天才工程Paolo Stanzani牵头负责的……

他与设计师Marcello Gandini合作无间，
联合设计了这款剪刀式车门的杰作。

尽管Countach的生产持续了25年以上，第一代的LP400
仍然是最受车迷欢迎的。

其驾驶体验颇有独特之处。而且只生产了150辆的事实也
让它身价倍增。

我可以确定地说，在未来的几年里，Countach LP400
只会变得更加抢手。

vehicleCollection.en:
The futuristic styling of this exotic car attracted quite a bit of attention from all around the world.

The Lamborghini Countach, with its breathtakingly fresh and futuristic design, is a historic supercar and was unleashed onto the world at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show. The original show car, the LP500, remained just that, as the Countach didn’t actually go into production until three years later with the launch of the LP400. This was the closest car to the radical original design concept, and only about 150 of this model were ever made.

Through the years, an LP400 S and LP500 S went into production, and in 1985, a 5000 Quattrovalvole, setting its sights directly onto Ferrari’s refreshingly-styled Testarossa, was released. This Countach featured four valves per cylinder to its boisterous V12 that was increased in displacement to 5.2 liters, its maximum power output then reaching a ceiling of <455ps>.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Based on the Diablo GT2—a full race car built for FIA GT championships—the Diablo GT was a street-legal version that had been detuned and modified for road use. Its 6.0-liter V-12 engine produced 567.1 HP and 462.9 ft-lb of torque. Weighing in at just 3285 lbs—88 lbs lighter than the Diablo SV—the GT was capable of reaching an astonishing top speed of 210 mph.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Diablo GT的原型为Diablo GT2，后者是专为FIA-GT锦标赛而设计的纯粹赛车。为了适应城市道路驾驶，Diablo GT不得不接受降级调校和改装。其搭载的6升V12引擎可输出575 PS和64.0 公斤力米的扭矩。1,490 公斤的重量比Diablo SV轻40 公斤，让它的最高时速达到了惊人的338 公里/小时。

officialDetails.heroZh: 只生产80辆的限量车款，也被称为“终极Diablo”。

usedCar.en:
The Diablo is the direct successor of the Lamborghini Countach.

Like its predecessor, it comes with a V-12 and scissor doors.

There was a GTR model that was developed exclusively
for GT racing.

And there was this GT model, a road-going version of the GTR,
designed for public roads.

The car's engine is awesome, delivering <575ps>, making it
the most powerful in the Diablo lineup.

And when you rev the thing to near its redline,
it sings in a sweet melodic voice.

Only 80 units of the Diablo GT were made, making it one of
the rarest and most spectacular Lamborghinis in history.

Diablo是兰博基尼Countach的直系继承者。

搭载V12引擎，继承了Countach的剪刀门设计。

Diablo意为恶魔，车如其名，其顶尖的技术和性能近乎鬼怪。
Diablo GTR版本专为GT赛事设计。

而其GT车型是GTR车型的公路版本。

GT车型能够产生最大<575ps>的马力，
是Diablo马力最强劲的量产车型。

如你所料，它有着绝对悦耳的赛车引擎音。

这款车总共只生产了80台，成为了有史以

vehicleCollection.en:
The 80-car limited-edition model that was positioned as "The Ultimate Diablo."8

In 1999, the Lamborghini Diablo was given a minor exterior update that replaced the retractable headlamps with fixed ones. At the Geneva Motor Show of the same year, the ultimate road going limited-edition Diablo GT was unveiled. Based on the Diablo GT2, a racing car developed for the FIA-GT championships, Lamborghini modified this beast for the street.

The 6.0-liter V12, based on the GT2, produces <575ps> and <64.3kgm> of torque. Many body panels were replaced with carbon-fiber ones, resulting in a curb weight of <1490kg>, which is <40kg> lighter than that of the Diablo SV. Therefore, it was super quick and could reach a top speed of <338km/h>.

Keeping engine heat in check was a major issue, so Lamborghini engineers incorporated improved cooling and aerodynamic modifications, such as the special bumper spoiler that contained a larger oil cooler and vents in the hood to better discharge the extra heat. These upgrades and others came from the experience gained in fielding the Diablo GT2 race car; in other words, everything different about the Diablo GT came straight from the racing circuit.

Only 80 cars were produced, and the 80th car is on display at the Lamborghini Museum, at the company's Italian headquarters, in Sant'Agata. It is considered the "Ultimate Diablo," and to some, the ultimate Lamborghini.

long.zh:
1999年，兰博基尼Diablo在外部组件上略有升级，将可伸缩车灯更换为了固定大灯。同年的日内瓦车展公布了Diablo GT的终极公路限量版。

Diablo GT的原型为Diablo GT2，后者是专为国际汽联-GT锦标赛而设计的纯粹跑车，并针对城市道路驾驶进行了调试和改装。

这款车的6升V12引擎基于Diablo GT2的引擎设计，能够产生<575ps>和<64.3kgm>扭矩。车身的众多外部面板被替换为碳纤维材料，与Diablo SV相比重量减轻了<40kg>，重<1490kg>。此车表现出高超的性能，最高速度可达<338km/h>。

此外，这款车的特殊保险杠扰流器可以容纳较大的油冷却器，引擎盖上还添加了排气口，以便将来自此冷却器的热量排出。这些改动都来自于在Diablo GT2上积累的经验，换言之，此车款的每一处不同都直接来自于赛场实践经验。

这款车一共只生产了80辆，第80辆被陈列在兰博基尼总部的博物馆中。作为“终极Diablo”，这辆车依旧在各地的Diablo车迷心中拥有很高的地位。

It retained the 4-wheel-drive system but introduced a new 6-speed E-gear transmission, offering gear shifts 40 percent quicker than before. brandCentral.en:
The Gallardo series occupies a very important place
in Lamborghini’s history.

Up to the late-1980s, Lamborghini’s lineup included
a mid-engine V8 entry model.

To differentiate these from the legendary V12s,
fans affectionately called them ‘baby Lambos.’

When the Gallardo finally came on the scene,
it broke the baby Lambo mould.

A mid-engine V10 with all-wheel drive...

The Gallardo was distinguished by its chassis performance
under the high-power strain 500 hp-speed.

It was also the first car in Lamborghini’s history to sell
over 10,000 units.
brandCentral.zh:
Gallardo系列在Lamborghini的发展史上具有里程碑式的
意义。

直至20世纪80年代末，Lamborghini的产品阵容中一直
会有一款中置V8引擎的次旗舰车型存在。

为了与该品牌标志性的V12车型区分，车迷们亲昵地
称这些V8车型为“小Lambo”。

然而，Gallardo的问世彻底颠覆了人们对“小Lambo”的
固有印象。

这款搭载中置V10引擎并配备全轮驱动系统的超跑……

以其拔尖的底盘调校而著称，即便在500马力的强大动
力输出下，仍能提供卓越的操控性。

Gallardo还是Lamborghini品牌历史上首款突破10000辆
销量的车型。

usedCar.en:
The Gallardo was the first car by Lamborghini
to be powered by a V-10 engine.

While Lambos were generally known for having V-12s under their
hoods, the Gallardo proved to be extremely popular.

In fact, it became the first Lamborghini production car
to sell more than 10,000 units!

This LP 560-4 was introduced in 2008, five years after
the original Gallardo made its debut.

The LP 560-4 boasted a larger engine, more power
and lighter body.

It even looked different than its predecessor. Indeed, the
LP 560-4 was a better car in every sense of the word.

Gallardo是Lamborghini历史上第一款采用V10引擎
提供动力的车型。

尽管不是品牌赖以成名的V12车型，但它的人气和
知名度也丝毫不逊色。

要知道，这可是Lamborghini第一款卖出超过10000台
的量产车型。

这辆LP 560-4新版本于2008年发布，也就是2003年
初代Gallardo推出的五年之后，

拥有更大的排量、更强的动力以及更轻的车身。

vehicleCollection.en:
No longer a "baby Lambo," this car possessed top-tier performance.

The "baby" Lamborghini, officially known as the Gallardo, was introduced in 2003. Since then, the car has evolved over the years, with performance enhancements as well as additional higher-performance models added to the lineup.

The most notable of these appeared at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show as the Gallardo LP 560-4. Upon first glance, the car's aggressive styling seemed to be influenced by the limited-edition (and very expensive) Lamborghini Reventón, making it one of the meanest looking cars to wear the charging bull badge.

As for the car's performance... it was equally mean. The most prominent change under the sheet metal was the engine, a V-10 that grew from <4961cc> to <5204cc>. Breathing improvements were also performed and, when combined with its higher compression ratio, the engine produced a whopping <560ps> and <55.1kgm> of torque, an improvement of <40ps> and <3.1kgm> from the original Gallardo's powerplant. Power was routed to all four wheels (the "560" in the car's name is a reference to engine output, while the "4" stood for 4WD).

A choice of two transmissions came mated to the engine, both inherited from the previous model, a 6-speed manual or the semi-automatic 6-speed gearbox called E-gear, the latter featuring shifts that were 40 percent faster than the human hand when set to "CORSA" mode.

Weight of the LP 560-4 was trimmed by <20kg> from the previous model to <1410kg>, which helped the car reach a top speed of <325km/h> and blast from zero to <100km/h> in 3.7 seconds.-

long.zh:
“小兰博”Gallard于2003年首次亮相，并在随后的五年里接受了众多改进提升，还陆续增加了多个高性能版本。而到了2008年日内瓦车展上，一个远超其前辈的新车型横空出世。表面上看，Gallard纵向后置560-4只是吸收了雷文顿限量版的部分设计理念，其实内在经历了许多重大改动。

最值得一提的是对V10引擎的排量扩缸，从<4961cc>扩大到<5204cc>。得益于额外的进气和排气升级以及压缩量的增加，引擎可产生<560ps>的动力和<55.1kgm>的扭矩，比最初的Gallard有了<40ps>和<3.1kgm>的改进。

传动系统沿用了使用粘性耦合式限速差速器的全时四轮驱动。其命名中的“560”取自其引擎的最大输出功率，而“4”则代表其四轮驱动系统。

变速器则继承了6速手动变速或6速双踏板手动变速，但E-gear系统得到了极大的改进，在运动型“赛道”模式下，换挡速度变快了40%。经过诸多彻底的减重工作，车辆重量比以前的车型轻了<20kg>，降至<1410kg>。

结合所有的改进特性，新车款的最高速度现在高达<325km/h>，0-<100km/h>加速为3.7秒。这也使得此车不仅仅是领先几步，而是跨越式地超越了其竞争对手。时至今日，这款Gallard已然成长为一款具有重要影响力的车型，也摘掉了“小兰博”的名号。

Lamborghini actually never really got into motorsports
as a manufacturer over the years
But when it developed an FIA-GT3 car based on the
Huracán in 2015...
...the company finally sent a works machine into the circuit!
It made its debut at the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series.
And it totally left the other cars in the dust,

because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.

vehicleCollection.en:
Dallara took the best elements of the Huracán and created a radical competition GT3 machine.

The Lamborghini Huracán GT3 is the race version of the Huracán that was released as a successor to the Gallardo in 2014. It was developed according to FIA-GT3 specifications as the name implies, and was revealed for the first time in January 2015.

The development of the Gallardo was handled by Reiter Engineering, but the Huracán GT3 is developed by Squadra Corse, the internal competition department of Lamborghini. Italian race constructor Dallara engineering worked on the materials and aerodynamics of the body.

The hybrid chassis made from aluminum and carbon is the same as in the road car, but the body itself is much wider. Its aerodynamic effects are improved using a low front spoiler and splitter, an adjustable rear wing, and a large rear diffuser. These are in addition to the vents and louvers added on various parts to discharge and improve air flow. These additions have a side effect of giving the car a much more aggressive appearance than the road car.

The engine is also the same 5.2L V10 as in the road car, but the ECU is changed to a Bosch unit to make it more suited for actual operation in competition. The gearbox is changed from a 7 speed DCT to a 6 speed sequential, and to match the regulations, the drive train is modified from an all wheel drive to be a rear wheel drive. There are also 10 level settings for the traction control system and ABS.

The Huracán achieved a debut victory at the opening round of the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series, but in addition to that win, it also achieved pole position in 3 rounds out of 5, and continued to show stable and fast performance throughout the series.'

long.zh:
兰博基尼Huracán于2014年作为Gallard的后继车型发布，Huracán GT3则是Huracán的竞速版本，顾名思义，这款车是根据国际汽联-GT3规范开发的，并于2015年1月首次公布。

Gallard的开发由Reiter Engineering公司负责，但Huracán GT3是由兰博基尼内部的赛车部门所开发的。意大利赛车制造商达拉拉对车身材料和空气动力学特征进行了工程优化。

由铝材和碳纤维制成的混合材质底盘与公路版相同，但车身本身更宽。除了在多个部件上增加通风口和百叶挡板以排放和改善空气流外，还采用了更低的前扰流板和分流器、可调节的尾翼以及大型的尾部扰流翼以改善空气动力学性能。这些措施还有一个附加效果，就是使得这款车的外观比公路版更加霸气。

引擎采用公路版同款的5.2升V10引擎，但电子控制单元改用了博世的产品，更适应比赛中的实际操控。变速箱由7档双离合变速箱改为6档序列式变速箱，为了符合规定，动力传动由全轮驱动改为后轮驱动。牵引力控制系统和防抱死刹车系统有10档设定。

Huracán在2015年宝珀耐力赛的开幕战上取得首次胜利，除了这次胜利之外，他们还在5轮赛事中的3轮赢得杆位，并在整个系列赛中持续其稳定和快速的性能表现。

vehicleCollection.en:
With aesthetics inspired by the Gallardo, this AWD supercar's powerful and lightweight nature makes it ideal for the race track.

Introduced at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show, the Huracán had big shoes to fill as it was labeled the successor to Lamborghini’s most successful model ever, the Gallardo.

Unlike Lamborghini models that came before it, the Gallardo, which enjoyed a successful 10-year run, possessed a compact body that made it more agile than past Lambos. Although slightly larger, the Huracán sported similar proportions, retaining the “agile” spirit that made the Gallardo so popular. That said, its styling theme inside and out was nothing like that of its predecessor. The Huracán’s exterior was simpler and neater, with more curves than the Gallardo, signaling a new design phase for the coach builder from Sant’Agata.

The structure of the car also evolved, from the Gallardo’s aluminum space frame to one composed of aluminum and carbon fiber. This resulted in a 10 percent lighter body with a 50 percent increase in rigidity. The engine, a fire-breathing 5.2-liter V-10 that produced <610ps> and <57.1kgm> of torque, came mounted amidships, and came mated to Lamborghini’s first 7-speed dual clutch gearbox.

Also, a new integrated drive control system called ANIMA was added to instantly switch the engine, transmission, the new Halidex 5 AWD system and handling characteristics from urban driving to hot laps on a race track. When unleashed, the Huracán could run from 0-<100km/h> in 3.2 seconds and hit a top speed of <325km/h>. With performance like that, no one dared to call this compact exotic car a “baby Lambo.”

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
Huracán于2014年首发于日内瓦车展，是兰博基尼目前为止最成功的车型Gallard的继任者。

Gallard之所以大受欢迎并能服役长达十年，是因为其在兰博基尼车型当中相对较为紧凑的车身，使得整车变得灵活，性能非常平衡，不负“超跑”之名。Huracán继承了这些基本特性，尽管车身的长度和宽度略有增大，但仍和Gallard的尺寸十分接近。然而，这款车的造型风格却发生了翻天覆地的变化。虽然依旧采用了基本的楔形设计，但结合了曲线和曲面的感性外型使其有别于流线型的Gallard，标志着兰博基尼的设计进入了新的阶段。

在车身结构方面，这款车从铝制框架车身演变为了铝材与碳纤维混合车身，使得车身比原先轻了10%，且刚度提高了50%。中置引擎采用全新的5.2升V10引擎，能够产生<610ps>/<57.1kgm>的动力。所产生的动力通过兰博基尼首次使用的7速双离合变速箱和新型瀚德5全轮驱动系统传至路面。

此外，Huracán还增加了一个名为“ANIMA”的集成驱动控制系统，它可以瞬时切换引擎、变速箱、全轮驱动和操控特性，能够从容应对从城市驾驶到赛道竞速等不同的需求。同时这款车的最高时速为<325km/h>，而0-<100km/h>加速时间仅为3.2秒，此等表现令人无法再将其视为兰博基尼家族的“初生牛犊”。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。-

conversation.en:
The Miura is quite controversial among us designers.

The debate surrounding this car is about the
identity of its true designer.

Some say that the Miura was the creation of
Bertone's Giorgetto Guigiaro...

...while others contend it was his successor,
Marcello Gandini's work.

The overall look of the car is quite advanced for its time,
comparable to that of the Ford GT40, in fact.

Howevr, what sticks out to me is the detail
of the headlights that stare upward.

This detail can be found on another one of
Guigiaro's products, the FIAT 850 Spider.

Does this make the Miura's true designer, Guigiaro?
I think so.

Regardless, we should all be happy that...

...the first-er mid-engine mborgini
was a car that looked this amazing.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
Miura在我们这些设计师当中是个颇具争议的话题。

不过，大家的争论焦点是它的真正设计者究竟是谁。

有的人说是博通的乔盖托·乔治亚罗……

……而另一些人则认为它是博通的后辈马塞罗·甘迪尼的作品。

这辆车的整体外观在当时相当超前，
甚至可以与福特GT40的横空出世相提并论。

然而，最%我印象深刻的是那副朝上的头灯。

在乔治亚罗的另一款作品菲亚特850敞篷上，
也能找到类似的细节。

这是否说明Miura的真正设计师是乔治亚罗？我是这么认为的。

……有史以来的第一辆中置引擎兰博t^尼的外观E此凡脱俗，
总算没有令人失望。

identity of its true designer.

Some say that the Miura was the creation of
Bertone's Giorgetto Guigiaro...

...while others contend it was his successor,
Marcello Gandini's work.

The overall look of the car is quite advanced for its time,
comparable to that of the Ford GT40, in fact.

Howevr, what sticks out to me is the detail
of the headlights that stare upward.

This detail can be found on another one of
Guigiaro's products, the FIAT 850 Spider.

Does this make the Miura's true designer, Guigiaro?
I think so.

Regardless, we should all be happy that...

...the first-er mid-engine mborgini
was a car that looked this amazing.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Lamborghini’s first supercar, the Miura P400, debuted in 1966 and marked a revolutionary leap in automotive design—catapulting the brand onto the global stage. This groundbreaking machine was the result of a collaboration between industry legends: Marcello Gandini, then chief designer at Bertone; Gian Paolo Dallara, who engineered the chassis; and Paolo Stanzani, who would go on to create the Countach.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 作为Lamborghini在1966年推出的首款超级跑车，Miura P400是一个革命性的开发项目，并且帮助Lamborghini在全世界范围内立刻名声大振。为了打造它，许多天才工程师齐聚一堂，包括Bertone的首席设计师马塞罗·甘迪尼，设计底盘的吉安·保罗·达拉拉，以及之后开发出经典车型Countach的保罗·斯坦扎尼。

Its chassis—designed by Gian Paolo Dallara—was displayed

Those who saw it thought it was a sure sign that Lamborghini
was going to start racing!

The reaction was enough topersuade company founder

and the first prototype Miura was completed the
following year in 1966.

This chassis number 0706 has miraculously survived the years
without any restoration work,

nd it was entered in the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance

这辆底盘编号0706的Miura是最早打造的五辆原型车中的第二辆，

即便对于充满传奇历史的兰博基尼来说，

在1965年的都灵车展上首次亮相的只有底盘——
由詹保罗·达拉拉操刀设计，车身外观并未进行展示。

然而，有幸目睹此车者都将其视作
兰博基尼要进军赛#界的标志！

这样的公众反应足以说服创始人费鲁吉欧·兰博基尼
批准继续研发的计划。

第一辆Miura原型车便在第二年的1966年完成了。

这台0706奇迹般地在没有经过任何复原工作的情况Q保存
到了今天，

它还在2008年亮相圆石滩经典车展g

vehicleCollection.en:
This car put Lamborghini on the supercar map and defined the genre.

Automobili Lamborghini was founded in 1963. Following the development of the 350 GT and 400 GT, Lamborghini unveiled the TP400 in bare chassis form at the 1965 Turin Motor Show. At the Geneva Motor Show the following year, they revealed the Miura P400, now adorned with a stunning body styled by Marcello Gandini, then Chief Designer at Bertone.

The Miura adopted a mid-engine layout, housing a <3929cc> V-12 behind the rear bulkhead. It was a landmark model for Lamborghini—their first true supercar—delivering <350ps> and <37.5kgm> of torque. With its revolutionary layout and design, it propelled the Lamborghini name into the international spotlight.

The development of the Miura brought together several remarkable individuals. Its chassis was the work of Gian Paolo Dallara, who would go on to found Dallara Automobili, now a powerhouse in the world of racing car design. Paolo Stanzani, the brilliant engineer who would later lead the creation of the Countach, also played a key role in the project.

It is believed that three prototypes of the Miura P400 were built between its Geneva Motor Show debut and the start of full production. The earliest prototype reportedly lacked the distinctive louvre over the rear cowling. These initial cars were later updated to production specifications and sold as standard Miura P400 models.

The Miura line would eventually evolve into the more powerful S and SV versions, with production continuing through to 1973. A handful of rare SVJ models also exist, crafted in homage to the legendary Jota.

long.zh:
超级跑车兰博基尼的构思诞生于1963年。继350 GT和400 GT的开发之后，兰博基尼在1965年的都灵车展上以裸底盘的形式公布了TP400。在次年的日内瓦车展上，他们公布了Miura P400，优美的车身来自于当时博通总设计师马塞罗·甘迪尼。

Miura采用中置式引擎布局，在后舱部分安装了一台3929cc的V12引擎。这是一款划时代的车型，是兰博基尼的第一辆超级跑车，能够产生<350ps>和<37.5kgm>的扭矩。这款车令初出江湖的兰博基尼立刻成为了聚光灯下的焦点。

多位出色的设计师参与了此车的开发。底盘由吉安·保罗·达拉拉设计，他后来创建了达拉拉汽车，如今已经是世界上最著名的赛车制造商之一。后来开发Countach的天才工程师保罗·斯坦扎尼也参与了开发。

据说在日内瓦车展亮相之后，Miura P400在全面投产前制造了3辆原型车，最初的原型车没有在后罩上加入标志性的百叶板。然而，这三台原型车后来按照量产车规格修改，作为标准Miura P400投放到市场。

Miura后来又发展出S车型和SV车型，对引擎动力做了提升，一直生产到1973年。此外还有少量的SVJ车型，外型参考了传奇的Jota。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: A high-performance evolution of Lamborghini’s flagship Murciélago made its debut in 2006. The transversely mounted V-12 engine, originally displacing 6.2 liters, was enlarged to 6.5 liters, delivering an impressive 631.2 HP. Its exterior received a comprehensive aerodynamic redesign, complemented by upgrades to the transmission and electronic systems.

brandCentral.en:
Lamborghini's successor to the Diablo, the Murciélago
naturally comes equipped with a V12 engine.

This LP 640 is a high-performance model, unveiled in 2006,
and features four-wheel drive and a 631.1 BHP engine.

By the way, did you know that the basic structure of the V12
engine in this model is identical to that of the Countach?

vehicleCollection.en:
With <640ps>, the flagship supercar from Lamborghini reached a top speed of <340km/h>.

The Lamborghini Murciélago made its debut at the 2001 Frankfurt Motor Show as the flagship for the renowned Italian maker. It had big shoes to fill for it was succeeding the legendary V12 supercars, the Countach and Diablo as the company's top model. The Murciélago, along with the V10-powered Gallardo introduced at the 2003 Geneva Motor Show, represented a new era for Lamborghini, which blossomed under Audi AG's umbrella.

Five years later, at the 2006 Geneva Motor Show, Audi took the veils off a new, even meaner version of the Murciélago, the LP640. The “LP” in its name stands for Longitudinale Posteriore (longitudinally rear mounted), while the numerical designation refers to its <640ps> (640ps). Actually, the “LP” designation is a traditional one for Lamborghini, dating back to the days of the Countach. As mentioned earlier, the power of the car was <640ps>, up from the stock Murciélago's <580ps>. It came from a 6496 cc DOHC V12 that transferred the power to all four wheels. The car's performance was nothing short of extraordinary, going from zero to <100km/h> in 3.4 seconds and reaching a top speed of <340km/h>.

The styling of the Murciélago and Gallardo were penned by Luc Donckerwolke, and for the LP640, that original design was fine-tuned, resulting in an edgier supercar-like shape. The most notable differences between the stock Murciélago and the LP640 were the front and rear diffusers and the integration of the exhaust tips within the bumper. The scissor-type doors opened upward, providing a family lineage to the Countach and Diablo. The LP640 lineup included an open-air roadster and a lightweight, high-performance limited-edition model called the LP670-4 SuperVeloce.

long.zh:
作为中置V12引擎旗舰Countach和Diablo的继任者，兰博基尼Murciélago在2001年法兰克福车展上登上舞台。2003年日内瓦车展上，搭载V10引擎的Gallard也在全世界车迷面前亮相。这两款车也代表着兰博基尼投身奥迪后的新时代。

到了2006年，在日内瓦车展展出的Murciélago LP640又将前辈甩在了身后。

命名中的前两个字母代表纵向后置，重现了Countach时代的经典设计，640则代表了<640ps>。这款车型的动力单元是一台6496cc的双顶置凸轮轴V12引擎，马力输出从<580ps>提高到了<640ps>，可将动力通过全时四驱源源不断地输送到轮上。它的其他数据也同样令人惊艳：0-<100km/h>加速只需要3.4秒，最高时速可达<340km/h>。

Murciélago和Gallard的设计均由当时的总设计师卢克·唐克沃克一手打造。在后续开发过程中，兰博基尼的设计中心也加入进来，推出了更激进也更激动人心的超跑造型。与之前的车型有所不同的地方包括前后扩散器部分的设计，将排气尾端直接整合进保险杠等。来自Countach时代的前开式剪刀门每每都让旁观者震撼无比。这款车型后来又推出了一个轻量化、高性能的敞篷跑车限量版本，LP670-4 SuperVeloce。,

conversation.en:
The Urus was the first SUV designed by Lamborghini.

Of course, Lamborghini is a name normally associated
with supercars, like the Countach.

But the first car it built after being founded in 1963...

...was a 2-door grand tourer that offered speed, comfort,
and class.

It was called the 350 GT, a large coupe with a V-12 engine
mounted up front.

Since the 1970s, Lamborghini has built many elegant GT
and 4-door sedan concepts, although they were not for sale.

This means that Lamborghini never forgot about its GT roots!
And the Urus was proof of that.

dialogues.zh: Urus是Lamborghini设计的第一款SUV。 如今，人们通常会将Lamborghini与各种超级跑车 联系在一起，如Countach…… 不过在1963年创立之初，它打造的第一款车…… 是一款强调速度、舒适性和档次的双门豪华旅行车。 它就是采用前置V12引擎的大型双门跑车——350 GT。 自从1970年代起，Lamborghini曾设计了多款优雅的豪华旅行车 和4门概念轿车，但从未正式发售。 看来Lamborghini从未忘记自己起步于豪华旅行车的根源！ 这款Urus就是确凿的证明！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 2018, the Urus was Lamborghini’s high-performance SUV. It marked the brand’s first use of forced induction, powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 capable of accelerating from zero to 62.1 mph in 3.6 seconds, and reaching a top speed of 189.5 mph—a record at the time of its debut. Equipped with active air suspension, rear-wheel steering, and a torque vectoring system, it delivered exceptional handling and cornering capabilities uncommon in vehicles of its class.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2018年推出的Urus是Lamborghini的超级SUV。这是Lamborghini历史上首次采用强制进气技术，搭载4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，0-100 公里/小时加速只要3.6秒，最高时速305 公里/小时，在初次亮相时便创下纪录。凭借主动空气悬挂、后轮转向和扭矩矢量系统，该车还具备卓越的操控和过弯性能。
officialDetails.heroEn: Lamborghini's take on a high-performance exotic SUV.
officialDetails.heroZh: Lamborghini对全球SUV浪潮的回应。

brandCentral.en:
The Urus was the first SUV to be designed by
world-famous maker of super cars, Lamborghini.

Taking design elements from such legends as the Countach
and the LM002...

...the Urus has reworked them into a functional 4-door
5-seat sport-utility vehicle.

Powered by a twin-turbocharged V-8 up mounted in front,
it’s capable reaching a top speed of more than 300 km/h.

At full throttle, you’ll swear it was a race car!

With its AWD system that excels on the roughest of roads,
the Urus is one super SUV.`
brandCentral.zh:
Urus是由举世闻名的超级跑车制造商Lamborghini
所设计的第一款SUV。

Urus借鉴了Countach和LM002等传奇车型
的设计元素……

并将它们活用在了这款非常实用的四门五座
运动型多用途汽车上。

Urus由一台前置的双涡轮增压V8引擎提供动力，
能轻松飙到<300 km/h>以上。

全速冲刺的时候，你一定会错以为座下是一辆赛车！

Urus的四轮驱动系统让它能够在哪怕最崎岖的道路上
发挥出优秀性能，是名不虚传的超级SUV！

catch.en: Lamborghini's take on a high-performance exotic SUV.
catch.zh: Lamborghini对全球SUV浪潮的回应。

vehicleCollection.en:
Lamborghini's take on a high-performance exotic SUV.

Introduced in 2018 in response to the global SUV boom, the Urus was a “Super SUV” from renowned exotic-car manufacturer Lamborghini.

Styled with sharp lines and an edgy design similar to that of the company's mid-engine models, the Urus' body construction was inherited from other full-size SUVs from the Volkswagen Group.

The Urus' front-mounted powerplant took the form of a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8, the first ever forced-induction engine ever in a Lamborghini. It produced an impressive <650ps> and <86.68kgm> of torque.

The default setting for the vehicle's AWD system was 40/60 front/rear, but it could be adjusted from 70/30 to 13/87 depending on the road surface.

Other Urus highlights were an adaptive air suspension system, rear-wheel steering, and torque vectoring, all of which combined to deliver the type of handling and cornering performance befitting a Lamborghini. Optional driving modes made the vehicle at home on off-road trails and even through the desert.

But what was most impressive about the Urus was its acceleration. It ran from 0-<100 km/h> in 3.6 seconds, to <200 km/h> in 12.8 and reached a top speed of <305 km/h>, making it truly the world’s fastest SUV upon its debut.

long.zh:
作为面对席卷全球的SUV潮流的回应，著名的超级跑车制造商兰博基尼在2018年推出了被誉为“超级SUV”的Urus。

在此车型中，设计师运用犀利的线条，呈现与同一时期兰博基尼中置引擎超跑车型同款的前卫设计。其结构基于大众汽车集团其他全尺寸SUV所采用的通用平台，但经过专门调校以提升性能。

前部搭载了一台4升双涡轮增压V8引擎，能够产生<650ps>的动力和<86.68kgm>的扭矩，这也是兰博基尼有史以来首次采用涡轮增压引擎。

驱动装置采用全时四驱系统，默认为前40后60的分配比例，并可根据驾驶情况调整为从70:30到13:87的各种区间。

此外，该车还配备了自适应空气悬挂、后轮转向和扭矩矢量控制，以提供超级SUV所需的卓越操控和出色转弯性能。Urus有多种驾驶模式可供选择，包括适用于越野和沙漠驾驶的可选模式。

Urus能够在短短3.6秒内完成从0到<100 km/h>加速，在12.8秒内完成0到<200 km/h>加速，并且能够达到<305 km/h>的最高时速。初次亮相便轻松摘下全球最快SUV的头衔。
