officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Veneno was a special limited-edition model created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Lamborghini’s founding. Only three units were ever sold to the public. Based on the Aventador and sharing its chassis and powertrain, the Veneno featured an uprated engine producing 739.6 HP, while weight was reduced through enhancements such as a carbon-fiber monocoque. As a result, the Veneno was 276 lbs lighter than the Aventador, with a total weight of just 3197 lbs.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Veneno是Lamborghini为了庆祝公司成立50周年而推出的一款特别限量版车型。这款车总共仅售出3辆。它基于Aventador开发，且采用同款底盘和动力系统，而引擎的动力输出被提升到了750 PS，此外还进行了车身减重，如采用碳纤维单体车壳等各种改进。这些改动将Veneno的车重削减到了1,450 公斤，比Aventador轻了125 公斤。
officialDetails.heroEn: Lamborghini celebrated its 50th anniversary with this extremely limited-production super car.
officialDetails.heroZh: 仅生产了3辆。Lamborghini 50周年纪念款。

brandCentral.en:
This machine was introduced to celebrate Lamborghini's 50th
anniversary.

Called the Veneno, it was unveiled at the 2013
Geneva Motor Show.

This coupe model was a one-off, made especially for
display at the show.

However, the company built three more to meet the
demands of passionate Lamborghini aficionados.

Later, nine roadsters were produced for sale.

Each Veneno is a one-of-a-kind example that has a solid place
in Lamborghini history.

How much does it cost? Well, if you have to ask,
you probably can't afford it.
brandCentral.zh:
Veneno是为庆祝Lamborghini成立50周年而设计的作品……

在2013年的日内瓦车展上揭开了面纱。

这款双门跑车原本是专为展会组装的孤品。

然而，为了满足热情高涨的Lamborghini收藏家的要求，Lamborghini
追加制造了三台车，

后来又额外生产了九辆敞篷车。

每辆Veneno都是独一无二的珍宝，也是Lamborghini历史的一部分。

您问价格？如果您非要刨根问底的话，反正一般人肯定
是买不起的……

catch.en: Lamborghini celebrated its 50th anniversary with this extremely limited-production super car.
catch.zh: 仅生产了3辆。Lamborghini 50周年纪念款。

vehicleCollection.en:
Lamborghini celebrated its 50th anniversary with this extremely limited-production super car.

When Lamborghini introduces a limited-production car to celebrate its 50th anniversary, you know that it’s bound to be special, and very exclusive. Well, the company from Sant’Agata, Italy didn’t disappoint when it unveiled the multi-million-dollar Veneno, a super car whose clientele was restricted to a mere three people.

The Veneno was based on Lamborghini’s flagship, the Aventador, which featured an exterior design that looked like it came from another planet. However, there’s a reason for its bizarre looks, as precision aerodynamics had been implemented into the body to ensure optimal performance. The “V” shaped nose suggested that Formula 1 technology had made its way into the car design. Combined with a high-mounted variable rear-wing, a gigantic rear diffuser, and a shark fin that extended from the roof to the rear, the Veneno possessed gobs of downforce that kept it glued to the pavement through high-speed corners.

Also keeping the Veneno stable was a full-time 4-wheel-drive system and an F1-type pushrod suspension system that made it one of the cars with the best handling of all time. Providing the punch was a 6.5-liter V-12 that came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. With <750ps> on tap and a lightweight carbon-fiber structure that made it <125kg> lighter than the Aventador at <1450kg>, the Veneno sprinted to <100km/h> in 2.8 seconds and reached a top speed of <355km/h>.

long.zh:
Veneno是兰博基尼在2013年日内瓦车展上发布的特殊车型。这款车是纪念兰博基尼50周年的限量款公路跑车——仅仅发售过三辆。

Veneno的设计基于兰博基尼的旗舰车型Aventador，具有惊艳的外观设计和精准的空气动力学性能，揭示了新一代兰博基尼的面貌。车辆前部包含极低的V形前鼻，并具有方程式赛车前翼的所有特性。结合高位安装的可调后翼、巨大的尾部扰流翼和从车顶延伸到尾翼的鲨鱼鳍，产生了巨大的下压力，从而提升转弯速度。

这款车将全时四驱系统与推杆悬挂结合，并由一台6.5升的V12引擎驱动，同时还采用与Aventador相同的7档双踏板手动变速箱。Veneno不仅将引擎动力提升至<750ps>，还采用了额外的减重措施，包括采用碳纤维单体壳，使得车体重量降至<1450kg>，比Aventador还轻<125kg>。性能差异一目了然：0-<100km/h>的加速时间仅为2.8秒，最高时速可达<355km/h>。

At a time when Giugiaro was designing many production cars,
he put his signature styling technique on full display...

...on this Lancia Delta.

It reflects the dignified brand image of Lancia,
and gives off a very positive feel.

During the 1970s, Lancia dominated rally races
with a car probably everyone is familiar with, the Stratos.

Lancia most likely intended for the Delta to be
the spiritual successor of the Stratos.

When comparing it to the rally bred Stratos...

...the Delta improved on the 2-box hatchback-sedan theme.

The fat 16-inch 205 tires and the huge, blistered fenders
provided the car with the prowess of a wild animal.
You can see how a tame hatchback can transform
into a fierce rally maine.

I dlike his kind of design approach as well.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Following a dominant run of victories in the World Rally Championship, powered by the exceptional performance of the Lancia Delta, Lancia faced rising pressure from a resurgent Toyota team in 1991. In response, the marque developed the ultimate evolution of its rally icon: the HF Integrale Evoluzione. This version not only featured increased engine output but also introduced a reworked front-to-rear power distribution and significantly enhanced handling characteristics. Making its debut in the 1992 WRC season, the Evoluzione extended Lancia’s record-setting streak of consecutive championship victories.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 在1991年Toyota带来激烈的竞争压力之前，Lancia凭借性能出色的Lancia Delta在世界拉力锦标赛斩获连胜。这催生了Delta终极型号——HF Integrale Evoluzione。除了提升引擎的输出外，前后动力分配也得到了全面优化，操控性更是显著提升。Evoluzione在1992年世界拉力锦标赛首次亮相，为Lancia的连胜立下汗马功劳。
officialDetails.heroEn: This last and most potent Delta set the WRC record for consecutive wins.
officialDetails.heroZh: 以连续胜利创下新WRC纪录的终极Delta。

usedCar.en:
The Italian-made Lancia Delta is one of the world's most
legendary rally cars.

vehicleCollection.en:
This last and most potent Delta set the WRC record for consecutive wins.

The original Lancia Delta was a family-oriented hatchback designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro. However, when Group B was phased out of the WRC, Lancia selected the Delta as the foundation for its new Group A contender. From that moment, the car’s destiny as a rally legend was sealed.

In 1987, Lancia equipped the Delta a high-performance turbocharged engine and a 4WD system, before setting it loose in the WRC.
From that moment on, Lancia secured an unprecedented six consecutive WRC championships. However, maintaining its edge meant that it had to undergo a series of evolutions. Such is the life of a competition rally car.

By 1991, Lancia faced mounting pressure from its rival, Toyota. In response, it unveiled the ultimate iteration of the Delta at the Frankfurt Motor Show—the HF Integrale Evoluzione.

The Evoluzione sported a larger front grille and expanded hood vents, enhancing enhanced airflow for improved engine cooling and ventilation. This allowed the power of the engine to be increased from <200ps> to <210ps>.

To help the car's stability, the front and rear track were widened by <60mm>.
This necessitated even wider blistered wheel arches, pushing the car’s overall width to <1770mm>.
And, by shifting the 4WD torque distribution toward the rear, Lancia engineered the car to deliver a driving character closer to that of a rear-wheel-drive machine. The car also featured a spoiler mounted to the edge of the roof to further improve downforce.

The Evoluzione made its WRC debut in 1992, playing a crucial role in extending Lancia's streak of dominance. Unfortunately, Lancia's parent company, FIAT, decided to withdraw the car from the WRC, bringing the Evoluzione’s competitive run to an abrupt end that same year.

long.zh:
原版蓝旗亚Delta是一辆家用型掀背车，由乔盖托·乔治亚罗设计。而在世界拉力锦标赛取消B组别赛事之后，蓝旗亚选择了Delta作为他们征战A组别赛事的新基础车款。从那一刻起，这款车的未来就已经注定了。

1987年，蓝旗亚为Delta装上了高性能的涡轮增压发动机和四驱系统，然后在世界拉力锦标赛上将其推向世界。从那一年起，蓝旗亚史无前例地连续六年夺得世界拉力锦标赛总冠军。不过在重重竞争压力下，他们也在持续不断地对Delta进行着改进，这也是竞争激烈的拉力赛车所必须经历的。

1991年，承受着来自死敌丰田的巨大压力的蓝旗亚，在法兰克福车展公布了Delta的终极型号：HF Integrale Evoluzione。

Evoluzione配备了更大的前格栅，引擎盖内的进气道也被加大，以此改善发动机舱的排气与冷却。因此，动力输出从<200ps>提高到了<210ps>。

值得一提的是，轮距也增加了<60mm>。止步在了这一年。其标志性的凸起式轮拱罩进一步向尾部加宽，使得整车的宽度增加到了<1770mm>。另外，四驱系统的扭矩分配倾向于后轮，使得该车的操控表现更接近于后驱。车顶的尾端也增加了扰流板来产生更多的下压力。

Evoluzione在接下来的1992赛季世界拉力锦标赛中亮相，为蓝旗亚连续不断的胜利立下汗马功劳。令人遗憾的是，蓝旗亚的母公司菲亚特决定从世界拉力锦标赛中退出，因此Evoluzione的参赛历史止步在了这一年。

Lancia of Italy had long been a dominant force
in the World Rally Championship.

This Group A rally version of the Delta stands

collection.en:
Lancia is well known for its elegant Italian designs
and is equally famous for its motorsports prowess.

It has produced great rally machines like the Fulvia and
Stratos, as well as the Delta, which competed in Group A.

The Delta made its stunning WRC debut in 1987, when
it racked up 9 wins to become the season champion.

As development on the car continued, innovative technology
was regularly added to it.

What do you think of its bulging blister fender? Does it not
express the wild ferocity of a genuine fighting machine?

Since entering competition in 1992, the HF Integrale has won
six straight manufacturers’ titles.

A true icon of 1990s rally racing, this is a legendary car
whose star has never dimmed.

vehicleCollection.en:
The Lancia Delta, a six-time consecutive WRC Champion.

Following the end of the Group B era in the WRC, Lancia turned to the Delta as its weapon of choice for Group A competition. Transformed with a turbocharged engine and a newly developed 4-wheel-drive system, the high-performance Delta was rebranded as the HF 4WD and made its debut in the 1987 WRC.

Just a year later, it evolved into the legendary Delta Integrale, equipped with aggressive blistered wheel arches. In 1990, the Integrale received a significant upgrade with the addition of a 16-valve cylinder head, boosting its performance even further. However, it soon faced fierce competition. Despite Lancia’s continued efforts, the Drivers’ Championship slipped from the Delta’s grasp in both 1990 and 1991, claimed by Toyota's Celica. Thus, in 1992, Lancia unveiled what would be considered the final evolution of the Delta.

This new Integrale featured reinforced bodywork for enhanced rigidity and underwent extensive suspension revisions, including a widened track. In line with these upgrades, the blistered wheel arches grew even more pronounced. To enhance aerodynamic performance, a roof-mounted spoiler was added to generate more downforce, while the torque distribution of the 4-wheel-drive system was recalibrated to give the car a more rear-wheel-drive–like character.

Thanks to these comprehensive improvements, the Delta regained its competitive edge. Although Lancia’s factory team ceased official racing activities in 1992 due to a policy shift by parent company FIAT, Lancia partnered with the Jolly Club satellite team, providing full technical support. Juha Kankkunen and Didier Auriol competed in 11 of 14 rounds that season, with Auriol taking six victories, Kankkunen adding one more, and Andrea Aghini yet another. With eight wins total, Lancia clinched the constructors' championship for the sixth consecutive year.

在B组别赛事从世界拉力锦标赛中取消后，蓝旗亚选择Delta作为他们的A组别赛车。此车被改装为四驱并配备涡轮增压器，就此诞生的高性能车型被称为HF 4WD，参加了1987年世界拉力锦标赛。

次年，Delta HF 4WD配备了大胆的凸起轮拱罩，进化为Integrale。1990年，Integrale的引擎采用了16气门缸盖，进一步提升了动力。然而，丰田Celica的竞争力更强，导致Delta在1990年和1991年连续两次眼看着车手冠军被Celica夺走。因此，蓝旗亚在1992年发布了可以称为Delta最终进化版本的车型。

新的Integrale通过车身加强改善了操控性，并对悬挂系统进行了大幅修改，扩大了轮距。相应地，凸起的轮拱变得更大。为了获得更多下压力，在车顶末端安装了扰流板，四驱系统的扭矩分配向后轮倾斜，使车辆设定更像后驱车。

得益于这些改进，Delta重新获得了竞争实力。1992年，由于母公司菲亚特的政策影响，蓝旗亚没有派出原厂车队参加赛车活动，但他们与卫星车队乔利俱乐部合作并提供全面技术支持。尤哈·坎库宁和迪迪埃·奥里奥尔参加了系列赛14轮中的11轮比赛，奥里奥尔取得6场胜利，坎库宁赢得1场，安德烈亚·阿吉尼也收获1场胜利。一年8场胜利，让蓝旗亚连续第六年夺得制造商冠军。

collection.en:
The Lancia Rally 037 is one of the iconic Group B
rally cars of the 1980s.

Introduced in the early years of Group B racing, it combined
a mid-engine layout with a rear-wheel drive.

Its spaceframe chassis and powerful mid-mounted engine...

...was reminiscent of Lancia's iconic Stratos rally car.

While 4-wheel drive would become mainstream starting
with the Audi quattro in 1981...

...the rear-wheel-drive Rally 037 claimed the 1983
season series title, besting the competition.

This Evoluzione II was the final spec of the car, which
came equipped with a 2.1-liter powerplant.
collection.zh:
蓝旗亚Rally 037是1980年代B组别拉力赛的
标志性参赛车型之一。

这台结合了中置引擎和后轮驱动布局的拉力车很早就开
始参加B组别比赛。

其空间框架底盘和中置引擎...

让人不禁回想起蓝旗亚标志性的Stratos。

当1981年奥迪quattro的出现带动四轮驱动
成为拉力赛车主流后，

Rally 037仍然顽强地用两轮驱动为蓝旗亚
带来了1983赛季的冠军，尽管是两轮驱动汽车。

这款名为Evoluzione II，是Rally 037的最终规格，
排量提高到了2.1升，冷却系统也得到了改进。

conversation.en:
A car that expresses this much strength and beauty
in its appearance...

...is quite revolutionary in the history of car design.

It's a design that you simply cannot imitate.

It's a design that goes beyond something that's simply beautiful,
that's what I find most alluring.

It possesses both a futuristic design theme,
a signature element of Gandini's...

...and styling that truly is car-like. The Stratos is a car that
is defined by both.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
你无法想象一辆汽车究竟是如何表现出这种程度的
力量和美感的。

这是革命性的一台车，

是一个无法被模仿的设计，

更是超越了单纯美学的设计。
我认为这就是其魅力所在。

它既拥有甘迪尼标志性的未来主义设计……

又没有忘记其本源。
确切地说，这辆Stratos是一辆跨越两个世界的车。

conversation.en: By the way, do you know who Gandini is?
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh: 顺便问一句，你们知道甘迪尼是谁吗？

conversation.en:
Yes. He's the legendary car designer from Italy,
Marcello Gandini.

He had a hand in the design of cars such as the Countach
and Stratos, and is known all around the world.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
对，马塞罗·甘迪尼，来自意大利的传奇汽车设计师。

他曾设计过Countach和Stratos，在全世界都享有盛名。

conversation.en:
He's the legendary car designer from Italy,
Marcello Gandini.

He was the chief designer
for Carrozzeria Bertone.

He had a hand in the design of cars such as the Countach
and Stratos, and is known all around the world.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
马塞罗·甘迪尼是位来自意大利的传奇设计师，

是Carrozzeria Bertone公司的首席设计师。

Countach和Stratos都是出自这位世界闻名的设计师之手。

conversation.en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.

From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?

I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...

...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.

In fact, "car design" is something that can't
be accomplished by just one persn.

The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.

In those terms...

...I think it's correct in saying that
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."

I would seriously love o add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.
G
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。

你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？

我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。

虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。

事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。

它需要工程技师和模{师之间的通力合作。

因此……

我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。

我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负b不起的天价了。
<

conversation.en:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...

...was created to accomplish just one goal.

And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.

Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive
owing to its short wheelbase.

In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really
master it.

One of them was the legendary rally driver
Sandro Munari.

He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.

His view on the matter was:

"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills
just aren't good enough."
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……

他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。

那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。

传说这辆车非常难驾驭……

实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。

传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。

对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！

他对此的看法是：

“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”
i

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 1970, Bertone unveiled the visionary Stratos Zero. The bold, wedge-shaped concept would evolve into the production Lancia Stratos. Built on a rigid monocoque frame with lightweight fiberglass body panels, it housed a 2.4-liter DOHC V-6 engine. With its exceptionally short wheelbase and razor-sharp handling, it excelled in rally competition.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Bertone于1970年发布了“Stratos Zero”概念车。这款楔形概念车后来以“Stratos”之名正式量产。车身采用刚性单体框架和玻璃纤维外板，搭载2.4升V6双顶置凸轮轴引擎。凭借短轴距带来的卓越过弯能力，它在拉力赛中表现极为出色。

usedCar.en:
The Stratos is a masterpiece of a roadster produced by
Lancia, an esteemed maker of rally cars.

This mid-engine marvel first emerged on the rally scene
in the 1970s.

Its speed and power led to it winning several world
championship titles.

It was styled by Marcello Gandini, a legendary figure
in automobile design.

The engine is the same V6 that's used in Ferrari's Dino 246.

There aren't many cars more magnificent than this,
let me tell you!
usedCar.zh:
Stratos是一款优秀的双座敞篷车，由备受
敬仰的拉力赛车制造商蓝旗亚推出。

这款奇妙的中置引擎车型于20世纪70年代
在拉力赛场上首度亮相。

它的速度和动力使它夺得了多项世界冠军。

这款车的风格设计由汽车设计的传奇性
人物马塞罗·甘迪尼负责。

它的引擎采用了和法拉利Dino 246相同的V6。

要知道，没有多少车的性能能比它更出色了！

vehicleCollection.en:
This mid-engine sports car made quite the impression on the rally world with its sharp wedge-shaped body.

At the 1970 Turin Motor Show, Bertone unveiled a striking concept car called the Stratos Zero. With its radical wedge-shaped profile and a front windshield that doubled as the door, the vehicle was conceived purely as a design study. But even then, Bertone described it as a mid-engine concept. Following the show, development began in collaboration with Lancia, which was in search of a new rally car to succeed the Fulvia.

Marcello Gandini was tasked with refining the concept into a production-ready model. Drawing inspiration from the shape of the Stratos Zero, he created an angular body that echoed its otherworldly name: Stratosphere. Thus, the legendary Lancia Stratos was born.

The Stratos featured a robust welded steel monocoque chassis clad in lightweight fiberglass panels. Mounted behind the seats was the same 2.4-liter DOHC V-6 engine found in the Ferrari Dino 246 GT.

Its performance potential was evident in its dimensions: an exceptionally short wheelbase of just <2180 mm> and a wide rear tread of <1457 mm>. This configuration delivered razor-sharp handling and extremely sensitive response. For those who could master its traits, the Stratos offered extraordinary performance that translated into rally dominance, ushering in a golden era for Lancia on the world stage.

long.zh:
在1970年的都灵车展上，博通推出了概念车“Stratos Zero”。车身轮廓完全呈楔形，前档风玻璃化身为车门。这款设计原本只是试水，但博通却表示已经在考虑使用中置引擎布局进行开发了。展会一结束，蓝旗亚就紧锣密鼓地投入到开发中，他们当时正在寻求代替Fulvia参加拉力赛的车型。

马塞罗·甘迪尼出手改进了设计，创造出了可供批量生产的Stratos Zero。充分利用楔形轮廓，为其打造出了与“至尊”称号相称的硬朗外观，蓝旗亚Stratos就此诞生。

Stratos的车体由坚固的焊接钢单体框架和玻璃纤维外板组成。座椅后方的引擎则是一台法拉利Dino 246GT同款的2.4升双顶置凸轮轴V6引擎。

从轴距和胎宽上，就足以体现出这款车卓越的性能：仅有<2180mm>的短轴距和宽达<1457mm>的后胎，带来了极致的过弯能力和难以驾驭的灵敏度。只有拥有极高驾驶技巧的车手才能驾驭得了蓝旗亚Stratos，另一方面，其完美适配拉力赛的优异性能也成就了蓝旗亚在拉力赛中的一段辉煌时刻。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The LC500 is a luxury sports coupe that made its debut at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show. While its design featured sleek, flowing lines, the front and rear overhangs were shortened to accommodate a front mid-engine layout with 2+2 seating. A mix of lightweight materials was used throughout the body, achieving a balance of reduced weight and high structural rigidity.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: LC500是一款豪华跑车，最初在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相。虽然其前悬和后悬进行了缩短，以实现2+2座位的前中置布局，但其依然保留了流畅的轿跑车身设计。另外，它的车身还运用了多种先进材料，在降低车重的同时还提升了刚性。
officialDetails.heroEn: This stylish sports coupe attracted plenty of attention with its low nose and short overhang design.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款时尚的双门跑车以其较低的车鼻和紧凑的前后悬间距吸睛无数。

brandCentral.en:
Have you heard of the 'LF-LC'? It's a truly beautiful
concept vehicle, unveiled by Lexus in 2012.

It's also the car on which the design of this LC500
was based.

The engine is a naturally aspirated 5L V8—the same one
that's used in the RC F sports model.

Though brimming with low-rev torque, it doesn't sacrifice
anything at the high-rev end.
brandCentral.zh:
您听说过“LF-LC”吗？这台绝美的概念赛车由雷克萨斯在2012年公布。

LC500在设计时也将之作为了参照。

它安装有一台5升自然进气V8引擎，和RC F跑车型号采用
的是同款。

这辆车在低转速时扭矩非常充足，达到高转速区间后也
没有牺牲任何性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
This stylish sports coupe attracted plenty of attention with its low nose and short overhang design.~

Introduced at the 2016 Geneva Auto Show, the LC500 luxury sports coupe represented the first F-segment model for Lexus.

The styling is nearly unchanged from the LF-FC concept vehicle revealed in 2012, which was penned at Lexus’ design studio in California. Its flowing lines and low hood give the LC500 a wind-cutting shape, and it features short front and rear overhangs that allow the engine to be placed aft of the front wheels, giving it a front mid-engine layout.

The LC500 was built on the newly developed GA-L platform. The body is composed of a combination of materials that include carbon fiber, aluminum and steel, which gives the sports coupe a highly-rigid yet lightweight character.

Under the hood is the same 5.0-liter naturally-aspirated V-8 found in the RC F and GS F that produces <477ps> and <55.1kgm> of torque. The engine comes mated to the first direct-shift 10-speed automatic transmission to be equipped on a passenger car.

The LC500 race car dominated its debut appearance in the GT500 class of the Super GT series in 2017, taking 1st to 6th place.

long.zh:
LC500是在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相的豪华跑车。这款车是雷克萨斯的首款F级双门跑车。

LC500的样式几乎与2012年发布的LF-FC概念赛车相同，是雷克萨斯位于加利福利亚的设计工作室的内部开发成果。虽然其流线形双门车身的前鼻很低，但前部和后部的悬垂非常短，得以容纳中置引擎和2+2的座位布局。

这款车的底盘结构是基于丰田新全球架构概念全新开发的GA-L平台。车身是碳纤维、铝材和钢材等多种材料的组合，这些材料被用于多种零件，从而在低重量和高刚度之间取得平衡。

引擎和RC F及GS F所使用的相同，仍采用5升V8自然吸气引擎，可产生<477ps>/<55.1kgm>的动力。搭配此引擎的是首次装备在乘用车上的直接换档式10档自动变速箱。

LC500从2017年开始参加Super GT系列赛的GT500组比赛，并在首次比赛中包揽了一到六名。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This ultimate sports car aimed to carry forward the spirit and performance legacy of the Toyota 2000GT. Its carbon-fiber body was produced through automated processes, and the transaxle and radiator were mounted at the rear to achieve a near-perfect 48:52 front-to-rear weight distribution. Under the hood was a 4.8-liter V-10 with a 72-degree bank angle. Its distinctive sound was tuned in collaboration with Yamaha. Only 500 units were produced, making it as rare as it was ambitious.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款顶级跑车承载着传承Toyota 2000GT辉煌成就与卓越性能的使命而诞生。采用自动化工艺制造的碳纤维车身，变速驱动桥和散热器后置布局，实现了48:52的理想前后配重比例。搭载4.8升V10引擎，采用72度气缸夹角设计。引擎优美的轰鸣声经由乐器制造商Yamaha精心调校打造。全球限量生产500台。

officialDetails.heroZh: 一辆以量产品质实现了终极性能的极致高科技水平跑车。

brandCentral.en:
The LFA was the first supercar from Lexus.

Can you believe it took a decade to develop?

It was the result of extensive testing at Nürburgring races,
so you can imagine how well this car performs.

One big feature of this front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive car...

...is that its transmission is positioned
on the rear axle.

This makes it a well-balanced "FR" machine with a rear
transaxle configuration.

Powered by a high-revving naturally-aspirated V-10,
the LFA sounds as sweet as it drives.

It's truly one of Japan’s greatest sports cars!

And while its production run ended more than a decade ago,
its allure never seems to diminish.
brandCentral.zh:
LFA是Lexus打造的第一款超级跑车。

你能想象吗？这款车的开发花费了整整十年时间。

在纽博格林的大量测试最终开花结果，
证明这辆车确实拥有飞一般的速度。

这款引擎前置、后轮驱动跑车的一项主要特点……

就是它的传动系统搭载在后轮轴上……

让它成为了一款采用后驱动桥配置、
前后配重比平衡的前置后驱车。

LFA由一台高转速自然进气V10引擎提供动力，
拥有澎湃震撼的声浪。

毫无疑问，它是日本最伟大的跑车之一！

尽管已经于十年前停产，但它的魅力却不减反增。_

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra high-tech sports car achieved ultimate performance with mass-production quality.

Twenty years before Japan’s automotive industry was truly recognized by the world, Toyota created a sports car called the 2000GT, which combined the latest technology of the 1960s with a truly revolutionary body design. In the 21st century, Lexus created another cutting-edge sports car that would continue that legacy. It was called the LFA.

Creating such a car was not easy. The goal was to provide stable and consistent quality while incorporating emerging technologies, which included a lightweight carbon-fiber body. For the engineers, it was not enough to simply make another sports car for the masses; they staked the company's reputation to create a car that balanced cutting-edge technology with consistent product quality.

One of the most important factors of a sports car remains the front-to-rear weight distribution ratio; the LFA's was 48 to 52. To achieve this figure, they implemented a transaxle layout and mounted the radiator at the rear. Also, curb weight was kept at <1480kg>. Emphasis was also put on lowering the car's center of gravity, utilizing a dry-sump lubrication system so that the powertrain could be mounted lower.

The LFA's 4.8-liter V-10 had bank angles of 72 degrees with a factory redline of <9500rpm>. Its <560ps> output equated to <117ps> per liter, but what's most impressive was that despite this incredibly high-performance level, the LFA was still relatively environmentally friendly. The transmission came in the form of a 6-speed single-clutch 2-pedal manual that could perform shifts in just 0.2 seconds, a figure on par with the world's top race cars.

Carbon ceramic brake discs were standard fare, with 6-pot calipers in front and 4-pot calipers at rear, all with varying piston sizes.

The LFA ran from zero to <100km/h> in just 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of <325km/h>. But what really sweetened the car's collectivity factor was that it was produced in a limited run of only 500 cars worldwide.

long.zh:
在日本的汽车行业真正得到全世界认可的20年前，丰田就打造了一款结合了1960年代最尖端科技的跑车，名为2000GT。时间来到21世纪，雷克萨斯接过品牌传承，打造出另一款技术领先的跑车——LFA。

既要整合碳纤维车身等最新研发的技术，又要保证品牌一以贯之的稳定品质，这台车的开发难度不可谓不高。对于雷克萨斯来说，光是将各种部件安装组合在一起是远远不够的，这台新车还需要在尖端科技和一贯的产品品质之间找到平衡点。它代表着雷克萨斯作为一家量产车制造商的门面和荣耀。

配重比是跑车最重要的因素之一，这款车的前后配重比被设计为48比52。为了实现这个参数，雷克萨斯采用了一套驱动桥布局，并将散热器布置在车身后部。车重也被降低到<1480kg>。另外一项设计重点放在降低重心上——通过采用一套干式油底壳润滑系统，得以实现更低的动力系统安装位。

它的4.8升V10引擎采用72度的V型夹角设计，原厂转速红线设在<9500rpm>，而<560ps>总动力输出相当于每升输出<117ps>。不过即便达到这样高的性能水准，这辆车依然比大多数车辆更加环保。其传动装置采用一部双踏板单离合的6速手动变速箱，可以在仅仅0.2秒内完成换挡，这个数据足以与世界最顶级的比赛机器相媲美。

碳化陶瓷刹车碟是LFA的标配，前轮采用6活塞卡钳，而后轮采用4活塞卡钳，而且前后活塞的尺寸略有不同。

LFA能够实现在3.7秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，极速更是高达<325km/h>。由于这台高性能车全球仅限量生产了500辆，所以相当的罕见。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The RC F was unveiled by Lexus at the 2014 Detroit Auto Show. At its heart lay a refined version of the 5.0-liter V-8 from the IS F, producing 449.7 HP and 383.3 ft-lb of torque—an increase of 32.5 HP and 10.8 ft-lb more than the original engine. Paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission featuring paddle shifters, the RC F delivered both power and precision. Excluding the LFA, it stood as the most sports-focused model ever introduced in the Lexus lineup.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: RC F是Lexus在2014年底特律车展上公布的一款高性能双门轿跑。其引擎采用了IS F的5升V8的改良版，能够输出456 PS和53.0 公斤力米，比原版引擎高出了33 PS和1.5 公斤力米。这套动力系统还搭配了一部带换挡拨片的8速自动变速箱。除了LFA之外，这辆车是Lexus产品历史中最强调运动性能的车型。
officialDetails.heroEn: Even beginners can experience dynamic driving performance with a range of electronic aids.
officialDetails.heroZh: 即便是新手也可以在多种电子辅助设备的帮助下体验到动态的驾驶表现。

brandCentral.en:
The Lexus RC F is well-known for its GT3 racing variant.

Did you know that the 'F' in the model name stands for the
Fuji Speedway, the home course for Lexus Gazoo Racing?

The naturally aspirated 5.0 L V8 engine allows for smooth
transition to higher RPMs and a pleasant exhaust note.

And the enhanced oil cooler also allows you to get the most
out of your time on the circuit.
brandCentral.zh:
Lexus RC F因其参加GT3组别的赛车而广为人知。

你知道吗，车型名称中的“F”代表富士赛道，后者正
是Lexus Gazoo车队的主场。

vehicleCollection.en:
Even beginners can experience dynamic driving performance with a range of electronic aids.

While German luxury carmakers have traditionally defined the luxury sports coupe market, Lexus decided to join the fray with a svelte version all its own called the RC F. Introduced at the 2014 North American International Auto Show, the RC F is the sportiest entry of the RC line—the letter “F,” which references Fuji Speedway, is added to all of the brand’s high-performance models.

Under the hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, the same powerplant found in the IS F, with new titanium valves, forged connecting rods, newly designed cylinder heads and custom exhaust system. They combine to help the engine produce <456ps>/<53.0kgm>, which is <33ps> and <1.5kgm> more than the IS F. It comes mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission that performs lightning-quick shifts via paddles near the steering wheel.

The Sports Mode of the VDIM, which centrally controls vehicle dynamics, has been refined for the racetrack, and most of the electronic devices have been updated. The RC F features the first torque-vectoring system in the world to be incorporated into a front-engine/rear-wheel drive car. This system allows drivers of all levels to enjoy the RC F’s excellent handling balance and overall performance.

With the exception of the limited-edition LFA supercar, the RC F is the sportiest model to ever come from Lexus.\

RC F是雷克萨斯品牌的高性能双门跑车，发布于2014年的底特律车展。雷克萨斯在他们的高性能车型名称中使用字母“F”进行标识，代表富士赛道。RC F是对2013年东京车展上发布的RC系列双门跑车大幅度升级后的版本。

引擎基于IS F所采用的5升V8引擎，采用新的钛合金气门、锻造连杆和新设计的气缸盖和排气系统。这款车的输出动力可达到<456ps>/<53.0kgm>，相比原款引擎，马力提高了<33ps>，扭矩提高了<1.5kgm>。同时还配备了带换档拨片的8档自动变速箱。

针对赛道驾驶，该车对控制车辆动力的车辆动态综合管理系统的跑车模式进行了进一步优化。这款车的电子设备得到再次更新，配备了世界首个用于前置引擎、后轮驱动车型的扭矩矢量分配系统。这是因为RC F的一个核心设计理念——让车手和新车手都能享受澎湃的跑车驾驶性能所带来的乐趣。

除了LFA之外，RC F是雷克萨斯史上最动感的车型。

catch.en: Emil Frey Racing was one of the first teams to compete with a GT3 version of the Lexus RC F.

vehicleCollection.en:
Emil Frey Racing was one of the first teams to compete with a GT3 version of the Lexus RC F.

While Lexus ran an RC F-based race car for the VLN and Super GT Series in 2015, it was allowed to compete with this particular car without

having to adhere to homologation requirements. The RC F GT3 Prototype made its debut in Round 9 of the VLN series and won the SPX class, which allowed specially permitted entries.

This prototype race car was developed with the intent of eventually providing a GT3 machine to race teams around the world. Starting out as an RC F, the entire car was altered dramatically to ensure competitiveness and reliability in GT3 races. Weight was significantly reduced and the body drastically stiffened; the front and rear fenders were swapped to improve aerodynamics; and power from the 5.0-liter V-8 engine was increased to <540ps>. Ultimately, the car was homologated and introduced as the Lexus RC F GT3 in 2017.

The following year, the new race car was delivered to Emil Frey Racing in Switzerland, which took part in the development of the RC F GT3. Participating in the GT Open Championship of Europe, the team won four of 14 races and placed 3rd for the season.

long.zh:
自2015年起，雷克萨斯使用一台基于RC F改装的赛车参加了VLN系列赛和超级跑车系列赛，但这辆车是没有经过认证的特许车辆。凭借这些经验，雷克萨斯继续研发了RC F GT3原型车，并将其用于2016年秋季VLN系列赛的第9轮比赛。在这场比赛中，他们成功赢得了特许车辆的SPX类别冠军。

原型车的最终开发目标是为GT3车队提供一款超级跑车，并以此参加世界各地的比赛。因此，这款车需要让业余车手也能驾驭，并能通过强化部件来提供可靠的性能。在对每一个组件的耐久性进行彻底的计算后，车辆设计进行了全面改动，在保证刚度的前提下减轻了重量，包括前后挡泥板等设计修改则进一步提升了车辆的空气动力学性能。量产版的5升双顶置凸轮轴V8引擎经过调试后，马力超过了<540ps>。这款车最终在2017年通过认证并以雷克萨斯RC F GT3的名称登场。

同年晚些时候，同属于RC F GT3开发团队的瑞士埃米尔弗雷车队也使用此车参加了欧洲GT公开锦标赛，在14场比赛中夺得4场冠军，在赛季车队排行榜上位列第三名。/

In its early testing phase, the car claimed victory in Round 9 of the VLN (Nürburgring Endurance Series). catch.en: This highly refined Lexus RC F coupe competed in the 2016 VLN as a GT3 race car.+
catch.zh: 参与过2016 VLN赛事的Lexus RC F GT3。

vehicleCollection.en:
This highly refined Lexus RC F coupe competed in the 2016 VLN as a GT3 race car.+

When Lexus introduced the RC luxury sports coupe in 2014, it also included a high-performance version in the lineup called the RC F, which served as the foundation for the RC F GT3 race car.

Created to compete in GT3 races around the world, the RC F GT3 was developed at the same time as the production RC F. The original V-8 engine was converted to have a dry sump lubrication system, and displacement was increased to 5.4 liters. Mated to a 6-speed sequential gearbox, the race engine produced <500ps>. Although it looks larger than the production car because of its wider fenders, the RC F GT3 tipped the scales at a lean <1300kg>.

Starting in the 2017 season, the RC F GT3 waged battle in the American IMSA series (GTD category), the European International GT Open series, and the Japanese Super GT series (GT300 class), where it performed admirably.

In the International GT race at Silverstone, the RC F GT3 grabbed its first victory. Then in Japan, it won for the first time in the Super GT series, taking the checkered flag in the second-round race at the Fuji Speedway.

The RC F GT3 prototype represented here is a car that was built for performance evaluation before the RC F GT3 acquired homologation. This car won the ninth race of the VLN (Nürburgring Endurance Series) on October 8, 2016, running without a paint job and its carbon-fiber body fully exposed. The car here, though, wears the livery of Emil Frey Racing, a top Swiss team that competes in the International GT Open.

long.zh:
RC F是雷克萨斯2014年发布的RC豪华双门跑车产品线中的高性能车型。雷克萨斯根据这一车型开发了竞赛车型RC F GT3，用于参加在世界各地所举行的GT3类别的知名赛事。

RC F GT3的立项在这款公路量产车型的开发阶段就已经开始，并与这款公路跑车同步进行开发。竞赛车型将标准款RC F的V8引擎驱动改为了干式油底壳润滑系统，排量也增加到了5.4升，同时采用了6档序列变速箱，最大输出功率达到<500ps>。由于使用了大直径的光面轮胎，所以这辆车还配备了挡泥板，并且尽可能地减轻重量，将整车重量降至<1300kg>。

从2017赛季开始，RC F GT3参加了美国国际汽车运动协会系列赛（GTD类别）、欧洲国际GT公开系列赛以及日本超级跑车（GT300组）赛事，并取得了不俗的成绩。

在国际GT公开系列赛中，这辆车参加的第二场比赛就在银石赛道斩获首胜；在日本，这辆车首次在超级跑车于富士赛道举行的第二轮比赛中获胜。

这里展示的RC F GT3原型车是RC F GT3在获得认证之前，为了评估性能而制造的车型。这辆车于2016年10月8日赢得了纽博格林耐力系列赛的第九轮比赛。当时参赛时，这辆车尚未涂装完毕，碳纤维的表面完全暴露在外。但在这里，车身使用了埃米尔弗雷车队的涂装，埃米尔弗雷车队是一支在国际GT公开赛中参赛的顶尖瑞士车队。

This Lexus RC F competes in Japan's top racing category,
Super GT.

vehicleCollection.en:
This Toyota/Lexus race car competed under joint regulations between the Super GT Series and DTM.

Toyota's weapon of choice for the GT500 class of the Super GT Series from 2014 to 2016 was the race version of the Lexus RC F production car, which was released in October 2014.

Because of new regulations from 2014, the car underwent a several changes to conform to the new rules. The weight and rigidity of the monocoque and center of gravity were altered, while new dampers, brakes and a rear wing were added, making it look like a true DTM machine. Powering the car was a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection (called the RI4AG), which also saw use in Super Formula cars. Because of of a new regulation that limited fuel flow from <100kg/h> to <95kg/h>, improvements were made elsewhere so the car could produce more power with less fuel.

The 2016 model was the final version of this RC F race car, with the au TOM’S RC F wearing the ace car number 36. It placed 3rd in the third race of the season and 2nd in Round 6, ultimately finishing 5th overall out of 15 cars.

long.zh:
代表丰田/雷克萨斯在2014至2016赛季的Super GT系列赛中赢得GT500级别冠军的是雷克萨斯RC F，原型来自2014年上市的量产车。

由于2014年颁布新规定，车辆的单体车壳重量、刚度及重心都接受了调整，以符合德国房车大师赛的规定。避震器、刹车和尾翼也改为符合德国房车大师赛规定的版本。受到新规定的限制，RC F外廓的车身上半部分无法改动，因此只能对下半部分进行重新设计以提高下压力。动力单元是一款2升涡轮增压直列式4缸直喷引擎：RI4AG引擎。这款与Super方程式完全共享的引擎已针对Super GT赛事的使用进行了专项调校。

2016的车型是这款车的最终版本。由于规则限制日益增多，燃油限制器的流量由<100kg/h>降低到了<95kg/h>，车辆接受了进一步改装，以便利用更少的燃料来产生更大的马力。同时还进行了多项其他改进。

雷克萨斯TOM’S车队的36号au TOM’S RC F在第6轮中取得了第2名，在第3轮中则取得了第3名，总成绩位列15辆参赛车辆中的第5位。

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of the highly refined Lexus RC F production coupe was modified for Gr.4.

While German luxury carmakers have traditionally defined the luxury sports coupe market, Lexus decided to join the fray with a svelte version all its own called the RC F. Introduced at the 2014 North American International Auto Show, the RC F is the sportiest entry of the RC line—the letter “F,” which references Fuji Speedway, is added to all of the brand’s high-performance models.

Under the hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, the same powerplant found in the IS F, with new titanium valves, forged connecting rods, newly designed cylinder heads and custom exhaust system. They combine to help the engine produce <456ps>/<53.0kgm>, which is <33ps> and <1.5kgm> more than the IS F. It comes mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission that performs lightning-quick shifts via paddles near the steering wheel.

The Sports Mode of the VDIM, which centrally controls vehicle dynamics, has been refined for the racetrack, and most of the electronic devices have been updated. The RC F features the first torque-vectoring system in the world to be incorporated into a front-engine/rear-wheel drive car. This system allows drivers of all levels to enjoy the RC F’s excellent handling balance and overall performance.

While the RC F’s appearance is similar to that of the base model, Lexus designers incorporated subtle-yet-functional details that help improve performance. These include air outlets on the engine hood and at the rear end of the front fenders. On the trunk is a variable rear spoiler that changes angles automatically according to speed.

With the exception of the limited-edition LFA supercar, the RC F is the sportiest model to ever come from Lexus.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

Under the hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, the same powerplant found in the IS F, with new titanium valves, forged connecting rods, newly designed cylinder heads and custom exhaust system. They combine to help the engine produce <456ps>/<53.0kgm>, which is <33ps> and <1.5kgm> more than the IS F. It comes mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission that performs lightning-quick shifts via paddles near the steering wheel.

The Sports Mode of the VDIM, which centrally controls vehicle dynamics, has been refined for the racetrack, and most of the electronic devices have been updated. long.zh:
RC F是雷克萨斯品牌的高性能双门跑车，发布于2014年的底特律车展。

雷克萨斯在他们的高性能车型名称中使用字母“F”进行标识，代表富士赛道。RC F是对2013年东京车展上发布的RC系列双门跑车大幅度升级后的版本。

引擎基于IS F所采用的5升V8引擎，采用新的钛合金气门、锻造连杆和新设计的气缸盖和排气系统。这款车的输出动力可达到<456ps>/<53.0kgm>，相比原款引擎，马力提高了<33ps>，扭矩提高了<1.5kgm>。同时还配备了带换档拨片的8档自动变速箱。

针对赛道驾驶，该车对控制车辆动力的车辆动态综合管理系统的跑车模式进行了进一步优化。这款车的电子设备得到再次更新，配备了世界首个用于前置引擎、后轮驱动车型的扭矩矢量分配系统。这是因为RC F的一个核心设计理念——让车手和新车手都能享受澎湃的跑车驾驶性能所带来的乐趣。

在外形方面，RC F的轮廓与标准的RC车型相同，但在某些细节上更具视觉冲击力，例如引擎盖和前挡泥板后端的排气口。在车身主体上有一个可调节的后扰流板，能够根据车速自动改变角度。

除了LFA之外，RC F是雷克萨斯史上最动感的车型。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.

The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible
powered by a mighty V-8 engine.

You see them quite often in the U.S.

The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design
studio located in California.

However, this SC430 was mainly conceived
at design studios in Europe.

A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic
upgrades for the 2008 season...

...during which it tore up the high-speed tracks.

在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。

Toyota设计工作室Calty所设计。

然而，这一辆SC430主要是在欧洲的设计工作室中构思完成。

作为日本GT比赛的参赛车辆之一，
其在2008赛季得到了空气动力学升级……

也因此，它在高速赛道上交出了极其出色的答卷。

conversation.en:
Toyota introduced this Lexus SC430 as the successor to...

The 80 Supra for the Super GT racing series.

The 2008 series in which it debuted was a heated contest
right down to the last race!

But when the Petronas Tom’s car crossed the finish line
and took the team title...

It established itself as a champion car
for the history books.

By the way, did you know that the base SC430
was a vario-roof convertible?

To get it battle-ready, Toyota built a reinforced roof
that combined a roll cage and carbon panels...

and fit it over the original.

In other words, the SC430 GT500 is in fact
built upn a coupe body!

参加Super GT赛事的80 Supra推出的继任者。

在这辆车出道的2008年，系列赛的每一场厮杀都十分激烈，
悬念一直留到了决赛！

最终，这辆Petronas Tom’s赛车越过终点线，
为车队夺得了冠军……

自己也作为冠军之车被载入了史册。

顺带一提，你知道SC430的基础车其{是一辆折叠硬顶敞篷车吗？

为了让它能够参赛，丰田专为它打造了以防滚车架
和碳纤维面板制造的强化车顶……

安在原先的车辆上。

换句话说，这辆SC430 GT500_实是基于双门轿跑的车身而打造的！

dialogues.en:
The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.

The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible
powered by a mighty V-8 engine.

You see them quite often in the U.S.

The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design
studio located in California.

However, this SC430 was mainly conceived
at design studios in Europe.

A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic
upgrades for the 2008 season...

...during which it tore up the high-speed tracks.
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.zh:
Lexus SC属于品牌的豪华旅行车系列车型。

其二代车型SC430是由一台强力的V8引擎所驱动的硬顶敞篷车。

在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。

该系列的第一代车型由位于加利福尼亚的
Toyota设计工作室Calty所设计。

然而，这一辆SC430主要是在欧洲的设计工作室中构思完成。

作为日本GT比赛的参赛车辆之一，
其在2008赛季得到了空气动力学升级……

也因此，它在高速赛道上交出了极其出色的答卷。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This Super GT race car competed during the 2008 season. To enhance aerodynamic efficiency, both the front and rear overhangs were extended, and its compact body proved highly effective on high-speed circuits. Although it didn’t claim any outright wins, its consistent performance throughout the season earned enough points to secure the team title.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是一辆曾参加过2008赛季的Super GT赛车。根据前一年度积累的经验，工程师们将它的车头和车尾加长，以有效优化空气动力学性能，而它的紧凑型车身也能在高速赛道上发挥出色。尽管它并没能拿下任何一场比赛的胜利，但确保了整个赛季持续有积分入账，最终赢下了车队冠军头衔。
officialDetails.heroEn: Won the Super GT team title with its stable performance on high-speed circuits.
officialDetails.heroZh: 在高速赛道上的稳定发挥帮助车队赢下了Super GT组别的桂冠。

GT500 class.

This model, the PETRONAS TOM'S SC 430, captured the

vehicleCollection.en:
Won the Super GT team title with its stable performance on high-speed circuits.

In 2008, the Nissan GT-R made its heralded return to the Super GT Series in Japan. As the GT-R made the headlines, Lexus was quietly making significant improvements to its entry in Japan's most popular racing series, the SC430.

The SC430 did not fare well in the Super GT series the previous year, as it was aerodynamically inferior to the competition, the result of a compact body with front and rear overhangs that were too short to provide acceptable levels of downforce. However for 2008, Lexus lengthened the overhangs, giving the car much improved aerodynamics than the previous year. The result was a sleek, fast race car that flourished on high-speed race tracks.

Despite winning only one race during the entire season (at the Fuji International Speedway) by the ZENT CERUMO team, the Lexus SC430 GT machine took home the overall championship, thanks to the consistency of the Petronas TOM's team. The combination of a good long-term strategy and a reliable, fast car proved to be the right formula in winning the series title that year.!

long.en:
In 2008, the Nissan GT-R made its heralded return to the Super GT Series in Japan. As the GT-R made the headlines, Lexus was quietly making significant improvements to its entry in Japan's most popular racing series, the SC430.

The SC430 did not fare well in the Super GT series the previous year, as it was aerodynamically inferior to the competition, the result of a compact body with front and rear overhangs that were too short to provide acceptable levels of downforce. However for 2008, Lexus lengthened the overhangs, giving the car much improved aerodynamics than the previous year. The result was a sleek, fast race car that flourished on high-speed race tracks.

Despite winning only one race during the entire season (at the Fuji International Speedway) by the ZENT CERUMO team, the Lexus SC430 GT machine took home the overall championship, thanks to the consistency of the Petronas TOM's team. The combination of a good long-term strategy and a reliable, fast car proved to be the right formula in winning the series title that year.!
long.zh:
2008年是日本Super GT赛事的一场盛会，日产赶在公开赛事首轮前，帮助日产GT-R全面回归，重返赛场。赛事期间，雷克萨斯仍在继续钻研如何提升SC430。

相比其他参赛车辆，最初的SC430存在一项巨大的缺陷。在超级跑车车辆中，安装于车身底板前后轴的空气动力学套件需要有效产生足够的下压力，而原版SC430相对较短的前后悬间距不足以提供足够的空力效果。

在前几个赛季，SC430的速度表现都不尽如人意。到了2008赛季，在加大了前后悬间距，获得了与对手相当的下压力后，紧凑车身的更小风阻成为了他们的优势。整个赛季当中，他们在多条高速赛道上展现出非凡的速度。

尽管只由森特塞鲁莫车队在富士赛道上取得一胜，但同样使用SC430的马石油汤姆车队最终赢得了当年的车队冠军，并将这台车的高水准研发和稳定的速度留在了赛车历史的史册中。

vehicleCollection.en:
Mazda's dream rotary race car.

The MAZDA RX-VISION is a concept car introduced at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Based on Mazda’s "KODO - Soul of Motion" design theme, the car represented Mazda's attempt to create the most beautiful FR sports car in the company's history. It came powered by the next-generation rotary engine called "SKYACTIV-R."

Back in 1967, Mazda overcame numerous obstacles to produce the first commercial rotary engine in history. It powered the Cosmo Sport and then was fitted to a number of other Mazda cars, including the RX-7, and even those that raced. In 1991, the four-rotor Mazda 787B became the first Japanese car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The MAZDA RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT expresses the design beauty of form following function in a race machine. To meet the performance requirements of the Gr.3 category, the design was inspired by the 787B, specifically the 4-rotor powerplant, now equipped with SKYACTIV technology. This new rotary engine was mounted in a lightweight body to achieve unprecedented performance.

long.zh:
马自达RX-VISION在2015东京车展上以概念车的身份亮相。这台基于马自达的“魂动”设计主题打造的新车旨在挑战自我，创造出最美前置后驱跑车。它还搭载了下一代的转子引擎“创驰蓝天-R”——代表马自达对未来的憧憬。

时间回到1967年，马自达克服了重重技术难关，推出搭载了商用转子引擎的Cosmo Sport。在那之后，作为唯一能够批量生产转子引擎的制造商，他们持之以恒地改进引擎的动力、燃油消耗和耐久性，甚至凭借787B引擎拿下了1991年勒芒24小时耐力赛的最终胜利。

马自达RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT在维持原型车设计美学的基础上，展现了更加凶悍的赛车外观。为了配合组别3级别赛事的性能标准，该车借鉴了787B引擎的设计理念，并采用了经创驰蓝天技术改良的四转子引擎。这款全新的转子引擎搭配轻量化车身，带来空前的性能体验。"

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This machine was created by Mazda Spirit Racing, an initiative launched in 2021 to embody Mazda’s motorsport ambitions. Although derived from the ND Roadster, it has a 2.0-liter block not typically offered on Japanese soft-top models, distinguished by specially developed camshafts, a bespoke cylinder head, forged pistons, and a custom exhaust manifold. This delivers an output of 197.2 HP, a figure that stands near the upper limit of what remains practical in a production car. Additional refinements were made throughout the chassis, drawing upon the wealth of expertise Mazda had accumulated through years of Super Endurance racing.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这台车由MAZDA SPIRIT RACING打造——该项目于2021年启动，旨在展示Mazda的赛车运动实力。虽然基于ND Roadster打造而成，却搭载了日本软顶车型上不常见的2.0升引擎，配备专门设计的凸轮轴、气缸盖、活塞和排气歧管。最终实现200 PS的惊人动力，这一数据已逼近量产车型工程设计的极限。底盘整体调校充分借鉴了公司在超级耐力锦标赛中的丰富经验。

brandCentral.en:
Have you heard of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING? It’s a new brand born
of Mazda’s exceptional achievements in motorsports.

One car that embodied the full extent of Mazda’s racing
expertise was the MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R.

As its name suggested, it was based on the ND Mazda Roadster,
although beneath the surface it was something totally different.

The 2.0-liter engine is a rarity in Japanese soft-tops—featuring
hand-assembled heads and pistons.

In terms of power, it pushed th boundaries of what a
production car could achieve, with <200ps>.

Its chassis was reinforced, the suspension used height-adjustable
Bilstein dampers, and the brakes supplied by Brembo.

Alas, production was limited to just 200 units. A true works-tned
roadster, it was a rare and shining gem.
brandCentral.zh:
你听说过MAZDA SPIRIT RACING吗？
这个全新品牌源自Mazda在赛车领域的非凡成就。

MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R正是一款
凝聚了Mazda所有赛车技术的集大成之作。

顾名思义，它基于ND Mazda Roadster打造，
但其内部构造却焕然一新。

这台2升引擎在日本敞篷跑车中极为罕见，
配备特制气缸盖和活塞，全部由手工组装。

在动力性能方面，它将量产车规格推向极致，
可爆发出<200ps>的强劲动力。

底盘刚性十足，悬挂采用高度可调的Bilstein减震器，
刹车系统则来自Brembo制造。

遗憾的是产量仅限200台！
相信我，这款经过厂队调校的敞篷跑车堪称稀世珍品！

vehicleCollection.en:
With only 200 units ever produced, this is the ultimate works-tuned roadster.!

“MAZDA SPIRIT RACING” was an initiative launched by Mazda to cement the company’s place in motorsports and to cultivate new talent through racing. Competing in events such as the Super Endurance Series with a large crew made up of Mazda employees, it grew into a formidable presence in the sport.

From this foundation, the team created a car that embodied the skills and knowledge it had gained through years of competition. That car was unveiled as the “MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R” in early 2025 at the Tokyo Auto Salon.

As its name suggested, it was based on the ND Mazda Roadster. But beneath the familiar silhouette, it was packed with works-grade components.

The centerpiece was its engine, built on a 2.0-liter block not normally offered in the domestic soft-top model, enhanced with a specially tuned head, pistons, and exhaust manifold among other components, each unit painstakingly assembled by hand. The power had been pushed close to the very limit of what was achievable in a production car that also demanded durability, ultimately delivering <200ps>.

Its chassis reflected the lessons learned from the Super Endurance Series. Among them was the suspension that used height-adjustable Bilstein dampers, while the brakes were equipped with 4-piston calipers from Brembo. It featured forged Rays wheels, identical to those used on race cars.

Other special parts included Recaro seats and a Fujitsubo exhaust system. With production capped at just 200 units, the ROADSTER 12R stood as perhaps the ultimate works-tuned roadster._

“马自达灵魂车队”是马自达为确立品牌在赛车领域的地位，并通过赛车培养新兴人才的一个项目。通过组织公司员工组成庞大的团队参加如超级耐力锦标赛等赛事，马自达灵魂车队逐渐成长为赛车界不容忽视的存在。

团队将把在赛车中积累的所有技能与知识，融入到一款全新车型的设计之中。这款“马自达灵魂车队ROADSTER 12R”于2025年初在东京汽车沙龙迎来首秀。

顾名思义，这台车基于ND Mazda Roadster打造而成。可以说，这辆车满载了官方车队使用的各类部件的精华。

其核心亮点在于引擎：采用了日本国内市场敞篷版车型鲜少配备的2升缸体，并增配了专门调校的气缸盖、活塞及排气歧管等部件，且每台引擎均采用手工组装。在确保部件耐受性的前提下，这款量产车的功率输出已逼近理论极限，最终达到<200ps>。

底盘设计充分参考了车队在超级耐力锦标赛中汲取的丰富经验。例如，悬挂采用了倍适登特别调校的可调高度减震器，刹车则是一套布雷博四活塞卡钳。莱耶斯锻造轮毂与赛车同款。

其他特殊零部件更是不胜枚举，如瑞卡罗桶椅和藤壶排气。该车限量生产200台，堪称是一台经过官方调校的终极敞篷跑车。

conversation.en:
I actually drive this MAZDA3 race car
in Japan’s Super Taikyu Series.

Naturally, the MAZDA3 was a production model first, but it
was also designed with racing in mind.

When it came to the racing variant, I tried to retain as much
of the original’s form as possible.

My aim of preserving the beauty and silhouette of the car
extended to the livery.

I also wanted to ensure that it looked good on the track.

I achieved this by giving it a wide rear axle, the kind
expected of a Super Taikyu car.

As a result, it looks very striking when overtaking.

So if you ever meet me on the track, be sure to let me
by, andyo'l see why!
conversation.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
conversation.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
conversation.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
conversation.zh:
我跟你讲，我在日本超级耐力系列赛中可是真开过这辆
马自达3赛车哦！

马自达3本身是款普通的量产车型，不过我们设计的时候
就已经考虑到了它未来可能会上赛道。

所以在打造赛车版本的时候，我们尽量保留了原版的帅
气造型。

不光是车身轮廓线条，连车身涂装我们都精心设计，
就是想让它保持原车的美感。

当然啦，我们也得让它在赛道上看起来够劲儿。

怎么做到的？我们给它装上了更宽的后轮轴，也是超级
耐力赛车的标配。

效果太棒了，尤其是超车的时候，那叫一个帅气！

所以呢，要是哪天你在赛道上碰cT我，可得|让。
然后你就知道它的超车有多帅气了！

vehicleCollection.en:
Exploring the potential of internal combustion, a next-generation bio-diesel-powered race car.

This MAZDA3 Gr. 4, featured here, is a Gran Turismo original model, aesthetically based on the Super Taikyu spec. MAZDA3 Bio concept.

The MAZDA3 Bio concept car is a next-generation, bio-diesel-powered race car, created for real-world testing in the 2023 Super Taikyu endurance race series.

It is the spiritual successor to Mazda’s Bio concept Demio, also known as the MAZDA2 Bio concept, which was created in 2021 with the dual pursuit of achieving carbon neutrality and preserving the joy of driving. Both vehicles participated in the ST-Q class, a category almost exclusively reserved for manufacturer development prototypes.

The car ran on 100-percent next-generation bio-diesel fuel refined from used cooking oil. Under the hood was a 2.2-liter SkyActiv-D diesel engine.

The car itself went through extensive modifications. To reduce weight, components such as the engine hood and roof were crafted from hybrid materials that combine carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) with natural fibers. Aerodynamic efficiency was enhanced through wider front and rear fenders, while new aero components, including a front spoiler, rear wing, and side skirts, were added to further optimize performance.

这款马自达3组别4赛车，如图所示，是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，其外观借鉴了日本超级耐力赛规格的马自达3 Bio赛车。

其原型车马自达3 Bio concept是新一代采用生物柴油供能的赛车，该项目的立项与开发是为了实际参与2023年的日本超级耐力赛。

它也是马自达Bio concept Demio/马自达2 Bio concept概念车的后继者。两台生物柴油概念车自2021年起便开始参加超级耐力赛ST-Q组别（专为各家厂商的技术开发中车型设置）的比赛，意图在“碳中和”以及“提升娱乐性”中寻找到恰到好处的平衡点。

该车使用的生物柴油完全由废弃食用油制备。车型搭载的是一台2.2L 创驰蓝天-D引擎。

作为赛车，改装自然必不可少。为了减重，引擎盖和车顶等部位均应用了由碳纤维复合材料和天然纤维打造的复合型材料。而为了提高空气动力学性能，车身的前后轮挡泥板都相应加宽，并装上了前扰流板、尾翼和侧裙。

conversation.en:
If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t
go wrong with the MAZDA3.

The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback
and a 4-door sedan.

That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts
is proof of their purposeful design.

Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful
that Mazda went and marketed it as a ‘fastback’.

What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a
‘burgundy selection’ grade!

From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this
grade is done up in a most distinctive shade of red.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
如果你想要找一辆外观时尚的掀背车，选MAZDA3准没错！

MAZDA3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。

尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。

以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而Mazda
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。

另外，这款MAZDA3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！

从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。

in its C-segment.

A personal favourite of mine, it is a car that will surely
go down in history.
#

它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。

我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。

而马自达3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。

我个人很喜欢马自达3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！

dialogues.en:
If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t
go wrong with the MAZDA3.

The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback
and a 4-door sedan.

That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts
is proof of their purposeful design.

Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful
that Mazda went and marketed it as a ‘fastback’.

What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a
‘burgundy selection’ grade!

From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this
grade is done up in a most distinctive shade of red.
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.zh:
如果你想要找一辆外观时尚的掀背车，选MAZDA3准没错！

MAZDA3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。

尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。

以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而Mazda
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。

另外，这款MAZDA3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！

从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。

dialogues.en:
The MAZDA3 is among the five most defining cars
of my career.

Its design dates back to the RX-VISION.

With the RX-VISION, I created a form that ‘came alive’
through its beautiful reflective surfaces.

The MAZDA3 echoes the RX-VISION’s form
in its C-segment.

A personal favourite of mine, it is a car that will surely
go down in history.
#
dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
dialogues.zh:
马自达3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。

它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。

我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。

而马自达3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。

我个人很喜欢马自达3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The fourth-generation MAZDA3 made its debut in 2018. A standout addition to the lineup was the mild hybrid M Hybrid, which gained global attention for its SKYACTIV-X engine, utilizing spark-controlled compression ignition. The X Burgundy Selection is a limited-edition variant based on the X grade, featuring the advanced SKYACTIV-X powertrain paired with a rich burgundy interior, offering a mature sense of elegance.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第四代MAZDA3于2018年正式发布。随后推出的轻混动力“M Hybrid”车型搭载采用火花控制压燃技术的“SKYACTIV-X”引擎，引起全球瞩目。这款“X Burgundy Selection”限量版基于搭载SKYACTIV-X引擎的X级别车型打造，酒红色内饰营造出成熟典雅的氛围。
officialDetails.heroEn: An elegant fastback with a revolutionary combustion system.
officialDetails.heroZh: 采用了革命性的新引擎、外观优雅的斜背车。

brandCentral.en:
This MAZDA3 fastback is especially prized
for its beautiful design.

In Japan, it has long been referred to as the Axela.

But ever since the debut of this fourth-gen model in 2018,
it has been known around the world as the MAZDA3.

Distinguished by its phenomenal styling, which adopts Mazda’s
"KODO" design language...

...this hatchback, with its beautiful roof line,
is referred to as a fastback in some markets.

In 2020, it won the World Car Design of the Year title,
an award celebrating the best international car design.
brandCentral.zh:
斜背版MAZDA3因其靓丽的设计造型而深受消费者喜爱。

在日本，这辆车被称为“Axela”（昂克赛拉）。

不过随着第4代型号于2018年亮相，它在全世界
打响了“MAZDA3”这个名号。

它那现象级的外观设计充分体现了Mazda的“魂动”
设计语言，优雅而独树一帜……

这款掀背车拥有美妙的车顶线条，并以“斜背车”的身份
在部分市场展开宣传。

在2020年，这款车赢得了国际性的汽车设计奖项——
世界汽车年度最佳设计大奖。

catch.zh: 采用了革命性的新引擎、外观优雅的斜背车。

vehicleCollection.en:
An elegant fastback with a revolutionary combustion system.

This MAZDA3 represents the fourth-generation model of Mazda's C-segment passenger car first released in November 2018. Back then, it was called the Axela in Japan, but with this model, it went by the moniker "MAZDA3" all around the world.

Like its predecessor, this MAZDA3 came in both fastback and sedan versions, but thanks to the company's "KODO" design language, the character of the car became more refined. The shape of the fastback was especially impressive, with the delicate form of the body panels beautifully expressing the subtle transition of light.

Powering the car was a new SKYACTIV engine. The base MAZDA3 models came with a 1.5-liter and 2.0-liter direct injection gasoline engines. There was a 1.8-liter turbo diesel powerplant and a 2.0-liter "Mild-Hybrid" (M-Hybrid) version that came a little later. The M-Hybrid was powered by the SKYACTIV-X engine that introduced proprietary spark-controlled compression ignition, a revolutionary technology that suppressed carbon emissions without relying on expensive solutions like the Urea-SCR.

The X Burgundy Selection was a special model with a burgundy interior on the Grade X model. Equipped with wine-colored leather seats and dashboard, this special model exuded a classy, uniquely mature aura.

马自达3于2018年11月上市，是马自达推出的第四代C级乘用车，其前代型号在日本也被称为昂克赛拉。这辆第四代型号是马自达全新一代产品中的第一款车，因此在全球范围内统一使用了“马自达3”的名字。

如之前型号一样，它也提供斜背和轿车两种车型，不过在马自达“魂动”设计语言的加持下，每种车型的特征都更加鲜明。它的斜背车型尤为引人注目，车身板件的精妙轮廓反映出了美轮美奂的光线变幻。

为这辆车提供动力的引擎源自马自达的新一代创驰蓝天引擎。主力型号包括1.5升和2升直喷汽油引擎款和1.8升柴油涡轮增压引擎款，之后又推出了一款2升“轻度混合动力”（M-Hybrid）型号，由一台创驰蓝天-X引擎供能。这款引擎引入了独家专利的火花控制压缩点火技术，而且这款革命性的引擎无需采用像Urea-SCR那样昂贵的解决方案便能够抑制氮氧化合物（NOx）输出。

这辆X Burgundy Selection是一款基于Grade X型号、采用了勃艮第红配色内饰的特殊型号。它的酒红色真皮座椅和仪表板彰显出了优雅的格调和成熟的韵味。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This Vision Gran Turismo represents a MINI built purely for racing. Weighing just 2315 lbs and producing 389.5 HP, it launches from zero to 62.1 mph in a mere 3.5 seconds. Power is sent to all four wheels. Its low-slung silhouette—with the wheels pushed to the very edges—delivers the signature go-kart-like handling MINIs are known for. The result is an exhilarating, track-ready driving experience.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款Vision Gran Turismo车型向我们展示了专为竞速打造的Mini会是什么样的。它拥有1,050 公斤的超轻量车身和395 PS的动力性能，在仅仅3.5秒内完成0-100 公里/小时的加速。其传动系统会向全部四个车轮输出动力。它的车身轮廓极低，几乎像是俯卧在地面上，四个车轮也已经向两侧外扩到了极限，这样的设计让它实现了类似卡丁车的极致操控性能，这也是Mini品牌赖以闻名的特点，更为驾驶者提供了无与伦比的驾驶体验。
officialDetails.heroEn: A race spec Clubman able to reach 0-62.1 mph in just 3.5 seconds, with a top speed of 180.2 mph.
officialDetails.heroZh: 竞赛配置的Clubman，从0到100 公里/小时加速仅需3.5秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。

brandCentral.en:
If I had to describe the Mini Clubman Vision Gran Turismo
in simple terms, it would be "battle-ready."

The car sits much wider and lower to the ground than the
classic model, looking ready to attack the race track.

Indeed, that's what it was created to do. Maximum performance
is ensured with lots of aerodynamic features.

And it's lightweight. It tips the scales at <1050kg> and comes
powered by an impressive engine that produces <400ps>.

Also, its full-time 4WD drivetrain provides plenty
of stability.
brandCentral.zh:
如果要用一个词来形容MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo，我会用
“蓄势待发”来形容！

此车带有MINI的标志性设计，但比经典车型更宽，离地间
隙更低。

这是因为此车是为赛道设计的，具备扁平化底板等空气
动力学特性。

其<1050kg>的轻盈车身由一台可提供约<400ps>动力的强劲引擎驱动……

而全时四驱系统则负责提供充足的稳定性。

catch.zh: 竞赛配置的Clubman，从0到100 公里/小时加速仅需3.5秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。

vehicleCollection.en:
A race spec Clubman able to reach 0-<100km/h> in just 3.5 seconds, with a top speed of <290km/h>.

The MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo, created from the inspiration of the MINI's success in motorsports, was designed strictly for the track. It's powered by a <395ps> engine that sends this <1050kg> vehicle from zero to <100km/h> in a mere 3.5 seconds. Top speed is rated at <290km/h>, with the right gear ratios. Power is transferred to all four wheels via a 6-speed sequential race gearbox. The suspension system consists of McPherson struts in the front and HA3 dampers at the rear, all of which are fully adjustable and ensure excellent cornering ability.

The MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo sits low to the ground, with the wheels positioned outside the body, resulting in go-kart-like agility. Adjustable carbon diffusers are placed in the front and rear, while large vents behind the wheel arches regulate air flow to cool the engine and brakes. The split rear spoiler and fully enclosed underbody enhance the sophisticated aerodynamics.

The car MINI design has familiar touches, such as the hexagonal front grille, elliptical headlights with implied racing-design stickers, and rally stripes on the hood and roof. Quick release hinges on the hood and tank and the small sliding window on the side reveal that this is not your oridinary performance car.

long.zh:
在MINI的传奇赛车运动历史的启发下，MINI的设计团队打造了全新的MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo：一款为竞赛而生的MINI精品。MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的轻量级车身仅重<1050kg>，高达<395ps>的动力可以在3.5秒内完成0到<100km/h>加速。全时四驱和竞赛级6档序列式变速箱确保该车的最佳动力传动。前轮的麦弗逊减震器和后轮的HA3减震器有多档可调，能完美适应任何路况。根据齿轮传动比（根据每条赛道特别调校）而定，Clubman最高可以达到<290km/h>的时速。

MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo那充满个性的轮廓在路面上驰骋，四个车轮置于车身外远端，让车辆的操控像卡丁车一般。车身前部和后部的可调式碳纤维扰流翼和轮拱后方的大型通风口可以控制气流，为引擎和制动器提供冷却。而其后扰流板和全封闭的底部也加强了车身的空气动力学性能。

这款MINI的设计特点，例如扁平六边形的前进气格栅，装饰有含蓄赛车风格贴纸的椭圆形大灯，以及引擎盖上的拉力条纹都清晰地表现了MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的赛车运动设计思路。引擎盖、油箱和侧窗上的快开铰链更是为MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的经典外形加上了画龙点睛的一笔。

conversation.en:
Without a doubt, the Mini is one of the world's
most popular compact cars.

It was introduced in Britain in 1959.

Its outward appearance was left largely unchanged
over the course of its 40-year production history.

In 2001, it was reborn in the form of the next-generation Mini
we see here.

Although double the size of its classic predecessor,
its handling and styling were pure Mini.

Although the original Mini was British, these modern iterations
were actually developed by BMW.

The German manufacturer did a commendable job
maintaining the spirit of the original car.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
Mini毋庸置疑是全世界最畅销的车型之一。

1959年在英国问世……

经过长达40年的生产历史，
外观大体未变。

直到2001年才推出新一代Mini，
也就是我们目前见到的这一款。

尽管尺寸上比历史悠久的前代车型大了两倍，
其操控性和风格仍维持地道的Mini水准。

Mini本是英国车，但其新一代车型出自BMW之手。

制造商的变动，在其响应迅速的转向及
卓越的刚性上得到淋漓尽致的体现。

conversation.en:
Stylistically and proportionately, the 2005 MINI Cooper S
is the best of its breed!

I loved these when they first came out, and I still
love them to this day!

Note the minimal overhang and simple profile,
the low beltline and all-around visibility.

All of the car’s horizontal lines were drawn
in parallel to each other.

These were the days when the MINI designers
seemed to have more vision!

These cars looked amazing in a variety of livery,
roof colours and decals.

Then there was that round central screen inside.

Ah yes, the MINI just screamed fun!
|

dialogues.en:
Without a doubt, the Mini is one of the world's
most popular compact cars.

It was introduced in Britain in 1959.

Its outward appearance was left largely unchanged
over the course of its 40-year production history.

In 2001, it was reborn in the form of the next-generation Mini
we see here.

Although double the size of its classic predecessor,
its handling and styling were pure Mini.

Although the original Mini was British, these modern iterations
were actually developed by BMW.

The German manufacturer did a commendable job
maintaining the spirit of the original car.
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.zh:
Mini毋庸置疑是全世界最畅销的车型之一。

1959年在英国问世……

经过长达40年的生产历史，
外观大体未变。

直到2001年才推出新一代Mini，
也就是我们目前见到的这一款。

尽管尺寸上比历史悠久的前代车型大了两倍，
其操控性和风格仍维持地道的Mini水准。

Mini本是英国车，但其新一代车型出自BMW之手。

制造商的变动，在其响应迅速的转向及
卓越的刚性上得到淋漓尽致的体现。
F

dialogues.en:
Stylistically and proportionately, the 2005 MINI Cooper S
is the best of its breed!

I loved these when they first came out, and I still
love them to this day!

Note the minimal overhang and simple profile,
the low beltline and all-around visibility.

All of the car’s horizontal lines were drawn
in parallel to each other.

These were the days when the MINI designers
seemed to have more vision!

These cars looked amazing in a variety of livery,
roof colours and decals.

Then there was that round central screen inside.

Ah yes, the MINI just screamed fun!
|

vehicleCollection.en:
This hopped-up MINI Cooper S featured a supercharged engine.

In the latter half of the 1990s, famed sports car manufacturer BMW purchased the branding and manufacturing rights to the MINI brand and resurrected the MINI Cooper in 2001.

This new MINI was a bit larger than the classic model of yesteryear, measuring <3655mm>, <1690mm> and <1455mm>, overall length, width and height, respectively. But BMW kept the car's spirit intact, thanks to quirky styling cues that were reminiscent of the original 1959 model. These included a "cute" face, highlighted by large round headlights and a square front grille and boxy silhouette.

The performance-oriented version in the new MINI lineup was the Cooper S. The power plant in the standard MINI was the "Pentagon," a 1.6-liter SOHC inline-4 developed in cooperation between BMW and Chrysler, while the Cooper S got an intercooled supercharger bolted on to its power plant—the large air intake on the model's hood being a dead giveaway of forced induction.

The supercharger accounted for an additional <54ps> and <7.26kgm> of torque over the stock engine, for a grand total of <170ps> and <22.45kgm>. It came mated to a slick-shifting 6-speed manual gearbox. This made the Cooper S one of the most fun to drive FF (Front drive, Front engine) compact cars in the marketplace.

It was a testament to the German company that effectively instilled the car's British heritage into the new MINI Cooper.

归入宝马旗下的新MINI长<3655mm>、宽<1690mm>、高<1495mm>，车身比原来的MINI足足大了两倍。无论是更大尺寸的头灯、特色鲜明的前格栅，还是拱起的车轮罩等元素，无不体现出对1959年原型车款的致敬和传承，一眼便能认出是MINI的正统继承者。

新MINI系列最热销的车型当属Cooper S。MINI的动力核心是一台1.6升顶置单凸轮轴Pentagon直列4缸引擎，由宝马和克莱斯勒共同研发。而Cooper S车型还加装了中冷机械增压，看到它引擎盖上巨大的进气口便不难猜到。机械增压为Cooper S额外带来了<54ps>和<7.26kgm>扭矩，总计可输出<170ps>和<22.45kgm>扭矩，再搭配上特制的6速手动变速箱，这台小车满载着驾驶的乐趣。

vehicleCollection.en:
A beautiful streamlined 2-seat sports car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy

Every August in the U.S., the world’s most stunning automobiles from across automotive history gather for the prestigious Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. In 2014, the Gran Turismo Trophy—just one of the many coveted awards—was claimed by this Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder, chassis No. 2078.

The A6 nameplate referred to a series of 6-cylinder race cars Maserati developed between 1947 and 1956. The GCS variant was built for sports car championship competition and initially took the form of a two-seat version of the classic cigar-shaped Grand Prix racers. But in 1953, following a shift in regulations, coachbuilders began to craft their own bodies for the car’s tubular frame.

Chassis No. 2078 was one such creation, graced with an elegant Spyder body penned by Carrozzeria Fantuzzi. Its <170ps> engine came from none other than Gioachino Colombo. During the 1954 season, this car competed as part of the Maserati works team, racking up five class wins and three overall victories.

每年八月，世界汽车史上最优美的车辆都会齐聚美国，参加举世闻名的圆石滩经典车展。车展中会颁出诸多奖项，超级跑车奖杯就是其中之一。2014年的获奖者就是这辆玛莎拉蒂A6GCS/53 Spyder，底盘号2078。

A6是玛莎拉蒂在1947到1956年期间开发的6缸赛车系列的代号。这款GCS原本是用于参加运动赛车赛事的，所以最初的外形设计类似于大奖赛赛车的经典雪茄型，但改成了双座版本。不过由于1953年的赛事规则变化，各家车厂纷纷开始改用管式框架打造赛车。

这辆底盘号2078的玛莎拉蒂采用了由凡图奇车身制造公司打造的优雅敞篷车身。其<170ps>的引擎则由乔亚基诺·科伦坡打造。这辆车代表玛莎拉蒂厂队出战了1954赛季，总共拿下了6个组别冠军和3次总成绩第一。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This was the high-performance variant of the GranTurismo, introduced at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show. Its DOHC V-8 engine had its displacement increased to 4.7 liters, while the transmission and rear differential were integrated into a transaxle layout. It also became the first in the series to adopt the two-pedal semi-automatic MC Shift system.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是2008年日内瓦车展上推出的GranTurismo高性能版本。V8双顶置凸轮轴引擎的排量扩容至4.7升，变速箱和后限滑差速器被整合进一个变速驱动桥单元中。它也是该系列中首款使用双踏板半自动“MC Shift”系统的车型。
officialDetails.heroEn: True to its Italian heritage, this grand tourer was defined by class, performance and elegance.
officialDetails.heroZh: 传统杰作，强大的赛车性能隐藏在并不明显的外观之下。

brandCentral.en:
The sports coupé is an iconic Maserati offering...

And this GranTurismo S was specifically built
to be a high-performance variant.

Not only has its engine displacement been increased
to produce more power and torque...

But it also features a transaxle layout, achieved
by altering the placement of the transmission.

Endowed with both style and substance, this is a car that
definitely means business.
brandCentral.zh:
这款运动型双门跑车极具Maserati的标志性风格……

而这台GranTurismo S是专门以高性能车型为目标的型号。

不仅增加了引擎排量以产生更大的功率和扭矩……

而且还特意改变变速箱的位置，采用了跨轴传动布局。

这是一台风格和内涵兼具，拥有绝对实力的车。

Maserati has long represented the standard for luxury Italian
sports cars.

the company's best qualities.

Its sweet-sounding V-8 was assembled by Ferrari...

Also, allow me to point out that the transmission was moved

vehicleCollection.en:
True to its Italian heritage, this grand tourer was defined by class, performance and elegance.

Maserati's GranTurismo S, not to be confused with this driving simulator of the same name, was unveiled at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show as the high-performance version of Maserati's handsome GranTurismo Coupe.

Although there wasn't much that visually separated the two cars, there were significant differences under the sheet metal; the most noteworthy of which being the drivetrain. For starters, the displacement of the DOHC V8 in the GranTurismo S was increased to <4691cc>, <500cc> more than in the base car. Combined with this revitalized engine was a state-of-the-art semi-automatic gearbox dubbed "MC Shift." MC Shift allowed drivers the choice between a smooth-shifting automatic transmission befitting a pure luxury car and a quick-shifting sequential manual where shifting is performed via paddles on the steering wheel.

And because it was a transaxle (with the gearbox mounted on the rear differential), the front/rear weight distribution was drastically improved, making the GranTurismo S a better handling machine.

Despite the two cars looking virtually identical, the GranTurismo S possessed a more athletic nature than the base car, while still delivering the luxury and elegance that has made the marque famous for nearly 100 years.

long.zh:
在2008年日内瓦车展官宣的跑车浪漫旅S是玛莎拉蒂伟大旅行的高性能版本。与标准版本相比，最大的两处差异在于专属引擎的引入和传动系统的改变。

跑车浪漫旅S的双顶置凸轮轴V8引擎排量高达<4691cc>，比标准车款高出<500cc>之多。双踏板半自动变速箱“MC Shift”也是首次用于该系列。相较而言，最让人动容的当属传动系统的改变，驱动桥的布局改头换面，变速箱后移与后限滑差速器整合在了一起。除此之外，这款车型以赛车为标准打造，因此前后车身配重也与标准版本截然不同。

外观方面，跑车浪漫旅S的唯二不同落在大一寸的轮毂和熏黑头灯上，内饰方面则延续了玛莎拉蒂品牌一贯的优良传统。当超高品质的GT车型遇上极致赛车性能，跑车浪漫旅S让全世界的爱车人士都对它心驰神往。

The Maserati MC20 is a mid-engine sports car from 2020.

The letters in its name stand for "Maserati" and "Corse,"
meaning "race," along with its introduction year.

You can think of it as a successor to the MC12, that legend
built to compete at the 2004 FIA GT Championship.

Since its founding in the early-20th century, Maserati has
been known for its race cars.

From F1 machines like the250F to sports cars like the
A6GCS, there is no limits to the company's achievements.

Now, while Maserati hasn’t been racing much
these days...

...this MC20-based machine marked its glorious return
to the track!

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This marked Maserati’s first mid-engine sports car in 15 years, following the MC12. Designed with Dallara, the streamlined body was engineered to generate significant downforce without relying heavily on external aerodynamic elements. At its core was a lightweight carbon monocoque chassis weighing less than 220 lbs, paired with a newly developed twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine, featuring F1–inspired pre-chamber combustion.

Its twin-turbo V-6 engine features an F1-derived

Not only does it offer a smooth ride on city streets,
but it can hold its own on any race track.!

它的双涡轮增压V6引擎采用了源于F1的预燃室点火技术！

不仅在城市道路上能够提供顺畅的驾驶体验，在任何赛道上
也能游刃有余。

vehicleCollection.en:
A special super car that embodies the tradition and passion of Maserati.

The MC20 is a mid-engine supercar introduced by Maserati in 2020. The Italian company is widely known for its elegant and masterfully constructed high-performance GT cars. The MC20 is the first mid-engine model in the company's road car lineup since the discontinuation of the MC12 in 2005.

With its scissor-type doors, the body is elegant and clean. It's seemingly devoid of aggressive aerodynamic add-ons, such as a large rear wing or a radical front splitter, but that is because this car doesn't need them. Developed by race-car constructor Dallara, this Maserati body underwent rigorous wind-tunnel testing from the beginning, so the use of overt downforce-induing parts was not necessary.

At its foundation is a carbon monocoque that apparently weighs as little as <100kg>. Keeping the car lightweight was a priority for Maserati, and the engineers were able to keep curb weight down to less than <1500kg>.

The newly developed twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine features the first F1-style pre-chamber combustion system used in a production car. It produces <630ps> and 730 Nm (<74.5kgm>) torque. Combined with an 8-speed DCT transmission, the MC20 can accelerate from 0 to <100km/h> in under 2.9 seconds and reach a top speed of more than <325km/h>.

MC20是玛莎拉蒂在2020年宣布推出的一款中置引擎超级跑车。提起玛莎拉蒂，首先让人想起的便是其在前置及后置引擎高性能GT跑车上炉火纯青且不失优雅的工艺。而MC20则是该厂自2005年MC12停产后15年来推出的第一辆中置引擎公路跑车。

乍一看，这辆有着蝶翼门的跑车似乎并没有任何明显的空气动力学套件，这是因为它那由跑车制造商达拉拉借助严谨的风洞测试设计制造出的外壳，巧妙的造型已经能够在不借助任何诸如扰流板的空气动力学组件的情况下，就产生足够的下压力。

该车采用了碳纤维单体车壳结构，外壳自重仅<100kg>。另外，在整车的各个区域都应用了轻量化措施，将整车总重降到了<1500kg>以下。

玛莎拉蒂最新研发的3升、V6双涡轮增压引擎使得MC20成为了第一台应用了F1式预燃室技术的量产车型。这台引擎可以提供最高<630ps>的动力与730 牛·米（<74.5kgm>）的扭矩。结合其8速双离合变速箱，MC20可以在短短2.9秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，且据称最高速度可达超过<325km/h>。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This mid-engine sports car made its debut in 1972 as the sister to the Bora. While the Bora was equipped with a V-8, the Merak utilized a smaller 3.0-liter V-6 sourced from the Citroën SM, allowing a 2+2 seating layout by making use of the extra space freed up in the rear. The SS was a high-performance variant introduced in 1975. By increasing the engine’s compression ratio, output was boosted, raising the top speed from 139.8 mph to 155.3 mph.

collection.en:
The Maserati Merak is a fine example of a
beautiful mid-engine supercar from the 1970s.

It was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro, who
began at FIAT in 1955, then worked at...

...Bertone for six years, and later at Ghia until 1968.

He subsequently established "Italdesign," a design firm
that would create many masterpieces.

The Maserati Merak was created during
Giugiaro’s early Italdesign days.

This stunning new Maserati was introduced at
the 1972 Paris Motor Show.

The Mrak SS is the lighter and more
powerful model that made its debut in 1975.

This 1980 model is powered by a <220ps> version
of the V-6 shared with the Citroën-Maserati SM.

Although the striking Merak has a mid-mounted
engine, it is actually a 22 with small rear seats...

...which is very rare for an exotic high-peormance car.

usedCar.en:
Many consider the Maserati Merak as one of the most beautiful
mid-engine supercars of the 1970s.

Introduced in 1975, the Merak SS was the high-performance
grade in the lineup.

This 1980 version of the SS came with a <220ps> V-6 engine.

And, it was true 2+2, meaning although it was a 2-door,
it came with rear seats.

The elegant lines of the car still look fresh today, a testament
to the genius of Giorgetto Giugiaro, who designed the car.

vehicleCollection.en:
This high-output model of the Merak has been tuned for even sharper performance.+

The Maserati Merak, a mid-engine sports car introduced in 1972, was developed as a sister model to the Bora that came out the previous year. Both vehicles shared the same basic exterior styling, penned by renown designer Giugiaro; however, the rear ends were noticeably different, as the Bora was a fastback, while the Merak was a notchback with a fastback-style pillar.

The engines of the two cars were also different. Where the Bora had a rumbling V-8 in its engine bay, the Merak featured a <190ps> 3.0-liter V-6 borrowed from the Citroën SM, thus allowing the Merak to adopt a 2+2 layout and boast more luggage space.

In 1975, a high-performance version of the Merak was offered, called the Merak SS, which came equipped with a <220ps> engine that increased the car's top speed from <225km/h> to <250km/h>.

long.zh:
玛莎拉蒂Merak是1972年推出的一款中置引擎跑车。此车是作为一年前亮相的博拉的姐妹车型而开发的。

该车的车身也是由乔治亚罗设计的。所以外观风格与博拉一脉相承。不过，博拉是一款溜背车，而Merak却是一款带有溜背车后柱的掀背车款。这也使得此车能够在保留相同外轮廓的同时，给人以更轻盈的感受。引擎冷却有所改善。

博拉采用的是一台V8引擎，而为Merak配备的是来自雪铁龙SM的3升V6引擎，可以带来<190ps>。搭载了这台更紧凑的引擎，座位布局也相应变为2+2，从而为行李厢腾出了空间。

在1975年，高性能版本的Merak SS面世了。压缩比优化及其他调整将引擎的动力输出提高到了<220ps>，而极速也从<225km/h>提高到<250km/h>。

conversation.en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.

There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz,
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.

To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.

Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...

Until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
A dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.

To this day, I haven't forgotten the famous green
and red livery of that race machine.<next id=1900306 type=

conversation.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
conversation.zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，
但全新的Peugeot 905也在其列。

此外，在发车格上还有各品牌常年出战的高性能赛车，
如Mercedes-Benz、Jaguar和Porsche等等。

Mazda派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。

在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……

……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。

时至今日，我依然无法忘怀那部比赛机器
的橙绿色涂装。<next id=1900306 typ=9A

making them ill-suited for endurance races.”

At least, this is what people in the racing world had believed.

But the engineers at Mazda took a different view.

So, they got together and created the R26B engine,
which emphasized horsepower over torque.

and fuel-efficient engine.

at Le Mans in 1991.

the final three stints...

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
“转子引擎的油耗高得吓人，所以不适合耐力赛。”

赛车界曾是这样看待转子引擎的。

但是马自达的工程师们却不这么认为！

他们努力的结晶便是将重点放在马力上，
而不是扭矩上的R26B引擎。

这项明智的决定使这台引擎不仅可靠，而且省油。

这台传奇的发动机就装在了这台787B上。

于1991年q它成为了第一台在勒芒夺冠的日本车。

不幸的是，约翰尼·赫伯特在开完最后三段后……

由于严重脱水，无法站上领奖台。

赛后，当马自W的工程师将引擎拆开时，
他们发现这台引擎还能再跑<50ۏm>！
