officialDetails.descriptionEn: Mazda’s 787B completed the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans without a single mechanical issue, making history as the first Japanese manufacturer to secure an overall win at the event. Mazda, which had entered Le Mans with rotary engines beginning in 1974, developed the 787 as its final bid for rotary-powered victory, before regulations would turn against such powertrains. Although the effort fell short at the 1990 race, the 787 underwent extensive revisions and emerged as the 787B.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1991年，787B成为日本制造商中首台在勒芒24小时耐力赛获得总冠军的赛车，并且全程未出现任何机械故障。Mazda于1974年开始一直使用转子引擎征战勒芒，但由于禁止使用转子引擎的技术规范即将到来，开发787是Mazda在勒芒凭借转子引擎获胜的最后机会。由于787在1990年的比赛中未能实现目标，次年，经过全面改进的787B由此诞生。
officialDetails.heroEn: The legendary Mazda 787B was the first Japanese-manufactured race car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
officialDetails.heroZh: 帮助Mazda成为首家赢得勒芒大赛的日本生产商，成就一代传奇。

collection.en:
Do you know about the 1991 Le Mans 24 Hours?

In the final year that rotary engines were allowed to compete,
Mazda defied the odds and won in miraculous fashion.

The winning race car was the 787B, powered by 4-rotor engine,
which outlasted powerhouse rivals like Jaguar and Porsche.

The victory was made even sweeter by the fact that Mazda
became the only Japanese company to win the historic race.

After a bad showing the previous year, no one expected the
787B to do well in 1991, qualiying in 19th position.

However, the Mazda team was undeterred and ran a strategic
and consistent race, taking the checkered flag.

The drivers who accomplished the impossible were Volker Weidler,
Johnny Herbert and Bertrand Gachot.

After the rce, the now-historic No. 55 car was safely stowed
away to be preserved forer.

Then,ʃn 201, the car was restored and returned to Le Mans for a
demo run celebrating the 20h annierary f its ictry.
collection.zh:
您对1991年的勒芒24小时耐力赛了解吗？

那是允许转子引擎赛车参赛的最后一年，
马自达也抓住了机会一举夺魁！

在那场令人震惊的赛事中，这辆编号为55的787B成为了全
场的天皇巨星。

因为马自达此前几年在勒芒屡次出师不利，这场来之不易的

1990年，787在比赛中大败而归，而1991年更是因为糟糕的排

伟大胜利。

catch.en: The legendary Mazda 787B was the first Japanese-manufactured race car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
catch.zh: 帮助Mazda成为首家赢得勒芒大赛的日本生产商，成就一代传奇。

vehicleCollection.en:
The legendary Mazda 787B was the first Japanese-manufactured race car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

Mazda's rotary-engine race cars were a familiar sight at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the mid-seventies and throughout the eighties, but it would be 18 years after its first race at the Sarthe Circuit when the car company from Hiroshima would make history.

It all began with the development of the 787, which was powered by the R26B, a 4-rotor Wankel engine that produced <700ps>. To match this power, the car's frame was changed from a conventional aluminum honeycomb composite to a carbon-fiber, which resulted in a light, rigid body structure. The 787 made its debut at the 1990 24 Hours of Le Mans, but mechanical problems forced it to retire from the race early. Mazda came back the following year with an improved version of the race car called the 787B.

The 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans fielded one of the most competitive grids in the history of the event with an all-out effort by Peugeot, as well as strong entries from Mercedes-Benz, Jaguar and Porsche. Two Mazda 787Bs were entered, with the No. 55 car, driven by Bertrand Gachot, Johnny Herbert and Volker Weidler, starting in the 19th position. Once the contest started, the Mazda race car gradually worked its way up the leader board, taking the overall lead just three hours before the end of the race. It managed to hang on to claim the checker, completing 362 laps, which beat the previous year's record. The win marked the first and still the only Japanese race team to win the overall title at Le Mans.

long.zh:
马自达自1974年起开始参加勒芒24小时耐力赛，并凭借他们的转子发动机获得了相当出色的战绩。但由于禁止使用转子发动机的技术规范即将到来，留给马自达的时间便不多了。这便是787投入研发的时代背景。

787配备了一台型号为R26B的四转子发动机，最大动力输出为<700ps>。为了承受如此强大的动力，车身框架从传统的铝制蜂窝结构变为了碳纤维复合材质，在降低重量的同时提高了刚性。车身的宽度被缩减以降低空气阻力，前鼻处安装了一个尺寸较大的散热装置。

787于1990年的勒芒24小时耐力赛首次登场，但由于遇到多个技术问题，而遭到了出人意料的失败。马自达很快从这令人失望的结果中走出，全面改进了787，将新款787B带到了下一年的勒芒。

这一年，标致携倾尽全力开发的905加入赛事，老牌劲旅梅赛德斯·奔驰、捷豹与保时捷的存在也意味着这将是一场艰苦的比赛。在参赛的两辆787中，由伯特兰·加丘、乔尼·赫伯特和沃克尔·魏德勒驾驶的55号车从19位出发，不断超越，在距离比赛结束仅有三小时的时候攀至第一。

这辆787B最终顺利完赛，在飞驰了362圈之后成功冲线，并且打破了上一年的纪录。马自达在参赛的第18个年头终于赢得了这场伟大的胜利，这是日本车厂在勒芒史上首次获胜。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This is a Gr.3 homologation model of the Atenza, derived from Mazda’s global market sedan and adapted to comply with Gr.3 racing regulations. Engineered as a true race machine, it has been transformed into a high-performance sedan producing more than 400 horsepower. Its design stands out for considering even the flow of reflections across the bodywork.

This road car was designed as a homologated
Mazda Atenza Gr.3.

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation Mazda6 featured a curvaceous body style and SkyActiv technology.

Called the Atenza in various markets, the Mazda 6 sports sedan offered European-like style and performance in a less expensive package. In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. However, the biggest surprise came under the sheet metal as the new Mazda 6 came equipped with an optional diesel engine called the SKYACTIV-D for select markets.

This diesel was in fact an improved version of the turbocharged direct-injection 2.2-liter inline-4 of the CX-5. It produced <175ps> and <42.8kgm> of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.

作为马自达的旗舰，阿特兹（马自达6）于2012年演化为第三代车型。这款车型受到了广泛的关注，因其外观酷似一年前在东京车展上所发布的“雄”概念车，其优美的轿跑车身流线极受青睐。但还有其他的因素令这款车型在发售时受到更多关注。第三代车型已全部采用马自达的次世代创驰蓝天技术（在CX-5车型中首次应用），配置了柴油驱动的创驰蓝天D型引擎。

相比CX-5使用的缸内直喷2.2升直列式4缸涡轮增压引擎，阿特兹采用的柴油引擎是该引擎的升级版。升级后的引擎能够产生<175ps>/<42.8kgm>的动力，仅需达到略高于怠速状态下的转速就能产生强劲的动力，足以使车手精神一振。该引擎不仅可以匹配6档自动变速箱，同时也能匹配6档手动变速箱，并且有前轮驱动和全轮驱动两种模式。在环保方面，除了“i-stop”怠速自动启停功能外，所有车型都配备了被称为“i-ELOOP”的基于电容的制动动能回收系统；配备了创驰蓝天D系引擎的车型能够实现油耗仅为<22.4km/L>的JC08高燃油经济性模式。

配备柴油引擎的车型被命名为XD，包括标准款、主动款和L包款三个等级。L包款为豪华车型，配备有真皮座椅等豪华配饰。这款柴油版的阿特兹极受欢迎，在发售首月便占到了销售总数的76%。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

The exterior showcases aggressive yet refined aerodynamics shaped by Mazda’s "KODO" design philosophy. To boost structural rigidity, a bulkhead has been added behind the cockpit, along with a rearview camera to enhance visibility.

This Gran Turismo Gr.3 original utilised the
third generation Atenza as its base...

And was converted to an FR layout to meet
Gr.3 specifications.

A rear cockpit bulkhead has been installed to improve the
overall rigidity of the body.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅组别3级别赛车采用了第三代阿特兹作
为其基础车型……

刚性。

相比CX-5使用的缸内直喷2.2升直列式4缸涡轮增压引擎，阿特兹采用的柴油引擎是该引擎的升级版。升级后的引擎能够产生<175ps>/<42.8kgm>的动力，仅需达到略高于怠速状态下的转速就能产生强劲的动力，足以使车手精神一振。该引擎不仅可以匹配6档自动变速箱，同时也能匹配6档手动变速箱，并且有前轮驱动和全轮驱动两种模式。在环保方面，除了“i-stop”怠速自动启停功能外，所有车型都配备了被称为“i-ELOOP”的基于电容的制动动能回收系统；配备了创驰蓝天D系引擎的车型能够实现油耗仅为<22.4km/L>的JC08高燃油经济性模式。

配备柴油引擎的车型被命名为XD，包括标准款、主动款和L包款三个等级。L包款为豪华车型，配备有真皮座椅等豪华配饰。这款柴油版的阿特兹极受欢迎，在发售首月便占到了销售总数的76%。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is an original racing version of the Mazda6 for Gr.4 competition.

Called the Atenza in various markets, the Mazda 6 sports sedan offered European-like style and performance in a less expensive package. In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. However, the biggest surprise came under the sheet metal as the new Mazda 6 came equipped with an optional diesel engine called the SKYACTIV-D for select markets.

This diesel was in fact an improved version of the turbocharged direct-injection 2.2-liter inline-4 of the CX-5. It produced <175ps> and <42.8kgm> of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

conversation.en:
The Atenza has a dynamic and elegant design.

It reinterprets the classic sensuality of Italian sportscars
from the 1960s...

With a typically Japanese sensitivity to surfaces
and details.

A 4-door sedan-coupe layout...

Combined with a style inspired by Mazda Design's
'Kodo' philosophy.

Its soft, fluid shapes and evolving surfaces...

Are enhanced by specially developed metallic colours.

It's not by chance that Mazda cars are often
shown in red.

This is done to evoke a sort of fiery temperament
defined by emotion and movement.
@
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
Atenza兼具动感和优雅的设计。

它重新诠释了20世纪60年代意大利跑车的经典性感……

又同时具备日本车典型的对于表面和细节的敏感。

这款车采用四门轿跑车的布局，

并融入了Mazda设计部提出的“魂动”设计理念。

柔和的流畅线条与不断演变的表面
被专门开发的金属色车漆进一步增强。

在Mazda的不同广告宣传中，经常以红车示人。
>
这并非偶然，红色唤起了某种充满情绪和动感的极致激情意象。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The third-generation Atenza also came equipped with Mazda’s SKYACTIV-D diesel engine. Nicknamed XD (cross-d), it was offered in three trims, with the L package as the highest specification. Thanks to features like idle-stop and i-ELOOP regenerative braking, SKYACTIV-D models achieved fuel economy figures of 52.7 MPG under Japan’s JC08 test cycle.

brandCentral.en:
The third-gen Atenza's handling is in line with Mazda’s
‘Jinba Ittai’ credo: unity between car and driver.

This model is equipped with a 2.2L turbocharged
straight-four diesel engine.

With plenty of torque, the engine has a mighty roar, and
is partnered by a six-speed manual transmission.

By the way, have you heard of Mazda’s Skyactiv Technology?

This line of fundamental engineering is found throughout
the vehicle, from body to engine to chassis.

Indeed, one might say that the entire third-gen Atenza
is the product of this advanced engineering approach.
brandCentral.zh:
第三代Atenza的操控体验非常符合Mazda的“人马一体”理念：
即车辆和驾驶者之间的和谐统一。

这款车型配备了一台2.2升涡轮增压直列四缸柴油引擎

和六速手动变速箱，充足的扭矩让这台引擎的轰鸣声响
彻云霄。

话说，您听说过Mazda的Skyactiv技术吗？

Mazda的这套汽车工程技术贯穿了整辆车的每个部件，从车
身到引擎，再到底盘，无处不在。

可以毫不夸张的说，
第三代Atenza就是集先进的Skyactiv技术于大成的作品。

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation Mazda 6 features a flowing body style and SKYACTIV technology.

Called the Atenza in various markets, the Mazda 6 sports sedan offered European-like style and performance in a less expensive package. In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. However, the biggest surprise came under the sheet metal as the new Mazda 6 came equipped with an optional diesel engine called the SKYACTIV-D for select markets.

This diesel was in fact an improved version of the turbocharged direct-injection 2.2-liter inline-4 of the CX-5. It produced <175ps> and <42.8kgm> of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.

long.zh:
作为马自达的旗舰，阿特兹（马自达6）于2012年演化为第三代车型。这款车型受到了广泛的关注，因其外观酷似一年前在东京车展上所发布的“雄”概念车，其优美的轿跑车身流线极受青睐。但还有其他的因素令这款车型在发售时受到更多关注。第三代车型已全部采用马自达的次世代创驰蓝天技术（在CX-5车型中首次应用），配置了柴油驱动的创驰蓝天D型引擎。

相比CX-5使用的缸内直喷2.2升直列式4缸涡轮增压引擎，阿特兹采用的柴油引擎是该引擎的升级版。升级后的引擎能够产生<175ps>/<42.8kgm>的动力，仅需达到略高于怠速状态下的转速就能产生强劲的动力，足以使车手精神一振。该引擎不仅可以匹配6档自动变速箱，同时也能匹配6档手动变速箱，并且有前轮驱动和全轮驱动两种模式。在环保方面，除了“i-stop”怠速自动启停功能外，所有车型都配备了被称为“i-ELOOP”的基于电容的制动动能回收系统；配备了创驰蓝天D系引擎的车型能够实现油耗仅为<22.4km/L>的JC08高燃油经济性模式。

配备柴油引擎的车型被命名为XD，包括标准款、主动款和L包款三个等级。L包款为豪华车型，配备有真皮座椅等豪华配饰。这款柴油版的阿特兹极受欢迎，在发售首月便占到了销售总数的76%。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The CX-30 is a crossover SUV introduced to fill the gap between the CX-3 and CX-5. Although compact in size, it showcased Mazda's signature "KODO" design, evident in its sculpted front end and the way light flowed across its sleek body lines. In 2021, Mazda released the CX-30 X Smart Edition. This version featured the innovative SKYACTIV-X engine, paired with enhanced driver assistance systems and refined pedal feedback.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: CX-30作为一款跨界SUV，正是为了填补CX-3和CX-5之间的产品线空缺。车型虽紧凑，却将“魂动”设计理念中的流动美学，在前脸与车身交错的光影间展现得淋漓尽致。CX-30 X Smart Edition版本于2021年推出。该版本搭载了SKYACTIV-X引擎，配备多项驾驶辅助，踏板反馈也得到了优化。
officialDetails.heroEn: This crossover SUV from Mazda featured a revolutionary engine design.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这是一款搭载革命性引擎设计的Mazda跨界SUV。

brandCentral.en:
Modern Mazdas are known for their elegant designs,
and this CX-30 is no exception.

Take a moment to admire its profile—the way the light dances
across its sculpted lines. Stunning, isn’t it?

But the CX-30 is far more than just a pretty face. Beneath that
sleek exterior lies Mazda’s innovative SKYACTIV-X engine.

Capable of burning a very lean air-fuel mixture at high pressure,
it stands as a next-generation engine—clean and efficient.

The X Smart Edition enhances the SKYACTIV-X base package
with a variety of driver-assist features.

Balancing control and comfort, the CX-30 possesses the heart
of a sports car wrapped in a crossover SUV body.
brandCentral.zh:
现代Mazda以优雅的设计著称，这款CX-30更是集大成者。

细致观察它的侧面轮廓和车身光影，是不是令人
叹为观止？

但CX-30的过人之处不仅在于外表。它搭载的SKYACTIV-X引擎
可谓技术卓越。

这款引擎能在高压环境下燃烧极度稀薄的空燃混合物，
堪称高效环保的“新世代动力”。

而X Smart Edition在这一基础上还增添了多项智能
驾驶辅助功能。

在操控性与舒适性之间达到完美平衡，CX-30
为驾驶者带来超乎想象的愉悦体验。

catch.en: This crossover SUV from Mazda featured a revolutionary engine design.
catch.zh: 这是一款搭载革命性引擎设计的Mazda跨界SUV。

vehicleCollection.en:
This crossover SUV from Mazda featured a revolutionary engine design.

During the global sport utility vehicle (SUV) boom of the 2010s, Mazda introduced the CX-3 and CX-5, although a notable gap in size existed between the two. The C30 was conceived to bridge that divide, offering a well-balanced compact crossover SUV.

Measuring <4395mm> from front to rear, <1795mm> in width, and standing <1540mm> high, the CX-30's exterior was relatively compact while showcasing Mazda’s signature "KODO Design" philosophy. The signature wing on the front fascia seamlessly linked the grille to the headlights, while the undulations along the body's side panels artfully reflected shifting light.

Under the hood was a choice of three powertrains: the 2.0-liter gasoline direct-injection SKYACTIV-G, the 1.8-liter direct-injection diesel SKYACTIV-D, or the 2.0-liter SKYACTIV-X, which employed a groundbreaking Spark-Controlled Compression Ignition (SPCCI) system.

The CX-30 X Smart Edition, shown here, was introduced in 2021, based on the SKYACTIV-X model. This model grade emphasized comprehensive driver assistance features as standard, including the Active Driving Display, which projects key information onto the windshield, and the Smart Brake Support automatic emergency braking system. Also, the introduction of this model coincided with refinements to the SKYACTIV-X system, with automatic transmission models receiving enhanced throttle pedal resistance that improved driving response.

Combining versatile dimensions with a dynamic driving character, the CX-30 stands out as an appealing option in Mazda's lineup.

long.zh:
在2010年代全球SUV热潮中，马自达推出了CX-3和CX-5车型。不过，这两款车型之间存在明显的尺寸差距。CX-30作为一款跨界SUV，正是为了填补CX-3和CX-5之间的产品线空缺。

在相对紧凑的尺寸下（长<4395mm>、宽<1795mm>、高<1540mm>），CX-30的外观依然展现出了马自达推崇的“魂动”设计理念——动态且流畅。在前脸设计上，标志性的展翼造型向两侧延伸连接左右大灯，而车身侧面的腰线则巧妙地反映出动态的光影效果。

该车提供三种动力总成选项：2升汽油直喷引擎“创驰蓝天-G”、1.8升柴油直喷引擎“创驰蓝天-D”，以及采用革命性火花控制压缩点火（SPCCI）系统的2升汽油直喷引擎“创驰蓝天-X”。

这里展示的“CX-30 X Smart Edition”版本于2021年推出，在“创驰蓝天-X”车款上更进一步。该车型的主要卖点之一是标配丰富的驾驶辅助设备，包括将信息投影到挡风玻璃上的Active Driving Display抬头显示系统，还有Smart Brake Support智能行车制动系统。这个版本的车型同时也对创驰蓝天-X系统进行了优化，自动挡车型增强了油门踏板反馈力度，提升驾驶质感。

CX-30凭借实用的车身尺寸和充满活力的驾驶体验，成为一款极具吸引力的车型。

conversation.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
conversation.zh: 是我，很高兴见到你们。

conversation.en:
It's so nice to meet you!

As a car designer for Mazda, Mr. Maeda worked on many road
cars including the RX-8 and Demio, and many concept cars.

He's famous for leading and managing all
the car designs produced in Mazda!

He's also the father of Mazda's "Kodo Design" philosophy,
and is one of the leading car designers of Japan.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
我也很高兴认识您！

前田先生以汽车设计师的身份设计过许多公路车型，
包括RX-8和Demio，当然还有许多概念车。

不仅如此，他还是Mazda所有设计项目的总设计师，
在业界享有盛名。

前田先生还是Mazda“魂动设计”理念的缔造者，可以说是
日本最有名的汽车设计师之一。

conversation.en:
So I was the Chief Designer for the Demio before this model,
and have a lot of memories about the car.

This model was not designed as a single car but as a series.

The three models, the Atenza, Axela, and the Demio
were designed simultaneously.

And actually I love small cars like the Demio.

I especially love Italian compact cars like the Autobianchi
and the Alfa Romeo Alfasud,

and I personally owned an old British Mini in the past.

So when I first found out that I would be designing
the Demio I was really happy about it!
P
conversation.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
conversation.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
conversation.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
conversation.zh:
哦，没错，说到这个车型，我可是前一代DEMIO的
首席设计师呢。

不过，这次我们可不是单独设计一款车，而是一口气
设计了一整个系列。

ATENZA、AXELA和DEMIO这三款车，我们是同期设计，
同时进行，一气呵成！

说实话，我其实特别喜欢DEMIO这种小巧玲珑的车。

尤其是意大利的那些紧凑小车，比如Autobianchi和
Alfa Romeo Alfasud。

我还真有过一辆老款的英国Mini呢。

所以你能想象到，当我听说要我来设计DEMIO的时候，
我有多高兴！

dialogues.en:
This Demio is Mazda’s entry in the compact
car marketplace.

It was sold outside of Japan as the "Mazda2"
and it proved to be a big hit.

So the car was reintroduced to the Japanese market in 2019
with that very name.

Mazda is famous for its beautiful rear-wheel sports cars...

...and its legendary race cars that have won titles
the world over.

I'm sure that you'll run into one eventually!

也有在全世界范围包揽冠军头衔的传奇赛车。

我相信你以后会遇到一辆这样的车！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Mazda Demio underwent a full model change in 2014, entering its fourth generation with a bold new direction. Adopting Mazda’s KODO design philosophy, it showcased styling sharp enough to rival its European counterparts. One of its standout features was the newly developed turbocharged 1.5-liter diesel engine, the SKYACTIV-D 1.5. Praised for its excellent fuel efficiency, the diesel variant quickly gained popularity, accounting for more than 60 percent of total orders.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Mazda Demio在2014年迎来全面改款，推出第4代车型。新车采用全新“魂动”设计理念，造型上与欧洲车型相媲美。最瞩目的莫过于新研发的1.5升柴油涡轮增压“SKYACTIV-D 1.5”引擎。卓越的燃油经济性使其广受欢迎，柴油车型订单占比超60%。
officialDetails.heroEn: This compact diesel model from Mazda offered more luxury than you would expect from a car in its class.
officialDetails.heroZh: Mazda的紧凑车型，使用柴油引擎，带来远胜于同级别车型的豪华体验。

brandCentral.en:
The Demio is Mazda's entry-level model.

This fourth-generation version was introduced in 2014.

Power is supplied by a turbocharged 1.5-liter diesel engine
that produces <25kgm> of torque.

Because of its predictable handling character, this car is
ideal for novices learning how to race.<
brandCentral.zh:
Demio是Mazda的入门级车型。

这一款2014年推出的车型已经是第四代产品了。

它的动力系统是一台1.5L涡轮增压柴油引擎，可以产生<25kgm>
的扭矩。

凭借绝对可靠的操控性，它成为了赛道新人的不二之选。

usedCar.en:
The fourth-generation Demio, which made its debut in 2014,
is perhaps best known for its diesel engine.

It's a turbocharged 1.5-liter inline-4 developed especially for
compact cars.

It delivers <20kgm> of torque in the low-RPM range that results
in a gratifying sensation when you take off from a standstill.

The car’s stable handling was also a major selling point, thanks
to the wheelbase that’s longer than the previous model.
usedCar.zh:
第四代Demio于2014年首次亮相，
最出名的可能就是它的汽油引擎。

这个1.5升直列四缸涡轮引擎，
专为紧凑型的车款而研制。

在低转速范围内能够超过<20kgm>，
真正运转起来时感觉很棒。

与上一型号相比轴距明显加长，
使其操控更加稳定。

vehicleCollection.en:
This compact diesel model from Mazda offered more luxury than you would expect from a car in its class.

The fourth-generation Mazda2, known as the Demio in its home market, was introduced in 2014.

It featured the company's "KODO" design philosophy, which implemented many traditional Japanese styling cues along with a sleek overall profile. The car came powered by the usual gasoline-engine options, but for this model, a 1.5-liter turbodiesel that Mazda dubbed "SKYACTIV-D" was added. This engine boasted the performance equivalent to a 2.5-liter gasoline engine, with <25.5kgm> of torque on tap for the 6-speed automatic model and <22.4kgm> for the 6-speed manual. The latter returned an impressive <30.0km/L> on the Japanese JC08 mode fuel economy test. Customers were so enthralled with the new diesel that more than 60 percent of the initial orders were for the SKYACTIV-D models.

There were three grades available for the diesel-powered cars. This included the base XD model, the XD Touring that included practical options such as LED lights and cruise control, and the XD Touring L Package, which included luxury options such as white leather seats and a leather bound steering wheel.

long.en:
The fourth-generation Mazda2, known as the Demio in its home market, was introduced in 2014.

It featured the company's "KODO" design philosophy, which implemented many traditional Japanese styling cues along with a sleek overall profile. The car came powered by the usual gasoline-engine options, but for this model, a 1.5-liter turbodiesel that Mazda dubbed "SKYACTIV-D" was added. This engine boasted the performance equivalent to a 2.5-liter gasoline engine, with <25.5kgm> of torque on tap for the 6-speed automatic model and <22.4kgm> for the 6-speed manual. The latter returned an impressive <30.0km/L> on the Japanese JC08 mode fuel economy test. Customers were so enthralled with the new diesel that more than 60 percent of the initial orders were for the SKYACTIV-D models.

There were three grades available for the diesel-powered cars. This included the base XD model, the XD Touring that included practical options such as LED lights and cruise control, and the XD Touring L Package, which included luxury options such as white leather seats and a leather bound steering wheel.
long.zh:
马自达2（Demio）在2014年进行了大改款，升级到了第4代。

它的外观延续了马自达在高端车型上推行的“魂动”设计理念，为它赋予了与理智知性的欧系车比肩的设计风格。另一个值得一提的特点是它不仅提供汽油引擎，还提供由马自达全新开发的1.5升“创驰蓝天-D”涡轮增压柴油引擎。这款引擎的性能可以和2.5升汽油引擎媲美。在经过调校后，6速自动档车型可以输出<25.5kgm>的扭矩，而6速手动档车型也可以输出<22.4kgm>的扭矩，并且在日本的JC08模式燃油经济性测试中取得了<30.0km/L>的惊人成果。事实证明，马自达2的柴油款车型非常受欢迎，初期收到的订单中有60%都是订购柴油版本。

柴油车共有三种型号配置，包括基础款的XD，提供LED大灯和定速巡航等实用功能的XD Touring，以及提供白色真皮座椅和真皮方向盘等奢华选项的XD Touring L Package。但每个车型都能为您提供超越其级别的品质。

conversation.en:
Now, this is one of the true icons of the industry, one that
changed the history of sports cars in the world.
It has attractive styling, a top that can
be folded down easily...

...and the cockpit space is just snug. Oh, and its price
at the time of release was very affordable.

But above all, the market for convertible lightweight
sports cars...

...was quickly decreasing at the time. It was a dark time
for enthusiasts.

This was the savior that revived this entire genre of cars.

的历史。

还是那家喻户晓的造型，加上方便折叠的顶篷和舒适无
比的座舱，

还有在发售之初非常实惠的价格。

能让你感到人车融为一体、操控自如的敞篷轻量级跑车
的市场

在当时已几近消亡。

这款车可以说是以一己之力挽救了所有同类车型的救星。

conversation.en:
There was this one time when I received a wedding invitation
from a total stranger living in Texas.

I thought, "Maybe it's an owner of a Roadster?"
So, I contacted the Roadster Club of Texas.

I found out that the happy couple owned a red car and a
white car, and met each other at that very club!

Unfortunately, I wasn't able to attend the wedding...

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This automotive masterpiece marked the revival of the lightweight sports car as the 20th century drew to a close. First introduced in 1989 with a 1.6-liter engine, the model saw its displacement increased to 1.8 liters in 1993. Its true appeal lay in its mechanical purity—the transmission and rear differential were unified by an aluminum powerplant frame, while double wishbone suspension and disc brakes at all four corners delivered precise, responsive handling.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款汽车杰作为20世纪末的轻量化跑车复兴奠定了基础。最初于1989年搭载1.6升引擎首次登场，1993年引擎排量扩大至1.8升。这款车的魅力在于其基础架构，变速箱和后差速器通过铝制动力单元框架相连，四轮均配备双叉臂悬挂和碟刹，成就了直接、灵敏的操控体验。

This little beauty's the perfect choice for an
aspiring sports car driver.

Nice and light, with a decent amount of power—
and the key point is that it's rear-wheel drive!

So it's perfect for those who are still learning the ropes.

The Roadster's got a long history, but the NA is the
original and, some would say, the best!
usedCar.zh:
这辆小美人儿非常
适合入门跑车爱好者。

它外观简洁，车身轻盈，马力适中……
而且还是后驱！

因此，它非常适合还在学习基础的车手。

这款Roadster拥有悠久的历史，但自然进气引擎
才是它最原本的引擎配备。有些人觉得自然进气才是最棒的！

vehicleCollection.en:
Mazda's Eunos Roadster is credited with reviving the small fun-to-drive rear-drive convertible sports car.

*The Eunos Roadster was sold as the Mazda MX-5 in Europe and as the Mazda MX-5 Miata in the U.S.

The Eunos Roadster captured the imagination of the world as soon as it made its appearance in September 1989. We know it better as the Miata, and it revived the category of the lightweight convertible sports car, bringing the classic genre back into the limelight. With a compact body, rear-wheel-drive and a simple, and yet straightforward 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4, the Eunos Roadster was as fun to drive as it was good-looking.

It came powered by the 1.6-liter Type B6-ZE that produced <120 ps> and <14.0 kgm> of torque. The suspension system consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, while the brakes were discs at both the front and rear.

Mazda wanted to make sure that its new creation acted like part of the driver's body, going wherever the driver wanted in an effortless way. Thus, the phrase "rider, horse, one body" was adopted as its guiding principle.

In August 1993, a new engine, the 1.8-liter DOHC Type BP-ZE, was placed under the hood, with the output increased to <130 ps> and <16.0 kgm> of torque. The next round of changes came in August 1995 when the final gear ratio and flywheel were modified, thus creating the 1800 Series 2. Mazda produced 531,890 units through the end of 1997, setting a world record for production of a 2-passenger open vehicle, an achievement recorded by the Guinness Book of World Records.

long.zh:
*Eunos Roadster在欧洲和美国分别以马自达MX-5和马自达MX-5 Miata的名字发售。

在20世纪末，Eunos Roadster以一己之力复兴了轻量级跑车品类。这是一台传统的两座轻型敞篷跑车，拥有紧凑而轻巧的车身，1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎和后驱布局。

1989年9月在日本地区上市时，采用的还是1.6升的B6-ZE引擎，可以输出<120ps>和<14.0kgm>扭矩。铝制的动力框架连接传动系统和后差速器，带给驾驶者直接、硬派的换挡感受。该车型还应用了全新设计的双叉臂悬挂和四轮碟刹。据说，只要是与驾驶相关的零件，马自达在设计时都不计代价。这也是为什么人们常将驾驶Eunos Roadster与骑马的美妙体验相提并论了。更何况，这还是一台敞篷跑车。最原始的驾驶乐趣和上佳的操控体验成功抓住了全世界车迷的心，无论是新手，还是资深玩家都对它心驰神往。

1993年8月，新一代的Eunos带来了小改款和一台全新的1.8升BP-ZE引擎，动力输出提高到了<130ps>和<16.0kgm>扭矩。

1995年的第二次改款中，最终齿比和飞轮也接受了改装，进化为Eunos Roadster 1800系列2。

马自达共为这款车型推出过无数个限量版本，截至1997年年底，总共生产出531890台，创下了两座敞篷车的生产世界纪录，甚至被收录进了吉尼斯世界纪录。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo was crafted as Mazda’s futuristic vision of endurance racing excellence, with its sights set on total victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Its striking silhouette was shaped by Mazda’s KODO design philosophy, and the front grille echoes the modern face of Mazda’s production lineup with a bold reinterpretation.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这辆Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是Mazda对未来的畅想，更是在勒芒24小时耐力赛争冠的赛道机器。这款车的外形轮廓充满动感，其设计灵感来源于Mazda的“魂动”设计哲学，甚至前格栅的形状也是对多年来Mazda量产车的标志性前脸的演绎。
officialDetails.heroEn: A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.
officialDetails.heroZh: 速度和优雅的融合，源自挑战者百折不挠的精神。

brandCentral.en:
The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo is a real beauty!

It's the perfect iteration of Mazda's "KODO: Soul of Motion"
design philosophy.

One of the inspirations for its styling was the legendary
787B race car that made history at Le Mans.

The designers attempted to capture the past and future of Mazda
in a single design, and I'd say they succeeded.

Its powertrain is capable of incredible power, efficiency,
and durability.

And who knows? Perhaps a victory at Le Mans is on the cards
for this mean machine too.
brandCentral.zh:
Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo实在是美得不可方物！

此车是Mazda“魂动：Soul of motion”设计理念的
完美示范。

其设计背后的灵感之一是在勒芒赛道上创造历史的
Mazda 787B。

可以说，这个车型成功地在一套设计中捕捉到Mazda的过去
和未来！

其动力系统能够提供令人难以置信的动力、功效和
耐久性。

谁知道呢，也许这个小美人将来也能在勒芒24小时耐力
赛中取得胜利！!

vehicleCollection.en:
A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.

The Vision Gran Turismo project is the setting for the world's best automakers to develop concept cars for motorsports fanatics. The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo pushes the boundaries at the intersection of technology and design. This is not your traditional Mazda but a vision of the future with a healthy dose of respect for the past. It’s the result of an unwavering pursuit of glory at the world’s most grueling endurance event, the legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans.

In crafting the Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo, the Mazda Design team masterfully fused agility with elegance. Its dynamic silhouette is drawn with sensual forms inspired by Mazda’s KODO design philosophy. Even the shape of the grille is an interpretation of the Mazda signature front end developed for its production vehicles. The stance of the Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo, reminiscent of the famed 787B that took overall victory at the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans, is powerful yet graceful.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo is engineered to be lightweight, featuring extensive use of carbon fiber, including a monocoque chassis, all wrapped in atmospheric white paint. Pair this with advanced drivetrain technology that delivers the pinnacle of power, efficiency, and durability, and the result is a remarkable power-to-weight ratio that surpasses most vehicles in its class.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo embodies Mazda’s vision for the future and its unwavering spirit to embrace challenges.

long.zh:
跑车浪漫旅愿景项目是世界上最好的车厂为赛车狂热分子打造概念车的平台。马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo推动了技术与设计之间的交汇。这不是一台传统的马自达，而是对未来的愿景，同时又适当兼顾传统。这款车是能在世界上要求最苛刻的耐力赛——著名的“勒芒24小时耐力赛”中取得卓越胜利，吸引万千瞩目的产品。

在马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo的设计中，马自达的设计团队将敏捷与优雅合二为一。感性的造型风格构造了这款车动感的轮廓，其灵感则来自于马自达的“魂动”设计理念。甚至前格栅的形状也源自马自达量产车的标志性前脸设计。马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo的风格让人想起在1991年勒芒24小时耐力赛中大获全胜的名车787B，强劲而不失优雅。

马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo车体极为轻盈，采用了轻巧的碳纤维组件，醒目亮白色涂装之下是轻盈的单体底盘。这款车采用了集大马力、高效率和耐久性于一体的高级动力传动技术，因而获得了极高的马力重量比，超过其同级别的大多数车型。

马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是马自达对未来的设想，是他们不屈不挠的挑战者精神的产物。

Mazda need to race in the top category at Le Mans?’

The LM55 name stands for ‘Car No. 55 of Le Mans’,
and is taken from a legendary Mazda racer.

I remember putting this car through a full aerodynamic

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This Gr.1-spec evolution of the LM55 Vision Gran Turismo represents Mazda’s vision of a modern rotary-powered prototype. It delivers the razor-sharp cornering Mazda is known for, enhanced by the exceptional grip of a 4-wheel-drive system. With the ability to dart through corners and surge down straights, it stands as a true modern embodiment of the legendary "rotary rocket."
officialDetails.descriptionZh: LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是Mazda构想的一款现代转子引擎原型车，而这辆车则是它的Gr.1改装版本。这辆车拥有超凡转向性能，不负Mazda的盛名，其四轮驱动系统也能提供强大的牵引力。看到它贴地冲过弯道，在直道上一骑绝尘的样子，你就能明白——这就是“转子火箭”梦想化为现实的样子。
officialDetails.heroEn: A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.
officialDetails.heroZh: 速度和优雅的融合，源自挑战者百折不挠的精神。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo Original is a Gr.1 racing car based on the
Mazda LM 55 VGT.

Its lightweight chassis and cutting-edge drivetrain tech
make it a formidable contender in its class.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.1级别赛车基于
Mazda LM 55 VGT开发。

它的轻量化底盘和行业领先的传动技术让它成为了同级
别赛车中最有实力的竞争者。

catch.en: A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.
catch.zh: 速度和优雅的融合，源自挑战者百折不挠的精神。

vehicleCollection.en:
A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.

The Vision Gran Turismo project serves as a stage for the world’s premier automakers to craft visionary concept cars that thrill motorsports enthusiasts. The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo pushes the boundaries at the intersection of technology and design. This is not your traditional Mazda but a vision of the future with a healthy dose of respect for the past. It’s the result of an unwavering pursuit of glory at the world’s most grueling endurance event, the legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans.

In crafting the Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo, the Mazda Design team masterfully fused agility with elegance. Its dynamic silhouette is drawn with sensual forms inspired by Mazda’s KODO design philosophy. Even the shape of the grille is an interpretation of the Mazda signature front end developed for its production vehicles. The stance of the Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo, reminiscent of the famed 787B that took overall victory at the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans, is powerful yet graceful.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo is engineered to be lightweight, featuring extensive use of carbon fiber, including a monocoque chassis, all wrapped in atmospheric white paint. Pair this with advanced drivetrain technology that delivers the pinnacle of power, efficiency, and durability, and the result is a remarkable power-to-weight ratio that surpasses most vehicles in its class.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo embodies Mazda’s vision for the future and its unwavering spirit to embrace challenges.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.1 regulations by Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
跑车浪漫旅愿景项目是世界上最好的车厂为赛车狂热分子打造概念车的平台。马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo推动了技术与设计之间的交汇。这不是一台传统的马自达，而是对未来的愿景，同时又适当兼顾传统。这款车是能在世界上要求最苛刻的耐力赛——著名的“勒芒24小时耐力赛”中取得卓越胜利，吸引万千瞩目的产品。

在马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo的设计中，马自达的设计团队将敏捷与优雅合二为一。感性的造型风格构造了这款车动感的轮廓，其灵感则来自于马自达的“魂动”设计理念。甚至前格栅的形状也源自马自达量产车的标志性前脸设计。马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo的风格让人想起在1991年勒芒24小时耐力赛中大获全胜的名车787B，强劲而不失优雅。

马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo车体极为轻盈，采用了轻巧的碳纤维组件，醒目亮白色涂装之下是轻盈的单体底盘。这款车采用了集大马力、高效率和耐久性于一体的高级动力传动技术，因而获得了极高的马力重量比，超过其同级别的大多数车型。

马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是马自达对未来的设想，是他们不屈不挠的挑战者精神的产物。

*这款车已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别1规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The FC3S, second generation of the RX-7, made its debut in October 1985. Sporting a sleek, futuristic design, it was shorter than its predecessor but both taller and wider. This new generation also carried an additional 441 lbs of weight. To offset the added weight, the FC3S was fitted with the newly developed 13B rotary engine. Each chamber was enlarged to 654 cc, and with the addition of a turbocharger, the engine delivered a peak output of 182.4 HP and 180.8 ft-lb of torque.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第二代RX-7——FC3S——于1985年10月首次亮相。这辆车拥有全新的未来风外观，从车身尺寸上看，它仅在长度方面小于初代车型，但是更高也更宽。这款新车型的重量也增加了200 公斤。为了驱动更重的车身，这辆车配备了一台全新的13B引擎。通过将每个转子缸体的排量扩大到654 立方厘米，并结合一部涡轮增压器，新引擎的性能得到了极大提升，能够输出185 PS的最大动力和25.0 公斤力米的最大扭矩。
officialDetails.heroEn: This version of the second-generation RX-7 offered better driver feedback and agility.
officialDetails.heroZh: 第2代RX-7的完整形态，性能与操控回馈都有提升。

usedCar.en:
If you're looking for a car that handles like it's on rails,
then you can't go wrong with any of the RX-7s.

This second-generation "FC" has a lower center of gravity than
many of its competitors, and it's lighter, too.

Even today, people rave about its amazing on-road prowess,
which comes via its unique rotary engine.

Properly tuned, it'll run circles around some of the
newer models out there today.
usedCar.zh:
想找一辆操控性出色的车子吗？
那么RX-7系列车型肯定适合你。

在第二代“FC”上市时，它的重量更轻，
重心也比当时的竞争者要低。

即使放在今天，这辆车优良的过弯性能
也并不常见。

在经过适当调校后，这辆车完全可以与
最新款的车型一较高下。

catch.en: This version of the second-generation RX-7 offered better driver feedback and agility.
catch.zh: 第2代RX-7的完整形态，性能与操控回馈都有提升。

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of the second-generation RX-7 offered better driver feedback and agility.

By the time the second-generation RX-7, the FC3S, arrived in October 1985, Mazda had firmly established the model as a competent rotary-powered sports machine. Although the new model was shorter than the previous car, it was wider and slightly taller, resulting in a 200-kg weight increase. The newly designed 13B Wankel did more than compensate for the extra mass, as the turbocharged 654-cc powerplant produced <185ps> and <25.0kgm> of torque. To keep the rear end more secure, Mazda incorporated semi-trailing arms and lateral rods for the rear suspension that featured a toe control hub.

An even purer sports version of the car was introduced in August 1986, called the Infini. This limited-edition model was a two-seater, and featured, among other things, BBS alloy wheels, firmer shocks and an aluminum hood. The Infini name would make an appearance seven times, each time representing the sportiest version of the model, before production of the FC3S ceased in 1991.

Mazda made significant tweaks to the RX-7 in 1989, when it matched a new independent twin-scroll turbocharger to the 13B as well as raising the engine's compression ratio. The result was a power increase to <205 ps> and <27.5kgm>. The final Infini model saw the power of the 13B raised to <215 ps> and <28.0kgm>. A convertible model was added to the lineup in 1987, which proved popular in the U.S., especially with women.

The newly designed 13B Wankel did more than compensate for the extra mass, as the turbocharged 654-cc powerplant produced <185ps> and <25.0kgm> of torque. To keep the rear end more secure, Mazda incorporated semi-trailing arms and lateral rods for the rear suspension that featured a toe control hub.

This limited-edition model was a two-seater, and featured, among other things, BBS alloy wheels, firmer shocks and an aluminum hood. The Infini name would make an appearance seven times, each time representing the sportiest version of the model, before production of the FC3S ceased in 1991.

Mazda made significant tweaks to the RX-7 in 1989, when it matched a new independent twin-scroll turbocharger to the 13B as well as raising the engine's compression ratio. The result was a power increase to <205 ps> and <27.5kgm>. The final Infini model saw the power of the 13B raised to <215 ps> and <28.0kgm>. A convertible model was added to the lineup in 1987, which proved popular in the U.S., especially with women.
long.zh:
RX-7于1985年10月进化为第二代“FC3S”。

未来主义风格的第二代相比第一代RX-7，长度更短，但更宽也更高，车身重量增加了大约200公斤。不过全新设计的13B引擎抵消了增加的重量。每个转子的排量扩展到了<654cc>，配合涡轮增压器后性能提升到了<185ps>和<25.0kgm>扭矩。

后部悬挂改为多连杆布局，同时采用了半拖曳臂和侧边杆。这个后悬挂的特点是采用了特殊的前束控制轮轴，能够提升车辆在转弯时后轮的稳定性。

FC3S系列同样推出了偏向于持久驾驶风格的限量版车型——英菲妮版本。英菲妮是一款高性能2座车型，省略了后排座位，装备了BBS合金轮毂、特殊减震器以及铝制引擎罩。第一款英菲妮亮相于1986年8月，但在1991年FC3S停产前，这款车一共限量发售了七批，是RX-7的标志性版本。

1989年，RX-7进行了几处小的改动。13B引擎应用了新型双涡流涡轮增压器，随着压缩比的提高，马力提高到<205ps>，扭矩则提高到<27.5kgm>。英菲妮的最后一款马力达到<215ps>，扭矩为<28.0kgm>。在外部配件方面，在小幅调整之后，三个圆形的尾灯成为了这几款车型的显著特征。

1987年，RX-7系列中新增了一款敞篷车型，与以往的耐久型赛车的印象不同。此车在美国获得成功，尤其在女性驾驶者中受到欢迎。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The FD3S, the third generation of the RX-7, was introduced in December 1991. Its widened body accommodated broader tires for improved grip, while extensive use of aluminum components throughout the chassis brought the weight down to just under 2646 lbs. Although it retained the 13B engine from the FC3S, the FD3S introduced a sequential twin-turbo system, boosting output to 251.5 HP and 217.0 ft-lb of torque. The lightest variant, the Type S, achieved a power-to-weight ratio of 4.97 kg/HP, making it the most potent RX-7 ever produced.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: FD3S，即第三代RX-7，于1991年12月首次亮相。虽然为了容纳更宽的轮胎而增加了车身宽度，但通过在车身各部位大量采用铝合金部件，显著减重至接近1,200 公斤。虽然引擎与FC3S同样采用13B转子引擎，但通过序列式双涡轮系统将功率输出提升至255 PS/30.0 公斤力米。最轻量化的Type S车型功率重量比达到4.90 公斤/PS，成为RX-7历史上性能最强的车型。

Those in the market for a rotary-engine car need look no further
than Mazda's RX-7.

This model, the FD3S "Spirit R," was the last RX-7 version

catch.en: This final version of the Mazda RX-7 marked the end of an excellent 25-year run for the model.
catch.zh: RX-7的最后一款纪念车型，25年的历史告一段落。

vehicleCollection.en:
This final version of the Mazda RX-7 marked the end of an excellent 25-year run for the model.

Arguably, one of the purest sports cars to come from Japan is the third-generation RX-7 (FD3S) that was introduced in 1991. Gone was the name "Savanna" that graced previous models, replaced by the moniker, ɛ̃fini RX-7. The FD3S was wider than the FC, and significantly lighter at <1200kg>, thanks to the aluminum used for the hood, double wishbone suspension, and spare-tire jack.

New life was breathed into the 13B Wankel via new twin sequential turbochargers. The rotary engine produced <255ps> and <30.0kgm> of torque. With each passing year, the FD improved, with dramatic improvements in body rigidity and ABS. The weight-to-power ratio of the lighter Type S was <4.90kg/ps>, making it the fastest RX-7 to date.

The FD3S continued to evolve. Body rigidity, the computer, and ABS were upgraded. The Type I, created in 1991, led to the Type II, Type III, and the Type VI in 2000. Available only in the Japan market was the limited-edition Type RZ, the first Japanese car equipped with 40/45 low-profile tires. This was followed by the Type R Bathurst R in 2001 that came equipped with self-leveling shocks.

The 13B got an upgrade in 1996 and produced <265ps>. In 1998, after Mazda refined the engine's cooling system, the two-rotor Wankel was able to produce the maximum <280ps> allowed for JDM cars at the time. This allowed the Type R to boast a weight-to-power ratio of <4.50kg/ps>, which put it in the same league as the exotics. In August 2002, the RX-7 Spirit R was introduced as an anniversary model and became the last one in the series. After 25 years of delighting sports car fans around the world, the RX-7 was discontinued.

long.zh:
FD3S作为第三代的RX-7，发布于1991年12月。先前版本的名称“Savanna”被弃用，更名为ɛ̃fini RX-7。

为了适应更宽的轮胎，FD3S被明显加宽，但其引擎盖、备胎、千斤顶和前后双叉臂悬挂均采用铝制，使车身重量在车身加大的同时奇迹般地降到了1200公斤。

和FC3S一样，FD3S采用了13B涡轮增压引擎。但借助全新的序列式双涡轮系统，让输出提高到了<255ps>和<30.0kgm>的扭矩。重量更轻的Type S的动力重量比达到<4.90kg/ps>，此车在所有已发布的RX-7车款中速度最快，并且仍有极大的升级潜力。

FD3S在随后不断进化。车身刚度、车载电脑和防抱死刹车系统的规格也逐年升级。1991年制造的Type I车型进化为Type II和III，并在2000年最终成为Type VI。

在升级过程中的亮点之一是限量版的Type RZ，这是第一辆采用40/45小尺寸轮胎的日本车。在此后的2001年，Type R Bathurst R发布，采用高度可调式悬挂，这在标准量产车中也十分罕见。

当然，引擎也在不断更新。1996年，对电子控制单元的进气和排气系统进行了改进，将马力提高到了<265ps>。1998年，对冷却系统和引擎的优化使马力最终达到了<280ps>。Type R的重量马力比已达到了<4.50kg/ps>，性能上已经和超级跑车不相上下。

然而，RX-7无法满足21世纪的环保标准。2002年8月，RX-7 Spirit R作为周年纪念版推出，同时也是该系列的最后一款，结束了其为期25年的生产。

Built on the 6-speed manual Type RS—equipped with Bilstein dampers—and the 6-speed automatic Type E—offering upscale touches like leather seating—both variants received exclusive interior and exterior enhancements. vehicleCollection.en:
The final version of the RX-8, Mazda's rotary engine sports car with a unique 4-door layout.

Introduced in 2011, the Mazda RX-8 Spirit R was the final special edition model of the RX-8 that was first released in 2003.

The RX-8 had two distinct personalities, depending on the gearbox you chose. Cars equipped with the 6-speed manual drove like a pure sport car, with brisk acceleration and more driver control, while those with the 6-speed automatic essentially behaved like luxury grand tourers. The Spirit R equipped with the 6-speed manual was based on the sporty Type RS, and featured extra aero parts and a sporty suspension setup, complete with Bilstein dampers. The automatic Spirit R was based on the Type E and included luxury accoutrements, such as leather seats. The car's Renesis rotary engine produced 235HP and 159 ft.-lb. of torque.

The lifespan of the Spirit R was short-lived, as Mazda discontinued the RX-8 in June 2012. Because of that, initial orders for the Spirit R exceeded the intended batch of 1000 units, so Mazda produced another 1000 to meet demand.[

The Spirit R equipped with the 6-speed manual was based on the sporty Type RS, and featured extra aero parts and a sporty suspension setup, complete with Bilstein dampers. The automatic Spirit R was based on the Type E and included luxury accoutrements, such as leather seats. The car's Renesis rotary engine produced 235HP and 159 ft.-lb. of torque.

The lifespan of the Spirit R was short-lived, as Mazda discontinued the RX-8 in June 2012. Because of that, initial orders for the Spirit R exceeded the intended batch of 1000 units, so Mazda produced another 1000 to meet demand.[
long.zh:
马自达RX-8 Spirit R在2011年首次推出，是2003年亮相的RX-8的最终特别版。

RX-8共可提供两种略有差异的体验。6速手动档款偏向跑车，而6速自动档的感觉更像是豪华旅行车。这款Spirit R车型也同样提供了手动档和自动档选项，都代表了符合其定位的最高档配置。

其手动型号基于跑车型的Type RS，包含额外的空气动力学套件和采用倍适登避震器的强化悬挂。自动档型号基于豪华旅行车风格的Type E，拥有高档内饰和皮革座椅。和旧型号相比，差异仅仅在于外观和内饰的诸多细节变化，引擎规格和机械系统完全没有改变。尽管如此，随着官方公布将于2012年6月停产RX-8，订单量飞快地超过了原计划的1000台。为了满足需求，最后又额外生产了1000台RX-8。

Did you know that in Europe, they have an annual contest
for the world’s most beautiful car?

Well, the Mazda RX-Vision took home the "Most Beautiful
Concept Car" award at this contest in 2016.

The event draws crowds of car enthusiasts from all over
the world to pick the most beautiful cars of the year.

The RX-Vision was the first car by an Asian manufacturer
to win this award.

Penned by Ikuo Maeda, it was a car that left its mark on not
only Mazda but Japanese sports-car design in general.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This rotary sports-car concept was unveiled at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Every unnecessary line and surface were meticulously carved away from its sleek long-nose, short-deck silhouette, revealing Mazda’s purest interpretation of the ideal rear-wheel-drive sports car. Powered by the next-generation SKYACTIV-R rotary engine, this concept offered a bold glimpse into the future of rotary performance.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2015年东京车展上发布的转子引擎运动概念车。在优雅的长前悬短后悬造型基础上，进行了精心雕琢，去除所有冗余线条，以抒写Mazda对理想后驱跑车的展望。搭载SKYACTIV-R下一代转子引擎，此车展现了对转子动力技术的未来愿景。
officialDetails.heroEn: This stunning concept provided a glimpse of a next-generation rotary-engine-powered car.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一辆采用了次时代转子引擎的优雅概念车。

brandCentral.en:
The RX-Vision concept car was first presented at the 2015
Tokyo Motor Show.

Mazda's stated aim when designing it was to create the
world's most beautiful rear-wheel drive sports car.

Its distinctive styling is bursting with life, and is based
on Mazda's 'KODO: Soul of Motion' design theory.

Powered by a naturally aspirated four-rotor engine...

It follows in the footsteps of the Mazda's legendary
787B racing car.|
brandCentral.zh:
这款RX-VISION概念赛车的首次露面是在2015年
的东京车展。

马自达表示，此车的设计目的就是打造出全世界最漂亮
的后驱跑车。

以马自达的“魂动”设计理念为原点，
它那独特的造型充满了生命力。

追随马自达传奇赛车787B的脚步，

它也搭载了一台自然进气的四转子引擎。

catch.zh: 一辆采用了次时代转子引擎的优雅概念车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This stunning concept provided a glimpse of a next-generation rotary-engine-powered car.

The Mazda RX-VISION was first shown at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Billed then as the company's Rotary Sports Concept.

Based on Mazda's KODO design philosophy, the car was a visual tour de force, with smooth flowing lines and proportions befitting a spiritual successor of the RX-7 and Eunos Cosmo. A bit of mystery surrounded what was under its hood.

All that was disclosed was that it was Mazda's next-generation Skyactiv-R rotary engine.

The catchphrase included the words, "a dream to hopefully achieve one day." That the company still had plans for a future rotary engine was made clear with this machine.

Gran Turismo Sport players had an exclusive chance to sample its prowess in the virtual world in the form of the RX-VISION GT3 Concept.

long.en:
The Mazda RX-VISION was first shown at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Billed then as the company's Rotary Sports Concept.

Based on Mazda's KODO design philosophy, the car was a visual tour de force, with smooth flowing lines and proportions befitting a spiritual successor of the RX-7 and Eunos Cosmo. A bit of mystery surrounded what was under its hood.

All that was disclosed was that it was Mazda's next-generation Skyactiv-R rotary engine.

The catchphrase included the words, "a dream to hopefully achieve one day." That the company still had plans for a future rotary engine was made clear with this machine.

Gran Turismo Sport players had an exclusive chance to sample its prowess in the virtual world in the form of the RX-VISION GT3 Concept.
long.zh:
2015年的东京车展上，马自达在他们的展位上展出了一辆跑车，并赢得了观众极高的关注度。这款车称为RX-VISION，副标题则是“转子运动概念车”。

这款车基于马自达的“魂动”设计理念开发，采用流畅的长车头、短驾驶舱外形，摒弃了一切不必要的线条或平面，追求前置后驱跑车的终极美感。它的外形也清楚地昭示了其双座前中置引擎的布局。

尽管规格详情没有公开，但据描述，这款车采用了下一代的转子引擎“创驰蓝天-R”。

其宣传口号中包含这样一句话，“希望有朝一日可以实现的梦想”。这款车也是全世界广泛转子引擎迷们翘首以盼、希望能够亲眼目睹的梦想。

而在这款车的公路型号公布之前，你已经可以在《跑车浪漫旅 竞速》中驾驶到RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT了。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This concept car was created to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Mazda’s founding. Its bullet-shaped body was mounted on a steel tube space frame and powered by a 10A-type rotary engine originally developed for the 24 Hours of Spa, delivering around 246.5 HP. Although it appeared publicly in three different body colors, later investigation revealed it was, in fact, a single car repainted for each appearance.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是一款为了纪念Mazda成立50周年而专门推出的概念车。其子弹外形车身被安置在一套钢管空间车架底盘上，并配备了一部专为斯帕24小时耐力赛打造、能够输出250 PS级别的10A型转子引擎。尽管市面上能见到三款不同配色的版本，但经过调查，人们发现其实都是同一款车身采用了不同的喷漆。
officialDetails.heroEn: This ultra-exotic concept featured a rotary engine and cutting-edge technology.
officialDetails.heroZh: 搭载了转子引擎和尖端科技的超跑概念车。

collection.en:
The Mazda RX-500 is a supercar that is nothing short
of mythical.

Built in 1970 for the 50th anniversary of Toyo Kogyo, known
today as 'Mazda', it debuted at the Tokyo Motor Show.

This RX-500 was conceived as a successor
to the famed Cosmo Sport of the 1960s.

Unlike the Cosmo Sport however, its rotary engine
was not mounted in front but rear-midship...

And was a high rpm type that could rev up to <14000rpm>.

With <250ps> and weighing only <850kg>,
the RX-500 was an extremely fast car.

Only one RX-500 was ever built as a concept model, and
in 2008 it was restored by Mazda to its original glory.
collection.zh:
Mazda RX500是一款神奇的超级跑车。

它于1970年为了纪念Toyo Kogyo（即现在的Mazda）
创立50周年而制造，并在东京车展上展出。

RX500是60年代广负盛名的Cosmo Sport的继任者。

与Cosmo Sport不同的是，它的转子引擎没有安装在前面，而是
采用了中后置布局。

这款转子引擎专为高转速而调校，最高转速高达<14000rpm>。

高达<250ps>的马力配上仅有<850kg>重的车身，RX500的速度快得惊人。

RX500仅有一台概念车存世。在2008年，经Mazda修缮后，它恢复
了往日的神采。

catch.en: This ultra-exotic concept featured a rotary engine and cutting-edge technology.
catch.zh: 搭载了转子引擎和尖端科技的超跑概念车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra-exotic concept featured a rotary engine and cutting-edge technology.

Created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Toyo Kogyo (Mazda), the RX500 concept car was introduced to the world in 1970. It featured the company's revolutionary rotary engine, which made its debut in the Cosmo Sport three years prior, and an unforgettable bullet-shaped body that focused on aerodynamics.

The designers of the car experimented with several different versions of the RX500, including a coupe with a beautiful rear section and a race car with a rear wing, but opted to go for the car you see here because of its superior Cd (drag coefficient) value of 0.31. In terms of styling, the car was truly before its time; for example, its upswing doors were introduced before those of the Lamborghini Countach.

The powerplant, mounted amidships in a steel-tube space frame, was a 10A rotary engine built for the company's Spa 24 Hours race car and produced more than <250ps>. It came mated to a 4-speed manual gearbox from the RX87 Luce Rotary Coupe. Top speed was expected to exceed <250km/h>, and the brake system featured 4-piston calipers and 4-wheel ventilated discs, which represented cutting-edge technology for that time, as only a very few racing cars boasted a similar set-up.

long.zh:
马自达RX500是为了纪念马自达的前身，东洋工业株式会社成立50周年而打造的概念跑车，也是对马自达转子引擎的绝佳展示。全球首台商用的转子引擎就装在马自达1967年款的Cosmo Sport身上。

RX500令人印象深刻的子弹造型是在综合考虑空气动力学效果后做出的决定。在车身制模阶段，公司内的设计师们曾制作过一款双门版本，拥有美妙的车尾，另外还有加装了尾翼的竞赛版本。但最后，马自达选择了这个在风洞测试中获得优秀成绩（风阻值0.31）的造型。不仅如此，在兰博基尼Countach问世之前，RX500就已经用了上开式剪刀门。

装在空间钢管车架上的中置引擎是一台为斯帕24小时耐力赛打造的10A转子引擎，可以输出超过<250ps>。传动系统则是一款RX87 Luce Rotary Coupe上使用的4速手动变速箱。这台车的预期最高时速是<250km/h>。刹车系统则包括了四活塞卡钳和四轮通风碟刹，以应对极速下的制动需求。这是一台集当时先进科技于大成的车型，恐怕只有少数赛车的配置能与之媲美。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This motorsport-focused base model was introduced as part of the fourth-generation Roadster lineup. Its drivetrain was upgraded to meet the demands of track use, complemented by a larger radiator and enhanced disc brakes. The suspension featured height-adjustable dampers supplied by Bilstein. In 2022, the car received Kinematic Posture Control, designed to dramatically improve rear-end stability and cornering composure.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第4代Roadster车系中新增的赛车运动基础版本。传动系统升级至赛道驾驶规格，同时配备了更大的散热器和碟刹。悬挂系统配备Bilstein高度可调减震器。2022年进行了进一步升级，新增运动姿态控制系统，大幅提升后部稳定性。
officialDetails.heroEn: This motorsports-based model epitomizes the core concepts of the Roadster.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款赛车向的基础车型成为了展现Roadster核心理念的典范。

brandCentral.en:
The NR-A is a sports car with a very special place
in Mazda’s Roadster series.

It was developed to be driven on both city streets
and the racing track.

The standard model was equipped with an enhanced drivetrain,
large brake rotors...

And an upgraded suspension system.

It even included a NR-A-branded roll cage and bucket seats,
items required for competition racing.

A Roadster with a long and storied history, the NR-A debuted
in 2002, during the era of the second-gen NB Roadster.

That same year, Mazda launched a one-make party race series
for numbered NR-A grade Roadsters.

The Roadster Party Race continues to be one of Japan’s
most popular race events.
brandCentral.zh:
在Mazda的Roaster系列中，NR-A拥有特殊的地位。

它的设计既考虑了城市街道使用，
也考虑到了赛道比赛。

标准版本就配置了改进后的传动系统、大型碟刹……

以及经过升级的悬挂系统。

甚至还加入了带有NR-A标志的防滚架和桶型座椅
——两者都是正式比赛必备的装备。

NR-A作为一款历史悠久、经历丰富的车型，首发于2002年，
当时在售的MX-5还是第二代型号NB。

同年，Mazda还专门举办了单一车种派对系列赛，
仅限有编号的NR-A Roadster参加。

这一赛事从此延续了下来，并成为了日本最有人气的赛事之一。

catch.en: This motorsports-based model epitomizes the core concepts of the Roadster.
catch.zh: 这款赛车向的基础车型成为了展现Roadster核心理念的典范。

vehicleCollection.en:
This motorsports-based model epitomizes the core concepts of the Roadster.

Released in 2015, the fourth-generation ND MX-5 received worldwide praise for its return to the original concept of "Jinba Ittai," which translates to "rider and horse, one body." This essence was especially apparent in the NR-A trim level, which was intended for track use.

The NR-A first made its appearance on the second-generation NB MX-5, catering to those who enjoyed driving their sports cars on the track. The concept proved popular enough for Mazda to include an NR-A in the ND lineup.

The section of the frame that connects the transmission to the rear differential was upgraded for the ND NR-A, along with the driveshaft, LSD and differential case. The size of the radiator and brake rotors were increased, and the suspension adopted height-adjustable dampers made by Bilstein. Another useful feature was the Multi-Information Display that allowed the driver to get vital stats through switches on the steering wheel.

This 2022 model has further improvements, including a new Kinematic Posture Control system that stabilizes the rear end of the car. The options list also features racing equipment such as roll bars and bucket seats, which come especially useful for hot-lapping sessions.

The NR-A is the ideal track car for weekend warriors because of its excellent and predictable handling, with power delivery that's just enough to make things fun and exciting.

long.zh:
这台2015年发售的第四代“ND” Roadster回归最初的“人马一体”理念，受到了全世界的赞誉。ND的精髓在NR-A这款比赛专用的基础车型上得到了纯粹而淋漓尽致的表达。

NR-A最初是在第二代“NB”车型时加入了系列，它推出时的理念是为所有人提供一个轻松体验赛道乐趣的机会。这些理念在ND版本的NR-A中得到了继承，并特别针对竞速驾驶作出了对应改动。

将传动系统与后轮差速器连接的动力装置得到了升级，同期强化的还有传动轴、限滑差速器和差速器箱等相关配件。散热器和刹车盘都变大了一码，悬挂采用了由倍适登制造的高度可调减震器。另外新增的一项实用功能是驾驶者现在可以通过方向盘上的声控开关来命令多功能显示器显示油耗等统计数据了。

这台2022年的车款还拥有进一步的改进，全新的运动姿态控制系统大幅提高了车尾的稳定度。选配清单中还包括了防倾杆和桶型座椅等赛车装备，可以轻松将此车变为一辆彻头彻尾的赛车。

NR-A可能是许多人梦寐以求的车型，在城市街道和赛道上都能提供同样的驾驶乐趣。

I got a call one day from my protégé at Mazda Design asking
for my thoughts on the design of the fourth-gen Miata.

I told him that I wrote a scenario for the first three
generations at the beginning of the NA project.

I normally look forward 20-25 years ahead
from the start of a project.

Therefore, I had no ideas for the fourth-gen car,
except the following:

 If it was to be mecanically similar,
then the design should...

...differ more from the NA to NB, and NB to NC.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The fourth-generation ND Roadster made its global debut in April 2014 at the New York Auto Show. Its compact dimensions, combined with a wide, low stance and elegantly sculpted curves, garnered widespread acclaim when the final design was revealed in September of the same year. Pre-orders commenced in March 2015. The entry-level S grade featured pared-down equipment, and at just 2183 lbs, it stood as the only variant with a curb weight under one ton.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第四代“ND”Roadster在2014年4月的纽约车展上盛大亮相。它的车身紧凑短小，但呈现出宽大、低伏的风格，外加优雅的弧线造型，在同年九月一经正式公布便受到全世界范围车迷的交口称赞。这款车于2015年3月开启了预购。其最基础的装饰级别为S级，采用了简化的配置，也是唯一一款重量低于1吨的车型，整备重量仅为990 公斤。

vehicleCollection.en:
The MX-5 Miata returns to its roots with a lightweight <990kg> body and dashing looks.

One look and almost anyone in the world can recognize Mazda’s sporty convertible sports car that's proved so popular that it made its way into the Guinness Book of World Records. While it goes by different names throughout the world, the Roadster in Japan, the MX-5 in Europe and the MX-5 Miata in the US, we’ll refer to it simply as the MX-5 here.

The fourth-generation MX-5, codenamed “ND,” was introduced at the New York Auto Show in April 2014. It was obvious from this “display only” model that the car possessed all the attributes to make it great, returning to the formula that made the first-generation model so successful. It was going to be lighter than the outgoing model, with most of the heavy components, including the driver, focused at the center of the chassis.

When the final exterior and interior design of the MX-5 was revealed simultaneously in the US, Japan and Europe in September of the same year, driving fans were excited. The new MX-5 looked sleek and sexy, sitting low to the ground with a wide stance. The car, slightly smaller than the previous model, was more in line with the first generation car. It measured <3915mm> long, <1735mm> wide and <1235mm> high, and rode on a <2310mm>-wheelbase. It tipped the scales from <990kg> to <1060kg>, depending on the grade model.

Powering the compact roadster was a <1496cc> DOHC inline-4 that delivered <131ps> and <15.3kgm> of torque. It came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox or an automatic transmission with a torque converter. The combination of the lightweight package, peppy engine and manual gearbox made the “ND” one of the most rewarding cars to drive on the planet, and it reminded everyone of how enjoyable top-down motoring can truly be.

*The Mazda Roadster was sold as the Mazda MX-5 in Europe and the Mazda MX-5 Miata in the US.

long.zh:
代号“ND”的第四代马自达敞蓬跑车于2014年4月在纽约车展上首次以实物形态亮相。虽然当时仅仅展示了底盘、引擎、传动系统和悬挂系统，但可以看到较重的元件被安置在较低、靠近底盘中心的位置，设计者为了减轻重量付出了大量的努力，车手坐在车辆中部略微靠后的位置。这次亮相成功地引起了全世界车迷的期望。

在同年9月的另一次重大更新中，车辆的造型于日本、美国和欧洲同步亮相，并宣布将于2015年开始发售。

这款车的前鼻和肩线较低，车身整体偏宽偏低。其优雅的线条十分迷人，但车身的尺寸比前辈型号NC要小。这款车在尺寸和设计方面受到了全世界的好评。

2015年，关于这款车的更多信息被透露出来。车的尺寸为<3915mm>×<1735mm>×<1235mm>，轴距为<2310mm>。车身重量在<990kg>与<1060kg>之间，根据车型等级而有所不同。引擎使用的是<1496cc>双顶置凸轮轴直4引擎，马力为<131ps>/<15.3kgm>。变速箱可提供6档手动变速箱和带有变矩器的自动变速箱。

预订开始于2015年3月，共有几个级别可选：基本S款、驾驶性能提升的S特别款和豪华版S真皮款。S款的配置十分简单，并未配备限滑差速器和后稳定杆。然而，此级别车型的重量低于1吨，只有<990kg>，适合驾驶者体验新款“ND”双座敞蓬跑车的本色。

*此款马自达双座敞蓬跑车在欧洲销售的型号为MX-5，在美国销售的型号为马自达MX-5 Miata。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Eunos Roadster (NA Special Package) '89 has been specially tuned by Gran Turismo to create this original machine. vehicleCollection.en:
A first-generation Mazda Roadster, tuned to perfection by Gran Turismo.

*The Eunos Roadster was sold as the Mazda MX-5 in Europe and as the Mazda MX-5 Miata in the U.S.

This original car created by "Gran Turismo" is based on the 1989 Mazda Eunos Roadster (NA Special Package). The following is the description of the base model:

The Eunos Roadster captured the imagination of the world as soon as it made its appearance in September 1989. We know it better as the Miata, and it revived the category of the lightweight convertible sports car, bringing the classic genre back into the limelight. With a light and compact body, rear-wheel-drive and a simple-yet-straightforward 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4, the Roadster was as fun to drive as it was good-looking.

It came powered by the 1.6-liter Type B6-ZE that produced <120ps> and <14.0kgm> of torque. The suspension system consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, while the brakes were discs at both the front and rear.

Mazda produced 531,890 units through the end of 1997, setting a world record for production of a 2-passenger open vehicle, a fact recorded by the Guinness Book of World Records.

long.zh:
*Eunos Roadster在欧洲和美国分别以马自达MX-5和马自达MX-5 Miata的名字发售。

这是跑车浪漫旅以马自达Eunos Roadster'89（自然进气特别版）为基础，调校制作的原创车型。以下是针对原始车型的介绍：

在20世纪末，Eunos Roadster以一己之力复兴了轻量级跑车品类。这是一台传统的两座轻型敞篷跑车，拥有紧凑而轻巧的车身，1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎和后驱布局。

1989年9月在日本地区上市时，采用的还是1.6升的B6-ZE引擎，可以输出<120ps>和<14.0kgm>扭矩。铝制的动力框架连接传动系统和后差速器，带给驾驶者直接、硬派的换挡感受。该车型还应用了全新设计的双叉臂悬挂和四轮碟刹。据说，只要是与驾驶相关的零件，马自达在设计时都不计代价。

马自达共为这款车型推出过无数个限量版本，截至1997年年底，总共生产出531890台，创下了两座敞篷车的生产世界纪录，甚至被收录进了吉尼斯世界纪录。

眼前这款是1991年推出的第三代车型，代号是“FD”。

其车名与徽标源自Mazda旗下的前豪华车部门——
“ɛ̃fini”，可谓声名显赫。

尽管FD RX-7身轻如燕，动力却相当澎湃。

当你深踩油门，转子引擎那源源不绝的强劲动力
便会瞬间涌现。

而一旦坐进驾驶舱，其低趴、宽体的战斗姿态更是展露无遗。

从旁观赏，它堪称一件工业艺术品，
更是Mazda品牌史上的一段不朽传奇。

dialogues.en:
The Mazda RX-7 is synonymous with rotary-engine sports cars.

This is the 3rd-gen model from 1991, also known
as the 'FD.'

It notably bears the name and emblem of
Mazda’s former luxury vehicle division, 'ɛ̃fini.'

The FD RX-7 is a light and powerful car.

Pressing down on the accelerator, you immediately
feel the limitless motive power of its rotary engine.

And its low, wide stance becomes apparent as soon
as you get behind the wheel.

Seen from the outside, it’s a thing of beauty,
and a legend in the annals of Mazda history.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The third-generation FD3S RX-7 was introduced in December 1991. The Savanna name used on earlier models was retired, with the official name in Japan becoming the ɛ̃fini RX-7. The car carried over the 13B rotary engine from the second generation, but output increased to 251.5 HP with the introduction of a sequential twin-turbo system. Thanks to extensive use of aluminum in components such as the hood, spare wheel, jack and 4-wheel double-wishbone suspension, the FD3S achieved an impressively low curb weight of around 2778 lbs.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第三代RX-7，“FD3S”，于1991年12月首次亮相。前代车型命名中的“Savanna”退出舞台，如今该车的日本市场官方名称为ɛ̃fini RX-7。该车和第二代车型一样，采用“13B”式转子引擎，得益于采用了串列式双涡轮布局，最大动力提升至255 PS。此外，引擎盖、备胎、随车千斤顶以及四轮双叉臂悬架部件均大量采用铝合金材质，使整车实现了令人惊叹的轻量化，整备质量约为1,260 公斤。

vehicleCollection.en:
The debut model of the third-generation RX-7, a car developed to be the ultimate sports car.

The FD3S, the third-generation RX-7, made its debut in December 1991. The “Savanna” name used on earlier versions was retired, and the model was rebadged as the ɛ̃fini RX-7.

To accommodate wider tires, the FD3S was significantly widened. Even so, extensive use of aluminum for the hood, spare wheel, jack, and front and rear double-wishbone suspension kept curb weight to a remarkable <1260kg>, despite the increase in size.

Power came from the 13B Turbo carried over from the FC3S. But the addition of a new sequential twin-turbo system raised output to <255ps> and <30.0kgm> of torque. In its lighter Type S form, the power-to-weight ratio reached <4.90kg/ps>, making it the fastest RX-7 ever released and a platform with enormous potential.

The FD3S continued to evolve throughout its lifecycle. Body rigidity, engine management, and ABS specifications were refined year after year. The original Type I introduced in 1991 progressed through Type II and Type III, culminating in the Type VI released in 2000.

Ultimately, the RX-7 could not meet the tightening environmental standards of the 21st century. In August 2002, the RX-7 Spirit R was released as a final commemorative model, closing the book on 25 years of RX-7 production.

long.zh:
FD3S，即第三代RX-7，于1991年12月首次亮相。先前版本的名称“Savanna”不再沿用，而是重新命名为ɛ̃fini RX-7。

为了适应更宽的轮胎，FD3S的车身被大幅加宽，但其引擎盖、备胎、千斤顶以及前后双叉臂悬挂均为铝制，所以尽管尺寸增加，但车身重量却奇迹般地降至<1260kg>。

和FC3S一样，FD3S采用了13B涡轮引擎。但得益于新引入的串列式双涡轮增压器，让输出提高到了<255ps>和<30.0kgm>的扭矩。而车身更轻的Type S的马力重量比更是达到了<4.90kg/ps>，是有史以来最快的RX-7，而且升级潜力巨大。

FD3S持续进化车身刚性、车载电脑和ABS的规格年复一年地获得升级。从1991年诞生的Type I，发展到Type II和Type III，最后演化为2000年的Type VI。

遗憾的是，RX-7无法应对21世纪日趋收紧的环境排放标准。2002年8月，RX-7 Spirit R作为该系列的最后一款周年纪念车型发布，标志着其25年生产的终结。

catch.en: The 650S supercar came loaded with F1 technology.
catch.zh: 当MP4-12C进化成了豪华超跑。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 650S supercar came loaded with F1 technology.

McLaren introduced the 650S at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show as the successor to its amazing MP4-12C, which signaled the company’s willingness to duke it out with Ferrari in the exotic production-car market, as wells at in Formula 1.

The 650S was designed to be the high performance version of the MP4-12C, as it shared the basic structure with its predecessor. It sported an extremely light-yet-rigid carbon-fiber monocoque body that helped keep its curb weight down to <1360kg>. The styling was updated from the MP4-12C, with a freshened face and improved aerodynamics.

The Proactive Chassis Control suspension was also based on the one in the MP4-12C, but revised to provide sharper responses and a smoother ride quality. Also making its way from the MP4-12C into the 650S was the torque vectoring brake steering and variable rear wing.

The car’s name came from the power derived from its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8 that produced <650ps> and <69.1kgm> of torque. The fire-breathing engine came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox that exhibited smoother shifts than that of its predecessor, and allowed the driver to choose three different shift maps: normal, sports, and tracks.

The 650S’s performance was certainly world-class with a zero-to-<100km/h> time of 3.0 seconds, a zero-to-<400m> time of 10.5 and a top speed of <333km/h>.

long.zh:
迈凯伦的超级跑车650S发布于2014年的日内瓦车展，接力迈凯伦首次全力进军超跑领域的车型MP4-12C。

该车型在策划之初是MP4-12C的高性能版，沿用相同的基本结构——至轻至坚固的碳纤维“单体车壳”，重量也与前者基本相当，为<1360kg>。

在造型方面，这款车的正面给人的印象与旗舰车型P1相似，但这其实是为了改善空气动力学性能而作的改进。从后面看，这款车几乎和MP4-12C一模一样，将其看作是改进车款也不无道理。

正如车名所示，650S使用的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎被调整为<650ps>/<69.1kgm>的动力输出。所配备的7档双离合变速箱在改进后换挡更加顺滑。搭载的驾驶模式选择器可以在普通、跑车和赛道三个模式之间切换。

主动式底盘控制悬挂在机械结构方面保持不变，但经过调整，使响应更加灵敏的同时保持迈凯伦超跑知名的舒适度。

当然，这款车也保留了扭矩矢量分配制动转向和提供空气制动的可变式尾翼。

0-<100km/h>的加速时间为3.0秒；0-400米所需时间为10.5秒，最高时速可达到<333km/h>。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 650S GT3 was developed as a full FIA-GT3 compliant race car, derived directly from the production McLaren 650S. While it retained the same twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8, power output was reduced to 493.1 HP to comply with GT3 regulations, similar to the MP4-12C GT3. Additional upgrades included extensive endurance-focused refinements throughout the car. The 650S GT3 earned significant victories in 2015, winning at GT Asia and later claiming top honors at the 2016 Bathurst 12 Hour.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 650S GT3是基于McLaren 650S超级跑车开发的符合FIA-GT3规则的车型。尽管使用的是相同的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎，但为符合GT3规则降低了调校。它和MP4-12C GT3一样，动力被限制到500 PS。全车还进行了多项针对耐力赛的改进。2015款650S GT3于同年在GT Asia赛事中获胜，并于2016年初在巴瑟斯特12小时耐力赛中夺冠。
officialDetails.heroEn: The GT3 successor to the remarkable MP4-12C race car.
officialDetails.heroZh: 在凶猛而性感的野兽的排气共鸣声中沉迷。

brandCentral.en:
Based on the 650S, this racing variant was developed in
accordance with FIA GT3 specifications.

It received acclaim after claiming victory at the 2016
Bathurst 12 Hour in Australia.

vehicleCollection.en:
The GT3 successor to the remarkable MP4-12C race car.

McLaren introduced the 650S at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show as the successor to its amazing MP4-12C, which signaled the company’s willingness to duke it out with Ferrari in the exotic production-car market, as wells at in Formula 1.

The car’s name came from the power derived from its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8 that produced <650ps> and <69.1kgm> of torque. The fire-breathing engine came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox that exhibited smoother shifts than that of its predecessor, and allowed the driver to choose three different shift maps: normal, sports, and tracks.

The 650S’s performance was certainly world-class with a zero-to-<100km/h> time of 3.0 seconds, a zero-to-<400m> time of 10.5 and a top speed of <333km/h>.

The race spec version of the 650S, introduced three months after the road car, was called the 650S GT3. As its name implied, it was developed in line with FIA-GT3 regulations. The 650S GT3 was the successor to the the MP4-12C GT3, the race car McLaren introduced in 2011. The MP4-12C GT3 contested in GT races all over the world, including the Blancpain endurance series and SCCA World Challenge.

Like the MP4-12C, the basic structure of the 650S GT3 consisted of a carbon mono cell taken from the road car; however, the suspension system was completely revised. The car came equipped with exterior carbon parts that further improved upon the MP4-12C GT3's excellent aerodynamics, thanks to a larger splitter and redesigned door mirrors.

The twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8's power was restricted down to <500ps> in line with GT3 regulations, but McLaren announced that there were additional improvements made to increase durability of various parts.

The 2015 650S GT3 won the 2015 GT Asia and the Bathurst 12-hour race in the beginning of 2016.

650S的竞速版车型为650S GT3。顾名思义，这款车是根据国际汽联-GT3规则设计的，并在650S公路版跑车发布3个月后发布。650S GT3将取代2011年亮相的迈凯伦GT跑车：MP4-12C GT3。MP4-12C GT3活跃在世界各地的GT赛场上，包括宝珀耐力系列赛和美国赛车俱乐部世界挑战赛等。

和MP4-12C一样，650S GT3的基本结构也采用了和公路版相同的碳纤维单体车壳，但悬挂却被完全修改，胎面也比MP4-12C宽<52mm>。650S GT3还配备了MP4-12C同款碳纤维空气动气学组件，并且安装了更大的分流器，对后视镜也进行了重新设计，空气动力学性能得到进一步提高。

引擎仍为3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎，和MP4-12C的GT版本一样，为了符合GT3规则，这款车的马力被限制为<500ps>。据称，迈凯伦对各种零件的耐久性进行了额外的改善。

2015款650S GT3在2015年亚洲GT系列赛和2016年初的巴瑟斯特12小时耐力赛屡获殊荣。)

vehicleCollection.en:
Here is the Gran Turismo original Gr.4 spec-version of the McLaren 650S super sports car.\

McLaren introduced the 650S at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show as the successor to its amazing MP4-12C, which signaled the company’s willingness to duke it out with Ferrari in the exotic production-car market, as wells at in Formula 1.

The 650S was designed to be the high performance version of the MP4-12C, as it shared the basic structure with its predecessor. It sported an extremely light-yet-rigid carbon-fiber monocoque body that helped keep its curb weight down to <1360kg>. The styling was updated from the MP4-12C, with a freshened face and improved aerodynamics.

The Proactive Chassis Control suspension was also based on the one in the MP4-12C, but revised to provide sharper responses and a smoother ride quality. Also making its way from the MP4-12C into the 650S was the torque vectoring brake steering and variable rear wing.

The car’s name came from the power derived from its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8 that produced <650ps> and <69.1kgm> of torque. The fire-breathing engine came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox that exhibited smoother shifts than that of its predecessor, and allowed the driver to choose three different shift maps: normal, sports, and tracks.

The 650S’s performance was certainly world-class with a zero-to-<100km/h> time of 3.0 seconds, a zero-to-<400m> time of 10.5 and a top speed of <333km/h>.

迈凯伦的超级跑车650S发布于2014年的日内瓦车展，接力迈凯伦首次全力进军超跑领域的车型MP4-12C。

该车型在策划之初是MP4-12C的高性能版，沿用相同的基本结构——至轻至坚固的碳纤维“单体车壳”，重量也与前者基本相当，为<1360kg>。

在造型方面，这款车的正面给人的印象与旗舰车型P1相似，但这其实是为了改善空气动力学性能而作的改进。从后面看，这款车几乎和MP4-12C一模一样，将其看作是改进车款也不无道理。

正如车名所示，650S使用的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎被调整为<650ps>/<69.1kgm>的动力输出。所配备的7档双离合变速箱在改进后换挡更加顺滑。搭载的驾驶模式选择器可以在普通、跑车和赛道三个模式之间切换。

主动式底盘控制悬挂在机械结构方面保持不变，但经过调整，使响应更加灵敏的同时保持迈凯伦超跑知名的舒适度。

当然，这款车也保留了扭矩矢量分配制动转向和提供空气制动的可变式尾翼。

0-<100km/h>的加速时间为3.0秒；0-400米所需时间为10.5秒，最高时速可达到<333km/h>。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The McLaren F1 was a groundbreaking supercar conceived by legendary Formula 1 designer Gordon Murray. From its unique 3-seat configuration, with the driver positioned at the center, to its balanced weight distribution, the F1 introduced a host of innovations that redefined what a road car could be. Celebrated worldwide, it earned acclaim not only as the fastest production car of its time but also for its usability in everyday driving.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: McLaren F1是一辆由Formula 1设计师戈登·穆雷打造的超级跑车。从将驾驶者置于中央位置的三座布局，到精心调校的配重比，这款极具革命性意义的车型拥有许多值得大书特书的优点。它不仅是全世界最快的超级跑车之一，在日常驾乘场景中也具备实用性，因而受到了全世界汽车爱好者的盛誉。
officialDetails.heroEn: The ultra-exotic McLaren F1 exemplified the genius of its designer, Gordon Murray.
officialDetails.heroZh: 跑车的终极，汲取了天才戈登·穆雷的理念。

collection.en:
Is the McLaren F1 the greatest supercar of them all?
Quite possibly.

McLaren's founder, Bruce McLaren, had always wanted
to enter the road car business...

But died in 1970 before a true production car
could be developed.

The company would not start working on road cars again
until the late 1980s.

This three-seater McLaren F1 was finally born in 1992.

Conceived and engineered by Gordon Murray, the exterior
and interior were designed by Peter Stevens.

Many aspects of this car, including the weight balance
and distribution, are close to perfection.

Needless to say, with only 106 built,
they're not easy to get.

It’s little wonder that the McLaren F1 is one
of the most desirable supercars ever.
collection.zh:
这辆迈凯伦F1是最伟大的超级跑车吗？我觉得算。

实际上，迈凯伦的创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦一直想要进入公路车市场。

可惜他在真正的量产车开发完成前就于1970年去世了。

直到1980年代后期，公司才开始重新考虑公路车的开发计划。

这款3座的“迈凯伦F1”终于在1992年姗姗来迟。

此车由戈登·穆雷构思和设计，
外观和内饰则交由彼得·史蒂文斯操刀。

catch.en: The ultra-exotic McLaren F1 exemplified the genius of its designer, Gordon Murray.
catch.zh: 跑车的终极，汲取了天才戈登·穆雷的理念。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultra-exotic McLaren F1 exemplified the genius of its designer, Gordon Murray.

The McLaren F1 production car first made its appearance in 1991 as the king of all super sports exotics. The car was built by Formula 1 constructor McLaren and styled by lead designer Gordon Murray, who was assigned the arduous task of bringing to life company founder Bruce McLaren's dream of building a road-going automobile with the McLaren name.

The F1 sports car had scissor-type doors not unlike those of a Lamborghini Diablo. Its monocoque structure was extremely light, contributing to the car's weight of <1140kg>. The car was laden with so many special features that they are too many to list here, but one trait worth noting is the car's passenger seating arrangement. By positioning the driver's seat at the center of the interior and the two passengers on opposing sides behind the driver, an ideal lateral and vertical weight balance was realized. Even the trunk was positioned within the wheelbase to ensure optimal weight distribution. Mounted amidships was BMW's 6.1-liter V12 that pumped out <627ps>. Although other exotics of the day used forced induction, McLaren opted to keep its powerplant naturally aspirated for better overall response and driving ease.

Upon its release to the public, the McLaren F1 was hailed as the fastest road-going sports car in the world, one that was also quite practical as an everyday driver. Needless to say, many McLaren F1 owners wanted to race the car because of its incredibly high level of performance, prompting the company to produce the F1 GTR, a race version of the road car. The F1 GTR went on to enjoy a successful racing career that included wins in races such as the 24 Hours of Le Mans._

long.zh:
迈凯伦F1是由一级方程式车厂迈凯伦研发的超级跑车，发布于1991年。

此车由一级方程式设计师戈登·穆雷设计，是为了实现已故公司创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦未完成的梦想——制造一款在公路上行驶的迈凯伦。

这款车采用鸥翼式车门和单体车壳结构，极度轻盈的车身仅重<1140kg>，并拥有数不清的特殊特性，成就革命性的车款。其中最值得注意一点的是，为了提高驾驶性能，设计者对重量配比的优化极其重视。

驾驶座被安置在车辆中部，两个乘客座位分别布置在后方左右两侧，形成了独特的三角形3座布局。甚至连行李箱也设置在前后轴之间，以使重心位于中央。中置安装的6.1升宝马V12引擎能够产生<627ps>。虽然当时超跑的主流是涡轮增压，设计者还是采用了自然吸气引擎，以便在整体上获得更好的反应能力和驾驶灵活性。

通过上述努力，迈凯伦F1得以享誉全球，被誉为全世界最快的公路超跑，且仍兼具日常实用性。由于其惊人的速度和驾驶性能，许多客户想将这款车用于赛车比赛，有鉴于此，迈凯伦又生产了此车的赛车规格版F1 GTR。迈凯伦F1在勒芒24小时耐力赛等比赛中大获成功，开创了自己的时代。*

This is a McLaren F1 that has seen some track action.
Many consider this car to be the perfect sport car.

This race spec version first made an appearance in 1994.

And in 1995, it made its Le Mans debut,
going on to grab the overall title!

Incidentally, the victorious McLaren F1 GTR was once driven
by former Formula 1 driver JJ Lehto...

...and Japanese driver Masanori Sekiya.

It was the first time that a Japanese driver had won at
Le Mans.

He was also the fastest driver on the team, even when rain
fell during the night at the Circuit de la Sarthe.

一辆久经战阵的迈凯伦F1！这可能是
有史以来最接近“完美”的车子了……

这辆车的赛车版本在1994年首次出现……

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This race version was based on McLaren’s first full-scale road car, the F1. At the rain-soaked 1995 24 Hours of Le Mans, the F1 GTR defied the odds, outperforming purpose-built prototype racers to claim overall victory. Car No. 59, backed by the factory and driven by Yannick Dalmas, Masanori Sekiya, and JJ Lehto, etched its name into motorsports history.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这台赛车基于McLaren首款量产公路跑车F1打造。在1995年勒芒24小时耐力赛中，面对几乎持续一整天的降雨，McLaren力压本应更具优势的开放式原型赛车，勇夺总冠军。夺冠的59号赛车来自获得McLaren工厂支持的客户车队，由雅尼克·达尔马斯、关谷正德和J.J.莱托共同驾驶。
officialDetails.heroEn: The ultimate automobile by McLaren would go on to win both the BPR series and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
officialDetails.heroZh: 终极机器，BRP GT系列赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

collection.en:
This McLaren F1 GTR is the overall winner
of the 1995 Le Mans 24 Hour race.

The drivers in the race were Masanori Sekiya, J.J. Lehto,
and Yannick Dalmas,

and Sekiya was the first Japanese driver to win the famed race,

and Lehto was also the first Finn to claim this honor.

Although design engineer Gordon Murray was not
keen on entering it in races,

he agreed to make some aerodynamic alterations,
and the result was a win at its first race,

which happened to be at Le Mans!

 Following the Le Mans victory, McLaren resolved to
continue developing the GTR as a race car,

making this a crucial icon in both the history
of McLaren and in the history of Le Mans.
collection.zh:
这辆McLaren F1 GTR是1995勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军车。

参加比赛的车手是关谷正德、J.J. Lehto和Yannick Dalmas，

关谷还是第一位赢得这项著名比赛的日本车手，

而Lehto也是第一位获得这一荣誉的芬兰人。

尽管设计工程师戈登·穆雷对于让它参加比赛并不感冒，

但还是同意作出一些空气动力学方面的改动。结果就在
处女秀上取得胜利，

更重要的是，那场比赛就是勒芒大赛！

在勒芒胜利之后，McLaren决定继续将GTR作为赛车来开发，

这也使它同时成为了McLaren历史和勒芒历史上的一个重要标志。
