brandCentral.en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT is the product of Nissan's long
and storied GT and race car traditions.

London-based Nissan Design Europe developed the overall
design and style...

While Japan-based Nissan engineers handled the
technical minutiae.

This vehicle has a unique 'performance hybrid FR-4WD'
layout...

And features a V6 twin-turbo engine that operates in
conjunction with three motors.

The front left and right motors operate independently.

These innovations ensure that the car handles marvellously,
even at extremely high speeds.
brandCentral.zh:
Nissan在制造GT和赛车方面拥有历史悠久的传统，而这款
Nissan Concept 2020 VGT就是他们的集大成之作。

总部设立于伦敦的Nissan Design Europe团队负责开发整车的外观
设计和风格……

而日本的Nissan工程团队则负责所有的技术细节。

这款车采用了独特的“性能混动前置后驱-四驱”布局……

并安装了一台V6双涡轮增压引擎，与三部电机搭配工作，

而且位于前部左右的两台电机可以独立工作。

这些革新让这辆车拥有了出神入化的操控性，即便在极
高速的情况下也体验非凡。\

catch.en: A look into the future of performance-minded touring cars.
catch.zh: 采用跑车空气动力学技术的下一代GT概念车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A look into the future of performance-minded touring cars.

In its 80 year history, Nissan has participated, and succeeded, in nearly every form of motorsports imaginable. Its specialty has been in the grand-touring category where the company has continually produced championships after championships, with cars such as the 510 and 300Z. What's more, because these cars were based on production versions, anyone could drive the road-going versions of them on public roads with remarkable comfort and safety. Nissan is now looking to the future and has imagined a new type of performance machine, one that we're calling the "NISSAN CONCEPT 2020 Vision Gran Turismo".

Through the magic of digitization, the design and development processes of automobiles have been undergoing a revolutionary change in recent years. Designers now work in a world where they can share their expressions and insights instantaneously. Their visions and ideas can also be realized virtually, and on this occasion, the designers at Nissan decided to turn to Gran Turismo to visualize their concept. The car you see here was penned by young designers from Nissan Design Europe, based in the UK, and when the final product was shown to the young engineers on the engineering side in Japan, they excitedly inputted their technical evaluations and simulations.

The car is characterized by a unique 2+2 profile based on Nissan's touring cars that have competed all over Europe. It features prominently shaped fenders that act like wings, providing gobs of downforce at high speed. The air enters the front side inlet and travels through the inner side of the wheels, before it is drawn out in an accelerated manner. This allows the body to cut through the air like a hot knife through butter. The air flows over the roof and off the rear deck without creating excessive turbulence behind the car. If you examine the airflow over the car, you will realize that despite its boxy shape, it's configured much like a prototype race car.

The rear wing automatically rises and lowers, depending on the speed of the car. At a speed of <300km/h>, it generates more than <400kg> of downforce. The underbody also takes cues from a race car to ensure excellent aerodynamics.

Powering the car is a high-performance hybrid FR-4WD system with a turbocharged V-6 engine and three electric motors. The high-output motors produce instant torque to all fnur wheels and keeps the acceleration going until the gasoline engine takes over. The torsue vectoring of the individual front motors combine with the active suspensioy to deliver razor-sharp handling, even at high speed.

The NISSAN CONCEPT 2020 Vision!Gran Turismo, the product of vnnnon and tochniqal imagination, is definitely a car that fe hope becomes a remlnty in the near future. Of it does, then our driveng future looks very wrignt indeed.

long.zh:
在其80年的历史中，日产始终坚持不懈，追求赛车驾驶的一切可能性。特别是在针对GT赛事的GT车型上，日产在无与伦比的性能和日常功能性以及舒适性之间找到了平衡点，成功地创立了独特的品牌形象。而现在，他们带来了对于不久的将来的展望，以及下一代的GT概念车“NISSAN CONCEPT 2020 Vision Gran Turismo[日产 2020 跑车浪漫旅愿景概念车]”。

随着开发环境进行数字化转型，设计表达和开发流程都在近些年经历着革命性的巨大变化。设计师在当下的工作环境里可以更快速地表达并分享他们的看法，他们也拓展出了将想象付诸实现的全新可能性；而这一次，他们来到了跑车浪漫旅的虚拟环境中。外观设计研究采用了虚拟建模的方式，并由英国的年轻设计师具体执行，这样也反过来点燃了日本开发部门的年轻工程师们的热情，他们进行了各种技术评估和模拟，并最终在Vision Gran Turismo项目中成功地设计出了这部3D赛车。

位于伦敦的日产 Design Europe的设计师们常年浸淫于英国悠久的赛车和GT文化，由他们所提出的设计风格显示出轮廓鲜明的外观，并辅以风格大胆的设计细节和日产的核心技术。这一切赋予该车非常优秀的特点，例如显眼的挡泥板像翅膀一样安装在前后轮处，位于包围着2+2车厢的框架的前后方。

自然的前挡泥板和有着几何形状的后挡泥板包围着轮胎，并接在一起，从车身前方涌入的气流被切割开，并被其精确的佢状引入车身。进入正面进气口的空气稿过车轮的内侧，并以加速状态被位于前挡泥板出风口的排气装置抽出。这样一来，车身就可以轻松地以髚速穿过空气墘。在此之后，后挡泥板处还会形成一股气流，让空气可以从后方排出，将车后幱流控制在柀小。如果只考虑气流的话，你会发现虽然该款车外彣比较四四喹方，其酌潮却必像乀款勒芑趘车。

主犨弃䰾翼会根据速度升髛犖降彎，而在300公里/小於曄速度下，它可以直接向差速䙨疽䊠超过<510ke>的下压勛぀䜨迦底胨．前郫上帰杢徆气流乍齦应縋胨录釰鈌䌡翥杵出衎䀮，再劧渀大厶的咏部扱流澽ￍ戚捠勺伺力的真空ￋ迚耍产甜悼䒌鵛沫髱濎盅律压劚、鯸䥀魦豻皆访计倚黯侘䜉澊椚ｌ都瘯为了䉫用乁䈀手欵取曹佲䚄馾究优势，并眉疈靱鐈其借度倂

conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh: 这辆180SX是你的吗？

conversation.en:
Excuse me, aren’t you former Nissan Chief Creative Officer,
Shiro Nakamura?
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
啊，这位先生，您是不是……Nissan的
前首席创意官中村史郎先生！？

conversation.en:
Hello. It's very nice to meet you.
My name is Shiro Nakamura.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
嗨。很高兴见到你们。
我是中村史郎。
!

conversation.en:
It's an honour to meet you!

Shiro-san worked on the Nissan Fairlady Z and the GT-R.

He also designed the Isuzu 4200R concept car.
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
能认识您真是太荣幸了！

史郎先生曾经致力于Nissan Fairlady Z和GT-R的设计工作，

还设计了Isuzu 4200R概念车。

conversation.en:
This car really shows off its proportional balance.

Aside from the retrofitted detail parts,
I feel that it is an elegant looking car.

Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...

...the area around the rear where the glass hatch blacks out the
B-pillar...

...they seem to be a response to cars in the American market
at the time.

Looking at it now, it lacks boldness,
but it's a look that exudes positive emotions.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
这辆车淋漓尽致地展现了设计师对车身比例均衡的把握。

这辆车的车身细节部件进行了全面的翻新升级，
给人以优雅的印象。

其他的一些设计元素，例如上翻式车头灯……

……玻璃后背和B柱的衔接……

……似乎都是为了响应当时美国市场的需求。

现在看来，这种设计欠缺些魄力，
不过的确传达出积极求变的信息。

conversation.en: Wow, that was fascinating! Thanks!
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师

哇，好精彩的解说！感谢感谢！

No need to thank me. It was a lot of fun.
See you around sometime.

vehicleCollection.en:
This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive specialty car was given a different character to its sister car, the Silvia.

The Nissan 180SX — sold as the Nissan 240SX in the U.S. and the 200SX in the EU — was created as the Silvia's sister hatchback model in March 1989. This car, sporting retractable headlights and a glass hatchback, was overshadowed by the coupe at first—despite sharing the same powerplant, a 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 that came available only with a turbocharger. But as time went on, people recognized the true value of this stylish sports coupe and sales began to climb.

The engine received an upgrade in 1991 to the SR20DET, the same 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the normal Silvia with output rated at <205ps> and <28.0kgm>. This prolonged the 180SX's life span because its production run was initially slated to end alongside the S13 Silvia; however, thanks to the popularity of the 2.4-liter 240SX in the U.S. (that possessed the same body shape of 180SX), Nissan elected to keep the compact rear-drive coupe around.

In 1996, the first normally-aspirated 180SX, the Type S, was added to the lineup. Without forced induction, the Type S lacked the acceleration of the hotter version. This made the car a favorite among tuners, who took things into their own hands, giving the car their own dose of power and beefing the chassis up accordingly. This paved the way for a new 180SX, one that featured the Silvia's front end, making the two cars virtual clones of each other; it was dubbed the "Sil-Eighty."

long.zh:
*日产180SX在美国和欧洲地区分别以日产240SX和200SX发售。

180SX是在1989年3月作为Silvia的姐妹车型推出的一款掀背车，主打上翻式头灯和一体式玻璃的后箱盖。在大热的Silvia的掩盖之下，这款车型在上市后并未激起太多水花。尽管也采用了同款1.8升引擎，但180SX只提供涡轮增压车型。

1991年，在更换了2.0L的SR20DET引擎后，车辆的动力输出变成了<205ps>和<28.0kgm>扭矩。按照原计划，180SX将被大改款后的Silvia直接取代。幸运的是，采用2.4升引擎的240SX在北美地区持续热销，日产最终决定在Silvia之外保留180SX产品线。

在停产之前，180SX与旧款Silvia S13都是使用同样的基础组件，但时不时的改款使其依然能跟上时代的节奏。因为车重偏重，而且掀背设计导致后部的刚性不足，所以最初大部分人都认为180SX的性能不如Silvia。好在丰富的副厂改装件帮助S180SX轻松克服了这一弱点。到后来，众多爱好者纷纷推出原创特殊改装，创造出各种各样的原创车型，让180SX成为了一款丰富多彩的特别车型。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Making its debut in 1969, the Fairlady Z was among the first Japanese automobiles to make a mark on the international stage. The standout variant was the Z 432, which featured the S20 inline-6 DOHC engine—borrowed from the Prince R380—rather than the standard L-type unit. The 240Z, the U.S.-spec version powered by a 2.4-liter engine, helped cement the Z’s reputation after strong showings in the Safari and Monte Carlo rallies.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1969年问世的Fairlady Z是首批征战国际舞台的日本车型之一。标志性车型Z 432弃用标准的L型引擎，转而采用源于Prince R380的S20直列6缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎。这台动力输出达160 PS的引擎也被投入到了赛车比赛中。240Z是搭载2.4升引擎的美规车型，这台车在东非拉力赛与蒙特卡洛拉力赛上的成功更是让“Z”成为跑车代名词。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its 'G-nose' and fender flares, this car epitomized Japanese sports car cool in the 1970s.

*The Nissan Fairlady Z was sold as the Nissan Z in markets outside of Japan.

Near the end of the 1960s, Japanese cars made a name for themselves on the international stage. One of these examples was the Datsun 240Z that was introduced in 1969. Yutaka Katayama, the president of Nissan North America at the time, convinced the Japanese brass that "now was the time for real sports cars," to challenge those from Europe. Thus, the Z was born.

Among the more notable Zs was the 432. While other Zs were equipped with the Type L engine, the 432 came equipped with the S20, a DOHC inline-6 lifted from the Prince R380. The "4" stood for 4 valves per cylinder, the "3" for 3 twin-choke carburetors, and "2" represented the engine's 2 camshafts. Output of the engine was rated at <160ps> and <18.0kgm> of torque.

This 432 also had a 432R racing spec model that sported a carbon-fiber hood for weight reduction. Only 30 of these cars were made.

A considerable amount of work went into making the 432. The S20 was known to be a delicate powerplant that only the Nissan mechanics at Oppama could get the most out of.

On the other hand, the 2.4-liter Type L engine in the U.S.-spec 240Z was easy to work with, and its ability to provide plenty of torque throughout the rpm spectrum made it popular for racers. The 240Z performed well in safari races and notable off-road events such as the Monte Carlo Rally, as well as those on tarmac racing circuits.

Thanks to its high level of performance, the 240Z made it to Japan in 1971, marketed there as the Fairlady Z. A special version of the car called the 240ZG, referred to as the "G nose," added to the car's popularity, solidifying its place in the history books as one of the most popular and longest-tenured sports cars ever.

long.zh:
*在日本以外的地区，日产Fairlady Z改以日产240ZG的名字投放市场。

60年代末，日本车逐渐在国际市场上获得了认可。Fairlady Z在1969年的亮相也为这场风潮起到了推波助澜的效果。时任日产北美总裁的片山丰成功说服日本总部“现在是开发真正跑车的最佳时机”，并最终推出一款与能欧洲车叫板的车型。Z系列的历史就此拉开帷幕。

Z系列的标志性车型当属432。在其他Z系列车型还在使用L型引擎时，432却得到了一台王子R380上使用的双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎。命名中的4代表每个气缸有4个阀门，3代表3个双腔式化油器，而2则代表一对凸轮轴。这款车型能够输出<160ps>，最大扭矩可达<18.0kgm>。

432还有一款赛车版本，名为432R。为了降低车重，采用了纤维强化塑胶引擎盖，仅仅生产了30台。

为了达到如此高的性能，颇费了一番苦心。因为S20是一台相当敏感的引擎，据说只有日产追浜工厂的工程师才能让其发挥出真正的威力。也因此，日产逐步将赛车开发的重心放到了240Z身上。

美版的240Z搭载的是一台2.4升L型引擎，优点是腔体更结实，调校更便利，加速时的转速区间也更宽松。这款车型在各种国际越野赛事和拉力赛事中均表现出色。

优异的表现帮助240Z得以在日本市场销售。1971年推出的240ZG以其长长的前鼻和宽轮眉成为大热车型，一时间让Z系列成为了跑车的同义词。

60年代末，日本车逐渐在国际市场上获得了认可。Fairlady Z在1969年的亮相也为这场风潮起到了推波助澜的效果。时任日产北美总裁的片山丰成功说服日本总部“现在是开发真正跑车的最佳时机”，并最终推出一款与能欧洲车叫板的车型。Z系列的历史就此拉开帷幕。

Z系列的标志性车型当属432。在其他Z系列车型还在使用L型引擎时，432却得到了一台王子R380上使用的双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎。命名中的4代表每个气缸有4个阀门，3代表3个双腔式化油器，而2则代表一对凸轮轴。这款车型能够输出<160ps>，最大扭矩可达<18.0kgm>。

conversation.en:
Design-wise, the Z34 sports a more classic look
than the Z33.

First of all, its wheelbase has been shortened
by <100mm>...

Giving it long-nose proportions.

And the shape of its roof, with the window decal
at the very front...

Is consciously taken from the S30.

In contrast, the massive rear fender, which squeezes
the shape of the body from front to rear...

Lends to it an aggressiveness never before
seen in a Z-car.

Of course, it wasn’t easy evolving the Z33's styling.

But in short, if the Z33 evoked modern elegance...

The Z34 was more of an authentic FR sports car
with added aggressiveness.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。

首先，轴距缩短了<100mm>……

显得车头相对更长。

其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……

则特意延续了S30的设计风格。

相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……

令它看上去更具有攻击性。
这是之前的Z系列中所罕见的。

当然了，对Z33的外型进行迭代并非易事。

简而言之，如果Z33给人以现代的优雅感……

Z34则更像是一款地道的前置后驱跑车，
而且更具攻击性。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Unveiled in 2008, the sixth-generation Fairlady Z (Z34) was an all-new model, although it retained a strong resemblance to its Z33 predecessor. Built on the same platform as the V36 Skyline Coupé, it featured a lighter chassis paired with a series of performance enhancements. At its core was the VQ37VHR engine, delivering an impressive 331.4 HP. Suspension and braking systems were also finely tuned, underscoring the model’s performance-focused character.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2008年推出的第6代Fairlady Z （Z34）虽与前代Z33在外观上神似，实则为全面改款。这台车与V36型Skyline的双门轿跑共享研发平台，但车身更轻、性能更强。VQ37VHR引擎动力输出达336 PS。这款性能车型还对悬挂与刹车进行了优化。
officialDetails.heroEn: A shortened wheelbase plus larger engine equals driving fun in this sixth-gen Z car.
officialDetails.heroZh: 排量提高，缩短轴距，第6代Fairlady z更专注驾驶体验。

brandCentral.en:
This sixth-generation 2009 370Z was known in-house as the Z34.

It came with a redesigned naturally-aspirated 3.7-liter V-6.

This engine produced <336ps>, which represented a significant
bump from the 3.5-liter unit of its predecessor.

It came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox
with a new rev-matching technology.

Called SynchroRev, it automatically matched engine speed
to wheel speed during downshifts.

This allowed the driver to perform perfect downshifts without
having to employ a technique called heel-and-toe.
brandCentral.zh:
这款第六代2008 Fairlady Z也被称为Z34。

其全新设计的3.7升V6自然进气引擎……

可提供<336ps>的最大输出功率，远远超过其前作Z33……

还有六速手动变速箱采用的技术也是前所未有的。

这项技术能够在每次车手换档时自动调整引擎的旋转……

不需要车手的跟趾动作，就能实现顺滑的降档补油！

usedCar.en:
The 370Z, called the Fairlady Z in Japan, is shorter than
its predecessor, the 350Z, but just as good looking.

Its shortened wheelbase helps it to be more agile, making it
easy to control on the race track.

But don't worry if you think that its small body results
in less stability, because that isn't the case at all.

In fact, the car actually feels more solid through corners
and remains composed in a straight line at high speeds.

And don't forget about the powerful 3.7-liter naturally-aspirated
V-6 under its hood, which pumps out more than <330ps>.
usedCar.zh:
370Z——在日本本土被为“Fairlady Z Z34”的车型。
相较350Z，它的轴距和车长更短。

这不仅使得该车的外观显得更加圆润、灵巧，
还令这辆车的过弯性能变得更迅敏。

别担心，这辆车的稳定性并没有
因此减退分毫。

它搭载的3.7升自然吸气V6引擎动力澎湃，
能产生超过<330ps>的马力。

如果这是你的第一辆后驱车，
那你大可放心开着它驰骋！

catch.en: A shortened wheelbase plus larger engine equals driving fun in this sixth-gen Z car.
catch.zh: 排量提高，缩短轴距，第6代Fairlady z更专注驾驶体验。

vehicleCollection.en:
A shortened wheelbase plus larger engine equals driving fun in this sixth-gen Z car.

When the sixth-generation Fairlady Z, the Z34, was introduced in December 2008, most people assumed that the car would be just a mildly updated version of the Z33 that revived the Z car in January 2002. The 370Z, as we knew it, appeared relatively the same; however, upon closer inspection, it became evident that this was an all-new car.

Built atop the E platform that also serves as the foundation of the Infiniti "Skyline" G37, the new Z featured an aluminum hood, door and rear hatch that kept the car's curb weight about the same as the previous vehicle (around <1500kg>). The new Z was nimble, thanks to a wheelbase that was <100mm> shorter and retuned suspension system that consisted of a double-wishbone setup in front and multilink at rear.

Under the hood was a more powerful engine, the VQ37VHR with VVEL. VVEL was a mechanism that varies the operating angle and lift of the valves for improved power and lower emissions. With <200cc> more displacement, the new V6 pumped out <336ps>/<7000rpm> and <37.2kgm> of torque that peaked at <5200rpm>. The engine came mated to either a quick-shifting 6-speed automatic transmission, or a revolutionary 6-speed manual gearbox equipped with the world's first synchro rev control mechanism. This system automatically adjusted engine rpm when downshifting, eliminating the need to heel and toe.

Thus, the Z34 became a true enthusiast sports car that even novices could drive effectively.

Built atop the E platform that also serves as the foundation of the Infiniti "Skyline" G37, the new Z featured an aluminum hood, door and rear hatch that kept the car's curb weight about the same as the previous vehicle (around <1500kg>). long.zh:
属于第6代的Fairlady Z，Z34登场于2008年12月。它是于2002年1月成功回归的5代车型Z33的继任者。

因为外观设计方面全面沿袭大获成功的Z33，所以人们会误以为这是Z33的小改款，其实不然。Z34的改动是全方位的。这款车型与V36 Skyline轿跑共享E平台，高度关注车辆的安全性能。引擎盖、车门和后箱盖的材质更换成了铝，以确保车重与前代的<1480kg>-<1530kg>相当。轴距相比Z33缩短了<100mm>，但操控性能得到了优化。

动力单元来自配备VVEL技术的VQ37VHR引擎，前者能够在引擎工作时调节气阀的工作角度和工作高度。这台引擎的最大输出是<7000rpm>下的<336ps>，最大扭矩则是<5200rpm>时的<37.2kgm>。

传动系统分别提供了一款6速自动变速箱，在切换至手动模式时的换挡速度也名列前茅，另一款6速手动变速箱则应用了全球首款同步转速控制技术，在换挡时无需车手跟趾降档补油，而是能自动将引擎转数调节至最优转速范围。

双叉臂前悬挂和多连杆后悬挂，以及前四后二的铝合金对置活塞卡钳在调校后可提供最大限度的操控性能。

纵观Fairlady Z的全部历史，这是在研发过程中对驾驶体验投入最多关注的一款车型。

Its wider body allowed for a broader track, unlocking improved cornering capabilities. in its home market.

vehicleCollection.en:
With its tidy exterior design, this 4th-gen Z car was a handsome sports car for the global market.(

*The Nissan Fairlady Z was sold as the Nissan 300ZX outside Japan.

The Z32, appearing in 1989, was the first complete transformation for the Fairlady Z. It came in a wide, flat body, turning 180 degrees from the narrow, long body designs that lasted 3 generations. It was sized as a global sports car, not restricted by the size classes of the Japanese market.

Its steering characteristics were changed drastically. As soon as the steering wheel is turned, the nose slices into the corner, and the wide tread gave it a high level of potential. This Z opened new doors as a cornering machine, while maintaining its performance as a GT. Again, the Z dropped European thoroughbreds into a hole of despair.

At the heart of this car was a compact V6 with a low center of gravity. Even though it is an FR, it was given a front midship layout with the engine located as far back as possible, to make the front/rear weight distribution close to 50:50. Aiming for the global market, the engine size was fixed at 3 liters, and producing <230ps> in the NA, and <280ps> in the twin turbo, its performance decorated the end of the 20th century. Its suspension used advanced designs as well, and even features like an ABS that does not transfer shock to the brake pedal, were things that went beyond the usual standards of the time.

In 1992, a convertible model was added to the lineup, and was greatly welcomed in its main market of California.

long.zh:
*在日本以外的地区，日产Fairlady Z改以日产300ZX的名字投放市场。

1989年亮相的Z32标志着Fairlady Z的彻底转身，车身设计从延续3代的纤细颀长转为低平的宽体设计。不再受制于日本市场对于车型尺寸的限制，紧跟国际市场的跑车标准。

相应的，车辆的驾驶特性也发生了翻天覆地的变化。当转动方向盘时，车鼻可以灵巧地切入弯道，再加上更宽的车胎带来高抓地力。这款Z32为Z系列打开了一扇新大门——在保持超级跑车性能的同时，打造出一台强大的过弯机器，也让欧洲的竞争对手们如坠冰窟。

这辆车的心脏是一台紧凑的V6引擎，车身重心相当得低。这是一辆前置后驱车，却采用了类似中置引擎前移的车身布局，将引擎位置尽量后挪，以达到车身前后配重为50:50的均衡配比。因为面向国际市场，引擎排量被定在了3.0。自然进气<230ps>和双涡轮<280ps>的动力参数在20世纪末期可谓鹤立鸡群。悬挂方面也应用了当时的先进设计，甚至超前引入了防抱死刹车系统，以避免将刹车时震动传回到制动踏板。

在1992年，产品线中又添加了一款敞篷车型，在Z系列的主要市场加利福尼亚州尤为受到欢迎。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 1969 as the top-grade variant of the Fairlady Z, the Z 432 was powered by the S20 inline-6 DOHC engine, producing 157.8 HP. Based on the powerplant of Nissan’s R380 race car, the engine gave the car a zero-to-1312.3 ft time of 15.8 seconds and registered a top speed of 130.5 mph. The Z 432 also proved itself in competitive racing. A lightweight version—the Z 432 R—was produced in limited numbers, featuring fiberglass panels and acrylic components to shed weight.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Z 432在1969年作为Fairlady Z的顶配版推出，搭载直列6缸双顶置凸轮轴“S20”引擎（160 PS）。该引擎源自Nissan R380赛车，0-400 米加速时间为15.8秒，最高时速达210 公里/小时。这台引擎也被投入到了赛车比赛中。此外，还有一款采用玻璃纤维与亚克力材料进行部件减重的Z 432 R车型，但销量寥寥。

collection.en:
The first model of the Nissan Z series was known
as the type S30.

Of all the S30s, this Z432 is particularly special.

With a classic Z-series design...

It is powered by the same S20 2L inline six-cylinder
engine seen in the Skyline GT-Rs of its day.

The four valves per cylinder...

Three carburettors...

And two cams don’t just prove its high performance.

These numbers are also the origin of the 'Z432'
model name.

The fact that it had a GT-R engine was reflected i its
price, more than double that of standard S30s.

Furthermore, only 419 of the Z432s were produced,
making it the most valuable of the first-gen Zs.

There was also a higher performance competition model
of the Z432, the Z432R.

An extremelyrare variant, it tends to fetch a very
handsome price at auctions.
collection.zh:
Nissan Z系列的第一款车型被称为type S30。

在所有S30车型中，Z432显得格外耀眼。

在保留了Z系列经典设计的同时……

它搭载了当时同样用于Skyline GT-R的
S20 2升直列六缸引擎。

这款引擎每个气缸有4个阀门……

3个化油器……

和2个凸轮，足以保证它的高性能。

这些数字也是“Z432”车型名称的来源。

配备GT-R同款高性能引擎的代价反映在其售价上，
它的定价是标准S30的两倍以上。

此外，Z432只生产了419辆，
使其成为所有第一代Z系列中最有价值的车型。

Z432还推出过一款性能更出色的竞赛版，
即Z432R。

其存世量极少，当它出现在拍卖会上时
hk能拍出相当可观的价格。

vehicleCollection.en:
This special Datsun Z was equipped with the same engine as the Skyline GT-R.

In 1969, Nissan completely transformed the Fairlady brand from that of a classic open-top roadster into a classy fixed-roof sports car that went by the name 240Z in many parts of the world. A performance-oriented version of this car was created, called the Z 432.

The car's name referred to its engine, namely its 4 valves, 3 carburettors and 2 camshafts. While the base car came with the L20, a SOHC inline-6, the Z 432 was powered by the L20, which was in fact a detuned version of the <220ps> GR8 engine used in the R380 prototype race car. In the Z 432, it produced <160ps>, which was the same as the previously released Skyline GT-R version.

This made the special Z car quick — a 0-<400m> time of 15.8s and top speed of <210km/h> — making for an ideal race car, but only a limited number of a pure race versions of the car, called the Z 432R, were made. It featured fibrerlass and acrylic components that decreased its weight by <100kg>. Today, the car is a prized collector's item with an example rumored to have fetched $800,000 at auction. .

long.zh:
1969年，日产Fairlady从传统的双座敞篷车变为了激进的斜背车造型。新的Fairlady “Z”系列的顶级型号为高性能的Z 432。

这款车最大的特色是它的引擎。基础款Z使用L20顶置单凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，只有Z 432配备了双顶置凸轮轴的S20引擎——日产R380原型赛车上使用的<220ps>GR8引擎的量产性能调低版本，它的动力输出和此前发售的Skyline GT-R一样，达到了<160ps>。车名中的“432”则代表了引擎配置：4个气阀、3个化油器和双凸轮轴。

这款车的0-<400m>成绩为15.8秒，极速可达到<210km/h>，在当时算是相当快的车型了。凭借如此优异的性能，它在面世一年后便登上了赛车舞台，并一举收获多个冠军头衔。

日产后来还推出了赛车版本Z 432 R，但销量寥寥。日产在赛车版本上应用了玻璃纤维和亚克力部件，让车重减轻了<100kg>。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: An enhanced version of the Z33 Fairlady Z arrived in 2007. At its heart was the new VQ35HR engine, which raised output to 308.7 HP. A redesigned intake manifold and reduced internal friction refined the engine’s character, especially at high revs. Revised suspension settings further contributed to a flatter, more composed ride, while maintaining the car’s trademark agility.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这台车是2007年发布的Z33 Fairlady Z的改进版。全新的VQ35HR引擎将动力输出提升至313 PS，进气歧管的改进和摩擦的降低改善了引擎高转速时的体验。悬挂设定改进后让车身姿态更加平稳、灵活。

brandCentral.en:
This fifth-generation Nissan Fairlady Z was codenamed Z33.
We know it better as the 350Z.

The Z was temporarily discontinued in 2000 with the 300ZX,
codenamed Z32.

It was revived in 2002 with the 350Z.

This specific model is from 2007, and it features massive
improvements to its naturally-aspirated V-6 powerplant.

In fact, this little beauty is capable of more than <300ps>
with added torque to make it quick off the line.
brandCentral.zh:
这款第五代日产Fairlady Z在日本被称为Z33，
而在日本以外地区则被称为350Z。

在90年代末和21世纪初之间，
Fairlady或“Z-car”系列逐渐退出了市场……

而现在，Z系列将因为新350Z的出现得以复苏！

这一车款是2007年推出的，
特点是对自然进气的V6引擎进行了大规模改进。

事实上，由于扭矩的增加，
这辆娇小尤物的动力已经超过了<300ps>！

usedCar.en:
The Nissan 350Z—known as the Fairlady Z (Z33) in Japan—
is impressive on both road and track.

With a naturally-aspirated engine that sends power to the
rear wheels, balance is the name of its game.

The 3.5-liter V-6 was retuned for this 2007 model.

So it possesses better top-end performance, partly because
the redline was raised.

The end result was the company's first naturally-aspirated
V-6 capable of producing more than <300ps>.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan 350Z——这款在日本本土被称为“Fairlady Z (Z33)”
的车子，几乎就是为赛道而生的。

这要归功于它搭载的大排量自然吸气引擎和
后驱系统。

2007年版的350Z搭载了重新设计的V6引擎。

改进版引擎的动力更强，转速区间更高。

这也是Nissan生产的第一款马力达到<300ps>
以上的自然吸气V6引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
This refined Z33 model came powered by the next-generation VQ35HR engine.

Nissan's legendary sports car, the "Fairlady Z," disappeared from the catalog lineup in the summer of 2000, but Nissan President Carlos Ghosn knew full well the importance of this car and had secretly given the go-ahead for the new generation model. In July of 2002, the new Z33 Z-car made its debut.

It shared its base frame and the V6 3.5-liter VQ35DE engine with the V35 Skyline, but it produced <280ps> and <37.0kgm> of torque. It also came with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

The new Z continued to evolve in the following years. One major advancement was made in January 2007, when the engine was changed to the new generation VQ35HR, improving power output to <313ps>. The intake manifold was completely redesigned, and the friction within the engine was reduced. By further improving the crankshaft section, the engine revved more freely. Also, the exhaust note was tuned to give off a deep and low sound, reminiscent of a V-8 engine. The designers added a power bulge to the car's hood to show the Z's extra power.

The engineers heavily modified the car's suspension, improving absorption of the road surface and delivering a flatter cornering character. These changes translated to better overall handling feel and enhanced race-track performance.

long.zh:
在2000年夏天，传奇的日产Fairlady Z突然在日产的产品名录中消失了。但日产充分意识到这台车的历史渊源和重要性，因此私下里批准了新一代车型的开发。在2002年7月，全新的Fairlady Z33正式亮相，

配备6速手动变速箱，并与V35 Skyline共享基础车架和3.5升的V6引擎VQ35DE，而且这台引擎的出力首次被调校到了<280ps>和<37.0kgm>扭矩。

随后的几年里，日产开发部门将“不断演进”的口号落到了实处，持续对Z系列进行改进提升。在2007年的重大改进中，新一代的VQ35HR引擎被用到了Z33上，将马力输出提高到了<313ps>。进气歧管得到了重新设计，以降低引擎内的摩擦。而对曲轴的改进大大提高了引擎的转速体验，给人以动力强劲又细致入微的跑车感受。排气声沉稳有力，仿佛出自大排量V8引擎一般。此外，引擎盖中央的隆起仿佛也在强调着变化。

悬挂设定经过重大改动后提升了对路面反馈的吸收，并能保持车身行驶时的平面稳定性，帮助营造出自然的操控感。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: After a surprise return to competition, the Nissan GT-R made its debut in the 2008 Super GT Championship. In preparation for upcoming regulation changes, the car received a pipe frame chassis and equipped with the same 4.5-liter V-8 previously used in the Z. The XANAVI NISMO demonstrated remarkable pace from the opening round and ultimately secured the drivers’ championship title.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 在完成令人惊喜的回归后，Nissan GT-R开始参加2008赛季Super GT锦标赛。为了针对下一年的规则改动提前做好准备，这款车采用了管式框架车身，并安装了一台沿用自Z车型的4.5升V8引擎。从第一轮起，Xanavi Nismo便展现出了不可思议的实力，并一路势如破竹般拿下了车手冠军。
officialDetails.heroEn: This very fast GT-R scored wins at Suzuki, Okayama, and Autopolis in the 2008 Super GT.
officialDetails.heroZh: 第一款符合新规则的GT-R，以压倒性的速度回应了车迷的期待。

brandCentral.en:
The 2008 Nissan Xanavi Nismo GT-R has certainly made its
mark on Super GT history.

This is the car that brought Nissan victory in the 2008
championship!

It comes with a 4.5L V8 engine that's based on the VK45DE...

And unlike the four-wheel drive GT-R, this model features
a front-engine, rear-wheel drive layout.
brandCentral.zh:

此车配备了基于VK45DE引擎改造而成的4.5L V8引擎……

而且与四轮驱动的GT-R不同，这款车型采用的是前置发引
擎、后轮驱动的布局。

catch.en: This very fast GT-R scored wins at Suzuki, Okayama, and Autopolis in the 2008 Super GT.
catch.zh: 第一款符合新规则的GT-R，以压倒性的速度回应了车迷的期待。

vehicleCollection.en:
This very fast GT-R scored wins at Suzuki, Okayama, and Autopolis in the 2008 Super GT.

When the all-new R35 GT-R made its debut in the Fall of 2007, it was obvious that Nissan intended its supercar to go racing. The company didn't waste much time making its official announcement. Only a month after the GT-R went on sale, Nissan told the Japanese press that the new GT-R would compete in the Super GT Series, the most popular race series in Japan, perhaps all of Asia.

Specifically developed with 2009 vehicle regulations in mind, this race-ready Nissan GT-R featured an innovative construction design that centered on the cabin. While its overall appearance was similar to that of the production GT-R, the race car was a completely different animal.

The engine was a 4.5-liter V8 based on the VK45DE, the power plant in the Fairlady Z GT race car from the previous year. It was reported to produce more than <500ps>.

In competition, the number 23 Xanavi Nismo GT-R piloted by Satoshi Motoyama and Benoît Tréluyer, showed incredible performance from the opening round of the car's maiden season, winning the first two races. In the end it won a total of three races, good enough to bring the team the drivers' title in 2008.

In all, five GT-Rs competed in the Super GT series that year. The GT-R finished 1-2 in the opening round at Suzuka, and won a total of seven out of that year's nine races, meeting, and perhaps exceeding, the expectations of Nissan and GT-R fans all over Asia.@

long.zh:
R35 日产GT-R于2007年秋季发布后，紧接着就在12月开始销售。2008年1月，这款刚上市不久的新GT-R就宣布会自本赛季起参加日本最受欢迎的超跑比赛“Super GT”系列赛。

这款车型提前根据将于2009年颁布的汽车法规进行研发，将原型车的车顶和立柱直接与由管式车架和部分座舱室组成的主底盘相连。也因此，虽然前饰板和车顶曲线依然有着GT-R的影子，但外观和感受都与普通的GT-R大不相同。

引擎是一款源自Super GT参赛车型Fairlady Z的VK45DE 4.5升V8引擎，最大动力输出超过<500ps>。R34 Skyline在参加全日本GT锦标赛时，将传动系统从四驱更改为前置后驱。

由本山哲和伯努瓦·特雷吕耶驾驶的23号Xanavi Nismo GT-R赛车代表NISMO车队参赛，在首轮比赛中就有惊人表现，夺下冠军，随后又趁势赢下了第二轮比赛。

两位车手在赛季中总共夺得3场比赛冠军，最终获得了2008年的车手总冠军。在这个赛季的Super GT中共有5辆GT-R参赛，他们在铃鹿举办的首轮比赛中包揽冠亚军，并在当年的9场比赛中赢下了7场，向广大车迷交出了一张满意的答卷。其中有接近半数的胜利是由Xanavi Nismo GT-R取得的。

第一款符合新规则的GT-R，以压倒性的速度回应了车迷的期待。

R35 日产GT-R于2007年秋季发布后，紧接着就在12月开始销售。2008年1月，这款刚上市不久的新GT-R就宣布会自本赛季起参加日本最受欢迎的超跑比赛“Super GT”系列赛。

这款车型提前根据将于2009年颁布的汽车法规进行研发，将原型车的车顶和立柱直接与由管式车架和部分座舱室组成的主底盘相连。也因此，虽然前饰板和车顶曲线依然有着GT-R的影子，但外观和感受都与普通的GT-R大不相同。

collection.en:
The Nissan Skyline GT-R has a storied racing history.

It established a tradition that was carried on by the
second-generation GT-R.

The 1999 Pennzoil Nismo GT-R was powered by
the RB26DETT, an inline-6 engine.

It won the All Japan Grand Touring Championship.

It remains one of the most consistent race cars to
ever wage war in the competitive series.

While the R34 GT-R took the title again
in 2003, which was its final year...

...the battle-tested engine under its hood had lready
been swapped in favor of a V-6 powerplant.

This means that this 1999 Pennzoil was the last GT-R
to win the series title with the iconic inline-6.

There's just something special about this inline-6-powered model.
For me, its achievements ae nothing short of legendary.
collection.zh:
日产Skyline GT-R曾拥有过一段传奇般的赛车历史。

它确立了这一传统，且在第二代GT-R上
得以延续。

1999年的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R由一台直列6缸RB26DETT引擎
提供动力，

一举夺得了全日本GT锦标赛冠军。

在这一年中，它表现出了坚如磐石的性能，
证明了自己是天生赢家。

当它在2003年再次夺冠时，
这一代GT-R也步入了末年，

连引擎都已经换成了新的V6引擎。

这意味着这台1999年的Pennzoil是最后一台搭载Nissan标志性
直列6缸引擎赢得系列赛冠军的GT-R。

这款直列6缸车型非常特殊。在我看来，
它的成就本身已是个传奇。

vehicleCollection.en:
This JGTC machine gained its edge by lowering the center of gravity and shortening the wheelbase.

Nissan originally conceived the Skyline GT-R R32 as a Group A race car, but when Group A racing went defunct, Nissan found a new series for its prized car, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC). The GT-R later underwent a full redesign as the R33, and performance of this new car on the track was impressive to say the least. However, as Nissan's main rival, Toyota, started contesting with a faster version of the Supra, and Honda added more heat when it joined the series in 1997, the GT-R was losing its grasp on JGTC dominance.

Although Nissan took both the Drivers' and Constructors' championship titles in 1998, the company switched to the new R34 in 1999 as the foundation for its race car. The new GT-R rode on a <55mm> shorter wheelbase than the R33, making it more agile than its predecessor. Also a shallower oil pan and the fuel tank relocated inside the cabin accounted for better weight distribution.

The new revived GT-R found itself in far fiercer competition than anticipated, and didn't score its first win until the fourth race of the season.

The GT-R was unable to log a second win that year, but collected enough points on the strength of its reliability to give Érik Comas, driving the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R, the Drivers' championship title for the second year in a row before the final race was even run.

long.en:
Nissan originally conceived the Skyline GT-R R32 as a Group A race car, but when Group A racing went defunct, Nissan found a new series for its prized car, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC). The GT-R later underwent a full redesign as the R33, and performance of this new car on the track was impressive to say the least. However, as Nissan's main rival, Toyota, started contesting with a faster version of the Supra, and Honda added more heat when it joined the series in 1997, the GT-R was losing its grasp on JGTC dominance.

Although Nissan took both the Drivers' and Constructors' championship titles in 1998, the company switched to the new R34 in 1999 as the foundation for its race car. The new GT-R rode on a <55mm> shorter wheelbase than the R33, making it more agile than its predecessor. Also a shallower oil pan and the fuel tank relocated inside the cabin accounted for better weight distribution.

The new revived GT-R found itself in far fiercer competition than anticipated, and didn't score its first win until the fourth race of the season.

The GT-R was unable to log a second win that year, but collected enough points on the strength of its reliability to give Érik Comas, driving the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R, the Drivers' championship title for the second year in a row before the final race was even run.
long.zh:
参照A组别赛车规则设计的R32 GT-R在A组别赛事停办后，转而投入到全日本GT锦标赛的竞争行列当中。为此，GT-R推出了全新设计的R33，在赛道的表现依旧强劲。但随着丰田的Supra一骑绝尘，本田的NSX也在1997年加入赛事，GT-R略显臃肿的车身成为了负担。

尽管在1998年的全日本GT锦标赛中，日产依旧收获了车队和车手冠军，但还是决定在1999年将基础车型更新至R34，轴距比R33缩短了<55mm>，带来了更强的竞争力。伴随着新的车身设计，日产为引擎换上了更浅的油底壳，通过压缩引擎高度来降低车身重心。为了应对新规，他们巧妙地将油箱挪到车厢内来优化配重比。

从1999年第一场比赛开始，GT-R便发现赛道上的竞争远超以往，胜利不再唾手可得。R34直到第四站美弥才迎来了首胜，埃里克·科马斯和本山哲驾驶的Pennzoil NISMO GT-R带着无法使用的4档艰难前行，在完赛前的5圈前超越了领先的Supra，拔得头筹。

但在那一年的后续比赛中，GT-R再未获胜，好在凭借稳定性能带来的积分足以帮助科马斯提前一轮蝉联车手冠军头衔。

通过降低重心和缩短轴距来提高速度的JGTC赛车。

参照A组别赛车规则设计的R32 GT-R在A组别赛事停办后，转而投入到全日本GT锦标赛的竞争行列当中。为此，GT-R推出了全新设计的R33，在赛道的表现依旧强劲。但随着丰田的Supra一骑绝尘，本田的NSX也在1997年加入赛事，GT-R略显臃肿的车身成为了负担。

尽管在1998年的全日本GT锦标赛中，日产依旧收获了车队和车手冠军，但还是决定在1999年将基础车型更新至R34，轴距比R33缩短了<55mm>，带来了更强的竞争力。伴随着新的车身设计，日产为引擎换上了更浅的油底壳，通过压缩引擎高度来降低车身重心。为了应对新规，他们巧妙地将油箱挪到车厢内来优化配重比。

从1999年第一场比赛开始，GT-R便发现赛道上的竞争远超以往，胜利不再唾手可得。R34直到第四站美弥才迎来了首胜，埃里克·科马斯和本山哲驾驶的Pennzoil NISMO GT-R带着无法使用的4档艰难前行，在完赛前的5圈前超越了领先的Supra，拔得头筹。

但在那一年的后续比赛中，GT-R再未获胜，好在凭借稳定性能带来的积分足以帮助科马斯提前一轮蝉联车手冠军头衔。

catch.en: Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

vehicleCollection.en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design was not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with <573ps> at <6800rpm> and a maximum torque of <64.6kgm> on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
日产GT-R于2016年4月在纽约国际车展上公布。这是自2007年推出以来对R35 GT-R最大幅度的更新。

外部特征的改变并不仅仅是为了外观，也在很高水平上平衡了空气阻力、下压力和冷却性能。车头前方依然保留了日产的标志性Vmotion前脸。引擎盖刚度进一步提升，以抵消超高车速情况下的变形。全新的前扰流板也可以产生强大的下压力。

这辆车的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎全部由手工打造，最大输出功率已提升到了<573ps>/<6800rpm>，最大扭矩为<64.6kgm>。在改良型6档双离合变速箱的辅佐下，这部引擎可以提供从中到高速度范围的平顺加速。当然，为了争夺世界最佳操控性车的名号，其弯道性能也同样得到了提高。

就如其“深度进化”表现那样，这是一辆代表日本跑车风范的车。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

额外安装的一组四盏雾灯是参加夜间赛事的完美搭档。

嗨。很高兴见到你们。

It's an honour to meet you!

Shiro-san worked on the Nissan Fairlady Z and the GT-R.

He also designed the Isuzu 4200R concept car.

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
能认识您真是太荣幸了！

史郎先生曾经致力于Nissan Fairlady Z和GT-R的设计工作，

还设计了Isuzu 4200R概念车。

conversation.en:
Remember the DeltaWing from the 24 Hours of Le Mans?

Well, this car inherits the spirit of that machine.

It was developed with a truly novel idea, one that sort of
went over the heads of regular folks.

This was an FF car on which designer and engineer
Ben Bowlby was given total control.

And it ended up a simple thing, which I quite like.

The proportions are unique and well-executed,
especially from the rear-quarter view.

This isn't exactly a race version of the GT-R, but after
talking things over with Ben...

It was given a Vmotion grille, and four round taillights,
which added some Nissan GT-R flavour.

Unfortunately, the car faile to perform at Le Mans,
and was scontineda a yer.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
你们记得三角翼吗？
参加过2014年勒芒24小时耐力赛的三角翼？

这辆车就是它的精神继承者。

它运用了完全原创的设计思路，
而且可能有些超出普通人的理解范畴。

我的意思是，这是一辆前置前驱车。设计师兼工程师
本·鲍尔比在打造它的过程中获得了充分的自由。

其结果就是这种朴实无华的外形。
我个人觉得喜欢。

它的比例非常特殊。但效果非常棒，你不觉得呢？
它从侧后方的观赏角度看上去特别震撼。

严格意义上说，它不能算是GT-R的赛车版本，
不过在本和我的通r合作下，

为这款车安装了V动感前格栅，而在其后部g
我们也安Io了r盏圆形尾灯。这些细节为它增加了日产GT-R的风味。

TZ车在勒o未能有所斩,e在一年后VW停产_。

Oh man, I mean, I can't help myself when there's

conversation.en:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about the car Nissan
were entering into Le Mans in 2015!

This GT-R LM NISMO.

The designer, Ben Bowlby, opted for an FF layout, and worked
hard on the aerodynamics.

Unfortunately, however, these innovations didn't pay off.

In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its
fastest rival.

Worse still, in the race itself, two of three cars had to
retire, so only one was able to reach the finish line.

However, even this finisher didn't complete enough laps,
and was officially judged not to have finished!
E
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
听说Nissan要在2015年参加勒芒比赛时，我非常惊讶！

在这辆GT-R LM NISMO上，

设计师本·鲍尔比选择了前置前驱布局，并在空气动力学
方面下了很大功夫。

不幸的是，这些创新并没有得到回报。

在排位赛中，该车比第一名慢了足有20秒。

雪上加霜的是，参加正赛的三辆车中有两辆不得不退赛，
这意味着只有一辆车最终到达了终点。

而且，就连这位通过终点线的车手也因为没有完成足够
的圈数而被判定为未完成比赛！

vehicleCollection.en:
A front-wheel-drive prototype hybrid racer designed by Ben Bowlby.

In the spring of 2014, Nissan Motor Company announced that it would enter the LPM1 hybrid class of the 24 Hours of Le Mans the following year with a race car wearing a GT-R badge. It would mark the return of "the Nissan prototype race car" after a 16-year hiatus—since the R391 in 1999. As if that wasn't newsworthy enough, Nissan revealed at the car's introduction in February 2015 that its new race machine, called the GT-R LM NISMO, possessed a front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout, a concept previously unheard of in prototype race cars.

The mastermind behind the GT-R LM NISMO is none other than Ben Bowlby, the man who created the DeltaWing and ZEOD RC race cars. By mounting the engine in the front, Bowlby claims that it opened up new design possibilities to maximize aerodynamics, thus making the car more efficient at higher speeds.

The body consists of a monocoque chassis and outer panels made of carbon fiber, allowing the car to tip the scales at a light <880kg>. Under the long front nose is a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter direct injection V-6 mated to an energy-recovery system.

The drivers of the car include homegrown talents, Michael Krumm and Tsugio Matsuda; GT Academy graduates Lucas Ordóñez and Jann Mardenborough; former F1 drivers Marc Gené and Max Chilton; and sports car drivers Alex Buncombe, Harry Tincknell and Olivier Pla.

Nissan will run two cars starting from the first round of the FIA World Endurance Championships, and enter three cars in the 24 Hours of Le Mans, with the sole purpose of grabbing the overall title._

long.zh:
在2014年春季，日产汽车公司宣布将于次年参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的勒芒原型车1级混合动力组别比赛，而参赛车辆则是一款GT-R车型。他们在2015年2月公布了他们的新车，并将其命名为“GT-R LM NISMO”。这辆车的革新性结构超出了每个人的想象。这也是自1999年的原型车R391以来，日产在时隔16年之后再次推出的一款原型赛车。这辆车出人意料地将引擎移至车身前方，不仅如此，它还是辆前轮驱动的车。

引擎前置解放了车辆的整体设计，从而在空气动力学方面获得更大的优势。毫无意外，这个特别的想法是由本·鲍尔比提出的，他负责设计了底盘和车身。也是同一个人，设计出了像三角翼和佐德RC这样的赛车。

车身包含一体式底盘和碳纤维制成的外部面板，重量最低只有<880kg>。在长长的前车鼻下安装有一具3升直喷V6双涡轮增压引擎，辅以一套能量回收系统。

这辆车的车手包括日产内部培养的车手迈克尔·克鲁姆和松田次生、跑车浪漫旅学院毕业生卢卡斯·奥多涅斯和扬·马登堡以及他们的导师亚历克斯·邦科姆、前F1车手马克·吉恩和马克斯·奇尔顿，另外还有在赛车界久负盛名的哈里·廷克内尔和奥利维耶·普拉。

日产将在国际汽联举办的世界汽车耐力锦标赛首轮派出两辆车参赛，并会在勒芒24小时耐力赛中派出三辆车参赛，剑指冠军。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 2017 GT-R was a smoother, more refined version of the previous model.

The GT-R NISMO was introduced in 2014 as the high-performance version of the R35 GT-R. It delighted Japanese sports-car enthusiasts as soon as it appeared and remained unchanged until the summer of 2016 when an updated model finally arrived.

The 2017 GT-R NISMO featured structural adhesives that improved body rigidity. Under the hood, new GT3 turbines were added and the engine was slightly tuned, but output was kept at <600ps>/<66.5kgm>. While still a menacing handling machine, the new GT-R felt more civil on public roads, thanks to the Damp Tronic ECU incorporated into the car's suspension.

At first glance, the new GT-R looked similar to the outgoing model, but in fact, major improvements were made to the car's aerodynamics. The addition of rear spoiler and a front under spoiler and bumper with canard shaped fins on both sides resulted in <100kg> more downforce than the standard GT-R at <300km/h>.

long.en:

The 2017 GT-R NISMO featured structural adhesives that improved body rigidity. Under the hood, new GT3 turbines were added and the engine was slightly tuned, but output was kept at <600ps>/<66.5kgm>. While still a menacing handling machine, the new GT-R felt more civil on public roads, thanks to the Damp Tronic ECU incorporated into the car's suspension.

At first glance, the new GT-R looked similar to the outgoing model, but in fact, major improvements were made to the car's aerodynamics. The addition of rear spoiler and a front under spoiler and bumper with canard shaped fins on both sides resulted in <100kg> more downforce than the standard GT-R at <300km/h>.
long.zh:
GT-R NISMO于2014年推出，是R35 GT-R系列中性能最高的车款。自此之后，它始终是一款热门车型，但一直没有进行显著的改进，直到2016年夏季推出的2017款GT-R NISMO为它带来了多项改进。

GT-R NISMO标志性的一体化车身使用结构胶粘剂进一步提高了车身刚性、GT3涡轮的使用以及经过精心调校，可输出<600ps>/<66.5kgm>的引擎基本没有改动。但2017款车型的前车窗框架进行了强化，同时也是对车身刚性的改善。悬挂系统由湿电电控减振器的控制单元进行设定，改善了极限过弯时的舒适性。

另一项重要的改变是空气动力学外观。前下扰流板与保险杆的两侧均安装了鸭翼样式的鳍片，而后扰流板和保险杆则由参与了Super GT公路版的空气动力学设计师打造。这使得时速达到<300km/h>时的下压力相比标准GT-R车型提高了<100kg>。

conversation.en:
The R32 Skyline GT-R is popular the world over, but this NISMO
version is really something else.

NISMO, or "Nissan Motorsport International," is the company's
motorsports division.

It was established in 1984.

Back then, Japan was totally into international touring car races
starring the Super Silhouette and other Nissan greats.

Actually, ever since the 1960s, Nissan’s works team has won
many of Japan’s top grand prix races.

This wealth of experience is what made NISMO possible.

And, with all the work that NISMO put into this GT-R,
you know it was destined to be a legend!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
R32 Skyline GT-R在全世界都非常有人气，但这台NISMO
却有其独特之处。

NISMO即“Nissan国际赛车”的简写，负责管理Nissan的赛车部门。

它成立于1984年。

当时，以“超级剪影”和其他Nissan大赛为代表的
国际房车赛令整个日本都为之痴狂。

事实上，自1960年代以来，Nissan官方车队就登顶了
许多场日本顶级的大奖赛。

这些在比赛中积累的宝贵经验成为了NISMO设计的基石。

只要了解NISMO在这台GT-R中倾注的努力，你就知道
它是一台不折不扣的传奇！

With Group A victory as its target, engineers implemented comprehensive cooling enhancements, replaced the turbocharger’s turbine with a more durable metal unit, and reworked the body to optimize aerodynamics while shedding unnecessary weight. The result was a marked increase in performance, propelling the car to numerous touring car victories not only in Japan, but also across Europe and Australia.

vehicleCollection.en:
A homologation model with 500 cars produced for Group A racing

Nissan's BNR32 Skyline GT-R was created to win touring car races. Armed with the RB26DETT engine with displacement meeting Group A specifications, this all-wheel-drive grand tourer had all the ingredients that went into a high-performance sports machine, including a 4-wheel steering system.

As was expected, a GT-R NISMO version appeared in its second year of production in the form of a Group A homologation model with a limited production of 500 cars.

Compared to the standard GT-R, the GT-R NISMO was equipped with fins above the front grille that increased airflow into the engine room for cooling, as well as air inlet openings in the front bumper. To improve aerodynamic characteristics, the rear end of the side sills had protectors that directed airflow around the rear tires. A small rear spoiler was also added to improve downforce, while the turbos were changed from ceramic to metal. The exhaust manifold was specially redesigned for this car, and to reduce weight the A/C, audio system, and rear wipers were deleted, making the car <30kg> lighter than the base model.

The GT-R NISMO won the top touring car class in Japan, as well as many other famous endurance races throughout Asia, Europe and in Australia. Its mere presence was enough to cause havoc at Group A races all over the world.

Nissan's BNR32 Skyline GT-R was created to win touring car races. Armed with the RB26DETT engine with displacement meeting Group A specifications, this all-wheel-drive grand tourer had all the ingredients that went into a high-performance sports machine, including a 4-wheel steering system.

As was expected, a GT-R NISMO version appeared in its second year of production in the form of a Group A homologation model with a limited production of 500 cars.

Compared to the standard GT-R, the GT-R NISMO was equipped with fins above the front grille that increased airflow into the engine room for cooling, as well as air inlet openings in the front bumper. To improve aerodynamic characteristics, the rear end of the side sills had protectors that directed airflow around the rear tires. A small rear spoiler was also added to improve downforce, while the turbos were changed from ceramic to metal. The exhaust manifold was specially redesigned for this car, and to reduce weight the A/C, audio system, and rear wipers were deleted, making the car <30kg> lighter than the base model.

The GT-R NISMO won the top touring car class in Japan, as well as many other famous endurance races throughout Asia, Europe and in Australia. Its mere presence was enough to cause havoc at Group A races all over the world.
long.zh:
BNR32 Skyline GT-R配备了排量符合A组别规格的RB26DETT引擎，四轮驱动系统不浪费任何一点传输到路面的动力，四轮转向系统则进一步扩展了底盘能力，是一台专为赢得房车比赛而诞生的车型。

在R32推出第二年诞生的GT-R NISMO就是最好的明证——这是一款A组别赛事认证车型，限量生产500台。

与标准版GT-R相比，GT-R NISMO在前格栅上方配备了鳍状翼片，通过增加导入引擎室的气流以强化冷却效果，还在前保险杠上新增了进气风道；为了改善空气动力学特性，侧梁的后端加装了保护罩，以引导后轮周围的气流，车尾也增加了小型后扰流板；涡轮增压器从陶瓷改为金属；排气歧管也是专门设计的；为了减轻重量，空调、音响系统和后雨刷都被省略了，比基础车型减重了足足<30kg>。

GT-R NISMO不仅在日本本土的最高级别客用车比赛中连续登顶，还在欧洲和澳大利亚的多项著名耐力赛中称雄。它在全世界范围的A组别比赛中横扫千军，惊艳了所有人。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 2013, Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi partnered with Schulze Motorsport to take on the Nürburgring 24 Hours. The GT-R GT3 was specially prepared for the race, with support from Polyphony Digital’s technical team. Data gathered from the car’s performance was later used to enhance the realism of Gran Turismo’s simulation engine.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2013年，《跑车浪漫旅》系列制作人山内一典与Schulze Motorsport携手开始合作。依托于Polyphony Digital的技术实力支持，打造出了专门用于参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛的GT-R GT3。从这辆车收集的数据将被用于改进《跑车浪漫旅》的模拟引擎。

brandCentral.en:
The GT-R NISMO GT3 was designed for GT3-class racing
by Nissan's motorsports arm, NISMO.

The car you see here was prepared by a privateer, who
entered it in the Nürburgring 24 Hours in 2013.

And, here's an interesting tidbit, it was driven by

Which is why it comes loaded with simulation data from

You might say it's more than just a car. We consider it
an integral part of Gran Turismo history!

此车由一家私人车队开发，并在2013年参加了纽博格林24

跑车浪漫旅系列游戏的制作人山内一典曾驾驶过此车，

上面甚至还装载了来自跑车浪漫旅的模拟数据。

可以说这不仅仅是一辆车——而是跑车浪漫旅历史

vehicleCollection.en:
Kazunori Yamauchi and this GT-R NISMO GT3 fought hard in the Nürburgring race in 2013. n

In 2012, Nissan introduced the GT-R NISMO GT3 into GT3 racing, a category that has now become the mainstay of GT races. Schulze Motorsport is a private team that fielded this car in the German ADAC GT Masters series.

In 2013, Gran Turismo game producer Kazunori Yamauchi collaborated with Schulze Motorsport for a fourth attempt at the 24 Hours of Nürburgring. The GT-R NISMO GT3 was updated to 2013 specs, and Polyphony Digital set up the car specifically for the Nürburgring using the simulation technology of Gran Turismo. In addition to Yamauchi, drivers taking the wheel included the two Schulze brothers, Tobias and Michael, as well as professional racer Michael Krumm.

Appearing like the production GT-R at first glance, the race car was converted from AWD to rear drive to meet FIA GT3 regulations. Fenders were widened to fit larger tires, and weight was reduced to <1300kg>. Engine output, brake performance, and aerodynamics were also upgraded. In qualifying for the 2013 race, car number 123 recorded the top time, a first for a Japanese car at the Nürburgring, but on race day, the team was plagued by a combination of red flags and mechanical problems. In the end, the 123 GT-R did not have a chance to show its full potential. There was a silver lining; however, the driving data gained from this racing effort significantly advanced the simulation engine of Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
在2012年，日产推出了GT-R NISMO GT3参加当今超级跑车界的主流赛事——GT3组别。私人车队舒尔茨赛车就使用这辆车参加了全德汽车协会超跑大师赛。

在接下来的2013年，跑车浪漫旅系列制作人山内一典与舒尔茨赛车携手合作，第四次参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛。GT-R NISMO GT3也升级到了2013版规格，Polyphony Digital还使用跑车浪漫旅的模拟技术专门针对纽博格林为赛车进行了调校。除了山内一典外，另两位车手是来自舒尔茨赛车的两兄弟，托拜厄斯和迈克尔，以及专业赛车手迈克尔·克鲁姆。

粗略一看，这款GT3赛车和其量产版非常相似，但是为了符合国际汽联GT3规范改成了后轮驱动。挡泥板被设计得更宽，以便使用更宽的比赛用胎，而且重量也减低到了<1300kg>。这次升级还包括引擎输出功率和刹车性能的提升，以及对空气动力学的强化。

在2013年的24小时耐力赛上，123号车曾一度升至排位赛的首位，这可是日本车在纽博格林上首次创此佳绩。只可惜在决赛时，车子遇到红旗和机械故障等影响，没能发挥出其完全的潜力。不过，从这部赛车上收集到的驾驶数据却为跑车浪漫旅模拟引擎的提高提供了很大的帮助。*

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3 was a production-based race machine built to FIA GT3 regulations, derived from the R35 GT-R. Later iterations were based on the GT-R NISMO, incorporating a dry sump system to lower the center of gravity and optimize weight distribution. Enhanced front-end rigidity and a newly designed suspension setup improved handling response. A revised engine bay layout boosted cooling efficiency, contributing to greater stability at high speeds.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3是基于R35 GT-R开发的FIA GT3规格量产赛车。后期又将基础车型更换为GT-R NISMO，后者采用了干式油底壳系统以降低重心并优化配重。强化的前部刚性和全新设计的悬挂系统提升了操控响应度。引擎舱布局的调整提升了散热效率，同时有助于高速行驶下的稳定性。

vehicleCollection.en:
This racing spec version of the GT-R was created for GT3 category competition.

The Nissan GT-R GT3, based on the road-going R35 GT-R, was a familiar presence in the FIA's GT3 class. When the race car was introduced in 2012, it came powered by the same twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-6 as in the production model, with the output of the engine rated well above <500ps>.

A new version of the race car appeared in 2015 with a stiffer body structure and going by a new name: the Nismo GT3. In 2018, a dry sump oil system was incorporated to allow the powerplant to sit lower in the engine bay by <150mm>, giving the car a better overall center of gravity. It was also moved aft by <150mm> to optimize front and rear weight distribution.

The radiators and intercoolers were repositioned to provide enhanced airflow and better engine cooling. By redirecting how the air flowed over the body, the Nismo GT3 possessed improved body stability, while a stiffer front body rigidity and retuned suspension system improved handling.

A new version of the race car appeared in 2015 with a stiffer body structure and going by a new name: the Nismo GT3. In 2018, a dry sump oil system was incorporated to allow the powerplant to sit lower in the engine bay by <150mm>, giving the car a better overall center of gravity. It was also moved aft by <150mm> to optimize front and rear weight distribution.

The radiators and intercoolers were repositioned to provide enhanced airflow and better engine cooling. By redirecting how the air flowed over the body, the Nismo GT3 possessed improved body stability, while a stiffer front body rigidity and retuned suspension system improved handling.
long.zh:
日产GT-R NISMO GT3是由NISMO基于日产R35车型GT-R开发的国际汽联GT3合规量产赛车。

自2012年起，GT3版本的GT-R就已经开始面向消费者发售，但在2015年后，基础车型换成了GT-R Nismo，其特点是提高了车身刚性。2018款的GT-R GT3换上了干式油底壳，使引擎在引擎室中的位置降低约<150mm>，以降低车身的重心；而且引擎还后移了<150mm>，以优化重量分配。

前部车身刚性得到了提升，前后悬挂和构件都进行了重新设计，以提供精准的车身反馈。

引擎室布局也得到了改进，散热器和中间冷却器的位置经过了重新调整，可以提供带来更多气流，获得更好的冷却效果。通过优化气流，高速段的车身稳定性有了长足的进步。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The new regulations for 2014 required the GT500 car to share the same monocoque weight and key components with its DTM counterpart. As a result, the GT-R underwent significant revisions to meet GT500 specifications, with ongoing refinements continuing through to the 2016 model. During the 2014 and 2015 seasons, the MOTUL AUTECH GT-R secured back-to-back series championships. Aiming for a third consecutive title in 2016, the team ultimately concluded the season in third place overall.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2014年实施的全新规则意味着这辆车也会采用与DTM版本相同的单体车壳车重和其他主要部件。这辆GT500规格GT-R加入了多项重大调整。直至2016年，车型经历了不少后续优化。在2014和2015赛季，这辆MOTUL AUTECH GT-R连续两年蝉联系列赛冠军。2016年，车队志在夺取三连冠，但最后仅以第三名的总成绩遗憾完赛。

vehicleCollection.en:
This 2016 Super GT race car was driven by the team of Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie Quintarelli.

Since 2008, Nissan's entry in the GT500 class of the Super GT Series was the R35 GT-R. The car initially came with a 4.5-liter V-8 (VK45DE), then switched to a 3.4-liter V-8 (VRH34A/VRH34B) in 2010. In 2014, it sported yet another new powerplant: a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection (NR20A), independently developed in the same manner as Toyota and Honda.

Because of new regulations in the Super GT Series for the 2014 season, where the weight and center of gravity of the monocoque had to mimic those of DTM machines, the GT500 GT-R underwent major changes under its skin. These changes continued all the way to the 2016 season.

In 2014, four teams competed with the new GT-R, and the Motul Autech team of Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie Quintarelli brought home the series championship that year. The following year saw them repeat the feat bringing home the Driver Championship and the Constructor Championship to Nissan for the second straight year. The streak came to an end in 2016 when, despite winning the first two races of the season, they ended up in 3rd place in both the Driver and Constructor championships.

自2008年起，日产就派出R35 GT-R参加Super GT系列赛的GT500类别比赛，最初的车辆采用4.5升的V8 VK45DE引擎，从2010年起换成了3.4升的V8 VRH34/VRH34B引擎。2014年又改成了2升涡轮增压直列4缸直喷式引擎NR20A，这款引擎的规格与丰田和本田使用的相同，但是独立开发的。

根据2014年新颁布的车辆规范，单体车壳的重量和重心均经过调整以符合德国房车大师赛的车辆要求，避震和后尾翼则需采用通用部件。虽然外观方面没有重大的变化，但统一规范化对GT500规格GT-R的车身内部造成了重大的影响。在对细节进行持续修改和优化后，这款车进一步升级为2016款。

有四支日产车队采用这款GT-R参赛，2014年，松田次生和罗尼·昆达列尼驾驶摩特奥泰克GT-R取得了系列赛冠军。在接下来的2015年，他们以同一支队伍再次夺冠，连续两年赢得车手冠军和车厂冠军。2016赛季他们再次以同一支队伍参赛，在第一、二轮获胜后，三连冠的呼声高涨，但赛季结束时，他们在车手和车厂排位上都只获得了第三名。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 2016, the Nissan GT-R underwent its most significant facelift since its 2007 debut. The updated exterior achieved a refined balance of aerodynamics, downforce, and cooling efficiency. Its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-6 engine, now producing 565.1 HP, was paired with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, delivering smoother acceleration and sharper cornering performance. These deeper, more focused refinements embodied the essence of Japanese sports car engineering.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2016年，Nissan GT-R迎来了自2007年问世以来最大幅度的改款升级。外观设计在空气阻力、下压力和散热性能之间达到完美平衡。同时，输出573 PS的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎配合改进的6速双离合变速箱，带来更顺畅的加速和更优异的过弯表现。这些深层次的进化完美体现了日本跑车的独有特质。
officialDetails.heroEn: Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.
officialDetails.heroZh: 2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

setup, and some key design improvements.

Ignition control has been optimised, resulting in a <20ps>

Maximum power output is now an impressive <570ps>.

Significant changes to the exterior have also been
implemented.

vehicleCollection.en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design was not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with 565 HP at <6800rpm> and a maximum torque of 467 ft-lb on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges. Of course, to be considered the world’s best handling car, the cornering performance has also been improved.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.

日产GT-R于2016年4月在纽约国际车展上公布。这是自2007年推出以来对R35 GT-R最大幅度的更新。

外部特征的改变并不仅仅是为了外观，也在很高水平上平衡了空气阻力、下压力和冷却性能。车头前方依然保留了日产的标志性Vmotion前脸。引擎盖刚度进一步提升，以抵消超高车速情况下的变形。全新的前扰流板也可以产生强大的下压力。

这辆车的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎全部由手工打造，最大输出功率已提升到了<573ps>/<6800rpm>，最大扭矩为<64.6kgm>。在改良型6档双离合变速箱的辅佐下，这部引擎可以提供从中到高速度范围的平顺加速。当然，为了争夺世界最佳操控性车的名号，其弯道性能也同样得到了提高。

就如其“深度进化”表现那样，这是一辆代表日本跑车风范的车。

catch.en: News of the Nissan GT-R R35's demise was evidently greatly exaggerated.
catch.zh: R35 GT-R系列的巅峰之作粉碎了停产的传言。

vehicleCollection.en:
News of the Nissan GT-R R35's demise was evidently greatly exaggerated.

Rumors had circulated that production of the GT-R would conclude with the 2022 model, but in reality, Nissan was still diligently working on further developments. This became evident with the unveiling of the 2024 model at the 2023 Tokyo Auto Salon.

Two significant changes distinguished the 2024 model from its 2022 predecessor. The first was the development of a new muffler system designed to meet the stricter noise regulations that had fueled speculation about the GT-R's discontinuation. This new system successfully reduced unwanted noise and vibrations without compromising engine performance.

The second update was a comprehensive exterior redesign, the first since the 2017 overhaul. The front end now features a horizontal line across the bumper, reminiscent of the iconic R34 GT-R. At the rear, a redesigned bumper and the first modification to the rear wing geometry since the R35's debut subtly push the attachment points further back. These enhancements increased downforce without adding drag.

Beneath the surface, several improvements were also made. For instance, the accelerometers in the electronically controlled suspension was upgraded to more sensitive units, resulting in better traction control and a noticeably smoother ride compared to previous models.

The first was the development of a new muffler system designed to meet the stricter noise regulations that had fueled speculation about the GT-R's discontinuation. The second update was a comprehensive exterior redesign, the first since the 2017 overhaul. The front end now features a horizontal line across the bumper, reminiscent of the iconic R34 GT-R. At the rear, a redesigned bumper and the first modification to the rear wing geometry since the R35's debut subtly push the attachment points further back. long.zh:
此前曾有传言称GT-R的2022年车款将成为系列的绝唱，但实际上日产一直在暗中努力进。在2023年东京汽车沙龙上亮相的2024年款车型粉碎了之前的传言。

与2022年款相比，新车型有两项重大改进。首先是开发了一套全新的排气消音管，可以满足更为严格的噪音限制规定——后者正是此前传闻导致GT-R停产的一大主因。新排气系统成功地降低了不必要的噪音和振动，同时保障了引擎的性能。

其次是对外观进行了重大改动。这是GT-R自2017年重新设计以来的首次大幅更新。前脸采用了横贯保险杠的水平线条设计，令人联想起R34 GT-R的经典造型。车尾则采用了全新设计的保险杠，并且自R35亮相以来首次调整了后扰流板的几何形状，将连接点略微后移。这些改进使得车辆能够在不增加空气阻力的情况下产生更大的下压力。

除了外观上的变化，新款GT-R在技术层面也有诸多升级。例如，电子控制悬挂系统中的加速度传感器被更为灵敏的新设备所替代。这一改进使得车辆的牵引力控制更加精准，路感之前的车型更加平顺，从而大幅提升了乘坐舒适性。

R35 GT-R系列的巅峰之作粉碎了停产的传言。

此前曾有传言称GT-R的2022年车款将成为系列的绝唱，但实际上日产一直在暗中努力进。在2023年东京汽车沙龙上亮相的2024年款车型粉碎了之前的传言。

与2022年款相比，新车型有两项重大改进。首先是开发了一套全新的排气消音管，可以满足更为严格的噪音限制规定——后者正是此前传闻导致GT-R停产的一大主因。新排气系统成功地降低了不必要的噪音和振动，同时保障了引擎的性能。

其次是对外观进行了重大改动。这是GT-R自2017年重新设计以来的首次大幅更新。前脸采用了横贯保险杠的水平线条设计，令人联想起R34 GT-R的经典造型。车尾则采用了全新设计的保险杠，并且自R35亮相以来首次调整了后扰流板的几何形状，将连接点略微后移。这些改进使得车辆能够在不增加空气阻力的情况下产生更大的下压力。

除了外观上的变化，新款GT-R在技术层面也有诸多升级。例如，电子控制悬挂系统中的加速度传感器被更为灵敏的新设备所替代。这一改进使得车辆的牵引力控制更加精准，路感之前的车型更加平顺，从而大幅提升了乘坐舒适性。

This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design were not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with 565 HP at <6800rpm> and a maximum torque of 467 ft-lb on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.

vehicleCollection.en:
Nissan's compact SUV is even better with e-Power.

The Qashqai is Nissan’s C-segment compact SUV, positioned as a cornerstone of the brand’s global lineup. It was launched in 2006 and followed by a second-generation model in 2013. The version featured here represents the third-generation Qashqai, which made its debut in 2021.

With this latest incarnation, the Qashqai continued to evolve. It arrived with a striking redesign, complementing its larger body with a bold, angular aesthetic. Sharp character lines converged toward Nissan’s signature Vmotion grille, giving the front end a confident and modern presence. Underpinning the vehicle is the advanced CMF-C/D3 platform, which enhances both ride comfort and handling.

When it comes to the powertrain, the Qashqai offers more than just conventional gasoline options—it also features Nissan’s innovative "e-Power" series-hybrid system. This setup uses a gasoline engine solely to generate electricity, which then powers an electric motor that drives the wheels. What’s more, the engine at the heart of Nissan’s e-Power system is the world’s first mass-producible variable compression ratio engine. It delivers significantly improved thermal efficiency, resulting in reduced CO₂ emissions.

Tekna denotes one of the higher model grades in the lineup. This trim comes generously equipped, with larger alloy wheels, ambient lighting, and a head-up display—all included as standard.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: With the All Japan GT Championship extending its turbocharger regulations through 1992, Nissan pressed forward with development, culminating in the formidable R92CP. Capable of exceeding 248.5 mph on Fuji Speedway’s main straight and generating up to 3.5 tons of downforce, the R92CP proved unstoppable, winning every race that season and bringing the turbo era to a dominant close.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 在全日本锦标赛决定将旧有的涡轮增压器规定沿用到1992年之后，Nissan也继续开发他们的赛车，直到最后推出了这款R92CP。R92CP在富士高速赛道的直道上跑出了超过400 公里/小时的创纪录极速，同时产生了最高达3.5吨的下压力。它势不可挡地赢下了当个赛季的每一场比赛，为涡轮增压器时代画上了圆满的句号。

collection.en:
This Nissan R92CP is the fastest Group C racing car of them all.

It really is an absolute beast, reaching over <400km/h>
on Fuji Speedway's long straight.

Group C races used to be extremely popular in Japan in their day,

The year after the FIA World Endurance Championship was created,
Japan had already set up its own endurance racing series.

This series was initially dominated by Porsche,

but Nissan and Toyota quickly grew stronger to become
its top contenders.

The R92CP -designed by Nissan's Kazutoshi Mizuno and built
entirely in-house, was developed for the former C1 class,

and its level of maturity as well as its speed
were way ahead of its competition.

Even legendary drivers of Japan such as Kazuyoshi Hoshino ad
Masahiro Hasemi spoke of R92CP's acceleration with dread.
collection.zh:
这辆Nissan R92CP在所有C组别赛车中速度名列榜首！

这辆车绝对是一匹真正的猛兽，曾在富士赛道的长直道
上跑出超过<400km/h>的速度。

C组别的比赛在日本曾经非常流行。

事实上，在FIA创立世界耐力锦标赛的第二年，日本就建
立了自己的耐力系列赛。

这个系列赛最初由Porsche主宰，

但Nissan和Toyota迅速崛起，成为其主要竞争者。

R92CP由水野和敏设计，所有零件均由Nissan自行制造组装，
原本是为了参加曾经的C1组别而开发的。

它的完善度和速度都要远远领先于其竞争对手。

就连日本传奇车手星野一义和长谷见昌弘也对R92CP无可比
拟的加速能力望而生|T

vehicleCollection.en:
Appearing towards the end of Group C's turbo era, this car won every round of the final All-Japan Sports Prototype Championship.

In the 1980s, Group C represented the most competitive arena for GT racing, prompting Nissan engineers to develop a strong engine for this class: a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V-8. This powerplant found a home inside the engine bay of a new, sleek race car called the R89C, which

was co-developed with the British company, Lola.

The R89C waged war in the European World Championships, the American IMSA and the All-Japan GT Championships, as well as the 24 Hours of Le Mans. As Nissan began development on its own chassis to house the powerful engine, those plans were scrapped when the FIA revised the regulations for the Group C class, prohibiting turbocharged engines. So while Nissan began development of a new Group C car for race series abroad, it refined its racer for Japan, where the regulations remained unchanged. The R89C eventually made way for the R92CP. With <900ps> on tap, the car's revised VRH35 engine allowed it to reach <400km/h> on the front straight at Fuji Speedway, generating 3.5 tons of downforce. An even more powerful version was tuned for Le Mans, which pumped out <1200ps>.

The new race car was most successful in Japan, winning all six All-Japan Championship races it entered.

The R89C waged war in the European World Championships, the American IMSA and the All-Japan GT Championships, as well as the 24 Hours of Le Mans. As Nissan began development on its own chassis to house the powerful engine, those plans were scrapped when the FIA revised the regulations for the Group C class, prohibiting turbocharged engines. So while Nissan began development of a new Group C car for race series abroad, it refined its racer for Japan, where the regulations remained unchanged. The R89C eventually made way for the R92CP. With <900ps> on tap, the car's revised VRH35 engine allowed it to reach <400km/h> on the front straight at Fuji Speedway, generating 3.5 tons of downforce. An even more powerful version was tuned for Le Mans, which pumped out <1200ps>.

The new race car was most successful in Japan, winning all six All-Japan Championship races it entered.

在二十世纪八十年代，日产在C组的赛事中投入了大量的精力，并开发了全新的3.5升双涡轮增压V8引擎，同时对该级别的车辆规则做了仔细分析。

他们的这台引擎安装在与英国的罗拉公司合作开发的底盘上。这辆车被命名为R89C，参加了欧洲世界锦标赛、美国国际汽车运动协会赛、全日本锦标赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛。此外，他们还基于R89C开发了自己的底盘，并持续提高车辆性能。

然而，随着国际汽联于1990年修订了C组的车辆规则，决定从1991年开始禁止采用涡轮增压发动机。日产针对新规则开展了新的C组赛车的开发，但同时也注意到全日本锦标赛在1992年年底之前将仍然采用旧的C组规则进行比赛。因此，采用现有涡轮增压发动机的C组赛车得到了延续，R92CP是开发的最后一款车型。

R92CP在1992年的全日本锦标赛上所向无敌。此车以6场比赛全胜的成绩，为涡轮增压C组赛车的时代划上了句号。VRH35引擎官方公布的输出马力为<900ps>以上，并在勒芒赛上证实特殊情况下可以输出<1200ps>。这款R92CP在富士赛道的主要直道上曾达到超过<400km/h>的最大速度，据说此车在第一个弯道减速前仍在继续加速。车身的下压力更是高达3.5吨。

此外，R92CP是一款设计理念前卫的车型，关注改善座舱环境，以减缓驾驶者的疲劳。其压倒性的胜利得益于对耐力赛分析过程中细致的思考和考量。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 180SX was introduced as the liftback version of the S13 Silvia. Although it carried slightly more weight and had reduced rear-end rigidity compared to the Silvia, it quickly gained a following as aftermarket tuning parts became widely available. One of the most iconic customizations was the combination of the 180SX body with the front end of the Silvia, also known as “Sileighty.”
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 180SX是作为S13代Silvia的掀背版本推出的。它比Silvia更重，后部刚性也有所不足，性能上存在差距。但很快就推出了众多改装部件，以便车迷打造属于自己的个性化设定。最著名的改装之一是为180SX换装S13的前脸造型，创造出了被称为“Sileighty”的经典车型。
officialDetails.heroEn: This Nissan blended the 180SX with the appealing front end of the Silvia.

usedCar.en:
How familiar are you with the Sileighty?

This singular Japanese car emerged from the street racing
scene of the 1990s.

It was made possible due to the fact the S13 Silvia and 180SX
share the same base—and thus the same front structure.

'The body of an 180SX, but the face of a Silvia.'—this simple
customisation was remarkably easy to achieve.

And so a unique custom car was born from the playful pursuit
of innovation.

这样简单的改装非常容易实现。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Nissan blended the 180SX with the appealing front end of the Silvia.

The Nissan 180SX — sold as the Nissan 240SX in the U.S. and the 200SX in the EU — was created as the Silvia's sister hatchback model in March 1989. This car, sporting retractable headlights and a glass hatchback, was overshadowed by the coupe at first—despite sharing the same powerplant, a 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 that came available only with a turbocharger. But as time went on, people recognized the true value of the stylish fastback and sales began to climb.

The engine received an upgrade in 1991 to the SR20DET, the same 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the normal Silvia with output rated at <205ps> and <28.0kgm>. This prolonged the 180SX's life span because its production run was initially slated to end alongside the S13 Silvia; however, thanks to the popularity of the 2.4-liter 240SX in the U.S. (that possessed the same body shape of 180SX), Nissan elected to keep the compact rear-drive coupe around.

In 1996, the first normally-aspirated 180SX, the Type S, was added to the lineup. Without forced induction, the Type S lacked the acceleration of the hotter version. This made the car a favorite among tuners, who took things into their own hands, giving the car their own dose of power and beefing the chassis up accordingly. This paved the way for a new 180SX, one that featured the Silvia's front end, making the two cars virtual clones of each other; it was dubbed the "Sil-Eighty."

long.zh:
*日产180SX在美国和欧洲地区分别以日产240SX和200SX发售。

180SX是在1989年3月作为Silvia的姐妹车型推出的一款掀背车，主打上翻式头灯和一体式玻璃的后箱盖。在大热的Silvia的掩盖之下，这款车型在上市后并未激起太多水花。尽管也采用了同款1.8升引擎，但180SX只提供涡轮增压车型。

1991年，在更换了2.0L的SR20DET引擎后，车辆的动力输出变成了<205ps>和<28.0kgm>扭矩。按照原计划，180SX将被大改款后的Silvia直接取代。幸运的是，采用2.4升引擎的240SX在北美地区持续热销，让日产决定在Silvia之外保留180SX产品线。

直到停产前，180SX都与旧的Silvia S13共享基础组件，但时不时的改款使其依然能跟上时代的节奏。因为车重偏重，而且掀背设计导致后部的刚性不足，所以最初大部分人都认为180SX的性能不如Silvia。好在丰富的副厂改装件帮助S180SX轻松克服了这一弱点。到后来，众多爱好者纷纷推出原创特殊改装。这些努力最终也为一台原创车型铺平了道路：当Silvia S13的前段车身被嫁接到S180SX身上后，独一无二的Sileighty就此诞生。

In 1996, it underwent a major facelift, incorporating menacing, slanted headlights and a prominent rear spoiler. The Aero package—available on both K’s and Q’s trims—added distinctive front and rear spoilers, exclusive bumpers, white-faced gauges, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob as standard.

officialDetails.heroEn: The top grade of the S14 adds a rear spoiler and leather wrapped steering wheel.

usedCar.en:
The Silvia is an iconic sports coupe,
produced by Nissan.

This example is the 6th-generation model, which first
appeared in the 1990s and is known as the S14.

This specific car is actually the very last of the S14s
that came out in 1996.

Its design is notably different from earlier models,
with a distinctively sharp look.

The power and torque remained the same as those of its
predecessor, but this K's grade car features a turbo.

And what about the Silvia's drivetrain, you ask?
Well, it's real-wheel-drive, giving it an FR layout.

The turbo engine's max output of <220ps> and the FR layout
makes it suitable for both track racing and drifting.
usedCar.zh:
Silvia是一款标志性的、优雅的双门跑车，由Nissan生产。

该车型来自于二十世纪九十年代初次推出的第六代，
被命名为S14。

我们看到的这一台事实上是S14的最后一作，于1996年推出。

其设计与早期车型有着明显的不同，更加棱角分明。

动力和扭矩数据都和老款相同，但这辆S-14 K's
拥有一台涡轮增压引擎。

那么Silvia的传动系统又如何呢？你可能会问。
好吧，它是一台后驱车，确切地说，是前置后驱。

搭载涡轮增压器的引擎的最大输出马力是<220ps>，
这使它在赛道竞速和漂移中都能游刃有余。

catch.en: The top grade of the S14 adds a rear spoiler and leather wrapped steering wheel.+
catch.zh: 装有后扰流板和皮革包裹方向盘的最顶级S14。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top grade of the S14 adds a rear spoiler and leather wrapped steering wheel.+

The S14 Silvia made its debut in October 1993 as the successor to the hugely successful S13 model. Armed with a new larger body Nissan hoped to continue on its previous successes.

The S14 is <1730mm> wide compared to the S13's <1690> ,and track width was increased. The new model is also <30mm> longer at <4500mm> and <5mm> taller at <1295mm> for an overall larger body. The softer lines of the body design make the wider stance stand out the most. The K's grade model also featured 16-inch wheels as standard.

The engine is a retuned version of the S13's SR20 series. The highest grade K's model features an intercooled turbocharger and produces <15ps> more than the previous generation at <220ps>/<28.0kgm> with the naturally aspirated Q's and J's models producing <160ps>/<19.2kgm>. The basic suspension structure was carried over from the S13, utilizing front struts and a multilink setup at the rear. The car was also available with the Super HICAS electronic rear-wheel steering system.

In 1996, Nissan released a facelift model with an extensive redesign. The exterior's soft image was tightened up with scowling headlights and a large real spoiler was added for a more sharp and striking appearance.

The "Aero" model featured here was added to the Q's and K's lineup in the spring of 1995 as the top-of-the-line model. The exterior features unique bumpers along with front and rear spoilers. The interior received a leather wrapped steering wheel, a new shift knob and white gauge faces. These changes proved to be popular with drivers, and the grade was continued on the facelift model.

As the number of affordable rear-wheel-drive coupes dwindled through the 1990s, the S14 Silvia can be considered a very important car for carrying that design DNA into the next generation. It was also popular overseas where it was sold in North America as the 240SX and in Europe as the 200SX.

S14 Silvia在1993年10月首次推出，是大获成功的S13的后继车型。日产希望它能延续这个系列的成功，为其配备了更大尺寸的新车身。

S14的车身宽度为<1730mm>，较之S13的<1690>略有增加，轮距也进行了相应的增加。另外，新一代车款的车身长度增加了<30mm>，为<4500mm>，车身高度也加高了<5mm>，增加到<1295mm>。可以说，整台车都大了一圈。而且，它车身设计中的柔和线条也更进一步凸显了车身的宽度。此外，其K's型号还标配了16英寸轮毂。

S14 Silvia采用的引擎是基于S13的SR20系列重新调校的版本。最高配置的K's型号还加装了中冷式涡轮增压器，输出功率为<220ps>/<28.0kgm>，比上一代多了<15ps>，而自然进气的Q's和J's型号则可以输出<160ps>/<19.2kgm>的动力。其基础悬挂结构也是直接继承自S13，前轮使用了支撑臂，而后轮使用了多连杆系统。这辆车还配置了一套“超级高性能主动控制转向”电子后轮转向系统。

日产在1996年又推出了经过大量重新设计的改款车型。改掉了原本柔和的外观，改为使用更具压迫性的大灯和大尺寸尾翼，让车身整体更加犀利、更引人注目。

这里登场的“飞空”车型是在1995年春天作为最高级别的配置版本加入到Q's和K's车型中的。其外饰装有独特的保险杠和前后扰流板。内饰采用了皮革包裹的方向盘和换挡杆柄，以及白色的仪表面。这些变化在车手中大受欢迎，所以该级别在后来的改款车型上得到了延续。

由于在90年代市面上价格实惠的后驱双门车型数量大幅减少，S14 Silvia可以说将这种设计理念延续到了下一个世纫，起到了牿剌启后的作用，是一款非常重馁的车型。S14 Silvia在海䤗幟奇受欢迎：它在北美地区以240SX的型号名上市，耍在欧洲地区的型号名则是200SX。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Built between 1988 and 1993, the S13-generation Silvia won over enthusiasts with its nimble handling and well-balanced rear-wheel-drive layout. Among its various trims, the high-performance K’s stood out—powered by a turbocharged DOHC inline-4, the CA18ET—earning a strong reputation for its versatility and performance. Later, the “Dia Selection” was introduced as a more affordable variant.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1988年至1993年生产的S13 Silvia凭借紧凑型后驱布局提供的出色操控性能赢得了无数车迷的喜爱。在Silvia的众多车型中，搭载涡轮增压直列4缸双顶置凸轮轴“CA18ET”引擎的高性能K's版本因其在各种场合下的巨大潜力而备受推崇。后来还推出了“Dia Selection”作为低成本车型。
officialDetails.heroEn: This special S13 had many previously optional items now included as standard equipment.
officialDetails.heroZh: 采用特殊规格的S13 Silvia，加入了众多倍受欢迎的选配配置。

usedCar.en:
Nissan's Silvia has a long and celebrated history.

One of the best-loved Silvia models is the S13,
which was first sold in the 1980s.

This two-door coupé was popular in Japan when it debuted,
and was especially sought after by the younger crowd.

The 1990 'K's' variant boasts a front-mounted 1.8L
straight-four turbo.

With its solid RWD performance, it is everything a driver
could ask for.

Furthermore, its compact body makes it competitive on both
winding roads and traditional circuits.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan的Silvia拥有一段悠久而著名的历史。

20世纪80年代上市的S13
是Silvia中最受欢迎的车型之一。

这款双门轿跑一经亮相便在日本流行了起来，
尤其受年轻人的追捧。

1990年的“K's”型搭载了前置1.8升
直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

凭借其可靠的后驱性能，它将是
车手的理想之选。

此外，其紧凑的车身使得它在蜿蜒的道路和传统的赛道上
都非常具有竞争力。

catch.en: This special S13 had many previously optional items now included as standard equipment.
catch.zh: 采用特殊规格的S13 Silvia，加入了众多倍受欢迎的选配配置。

vehicleCollection.en:
This special S13 had many previously optional items now included as standard equipment.

The Nissan Silvia, called the 240SX in the States, had a loyal following since it was first introduced in 1988 because of its extremely sporty nature and head-turning good looks.

The most popular version was the 5th-generation model, which many felt was the best looking in the car's lineage. Produced from 1988 through 1993 and dubbed the S13, the stylish coupe was also heralded by the media, garnering Japan Car of the Year honors for 1988. It would eventually go on to become the best-selling Silvia ever. The top-of-the-line version was the K model, powered by Nissan's CA18DET, a turbocharged DOHC inline-4 that produced <175ps>/<6400rpm> and <23.0kgm> of torque at <4000rpm>.

From the driver's seat, the engine felt much more powerful, thanks mainly to the car's lean curb weight of <1140kg>. Its straight-line prowess and finely-tuned suspension that included a compliant multilink setup at the rear made the FR (Front drive/Rear engine) sports coupe a true driver's car that was capable on both winding roads and the open highway.

In February 1990, a Diamond Select Edition was added to the lineup. This special model offered an array of optional features that included automatic climate control, aluminum wheels and a rear spoiler, allowing prospective owners to tailor their car toward either a grand tourer or pure sports car.*

Silvia是日产旗下的双门轿车产品线。其中的S13是于1988-1993年间生产的第5代车型。

日产对S13的最初定位是一款用于约会兜风的时尚双门轿跑，结果在推出后却受到了街头车手们的热烈追捧：在当时已堪称稀有的中级别前置后驱车款，强劲的引擎动力和操控性能卓越的底盘，都完美契合竞速车的标准。

正是S13的出现，把大众心目中的Silvia定义成了一款运动车型。在随后推出高性能版本S13s（之前的Silvia高性能版本都被称为Ks）上，搭载有CA18DET双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压直列4缸引擎，可在<6400rpm>时输出<175ps>，以及<4000rpm>时的<23.0kgm>扭矩，对于一台仅重<1140kg>的车来说绰绰有余，再加上日产全力研发，精心打造的多连杆后悬挂，让它成为了一款在任何设定下都能畅快驾驶的车。

在1990年2月，日产针对Silvia的Ks、Qs和其他级别车型推出了钻石选配包，包含自动空调、铝制轮毂和后扰流板等多种多样的选配件可供选择。
