vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

On May 30, 1916, Peugeot won the legendary “Indianapolis 500 Mile Race” with its L45 race car. One hundred years later, we pay homage to that achievement by bringing you the Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo.

Filled with the latest technology, the L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo features sharp styling cues and an incredibly low profile. With even the bulge that covers the cockpit kept to a minimum, the car stands a mere <1m> tall. The tail section was inspired by the old L45 race car, ending in a streamlined shape with three distinctive rear lamp claws similar to that of the 3008, which is a Peugeot design cue today.

The cockpit utilizes a near-future user interface, with two holograms displaying a variety of information to the driver. Unlike the L45, the L500R is a single seater—the navigator has been replaced with a virtual navigator in this concept.

The L500R is powered by a 1.6-liter 4-cylinder turbocharged engine and two electric motors. Total output is <500ps> and maximum torque is <74.43kgm>. Utilizing the latest lightweight materials, the car weighs only <1000kg>. All this allows the Peugeot race car to run from 0-<100km/h> in 2.5 seconds and to the <1000m>-mark in just 19 seconds.

Peugeot has participated in many forms of motorsports all over the world, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans, WRC and Rally Raids. This innovative machine represents the company’s spirit and passion for competition.

long.en:
On May 30, 1916, Peugeot won the legendary “Indianapolis 500 Mile Race” with its L45 race car. One hundred years later, we pay homage to that achievement by bringing you the Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo.

Filled with the latest technology, the L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo features sharp styling cues and an incredibly low profile. With even the bulge that covers the cockpit kept to a minimum, the car stands a mere <1m> tall. The tail section was inspired by the old L45 race car, ending in a streamlined shape with three distinctive rear lamp claws similar to that of the 3008, which is a Peugeot design cue today.

The cockpit utilizes a near-future user interface, with two holograms displaying a variety of information to the driver. Unlike the L45, the L500R is a single seater—the navigator has been replaced with a virtual navigator in this concept.

The L500R is powered by a 1.6-liter 4-cylinder turbocharged engine and two electric motors. Total output is <500ps> and maximum torque is <74.43kgm>. Utilizing the latest lightweight materials, the car weighs only <1000kg>. All this allows the Peugeot race car to run from 0-<100km/h> in 2.5 seconds and to the <1000m>-mark in just 19 seconds.

Peugeot has participated in many forms of motorsports all over the world, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans, WRC and Rally Raids. This innovative machine represents the company’s spirit and passion for competition.

在1916年5月30日，标致依靠他们彗星般的赛车L45赢下了传奇赛事——印地500英里比赛。在这场胜利的一个世纪以后，标致又用一辆L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo向这位过去的冠军表达敬意。20世纪初标致赛车的性能和激情被带到了现代，与精雕细琢的优雅和最先进的技术发生了碰撞。

其最出色的外形设计便是那难以置信的极低车身。即便是容纳车手的驾驶舱，其突出高度也被控制在最低程度，而整车高度仅为<1m>。渐渐收窄的尾部和一个世纪前的老款L45颇为类似，流线型的尾端外形突出三只独具特色的爪型尾灯，和3008的尾灯非常相似。这样的尾灯也成了如今标致车身设计的一大标志。

包裹车手的座舱采用未来风格的用户界面，两块全息图为车手展示了各种信息。虽然L500R是一部单座车，但是L45时代必不可少的领航员在这部概念赛车中被换成了一名虚拟领航员。

动力方面，这辆车使用一具1.6升4缸涡轮增压引擎和两部电机。总输出功率达到<500ps>，可以产出<74.43kgm>的最大扭矩。使用最新材料的这款车车重仅有<1000kg>，可以在2.5秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，仅用19秒就可以跑完<1000m>的距离。

在赛车运动的世界里，标致不仅在印地500中延续出色的发挥，还参加了全世界的各种比赛，包括勒芒、世界赛车拉力锦标赛和越野拉力赛等。这部革命性的赛车将他们的精神和激情带向了未来。_

vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

On May 30, 1916, Peugeot won the legendary “Indianapolis 500 Mile Race” with its L45 race car. One hundred years later, we pay homage to that achievement by bringing you the Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo. To celebrate the release of Gran Turismo Sport, Peugeot decided to develop the L500R even more, creating the L750R HYbrid, a competition model with even more performance.

What mainly separates the L750R from the L500R is its power unit. By raising the rev limit of the turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-4 to <10000rpm>, output has been increased to 580 brake horsepower. And when you combine that with the 170 brake horsepower coming from the electric motors, you get a total output of 750 brake horsepower.

The L750R basically wears the same body as the L500R, but with improved aerodynamics. A large splitter has been added to the front, and the airflow of the underfloor has been further optimized. A rear wing has also been added to increase downforce. The L750R weighs <175kg> less than its stablemate, tipping the scales at <825kg>. This has improved the car’s 0-<100km/h> acceleration by 0.1 second, to 2.4 seconds.

Peugeot took the incredible L500R race car and refined it even further to create a truly remarkable machine that conveys the company’s passion and spirit for competition.

Peugeot took the incredible L500R race car and refined it even further to create a truly remarkable machine that conveys the company’s passion and spirit for competition.
long.zh:
在1916年5月30日，标致依靠他们彗星般的赛车L45赢下了传奇赛事——印地500英里比赛。在这场胜利的一个世纪以后，他们又开发出了L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo向L45的百年诞辰表达了敬意。

而现在，为了庆祝跑车浪漫旅竞速的推出，标致决定对L500R进行更深入的开发。在保留L500R原本的未来概念设计的前提下，这部新车将会是一款竞技车型，为了比赛而实现更强的性能——这款超级明星就是L750R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo。

L750R最大的革新在于其动力系统。L500R的1.6升直4涡轮增压引擎的转速上限被提高到了<10000rpm>，其输出功率也提升到了580有效马力。再加上可以输出170有效马力的电机，整套系统的输出功率达到了750有效马力。

尽管L500R的车身已经非常低了，标致决定进一步改良这辆车的空气动力学设计。车身前部加装了一部大型分流器，进一步优化了车底的气流。在加上大号尾翼后，这辆车成功获得了强大的下压力。车身重量也继续得到削减，仅为<825kg>，比L500R还轻了<175kg>。这些努力将0-<100km/h> 的加速时间再次缩短了0.1秒，变成2.4秒。

标致的赛车精神在L500R中得到了充分体现，而这款车则让其赛车理念更加纯粹和炽热。

vehicleCollection.en:
A unique car with a double-bubble rear roof.[

At the Peugeot booth of the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, there was a concept car displayed with flowing lines: the “308 RCZ”. This sports car was notable for its wide and low silhouette, with a cabin offset forward due to its midship layout. From the center of the roof to the rear glass, a double-bubble design was utilized, giving it a unique style.

This was a design study based on the 308, but it gathered a lot of attention, with many fans wanting to see the car actually produced. To answer their call, the car was finally released in 2010 with a style that was virtually unchanged from the prototype. It was named with no 308 designation but simply as the “RCZ”.

The engine is a 1.6-liter inline 4-cylinder turbo, with two models producing <156ps> and <200ps> respectively. The <200ps> version is given an engine that becomes more lively as the engine RPM becomes higher, and a suspension system carried over from the original 308 series is made stiffer for sports driving. The combination gave the car a level of performance that provided a fulfilling sports driving experience.

Then in 2012, the RCZ underwent a minor change. This was mostly a stylistic change with the opening of the grille made smaller, the addition of a black light unit and LED position lights, and the overall facelift of the front end, giving it a chic style and appearance.

The GT Line is a grade model added from 2015, with a special front grille, double exhaust pipes, 19-inch wheels, and red stitched black leather interior for a sportier look.

long.zh:
在2007年的法兰克福车展上，标致展示了一部概念赛车，优雅流畅的车身线条拥有极高的辨识度。这是一辆308 RCZ。这辆跑车宽而低的轮廓非常鲜明，而由于其采用了中置引擎布局，座舱被前移。这款车从车顶中央到后窗采用了双气泡设计，独具风格。

这种设计思路来源于308，不过还加入了许多新亮点，许多粉丝也表达了他们对这辆车的期待。为了响应粉丝的呼声，这辆车在2010年最终推出，其外形风格和原型几乎没有任何改变。命名也脱离了308的称呼，而是简单地称为RCZ。

这辆车采用一具1.6升直4涡轮增压引擎，两种型号分别可输出<156ps>和<200ps>动力。<200ps>版本的引擎更加强力，转速更高，而继承自原版308的悬挂系统也进行了加固，更加运动。这样的搭配让这款车的性能非常优秀，这款车的运动驾驶体验令人心满意足。

然后在2012年，RCZ又进行了少量改款。这次的改变主要在外观上，进气格栅的开口更小了，加入了背光单元和LED示廓灯，而前端的整体改款让其风格和外观更加时髦。

GT产品线是在2015年加入的高端型号，带有特殊的前进气格栅、双排气管、19英寸轮毂、和更具运动风的红色缝线黑色皮革内饰。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This is the homologation model of the RCZ Gr.3, a race-spec version of Peugeot’s gracefully sculpted specialty coupe, adapted for Gr.3 regulations. Transformed into a mid-engine supercar, the design draws inspiration from the 2002 RC concept, one of the earliest visions that eventually gave rise to the RCZ.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: RCZ是Peugeot的特色车型，拥有优雅流畅的外观，RCZ Gr.3是专为Gr.3规则对其进行改装的版本，而这辆车则是RCZ Gr.3的赛事认证型号。这辆车从RCZ最终定型前的一款早期原型——2002年的“RC”概念车上汲取灵感，改为了一款中置引擎的超级跑车。

brandCentral.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Peugeot RCZ Gr.3.

The mid-engine layout allows for the glamorous proportions that
give it its unique look.

The design brings to mind Peugeot's 2002 "RC" concept.

And it may have been the original inspiration here.
The RC also had a mid-mounted engine, after all!
brandCentral.zh:
这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
Peugeot RCZ Gr.3级别赛车。

通过中置引擎布局，它实现了令人着迷的车身比例
和独特的外观。

其外观设计带有Peugeot的2002款“RC”概念车的影子，

也许它的灵感就来源于此，毕竟RC也是一台
中置引擎车型！

This is a Gr.3 production version of the stylish Peugeot RCZ compact coupe."

At the Peugeot booth of the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, there was a concept car displayed with flowing lines: the “308 RCZ”. This sports car was notable for its wide and low silhouette, with a cabin offset forward due to its midship layout. From the center of the roof to the rear glass, a double-bubble design was utilized, giving it a unique style.

This was a design study based on the 308, but it gathered a lot of attention, with many fans wanting to see the car actually produced. To answer their call, the car was finally released in 2010 with a style that was virtually unchanged from the prototype. It was named with no 308 designation but simply as the “RCZ”.

The engine is a 1.6-liter inline 4-cylinder turbo, with two models producing <156ps> and <200ps> respectively. The <200ps> version is given an engine that becomes more lively as the engine RPM becomes higher, and a suspension system carried over from the original 308 series is made stiffer for sports driving. The combination gave the car a level of performance that provided a fulfilling sports driving experience.

Then in 2012, the RCZ underwent a minor change. This was mostly a stylistic change with the opening of the grille made smaller, the addition of a black light unit and LED position lights, and the overall facelift of the front end, giving it a chic style and appearance.

The GT Line is a grade model added from 2015, with a special front grille, double exhaust pipes, 19-inch wheels, and red stitched black leather interior for a sportier look.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: A Gran Turismo Original, this is a race-prepared version of the RCZ—Peugeot’s elegantly contoured specialty coupe—adapted for Gr.3 regulations. To enhance weight distribution and overall performance, the drivetrain has been reconfigured from its original front-engine/front-wheel-drive setup to a mid-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout. With its extended 102.8 inches wheelbase, the RCZ provides an ideal foundation for transformation into a competitive race machine.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: RCZ是Peugeot的特色车型，拥有优雅流畅的外观，而这辆车则是专为Gr.3规则改装的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。为了优化配重比和整体性能，这辆车的传动系统从前置前驱改为了中置后驱布局。RCZ那2,612毫米的长轴距也让它成为了赛车改装的完美候选者。
officialDetails.heroEn: This is a Gr.3 race version of the stylish Peugeot RCZ compact coupe.
officialDetails.heroZh: Peugeot RCZ紧凑型双门轿车的Gr.3公路车版。

brandCentral.en:
Serving as the foundation for the Gran Turismo Gr.3 race car
was the Peugeot RCZ.

While the original came with an FF layout, we changed it to an
MR layout to suit Gr.3 specifications.

This was easily done, thanks to the base RCZ's long wheelbase,
which provides exceptional lateral stability.

We must say that the car's overall balance has been greatly
improved with the new engine location. %
brandCentral.zh:
Peugeot RCZ是这辆跑车浪漫旅Gr.3级别赛车的基础改装车型。

原车是前置前驱布局，赛车版本却改为使用中置后驱布
局，以满足Gr.3的规范。

基础的RCZ轴距较长，拥有较高的稳定性，

再通过将引擎中置，在性能提升方面获得最大的优势。

Maintaining a front-wheel-drive layout, this model features motorsports-inspired enhancements including a prominent front splitter, a rear wing, and redesigned aerodynamic front fenders.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: RCZ是Peugeot的特色车型，拥有优雅流畅的外观，而这辆车则是专为Gr.4规则改装的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。RCZ Gr.4采用了正统的前轮驱动房车架构，还加装了前定风翼和尾翼，以及一套空气动力学性能更强的前挡泥板。

officialDetails.heroZh: Peugeot RCZ紧凑型双门轿车的Gr.4公路车版。

brandCentral.en:
The Peugeot RCZ was the foundation for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

The front fenders are one of a number of custom parts that
were intended to improve aerodynamics.

Despite being front-wheel drive, it handled surprisingly well.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车采用
Peugeot RCZ作为基础车型。

车身安装了大量空气动力学定制部件，前挡泥板就是其
中之一。

这辆前置前驱车拥有引以为傲的顺滑操控。

conversation.en:
Peugeot cars are distinguished by their numerical names.

Like the 205 or the 306, they all seem to follow
a three-digit pattern.

The history behind this convention actually dates back
to 1921 with the 201.

Today, it’s not uncommon to see four-digit names,
but did you know that those are reserved for SUVs?

This "2008" is a compact SUV.

As is to be expected of a Peugeot, it's perky and nimble,
just as it should be!

vehicleCollection.en:
This compact SUV showcases Peugeot design cues throughout.

Peugeot has long been known for crafting spirited compact cars. This legacy continues to shine in today’s SUV-dominated market. The brand found success in 2013 with the debut of the original 2008 compact SUV, and in 2019, Peugeot elevated the concept further with the launch of the next-generation 2008.

Peugeot’s traditional naming convention—three digits with a zero in the center—evolved with the rise of SUVs, expanding to four digits. The 2008 follows this format, sharing the same CMP platform as its hatchback sibling, the 208.

Measuring just <4.3m> in length, the 2008 may be compact in size, but it projects all the presence and stature expected of a true SUV. Its sharp, angular motifs evoke the image of a lion’s claws and fangs, a design language that has become a hallmark of Peugeot’s identity.

Step inside, and you’re greeted by Peugeot’s distinctive 3D i-Cockpit, a driver-focused layout that sets the cabin apart. At its heart is a compact, flat-topped and -bottomed steering wheel. Just above it sits a head-up digital instrument cluster, cleverly elevated to fall within the driver’s natural line of sight.

long.zh:
标致多年来生产了众多活力十足的紧凑型车。这种热情在SUV主导市场的今天仍然没有退减。他们在2013年凭借“2008”紧凑型SUV获得成功，2019年再接再厉，在此基础上推出了真正的SUV 2008。

标致车型的命名传统是中间带0的3位数字，而在SUV车型上，将其扩展为4位数字。使用与“208”掀背车相同的通用模块化平台的SUV 2008也遵循这一规则。

虽然<4.3m>的车身尺寸在现实中相对较短，但外观上展现了SUV应有的十足气势。灯具的造型让人联想到狮子的爪牙，这已成为标致近年来设计特色的一部分。

看到内饰时，你会注意到独特的驾驶员布局，被称为“3D直观驾驶舱”。它由上下扁平的小直径方向盘和位于其上方中央的抬头数字仪表盘组成，提供运动感受和无与伦比的驾驶员视野。

This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.

In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced
pretty much as-is.

The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose
were essential tools...

...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock
car racing in the United States.

Basically, they were special racing parts
for a production car.

In its effort to meet NASCAR hoologation,
the Superbird was sold for but one year...

...and few were ever produced.

Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more
and more pure race cars.

Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars
an race cars greatly resembled each other.

vehicleCollection.en:
This stock car for the street had a wedge-shaped front end and one of the tallest rear wings ever to grace a production car.

From the middle of the 1969 season, the Charger 500 Daytona made its appearance in stock car racing. It took full advantage of its aerodynamics, and was performing very well. This in turn raised demand from teams racing Plymouth race cars which are in the same Chrysler group, for a model that has the same aerodynamics as the Daytona.

The answer to those demands was the Superbird.

Because Plymouth did not produce a vehicle that could be considered the sibling of the Charger, the Road Runner — with the same intermediate-class chassis — was selected to be its base.

Because of the familiar extended nose and rear wing, it looks very similar to the Daytona, but there are slight differences to details such as the shape of the roof.

Because the number of cars required for homologation was doubled in 1970 from 500 cars to 1000, and with the Daytona’s performing so well on the circuit, many Superbirds made it to the streets, not just the circuit.

The base engine for the Superbird was the <375ps> 440 Super Commando, with a 426 Hemi producing over <425ps>, and a <390ps> 440 six barrel as options. This was more in line with the GTX, which was ranked above the Road Runner.

The Superbird was produced, like the Daytona, during the homologation certification period of only one year.

long.zh:
从1969年赛季中期开始，Charger 500 Daytona在原厂车比赛中亮相。它充分发挥了其在空气动力学方面的优势，取得了极其优异的表现。这反过来促使使用普利茅斯赛车（与克莱斯勒同属一个集团）的车队提出需求，要求获得一款具备与戴通纳相同的空气动力学特性的车型。对这些需求的回应就是Superbird。

普利茅斯没有选择直接生产一台Charger血统的车型，而是选择了具有相同中级底盘的路跑作为其赛车的基础。

Superbird看起来与Daytona非常相似，同样拥有眼熟的加长车头和尾翼等特征，只在细节上有细微差别，如车顶的形状等。

1970年，通过赛事认证所需的量产车数量翻了一番，从500辆增加到1000辆。随着Daytona在赛道上的表现愈发出色，也让更多的Superbird有机会出现在了街头和赛道上。

Superbird使用的基础引擎是<375ps>的440超级突击队。另有两个备选版本：可产生超过<425ps>动力的426 Hemi引擎，以及产生<390ps>的440六缸引擎。这样的配置基本上照搬了规格与性能还在路跑之上的普利茅斯 GTX的产品线。

和Daytona一样，Superbird只在赛事认证期内生产了一年。

conversation.en:
Virgil Exner is a designer that I'm quite fond of.

After working with Raymond Loewy, he served as the first
design director for Chrysler from 1953 to 1961.

With designs overflowing with personality, he was the
leading figure in the golden age of Chrysler design.

From all of those creations, the one that stands out to me
is the XNR.

This concept car can be regarded as an answer to sports cars
like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.

It features a unique asymmetrical design, with an air scoop,
interior panel and tailfin serving as accents.

One might call the styling of this car outrageous,
but i was very fresh.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
维尔基尔·艾克斯勒是我非常欣赏的设计师。

在与雷蒙德·洛威展开合作后，他在1953到1961年之间
担任Chrysler的首位设计总监。

他的设计洋溢着个人风格，
也是Chrysler设计黄金时代的领导人物。

在他所有的创作中，我觉得最杰出的就是这辆XNR。

这款概念车可以称得上是Chrysler对Chevrolet Corvette和
Ford Thunderbird等跑车的回应。

它采用了独特的非对称设计，并通过进气口、
内衬板和尾翼等元素加以强调。

也许有人会认为这样的风格十分离经叛道，
但确实做到了让所`RX目一新。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This was a masterpiece roadster crafted by legendary designer Virgil Exner in 1960. Its asymmetrical styling, hood bulge, and dramatic aero fins gave the impression of Exner’s personal interpretation of a 1950s-era race car. It was awarded the Gran Turismo Trophy in 2011.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 由汽车设计大师维吉尔·埃克斯纳在1960年献上的一款敞篷跑车杰作。它采用非对称风格、引擎盖鼓起式进气口和气动翼面设计，成为了埃克斯纳对1950年代赛车精彩的全新演绎。这款车在2011年赢得了“Gran Turismo奖杯”。

collection.en:
This unique Plymouth roadster is best known for having been
designed by Carrozzeria Ghia.

But do you know where the "XNR" name comes from?

If you try to read “XNR” out loud, it sounds just like
"Exner," doesn't it?

It's the name of the legendary American designer
Virgil Max Exner...

...who led Chrysler's design for much of the 1950s and 1960s.

He developed various designs in conjunction with
Luigi Segre of Carrozzeria Ghia.

Many innovative and interesting designs
resulted from this collaboration.

And this XNR Ghia Roadster was one of them.

The XNR also made waves in 2011 when it claimed the Gran Turismo
Trophy at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
collection.zh:
这款独特的Plymouth敞篷跑车的出名之处在于
它是由Carrozzeria Ghia设计的。

但您知道“XNR”这个名字是怎么来的吗？

您读一下就会发现“XNR”听起来很像“Exner”，对吧？

这款车的名字正是取自美国传奇设计师Virgil Max Exner，

他于上世纪50至60年代主要领导Chrysler的设计。

他与Carrozzeria Ghia的Luigi Segre 合作完成了许多设计，

二人的合作带来了大量创新而有趣的作品。

这辆XNR Ghia Roadster就是其中之一。

这辆XNR还于2011年在圆石滩经典车展夺得了Gran Turismo奖杯，
再次吸引了所有人的目光。

vehicleCollection.en:
The Gran Turismo Trophy winner, with unique asymmetric styling.

The car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy at the 61st Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in 2011 was this 1960 Plymouth XNR Ghia Roadster.

The designer was Virgil Exner, the legend who led the golden years of Chrysler in the 1950s and 1960s. The XNR Ghia Roadster, which inherited his name in abbreviated form, was actually built by Carrozzeria Ghia, a company that Exner had close ties with.

Plymouth represented the entry-level brand for Chrysler, but that didn't stop Exner from incorporating technology into his creation that had trickled down from Chrysler's involvement in NASCAR. This concept car was made as the future of sports cars that would rival cars like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.

By far, the most striking feature was its asymmetric styling. From the air intake in the car's nose to the flow from the headrest to the rear, it's Exner's interpretation of aerodynamic styling that characterized 1950s racing. The cockpit's right side is covered with a tonneau cover which makes the car appear to be a single-seater at first glance, but there actually is a seat hiding under the cover, making it a fully-fledged 2-seat sports car.

The prominent fins on the sides of the body were actually a shared design feature from the Valiant, the car on which the concept car was based. Although its overly avant-garde styling ultimately proved too much for the market, thus prohibiting the car from making it to mass production, the XNR did manage to make major shockwaves in the car design realm at the time and gave a glimpse into the depth of American Automotive History.

在2011年举办的第61届圆石滩优雅竞赛中，这台来自1960年的普利茅斯 XNR Ghia Roadste荣获了GT奖杯。

负责设计这款车型的传奇设计师便是维吉尔·埃克斯纳，他在1950到1960年代将克莱斯勒带入了黄金时代。XNR便是以他的名字命名的。这款车的车身来自于Ghia，后者与埃克斯纳的合作堪称亲密无间。

普利茅斯原本是克莱斯勒的入门级品牌，然而埃克斯纳却借助克莱斯勒在纳斯卡赛车中的表现，将高性能的印象植入到这辆车中。制造这辆概念赛车的目的是在未来成为与雪佛兰科尔维特和福特雷鸟比肩的跑车。

最令人眼前一亮的当属其非对称的设计风格。从前鼻的进气口、引擎盖的隆起，再到座椅头枕到后部的线条，无不体现出埃克斯纳对50年代赛车的空气动力学造型的解读和诠释。座舱右侧被车厢盖布全部覆盖，让人在初见时错以为这辆车仅限单人驾驶。揭开盖布露出副驾驶座椅后，才让人明白这是一辆不折不扣的双座车型。

车身两侧突出的侧鳍则来源于其设计原型，另一款车型勇猛者。虽然过于前卫的造型设计使得这款车无法投入量产，但却在当时的车辆设计行业引发了一场地震。通过这款车型，我们也能对美国汽车工业的历史纵深有所了解。

Polestar is an electric vehicle brand from Sweden.

Among its lineup is the hybrid Polestar 5...

...a four-door GT that produces more than 800 horsepower!

You know, Polestar has a bit more history behind it
than meets the eye.

It originally served as Volvo’s racing division in the mid-1990s.

The team even collaborated with Volvo to develop several
road-going sports cars.

In 2017, Polestar branched out on its own as a high-performance
electric vehicle brand.

So now you know a little more about Polestar,
a Swedish company with deep racing roots!

Polestar是源自瑞典的电动汽车品牌。

其产品阵容中包含这款混动版Polestar 5……

这是一款动力超过800匹马力的四门GT车型！

事实上，“Polestar”的品牌底蕴远比表面所见更为深厚。

九十年代中期，它曾担任Volvo的赛车研发部门。

甚至协助Volvo打造了多款公路版运动车型。

2017年，品牌正式独立，转型为高性能电动汽车制造商。

总之，现在你应该对Polestar有点初步概念了——
这是一家植根赛车传统的瑞典企业！
?

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Created by the Scandinavian electric performance brand Polestar, the Polestar 5 is an all-wheel-drive electric sedan distinguished by its sleek, sub-five-meter profile and a glass roof that extends gracefully to the rear. Power came from a dual-motor setup, with one motor mounted on each axle. In Performance trim, it delivered an impressive 650 kW and 1,015 Nm of torque. officialDetails.descriptionZh: 由北欧电动汽车品牌Polestar打造的Polestar 5是一款全轮驱动电动轿车，其特点是拥有修长的5 米流线型车身以及一直延伸至车尾的玻璃车顶。它采用双电机布局，前后轴各配备一台电机。性能版车型可输出650千瓦功率和1015牛米扭矩。800伏电气架构支持350千瓦快速充电，仅需22分钟即可将电池电量从10%提升至80%。在WLTP测试下，最大续航里程为670 公里（双电机版）。

brandCentral.en:
Polestar is a premium EV brand from Sweden with a
unique focus on speed and sustainability.

Its flagship car is the Polestar 5, a grand AWD saloon
measuring <5m> in length.

Its panoramic glass roof doesn't compromise visibility
thanks to a camera-supported virtual rear-view mirror.

Powered by dual motors at the car’s front and back,
the performance model can output 650 kW...

And employs BWI MagneRide dampers that can read the road up
to 1,000 times per second, increasing comfort and speed.

Its 800V battery supports charging rates up to 350 kW, and
its rear motor can be detached to boost efficiency.

Sustainable inside and out, the Polestar 5 may very well be
a guiding light for automotive design in the years to come.

全景玻璃车顶丝毫不影响后方视野，

还配备了BWI MagneRide减震器，每秒可扫描路面信息

vehicleCollection.en:
Polestar's flagship model combines sustainability with high-performance.

The Polestar 5 is the flagship model of the Scandinavian high-performance electric brand, Polestar. It represents the realization of ideas introduced by the Precept concept car in 2020, embodying pure Scandinavian design, advanced technology, and sustainability.

Its stretched form, measuring <5m> in length, draws inspiration from aircraft, while the panel structure and expansive glass roof, extending toward the rear, contribute to its aerodynamic efficiency. With a drag coefficient of just 0.24, the bonded aluminum body delivers a lightweight yet rigid structure, offering greater torsional rigidity than many sports cars.

The powertrain employs a dual-motor system built around an in-house developed electric rear motor. The Performance Edition is capable of a total system output of 650 kW (<884ps>) and runs from zero to <100km/h> in just 3.2 seconds. Its 800 V electric architecture enables 350 kW fast charging, replenishing the battery from 10 percent to 80 in only 22 minutes. Maximum range under WLTP testing reached <670km> for the Dual Motor edition.

The suspension consists of a specially designed double-wishbone layout. The Performance Edition features magnetorheological dampers that read the road surface up to 1,000 times per second, balancing agility with comfort. Driver assistance systems extend further, with automatic lane and speed control operating up to <150km/h>.

With futuristic design, remarkable electric performance, and a deep commitment to sustainability, the Polestar 5 stands as the ultimate grand tourer package.

极星5是源自斯堪的纳维亚地区高性能电动汽车品牌极星的旗舰车型。该车型完美践行了2020年发布的“Precept”概念车所倡导的理念，通过纯正的斯堪的纳维亚设计、前沿科技与可持续性理念得以具象化呈现。

修长的<5m>车身造型从飞机设计汲取灵感，延伸至车尾的面板结构与玻璃车顶共同实现了卓越的空气动力学表现。该车型车身风阻系数仅为0.24，采用铝材胶接技术打造出轻量化且高刚性的车身架构，其抗扭刚度甚至优于众多跑车。

动力总成采用双电机系统，其核心为自主研发的后置电机。Performance性能版可实现650千瓦（<884ps>）的总输出功率，0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3.2秒。800伏电气架构支持350千瓦快速充电，仅需22分钟即可将电池电量从10%提升至80%。全球统一轻型汽车测试程序测试标准下的最大续航里程为<670km>（双电机版）。

悬架系统采用特殊设计的双叉臂结构。Performance性能版搭载磁流变液减震器，可每秒1000次实时扫描路面状况，完美兼顾舒适驾乘与敏捷操控。该车还配备全面的驾驶员辅助系统，支持最高<150km/h>的自主车道保持与速度控制功能。

极星5集前瞻设计、卓越电动性能与可持续性于一身，以终极豪华旅行车的姿态完美呈现了所有这些特质。

The Pontiac Firebird was built to compete with the Mustang.

The high-performance version, called the Trans Am, gained

The two cars were historically called the F-body pony cars.~

vehicleCollection.en:
Made famous by Burt Reynolds in "Smokey and the Bandit," this was one of the leading '70s muscle cars.

Pontiac was the sporty upscale brand of General Motors, and the model which helped define the division in its heyday was an American muscle car called the Firebird. It was created to take on Ford's ultra-popular pony car, the Mustang.

Many variations of the Firebird were produced in order to compete against its famous rival, with Pontiac making the cars faster and more luxurious. The top model "Trans Am" was a car enthusiast's dream: the name of this top-of-the-line model, which ended up becoming more famous than the original "Firebird" name, was taken from the popular sports car racing series. The Pontiac Trans Am, with its giant Firebird sticker garnishing the hood, became a revered muscle car, and a classic American automotive symbol of the 1970s.

The final 1978 model of the second-generation series was available with both a 400 or 403 cubic inch V8. The big, high-compression 6.6-liter mill was an engine exclusive to Pontiac, and was not available in its pony car brother, the Chevrolet Camaro. The brass at Pontiac figured that instead of aligning the Trans Am with the Camaro, they were better off developing a special engine unique to the Firebird. Also, the car possessed a four-headlamp design, instead of the customary two, which differentiated it from the Camaro and other GM products.

The car was a great hit, and the Firebird Trans Am lives on in infinite lore as the car driven by Burt Reynolds in the movie "Smokey and the Bandit."

long.zh:
庞蒂亚克是通用汽车旗下的高端运动品牌，在曾经的峥嵘岁月里，撑起这一品牌的是一款美国市场独有的车型：火鸟。

在当时，它的竞争对手是畅销全美的小马车——福特旗下的Mustang。为了与这位著名的竞争对手一较高下，火鸟陆续推出过多款车型，有些专注速度，有些则兼顾奢华感。

其中的顶级车型“Trans Am”是爱好者心目中的梦想车款。这个车型的命名来自1978年全美热门的跑车系列赛事，最终变得比火鸟的本名更为人熟知。庞蒂亚克Trans Am及其引擎盖上的硕大火鸟贴纸，代表着1970年代最最热门的肌肉车。

第二代火鸟的最后一个1978年车款上分别搭载了400立方英寸和403立方英寸的两款引擎。这台高压缩比的6.6升V8引擎是由庞蒂亚克自研开发的，甚至未开放给其兄弟车型雪佛兰科迈罗使用。对他们来说，使用科迈罗同款引擎还不够好，所以希望制造一台有别于其他任何车款的特殊引擎来宣告Trans Am的独一无二。

可以这么说，火鸟Trans Am代表的是庞蒂亚克的骄傲和原则。

vehicleCollection.zh:
来自1970年的头号肌肉车，核心是一颗自行研发的特殊引擎。

庞蒂亚克是通用汽车旗下的高端运动品牌，在曾经的峥嵘岁月里，撑起这一品牌的是一款美国市场独有的车型：火鸟。

在当时，它的竞争对手是畅销全美的小马车——福特旗下的Mustang。为了与这位著名的竞争对手一较高下，火鸟陆续推出过多款车型，有些专注速度，有些则兼顾奢华感。

其中的顶级车型“Trans Am”是爱好者心目中的梦想车款。这个车型的命名来自1978年全美热门的跑车系列赛事，最终变得比火鸟的本名更为人熟知。庞蒂亚克Trans Am及其引擎盖上的硕大火鸟贴纸，代表着1970年代最最热门的肌肉车。

第二代火鸟的最后一个1978年车款上分别搭载了400立方英寸和403立方英寸的两款引擎。这台高压缩比的6.6升V8引擎是由庞蒂亚克自研开发的，甚至未开放给其兄弟车型雪佛兰科迈罗使用。对他们来说，使用科迈罗同款引擎还不够好，所以希望制造一台有别于其他任何车款的特殊引擎来宣告Trans Am的独一无二。

可以这么说，火鸟Trans Am代表的是庞蒂亚克的骄傲和原则。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 1968, the second-generation Pontiac GTO was hailed as a pioneer of the muscle car era, though it faced fierce competition. To silence the debate, Pontiac unveiled “The Judge." Equipped with a 6.6-liter Ram Air III V-8, a Hurst shifter, heavy-duty suspension, wide tires, and a rear spoiler, the package propelled the GTO back to the forefront of the muscle car wars.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1968年推出的第二代Pontiac GTO被誉为肌肉车的鼻祖之一，但面临着众多强劲对手的竞争。“The Judge”运动套件的推出正是为了终结这场争论。这个套件包含6.6升V8“Ram Air III”引擎、Hurst换挡器、重型悬挂系统、宽胎和后扰流翼，让GTO重新夺回了王者地位。
officialDetails.heroEn: The ultimate sports spec car that appeared towards the end of the GTO era, when muscle cars flourished.
officialDetails.heroZh: 在肌肉车首次领跑的GTO时代末期出现的终极运动规格车辆。

collection.en:
Introduced in 1964, the Pontiac GTO is considered
one of the first American muscle cars.

In a series of one-upmanship by various manufacturers, the GTO's
performance was soon eclipsed by the competition.

In response, Pontiac created a new high-performance
model called "The Judge."

It came equipped with a powerful 6.6-liter V-8.

It also boasted wide tires, a rear spoiler and distinctive livery
that gave the car an extremely powerful presence.

Because of The Judge, the Pontiac GTO retained its rightful
place at the top of the muscle-car heap.
collection.zh:
被视为美式肌肉车的先驱之一的
Pontiac GTO于1964年推出。

但没过多久，强大竞争对手就将它的表现掩盖。

作为回应，Pontiac将希望寄托在一款
新的高性能版本，“The Judge”。

除了性能卓越的6.6升V8引擎外……

 其外观也在独特的贴花，宽轮胎、后扰流板与
其他装饰的加持下显得霸气。

多亏了“The Judge”的存在，Pontiac GTO才能维持
其在肌肉车领域其应有的领导地位。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate sports spec car that appeared towards the end of the GTO era, when muscle cars flourished.

The first-generation Pontiac GTO, which was introduced in 1964, was a big hit and is credited for the boom in street-legal muscle cars. The second-generation model followed in 1968 with a more stylish fastback style and decent performance. It wasn't enough to prevent the GTO from losing its king-of-the-hill status to its increasingly impressive rivals, however.

Keen to rectify this situation, in 1969, General Motors released a new GTO known as "The Judge." The standard sports package wore an exclusive logo and stripe decals, and powered by a 6.6-liter V-8 "Ram Air 3" engine that was said to be capable of more than the advertised <366ps>. It was mated to a Hurst shifter. The car had a heavy-duty suspension system, wide tires, and a rear spoiler. Despite all this, it only cost $332 more than the standard GTO. In terms of both performance and sheer presence, it outdid its rivals and attracted plenty of attention.

Muscle cars such as the GTO started to disappear when strict emissions regulations were introduced a couple of years later.

long.zh:
第一代庞蒂亚克GTO于1964年首次亮相并获得了很大的成功，据说这是第一辆能够合法上路的肌肉车。然而，1968年推出的第二代车型转而采用了风格更鲜明的溜背设计，虽然动力表现依旧不俗，但随着动力更强劲的竞争对手登上舞台，渐渐显露不支之态。

为了扭转这一局面，1969年通用汽车发布了“The Judge”。该运动套件售价仅为332美元，却包含了相当丰富的“标准配件”。其中包含了独家标志和条纹贴花、一个赫斯特变速箱、重型悬挂车架、宽胎以及后扰流板。引擎升级为一台6.6升“冲压空气III”V8引擎，官方标明的动力输出为<366ps>，但据说其实力不止于此。最终“The Judge”无论是性能还是车身外观，都超越了竞争对手，引来了广泛的关注。

不过只过了一年，随着更严格的排放法规在美国推出，GTO这样的肌肉车逐渐退出了历史舞台。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Launched in 1949, the 356 A was a refined successor to Porsche’s first production model, the 356. Two variants were offered, both using a detuned version of the 550 Spyder’s engine. The 1500 GS Carrera road-going version produced 98.6 HP, while the semi-competition 1500 GS GT delivered 108.5 HP. This model also introduced the "Carrera" name—now synonymous with Porsche performance.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1949年推出的356 A是Porsche首款量产车型356的改进版。356A有两个版本，所搭载的引擎均来自550 Spyder，但性能经过下调。公路车1500 GS Carrera能输出100 PS，半赛车1500 GS GT则能输出110 PS。这款车更是首次启用了Porsche如今标志性的“Carrera”子车型命名。
officialDetails.heroEn: A semi-race equipped model of the 356A, one of the cars that contributed to the Porsche mystique.
officialDetails.heroZh: 356A的半赛事车型，该车使Porsche闻名于世。

collection.en:
On the outside, the Porsche GS Carrera looks no different
from other 356 coupés of its day.

What makes this GS Carrera so special
and raises its value...

Is its four-cam 1.5L engine, capable of producing <100ps>.

This engine was the most powerful version
available for the 356 series at the time.

To reduce weight, it was possible to order lighter
speedster seats and remove the heaters.

That's why the GS was not just a fast street car,
but was also seen in many races.

I think you'll find that it's directly linked to
Porsche's illustrious past!
collection.zh:
从外观上看，保时捷GS Carrera和当时的其他356轿跑
并无二致，

但令GS Carrera如此独特而价值不菲的，

是那台能够输出<100ps>的四凸轮1.5升引擎。

这款引擎代表了当时356车系的最强动力版本。

同时这款车接受定制轻量化的speedster座椅，甚至为了减重拆
除了加热系统。

也因此，GS不仅是一辆够快的街车，更是许多赛事的常客。

看着它的光辉履历您就会发现，这辆车与保时捷辉煌的过去
密不可分！

vehicleCollection.en:
A semi-race equipped model of the 356A, one of the cars that contributed to the Porsche mystique.

The 356, Porsche's first mass-produced car, made its debut in 1949 and immediately revolutionized the compact sports-car genre. An updated version of the original model called the 356A appeared in 1955 and again in 1959.

The 356A featured a rounded windshield, soft padding above the interior panels, and a horn at the center of the steering wheel. Performance of the car increased every year, ultimately leading to the 1500 GS Carrera and the 1500 GS GT Carrera, which were limited-production models billed as the GT3 of their day.

Powering the 356A was a slightly detuned version of the 4-cam engine found in the 550 Spyder race car. The road-going 1500 GS Carrera produced <100ps>, while the track-ready 1500 GS GT Carrera pumped out <110ps>. Both cars were offered as a coupe, cabriolet, and speedster.

Of particular note is that the 1500 GS Carrera was the first to go by the "Carrera" name, which has now become synonymous with Porsche.

It's a well-known fact that Porsche’s first production car
started with the rear-engine Porsche 356.

Full production of the 356 series began in 1950...

...and the coupe model was soon followed by
open-top versions.

All of these models shared a boxed sheet metal
chassis with independent suspension.

And the flat-4 engine was available in five
different displacements and output.

A slightly modified 356A appeared in 1955.

In 1956, a high performance 1.5-liter engine developd for
the 550 Spyder was offered as an option.

Models equipped with the powerful 1.5-liter engine
were called the GS Carrera.

They are known to have been cars that could immediately
be raced as is.

This model is a GS Carrera GT, characterize by
a lighter body and powerful engine.

These cars are collectibles tt rarely changhands
so don't miss your chance to drive it!

356系列的全面生产始于1950年……

继双门硬顶版本之后很快推出了敞篷版。

所有车型都适配了搭载独立悬挂的箱形金属底盘，

水平对置四缸引擎则有五种不同的排量和动力输出可选。

小改款356A于1955年推出，

到了1956年，专为550 Spyder设计开发的
高性能1.5升引擎正式登场。

配备了强大的1.5升引擎的#型被称为GS Carrera。

它们的特点在于可以随时下场参加比赛。

这台车型为GS GT Carrera，配备了
更轻的车身和更强大的引擎。

是相当罕见的Speedster款，几乎未曾易手，
您绝不会想错过亲驾驭这款车的机会！

vehicleCollection.en:
With the introduction of this model, Porsche became known as a maker of the world's finest sports cars.

The Porsche 356, the German sports car maker's first mass-production model, made its debut in 1949. It went through major updates in 1955 and 1959. During these two updates, the car was referred to as the 356A.

The 356A was simply a modernized version of the original, with a rounded windshield, soft padding above the interior panels, and a horn at the center of the steering wheel. The performance of the 356A improved every year, which ultimately led to the creation of the 1500 GS Carrera and the 1500 GS GT Carrera, a pair of limited-production models that were in essence the GT3s of their day.

Power came from a slightly detuned version of the 4-cam engine found in the 550 Spyder race car. The 1500 GS Carrera, offered as the road-going model, produced <100ps>, while the track-ready 1500 GS GT Carrera pumped out <110ps>. The two cars came in the forms of a coupe, cabriolet, and speedster.

Of particular note is that these cars were the very first to carry the "Carrera" moniker, a name that has now become synonymous with Porsche. !

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The first Porsche 911 to carry the RS badge was the 911 Carrera RS 2.7, released in 1973. The "RS" stood for Rennsport, meaning racing sport in German. Developed to meet FIA Group 4 homologation requirements, the car was designed with motorsports in mind. It quickly proved to be a hit—its initial production run of 500 units sold out immediately. Due to high demand, Porsche expanded production, ultimately building a total of 1,580 examples.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Porsche 911史上首款冠以“RS”徽标的车型是1973年发布的911 Carrera RS 2.7。RS代表“Rennsport”，也就是“比赛运动型”的意思。这款车是专为满足国际汽联Group 4组别赛事认证而开发的。上市后反响极为热烈，原计划生产的500台瞬间售罄。Porsche随后增产并总计生产了1580台。

collection.en:
There have been many great Porsche 911s over the years,
but the Carrera RS stands out as a shining masterpiece.

The 1973 Carrera RS was the first production
911 to wear the ‘Carrera RS’ name...

And was built specifically to win races.

A homologation model designed to meet FIA Group 4
regulations...

Its engine displacement was increased to 2.7L
from the 2.4L of the standard 911.

The car was also lightened by omitting anything
deemed to be unnecessary.

Summer tyres were chosen for enhanced grip, aided by
special front and rear spoilers.

The so-called ‘ducktail’ spoiler in the rear is a
particularly iconic design feature.

The 911 Carrera RS only sold in limited numbers
from late 1972 to 1973.

And whilerain iterations have followed in the fotsteps
of their forebear all theʓay to crrn1s.
As the first o the series, the 911 Crrera RS
ejoys a legendary sort of ppularity.

多年以来，保时捷911推出过许多款伟大的车型，
不过Carrera RS才是其中最闪亮的杰作。

1973款Carrera RS是第一辆被冠以
“Carrera RS”之名的911……

也是专为胜利所打造的比赛机器。

这辆针对国际汽联组别4规则所开发的认证赛车……

将引擎排量从标准911车型的2.4升增加到了2.7升。

此外，它还拆除了一切非必要的部件，
让车重得到了大幅减轻。

为了增强抓地力，款车采用了夏用轮胎，
并由特制的前后扰流板来辅助增加下压力。

车尾的“鸭尾”扰流板是其极具标志性的特征。

这款911 Carrera RS仅在1972到1973年之间限量销售。

尽管在此之后，多款y续赛车型号继承了前辈的衣钵，
直至演化到最新款的911	d…

但Wv为R列的开山之作，这款911 Carrera RS永远
享有最传奇的知名度。

vehicleCollection.en:
A first in Porsche 911 history, the elusive Rennsport.

Introduced in 1973, the 911 Carrera RS 2.7 was the first model in the long history of the Porsche 911 to feature the RS badge. The "RS" stands for "Rennsport," which is translated as "racing sport" in English. As its name suggests, this sports car was developed as a homologation model for the FIA's Group 4 category.

Mounted at the rear is a 2.4-liter engine from the base model 1973 911 S, but displacement was increased to 2.7 liters, which in turn upped power to <210ps>. The front end was modified to house an air dam that fed into an oil cooler. The tail section of the car featured the iconic duck-tail spoiler as standard fare, and the fenders were stretched to make room for wider rear tires.

The Carrera RS 2.7 came in three grades: Touring, Sport and Racing. Of note, even the luxury-oriented Touring model weighed less than <1100kg>.

The car was originally produced in a limited homologation run of 500 units; however, because it sold out almost immediately, Porsche increased production to 1,580 units.

long.zh:
于1973年亮相的911 Carrera RS 2.7是保时捷911那漫长历史上第一款采用了RS徽标的型号。RS代表了“Rennsport”，也就是“比赛运动型”的意思。顾名思义，这款车是作为国际汽联组别4组别赛事认证型号而开发的。

它将1973款911 S中的2.4升引擎扩容到了2.7升，可以输出<210ps>的动力。车头底部的前保险杠加宽，以便多容纳一部油冷器。而车尾则标配了标志性的鸭尾型扰流板；为了容纳宽胎，还延长了后挡泥板。

Carrera RS 2.7共推出了三个等级的配置：旅行、运动和赛车。即便是其中配置最豪华的旅行款，重量也不超过<1100kg>。

这辆车起初只计划按照认证规则限量生成500辆，但因为几乎瞬间售罄，导致保时捷不得不追加生产。这款车型最终总共生产了1580辆。*

The only notable difference with the standard 964 Carrera
is the <40mm> lower ride height.

You may not notice that because it's very discreet.
At a glance you would think it was a standard 964.

But that's another element that woos the fans
of the 964 911 Carrera RS.

It's extremely pure to say the least. There are no comfort
items here at all.

As a result, it's <120kg> lighter, and its handling
is razor sharp.

I'm certain it will continue to rise in value over time.
It's definitely one of the best of the best.
?

conversation.en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!

I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.

You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
Z
conversation.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
conversation.speaker: Freeman Thomas
conversation.zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。

为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！

它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。

而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。

我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。

只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。

964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，

而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料造。

镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不dV！

conversation.en:
Freeman is also a huge fan and connoisseur of Porsches.

Should we hear more about the car from him?
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
弗里曼还是Porsche的忠实粉丝和鉴赏家。

或许我们可以从他那里了解更多关于这辆车的信息？

conversation.en:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with
Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.

The sparse interiors came in black as standard.

Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.

There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.

This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!

蓝。

内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，

外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 1989, Porsche introduced the third-generation 911, known internally as the Type 964. Although it retained the familiar shape of its predecessor, it was a major leap forward, with about 80 percent of its components being newly developed. The Carrera 4, featuring 4-wheel drive, debuted first, followed by the rear-wheel-drive Carrera 2 in 1990. The Carrera RS of this generation was a performance-tuned variant based on the Carrera 2.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1989年，Porsche推出第3代911，这便是Type 964。造型上虽然与前代911颇为相近，实则约80%的零部件都是全新设计。四驱款Carrera 4率先发布，后驱款Carrera 2于1990年问世。Carrera RS是在Carrera 2基础上衍生的性能车型。
officialDetails.heroEn: This Porsche was a lighter version of the third-generation 911 Carrera 2 and came with a 3.6-liter flat-6.
officialDetails.heroZh: 引擎排气量增加到3.6L。这款跑车车型是第三代911 Carrera 2的轻量化版本。

usedCar.en:
If you're a fan of sports cars, you'll love the 964 series
Porsche 911 Carrera RS.

The 964 series was successful in the 'Carrera Cup', helping
to fuel a huge surge of consumer interest in race cars.

This Carrera RS is therefore a road-legal version of an
iconic racing champion.

The designers went to great lengths to get the most out of
the engine while keeping the car as light as possible.

It might not look all that powerful, but no other car out
there can compete when it comes to handling.
usedCar.zh:
如果你是跑车爱好者，那你会爱上964系列
Porsche 911 Carrera RS。

964系列在“Carrera Cup”中非常成功，让
大量的消费者对赛车产生了兴趣。

这款Carrera RS因此成为代表性赛车锦标赛
的合法公路版。

设计师在保持车身尽量轻盈的同时加长了
车身，让引擎发挥出最大的优势。

它看起来可能没那么强大，但就操作性
而言，没有其他车辆可与之媲美。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Porsche was a lighter version of the third-generation 911 Carrera 2 and came with a 3.6-liter flat-6.

In 1989, Porsche introduced the Type 964, the third-generation version of the popular 911. While the car featured approximately 80 percent new parts, it nevertheless stayed true to the elements that defined all 911s before it. What was different about this one was that the first model offered, the Carrera 4, came equipped with a new 4WD system originally developed for the vaunted 959. The lighter 2WD version of the 964, called the Carrera 2, came a year later in 1990.

All Type 964 911s came powered by an air-cooled flat-6, mounted aft of the rear wheels, with 3.6 liters of displacement. The Type 964 produced <250ps>/<31.6kgm>.

The Carrera RS was a performance model based on the Carrera 2, with a more rigid body structure and less weight (lighter by <120kg>). Power was upped to <260ps>, making this model a monster on the race track. A turbocharged 911 would appear later, with the top-of-the-line Turbo S delivering a whopping <381ps>.

long.en:

While the car featured approximately 80 percent new parts, it nevertheless stayed true to the elements that defined all 911s before it. What was different about this one was that the first model offered, the Carrera 4, came equipped with a new 4WD system originally developed for the vaunted 959. The lighter 2WD version of the 964, called the Carrera 2, came a year later in 1990.

All Type 964 911s came powered by an air-cooled flat-6, mounted aft of the rear wheels, with 3.6 liters of displacement. The Type 964 produced <250ps>/<31.6kgm>.

The Carrera RS was a performance model based on the Carrera 2, with a more rigid body structure and less weight (lighter by <120kg>). Power was upped to <260ps>, making this model a monster on the race track. A turbocharged 911 would appear later, with the top-of-the-line Turbo S delivering a whopping <381ps>.
long.zh:
1989年，保时捷公布了全新型号的911。这便是Type 964，911的第三代车型。

由于911在全球范围，尤其是在北美地区颇受欢迎，因此964的整体形象也和前代911颇为相近。另一方面，内部配置有了显著的改进，80%的部件都是全新设计的。随后公布的首款衍生车型Carrera 4搭载了959原型车上使用的四驱系统，旨在改善后置引擎带来的独特操控特性。在一年后的1990年，保时捷又顺势推出了更轻的后驱车款Carrera 2。

两款车都配备了911举世闻名的风冷水平对置6缸引擎，排量也增大到了3.6升，现在可输出<250ps>/<31.6kgm>扭矩。

Carrera RS是在Carrera 2基础上衍生的性能车型，加强了车身结构，同时减重达<120kg>。引擎动力也跟着水涨船高，来到了<260ps>。这些改进大幅提升了这款车的赛道表现。在964的产品线中，同样加入了涡轮增压车型。其中动力最强劲的涡轮增压S甚至可以输出惊人的<381ps>。

The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san. What an honour
it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel. He worked
for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic vintage

conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。认识您真是荣幸！

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展

conversation.en:
You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also their overall design…

Which is said to be owing to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s right-hand engineer.

Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.

With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...

A sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...

It is a basic example of the ‘Jaray-style.’
Q
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
很多人认为Porsche不仅在其汽车的架构上
受到Volkswagen的启发，整体设计理念方面也是如此……

并将之归功于艾尔文·柯曼达的天才头脑，
这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。

但将这一设计理念真正融入到现代911车型中的
其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。

在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……

后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……

这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。
g

conversation.en:
Yes! It refers to a design language used by the
aerodynamics expert Paul Jaray.

Jaray is known for his streamlined automobile designs,
which took inspiration from airplanes and airships.

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.zh:
我知道！这是指空气动力学专家保罗·贾雷
所创立的一种设计语言。

贾雷因其流线型汽车设计而闻名，
而他的设计灵感来源于飞机和飞船。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Porsche introduced the fourth-generation 911 in 1993 with the launch of the Type 993. Alongside revised styling, the model featured significant suspension improvements that enhanced handling. The most powerful variant of the series was the Carrera RS, released in 1995, which featured a more rigid yet lighter body. Powering the car was the final air-cooled engine used in the 911—a 3.8-liter flat-6 producing 295.9 HP. The track-focused Carrera RS Clubsport was also made available.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Porsche 911于1993年推出了代号为993的第四代车型。在造型设计更新的同时，悬挂系统也得到了改良，进一步提升了操控性能。最高性能版本是1995年推出的Carrera RS，采用了更加坚固，同时也更轻量化的车身结构。该车还搭载了993系列最后一款风冷引擎——一款3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，最大动力300 PS。同时还提供了专为赛道设计的Carrera RS Clubsport版本。

usedCar.en:
The Porsche 911 Type 993 will always be remembered as
the last of the air-cooled 911s.

The base Carrera models come with a naturally-aspirated
flat-6 engine, which is mounted aft of the rear axle.

This includes the venerable RS, which is based on a
racing version of the car.

The lightweight body and more responsive engine make this
particular machine stand out from the other 911s.

Although it isn't as fast in a straight line as the 911 Turbo,
many enthusiasts prefer taking this one out on the track.

这款Porsche 993作为911系列最后一款使用
风冷式引擎的车型，多次获得嘉奖。

它是体验搭载自然进气引擎的911车型的
完美方式。

与其他RS车型一样，这一名称表示该车型
是基于跑车版本。

轻量级车身结合响应速度更快的引擎，
与经典Porsche后置后驱布局相得益彰。

驾驶这款911时间越长，
就会越欣赏它。

vehicleCollection.en:
The most powerful version of the 993, the last air-cooled Porsche, came with a 3.8-liter flat-6 producing <300ps>.(

The Porsche 911 entered its fourth generation in 1993 with the introduction of the Type 993.

The most noticeable change was a significantly lower nose that flattened the peaks of the front fenders and swept the headlights rearward. The rear fenders were widened, among other revisions, giving the car an entirely new look. The rear suspension was also redesigned with a multilink setup to improve handling.

The base engine was a 3.6-liter flat-6 carried over from the previous Type 964 and tuned to <272ps>. With the succeeding 911 (996) moving to water cooling, the 993 became the last air-cooled flat-6 911.

The most powerful version of the Type 993 was the Carrera RS, released in 1995. Its engine was enlarged to a <300ps> 3.8-liter unit, body rigidity was increased, and weight was reduced by removing the rear seats.

The lineup also included the Carrera RS Clubsport, which featured track-oriented modifications such as a large front spoiler, a rear wing and a welded roll cage.

long.en:
The Porsche 911 entered its fourth generation in 1993 with the introduction of the Type 993.

The most noticeable change was a significantly lower nose that flattened the peaks of the front fenders and swept the headlights rearward. The rear fenders were widened, among other revisions, giving the car an entirely new look. The rear suspension was also redesigned with a multilink setup to improve handling.

The base engine was a 3.6-liter flat-6 carried over from the previous Type 964 and tuned to <272ps>. With the succeeding 911 (996) moving to water cooling, the 993 became the last air-cooled flat-6 911.

The most powerful version of the Type 993 was the Carrera RS, released in 1995. Its engine was enlarged to a <300ps> 3.8-liter unit, body rigidity was increased, and weight was reduced by removing the rear seats.

The lineup also included the Carrera RS Clubsport, which featured track-oriented modifications such as a large front spoiler, a rear wing and a welded roll cage.
long.zh:
1993年，保时捷911系列推出第4代，名为Type 993。

新一代车型最明显的改变是车鼻大幅降低，导致前挡泥板的顶端变平，头灯向后倾斜，后挡泥板也被加宽，再加上其他改动，让这款车的外观变得完全不同。后悬挂改为多连杆设计，以改善操控性。

它的基础动力单元以上一代964的3.6升水平对置6缸引擎为基础，马力调校到了<272ps>。由于下一代的996改为水冷，因此，993便成为了最后一款采用风冷水平对置6缸引擎的车型。

Type 993 911系列最强悍的车型莫过于1995年上市的Carrera RS。它的引擎升级为<300ps>马力和3.8升，车身刚性提高，并且去掉后座以减轻重量。

这条产品线还包括了Carrera RS Clubsport，加入一些针对赛道的改装，例如大型前扰流板和尾翼，以及焊接防滚架。

conversation.en:
Unlike the 993 Carrera RS, the 993 RS Clubsport
was bred for racing.

It is equipped with a unique rear wing
and integrated air inlets.

The downforce generated by the rear wing
is balanced with a long front spoiler.

The wheels are a three-piece design with
different offsets in the front and rear.

One look at the exterior details will tell you
it was the work of Style Porsche...

The in-house design studio at Porsche-Weissach.

The interior is defined by a spartan palette
and a reinforced roll cage.

Like other 911-based race cars of this era,
the Clubsport evokes its forebear.

Ah, I pity the owner whotresto convince
the authorities to alow it on the road!

A difficult task, bt not impossible!

conversation.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

In 1995, the Carrera RS followed, featuring a lighter yet more rigid body and a 295.9 HP 3.8-liter flat-6 engine. The lineup also included the track-focused Carrera RS Clubsport. Specifically designed for circuit use, it came equipped with a large front spoiler, a prominent rear wing, and a welded roll cage.

officialDetails.heroEn: This version of the Type 993, the final air-cooled Porsche 911, was designed specifically for the race track.
officialDetails.heroZh: 专为赛道打造的Type 993，最后一款911风冷车型。

usedCar.en:
The 993 series are famous for being the last
of the air-cooled 911s.

And even amongst RS models, Clubsport are a little special,
much coveted by collectors around the world.

The carpets and soundproofing have been removed to reduce
weight, and a roll cage added to make it more robust.

The 3.8L naturally aspirated flat engine is capable of <300ps>,
while the <1200kg> weight keeps the back end down.

The suspension is a little on the stiff side, but its handling
out on the track is nothing short of exceptional.
usedCar.zh:
993系列是911的最后一个风冷车型，
也因此而闻名于世。

即使在RS车型中，Clubsport版也算是特别之作，
深受世界各地收藏家的喜爱。

为了减轻重量，车内的地毯和隔音材料都被拆除，
还加装了防滚架以提高坚固性。

3.8升自然进气水平对置引擎提供，<300ps><1200kg>的车重则保障了后端的稳定性。

虽然悬挂系统的调校略硬，但丝毫无损赛道上的操作性。

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of the Type 993, the final air-cooled Porsche 911, was designed specifically for the race track.

The Porsche 911 entered its fourth generation in 1993 with the introduction of the Type 993.

The most noticeable change was a significantly lower nose that flattened the peaks of the front fenders and swept the headlights rearward. The rear fenders were widened, among other revisions, giving the car an entirely new look. The rear suspension was also redesigned with a multi-link setup to improve handling.

The base engine was a 3.6-liter flat-6 carried over from the previous Type 964 and tuned to <272ps>. With the succeeding 911 (996) moving to water cooling, the 993 became the last air-cooled flat-6 911.

The most powerful version of the Type 993 was the Carrera RS, released in 1995. Its engine was enlarged to a <300ps> 3.8-liter unit, body rigidity was increased, and weight was reduced by removing the rear seats.

The lineup also included the Carrera RS Clubsport, which featured track-oriented modifications such as a large front spoiler, a rear wing and a welded roll cage.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Porsche also developed the 911 GT1 Strassenversion—a road-legal counterpart to the 911 GT1 race car built for GT competition between 1996 and 1998. While the headlights were updated to match those of the Type 996, the core construction of the car remained nearly identical to its racing sibling. To comply with emissions regulations, the engine was detuned to 536.5 HP, yet the car still managed a 0–62.1 mph sprint in just 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of 191.4 mph.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Porsche在1996至1998年间为GT赛事开发了911 GT1赛车，911 GT1 Strassenversion是该车的道路合法版本。车灯改为与type 996相同的配置，但车辆的基础结构与赛车版本几乎别无二致。为符合排放法规，引擎动力下调至544 PS，但该车依然能够实现3.7秒的0-100 公里/小时加速时间，最高时速达308 公里/小时。
officialDetails.heroEn: A road-going version of the 911 GT1 was developed by Porsche to compete in GT racing.
officialDetails.heroZh: 911 GT1的公路版，此车是Porsche为GT赛事而专门开发的。

collection.en:
What do you call a street-legal Porsche 911 that shoots from
zero to <100km/h> in 3.7 secs, and tops out at <310km/h>?

Why, the Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion of course!

Developed to meet competition rules for the Le Mans
GT1 Class, only 25 cars were ever sold.

The production car it was based on was
pretty much a race car to begin with.

From its nose to its front suspension, the Porsche 911 GT1
Strassenversion looks like a type 993 911.

But behind the seats you’ll see lots of parts reminiscent of
the Porsche 962 that competed at Le Mans in the 1980s.

The engine is a fire-breathing twin-turbocharged
3.2-liter flat-6.

A chance to own this car rarely comes around.
And this is your chance.
collection.zh:
曾经有一台可以合法上路的Porsche 911，能在3.7秒内从零加速
至<100km>，极速高达<310km/h>，它的名字是？

没错，它就是Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion。

专为满足勒芒GT1级别赛事要求而打造，
仅发售了25辆。

它所基于的量产车从一开始
就几乎是一辆赛车。

从车头到前悬架部分，Porsche 911 GT1 Strassenversion
看起来就像993型号的Porsche 911，

但座椅后面的很多部件则让人想起
80年代征战勒芒的Porsche 962。

动力部分采用3.2升 双涡轮增压的
水平对置六缸引擎。

拥有这辆车的机会很少登门，机不可失哦。

catch.en: A road-going version of the 911 GT1 was developed by Porsche to compete in GT racing.
catch.zh: 911 GT1的公路版，此车是Porsche为GT赛事而专门开发的。

vehicleCollection.en:
A road-going version of the 911 GT1 was developed by Porsche to compete in GT racing.

As its name implies, the 911 GT1 Strassenversion was the "street version" of the 911 GT1, a race car developed to compete in grand touring races between 1996 to 1998. Because the FIA required that every GT1 race car needed to be based on a production car with at least 25 units produced, Porsche homologized the 911 GT1 into the vehicle you see here.

Introduced in 1996, the 911 GT1 race car used the Type 993 chassis converted into a mid-engine layout. Power came from a twin-turbocharged 3.2-liter flat-6 that produced <640ps>. A year later, the production version of the GT1 was released wearing the front fascia of the Type 996, but possessing the same basic architecture of the race car.

The engine was relatively unchanged, but power was decreased to <544ps> to meet European emissions standards. Still, the race car-converted-into-street car was remarkably quick, thanks to its lean curb weight of <1100kg>, which allowed the 911 GT1 Strassenversion to run from zero to <100km/h> in a scant 3.7 seconds and reach a top speed of <308km/h>.!

long.zh:
911 GT1 Strassenversion是911 GT1的街车版本，对标原型车是保时捷于1996到1998年参加GT赛事时所使用的赛车。根据国际汽联的规则，GT1组别的参赛车辆必须生产超过25辆民用版本，才能通过赛事规则认证。因此，这款车实际是以赛车标准设计，随后进行改装来获得上路许可。

这款车于1996年面市，在空间车架上使用了993的底板和车身，采用中置引擎布局。动力单元使用了一台双涡轮增压3.2升水平对置6缸引擎，可输出<640ps>。

同一年，街车版获得了上路许可。1997年生产的型号换用了996的车灯，以匹配911街车版本的改动，但它骨子里仍然是一款赛车。为了满足欧洲的排放规定，引擎动力被下调到了<544ps>。车身干重仅有<1100kg>，0至<100km/h>加速仅需3.7秒，极速更是可以达到<308km/h>。

That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!

He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.

Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...

...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.

没错！这款引擎由Porsche的传奇工程师汉斯·梅茨格打造！

他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，以及
F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。

尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 996-generation Porsche 911, introduced in 1997, was the first to feature a GT3 variant. Using the rigid Carrera 4 chassis as a foundation, it incorporated race-grade upgrades to the suspension and brakes, while the engine took on a GT1-spec crankcase for high-rev performance. A total of 1,889 units were produced.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 最初于1997年推出的996款911是首款GT3车型。以高刚性的Carrera 4车身为基础，悬挂和刹车均升级为赛车级部件，而引擎则用适合更高转速的GT1曲轴箱来搭配。此车总共生产了1889台。
officialDetails.heroEn: The 911's first GT3 spec model was introduced for the Type 996. It proved to be very popular, selling 1889 units.
officialDetails.heroZh: Type 993引入了911系列中的首款GT3规格车型。这款车深受消费者的喜爱，现已售出1,889辆。

brandCentral.en:
The 996 GT3 was a true labor of love for Porsche's
top engineers.

In fact, this high-performance model reinvented the 911 genre.

First, instead of the traditional air-cooled engine, this one
came with a water-cooled boxer powerplant.

Thanks to its excellent power and race-ready chassis, the GT3
served as the foundation for many race cars.

Some say it's the true successor to the 993 Carrera RS.

But everyone agrees it's a car that will go down
in Porsche history.
brandCentral.zh:
996 GT3是Porsche的顶尖工程师们充满热诚的产物：

基于充满魅力的911原版车打造，

并加入部分现代化的设计要素，尤其是一台水冷引擎。

这款GT3在未来将会成为多款赛车的设计基础。

还有人说他是993 Carrera RS的真正继承者。

无论从哪个角度看，它都是一款真正具有开创历史意义的赛车。

usedCar.en:
The Porsche 911 GT3 came into being with the Type 996, and
it has since become a mainstay of the brand.

vehicleCollection.en:
The 911's first GT3 spec model was introduced for the Type 996. It proved to be very popular, selling 1889 units.

It can arguably be said that the Porsche 911 is the quintessential sports car, with many race versions found in all kinds of series all over the world, as well as various trim levels to satisfy the most demanding enthusiast. Nowadays, the GT3 model is the closest thing you can get to a race-ready car, and this super-focused model first appeared in the 911 lineup in 1999.

In the midst of the Type 996 production run (1997 to 2002), the GT3 was introduced using the Carrera 4 chassis, which possessed a stiffer body and was slightly wider than the C2's. In addition to suspension upgrades, the 911 GT3 utilized the brake system (calipers and discs) of the 911 Turbo for better stopping power from higher speeds.

The engine featured what is called a GT1 crank case, a high-strength unit used for race cars to withstand heavy loads at high rpm. The cylinder head came equipped with Variocam Plus, a two-stage variable-valve lift mechanism. The 3.6-liter naturally-aspirated engine produced <360ps>, which was <60ps> more than the standard 3.4-liter flat-6.

Initially, the 911 GT3 was planned for a limited production run of 1400 cars, but a total of 1889 cars were built to satisfy high demand.

GT3于1999年公布，采用Carrera 4底盘，拥有极高的车身刚性，适合赛场竞速。除了悬挂系统的升级外，它还采用了取自911 Turbo的卡钳和刹车碟，以满足高速驾驶的需求。

它的引擎采用了GT1曲轴箱，这是一种高强度的曲轴箱，能够承受赛车在高转数下的负载。它的气缸盖采用了升级版可变凸轮轴正时技术，也就是2段可变气门升程装置。3.6升的自然进气引擎马力达到了<360ps>，比标准版911的3.4升引擎高出足足<60ps>。

911 GT3最初计划限量生产1400台，但由于需求高涨，最后共生产了1889台。

vehicleCollection.en:
Featuring adjustable dampers as standard equipment, this GT3 version of the Type 997 made its debut in 2006.

The GT3 model joined the Porsche 911 lineup in 2001, during the Type 996 production run (1997 to 2002). The 911 GT3 proved to be as fast as it was popular, prompting Porsche to offer it for its Type 997 911. The new 997 911 GT3 was introduced in 2006, and like its predecessor, it was a race car in road-car clothing, still built on the Carrera 4 chassis with various reinforcements and brake upgrades.

While the 3.6-liter flat-6 was basically the same as the one found in the 996 GT3, it did get a power increase of <34ps>, raising the final number to <415ps>. And for handling improvements, the new GT3 (as well as the RS) came equipped with PASM variable damping shocks.

In 2008, the 911 GT3 received a performance upgrade, with engine displacement increased from 3.6 to 3.8 liters. Thanks also to slight tuning of the exhaust system, the car was rated at an incredible <435ps>. The suspension system was also stiffened and a new PSM system was added to control the car's stability and traction.

displacement over the previous model...

...the Porsche 911 GT3 R (992) became the first

然后它就在下一年再次上演了同样的精彩戏码

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 911 GT3 R was a pure racing machine developed from the 992-model 911, the eighth generation of Porsche’s everyday sports car. Introduced in 2022, this machine was equipped with a naturally aspirated 4.2-liter flat-6 engine, producing a maximum 557.2 HP. It also featured lightweight carbon body panels and aramid-fiber components, as well as the double-wishbone/multilink suspension setup derived from the 911 RSR.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 911 GT3 R是一款纯粹为赛道而生的跑车，基于Porsche面向日常使用的911跑车的第八代车型992来研发。这款于2022年发布的赛车装备了一台自然进气的4.2升水平对置六缸引擎，可产生高达565 PS的动力。其车身还采用了轻量化的碳纤维车身板件和芳纶纤维部件，以及沿袭自911 RSR的双摇臂/多连杆悬挂配置。

officialDetails.heroZh: 脱胎于第八代911车系的纯粹竞速机器。

brandCentral.en:
What hasn’t already been said about the Porsche 911,
that historic and legendary sports car par excellence?

This GT3 R was derived from the 911 (992) introduced in 2018.
It may resemble a road car, but it was engineered for racing.

Notably, its displacement was increased to 4.2 liters,
and the engine was tilted forward by 5.5 degrees.

A revised layout extended the wheelbase to <2507mm>, and both
the front and rear axles employed a multilink suspension.

The underfloor design concep was particularly striking, and
the swan-neck mount for the rear wing was a novel touch.

Meanwhile, the interior featured a centered seat, roll cage,
and a 10.3-inch display.

A car with a truly international clientele, the 911 GT3 R
proved its raing prowess at events across the world.
brandCentral.zh:
对于保时捷911这款无与伦比的历史传奇跑车，
人们早已穷尽赞美之辞。

眼前这台GT3 R正是基于2018款911（992）打造。
它虽然形似公路跑车，实则是专为赛道竞速而生。

相比911，它的显著变化在于引擎排量增加到了4.2升，
且引擎姿态向前倾斜了5.5度。

布局经过优化，将轴距延长到了<2507mm>，前后轴
均采用多连杆悬挂系统。

底板的设计理念相当惊艳，尾翼的天鹅颈式支架
也是富有新意的神来之笔。

同时，在座舱内，中央驾驶位、防滚架和10.3英寸显示屏
一应俱全。

作为饱受全球车迷喜爱的车型，911 GT3 R
还在世界各地的赛场上证明了其非凡实力。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is a pure racing machine from the 8th generation 911 catalogue.

Since the introduction of the original Porsche 911 more than half a century ago in 1963, the 911 had long been regarded as the epitome of the sports car on both public roads and race circuits around the world. With its unique rear-mounted flat-6 engine and highly tuned performance, the 911 series had claimed victory in countless races, cementing its position in automotive history.

This bloodline was continued by the eighth-generation "992" model 911, released in 2018. With features such as stretched rear fenders on all models, 4-point LED headlights, and intricate rear combination lamps, this car became the true embodiment of modern Porsche design philosophy. Built around a turbocharged 3.0-liter flat-6, technological upgrades like improved cooling and the 8-speed PDK transmission allowed for peak performance from everyday driving to spirited sports use.

The 992 model was also developed into a pure racing machine as the 911 GT3 R.

Introduced in 2022, this car housed a 4.2-liter flat-6 engine producing up to <565ps>. It featured carbon-fiber and aramid-woven components, along with the double-wishbone and multilink suspension from the 911 RSR.

The brakes featured AP Racing discs, while the driver controls were updated with new steering components and a 10.3-inch user display. The 911 GT3 R represented the culmination of all Porsche’s racing knowledge and technology—a single purpose-built car designed to dominate the circuit.

long.zh:
自从1963年保时捷911初代车型问世以来，历经半个多世纪，911已经成为了全球公路和赛道上公认的跑车典范。凭借独特的后置水平对置6缸引擎和精密的性能调校，911系列在无数赛事中斩获桂冠，从而奠定了其在汽车史上的传奇地位。

这份血脉在2018年问世的第八代911（“992”）车型上得以传承。全系标配的宽体后挡泥板、4点式发光二极管大灯和精巧的尾灯套组，都令此车彰显出现代保时捷设计哲学的精髓。该车的动力核心是一台3.0升的水平对置六缸涡轮增压引擎，辅以强化的冷却系统以及8速保时捷双离合器变速箱等技术升级，令此车无论是日常驾驶还是赛道竞速，都能保持巅峰性能。

基于992车型，保时捷还打造了一款纯粹赛车版本，并命名为911 GT3 R。

这款于2022年发布的车型，采用一台4.2升水平对置6缸引擎，可产生<565ps>的动力。车身采用了碳纤维/芳纶混编复合材料打造的部件，并沿袭了911 RSR的双摇臂和多连杆悬挂结构。相比前代991车型，其轴距进一步加长，从<2459mm>增至<2507mm>。

其制动系统配备了AP赛车刹车盘，驾驶操控也全面升级，采用了全新的转向组件和10.3英寸的用户显示屏。911 GT3 R集保时捷赛道经验和技术之大成，是一台专为主宰赛场而生的赛车。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This high-performance model served as a further evolution of the 991-generation Porsche 911 GT3. Starting with the wide-body shell of the 911 Turbo, Porsche increased front and rear track widths, while also implementing major weight reductions and aerodynamic enhancements. The engine, enlarged to 4.0 liters, produced 493.1 HP and enabled the car to record a Nürburgring Nordschleife lap time of 7 minutes and 20 seconds.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款高性能车型是991系列中的Porsche 911 GT3的改进版。基于911 Turbo的宽体车身，前后轮距加宽，同时进行了大幅减重和空气动力学方面的改进。如今引擎排量扩容至4升，动力输出达500 PS，得以在纽博格林北侧赛道创下7分20秒的圈速。
officialDetails.heroEn: The ultimate 991, rebuilt from the ground up.
officialDetails.heroZh: 从零开始全新打造的终极版911。

brandCentral.en:
It's no secret that many of Porsche's road-going masterpieces
were the product of the company's racing heritage.

The 911 GT3 RS is no different.

The engine and suspension were custom-built for this car.

And extra steps were taken to reduce the weight,
including the installation of a magnesium roof.

The 991 was the first GT3 RS car to add rear-wheel
steering to its formidable array of features.

If you want to go fast anywhere from the open road to a
challenging race track, this car should be high on your list.
brandCentral.zh:
Porsche那赛车范十足的设计风格深受全世界汽车爱好者的喜爱。

这款911 GT3 RS就充分地展现了他们最精湛的生产工艺。

定制化打造的引擎和悬挂系统自不必提。

Porsche还采取了一系列措施来减轻车重，例如安装镁合金车顶等。

在同类型车中首次应用的后轮转向让本就所向披靡的各项特性
如虎添翼。

不论车速有多快，它都能确保提供超一流的操控性能。

catch.en: The ultimate 991, rebuilt from the ground up.
catch.zh: 从零开始全新打造的终极版911。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate 991, rebuilt from the ground up.

Since the Type 996, the name "GT3" had been given to Porsche 911 roadcars with a strong emphasis on motorsports, developed with FIA GT3 race regulations in mind. And for the 996 and the later 997, there exists a "GT3 RS," which further refines the GT3 and improves its performance. At the 2015 Geneva Motor Show, the successor to these, the Type 991 GT3 RS was announced.

The model is said to be based on the Type 991 GT3, but on the inside it is something that looks like it has been developed from scratch using all the knowhow they have gathered over the years.

The body takes the widest 911 Turbo model, with track widths in the front and rear widened even further. The roof is made of magnesium, the front fenders and hood are carbon fiber. The rear and rear side windows are acrylic, giving a total weight reduction of <10kg>.

Aerodynamic parts have also been updated. The front spoiler is even lower and wider, and the rear wing stands much higher and is larger. Behind the front fenders are air outlets for drawing air out from under the car. As a result, the downforce is more than double that of a standard 911.

The engine takes the 3.8-liter engine of the GT3 and extends its stroke, making it 4.0 liters in displacement. The tuned engine now produces <25ps>/<2.0kgm> more, at <500ps>/<46.9kgm>. And the dampers, springs and stabilizers for both the front and rear have been newly developed for this car.

As a result the car lapped the Nürburgring at 7 minutes 20 seconds, a full 5 seconds faster than the base 911 GT3.

long.zh:
自从Type 996以来，“GT3”这个名字被用于保时捷911公路车的命名，这个系列在设计时参考国际汽联GT3比赛规则，重视在赛车运动中的表现。996和稍后的997都有“GT3 RS”版，在GT3基础上进一步优化，提高其性能。在2015年日内瓦车展上，上述车款的继任者Type 991 GT3 RS发布。

这款车据称是基于Type 991 GT3开发的，但从内部结构来看，这款车更像是车厂运用多年来累积的经验全新开发的产物。

这款车的车身是目前911 Turbo车款中最宽的，前后的轮距也进一步加宽。车顶由镁材料制成，前挡泥板和引擎盖由碳纤维制成。车尾和后侧窗采用丙烯酸塑料，使得总重量减少了<10kg>。

空气动力学组件也进行了升级。前扰流板更低也更宽，尾翼则更高更大。前挡泥板后方设置了排气口，使空气经过车底排出。因此，该车的下压力达到标准911的两倍多。

引擎采用GT3的3.8升引擎，并增大其冲程，使排量达到4.0升。引擎经过调校后输出增大了<25ps>/<2.0kgm>，达到<500ps>/<46.9kgm>。前后轮的避震器、弹簧和防滚杆都是专为这款车全新开发的。

结果，这款车最终以7分20秒完成纽博格林赛道，圈速比原型车911 GT3整整快了5秒。

It was fitted with a range of advanced aerodynamic systems, including a large swan-neck rear wing with DRS (drag reduction system) and an active diffuser that functioned as an air brake under hard braking.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Porsche 911 GT3 RS（992）是一款高性能公路跑车，采用了源自911 GT3 R赛车的空气动力学套件。该车配备了多种先进的空气动力学系统，包括搭载DRS（可变尾翼减阻系统）的大型天鹅颈式尾翼，以及在急刹车时可起到气动减速作用的可调主动式扩散器。
officialDetails.heroEn: A hyper-performance road car packed with race car features.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一辆配备各种赛车特性的终极性能公路车。

brandCentral.en:
The Porsche 911 GT3 RS is the modern incarnation
of the legendary 911 Carrera RS from 1973.

It was based on the 992 Porsche 911 GT3 from 2021...

...which was another special creation from Porsche’s
motorsports division.

Unique to the GT3 RS, however, is the technology it inherited
from race cars like the 911 RSR and 911 GT3R.

Whether it’s on the road or in your garage, this is one

Porsche 911 GT3 RS是1973年的传奇车型
911 Carrera RS的现代版本。

这款车是基于2021年的992 Porsche 911 GT3所打造……

而后者本就是Porsche赛车运动部门的特殊作品。

赛车处继承的技术。

不论是上路行驶，还是停在你的车库里，

vehicleCollection.en:
A hyper-performance road car packed with race car features.

Introduced in the summer of 2022, the Porsche 911 GT3 RS (992) was a high-performance road car that brought the aerodynamics of the 911 GT3 R race car to the 992 model.

Visually, the car shared more in common with race cars than even its predecessor, the 991.2 model GT3 RS. Its most prominent feature was the swan-neck-mounted rear wing, the largest ever fitted to a production Porsche. It incorporated a Formula 1-style drag reduction system (DRS), which, under certain conditions, allowed the wing to flatten at the push of a button to reduce drag and increase top speed. Under heavy braking, the system also functioned as an air brake, increasing aerodynamic drag to enhance stopping performance.

Beyond these features, further aerodynamic refinements included front aero bars and air outlets integrated into both the front and rear fenders. These innovations collectively resulted in more than double the downforce produced by the 991.2 GT3 RS. Additional race-derived features, inspired by the 911 GT3 R and RSR, included the front compartment—traditionally used for luggage—which was replaced by a front-mounted radiator. This was one of the key features of the 992 model GT3 RS.

Mounted at the rear was a naturally-aspirated 4.0-liter flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed PDK transmission. Official figures indicated a modest power increase of <5ps> over its predecessor, bringing the output to <525ps>, while peak torque was reduced by <0.51kgm> to <47.42kgm>. The GT3 RS sprinted from 0 to <100 km/h> in just 3.2 seconds and reached a top speed of <296km/h>.

long.zh:
2022夏季推出的保时捷911 GT3 RS (992)是一款终极性能公路跑车，直接将赛车型号911 GT3 R的空气动力学设计下放到了992上。

相比前代GT3 RS (991.2)，992的外观更向赛车靠拢：最显著的特征便是那所有量产保时捷车型中体积最大的天鹅颈式尾翼。它甚至应用了一级方程式的可变尾翼减阻系统，可将尾翼一键调整到水平状态，进而降低阻力，使车提升至极速。此外，在高速下进行急刹车时，其可调主动式前扰流板能够起到气动减速的作用，提升制动性能。

除了上述特性外，这款车还采用了如前气动双叉臂和前、后挡泥板进气口等空气动力学优化部件，能比前代的991.2 GT3 RS产生多一倍的下压力。这款车还从911 GT3 R和RSR等赛车处继承了许多其他特性，例如在通常作为储物空间使用的前备箱中放入了一部中央散热器。这也成为了新一代GT3 RS的卖点之一。

其动力系统采用了一部4升直列6缸自然进气引擎，搭配7速保时捷双离合器变速箱。根据官方提供的数据，它能够输出<525ps>的动力，比前代型号提升了<5ps>，不过最大扭矩却降低了<0.51kgm>，为<47.42kgm>。它可以在3.2秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，并可以达到<296km/h>的极速。

vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆配备各种赛车特性的终极性能公路车。

2022夏季推出的保时捷911 GT3 RS (992)是一款终极性能公路跑车，直接将赛车型号911 GT3 R的空气动力学设计下放到了992上。

相比前代GT3 RS (991.2)，992的外观更向赛车靠拢：最显著的特征便是那所有量产保时捷车型中体积最大的天鹅颈式尾翼。它甚至应用了一级方程式的可变尾翼减阻系统，可将尾翼一键调整到水平状态，进而降低阻力，使车提升至极速。此外，在高速下进行急刹车时，其可调主动式前扰流板能够起到气动减速的作用，提升制动性能。

除了上述特性外，这款车还采用了如前气动双叉臂和前、后挡泥板进气口等空气动力学优化部件，能比前代的991.2 GT3 RS产生多一倍的下压力。这款车还从911 GT3 R和RSR等赛车处继承了许多其他特性，例如在通常作为储物空间使用的前备箱中放入了一部中央散热器。这也成为了新一代GT3 RS的卖点之一。

其动力系统采用了一部4升直列6缸自然进气引擎，搭配7速保时捷双离合器变速箱。根据官方提供的数据，它能够输出<525ps>的动力，比前代型号提升了<5ps>，不过最大扭矩却降低了<0.51kgm>，为<47.42kgm>。它可以在3.2秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，并可以达到<296km/h>的极速。

With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning
in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...

...Porsche needed to do something.

Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...

...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.

Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar,
getting Tony Hatter to design...

...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.

The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...

...its mid-engine architecture, making it look
like a rear-engine 991.

That said, it is wider and more aggressive.

As the saying goes in the automobile industry...

..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"

vehicleCollection.en:
This 911, the first in history to feature a mid-engine layout, is a full competition spec machine.(

Starting with the Carrera RSR that was born in 1973 to compete in Group 4 racing, the RSR series has left an impressive mark in the world of motorsports over the years. The latest version of the series based on the 7th generation model of the 911 (Type 991) is the 911 RSR that debuted at the 2016 Los Angeles Auto Show.

This RSR is a pure competition machine born and bred to race in the LM-GTE class of the WEC (World Endurance Championships), and the American IMSA. Even though it’s obvious just by looking at the completely different exterior, including the aerodynamics, body structure, engine, and transmission, the car was truly developed in an entirely different process from the road car.

The showcase of difference is in the engine. In the history of the 911 series the engine was always mounted behind the rear axle, but this is the first car where the engine is mounted mid-ship, in front of the axle. What resides in that space is a 4-liter, horizontally opposed 6-cylinder naturally aspirated engine with direct fuel injection, producing <510ps>. The change in the engine mounting location had an immense impact on drivability, and furthermore allowed the addition of a large diffuser in its original space, giving it a distinct advantage in terms of aerodynamics. The large swan neck rear spoiler that was carried over from the 919 Hybrid LMP machine also gives the RSR’s rear end a distinct look.

At the Le Mans 24 hour race held in June 2017, the 911 RSR led the pack for much of the race, proving its impressive performance to sports car fans. Although it did not make it on top of the podium due to an unfortunate tire issue near the end, its driving performance was top notch throughout the race and worthy of the RSR lineage.

long.zh:
Carrera RSR诞生于1973年，用于参加组别4的比赛。自此以后，RSR系列多年来在赛车世界中给人留下了深刻的印象。该系列的最新车款是911 RSR，这款车基于911的第七代车款（Type 991），在2016年洛杉矶车展上首次亮相。

这款RSR是一款纯粹的赛车，专为参加世界耐力锦标赛的LM-GTE级别比赛和美国国际汽车运动协会赛而打造。只需看看这款车截然不同的外观（包括空气动力学设计）、车身结构、引擎和变速箱等，便不难发现，其开发过程完全不同于公路车。

在这些不同之处中，最引人注目的还是引擎。在911系列的历史上，引擎一直是安装在后轴的后方。而这款车首次采用了安装在车轴前方的中置式引擎。引擎使用的是一台4升6缸水平对置自然吸气引擎，采用燃料直喷技术，输出马力为<510ps>。引擎安装位置的变化对驾驶性带来巨大的影响，这也使得在原先引擎位置增加一个大型扰流翼成为可能，在空气动力学上带来明显的优势。大型天鹅颈式后扰流板继承自919 Hybrid勒芒原型车，也使得RSR的尾部看起来与众不同。

在2017年6月举行的勒芒24小时耐力赛上，911 RSR在大部分比赛时间中一马当先，向跑车车迷们证实了其优异的性能。虽然最后由于临近终点时发生了不幸的轮胎故障，未能登上领奖台，但其驾驶性能在整场比赛中仍可称得上出类拔萃，无愧于RSR血统。

conversation.en:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo".
Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."

Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the
turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.

Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more
displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of <300ps>.

Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on
the rear tires giving it superior traction.

Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that
can really get up and go!

This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces
and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.zh:
这辆车让世界领教到了“涡轮”的真正含义。
即使在今天，这辆车也会经常被提起。

Porsche汇集了他们所有的涡轮设计经验，
然后将其倾注到了这台930型911的涡轮上。

相比79年版，这款车的排气量提升到了3.3升，动力也增加至了<300ps>。

由于911是一辆后置引擎的跑车，其后轮承受的重量更多，
产生的抓地力也更大。

在这些基础上，涡轮增压器更是大幅增加了这辆车的进气量！

这辆930在Porsche众多杰作中占有一席之地，非常有收藏价值。

dialogues.en:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo".
Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."

Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the
turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.

Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more
displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of <300ps>.

Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on
the rear tires giving it superior traction.

Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that
can really get up and go!

This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces
and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.zh:
这辆车让世界领教到了“涡轮”的真正含义。
即使在今天，这辆车也会经常被提起。

Porsche汇集了他们所有的涡轮设计经验，
然后将其倾注到了这台930型911的涡轮上。

相比79年版，这款车的排气量提升到了3.3升，动力也增加至了<300ps>。

由于911是一辆后置引擎的跑车，其后轮承受的重量更多，
产生的抓地力也更大。

在这些基础上，涡轮增压器更是大幅增加了这辆车的进气量！

这辆930在Porsche众多杰作中占有一席之地，非常有收藏价值。
