officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 1975, the 911 Turbo was the first production Porsche to wear the now-iconic "Turbo" badge. True to its name, the car’s 3.0L air-cooled flat-6 engine was equipped with a KKK turbocharger, producing 256.4 HP. This setup enabled the car to cruise at speeds of up to 155.3 mph—a remarkable feat for its era. Beginning in 1977, the engine’s displacement was increased to 3.3 liters and paired with an air-to-air intercooler, which further boosted performance.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1975年推出的这款911 Turbo是Porsche量产车历史上首款使用“Turbo”标识的车型。正如其标识所示，3升风冷水平对置6缸引擎搭载了KKK涡轮增压器，最大动力达260 PS。这些配置还能让该车达到250 公里/小时的巡航速度，在当时堪称惊人的成就。从1977年起，引擎排量提升至3.3升并增配了空对空式中间冷却器，进一步提升了动力输出。
officialDetails.heroEn: This top-of-the-line version of the vaunted 911 possessed a more muscular look and a turbocharged engine.
officialDetails.heroZh: 911系列当中的旗舰款，拥有强大的车身设计和同等强劲的涡轮增压引擎。

usedCar.en:
This 930 version of the 911 is the first Porsche production
car to include turbocharging technology.

Turbocharging was originally a standard feature of
Porsche race cars in the 1970s.

But it wasn't long before the company decided to incorporate
forced-induction into its flagship vehicles.

Thanks to the added boost supplied from the turbocharger,
the engine pumps out <300ps>.

The wide rear tires help transfer this power to the driving
surface, making this thing a beast on the race track.#
usedCar.zh:
这款基于911车型的930是第一款搭载涡轮
增压技术的Porsche产车。

涡轮增压是1970年代Porsche
最初的标准特色。

但不久之后公司就决定将
这一特色融入他们的旗舰线。

当时引擎最多只能产生<300ps>的马力，而
涡轮产生的增压大大弥补了这一缺失。

宽大的后轮满足了人们对后置后驱车型
预期的稳固抓地力。

vehicleCollection.en:
This top-of-the-line version of the vaunted 911 possessed a more muscular look and a turbocharged engine.

The first time that the word "Turbo" appeared on a Porsche product was 1975, with the birth of the 911 Turbo. This car became the company's halo model, as it possessed much of the technology gained from its participation in motorsports.

The car's bulging front and rear fenders were indeed reminiscent of a race machine, as was its large rear wing. Sitting right under that wing was Porsche's tried and tested 3.0-liter air-cooled flat-6 equipped with a KKK Turbocharger. This engine produced <260ps>, which allowed the lightweight 911 to reach a top speed of <250km/h>, an incredible feat for a production car of its day.

From 1977, the engine's displacement was increased to 3.3 liters, while an air-cooled intercooler was added to raise power to <300ps>. This version of the Porsche 911 Turbo was produced up to 1989, and is often referred to as the "930 Turbo." The name came from the internal code name of the car, 930, and also because the folks at Porsche themselves referred to it as the 930 Turbo at the Paris Motor Show where the car was displayed a year before going on sale.

long.zh:
保时捷的量产车型首次使用“Turbo”一词命名是在1975年。当时911 Turbo刚刚开始投入市场，这款车集成了保时捷在赛车运动中研发和积累的全部涡轮增压技术。

它的前后挡泥板像赛车一样向外突出，后段装上了大型尾翼。3.0L风冷水平对置6缸引擎上搭载了一台KKK涡轮增压器，输出动力可达<260ps>。这些配置让这款车的巡行速度都能达到<250km/h>，以当时的量产车型来说，是一个不可思议的水平。

自1977年起，它的排量提高到3.3升，引擎舱内加装了一台风冷式中间冷却器，马力提升至<300ps>。1985年之前，采用这款引擎的车一直都是标准产品线上的最高规格车型。

这个版本的保时捷911 Turbo于1989年停产。它通常被称作930 Turbo，因为保时捷研发部门内部给它的型号代码是930，而它在发售前一年的巴黎车展上展出的试验生产车型也叫930 Turbo。

brandCentral.en:
For more than six decades, the Porsche 911 has remained
a timeless icon within the brand's storied lineup.

In 2018, Porsche unveiled the eighth-generation model,
known as the "992."

Built on the new MMB platform, the 992 utilized more aluminum in
its construction, achieving a lighter curb weight.

The pinnacle of the 992 series was the 911 Turbo S,
a model that outshined its siblings in performance.

Powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.7-liter flat-6 that delivered
<650ps>/<81.6kgm> to all four wheels…

...this gasoline-powered engine catapulted the 911 to new heights
in a landscape increasingly dominated by electric vehicles.'
brandCentral.zh:
作为Porsche的标志性车型，911已有超过60年的历史。

2018年，它以“992”的代号迈入第八代。

992虽然采用全新的“MMB”开发平台，
但通过大量应用铝合金材料实现了轻量化。

作为992系列的旗舰性能车型，911 Turbo S自然实力非凡。

搭载3.7升水平对置六缸双涡轮增压引擎，可向四个车轮
输出<650ps>/<81.6kgm>的动力……

几乎可以说，它在电气化时代来临前将911系列
推向了新的高峰。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top performance version of the eighth-generation 911.

For more than 60 years, the Porsche 911 has reigned as the crown jewel of the historic sports-car company, and in 2018, it entered its eighth generation, codenames "992."

Visually, the 992 refined the design language introduced by its predecessor, the 991. While the body grew slightly larger, Porsche made significant strides in weight management by incorporating more aluminum into the construction. One notable departure from tradition was the elimination of the "narrow body" base model, a hallmark of previous generations.

A key innovation in the 992's design was the new "MMB" modular development platform. This flexible architecture included a front axle, floor, and rear axle, designed to accommodate both rear-engine and mid-engine configurations by simply adjusting the rear axle position.

The powertrain reflected a move toward downsizing, with the base model powered by a turbocharged 3.0-liter flat-6. Power output varies by model, with the Carrera generating <385ps> and the Carrera S delivering <450ps>. The standard gearbox was an 8-speed PDK, while a 7-speed manual was available for the Carrera 4 and Carrera 4S.

In April 2020, the range-topping Turbo S model joined the 992 lineup. Featuring a slightly shorter stroke than its predecessors, the twin-turbocharged 3.7-liter flat-6 produced an impressive <650ps> and <800Nm> of torque (<81.6kgm>), sending power to all four wheels.

These figures translated into phenomenal performance: the Turbo S accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in just 2.7 seconds, and a top speed of <330 km/h>. As the automotive world edges toward electrification, the 992 Turbo S may well represent the pinnacle of the internal combustion era for the iconic 911.

long.zh:
911产品线作为保时捷品牌的象征已经超过60年。2018年，第八代911问世，代号“992”。

在外观方面，992进一步提炼了其前代车型991的设计。车身尺寸略有增加，但通过增加铝材的使用，车重得到了很好的控制。另一个显著变化是取消了以往的“窄体”基础版车型。

在结构方面，值得注意的是新采用的“MMB”模块化开发平台。这一灵活的平台由前轴、车底板和后轴组成，可以调整后轴的位置来适配后置引擎或中置引擎的设计需要。

动力方面有所缩减，基础版车型搭载了3.0L涡轮增压水平对置6缸引擎。动力输出根据车型的不同进行调校，Carrera能输出<385ps>，Carrera S则能输出<450ps>。标准变速箱为8速保时捷双离合器变速箱，Carrera 4和Carrera 4S可选7速手动变速箱。

2020年4月，Turbo S加入了992系列，并成为该系列的顶级性能车型。相比前几代的Turbo S，新款车型冲程稍短，<3745cc>排量的水平对置6缸双涡轮增压引擎能输出<650ps>/800Nm（<81.6kgm>），为四个轮胎带来强劲的动力。

以上的性能指标使其能够在2.7秒内从0加速到<100km/h>，最高时速可达<330km/h>。在电动汽车蓬勃发展的当下，这款汽油车很可能成为电动时代之前911的巅峰之作。

在结构方面，值得注意的是新采用的“MMB”模块化开发平台。这一灵活的平台由前轴、车底板和后轴组成，可以调整后轴的位置来适配后置引擎或中置引擎的设计需要。

动力方面有所缩减，基础版车型搭载了3.0L涡轮增压水平对置6缸引擎。动力输出根据车型的不同进行调校，Carrera能输出<385ps>，Carrera S则能输出<450ps>。标准变速箱为8速保时捷双离合器变速箱，Carrera 4和Carrera 4S可选7速手动变速箱。

2020年4月，Turbo S加入了992系列，并成为该系列的顶级性能车型。相比前几代的Turbo S，新款车型冲程稍短，<3745cc>排量的水平对置6缸双涡轮增压引擎能输出<650ps>/800Nm（<81.6kgm>），为四个轮胎带来强劲的动力。

以上的性能指标使其能够在2.7秒内从0加速到<100km/h>，最高时速可达<330km/h>。在电动汽车蓬勃发展的当下，这款汽油车很可能成为电动时代之前911的巅峰之作。

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation 911 Turbo was virtually all new with 80 percent new parts. +

One of the most storied sports cars in history is the Porsche 911, and among the most popular versions of this classic German sports car is the Type 964, the third-generation model introduced in 1989. While its exterior appeared nearly identical to its predecessor, the 930, the 964 featured approximately 80 percent of new parts, all but making it an all-new model.

The 964 was offered in three different trim levels: the rear-drive Carrera 2 base car, the all-wheel-drive Carrera 4 and the high-performance 911 Turbo. When the 911 Turbo made its debut, it came with the same turbocharged 3.3-liter flat-6 in the Type 930 911 Turbo, producing <320ps>, but in 1993, Porsche upgraded the powerplant to a turbocharged 3.6-liter, increasing power to <360ps>. The new 911 Turbo 3.6 looked meaner too, with a body lowered by <20mm>, the addition of Speedline 18-inch wheels and a special RS bumper.

The Type 964 remains one of the most popular 911 models ever, and the 964 911 Turbo has become a highly sought-after car for classic Porsche collectors everywhere.

The 964 was offered in three different trim levels: the rear-drive Carrera 2 base car, the all-wheel-drive Carrera 4 and the high-performance 911 Turbo. When the 911 Turbo made its debut, it came with the same turbocharged 3.3-liter flat-6 in the Type 930 911 Turbo, producing <320ps>, but in 1993, Porsche upgraded the powerplant to a turbocharged 3.6-liter, increasing power to <360ps>. The new 911 Turbo 3.6 looked meaner too, with a body lowered by <20mm>, the addition of Speedline 18-inch wheels and a special RS bumper.

The Type 964 remains one of the most popular 911 models ever, and the 964 911 Turbo has become a highly sought-after car for classic Porsche collectors everywhere.
long.zh:
首次亮相于1989年的Type 964是保时捷911的第三代车型。基于Type 901和930车型研发和演进，带来全面一代的变革，车内约有80%的零部件都是全新设计的。尽管初看时外观与型号930十分相似，其实车体进行了大量空气动力学改动。

在机械工程方面，水平对置6缸引擎的排量扩大到了3.6升。Carrera 4引入的新款全轮驱动迅速成为了热议话题。而针对后驱版本，全线引入手自一体变速箱也帮助911有效地扩大了市场。

对于追求更多动力的车手们，Type 964同样带来了一款涡轮增压车型，最初采用继承自Type 930的3.3升<320ps>引擎。在1992年，又追加了纪念国际汽车运动协会参赛生产的高功率版本，也就是911 Turbo S。

高升程凸轮轴加上特制的涡轮，总共可产生<381ps>/<50kgm>扭矩。部分车身板件的材质换为碳纤维和铝合金，相较标准版本的Turbo，车重得到大大削减。后轮轮拱上的进气道和特制的后扰流板成为了鉴别这款Turbo S的指定标识。该车型仅只生产了86辆，因而成为了911系列中最稀有的车型之一。

brandCentral.en:
Everyone knows about the importance of safety cars, the
vehicles deployed during rolling starts, or after accidents.

Ordinary road cars are generally used, but it goes without
saying that ordinary-level performance isn't enough.

Gran Turismo has therefore produced this special safety car
version of the 992‑generation Porsche 911 Turbo S.

The 992-gen 911 made its debut in 2018, drawing attention
for its adoption of the all-new MMB platform.

This Turbo S appeared two years later, with its 3.8-litre
twin turbo and 4WD setup providing rock-solid performance.

Doing 0-<100km/h> in 2.7 seconds and with a top speed
of <330km/h>, it fulfils its role as safety car with aplomb.

The roof-mounted light is the unsung hero that maintains
orerand safety out on the track.
brandCentral.zh:
大家都知道安全车的重要性。
它们会在滚动发车或发生事故时出动，引领车阵。

通常安全车由普通公路车充任，但普通车的性能
显然有些力不从心。

因此，《跑车浪漫旅》精心打造了这款特别车型，
基于992世代保时捷911 Turbo S的安全车规格版本。

992世代911于2018年首次亮相，
因采用全新的MMB平台而备受瞩目。

这款Turbo S在两年后问世，其3.8升双涡轮增压引擎
与四轮驱动系统提供了极其稳定的性能。

它从0加速到<100km/h>仅需2.7秒，最高速度可达<330km/h>，
能从容胜任安全车的角色。

安装在车顶的指示灯是维持赛道秩序与安全的无冕英雄。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 911 Turbo S reimagined as a safety car.}

This 992-generation 911 Turbo S was a virtual model created by Gran Turismo, reimagined as a safety car leading the pack in the event of an incident.

The original 992-generation 911 Turbo S was the top-performance model of the eighth-generation Porsche 911. Built on Porsche’s latest 911 architecture, the wide body used a high percentage of aluminum parts, blending tradition and innovation. The rear-mounted twin-turbo <3745cc> flat-6 engine produced <650ps> and 800 Nm (<81.6kgm>) of torque, sending power through an 8-speed PDK transmission and sophisticated four-wheel-drive system before reaching the track surface. It was able to accelerate from 0-<100km/h> in just 2.7 seconds and reach a top speed of <330km/h>, but that served as only a glimpse of its true potential.

Qualities such as excellent traction and stability made the 911 Turbo S ideal for leading the field as a safety car. Meanwhile, its ability to keep a pack of race cars in line without faltering came from its outstanding performance and high-level chassis control.

long.zh:
这款992世代911 Turbo S是《跑车浪漫旅》创作的一款虚拟车型，在原车型基础上重新设计为安全车，用于在赛道发生事故时引导车阵。

实际量产的992世代911 Turbo S是第八代保时捷911系列中的顶级性能车型。基于全新开发的MMB平台，该宽体车身大量采用铝制部件，实现了传统与创新的融合。后置的<3745cc>水平对置六缸双涡轮增压引擎可输出<650ps>功率和800Nm（<81.6kgm>）扭矩，动力经由8速保时捷双离合器变速箱和精密的四轮驱动系统传递至路面。该车从0加速至<100km/h>仅需2.7秒，最高时速可达<330km/h>，但这仅仅是其真正实力的冰山一角。

出色的牵引力与稳定性，让911 Turbo S成为担任安全车、引领车阵的不二之选。同时，它之所以能毫不费力、稳定地带领一队赛车保持队形，无疑要归功于其卓越的性能和顶级的底盘控制。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Porsche 917 earned a celebrated place in motorsport history by securing seven victories out of ten races during the 1970 World Sportscar Championship season. The Porsche 917 LIVING LEGEND was a hypercar concept inspired by the 917. Its classic exterior design masked cutting-edge technology beneath the surface. Its blend of top speed and aerodynamic downforce resulted in remarkable stability, even at speeds exceeding 186.4 mph.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 917为Porsche创造了诸多辉煌战绩，包括在1970年世界跑车锦标赛中10场比赛斩获7场胜利。Porsche 917 LIVING LEGEND是一款以经典917为灵感打造的终极跑车。经典的外观设计下蕴藏着前沿的技术内核。极速与下压力的完美结合，即使在超过300 公里/小时的速度下也能保持如磐石般的稳定性。
officialDetails.heroEn: This extreme hyper car is an updated version of the legendary 917, one of the most celebrated race cars in Porsche history.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款极限超跑是对经典917的现代重塑，后者是Porsche历史上最辉煌的机器之一。

brandCentral.en:
How much do you know about Porsche's legendary 917
racing car?

It's the car that brought the company their first ever
overall victory at Le Mans, back in 1970.

This '917 LIVING LEGEND' is designed with that illustrious
predecessor in mind.

Incredibly, it was developed by just a handful of staff in
Porsche's research department!

One of the key design features retained from the 917 is the
iconic fan, located above the midship V8 engine.
brandCentral.zh:
不知您对Porsche的传奇赛车917了解多少？

它为这家公司在1970年赢得了首个勒芒比赛的总冠军。

这辆“917 LIVING LEGEND”在设计伊始就从它那战绩彪炳的前辈身
上吸取了不少灵感。

更令人难以置信的是，这辆车仅由人数不多的Porsche研究部
门研发完成！

其最关键的设计特性当属沿袭自917的标志性风扇，置于
中置V8引擎的正上方。*

vehicleCollection.en:
This extreme hyper car is an updated version of the legendary 917, one of the most celebrated race cars in Porsche history."

The Porsche 917 Living Legend is a hyper car inspired by the legendary Porsche 917 racer, which brought the manufacturer the first overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans back in 1970.

Developed in 2013 by a small team of engineers and designers in Weissach, the 917 Living Legend was simultaneously a tribute and spiritual successor to the legendary Porsche racer. Inspired by the signature proportions of the original, the 917 Living Legend was all about celebrating the car that brought the Le Mans title to Stuttgart.

Under the sheet metal, the 917 Living Legend featured the latest technology of its day, including lightweight materials such as carbon fiber, which was used for the chassis. Powering the car was a turbocharged 8-cylinder engine that pumped out about <1014ps>, while the suspension system, based on the 918 Spyder, provided remarkable handling at all speeds.

With updated aerodynamics, the car could reach <300km/h> on long straights, making the 917 Living Legend a true reincarnation of the legendary Porsche race car.

long.zh:
保时捷917 Living Legend是受传奇赛车917启发而研发的终极跑车。在1970年，后者为保时捷带来了车队史上首个勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军。

917 Living Legend是2013年由魏萨赫的一支小型研发团队设计，它不仅是一款致敬车款，也是917的精神继承者。它的造型源自经典的原版917，全身上下都流淌着勒芒的血液。

另一方面，它的概念设计已远远超越了造型的相似之处。碳纤维底盘汇聚了各项顶尖技术。强而有力的心脏是一颗最高可输出1000马力（<1014ps>）的8缸涡轮增压引擎。前后悬挂基于918 Spyder的原厂件，但使用了赛车专用的连接件和连杆。这使得917 Living Legend在<300km/h>的高速下依然可以保持稳定。此外，这款车使用了自适应空力组件，有着无与伦比的最高时速和下压力。

917 Living Legend是保时捷核心价值的化身，它将创新和传承完美结合，将赛车运动的历史与现代赛道上的最高志向合二为一。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The 917K was a prototype race car developed by Porsche specifically for sports car competition. Despite weighing under 1764 lbs, the 1970 version was capable of producing up to 591.7 HP in its most powerful configuration. In its second year of competition, 1970, the 917K proved nearly unbeatable, winning seven out of ten rounds in the International Championship for Makes. It also delivered Porsche its long-awaited first overall victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 917K是Porsche为跑车赛事专门设计的原型赛车。车重仅800 公斤，1970款917的引擎在最强配置下可输出高达600 PS的动力。1970年是其参赛的第二年，几乎鲜有对手可以匹敌。在国际车厂锦标赛10轮比赛中豪取7场胜利，并为Porsche赢得了期盼已久的勒芒24小时耐力赛首冠。
officialDetails.heroEn: This prototype race car that gave Porsche its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款原型赛车帮助Porsche在勒芒24小时耐力赛中首次获胜。

collection.en:
The 917K is one of the most important race cars
in Porsche's history.

It was developed from the long-tailed 917LH which made its debut
in 1969.

Under its hood was a few different engines depending on the car,
from a 4.5-liter, 4.9-liter and a 5.0-liter air-cooled flat-12.

Fast and ferocious on the track, the 917K delivered
Porsche its first overall victory at Le Mans.

Although Porsche didn't have a works team, the 917K still won
7 of 10 races in the International Championship for Makes.

Even better, it would also go on to win the 24 Hours
of Le Mans that year, and again in 1971.

Porsche's golden era began with the 917K, making it one of
the most significant models in motorsports history.
collection.zh:
917K是Porsche历史上最重要的赛车之一。

该车基于1969年生产的长尾款917LH研发而来……

可配备多款不同引擎，包括4.5升、4.9升，
或是5升风冷水平对置12缸引擎。

速度极快，在赛道上悍勇无双的917K，赢来了
Porsche在勒芒赛场上首个总冠军。

在1970年，917K赢下国际制造商锦标赛
十场赛事中的七场……

并摘得了勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军，紧接着
又在1971年卫冕成功。

可以说，Porsche的黄金年代
正是由917K揭幕的。

vehicleCollection.en:
This prototype race car that gave Porsche its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The Porsche 917K, a prototype race car developed by Porsche to compete in Group 4 sports-car racing, was essentially the 917 with a shortened body. After the debut of the 917 in 1969, Porsche introduced the shorter model, calling it the 917K (the "K" stood for "Kurz," which means "short" in German). The standard, longer car was then called the 917LH.

The car's space-frame chassis was composed of aluminum alloy pipes that weighed just under <50kg>. A carbon-fiber body covered a mid-mounted <4494cc> flat-12 engine that produced <600ps>. And with a curb weight of about <800kg> and enhanced aerodynamics — downforce was increased by sloping up the rear edge of the short tail body, while the front tip was squared off — the 917K was a monster on the straights.

In 1970, it dominated the international manufacturer’s championship winning 7 of 10 races, and also brought Porsche its first victory in the Le Mans 24 Hour race.

其使用的基础车架是一套铝合金管式空间车架，总重不到<50kg>。车身由轻量纤维强化塑胶材料制造，动力单元则使用了一款中置<4494cc>水平对置12缸引擎。尽管车重仅有<800kg>，但1970年时的917在高动力设定下就可以输出<600ps>。在同一年，保时捷又为917K带来了空气动力学方面的改进，通过提高车身后部的坡度来提升下压力，并削平了前缘以减少下压力的变化。

vehicleCollection.en:
This super sports car represents the first plug-in hybrid flagship from the famed German car maker. ~

Introduced by Porsche in 2011, the 918 Spyder succeeded the Carrera GT as the company's flagship model and was its first road-going supercar to feature a hybrid powerplant.

Based on the powertrain of the RS Spyder prototype race car, the 918 Spyder's drive system takes a <608ps> 4.6-liter V-8, mounted amidships, and mates it with a single electric motor at the rear. The combined output totals a whopping <886p>, enabling the 918 to reach <100km/h> in just 2.6 seconds, <200km/h> in 7.2 and <300km/h> in just 19.9, when equipped with the Weissach Package that reduces the car’s curb weight from <1674kg> to <1634kg>.

The 918 Spyder, of which only 918 examples were made, claimed a top speed of <345km/h> and lapped the famed Nürburgring Nordschleife in 6 minutes and 57 seconds.

最值得一提的是，该车其实是一款插电式混合动力跑车。拥有<608ps>的4.6升V8引擎基于RS Spyder原型赛车的引擎开发，采取中置布局，前后部都设有一台电机，因此总输出功率可达到<886ps>。

绝无仅有的强大性能在与选装的Weissach套件相结合后，可以在2.6秒内达到<100km/h>的时速，7.2秒内达到<200km/h>，而<300km/h>也仅需19.9秒。保时捷对外公布的最高时速高达<345km/h>。此外，918 Spyder还在纽博格林北侧赛道上创造了6分57秒的惊人圈速记录。

918 Spyder标准车型的车重只有<1674kg>。鉴于该车是一款混合动力车，这已经是非常轻巧了。而在采用Weissach套件后，总重量还能再降<40kg>。"

dialogues.en:
The Porsche 919 Hybrid first competed at the WEC in 2014,
if I’m not mistaken.

This is the 2016 model. The 2014 car had a white
paint job and stylish gray stripes across its body.

Viewed from above, the stripes spelled out the phrase
"PORSCHE INTELLIGENT PERFORMANCE."

Among its many design features was its multi-LED headlight
system, meant to improve night driving.

To implement it, the front wheel arches were
raised, along with the driver’s seat.

The 919’s historic 2016 battle against Toyota’s TS050 was one
that will not soon be forgotten at Le Mans.

Indeed, it arked the beginning of the car’s three-year
winning streak at the famous˖acing event.

vehicleCollection.en:
The consecutive Le Mans champion & hybrid prototype sports car.

The 919 Hybrid is a prototype sports car developed by Porsche for the World Endurance Championships and the Le Mans 24 hour race. This is a hybrid prototype machine developed for the new regulations of the LMP1-H that had been planned for introduction in 2014, and was revealed at the Geneva Motor Show of the same year.

Its base configuration is a carbon composite monocoque with a turbocharged 2-liter V4 engine mounted mid-ship. It is an all-wheel drive, equipped with an ERS (an advanced version of KERS) for the front axles, with lithium ion batteries.

The total system power of <900ps> consists of <500ps> delivered from the engine to the rear axle, with <400ps> delivered to the front axles through the hybrid system. This propels the <875kg> car from a standstill to <100km/h> in 2.2 seconds, reaching <200km/h> in 4.8 seconds.

For visibility and operability, the seat position is slightly high. Driver safety is also maximized by providing ample interior space and reinforcing the side panels with materials used for bulletproof vests.

The competition debut of the car was in 2014 as planned, but it ended with only 1 victory in the final round of the World Endurance Championships. However, for the 2015 season, alterations were made to the chassis design to optimize weight distribution while still keeping the concept of the car intact, and they went on to dominate the WEC series by winning 6 out of 8 races, including Porsche’s 17th overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans. In 2016, the car was further refined, and not only did it win the 24 Hours of Le Mans, but by the 6th race they had already scored 5 wins and 1 race in 2nd place.

long.zh:
919 Hybrid是一款由保时捷开发的原型跑车，用于参加世界耐力锦标赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛。这是一台混合动力原型车，依据2014年起实施的勒芒原型车1级-H新规定开发，并计划于同年的日内瓦国际车展上亮相。

车辆的基础配置包括碳纤维复合材料单体车壳和中置安装的2升V4涡轮增压引擎。该车采用了全轮驱动系统，前轴配备有能量回收系统（动能回收系统的高级版本），并使用锂电池。

这套动力系统的总马力为<900ps>，其中<500ps>由引擎传至后轴，<400ps>通过混合动力系统传至前轴。推动<875kg>的车身由静止加速到<100km/h>的时间为2.2秒，到<200km/h>的时间为4.8秒。

出于视野和操作性的考虑，座椅的位置稍高。通过提供充足的内部空间以及采用防弹背心材料加固侧板，尽可能提高驾驶员的安全性。

这款车如约于2014年首次在赛场上亮相，但当年只在世界耐力锦标赛的最后一轮获得了一次冠军。在2015赛季，保时捷对底盘设计进行了调整以优化配重，同时保持车辆的设计理念不变，此后，他们压倒性地在世界耐力锦标系列赛的8场比赛中获胜6场，包括在勒芒24小时耐力赛中获得了保时捷的第17次总冠军。在2016年，进一步优化的车型不仅赢得了勒芒24小时耐力赛的奖杯，而且是在6场比赛中获得5次冠军和1次亚军。

performance at the Paris-Dakar Rallies of the 1980s.

The Paris-Dakar Rally...

...was a race that stretched for more than 10,000km,
from Paris, France, to Dakar, Senegal.

A course spanning vast deserts and mountainous terrain,
it was considered the toughest rally in the world.

Porsche’s first success at the event was in 1984,
a year efore the 959’s official debut.

Driver René Metge pulled off a marvelous overall victory
in a 911 fitted with a developmental 4WD system.

A year later, in 1985, Porsche entered the race with a 959, which
combined 4W and a twin-turbo engine.

However, it wasn’t until ’86 that the 95had an overallvictoy at the rally, once again thanks to René Metge!

vehicleCollection.en:
A four-wheel-drive road car that shines bright in automotive history.

At the 1983 Frankfurt Auto Show, Porsche introduced the "Gruppe B" concept model. This was a design study of an all-wheel-drive race car that was being developed for competition in the top "Group B" category of the WRC that started in 1982.

Two years later, in 1985, the road going version of this model was unveiled. Called the Porsche 959, it adopted the basic structure of the Porsche 911 and was packed with revolutionary technology. The engine was a <2850cc> twin-turbocharged horizontally-opposed 6 cylinder, with a maximum output of 450 horsepower. It came mated to a 6-speed manual transmission.

The most noteworthy feature of this car was its electronically controlled all-wheel-drive system that actively managed the drive ratio between the front and rear wheels according to the conditions of the road surface. Also, it was possible to select a drive mode that matched the current driving condition. The 959's all-wheel-drive system was truly revolutionary in that it provided not only excellent stability at high speeds, but also convenience for the user.

Only 292 examples of the Porsche 959 were produced for Group B homologation, but because of the termination of the Group B category, the race version never made it to the WRC. But it did go on to set great records in competition, even winning the overall title at the Paris-Dakar Rally, which is considered one of the most grueling races in the world.

Many of the technical innovations of the 959, including the all-wheel-drive system, saw their way into the company's other production cars, such as the 911. The Porsche 959 still enjoys a high level of respect and popularity today and remains a very important part of automotive history.

long.zh:
在1983年的法兰克福车展上，保时捷隆重推出了“格鲁贝B”概念赛车。
这辆四轮驱动公路车是一项设计研究项目的产物，专为参加1982年开始的世界拉力锦标赛顶级组别“组别B”所开发。

在亮相两年后的1985年，这款原型车的公路版本——保时捷959——也隆重亮相。虽然采用了与保时捷911相同的基础结构，但也加入了大量的革新性技术。它安装了一台<2850cc>水平对置双涡轮增压6缸引擎，最大输出动力可达450马力，并搭配一部6档手动变速箱。

不过这辆车上最先进的功能是它的电子控制四轮驱动系统，可以将这台高功率引擎产生的动力几近无损地输送到路面上。这套系统会根据路面条件主动控制前后轮的传动比，并根据当前的驾驶条件选择匹配的驱动模式。这套全新一代的四轮驱动系统不仅可以在超高速行驶的情况下提供极佳的操控稳定性，而且还简单易用。

为了匹配组别B的赛事认证，保时捷生产了共计292辆保时捷959，不过由于组别B组别的突然取消，这辆车未能如愿参加世界拉力锦标赛。但它却参加了多项其他赛事，并且连续创下辉煌的纪录，甚至还拿到了被誉为全世界最艰苦的拉力赛——巴黎-达喀尔拉力赛的总冠军。

959的许多技术成就，例如全新开发的四轮驱动系统，之后也被沿用到了911等众多保时捷量产车款中，甚至为跑车类型定义了全新标杆。也因此，保时捷959是汽车历史上非常重要的一款车。

years, as a manufacturer and seller to privateers.

Even in the world's fastest racing category, which is
the sports prototype class...

It entered races as a factory team while also
selling its race cars to privateers.

Indeed, Porsche's widespread support of race
culture is an integral part of its legacy.

This is evidenced by the history o the 956 and 962,
two Group C models from the early 1980s.

Although the 962’s factory team withdrew from competition
in 1988...

It's aid that Porsche manufactured 150 examples
of the 956 and 962 for competitn.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Porsche 962 C was a prototype race car that made its debut in the World Endurance Championship (WEC) in 1985. Over the course of its career, the car delivered Porsche numerous race victories and championship titles. In its debut WEC season, it won seven out of ten races. The following year, in 1986, it claimed four wins from nine rounds in the newly renamed World Sports Prototype Championship (WSPC). At the 1987 WSPC, it secured a win at Le Mans and followed it up with a 2nd-place finish the year after.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Porsche 962 C是于1985年在世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）中首次登场的原型赛车。在整个参赛生涯中，其为Porsche夺得了众多分站胜利和锦标赛冠军。此车在其WEC首秀之年便赢得了10场比赛中的7场胜利，1986年在WEC更名后的世界运动原型车锦标赛（WSPC）中又夺得9轮比赛中的4场胜利。1987年WSPC赛季，它在勒芒收获冠军，次年又获得亚军。
officialDetails.heroEn: These Group C cars scored numerous endurance racing championships for Porsche.
officialDetails.heroZh: 在无数场耐力赛中为保时捷带来胜利的C组别赛车。

collection.en:
The world of motorsports is known for its
extremely competitive development,

which makes Porsche's achievements during the 1980s
truly miraculous.

Porsche won at Le Mans in 1982 and 1983 with their 956,

and the updated Porsche 956 went on to win 2 more
Le Mans races.

The Porsche 962 series is a race car that is directly linked to
the legendary 956 series,

and the Porsche 962C won at Le Mans in 1986 and 1987,

contributing to the last 2 of the 7 consecutive Le Mans
victories by Porsche that started in 1981.

The 962C remains a potent piece of machinery to this day.
Are you ready to harness the power of this legendary Porsche?
collection.zh:
赛车运动的世界以竞争极其激烈的开发而著称，

这也使得Porsche在上世纪80年代的成就显得犹如神迹一般。

Porsche在1982年和1983年连续使用956赛车赢下勒芒冠军，

紧接着，改进后的956又再夺两冠。

保时捷962系列是传奇的956的正统继承者，

系列中的962C于1986和1987年再次赢得勒芒冠军，

也是自1981年以来Porsche勒芒七连冠的最后两座奖杯的功臣。

962C的车况保存良好至今。
您准备好驾驭这辆传奇Porsche的强劲动力了吗？

catch.en: These Group C cars scored numerous endurance racing championships for Porsche.
catch.zh: 在无数场耐力赛中为保时捷带来胜利的C组别赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
These Group C cars scored numerous endurance racing championships for Porsche.

Porsche built the 962 C in 1985 as a prototype race car to compete in the WEC (World Endurance Championships). The car was in fact based on the 956, which in 1982, waged battle in the WEC in the FIA Group C category.

The 956 was a spectacular success right from the start, winning races in the WEC as well as dominating the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Thereafter, the 956 was improved for the IMSA-GTP of North America which had similar regulations as the WEC, and it made its debut in 1984 as the 962. The following year, when Group C safety regulations were changed to be in line with those of IMSA-GTP, Porsche modified the 962 and thus was born the 962 C.

The car, powered by the twin-turbo flat-6, scored many championship titles, winning seven out of its first 10 races. In 1986, the Porsche 962 C won four out of nine races in the WSPC (World Sports Prototype Championship), which took the place of the WEC. In 1987, it dominated Le Mans, and took 2nd the following year.

保时捷962 C在其首次出战的那年，总共参加了10场世界耐力锦标赛比赛，赢得其中7场，之后更是为保时捷捧回了大量奖杯和冠军头衔。1986年，它在取代世界耐力锦标赛举办的世界原型跑车锦标赛上参加了9场比赛，勇夺4次冠军。1987年，它在勒芒独占鳌头，并在1988年再次取得第2名的好成绩。

The Porsche 963 is a formidable contender in
the premier categories of the IMSA and WEC.

It’s had especially strong showings at the IMSA.

Competing in the 2024 IMSA GTP category, the 963 won
the first round of the series—the 24 Hours of Daytona.

From there, it racked up further victories at Laguna Seca,
Watkins Glen, and Road America...

Before clinching both the Manufacturers' and Drivers'
Championship titles.

Meanwhile, in the WEC series, it has established itself
as a podium fixture...

Further cementing its status as a modern masterpiece
of endurance racing!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
Porsche 963是IMSA与WEC最高组别中的实力劲旅，

在IMSA赛场上的战绩尤其斐然。

征战2024年IMSA GTP赛事期间，
963一举拿下戴通纳24小时耐力赛揭幕战冠军。

随后又接连斩获拉古纳-塞卡赛道、
沃特金斯峡谷国际赛道与美国之路赛道的分站冠军……

最终包揽车厂与车手年度总冠军。

而在WEC赛场上，它也是领奖台的常客……

由此逐步奠定了它在耐力赛中当代经典神车的地位。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new category LMDh hypercar created by Porsche, the masters of endurance.

The 963 is Porsche’s latest-generation LMDh prototype, carrying on the concepts embodied by the legendary 962 and 919 Hybrid. Its Multimatic carbon-fiber monocoque is equipped with a twin-turbo 4.6-liter V-8 rooted in the RS Spyder and 918 Spyder, combined with a standardized hybrid system. It was a package that combined the efficiency, reliability and overwhelming performance demanded in top-level endurance racing.

The 963 made its race debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona and went on to compete in both the World Endurance Championship and the IMSA Championship. Together with the esteemed Team Penske, it challenged for the very pinnacle of endurance racing.

The 963 truly came into its own in 2024. It won the IMSA season opener at Daytona, then followed with victories at Laguna Seca, Watkins Glen and Road America, results that helped it secure both the drivers’ and manufacturers’ championships.

Its WEC results also were highly impressive. The 963 showed consistent pace throughout the season, winning in Qatar, at Spa-Francorchamps and at Fuji, while Porsche Penske Motorsport clinched the 2024 drivers’ title.

Porsche withdrew the 963 from the WEC’s Hypercar class at the end of 2025, but the car continued to compete in the 2026 IMSA Championship. The 963 is something of a masterpiece, further burnishing Porsche’s reputation as the king of endurance racing.

long.zh:
963是保时捷旗下最新一代的勒芒-戴通纳混合动力规格原型车，它延续了传奇车型962和919 Hybrid的设计理念。摩缇马帝碳纤维单体车壳搭载4.6升V8双涡轮增压引擎，该引擎源自传奇车型918 Spyder，并配备标准化混合动力系统。这套动力系统将高水平耐力赛对效率、可靠性与强大竞技实力的极致要求融为一体，并实现了三者的完美平衡。

963在2023年戴通纳24小时耐力赛中迎来了辉煌的首秀，此后更挺进世界耐力锦标赛和国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛两大顶级舞台。与声誉卓著的潘世奇车队并肩携手，963向着世界耐力赛最高荣誉发起冲击。

963在2024年真正迎来了高光时刻。它夺得了戴通纳国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛开幕战的冠军，随后又相继在拉古纳-塞卡、沃特金斯峡谷和美国之路站凯歌高奏——这一连串傲人战绩最终助其锁定车手和制造商双料总冠军。

此车在世界耐力锦标赛的表现也十分亮眼。它在所有分站赛事中均保持着高度稳定的节奏，先后拿下卡塔尔、斯帕弗朗科尔尚和富士赛车场三站冠军，并最终锁定了2024车手年度总冠军。

保时捷于2025年底宣布963退出世界耐力锦标赛赛场，但改款升级后的车型仍在2026年继续征战国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛。963堪称赛车中的杰作，更为保时捷耐力赛之王的崇高声誉再度添上了浓墨重彩的一笔。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Porsche Carrera GT was a mid-engine super sports car produced from 2003 to 2006, with a total of 1,270 units built. Its chassis centered on a lightweight yet rigid carbon-fiber monocoque, complemented by carbon fiber subframes supporting the engine and rear suspension. vehicleCollection.en:
Only 1270 examples of this mid-engine supercar were produced from 2003 to 2006.

When the Carrera GT was introduced in 2003, it became an instant collector's car, not only because it was one of the most exotic cars Porsche had ever produced, but only a total of 1270 units were manufactured.

Unlike the 911, Porsche's signature model, the Carrera GT had a mid-engine layout. Tucked behind the cabin was a 5.7-liter V-10 that was originally designed for LMP endurance racing. The naturally aspirated engine produced <612ps> and <60.2kgm> of torque that came mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. With a curb weight of only <1380kg> — carbon fiber was not used sparingly in the Carrera GT — the car was a virtual road rocket, going from zero to <100km/h> in a scant 3.9 seconds and reaching a top speed of more than <330km/h>.

In 2006, the Carrera GT was discontinued, but it remains one of the most alluring Porsches of not only its generation, but of all time.

保时捷Carrera GT是一款2003年至2006年间生产的中置引擎超级跑车，仅生产了1270辆。

这款车和911这样的量产车有着本质上的不同，它的所有部件都是专门量身定做的。

在结构方面，它配备了碳纤维座舱，组合了覆盖引擎和悬挂的底部框架，车身板件全部为碳纤维。因为整车的所有外力都可以被底盘吸收，它也可以改装为半敞篷。在大量应用碳纤维等轻量化材料后，整车车重仅有<1380kg>。

引擎为一台传闻为勒芒原型车耐力赛设计的5.5升V10引擎，改装为5.7升来提供更适合普通公路行驶的扭矩特性。这台引擎可输出<612ps>，最大扭矩为<60.2kgm>。变速箱为6档手动，0-<100km/h>加速仅需3.9秒，标称极速为<330km/h>。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 1963, Porsche developed the Carrera GTS in response to the World Sportscar Championship regulations of the era. To meet the 100-unit production homologation requirement, the car employed a ladder-frame chassis paired with a lightweight fiberglass body. It delivered strong performance and achieved numerous victories, beginning with the Targa Florio, ultimately becoming the foundation of Porsche’s GT racing efforts throughout the 1960s.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1963年，Porsche为迎合当时世界跑车锦标赛的规则开发了Porsche Carrera GTS。为了满足100台量产车的赛事认证条件，该车采用了梯形框架底盘与轻量化玻璃纤维车身。这款车型性能卓越，从塔格·佛罗热大奖赛开始便在众多顶级赛事中夺冠，成为1960年代Porsche GT车队的中流砥柱。

collection.en:
The Carrera GTS 904 is a shining star in Porsche's
storied motorsports history.

Since the early 1950s, Porsche competed in
international races with the 356.

All the while, the folks there were planning to build
a dedicated GT race car.

Essentially, they needed to build 100 cars in
12 months to qualify for competition.

The result was the Carrera GTS in 1963.

While a plan to use the flat-6 engine developed for
the 911 never bore fruit...

...the car featured a low and ligtweight mid-engine
body and specially-designed suspension.

As soon as the car was ready, it was racing all over
the world.

This particular Carrera GTS competed in the second
Japanese Grand Prix, held in 1964.

Its heated yet successful battl against Japan's Skyline is
still talked about by Japanese race fans to ts day.
collection.zh:
Carrera GTS 904是保时捷赛车
运动历史上一颗闪耀的明星。

从20世纪50年代开始，保时捷就将
保时捷356投入到各项国际赛事中。

一直以来，他们都计划
打造一辆专门的超级跑车。

但他们要能满足12个月内生产100辆
以获得对应的参赛资格。

于是Carrera GTS在1963年应运而生。

虽然原计划采用为911开发的
水平对置6缸引擎从未取得任何成果……

其轻盈贴地的玻璃纤维8身、中置引擎
和悬挂等专门设计的部件。

让它刚一发布就惊爆全球。

这辆特别的Carrera GTS参加了
1964年举行的第二届日本大奖赛。

它与日本本土的Skyline展开了激烈厮杀并最终
一举夺的场面，至今仍被日本赛车迷津津乐道。*

catch.en: A masterpiece that brought great success to Porsche's GT race efforts in the 1960sf
catch.zh: Porsche在1960年代赖以统治GT赛事的杰作。

vehicleCollection.en:
A masterpiece that brought great success to Porsche's GT race efforts in the 1960sf

Shortly after its establishment in the 1950s, Porsche quickly rose to prominence in global motorsports with the 356 and its purpose-built mid-engine derivatives like the 550 Spyder.

One of the key milestones that carried this legacy forward was the 1963 Porsche Carrera GTS. Also known by its development code, the 904 GTS, it was developed in response to the evolving World Sportscar Championship regulations.

In the 1950s, the championship featured low-volume, pure racing machines. However, the regulation changes of 1961 shifted the focus to mass-produced sports cars. To compete in the GT Class, manufacturers had to meet a homologation requirement of producing at least 100 units.

Porsche responded with the Carrera GTS, engineered around a ladder-frame chassis better suited for small-series production. It was then wrapped in a lightweight fiberglass-reinforced plastic (FRP) body. This combination was a first for the company. Styling was led by Ferdinand Alexander Porsche, grandson of company founder Dr. Ferdinand Porsche. His design gave the car its low, clean lines that remain iconic to this day. Mounted in a mid-engine layout was an air-cooled flat-4 engine, though the chassis was versatile enough to accept 6- and even 8-cylinder units for competition use.

From its debut, the Carrera GTS proved its capability with victories in storied events like the Targa Florio, as well as class wins at endurance races including the Nürburgring and Le Mans. In 1964, it went on to dominate the GT Class Championship.

long.zh:
在1950年成立之后不久，保时捷推出356系列型号，以及基于356衍生出的包括550 Spyder在内的多款纯正中置引擎赛车，并凭借这些车型的优异表现在赛车运动领域名声大振。

在取得了初步成功之后，品牌的另一个重要里程碑——保时捷Carrera GTS在1963年推出。这个型号也经常根据其开发代号被称为904 GTS。这是一款为了迎合当时世界跑车锦标赛规则变动而开发的跑车。

时间拨回到二十世纪五十年代，世界跑车锦标赛主要由单独定制的纯种赛车参与角逐。但在1961年的规则修改后，主赛事更改为以由量产跑车参赛的GT级组别为主。为了能够参加GT级比赛，参赛车型必须要满足最低100辆车的产量要求。

保时捷Carrera GTS在开发和生产中采用了更适合量产的梯形框架，然后再覆盖以轻量化纤维强化塑料车身。这也是保时捷首次应用这一设计。此外，它那压低且优美的外观设计也有口皆碑，出自公司创始人费迪南德·保时捷博士的孙子——费迪南德·亚历山大·保时捷之手。它搭载了一部中置的风冷式水平对置4缸引擎，在参加竞速比赛时还可以换成6缸或8缸引擎。

自从亮相之后，保时捷Carrera GTS拿出了极佳的竞技表现——包括赢得了塔格·佛罗热等重磅大赛、在纽博格林以及勒芒等耐力赛中赢得了组别冠军，甚至还成功地统治了1964年的世界跑车锦标赛GT级组别。

It was powered by a 3.8-liter flat-6 derived from the 911 Carrera S, paired with a 6-speed manual transmission. Optional equipment included a roll cage and 6-point harnesses.

vehicleCollection.en:
A Cayman designed for motorsports and possessing all the competitive flair of the 911.

Porsche has competed in many sports-car races with the 911, which was one of the most popular models in its production-car lineup. The company eyed going racing with another of its production cars in 2015, when it introduced the Cayman GT4. The Cayman was a mid-engine model that possessed performance levels comparable to the 911, and the GT4 was created specifically for motorsports.

The Cayman GT4 had the same combination of 3.8-liter flat-6 and 6-speed manual gearbox used in the 911 Carrera S. In fact, it actually outdoes the 911 with <385ps> of power.

Some parts from the 991 GT3 were used for the brakes and suspension of the Cayman GT4, thus reducing ride height by <30mm>. The 2-seater also came with a distinctive lip spoiler and a fixed rear wing.

The choice of optional extras included a roll cage, fire extinguisher, and a 6-point seatbelt, making it clear from the start that this was a car designed for the track.

The Cayman GT4 had the same combination of 3.8-liter flat-6 and 6-speed manual gearbox used in the 911 Carrera S. In fact, it actually outdoes the 911 with <385ps> of power.

Some parts from the 991 GT3 were used for the brakes and suspension of the Cayman GT4, thus reducing ride height by <30mm>. The 2-seater also came with a distinctive lip spoiler and a fixed rear wing.

The choice of optional extras included a roll cage, fire extinguisher, and a 6-point seatbelt, making it clear from the start that this was a car designed for the track.
long.zh:
911一直以来都在保时捷的赛车运动阵容中担当主力，偏向于赛车运动的911车型同时也是产品线的重要组成部分，而且对公众出售。然而在2015年，一个新成员加入了此阵容。动力稍稍逊色的中置引擎Cayman双门轿车引入了赛车版本，并被命名为Cayman GT4。

其最引人注目的特征是其动力单元和传动系统。此车基于911 Carrera S打造，采用了3.8升水平对置V6引擎和6速手动变速箱。而且能够输出<385ps>的动力，与基础车型的911 Carrera相比尤胜一筹。

刹车和悬挂系统也采用了991 GT3的一些部件，使得车身离地间隙在标准版本基础上又降低了<30mm>。外观方面采用了车型专属的前唇和固定式尾翼，以更加契合新的造型。

可选组件列表还包括防滚架、灭火器、驾驶员座椅的六点式安全带等，充分表明这其实是一个专注于赛道的车型。

dialogues.en:
The Cayman has gone through a few cycles now.

The mid-engine layout here has made it sleeker
in both its roof line and overall proportions.

Indeed, the Cayman has taken on a more serious look
with each evolution.

With the GT4 trim, it is no longer positioned beneath
the 911.

Holding its own with great presence, tough looks and
beefy footwork...

...it has graduated from a casual racer to one that can
take on much bigger competition.
\
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.zh:
迄今为止，Cayman已经历了数次更新换代。

中置引擎的布局强化了车顶线条和整体比例的流线感。

事实上，Cayman的每次进化都让其更加凌厉。

升级到GT4版本后，它不再被定位在911之下。

凭借其强大的气场、富有侵略性的外观
和稳健的操控性能……

它已经从一款休闲性能车升级为能够与更高级别对手
竞争的真正赛道利器。

officialDetails.descriptionZh: 专为GT4级别Cayman赛车推出的纯赛车版本。它使用与GT4型号相同的385 PS输出3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，除此之外，还经过了完美的赛车调校，移除了所有与舒适度有关的部件的同时，采用了911 GT3 Cup上的部件。

brandCentral.en:
The Clubsport is a Porsche Cayman GT4 designed for
racing on the track.

In terms of power, it's no different from the base model.

However, changes to the shape, underbody and power train
mean it's much more competition-focused.

The change from a 6-speed manual to a two-pedal DCT
transmission also help maximize performance.
brandCentral.zh:
本质上来说，Clubsport就是一台中置引擎版本的Cayman GT4，
专为赛道竞速设计。

它的动力与原版车型并无差异，

而外观、车身底板和传动系统方面的改动则表明它更强调竞赛。

此外，它的六速手动变速箱被换成了双踏板双离合变速
箱，以便最大发挥速度的优势。

vehicleCollection.en:
The highest performance model of the Cayman series in its naturally aspirated flat 6 generation.

Throughout the modern racing era, Porsche has traditionally used the 911 to participate in major sports-car races, but in 2015, they surprised many by turning to the Cayman as its entry in GT4 races

The Cayman GT4 was the fastest Cayman ever, with many components carried over from the 911. It came with a 3.8-liter flat-6 from the 911 Carrera S that produced more power than the 911 Carrera at <385ps>. The front suspension and brakes were lifted from the 911 GT3, which meant it handled amazingly well and had plenty of stopping power.

The following year, the GT4 was even further refined, creating the Cayman GT4 Clubsport. This special Cayman was a pure race version designed exclusively for the race track. Any and all creature comforts on the road-going model were deleted to make it as lightweight as possible.

A roll cage protected the driver, and the seats were replaced with full bucket types. It also came with a DCT gearbox and the suspension and brakes used components equal to that of the 911 GT3 Cup car. While the engine was left as is, the mid-engine GT4 Clubsport was the ultimate Cayman and is sure to go down in the annals of Porsche history.

long.zh:
在过去，除了极少数的例外情况之外，保时捷的传统是派出911参加比赛。这一历史悠久的传统在2015年被打破了，保时捷在Cayman产品线中增加了GT4赛车原型车款。

Cayman GT4有许多零部件都直接继承自911，是史上最快的Cayman车款。其采用的引擎是与Carrera S相同的3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，马力为<385ps>，比911 Carrera更高。前悬挂和刹车也采用了911 GT3的零部件，在稳定性和制动性能方面远超其他Cayman车型。

但是改进并没有就此告一段落。在接下来的2016年，保时捷对GT4做出进一步优化，推出了Cayman GT4 Clubsport。

这款特别版Cayman是专门用于赛道上的纯赛车版本。公路版Cayman GT4中任何为舒适度而保留的特性都被移除，造就了这样一款纯粹的赛车。

车内安装了保护车手的防滚架，座位也被替换为桶型座椅。为了尽可能提高单圈圈速，六速手动变速箱换成了双离合变速箱，悬挂和刹车则采用与911 GT3 Cup car相当的零部件。引擎马力仍然与GT4相同，但悬挂和传动系统都经过调校，以适应赛车中所采用的全光面轮胎。

相比引擎后置的911，这款Cayman的中置式引擎广受好评。GT4 Clubsport是Cayman的终极版，将其优势发挥得淋漓尽致。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This all-electric hypercar was unveiled on June 8, 2023—exactly 75 years after the original Porsche 356 "No.1" Roadster received approval. Its exterior design incorporated motifs from Porsche’s storied racing heritage, while the cockpit focused entirely on the driver experience. This car achieved a power-to-weight ratio of 1 horsepower per 2 lbs and downforce far exceeding that of the 992-generation 911 GT3 RS.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款全电动终极跑车于2023年6月8日正式发布，恰逢Porsche首款汽车356“No.1”Roadster获得批准的75周年纪念日。外观设计融入了该公司悠久赛车历史的经典元素，配备了专为运动驾驶打造的高性能座舱。这款车型的马力重量比达到了每1 公斤  1 PS，下压力比992款911 GT3 RS显著提升。

officialDetails.heroZh: 这是为庆祝Porsche成立75周年推出的概念超跑。

brandCentral.en:
A shift from combustion to electricity-based power units
has not marked the end of the sports car.

No car proves this fact more than the Mission X,
a fully electric concept from Porsche.

You might even say that it is a technology beacon for
the sports car of the future.

It serves as an homage to the great Porsche cars of the past,
while representing a technological breakthrough for the future.

The fastest road-car to conquer the Nürburgring's famous
Nordschleife loop...

...the Mission X is an ambitious automobile that pushes
the limits of possibility.

It follows in the footsteps of the 917 LIVING LEGEND,
Porsche Vision Gran Turismo, and Porsche Vision Gran Turismo Spyder.
brandCentral.zh:
动力系统从内燃机向电气化的转变
并未宣告跑车时代的终结。

Porsche全电动概念车“Mission X”就是最有说服力的证明。

你甚至可以称它为“未来跑车的技术灯塔。”

它既是对Porsche过去伟大车型的致敬，
也是开拓驾驶领域未来的技术突破。

征服著名的纽博格林北环赛道的最快量产车……

Mission X是Porsche雄心勃勃的设计，突破了可能性的极限……

延续了917 LIVING LEGEND、Porsche Vision Gran Turismo
和Porsche Vision Gran Turismo Spyder的创新精神。,

catch.en: A hypercar concept to celebrate the 75th anniversary of Porsche.
catch.zh: 这是为庆祝Porsche成立75周年推出的概念超跑。

vehicleCollection.en:
A hypercar concept to celebrate the 75th anniversary of Porsche.

On June 8, 1948, the first car to bear the Porsche name, the 356 "No. 1" Roadster was approved, setting in motion the rise of one of the greatest sports car brands in history.

Seventy-five years later, on the same date in 2023, the company unveiled a new concept car, a vision of the future of sports car technology inspired by classic Porsche legends. It was called the Mission X.

The conceptual 2-seat fully electric hypercar was relatively compact, measuring <4500mm> in length and <2000mm> in width. Standing just under <1200mm> tall, the low-slung design featured an almost sculptural form with bold lines, which proved that a hypercar did not necessarily need to look hyper aggressive.

Historic Porsche motifs were placed throughout the car’s exterior. The headlights served as a reinterpretation of the quad lights of historic cars like the 906 and 908, while the doors adopted the same upward opening motion as the legendary 917 endurance car. An illuminated "PORSCHE" logo adorned the center of the taillights, which extended out from the side of the body. The Porsche emblems on the hood and steering wheel were also updated to a more modern interpretation of the classic logo.

The interior expressed a strong affinity with motorsports. The steering wheel featured an open yoke style design, fitted with paddle shifters and several mode switches. The passenger had access to a stopwatch module, created by Porsche Design, which had both analogue and digital timers. Also, the driver could press the record button on the multi-purpose controller at any time to begin recording video footage from the numerous cameras installed around the car.

The Mission X aimed to be the fastest road-legal car on the Nürburgring Nordschleife, and shows off its prowess in Gran Turismo 7. With a power-to-weight ratio of over 1 PS per kilogram, it generated more downforce than even the current 911 GT3 RS. The concept car also had radical charging capabilities. With its 900V system architecture, charging speeds were greatly improved, allowing it to hypothetically charge around twice as fast as Porsche’s current popular EV, the Taycan Turbo S.

Following in the tradition of the 917 LIVING LEGEND, the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo, and the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo Spyder—all featured in Gran Turismo 7—the Mission X is yet anothes remarkable automobile that pushes the boundaries of what is possible in the future.

long.zh:
1948年6月8日，第一辆以保时捷命名的汽车——356 “No. 1” Roadster获批，由此开启了历史上最伟大的跑车品牌之一的崛起。

75年后，在2023年的同一天，保时捷发布了一款全新的概念车，以此诠释灵感源于众多经典保时捷车型的未来跑车技术。这款车被命名为Mission X。

这款两座纯电超跑体型相对紧凑，车长仅为<4500mm>、车宽仅为<2000mm>，车高不到<1200mm>，低趴的车身极具雕塑感，线条大胆，彰显超跑并非一定要看起来极具攻击性不可。

历史经典的保时捷设计元素在车身各处重现。车头灯复现了曾搭载在906和908上的四灯设计，车门则采用了传奇917耐力赛赛车的上掀式设计。车尾中央镶嵌发光的“保时捷”标志，一条灯组从车身两侧延展而出。细节之处，车盖和方向盘上的保时捷徽标也焕然一新，采用了经典标志的现代版本。

内饰设计彰显浓郁的赛车运动基因。配有换挡拨片的轭式方向盘支持切换多种模式。副驾驶座可配备保时捷设计专门打造的计时码表模块，集成模拟与数字计时功能。此外，驾驶者可以随时通过多功能控制器上的录像按钮，来启用车上的多个摄像头进行视频录制。

Mission X的目标是成为纽博格林北环最快合法上路车型，并在跑车浪漫旅7中充分展现了这一实力。凭借着每公斤超过1马力的马力重量比，它能产生比现款911 GT3 RS更强大的下压力。这款概念车在充电技术上同样突破创新。采用900V高压架构，充电速度获得显著提升，理论上可达到保时捷当前旗舰纯电车型Taycan Turbo S的两倍。

与917 LIVING LEGENDぁ保时捷Virion Fran Turismo和保时捷Vision Gran Ttrismo Spyder（这些车型都䏮䜨趑车浪漫旅7中体验）等车型一样——Mission X延续庆保时捷突破创新的设计理念，拓展了末来的可能性边界。

collection.en:
Did you know that the first car to ever bear the 'Porsche'
name was a midship Spyder?

Specifically, it was the 356/1 prototype from 1948.

I guess the company was always interested in
mid-engine sports cars.

The 550 Spyder, introduced in 1953, is another example of
the mid-engine concept from Porsche.

The 550/1500RS was a variant that went on the market
at the end of 1954.

This specific 550/1500RS, with its blue body and white
triangular stripes, is serial number 0067.

It's the only 550 still wearing the same finish
with which it left the factory...

And that makes it pretty much priceless.

您知道第一辆冠以Porsche名字的汽车是中置引擎的Spyder吗？

我猜，Porsche对中置引擎跑车的偏爱由来已久。

1953年推出的550 Spyder再一次证明了这种偏爱。

vehicleCollection.en:
This French blue Porsche wears the original livery from the 1956 24 Hours of Le Mans race.

The 550/1500RS was a purpose-built racing sports car that Porsche introduced in late 1954.

Its name, “550,” reflected its impressively light dry weight of just <550kg>. Built on a steel tube frame clad in an aluminum body, the car was powered by a 4-cam flat-four engine that produced <135ps>.

The 550/1500RS quickly proved itself on the racing circuit, capturing its class win at the 1954 24 Hours of Le Mans. The following year, it finished 4th overall, repeating its class victory.

One notable example was chassis number 550-0067, finished in French Blue. Delivered originally to a French dealership, this car also made an appearance at the Paris Motor Show.

This extremely historic race car still wears its original livery from its participation in the 1956 24 Hours of Le Mans race and is said to have been owned by famed French race driver Jean Marie Behra.

long.zh:
550/1500RS是保时捷在1954年底发售的一款竞技型跑车。

其名称中的550取自车身干重的<550kg>。车身底盘结合了钢管框架结构和铝制车体，再配备上一台4凸轮水平对置4缸引擎，输出功率高达<135ps>。

这款车在各项赛事中屡战屡胜，并在1954年的勒芒24小时耐力赛中获得了本级别的冠军。在1955年的比赛中，它再次赢得了本级别的冠军，并且取得了总排名第4的好成绩。

这台底盘号为550-0067的法国蓝1500RS最初交付给了法国经销商，也曾在巴黎车展上亮过相。

这是一辆极其罕见的赛车，至今仍保留着1956年参加勒芒24小时耐力赛时的原厂漆和涂装。据说，这台车曾经的主人是著名的法国赛车手让·玛丽·贝赫拉。

conversation.en:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.

The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts
the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.

The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera,
are more compact and lower to the ground...

...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip
of LED rear lights.

However, the front expresses its new identity with
the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...

...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the
aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
这款车是对Porsche设计的全新“电气化”表达。

这辆可持续环保升级车型的设计采用
斯图加特品牌那柔和又利落的设计语言。

Taycan的车身比与Panamera类似，
但要比后者更加紧凑、更贴近地面……

还采用了典型的斜背车尾和
由LED灯带构成的横条车尾灯。

不过它的前脸充分体现了全新个性，
两盏大灯和四盏日间行车灯连在一起，直接“下切”向路面……

此外，前轮后方还设计了空气动力学排气口。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Taycan marked Porsche’s first fully electric sports sedan. Equipped with electric motors on the front and rear axles, its advanced all-wheel-drive system was paired with a 2-speed transmission, delivering blistering acceleration and top-end performance. The overboost-equipped Turbo S variant produced 560 kW (750.5 HP). Notably, the Taycan was the first mass-produced vehicle to feature an 800V electrical system, enhancing both powertrain efficiency and reducing charging times.

vehicleCollection.en:
With a total system voltage of 800V, this fully electric sedan boasts both comfort and remarkable performance.

The Taycan is Porsche’s answer to the question of sustainable mobility, their first fully-electric vehicle.

A sports sedan that combines sports performance with everyday usability, its electric all-wheel-drive system uses 2 electric motors mounted on the front and rear axles, with the rear-motor encompassing a revolutionary 2-speed transmission allowing unparalleled acceleration and efficiency at high speeds.

Both the Turbo and the Turbo S models normally output 460 kW (<625ps>), but with the overboost feature engaged the output of the Turbo model is boosted to 500 kW (<680ps>), and the Turbo S cranks out a staggering 560 kW (<761ps>). This incredible power output is enabled by the first 800-volt power unit to be seen in a production car, which successfully achieves greater efficiency while drastically reducing charging time.

And of course no effort has been spared in producing dynamic handling. It features Porsche’s superior active suspension management and torque vectoring technology, controlling these systems in sync to provide the best possible driving experience under all driving conditions. Taycan’s technical advances also extend to its user interface, enabling media and air-conditioning to be operated directly through its intuitive voice control system.

The Taycan carries forward Porsche’s historical lineage while signaling a new era of automobiles. Truly a model in which heritage meets the future.

long.zh:
Taycan是保时捷的第一款纯电动汽车，也是他们为可持续机动性交出的答卷。

这款轿跑车兼具跑车性能和日常实用性，其电动全驱系统由安装在前后轴上的2台电机辅助。后轴电机采用了革命性的2档变速箱，带来了无与伦比的加速性能和高效率。

通常情况下，Turbo和Turbo S车型可输出460kW（<625ps>），但在超增压模式介入后，Turbo车型的输出将提高到500kW（<680ps>），Turbo S车型更是能达到惊人的560kW（<761ps>）。如此不可思议的动力输出全都依赖于这套首次在量产车型中使用的800伏供电动力单元，不仅能在短时间内大幅度提升功率，而且能显著减少充电时间。

设计者在全路段的动态操控上也耗费了大量心血，引入了保时捷极其出色的主动悬挂管理系统和扭矩矢量技术，这些系统的协同作用可以在任何驾驶情况下实现最佳驾驶体验。Taycan还将技术革新覆盖到了用户交互界面上，支持驾驶者通过语音系统直接启动多媒体和空调。

这款车型既延续了保时捷的优良传统，也代表着汽车的新时代，可以说是真正的过去和未来交融的典范。

vehicleCollection.en:
Porsche's modern-yet-daring statement on the future of the sports car.

Starting in 1948, Porsche built its reputation as one of the world’s premier automotive manufacturers by creating elegant, well-engineered lightweight sports cars. These cars were not defined by extreme horsepower, but instead were characterized by a highly efficient power-to-weight ratio combined with timeless, functional design.

The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo follows in this tradition while expressing the company's take on the future of the sports car. It merges elements of the iconic design of historic Porsche sports cars with the company's storied race machines. The car also possesses hints of the record-breaking 919 Hybrid, as well as Porsche's first electric sports car, the Taycan.

Exterior and interior design flow seamlessly together, providing drivers with the feeling of being one with the car when inside the cockpit of the state-of-the-art carbon monocoque chassis. The glass dome places them into the surrounding natural environment.

The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo’s dual electric engine layout delivers 820 kW (<1114ps>) of power and a maximum torque of 1,090 Nm (<111kgm>). An innovative active aerodynamic system dynamically reacts to all driving situations to enhance the car’s performance, thus making the car perfectly suited for the demanding corners and high-speed segments found on tracks like the Nürburgring Nordschleife or on alpine roads.

保时捷Vision Gran Turismo也遵循了这家德国汽车制造商的传统，同时也绝对是一种对于未来跑车的真正现代化的、激进的展现。它结合了保时捷跑车的经典标志性设计，919 Hybrid的破纪录赛车基因，和保时捷第一辆纯电动跑车Taycan的先锋精神，最终打造出了一款高性能的轻量化跑车。

这款车的外观设计和内饰天衣无缝地结合在一起，为驾驶者提供了一种人车一体的体验，尤其是在你坐进以最先进的碳纤维单体车壳底盘科技打造的驾驶舱时。

保时捷Vision Gran Turismo采用了双电机布局，可以输出820千瓦 （<1114ps>）的功率和1090 牛·米 （<111kgm>）的最大扭矩。其创新的主动式空气动力学体系可以对任何驾驶环境做出动态反应，以提升车辆性能，完美适应纽博格林北侧赛道或阿尔卑斯高山公路这样高难度弯道和高速直线路段兼而有之的赛道。

vehicleCollection.en:
Porsche's modern yet daring statement on the future of the sports car remains true to its racing roots.

Since it was founded in 1948, Porsche has continually represented the highest level of automotive performance in both motorsports and on the public road. The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo honors the virtues of the German manufacturer with a future version of a sports car designed without restrictions.

Merging elements many historic Porsches from the past with those of today, including the 919 Hybrid super car and the company's first EV, the Taycan, the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo may well be the closes thing to the perfect sports car.

Virtually built around a state-of-the-art carbon monocoque chassis, the cabin is enclosed by a glass dome. Powering the car are dual electric motors that combine to produce 820 kW (<1114ps>) and 1090 Nm (<111kgm>) of torque. An innovative active aerodynamic system dynamically reacts to all driving situations to enhance the car’s performance.

The car's styling was inspired by past Porsche race cars such as the 908 and the legendary 917, and while the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo looks like it belongs exclusively on a track, it was created to also shred winding roads as a true GT car.

conversation.en:
The FD3S Mazda RX-7 was released in 1991. Even now,
there are many young fans of this car in the U.S.

It possesses a simple design without any faults.

The styling of this car was born at Mazda's California
design studio, led at the time by Tom Matano.

This particular street machine was created by RE Amemiya,
which specializes in tuning rotary-powered machines.

Although it's not exactly a "hashiriya," or street racer,
it's nevertheless captivating.

It's a car you should drive at least once in Gran Turismo.

vehicleCollection.en:
The Amemiya FD3S was another stylish RX-7 created by master tuner, RE Amemiya.

The Amemiya μ Boost up 7 is a street machine created by the RE Amemiya corporation, the legendary tuner of rotary powered cars renowned for its activity in the Super GT and D1GP. The front, rear and side aerodynamic parts and the fixed position sleek light kit are all RE Amemiya original designs. RE Amemiya has a variety of aerodynamic parts available including even a GT replica kit, but this particular model has a presence that stands out from the others.

In terms of driving performance, the specs live up to the unique exterior. Though the turbo is kept stock and the power is only increased through additional boost, the car still produces over <370ps> with a maximum boost of 1 kg/cm2, along with a maximum torque of <47kgm>. It is set up to produce abundant torque from the mid speed range.

It is also equipped with a horizontally mounted intercooler kit, an aftermarket air cleaner, dolphin tail exhaust muffler, and everything from the cooling system, accessories and exhaust system has been thoroughly revised.

In addition to these engine characteristics, the Quantum-based Amemiya spec adjustable suspension has been perfected to a level which draws out the true character of the FD3S as the ultimate cornering machine. In the Japanese DVD magazine "Hot Version," it was shown to be utterly undefeatable on winding roads, and was dubbed the "demon-lord of mountain paths."X

long.en:
The Amemiya μ Boost up 7 is a street machine created by the RE Amemiya corporation, the legendary tuner of rotary powered cars renowned for its activity in the Super GT and D1GP. The front, rear and side aerodynamic parts and the fixed position sleek light kit are all RE Amemiya original designs. RE Amemiya has a variety of aerodynamic parts available including even a GT replica kit, but this particular model has a presence that stands out from the others.

In terms of driving performance, the specs live up to the unique exterior. Though the turbo is kept stock and the power is only increased through additional boost, the car still produces over <370ps> with a maximum boost of 1 kg/cm2, along with a maximum torque of <47kgm>. It is set up to produce abundant torque from the mid speed range.

It is also equipped with a horizontally mounted intercooler kit, an aftermarket air cleaner, dolphin tail exhaust muffler, and everything from the cooling system, accessories and exhaust system has been thoroughly revised.

In addition to these engine characteristics, the Quantum-based Amemiya spec adjustable suspension has been perfected to a level which draws out the true character of the FD3S as the ultimate cornering machine. In the Japanese DVD magazine "Hot Version," it was shown to be utterly undefeatable on winding roads, and was dubbed the "demon-lord of mountain paths."X
long.zh:
雨宫μ Boost up 7是RE雨宫推出的公路车，该公司是转子引擎调校领域的传奇，它所经手的车辆在Super GT和D1GP比赛中均表现不俗。前、后和侧面的空气动力学套件以及定位圆滑车灯套件都是其原创设计。RE雨宫拥有各种空气动力学部件，甚至包括GT复刻套件，但雨宫μ Boost up 7明显更加与众不同。

其驾驶性能与独特的外观相辅相成。尽管采用了标准版本的涡轮增压引擎，需要通过额外的增压器来提升动力，但本车仍能输出超过<370ps>，最大增压为1公斤/立方厘米，最大扭矩为<47kgm>。雨宫μ Boost up 7的调校设定是在中等转速时就能产生可观的扭矩。

它还配备了卧式中冷套件、副厂空气滤清器，海豚尾排气管，并且全面改装了冷却系统、附属组件和排气系统。

除了优异的发动机特性外，基于昆腾的雨宫可调节悬挂系统功能尽善尽美，使得FD3S作为终极转弯机器发挥出了真正的实力。日本的DVD杂志《Hot Vision》表示，雨宫μ Boost up 7在迂曲道路上的表现无与伦比，人称“山道魔王”。

conversation.en:
Inspired by the Komenda Porsche 550 Le Mans Coupé...

...the RUF CTR3’s styling has lasted well, and is still being
requested by customers.

This was RUF’s first foray into building a car with its
own all-carbon-fiber body design.

It utilized a race-engineered all-aluminum mid-engine
subframe with pushrod suspension.

The front underbody is a highly modified Porsche
lightweight steel/aluminum structure.

It was engineerd to meet RUF’s performance standards.

The super low cabin allows for an extremely low front, while
the rear spoiler generates speed control and downforce.

Elsewhere, the six rear vents rovide a clue to the <700ps>
twin-turbo Mezger-based flat-6 underneath.

它的外观设计历久弥新，至今依然能够打动消费者。

这是如虎首次使用他们自己的全碳纤维
车身设计打造一辆车……

并采用了针对比赛开发的全铝合金后中置引擎
副车框和推杆式悬挂系统。

其车头的底部结构是一套经过高度改装的保时捷
轻量化钢铝制结构……

{为了满足如虎的性能需求而经过重新加工。

其超低设置的驾驶舱也使车头高度降至极低，
同时由后扰流板提供高速下的操控性和下压力。

此，其车身后部的六个排气管也让人得以一瞥它那基于梅gL格打造的
00ps>涡轮增压水平对置六缸引擎的恐怖动力。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Released in 2007, the RUF CTR3 served as the successor to the iconic CTR and CTR2. Unlike its predecessors, which were based on the Porsche 930 and 993 Turbo, the CTR3 was designed entirely from the ground up by RUF. It adopted a mid-engine layout and was powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-6 with intercooling. Performance was staggering, with a top speed of 236.1 mph and zero-62.1 mph acceleration in just 3.2 seconds.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2007年发布的RUF CTR3是其CTR与CTR2的继任者。前代车型基于Porsche 930和993 Turbo打造，而CTR3却是由RUF从零开始设计研发。这台车采用中置引擎布局，搭载的是一台3.8升水平对置6缸中冷式双涡轮增压引擎。最高时速为380 公里/小时，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.2秒。
officialDetails.heroEn: The third-generation CTR was thoroughly re-engineered by Ruf, including being converted to a mid-engine layout.
officialDetails.heroZh: 第3代CTR，大量继承了来自Ruf的原创设计，包括中置引擎底座。

brandCentral.en:
Ruf is a manufacturer that has a lot of cachet among Porsche
owners—and with good reason.

They've made a name for themselves by taking Porsche base
models and somehow improving upon perfection.

Even for them, though, the CTR3 is an incredible
achievement.

It's a mid-engine design developed, engineered and built on
a unique standalone platform.

The engine is a 3.8L twin-turbo flat-six.

And with a top speed of <380km/h>, it really is a
super sports car.%

这款车基于专用独立平台研发打造，采用中置引擎布局，

其配备的3.8L双涡轮增压水平对置六缸引擎

拥有高达<380km/h>的最高时速，是一辆纯正的超级跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation CTR was thoroughly re-engineered by Ruf, including being converted to a mid-engine layout.

There is little doubt who the world's premiere Porsche tuner is: Ruf Automobile. Nestled in the small town of Pfaffenhausen, Germany, the firm has been turning out the world's fastest road-going Porsches since 1939. One of the most ominous Ruf creations was the RUF CTR, and the third example in the series, the amazing CTR3, introduced in 2007, was the most potent of them all.

While the CTR was based on the Porsche 930, and the CTR2 on the Porsche 993 Turbo, the CTR3 borrowed parts from the Porsche 997 while its design and development were performed independently by Ruf.

Like all Porsche 911-based models, the CTR3 featured a rear-engine layout, where the twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-6 was mounted aft of the rear axle. This engine was completely rebuilt and produced an amazing <700ps> and <90.7kgm> torque. This allowed the CTR3 to reach <380km/h> and run from zero to <100km/h> in only 3.2 seconds.

It just went to show that with the CTR3, Ruf was not intent on letting go of its claim as being the world's most formidable Porsche tuner.

long.zh:
CTR3是如虎在2007年推出的原创跑车，是品牌旗舰CTR和CTR2的继任者。

在这辆车推出之前，如虎的CTR是以保时捷930为基础开发的，而CTR2是以保时捷993 Turbo为基础开发的。这台CTR3虽然也使用了保时捷997的一些零部件，但其设计和开发均由如虎独立完成。

另外，这次的中置引擎布局也和之前的两款CTR截然不同。其全新设计的纵向6速序列式变速箱被安装在空间车架的后部，引擎也从一台调校版3.8升911引擎换成了一台全新设计的3.8升中冷式双涡轮增压水平对置6缸引擎，可以输出<700ps>和<90.7kgm>的扭矩。

这款车型的最高时速可达<380km/h>，0-<100km/h>加速仅需3.2秒，是当时最快的车型之一。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This RUF original was based on the 991-generation Porsche 911 GT3. Developed with the philosophy of blending GT3-level performance with refined road car comfort, it was powered by a naturally-aspirated Mezger engine—fitted with the legendary GT1 crankshaft—and enlarged from 3.8 to 4.2 liters. vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate naturally-aspirated flat-6 machine, meticulously crafted by Ruf.!

Ruf continues to create distinctive sports cars, all of them based on Porsche models, and infusing them with its own unique philosophy and craftsmanship. Among their enduring model lines is the “RGT,” based on 911 GT3 models.

At the heart of the RGT lies the concept of enhancing the performance of the GT3 while endowing it with the comfort of a road car. At the 2015 Geneva show, Ruf unveiled a new addition to this lineage: the RGT 4.2, based on the Type 991, 911 GT3.

As its name suggested, it came powered by a 4.2-liter flat-6 engine, increasing the displacement from the standard 3.8 liters of the Type 991, 911 GT3 by nearly <400cc>. However, the increased displacement was not its only notable feature. It employed the renowned “Mezger" touch with the GT1 crankshaft at its foundation—an engine celebrated for its racing success since the days of the air-cooled flat-6. The car produced an impressive <125ps> per liter, culminating in a maximum power output of <525ps>.

In terms of design, the RGT 4.2 boasted aggressive riveted overfenders, while the interior featured an integrated roll cage, an element for which the RGT series is renowned. Combining the spirit of competition with the elegance of a road car, this model exemplified the Ruf ethos, offering the ultimate vehicle for the gentleman driver who sought both track performance and daily usability.

如虎是一家不断基于保时捷车型开发、改装新车的公司，他们在这些独特的跑车中注入了自己的理念和工艺。“RGT”是他们持续更新的产品线之一，基于911 GT3的各种车型开发而来。

RGT的核心理念是进一步打磨GT3的性能，同时奇迹般地令其拥有如同公路车般的舒适体验。在2015年的日内瓦车展上，如虎新添了一位家族成员：RGT 4.2，此车基于991型的911 GT3开发而来。

如名称所示，此车由一台4.2升的水平对置6缸引擎驱动。比911 GT3的原厂3.8升排量增加了<400cc>。然而，排量并不是它唯一值得关注的地方。RGT 4.2的引擎并没有使用调校过的911 GT3引擎，而是以配备GT1曲轴的“梅茨格引擎”为基础开发而来。后者是一款从风冷时代的水平对置六缸引擎起步并在赛车领域取得了多次成功的引擎。按照每升排量可输出<125ps>计算，这台RGT的最大输出功率高达<525ps>。

外观方面，它配备了张扬的铆钉式轮眉，内饰则采用了RGT系列标志性的集成式防滚笼。此车是竞技血统与公路车的优雅结合，是如虎的又一杰作。对于那些既享受赛道，又注重日常使用的绅士车手而言，拥有此车便别无所求。_

vehicleCollection.en:
The road-going racer that can handle both pleasure cruises and circuit laps.

Not many car makers in the world can compete with Radical Sportscars Ltd. when it comes to creating pure unbridled performance cars. Since 1970, when the company was founded, Radical has been providing lightweight mid-engine race cars, powered by high-performance motorcycle engines, to the motorsports public. The vehicles were so popular that Radical began producing road-going versions that slightly resembled Le Mans prototype race cars.

The idea behind the road-going car was that anyone could drive it from his or her own home to the race track, then drive it back home, without the need for a trailer or car transporter. Of all the Radicals offered, the SR3 SL was the most gentlemanly. No major changes were made to its design principles and styling, but the car did come equipped with an automobile engine to meet the variety of emissions regulations around the world. The power unit was a Ford Ecoboost direct-injection turbocharged 2.0 liter inline-4 that produced <240ps> in standard form, with an option to go up to <300ps>. The gearbox was a 6-speed sequential unit with paddle shifters.

The lightweight <775kg> car went from zero to <96km/h> in 3.4 seconds and peaked at <257km/h>. The SR3 SL came to a full stop from <96km/h> in just 2.67 seconds. The SR3 SL’s performance was leaps and bounds beyond the norm, making it the quintessential road-going race car.

long.zh:
Radical赛车有限公司是一家汽车制造商，专为业余赛车爱好者打造拥有成熟设计的赛车。自1997年成立以来，他们的基础理念便是打造采用高性能超级摩托车引擎的中置布局赛车。除此之外，他们还出售外观和性能都与勒芒原型车相仿的公路版本。

你完全可以从家里出发，在赛道上畅快淋漓地飞驰一整天，然后再安然回家。这款车型在连续弯道上的表现无可比拟，就仿佛在城市里驾驶赛车一般。这款车带来的极限刺激不仅吸引着赛车爱好者，还捕获了一大群已经不满足于普通跑车性能的拥趸。

SR3 SL是一款强调其公路车特性的型号。在设计原则和外观风格方面，这款车并无重大变化，不过为了满足全球各地的排放规范和标准，改为搭载汽车引擎。

其动力单元是来自福特的节动2升直喷涡轮增压4缸引擎，可以输出<240ps>的标准马力，也可以选择将马力提升至<300ps>。传动装置配置的是一部带换挡拨片的6速序列式变速箱。因为这台车仅重<775kg>，

它从静止加速到<96km/h>仅需3.4秒，完全制动也仅需2.67秒，再加上<257km/h>的最大速度，性能表现超乎想象。或许，再没有比它更符合“公路赛车”称号的车型了。

雷诺以其打造的多功能乘用车而闻名，特别是Espace。

虽然这款Avantime看起来像多功能乘用车，但实际上
它是按照双门轿跑车的标准打造的。

实话实说，这确实是一款独一无二的车。

它的设计师正是帕特里克·勒·奎芒，
他在1980年代至2000年代期间担任雷诺的首席设计师。

v车于2001年发布，生产周期却异常短暂，
仅仅持续了两年时间。

这实在令人惋惜，因为这是一款由内到外都充满个性
的汽车。说真的，我觉得再也找不到如此特立独行的车型了。

难怪它至今仍吸引着世界各地的车迷。
这k是雷诺悠So历[中的一项辉煌成就。

dialogues.en:
Renault is famous for its minivans, especially the Espace.

This Avantime may resemble a minivan, but it
was really intended to be a two-door coupe.

A truly unique car, if I may say so.

It was designed by none other than Patrick le Quément,
chief designer at Renault from the 1980s to the 2000s.

Released in 2001, it had a remarkably brief production run
of wo short years.

A shame, really, as it’s a car overflowing with character,
inside and out. Indeed, I feel there’s nothing quite like it.

No wonder it continues to attract fans all over the world.
It’s another shiing achievement in Renault’s long history.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Avantime was a specialty car penned by Patrick Le Quément of Renault Design. Its distinctive body blended the proven underpinnings of the third-generation Espace, a favorite across Europe, with a striking three-door fiberglass shell. Although coupe-like in silhouette, what set the Avantime apart were its B-pillarless side windows and large sunroof, which could be opened. A pure expression of Renault’s design philosophy, the Avantime was proof that the monoform concept need not be limited to minivans.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Avantime是由Renault设计部门的帕特里克·勒·奎芒设计的特色车型。大胆采用了创新的车身设计，将在欧洲大受欢迎的第三代Espace底盘与玻璃纤维三门车身相结合。虽然外观酷似双门轿跑车，但真正让这款车与众不同的是无B柱侧窗设计和可完全开启的大尺寸天窗。作为Renault品牌个性的完美诠释，这款车证明了单体车身设计不只是厢式旅行车的专属。
officialDetails.heroEn: A unique coupe that tests the boundaries of monoform design.
officialDetails.heroZh: 探索单体车身设计边界的独特双门轿跑车。

brandCentral.en:
Monoform bodies, known for their roomy interiors,
have long been the go-to for high-occupancy minivans.

The Avantime turned that idea on its head, becoming the first to
pair a spacious cabin with the sleekness of a low-occupancy coupe.

Derived from the 1997 third-gen Espace, the Avantime broke new
ground with its bold three-door layout and lightweight FRP body.

This resulted in an airy, elegant cabin unlike anything else.
With no B-pillar, the side windows stretch to the rear.

Open the expansive sunroof,
and it nearly feels like a full convertible!

Penned by Renault’s legendary designer Patrick Le Quément, this
unique coupe redefined what was possible with a monoform body.
brandCentral.zh:
可提供宽敞内部空间的单体车身设计通常被用于
满足大容量多人座厢式旅行车的需求。

而首次挑战这一概念，将宽敞空间运用到
小众三门轿跑车上的，正是Avantime。

基于1997年第三代Espace，Avantime采用了
令人眼前一亮的三门玻璃纤维车身设计。

呈现出既优雅又独特的座舱氛围。
无B柱设计让侧窗可以完全打开。

配合大尺寸天窗开启时，几乎让人感觉置身于敞篷车中！

由Renault首席设计师帕特里克·勒·奎芒倾心打造，这款
独特的三门轿跑车为单体车身设计开创了新境界。

usedCar.en:
Looking for a coupe with real character?
If so, then have I got the perfect choice for you!

Built on the third-gen Renault Espace platform, the Avantime
is a unique-looking coupe that embraces minivan elements.

What truly sets it apart is the remarkable sense of freedom
it delivers, notably from its ingeniously designed rear seating.

The body, crafted from lightweight FRP, was built by Matra,
a name once synonymous with Formula 1 competition.

While it came with a range of engine options, this model packs
a 3.0-liter V-6, whose torque contributed to good handling.

A true rarity, only 8,500 units rolled off the line during
its brief two-year production run that began in 2001!
usedCar.zh:
你在寻找一辆独具个性的双门跑车吗？
那这款车无疑是最完美的选择！

基于第三代Renault Espace打造的Avantime是一款
融合了厢式旅行车元素的独特双门跑车。

它最大的魅力在于通过设计所营造的强烈自由感，
尤其是其创新的后排座椅设计。

车身采用玻璃纤维强化塑料制造，由曾参与
F1赛事的Matra公司生产。

这款车型还提供多种动力配置选择，我们眼前的这台搭载
3升V6引擎，低扭输出特性带来出色的操控表现。

这是一款罕见车型，在自2001年开始的两年生产周期中，
仅制造了约8500台！_

vehicleCollection.en:
A unique coupe that tests the boundaries of monoform design.	)

The Renault Avantime brought an unconventional twist to the widely praised Renault Espace, reimagining the European minivan. Conceived as a bold design study by Renault’s chief designer, Patrick Le Quément, the Avantime made its debut at the 1999 Geneva Motor Show. When Renault confirmed plans to launch it as a production model in 2001, the news was met with widespread disbelief.

At first glance, the Avantime resembled a minivan—but with a twist: it had only two doors. Inside, it featured a conventional layout with two rows of seats, accommodating up to five passengers in comfort. Renault’s reasoning for this unorthodox design was that it was intended to be a niche coupe.

This intent became clear the moment you stepped inside the Avantime. The luxury of enjoying the expansive cabin of a minivan, with only a handful of passengers, truly defined it as a niche creation. From the rear seats, the visibility was exceptional. With all the side windows lowered and the expansive sunroof fully open, the sense of openness was remarkable. It offered a feeling of freedom and airiness not unlike that of a convertible.

In its home market, the Avantime was also offered with a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine. But for Japan, it possessed a 3.0-liter DOHC 24-valve V-6, producing <207ps> at <6000rpm> and <28.5kgm> of torque at <3750rpm>. True to its character, the Avantime delivered a composed and confident ride. The generous torque and trademark Renault smoothness came together in perfect harmony. The driving quality was so refined, it surpassed that of many traditional sedans and coupes.

The Avantime embodied Renault’s unique spirit that proved the monoform silhouette wasn’t the sole domain of minivans.

long.zh:
雷诺Avantime为备受好评的欧洲多功能乘用车车型雷诺Espace装配了独特的车身。Avantime诞生于雷诺首席设计师帕特里克·勒·奎芒的设计预研项目，并于1999年在日内瓦车展首次亮相。当雷诺宣布将在2001年量产上市这款车型时，人们都感到震惊不已。

乍一看，Avantime是一款不折不扣的多功能乘用车，但它却只有2扇车门。车内采用标准布局，配备两排座椅，共可容纳5名乘客。雷诺对这一设计决策的解释是，Avantime被定位为一款小众双门轿跑车。

当你真正坐进车内，这一观点倒是一目了然。如多功能乘用车般宽敞的空间只供少数人享用，如此奢华的体验确实让它成为了一款小众车型。后排座椅的视野开阔程度令人惊叹。当所有侧窗摇下、巨大的天窗完全打开时，你会体验到如同敞篷车般的自由感受。

引入日本市场的车型搭载了3升双顶置凸轮轴24气门V6引擎。但在其原产国，还提供2升涡轮增压版本。其最大功率输出为<207ps>@<6000rpm>，最大扭矩为<28.5kgm>@<3750rpm>。与其独特气质相符，Avantime的行驶品质表现得从容不迫。充沛的扭矩输出与雷诺一贯的平顺行驶特性完美融合，互相成就。出色的驾驶质感，即便是传统轿车和双门轿跑也难以与之媲美。

Avantime集成了雷诺诸般特质，证明了单体车身不止能用于多功能乘用车。

The second-generation model, introduced in 2019, measured 13.9 ft in length, 5.9 ft in width and 5.2 ft in height, giving it the stance of an SUV while preserving the agility of a compact car. brandCentral.en:
Renault is best known for its compact cars, but its
technical prowess extended even to its SUVs.

This was nowhere more evident than in the Renault Captur,
the perfect marriage of compact style and SUV strength.

Here is the second-generation model from 2019, easily
recognizable by its C-shaped signature lighting.

Available with gasoline, diesel and mild hybrid engines, the
range introduced Renault’s first plug-in hybrid model.

Renault hybrids were built with F1-tested technology, maning
they were fast and offered unparalleled control.

Inside, the Captur featured a floating center console
with a 7-inch display and smartphone connectivity.

Boasting comfort and convenience in a compact package,
the Captur was a small but mighy hero of everyday life.

最显著的例证便是Renault Captur，紧凑型风格
与SUV运载力的完美结合体。

这里的这台是2019年的第2代车型，
标志性的C型灯光设计很容易分辨。

和Renault的第一款插电式混合动力车型一样，该车型有
汽油版、柴油版和轻度混合动力版的引擎可供选择。

Renault的混合动力车型采用F1比赛中验证过的技术，
因此在高车速下仍能保证无与伦比的可操控性。

在内饰方面，Captur采用了悬浮式中控台，
带有7英寸显示屏和智能手机互联互通功能。

Captur以紧凑的尺寸实现了引RPi的舒适度和便利性，
是Q款小巧而又强悍的日用多y手。

vehicleCollection.en:
A formidable vehicle that blurred the boundaries of the compact SUV class.

The Captur is a compact crossover SUV produced by Renault. The first model appeared in 2013 and quickly gained popularity for its urban-friendly design and strong everyday utility. The second-generation model was released in 2019, built on an updated platform that improved driving performance and ride quality. It also introduced the C-shaped signature lighting that became a defining design element.

Measuring <4.23m> in length, <1.8m> in width and <1.58m> in height, it balanced the agility of a compact car with the presence of an SUV. The extended wheelbase and folding rear seats also allowed for flexible use of the cargo area.

Powertrain options varied by region and trim level, ranging from turbocharged 1.0- and 1.3-liter gasoline engines to diesel and hybrid configurations. Renault also offered its first plug-in hybrid in the Captur lineup, the E-TECH PHEV, which utilized hybrid technology derived in part from Renault’s Formula 1 experience, delivering quiet and efficient operation with electric assist.

Agile handling and a stable ride were complemented by a well-finished interior and a cutting-edge infotainment system, providing comfort for both driver and passengers. Its elevated driving position made maneuvering easy, allowing drivers to transition from daily commuting to winding rural roads with confidence and ease. As a result, the Captur emerged as a versatile all-rounder that pushed beyond the traditional boundaries of the compact SUV segment.

long.zh:
Captur是一款雷诺出品的紧凑型跨界运动型多用途汽车。第一代车型于2013年发布，很快就因其适应城市的设计和灵活多样的用途而获得了大众的青睐。第二代车型于2019年发布，其底盘平台经过升级，提高了驾驶表现和乘坐舒适度。从这一代开始，标志性的C型灯组设计成为了该车型的独有特征。

该车尺寸为<4.23m>长、<1.8m>宽和<1.58m>高，在紧凑型车的轻便性和运动型多用途汽车的容积之间做出了平衡。同时，扩大的轴距和折叠式的后座也为其创造了实用灵活的货厢空间。

针对不同地区或级别的车型，Captur的动力单元也有所不同：有1.0或1.3升的涡轮增压汽油引擎、柴油引擎和混合动力系统可供选择。该车甚至和雷诺的第一款插电式混动车型一样，提供了E-TECH插电式混合动力系统，该系统采用了自雷诺一级方程式车队掌握的混动技术，有效利用电机提供的动力，保证使车辆行驶时安静平稳。

at the Paris Motor Show.

yet it remains as astonishing as ever.

Based on the wildly popular family car,
the Renault Espace...

in Formula 1 racing.

minivan! It was, indeed, a fantastical concept.

Although it never reached production, it remans a brilliant star
in Renault’s history.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Ten years after the debut of Europe’s first minivan came the Renault Espace F1—an unprecedented creation that redefined the limits of imagination. At its heart resided the RS4 3.5-liter V-10 from the 1992 Formula 1 championship–winning FW14B, mounted amidships within a body crafted from aluminum and carbon fiber.
