vehicleCollection.en:
Renault's rebellious minivan carries an F1 engine.

The Renault Espace made its debut in 1984 as Europe’s first minivan. Ten years later, in 1994, an extraordinary version of the Espace was revealed at the Paris Motor Show. This machine carried an F1 engine at its core and was christened the Espace F1.

The original concept came from Matra, which had first pitched the Espace to Renault and had crafted its fiberglass body panels. At the time, Renault was partnered with Williams, fresh from its triumph in Formula 1. Matra proposed installing the 3.5-liter V-10 RS4 engine from the 1992 championship-winning FW14B into the Espace, both as a tribute to the model’s tenth anniversary and as a statement of Renault’s success.

Built at Matra’s Romorantin plant in France, the Espace F1 stood as an entirely unconventional minivan. It shared part of its chassis with the second-generation model, yet most of the body was refashioned in aluminum and carbon fiber. The body’s width was expanded to house massive tires, while a giant rear wing adorned the roof, pressing the body downward.

The engine, the very heart of the beast, was mounted amidships between the front and rear axles. Inside, the three rows of seats gave way to four carbon-fiber buckets, while the engine’s intake funnels stood proudly on display between the rear seats. The Espace F1 produced <800ps>, accelerating from 0-<100km/h> in just 2.8 seconds and reaching a top speed of <316km/h>.

Legends like Alain Prost took the wheel of the Espace F1 on circuit, releasing the piercing whine of its race engine as it roared past enthralled crowds.

long.zh:
雷诺Espace于1984年问世，成为欧洲首款小型厢式车。十年后的1994年，一款引人注意的超常规Espace车型在巴黎车展上发布。这头机械猛兽在车身中央搭载了一台一级方程式引擎，因而得名Espace F1。

这款车型的初始构想来自马特拉公司——他们最初向雷诺推介了Espace项目，并负责制造其玻璃纤维车身板件。当时，雷诺作为威廉姆斯车队的引擎合作伙伴，成功赢得了一级方程式锦标赛的胜利。马特拉公司提议，将1992年冠军车型FW14B赛车的3.5升“RS4”V10引擎移植到Espace上，既庆祝Espace问世十周年，又彰显雷诺的冠军荣耀。

这款Espace F1在马特拉公司位于法国罗莫朗坦的工厂制造，是一款彻底颠覆传统的小型厢式车。该车沿用了第二代车型的部分基础底盘结构，但车身大部分材料已换装为铝合金和碳纤维。车身宽度经过特别加宽以适配宽幅轮胎，车顶末尾更配备巨型尾翼，装饰之余也有效提升车身下压力。

作为这辆性能猛兽的核心，动力总成采用中置布局，位于前后车轴之间。内饰方面，原有的三排座椅被替换为四张碳纤维桶椅，引擎的进气歧管傲然展示于两张后排座椅之间。该车最大功率输出为<800ps>，0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需2.8秒，极速更可达<316km/h>。

包括阿兰·普罗斯特在内的一级方程式车手曾亲临赛道驾驶Espace F1，当赛车呼啸而过时，竞速引擎特有的尖锐嘶鸣响彻赛场。_

conversation.en:
Did you know that the Kangoo was originally designed
as a commercial vehicle?

With its generous cargo space, this is a machine that, for many,
became a trusted co-worker.

But not all Kangoos were built for hard labor.

Some serve as passenger cars, offering a welcome blend of style
and comfort, and they’re every bit as popular.

Renault, after all, has a long tradition of crafting
iconic utility vehicles.

Among them was a commercial version of the Renault 4
from the 1960s.

Another was the Express, derived from
the second-generation Renault 5.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In French, small vans are called "fourgonnettes." And the Kangoo gained popularity for embodying that spirit, with sliding passenger doors and split-folding rear seats that made it ideal not only for commercial tasks but also for personal and recreational use. It became a pioneer of the ludospace segment—vehicles designed for leisure activity. While its engine delivered only modest power, the soft suspension gave it a surprisingly lively and enjoyable driving character.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 在法语中，小型厢式货车被称为“fourgonnette”。Kangoo凭借侧滑车门和可折叠后排座椅的实用设计获得了广泛认可，既适合商用也完美满足个人休闲用车需求。它成为了“ludospace”休闲空间车型的开创者。虽然引擎功率不算强劲，但舒适的悬挂调校营造出轻松动感的驾驶感受。
officialDetails.heroEn: This popular leisure activity vehicle began its life as a commercial van.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这是一款由商用厢式车演变而来的人气休闲车型。

brandCentral.en:
Are you familiar with the term "fourgonnette?"
It’s a French word that means a light van.

The Renault Kangoo was a best-selling fourgonnette
since its debut in 1997.

But the Kangoo is no ordinary van—it’s a very popular MPV
suited for camping and long-distance trips.

Access to the rear compartment was simplified by sliding doors
and folding seats that resulted in excellent cargo space.

This clever touch was often praised by fans as a
prime example of "ludospace."

A compact vehicle with a lot of versatility, the Kangoo embodied
the ingenuity that long defined French automotive design.
brandCentral.zh:

Perfect timing! I just received a little French van
that I think you might love.

Offering great control and ample storage, the Kangoo
was positioned as the ideal leisure vehicle.

This bold approach paid off, resulting in success not only as a
commercial van, but also as a multi-purpose vehicle (MPV).

Sure, its 1.4-liter engine produced only <75ps>, but French cars
are known for making the most of what they’ve got.

vehicleCollection.en:
This popular leisure activity vehicle began its life as a commercial van.

In France, a long-standing affection for practical "fourgonnette" vehicles—small commercial vans—gave rise to several iconic models over the years. Among them was the Renault Kangoo, introduced in 1997, that left a lasting mark.

Renault designed the Kangoo not merely as a utilitarian workhorse but also gave it the versatility to serve as a multi-purpose vehicle (MPV) for family and leisure use. It introduced sliding rear doors for easier access and individual rear seats that could be adjusted independently.

The Kangoo’s success effectively established the "ludospace" genre, combining van-like practicality with car-like comfort. Overall length was about <4m>, with generous cargo space that made it a favorite among those with outdoor pursuits.

Various powertrains were available to suit different needs, but the example highlighted here is powered by a 1.4-liter gasoline powerplant. Producing a modest <75ps>, this engine aligns with the spirit of classic French automobiles—prioritizing the pleasure of fully utilizing every ounce of available power. Combined with its soft, supple suspension, the Kangoo delivered an unexpectedly fun and engaging driving experience. w

vehicleCollection.en:
The world's first hatchback found great success through utilitarian design."

The compact Renault 4 (also called the "Quatre") made its debut in 1961 to replace the best-selling Renault 4CV. Although the 4CV was a rear-engine/rear-drive model, or RR, the Renault 4 came with a front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout, or FF.

The car's most notable characteristic was its packaging, which became the foundation for the modern hatchback. The FF configuration allowed for a more spacious interior, including a generous luggage compartment behind the back seats.

Also unique were the Quarte's mechanical qualities. One such example was its rear suspension. It utilized two torsion bars, one for each of the rear wheels. These bars were displaced slightly, resulting in a different wheelbase for the left and right side of the vehicle. A torsion bar suspension uses the elastic force of twisting a metal bar in place of a spring, so the Quarte's setup worked almost like an independent rear suspension.

Also, the transmission was located at the very front of the car, in front of the engine. Therefore, gear changes were performed through a long rod that passed over the engine and protruded into the cabin. The driver changed gears by pushing and pulling the rod in and out of the dashboard.

Building upon the reputation for reliability that had been forged by the classic 4CV, the innovative qualities of the Renault 4 proved extremely popular, resulting in a long shelf life; it was produced for 30 years. In 1978, Renault created the ultimate version of this car, called the GTL. It featured a new plastic front grille and a peppy 1.1-liter engine, as well as a more modern instrument panel borrowed from the Renault 5.

The Renault 4 was discontinued in 1992 after a production run of about 8,135,000 units. In terms of individual car models, this record puts the car in the same league as the Volkswagen Beetle and the Ford Model T, making it one of France's greatest contributions to automotive history.

long.zh:
雷诺4（通常因其法文名字而被称为“Quatre”）是一款紧凑型轿车，于1961年首次亮相，用以取代畅销车型雷诺4CV。尽管其前身采用了“后置后驱”布局，即将引擎和驱动车轮都设置在车辆的后部，但雷诺4采用的却是前置引擎前轮驱动配置。这款新车随后取得了巨大的成功，在上市后的许多年里一直都是法国的国民座驾。

这辆车最抢眼的设计元素是它的行李厢，为现代掀背车奠定了基础。雷诺4的前置前驱配置使内部空间更为宽敞，在此基础上，它又配备了一个宽敞且易用的后座后方行李箱空间。

此车的机械结构也相当独特。例如，尽管它采用了扭杆悬挂，用金属杆的弹性力代替弹簧的作用，但它在每个后轮上平行安装了两根不同的扭杆，导致车轮略有位移，更使得车辆左右两侧的轴距不同。

此外，由于传动装置被安装在车辆的前部，位于引擎之前，换挡是由一根长杆来操作的。该杆的一边伸到引擎上方，另一边则突出到驾驶舱内。驾驶员通过将此杆推入或拉出仪表板来换挡。

在经典的4CV积累的可靠性与声誉的基础上，雷诺4完美地融合了新理念和掀背造型，创造出了一个长盛不衰的热销车型，生产了足足30年。该车的终极版本于1978年推出，搭载了新款塑料前格栅和强大的1.1升引擎，以及来自雷诺5的更现代化的仪表板。这个版本被命名为GTL，受到了车迷们的广泛关注。

雷诺4最终于1992年停产，总计生产了约813万5000辆。若按单个汽车型号来计算，这一纪录与大众甲壳虫和福特T型不相上下。毋庸置疑，它确实是法囼在汽车史帊皅杰出贡献之一。

conversation.en:
Renault is a company that loves to compete.

It has been involved in many forms of motorsport,
including Formula 1.

It was also formidable in the rallying world, alongside
cars such as the Gordini and the Alpine from the 70s.

The 1980s, though, the company was all about this R5 Turbo.

One of its early drivers, Jean Ragnotti, mentioned that the
car suffered from terrible handling.

He also confessed that misjudgments on narrow roads would
always cause the rear of the car to hit objects.

This is because the rear of the R5 Turbo was wider than the
front.

It's amusing to hear easoned pros complain about aspects
of a car they don't like.

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
Renault是一家热爱竞技的公司。

他们会参与各项赛车运动，F1自然也在其列。

他们的拉力赛血统包括Gordini，以及1970年代的Alpine。

而到了20世纪80年代，主角就成了R5 Turbo。

作为早期驾驶者之一的让·拉格诺蒂提到过，车辆原本的
操控性非常糟糕。

他还坦言，在狭窄的道路上，车尾常常会因为车手的错
误判断而导致碰撞。

这是因为R5 Turbo的车尾比车头宽。

听到经验丰富的专业人员也会遇到这类问题，真是很有
意思！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Renault R5 ("Cinq") Turbo drew major attention when it was introduced at the 1978 Paris Motor Show. Initially developed as a prototype for the World Rally Championship (WRC), a production version followed in 1980. The transformation was dramatic, its front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout replaced with a mid-engine/rear-wheel-drive one. The new engine delivered 1.5 times the power and more than three times the torque compared to the standard model. Making its debut at the 1980 WRC Tour de Corse, the R5 Turbo dominated the field, establishing Renault as a serious WRC force.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Renault R5 ('Cinq') Turbo在1978年巴黎车展首次亮相时就备受瞩目。这款最初为征战世界拉力锦标赛打造的原型车于1980年推出量产版本。设计上经过了大改，从前置前驱布局改为中置后驱布局。相较普通版Renault 5，新引擎动力输出提升了1.5倍，扭矩增加了3.3倍。1980年世界拉力锦标赛，它自科西嘉站首秀起，横扫多项赛事，为Renault在世界拉力锦标赛历史中留下了浓墨重彩的一笔。
officialDetails.heroEn: The rear-mid-engine layout and ultra-wide rear fenders of this Renault hatchback set the 1980s auto industry on the right track.
officialDetails.heroZh: 在功能车的基础上经过极限改装，成为一辆怪物级的中置引擎前轮驱动紧凑车型。

usedCar.en:
The R5 Turbo was among the hottest rally cars in the 1980s.

While the base R5 came as a front-engine car, Renault
converted the R5 Turbo into a mid-engine machine.

This improved the car's off-road balance, resulting in numerous
rallying championships all over the world.

It's fair to say that the heavy rear could be
a bit jittery at times...

...but its unique driving character makes it more appealing
to many tarmac rally drivers!
usedCar.zh:
R5 Turbo是80年代拉力赛事中的明星。

近年来，参赛队伍把量产车改成
中置引擎布局也不是什么新鲜事……

但在80年代，这一做法还相当新颖。

虽然这车的后端确实比较重，而且
偶尔不太稳……

但是柏油路拉力赛才是它
展现实力的地方！

vehicleCollection.en:
The rear-mid-engine layout and ultra-wide rear fenders of this Renault hatchback set the 1980s auto industry on the right track.

The Renault R5 ("Cinq") Turbo was the talk of the 1978 Paris Motor Show, where it was displayed with its body panels removed. While this first model was only a prototype for entry in the WRC, the vehicle came on the market in 1980.

The R5 Turbo employed the same body shell as the normal Renault 5, but in order to more effectively transfer the turbo-boosted power to the road, the original model's FF layout was scrapped in favor of a mid-engine setup where the entire powertrain, including the engine, transmission, and even the differential, sat on top of the rear axle.

The engine was a small, water-cooled, <1397cc> OHV inline-4, but thanks to its Bosch K-Jetronic fuel injection, Garrett turbocharger, and air-cooled intercooler, maximum power and torque were raised to <162ps> and <22.5kgm> for a truly substantial boost in engine performance, representing a 1.5x increase in power over the basic Renault 5, and a 3.3x increase in torque.

Of course the chassis and body were also strengthened. The front and rear fenders, widened to fit the 5 Turbo's wider tires, gave this car an irresistible visual impact. A big spoiler was also mounted on the top of the rear hatch, as well as a large air dam in front.

As a result of the extensive makeover, this <970kg> car was able to produce some astonishing performance figures. Maximum speed was <200km/h>, with a 0-<400m> (400m) time of 15 seconds and a 0-<1000m> (1000m) time of 28 seconds. Debuting at the 1980 WRC in Corsica, the R5 Turbo took its first victory the following year at Monte Carlo. After that, the R5 Turbo was a ferocious contender at numerous events, forever branding the Renault name into WRC history.

long.zh:
1978年的巴黎车展，雷诺R5 ('Cinq') Turbo以拆除全部车身板件的姿态登场，成为话题焦点。这款车其实是用于参加世界拉力锦标赛比赛的原型车，正式车型上市则等到了1980年。

R5 Turbo的车壳与普通版雷诺5并无区别，但为了让涡轮动力更有效地转化为速度，它放弃了普通版的前置前驱布局，改为中置引擎，把包括引擎、变速箱、甚至差速器在内的整套动力系统放到后轴上。

它的引擎是小型水冷<1397cc>顶置气门直列4缸引擎，但在博世的机械连续燃油喷射系统、盖瑞特公司的涡轮增压器、风冷式中间冷却器的帮助下，它的最大动力和扭矩分别达到<162ps>和<22.5kgm>，极大提高了引擎性能。相当于将普通版雷诺5的动力提高1.5倍，扭矩提高3.3倍。

当然，它的底盘和车身也得到了相应强化。为了配合5 Turbo的加宽轮胎，前翼和尾翼也被加宽，带来难以抗拒的视觉冲击。它的后盖上安装了一块大型扰流板，前方则装有空气阻尼套件。

经过彻底改造，这台仅重970公斤的车性能数据堪称惊人。它的最高速度为<200km/h>，0-<#400m>只需15秒，0-<#1000m>只需28秒。R5 Turbo在1980年世界拉力锦标赛的科西嘉站首次登场，次年在蒙特卡洛站赢得首场胜利。其后，R5 Turbo一直是各大赛事上的冠军有力竞争者，帮助雷诺把品牌名称永远写进了世界拉力锦标赛的历史。

conversation.en:
Following a trend set by the 4CV, the Renault R8 was the
third generation of the marque’s rear-engine saloons.

Yet the addition of four-wheel disc brakes made it
uniquely modern.

The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, quickened by
the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.

Affectionately called the ‘Lunchbox,’ it has blunt lines
and an overall spartan design.

1966 saw the addition of twin headlights.

Dressed in French racing blue, with two white stripes,
the Gordini truly has a charm that’s all its own.
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
Renault R8继承4CV的传统，成为该知名品牌的
第三代后置引擎轿车。

四轮碟刹的加入为该系列增添了一抹独特的现代气息。

R8 Gordini是系列中的一款升级版车型，在伟大的设计师
阿梅德·戈迪尼的神奇手笔下，该车的速度进一步提升。

此车因其简洁的线条和整体简约设计
而被亲切地称为“饭盒”。

1966年，该车增加了双前大灯版本。

Gordini车身喷涂法国赛车蓝，配以两条白色条纹，
有一种浑然天成的魅力。

conversation.en:
The Tour de Corse?

Well, it's a famous rally event that takes place on the
French island of Corsica.

The 1964 Tour de Corse was a particular classic.

Only eight cars out of 79 managed to complete the race!

What's more, Renault's R8 Gordini claimed first, third,
fourth and fifth place!

It was quite the remarkable achievement.

Gordini was an engine manufacturer, originally, established
by the Italian driver and engineer Amedeo Gordini.

The R8 Gordini came about through a collaboration with
Renault.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
科西嘉岛拉力赛？

嗯，这是一项著名的拉力赛事，在法国的科西嘉岛上
举行。

1964年的科西嘉岛拉力赛特别经典。

79辆参赛汽车中只有8辆成功完成了比赛！

而Renault的R8 Gordini就囊括了第一、第三、第四和第五名！

这是相当了不起的成就。

Gordini是一家引擎制造商，由意大利车手和工程师阿
梅戴·戈蒂尼一手创办。

R8 Gordini就是其与Renault合作的产物。
;

嗯，这是一项著名的拉力赛事，在法国的科西嘉岛上
举行。

1964年的科西嘉岛拉力赛特别经典。

79辆参赛汽车中只有8辆成功完成了比赛！

而Renault的R8 Gordini就囊括了第一、第三、第四和第五名！

这是相当了不起的成就。

Gordini是一家引擎制造商，由意大利车手和工程师阿
梅戴·戈蒂尼一手创办。

R8 Gordini就是其与Renault合作的产物。
;

dialogues.en:
Following a trend set by the 4CV, the Renault R8 was the
third generation of the marque’s rear-engine saloons.

Yet the addition of four-wheel disc brakes made it
uniquely modern.

The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, quickened by
the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.

Affectionately called the ‘Lunchbox,’ it has blunt lines
and an overall spartan design.

1966 saw the addition of twin headlights.

Dressed in French racing blue, with two white stripes,
the Gordini truly has a charm that’s all its own.
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.zh:
Renault R8继承4CV的传统，成为该知名品牌的
第三代后置引擎轿车。

四轮碟刹的加入为该系列增添了一抹独特的现代气息。

R8 Gordini是系列中的一款升级版车型，在伟大的设计师
阿梅德·戈迪尼的神奇手笔下，该车的速度进一步提升。

此车因其简洁的线条和整体简约设计
而被亲切地称为“饭盒”。

1966年，该车增加了双前大灯版本。

Gordini车身喷涂法国赛车蓝，配以两条白色条纹，
有一种浑然天成的魅力。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This high-performance version of the Renault 8 was tuned by Amédée Gordini, known as "The Sorcerer" for his remarkable engine tuning. Building on the strengths of the original 1108 cc compact sedan, Gordini transformed the modest Renault 8 into a formidable touring machine, blending precision engineering with motorsport spirit. In 1966, the engine was enlarged to 1300 cc and paired with a 5-speed transmission, further unlocking its performance potential. With its distinctive character and motorsport pedigree, this automotive gem holds a cherished place in the hearts of enthusiasts to this day.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款Renault 8高性能版本由被誉为引擎“魔法师”的阿梅德·戈迪尼亲自调校。巧妙发挥了Renault 8基础车型的设计优势，让看似平凡的1,108 立方厘米紧凑型轿车蜕变为强悍的竞技房车。1966年，引擎排量扩大至1,300 立方厘米，变速箱升级为5速，进一步挖掘出车辆潜能。凭借独特的设计理念，这款汽车杰作至今仍在车迷心中占据特殊地位。
officialDetails.heroEn: A French icon of the '60s, the R8 Gordini is still popular half a century after its birth.
officialDetails.heroZh: 作为1960年代标志性的法国车，自其诞生之后的半个世纪，依旧经久不衰。

collection.en:
Amédée Gordini was a legendary tuner of Renault
and Simca cars...

And may be best known for his achievements at Le Mans.

Gordini was a hard-working Frenchman who went on to become
an F1 race car constructor—basically, a genius.

For many years, Gordini partnered with Renault to produce
performance versions of the company's mass-market cars.

This Renault 8 Gordini is one such example and probably the
most popular of the official collaborations.

The fact that it's near twice as powerful as the base model
just goes to show what a genius tuner Gordini really was.

The classic blue-paint-with-whit-stripes, V-shaped bonnet
and boxy styling still has legions of fans to this day!
collection.zh:
Amédée Gordini是Renault和Simca汽车的传奇调校大师，

因其在勒芒比赛中的成就而广为人知。

这位勤奋的法国人甚至还参与了一级方程式赛车的制造，
换句话说，这一位是真正的天才。

多年来，Gordini一直与Renault合作，生产面向大众市场车型的高
性能版本。

这辆官方合作的Renault 8 Gordini就是个不错的范例，而且可能是
最受欢迎的范例！

这台车的性能相比基础车型几乎翻了一番，足以证明Gordini
确实是一位天才的调校大师。

带有白色条纹的经典蓝色漆面、V形引擎盖和方正的造
型使得此车至今仍坐拥大量的粉丝！

vehicleCollection.en:
A French icon of the '60s, the R8 Gordini is still popular half a century after its birth.

The Renault R8 Gordini was a sports model released in 1964 as a high-performance version of the compact "8" sedan. The legendary Amédée Gordini tuned the car at Renault’s special request.

The base 8 was full of advanced technology, such as a newly developed five-main engine and class-first disc brakes on all wheels. Gordini took maximum advantage of these tech innovations. The <1108cc> engine, already offering superior revving and endurance characteristics, was an excellent foundation for "The Sorcerer" to build upon. The addition of a cross-flow head with sub-combustion chambers and dual twin-choke carburetors increased engine output to <95ps> without any increase in displacement.

In 1966, the R8 Gordini 1300 was announced, with an actual displacement of <1255cc>. This car pumped out <103ps> and its innovative 5-speed gearbox helped boost top speed by <5km/h> to <175km/h>. The R8 Gordini dominated the Tour de Corse and many other races for three years in a row starting in 1964. From 1966, the world's first single-make series, the "Gordini Cup," became the training ground for French racers and produced many top professional drivers, making this car an icon of the 1960s French motorsports scene. The car is still popular with enthusiasts and collectors who love the distinctive "lunch pail" styling of the R8 Gordini.

long.zh:
雷诺的R8 Gordini是1964年作为紧凑型轿车“8”系的高性能运动版本推出的。应雷诺之邀，阿梅代·戈迪尼对车辆进行了调校。

作为改装原型的8系车型本身就搭载了各种先进技术，例如全新开发的拥有5根主轴承的引擎和首次应用于该级别的四轮碟刹。

这些技术也在戈迪尼手中得到了充分发挥。这台<1108cc>的引擎拥有优秀的转速和耐久性，正是“魔法师”戈迪尼所期待的施法素材。利用横流气缸盖、副燃烧腔室和一对双腔式化油器，戈迪尼在不提高排量的前提下，让动力输出几乎翻倍，达到了<95ps>。

到了1966年，R8 Gordini 1300面世，这次的排量增加到了<1255cc>，可以输出<103ps>，搭载有5速变速箱，将最高速度上限又推进了<5km/h>，来到了<175km/h>。

自1964年起，R8 Gordini连续3年称霸科西嘉岛拉力赛，在其他各项赛事当中也屡有斩获。1966年举办的全球首个单一车种赛“Gordini杯”更是成为了法国车的训练场，培养出了无数职业车手。也因此，这台R8成为了60年代末法国赛车界的标志及缩影。

其规规整整的午餐包造型至今仍为世界各地的爱好者们津津乐道。发售近半个世纪后，依然是现今收藏家们的热门之选。

brandCentral.en:
The name Renault Sport may not be familiar here in the States,
but in Europe, it's one of the most well-known sporty brands.

It's the name of the motorsports division of the company, which
has participated in everything from Formula 1 to Le Mans.

The fourth-generation Clio is a great example of
the types of cars it produces.

Providing the power for this compact is a turbocharged
1.6-liter inline-4 that produced <220ps>.

The "Trophy" version was created as a special model
specifically for race-track use.

To see how fast the car was, the folks at Renault Sport
took it to the Nürburgring.

And guess what? The thing ended up setting a new lap record
for compact hatchbacks!
brandCentral.zh:
Renault Sport在全球范围内都享有极高的知名度。

这都要归功于F1和勒芒24小时耐力赛等重大赛事的胜利，
为Renault的赛车部门积攒下了赫赫声名。

第四代Clio正是他们的杰作之一。

经过Renault Sport的专门调校，这台1.6L涡轮增压直列四缸引擎可
以产生高达<220ps>的动力。

此外，“Trophy”特别车型还针对赛道进行了专项性能调校。

Renault的高性能掀背车是纽博格林赛道圈速纪录上的常客。

事实上，Clio甫一亮相，就创下了紧凑型掀背车类别中的
新纪录——表现出了巨大的潜力。

vehicleCollection.en:
This super fast Clio set the compact hatch lap record at the Nürburgring.

The Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy is the sports version of the 4th generation Clio developed by Renault Sport, the motorsports department of Renault. It was introduced at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show as an even higher performance model than the R.S. 200 EDC. The name “Trophy” is a special name given to extraordinary sports models that are suited for track.

There are 2 major differences between the R.S. 220 EDC and the older R.S. 200 EDC. The car was given a different turbocharger, the intake and exhaust were tuned, and the ECU map was changed in order to increase the output of the 1.6 liter inline 4 turbo by 10% to 217 HP (220ps); as is indicated in the digits of the car’s name. The rev limit is also higher, raised from <6500rpm> to <6800rpm>. The maximum torque output is <191.7 ft-lb>, a <14.5 ft-lb> increase from the R.S. 200. The gearbox EDC has also received changes to the software, shortening the shifting speed by 50%. Even the stroke of the shift change paddles were made smaller by 30%.

The other major change was the implementation of a “Chassis Trophy,” giving the car a chassis that has the best sports setup in the series. The dampers and springs of the suspension were reinforced, a hydraulic bump stop was added, and the ride height is <0.8 in> lower in the front and <0.4 in> lower in the rear. The steering gear ratio was made quicker from 14.5 to 13.2.

The R.S. 220 EDC Trophy was taken on the Nürburgring Nordschleife by a German car magazine, and marked an incredible 8 minutes 23 seconds on the track. This was the fastest time ever for a car in the compact hatchback category at the time.#

long.zh:
Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy是雷诺的赛车部门雷诺运动所开发的第4代Clio的跑车版本。这辆车在2015年的日内瓦车展上作为R.S. 200 EDC的高性能版本发布。其名字中的“Trophy”仅供专为赛道打造的最杰出跑车型号使用。

R.S. 220 EDC的新老款车型之间有两大改变。首先，这辆车采用了全新的涡轮增压装置，进气和排气系统也经过了调校，电子控制单元的程序经过了更改，将其1.6升直4涡轮增压引擎的输出功率提升了10%，达到了<220ps>；车名中的220便是由此而来。转速上限也同样得到了提高，从<6500rpm>提高到了<6800rpm>。而最大扭矩输出变成了<26.5kgm>，比R.S. 200提高了<2.0kgm>。变速箱的EDC也同样进行了软件调整，让换挡时间缩短了50%。就连换挡拨片的行程也缩短了30%。

另外一项重要改变就是应用了“纪念版底盘”，这种底盘在全系列里拥有最佳的跑车设置。减震器和悬挂的弹簧进行了强化，还加入了液压制动泵，底盘前部高度降低了<20mm>，而后部降低了<10mm>。转向齿轮传动比也经过了调整，从14.5改到了13.2。

这辆Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy接受了一家德国汽车杂志的测试，在纽博格林北侧赛道上创下了8分23秒的佳绩，成为当时紧凑型高性能掀背车的最快圈速。

足以在视觉上将h分改造成R款\道小钢炮！

vehicleCollection.en:
This Clio sports model, tuned by Renault Sport, excelled on the race track. n

The Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy is the high-performance version of the fourth-generation Clio developed by Renault Sport, the motorsports arm of the French car company. Introduced at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show, the Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy is even meaner than the R.S. 200 EDC, as the name "Trophy" graces only those special cars that can excel on a racetrack.

While the R.S. 220 EDC and the older R.S. 200 model may seem similar, there are two major things that separate the two. One is that the newer car has a more refined powerplant, thanks to a new turbocharger, re-tuned intake and exhaust systems, and a revised ECU map. These changes result in a 10 percent output bump for the 1.6-liter inline-4 to <220ps>. Torque has also increased by <2.0kgm> to <26.5kgm> and the redline of the engine has been raised from <6500rpm> to <6800rpm>. What's more, shift speed has increased by 50 percent, and the shift paddles are now 30 percent smaller.

The other major change was the implementation of the “Chassis Trophy,” highlighted by reinforced dampers and springs, the addition of a hydraulic bump stop, a quicker steering ratio (from 14.5 to 13.2) and a lower ride height (<20mm> lower in the front and <10mm> lower at the rear).

The R.S. 220 EDC Trophy lapped the Nürburgring Nordschleife in an incredible 8 minutes 23 seconds, which set a new record for compact hatchbacks at that time.

long.zh:
Clio R.S. 220 EDC Trophy是第四代Clio的运动版本，由雷诺的赛车部门雷诺运动研发。它于2015年的日内瓦车展上亮相，是R.S. 200 EDC的性能提升版本。“Trophy”则是为赛道设计的特别运动版车辆的专属名称。

R.S. 220 EDC和此前的R.S. 200 EDC之间有两个重要的区别：采用了不同的涡轮增压器，进气道和排气都经过调节，电子控制单元分配也接受改动，将1.6升直列4缸涡轮增压引擎的动力提升了10%，达到了<220ps>，这也是名称中数字的由来。转速极限也从<6500rpm>提高到了<6800rpm>。最大扭矩为<26.5kgm>，比RS200提高了<2.0kgm>。变速箱的软件也进行了更改，将换挡速度提高了50%。就连排挡拨片的行程也缩短了30%。

另一个重要的变动是竞赛级车身的加入，赋予了该车在同系列中最优秀的运动配置。避震器和悬挂的弹簧得到了强化，添加了液压减震杆，前车身高度降低了<20mm>，后车身则降低了<10mm>。方向盘齿轮比也从14.5减少到了13.2。

一家德国汽车杂志将R.S. 220 EDC Trophy带到了纽博格林北侧赛道，完成了8分23秒的惊人成绩。这是当时紧凑掀背车级别中的最快圈速。

conversation.en:
Imagine transforming a little French city car
into a mid-engine racer!

Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's
direct descendant.

Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through
widened flanks and central dual exhausts.

Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced
with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.

This is most evident in the way the side edge line
"rolls" around the rear wheel...

...and in the use of a geometric design
for the front and rear grilles.
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
你能想象将一辆小型法式城市用车改造成
一辆中置引擎赛车是什么样子吗？

这辆R5 Turbo的后继车型就承载了这样叛逆不羁的精神。

它的运动形态通过加宽的侧面裙边
和居中的双排气管得到了动态的展现。

有趣的是，这些激进的设计元素却通过90年代经典Renault风格
的中和，取得了完美的平衡。

后轮的“管装”风道线条……

和前后格栅采用的几何分割设计就是最显而易见的证明！

vehicleCollection.en:
Built by Tom Walkinshaw Racing, this sporty Lutecia featured a mid-mounted 3.0-liter V6.

Renault wanted to build the ultimate hot hatch from the second-gen Clio, and to do so, the company wanted to install a V6 into the compact car. There wasn't enough room to accommodate such a large powerplant under the hood, so the rear seats were removed, and in its place sat a 3.0-liter V6 mounted amidships.

This car was marketed in Japan as the Lutecia Sport V6. This powerplant is the same one found in the company's upscale model, the Laguna. It produces <233ps>/<6000rpm> and an impressive <30.6kgm> of torque at <3750rpm>. Shifting is performed via a 6-speed manual gearbox. The big power made the Clio R.S. V6 the prototypical “point and squirt” car because it possessed both excellent acceleration, especially at the low end of the rpm spectrum, and remarkable nimbleness.

The suspension system consisted of specially designed struts, and when combined with the grip provided by its wide tires—205/50R17 up front and 235/45R17 at rear, the little Renault stuck to the road surface through corners. That the Lutecia performed as well as it did was amazing given that Renault transformed an FF (Front engine/Front drive) car into an MR (Mid-engine/Rear drive).

A slightly redesigned Clio R.S. V6 appeared at the Paris Motor Show in October 2002, featuring larger 18-in. wheels. Power for the engine was bumped up to <255ps>/<7150rpm> and <30.6kgm> of torque at <4650rpm>. The suspension geometry was also revised, and, when combined with an additional subframe at the rear, the car handled better than the original.

long.zh:
Clio R.S. V6（在日本命名为Lutecia R.S. V6）是一辆中置引擎跑车，它基于雷诺Clio改装，拆除了后座，并换上了一台原本用于高配车型如Laguna上的3升V6引擎。

这款车专为赛车运动打造，在F1进入欧洲前，它被用于单一车种比赛。我们看到的这一款是公路版本。据说它是在1980年代早期在世界拉力锦标赛比赛中打响名号的R5 Turbo的复刻车型。

其3升V6引擎能在<6000rpm>时输出<233ps>，最大扭矩为<3750rpm>下的<30.6kgm>。变速箱只有6速手动可选。

其悬挂系统前后都采用了专门设计的支撑臂，轮胎则分为前轮205/50R17，后轮235/45R17。为了配合宽轮胎，车身前后均安装了外扩挡泥板，但造型方面并没有R5 Turbo那样狂野，而是与车身构成了优美的线条。

在2002年10月举办的巴黎车展中，Clio R.S. V6的相位2小改款初次亮相。外观只有少量改动，但和标准款Clio一样，采用全新一代的雷诺家族设计。与此同时，其内饰也得到了全面升级，而且把轮胎尺寸加大到了18英寸。

虽然引擎排量没有变化，但最大输出动力增加到了<7150rpm>时的<255ps>。输出最大扭矩所需的转速也提高到了<4650rpm>。悬挂结构经过了改进，车身后部额外增加了一具副车架，使整体驾驶性能得到了提升。

由TWR开发的极致小钢炮，搭载3升中置引擎。

Clio R.S. V6（在日本命名为Lutecia R.S. V6）是一辆中置引擎跑车，它基于雷诺Clio改装，拆除了后座，并换上了一台原本用于高配车型如Laguna上的3升V6引擎。

这款车专为赛车运动打造，在F1进入欧洲前，它被用于单一车种比赛。我们看到的这一款是公路版本。据说它是在1980年代早期在世界拉力锦标赛比赛中打响名号的R5 Turbo的复刻车型。

其3升V6引擎能在<6000rpm>时输出<233ps>，最大扭矩为<3750rpm>下的<30.6kgm>。变速箱只有6速手动可选。

其悬挂系统前后都采用了专门设计的支撑臂，轮胎则分为前轮205/50R17，后轮235/45R17。为了配合宽轮胎，车身前后均安装了外扩挡泥板，但造型方面并没有R5 Turbo那样狂野，而是与车身构成了优美的线条。

在2002年10月举办的巴黎车展中，Clio R.S. V6的相位2小改款初次亮相。外观只有少量改动，但和标准款Clio一样，采用全新一代的雷诺家族设计。与此同时，其内饰也得到了全面升级，而且把轮胎尺寸加大到了18英寸。

虽然引擎排量没有变化，但最大输出动力增加到了<7150rpm>时的<255ps>。输出最大扭矩所需的转速也提高到了<4650rpm>。悬挂结构经过了改进，车身后部额外增加了一具副车架，使整体驾驶性能得到了提升。

vehicleCollection.en:
This limited-edition Renault set a lap record at the Nürburgring.

The 3-door model of the third-generation Mégane that was introduced in 2008 was on a totally different level from its 5-door hatchback stablemate.

The high-performance version of this 3-door coupe, tuned by Renault Sport Technologies, is the Mégane Renault Sport. It was first shown at the 2009 Geneva Auto Show, and reached the public in 2010.

Mounted in a body that wore special aerodynamic parts was a dedicated 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 with a twin-scroll turbocharger, producing <250ps> and <34.7kgm> torque. The engine was mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox.

The most notable component of this car was the chassis. Renault Sport, which develops cars for one-make and rally racing, created two different types of chassis for this car. One was tuned for road use, while the other was a “Chassis Cup” spec that also took into account on-track racing. Both utilize a double-axle strut system that allows load to remain at the centers of the front tires regardless of the up/down movement of the suspension. Because of this, the car’s cornering speed was said to be the quickest ever for a front-wheel drive.

In 2011, Renault introduced a 500-car limited edition model called the Mégane Renault Sport Trophy, featuring an increased power output of <265ps> as well as 19-inch wheels. This car was taken to the Nürburgring for a time trial, and set a front-engine/front-wheel-drive record of 8 minutes, 7.97 seconds!

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
2008年首次亮相的第三代3门版梅甘娜是一款有着赛车设计的跑车，和5门的掀背车完全不可同日而语。

而这辆三门跑车的高性能版本——梅甘娜R.S.，由雷诺运动技术进行调校，首次亮相是在2009年的日内瓦车展上，并于2010年开始交付。

这辆车搭载一部专用的2升双顶置凸轮轴直4双涡流涡轮增压引擎，可以输出<250ps>和<34.7kgm>的扭矩，并配有特别设计的空气动力学部件。传动方面，则采用了一款6档手动变速箱。

这辆车最吸引人的部分就是底盘。雷诺运动作为雷诺专门开发单一车种赛和拉力赛用车的部门，为这款车配置了两套不同类型的底盘。其中一种是针对公路进行调校的底盘，而另外一种“杯型底盘”则加入了赛道驾驶环境的考量。二者都使用了双轴支撑，这样一来，无论悬挂如何上下运动，都可以让载荷始终施加于前轮的中央。据称这款车的弯道速度是所有前轮驱动车里最快的。

在2011年，雷诺还推出了一款500辆的限量版本，称作梅甘娜R.S Trophy，其引擎功率提升到了<265ps>，还换用了19英寸轮毂。这款车于同一年在纽博格林赛道上进行了一场计时赛，并创下了前置引擎、前轮驱动车的记录——8分7.97秒。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

conversation.en:
This is a car I had a hand in styling when I was
with Renault Design!

When I designed the Mégane III series with my team...

We decided to make an RS variant right from the start.

The original design was already very compact...

And extreme for a 3-door hatchback, with its sloping rear window
and dynamic rear pillar.

Obviously the modified bumpers...

And the large rear central exhaust contribute to making it
appear even more aggressive.

But the most successful detail is...

Undoubtedly the F1-inspired suspended wing in the front
grille, which integrates the daytime running lights.
g
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:
这辆车的造型还是我在Renault Design工作时经手设计的！

当我和我的团队一起设计Mégane III系列时……

从一开始就决定追加设计一个RS版本。

这是一辆紧凑到极致的三门小钢炮，有着大坡度后窗
和动态十足的C柱，

以及显著改造过的后保险杠……

还有汇集到尾部正中的大号排气管，让它更显侵略性。

但最成功的细节……

无疑是前格栅里受F1赛车启发的悬浮翼片，
我们将它直接与日间行车灯整合到了一起。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Based on the third-generation Mégane 3-door coupe, the Mégane R.S. was factory-tuned by Renault Sport for high performance. With bespoke ground effects and a newly developed chassis, it delivered exceptional cornering capability—earning its reputation as one of the fastest front-wheel-drive cars of its time. In 2011, the Mégane R.S. Trophy was introduced. With just 500 units produced worldwide, it made headlines by setting a new Nürburgring lap record for mass-produced front-wheel-drive cars, clocking in at 8 minutes and 7.97 seconds.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这辆Mégane R.S.基于第三代Mégane三门轿跑打造，并由Renault Sport进行了精心的原厂调校。这辆车采用了全新开发的底盘，足以实现独特而优秀的地面效应，能够以相对较高的速度通过弯道，让它轻松摘得了速度最快的前轮驱动车的桂冠。Mégane R.S. Trophy于2011年正式上市，全球仅限量生产500辆。之后它在纽博格林赛道上跑出了8分7.97秒的圈速，创下了量产前轮驱动车的新纪录。

brandCentral.en:
The R.S. Trophy is a high-performance model that is
based on the third generation Mégane.

Featuring a specially tuned 2L straight-four engine...

It offers plenty of torque in the mid-RPM range, and an
exciting sense of power once you hit the higher revs.

The R.S.'s main USP, however, is its suspension, which is
designed to improve the grounding of the front tyres...

Meaning the car responds well when entering corners,
without sacrificing any capacity for exiting them.

In short, it lets you keep the pedal to the metal
for longer!
brandCentral.zh:
R.S. Trophy是一款基于第三代梅甘娜研发的高性能车型，

配备了经过特别调校的2升直列四缸引擎……

此车在中段转速范围内可提供充沛的扭矩，而进入高转
速区后，令人兴奋的动力感则会源源不断。

然而，R.S.系列的最大优点在于其悬挂，在设计时着重改
善了前轮胎的抓地性……

因此该车不仅在进入弯道时反应良好，而且不必牺牲任
何出弯的能力。

简而言之，可以让您有更多的时间踩住油门！

这辆车最吸引人的部分就是底盘。雷诺运动作为雷诺专门开发单一车种赛和拉力赛用车的部门，为这款车配置了两套不同类型的底盘。其中一种是针对公路进行调校的底盘，而另外一种“经典杯”则加入了赛道驾驶环境的考量。二者都使用了双轴支撑，这样一来，无论悬挂如何上下运动，都可以让载荷始终施加于前轮的中央。据称这款车的弯道速度是所有前轮驱动车里最快的。

在2011年，雷诺还推出了一款500辆的限量版本，称作梅甘娜R.S. Trophy[梅甘娜 R.S 纪念版]，其引擎功率提升到了<265ps>，还换用了19英寸轮毂。这款车于同一年在纽博格林赛道上进行了一场计时赛，并创下了前置引擎、前轮驱动车的记录——8分7.97秒。/

vehicleCollection.en:
This safety car version of the Mégane RS Trophy was created to patrol the race track.

Unveiled at the Geneva Motor Show in the spring of 2009, the Mégane RS was a high-performance model, tuned by Renault Sport Technologies, based on the third-gen 3-door Renault Mégane that was introduced in 2008.

The car's aerodynamics were significantly improved from the previous model, thanks to new body panels all over. Under the hood resided a specially-tuned 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 fitted with a twin-scroll turbocharger that produced <250ps>/<34.7kgm>. This engine came mated to a 6-speed manual transmission.

One of the most notable features of this car was that it was available with two different chassis options. The "Sport Chassis" was tuned for road use, while the "Cup Chassis" was meant to be enjoyed on the track. Both models came equipped with a double-axis strut suspension that placed load on the center of the front tires regardless of vertical suspension movement.

In 2011, the Mégane RS Trophy, a limited-edition version with <265ps>, was offered. Only 500 units were produced, and the car went on to set a record for front-wheel-drive production cars at the Nürburgring with a lap time of 8:07:79.

*This safety car version is an original model created by Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
2009年春天在日内瓦车展揭开面纱的梅甘娜RS是接受了雷诺运动调校的高性能车型。其开发原型是2008年才推出的第三代3门版雷诺梅甘娜。

车身上的改进相当多：独有的空力套件，加装了双涡流涡轮的2升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎接受过特殊调校，可输出<250ps>和<34.7kgm>扭矩，与动力单元搭配的还有一台6速手动变速箱。

这台车型最引人注目的特点在于提供了两套完全不同的底盘。“运动底盘”针对道路驾驶调校，而“杯赛底盘”专为赛道而生。两种底盘同样采用双悬臂悬挂系统，无论悬挂的竖向行程长短，都能将重心集中在两只前胎的中央位置，主要差异之一在于对阻尼率的设定。得益于这套底盘系统的引入，梅甘娜RS实现了前驱车中最快的过弯速度。

2011年，动力提升至<265ps>的梅甘娜R.S Trophy上市，全球限量500台。也是在同一年，这款车型以8:07:79的成绩刷新了前驱量产车在纽博格林赛道上的圈速纪录。

*这款安全车是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。

conversation.en:
In touring car races and rallies...

Renault has long been represented by the compact R5
and its successor, the Clio.

Ah, the WRC Gr.B R5 Turbo and the F2-class Clio Williams!
Those were some great cars!

But what about the somewhat larger Mégane?
Well...

They certainly pulled out all the stops for
this Mégane Trophy!

Despite the outward resemblance to its road-going
variant...

It is in fact a one-make racer, powered by
a midship 3.8L V6 courtesy of Nissan!

It was originally built to compete in the popular Renault
Sport Series, which takes place in Europe.
g
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
在房车赛和拉力赛方面……

一直以来代表雷诺出战的都是紧凑型的R5及其继任者Clio。

像是世界拉力锦标赛组别B R5 Turbo和F2级别的Clio Williams！

再往上一个级别，就轮到梅甘娜了？

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Renault Sport Mégane Trophy was developed specifically for the Mégane Trophy race series, which began in 2005. While retaining the overall silhouette of the production Mégane, the Trophy version featured far more aggressive styling and a mid-mounted 355 HP 3.5-liter V-6 in a lightweight 2194 lbs package. A 6-speed two-pedal manual transmission with paddle shifters delivered quick, precise gear changes. The suspension and brakes were full racing spec.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这辆Renault Sport Mégane Trophy是专为参加自2005年起创办的Mégane Trophy比赛所打造。在保留Mégane的整体风格之余，这辆Trophy版本加入了更富有进攻性的外观元素，并在其仅重995 公斤的车身内配备了一台调校至360 PS动力输出的3.5升V6引擎。它的传动系统采用了一套配有换挡拨片的6速双踏板手动变速箱。而悬挂和刹车也统统升级成完整的赛车规格。

vehicleCollection.en:
Aggressive looks topped off by gullwing doors highlight this Mégane Trophy.

This special edition to commemorate the 15th anniversary of Gran Turismo is based on the third-generation Renault Mégane. The concept car was unveiled at the Geneva show in the spring of 2008, and the official debut was at the Paris Motor Show in the autumn. Completely different from the second-generation model, and renewed with a stylish, sporty form, it was well received by enthusiasts from all over Europe. This latest generation of the one-make race machine was dubbed the Mégane Trophy V6.

As with all one-make Mégane race cars since the first generation, Renault Sport was in charge of machine development. The third-generation car adopted the same method as that of the second-generation machine, building it into the style of a DTM machine with significantly enlarged fenders that functioned as radical aerodynamic devices front and rear. The few parts shared with the production car include lamps, door mirrors and the emblem on the front. The designers performed a remarkable job retaining the general look of the base car, making it unmistakable as a Mégane from any angle.

The powerplant, mounted low in a vehicle weighing just <955kg>, is paired with a Renault Sport-tuned 3.5-liter Nissan V6 that delivers <360ps>/<39.8kgm> through a 6-speed, manual gearbox. Suspension is the classic coil and damper formula, the body is made of FRP, not carbon, in order to reduce the cost for racers – the only people who get to purchase this iconic machine.

long.zh:
雷诺自1960年代的8 Gordini起就以各种形式参与单一车种赛事。2005年，他们开始自行主办梅甘娜欧洲杯赛事，这也是雷诺世界系列赛的一部分。这款车型是为了参加2006年起的梅甘娜欧洲杯而开发的，梅甘娜也随之迈入了第三代。

该车的引擎中置于管式框架内，特殊车身外壳则采用梅甘娜专属设计。只有少数几个部件，如头灯和尾灯与量产型通用。由超宽的前车身和后尾翼等空气动力学组件塑造的造型，和足以让DTM赛车望而却步的庞大扩散器呈现出强烈的侵略感。就连车门也改为了鸥翼式，带来额外的感官刺激。

即便如此，原版梅甘娜的外廓和独特细节依然得到了全盘保留，使得整车外观与第三代梅甘娜轿跑非常相似。安装在仅重<955kg>的车身内的动力单元是一台调校到<360ps>的3.5升日产V6引擎，传动系统是6速双踏板手动变速箱，具备手自一体换挡功能。

悬挂与刹车均采用赛车标准配置，而且该车型只向参加赛事的车手提供。但你应该也猜得到，众多爱好者们已经向雷诺提出了推出风格类似的公路版车型的诉求。

The R.S. 01 was a true mid-engine competition car
belonging to the GT category.

Designed for the track, it sat low, wide, and it was functional.

Thanks to its dynamic and muscular form, it was also
extremely aggressive.

The huge carbon rear wing always impressed, along with
the front spoiler and the rear diffuser.

That said, Renault desired to maintain a "family feeling"
in the front and rear...

of the production Mégane.

conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.zh:

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In the summer of 2014, Renault Sport unveiled the R.S.01 as its new contender for one-make racing, succeeding the Mégane Trophy. Measuring 164.2 inches in length and 78.7 inches in width, the R.S.01 boasted a lightweight body at just 2425 lbs. Beneath its sculpted exterior was a potent twin-turbo V-6 engine producing 542.4 HP. Every detail of the car—from its advanced aerodynamics to its efficient cooling systems—reflects Renault Sport’s deep expertise, making it an impressive race machine in every sense.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 在2014年夏天，Renault Sport推出了这款全新赛车R.S.01，代替Mégane Trophy参加单一车种比赛。虽然它的车身长4,170毫米，宽2,000毫米，车重却仅有1,100 公斤。这套轻量级框架由一部能输出550 PS的V6双涡轮增压引擎供能。这辆车能够满足人们对赛车的一切要求，Renault Sport也将他们丰富的汽车工程知识统统运用在了空气动力学和散热部件的设计上。

vehicleCollection.en:
A French race car with a Japanese heart.

Renault Sport has been transforming Renault cars into exclusive high-performance machines for many years. The division created the R.S.01 in the summer of 2014 to participate in a one-make race series, especially for its fan base of hardcore enthusiasts.

The R.S.01 illustrates the deep working partnership between Renault and Nissan. Its carbon monocoque chassis was co-developed by Renault and Dallara, while the exterior styling was executed by a Nissan designer. The car measures <4710mm> from bumper to bumper and sits <2000mm> wide. It tips the scales at a lean <1100kg>, making it quick and agile. Nissan was also responsible for providing the power unit, a Nismo-tuned VR38DETT from the Nissan GT-R. The twin-turbocharged V-6 produced <550ps> in the R.S.01.

Renault Sport also produced another version of this race car called the R.S.01 GT3. As the name suggests, it met FIA's GT3 homologation rules. Because of this, the GT3 version wasn't as hardcore as its stablemate, with steel disc brakes rather than carbon and less engine power. However, because the GT3 category has become the most popular category in sports car racing, it presents an ideal opportunity for the R.S.01 to showcase its amazing potential for all the world to see.

雷诺运动多年来一直在为雷诺车型打造高性能版本。这家在法国赛车行业首屈一指的车厂在2014年夏天公布了他们的单一车种赛比赛用车R.S.01。

这部血统纯正的赛车展现了雷诺和日产的深度合作成果。碳纤维单体车壳底盘由雷诺和达拉拉合作开发，外观设计则由日本设计师负责，而引擎是一部来自日产GT-R、经过Nismo调校的VR38DETT。

车身长<4710mm>，宽<2000mm>，重量仅为<1100kg>。其轻量化的底盘由一具<550ps> V6双涡轮引擎驱动。雷诺运动的专业技能应用到了该车的空气动力学设计和冷却上，因此这辆赛车的实力毋庸置疑。

雷诺运动同时还另外制造了其衍生版本——R.S.01 GT3。这辆车经过改造，符合国际汽联GT3规范，同时又保留了原本R.S.01的精髓。经过改造之后，这辆车的性能甚至还略有下降。碳纤维刹车碟被换成了钢制刹车碟，引擎功率也受到了限制。不过，GT3是赛车运动领域最受欢迎的组别。如果R.S.01可以更频繁地在赛道上露面，那么这些改造就是非常值得的。

vehicleCollection.en:
Renault's special GT3 machine with Nismo power.

Created for a special one-make race series introduced in 2015 called the “World Series by Renault”—the successor to the Mégane Trophy—the Renault Sport R.S.01 was a limited-edition competition machine that defined the term “pocket rocket,” thanks in part to a power unit straight from the Nissan GT-R. itself.

Utilizing a carbon monocoque developed together with Italian race car constructor Dallara, the Sport R.S.01 was extremely lightweight, tipping the scales at a lean <1100kg>. Power was supplied by Nissan’s twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter V-6 found in the Nissan GT-R, which was further tuned by NISMO. The engine, mounted amidships, produced more than <500ps> and <61.2kgm> of torque. It came mated to an SADEV 7-speed sequential gearbox that helped the car reach a maximum speed of more than <300km/h>.

In November 2015, Renault introduced a GT3 version of this car at the Paul Ricard Circuit in France, developed for the FIA-GT Championships. The R.S.01 GT3 had to be tamed considerably to meet GT3 regulations, so a restrictor was added to the engine to decrease power. Also, the brakes were changed from carbon ceramic to steel discs. To meet the minimum weight specified by the FIA, more than <50kg> of ballast was added to the chassis, and the aerodynamics were also revised. All the changes just confirmed how potent the original was.[

long.zh:
雷诺运动 R.S.01是一部特殊的单一车种赛比赛用车，专为参加由雷诺运动主办的雷诺世界系列赛而少量生产。这辆车在2015赛季首次亮相，成为了梅甘娜Trophy的后继车型。

其车身使用了与意大利赛车生产商达拉拉共同开发的碳纤维单体车壳，全车重量控制在了<1100kg>以下。中置引擎采用日产GT-R的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎，并由日产的赛车运动部门Nismo调校。这辆车的输出功率超过<500ps>，最大扭矩超过<61.2kgm>，再搭配SADEV 7档序列式变速箱，其最大时速可以超过<300km/h>。

基于这辆R.S.01，雷诺运动还为参加国际汽联的GT锦标赛开发了R.S.01 GT3，并于2015年11月在法国保罗里卡德赛道上首次公布。为了符合国际汽联的GT3规范，R.S.01 GT3的性能有所下调。V6双涡轮增压引擎被加上了限速器，降低了功率，而刹车也从碳化陶瓷刹车碟改成了钢制刹车碟。为了满足国际汽联的最低重量要求，这辆车不得不增加超过<50kg>的配重，空气动力学外观也重新进行了设计。不过，由于这辆车原本以超高性能赛车为标准设计，所以在遭遇规范限制时也有很大的下调余地。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Twingo became known for its 3-door monospace design, with a near-continuous curve flowing from the truncated hood, over the roof and into the rear. The wheels were positioned at the extreme corners of the body, allowing for an unusually spacious interior despite its compact form. At launch, the engine delivered modest output, but paired with the lightweight body, it provided a lively and engaging drive in urban settings. It was also praised for bringing character to a practical vehicle, with sliding rear seats that enabled a variety of seating/cargo configurations.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Twingo以其三门单厢式车身而闻名，其轮廓线条从短促的引擎盖开始，经车顶延伸至车尾，几乎一气呵成，流畅自然。四个车轮被极限排布在车身的四角，使其在紧凑车身尺寸下，仍然保证了超乎寻常的内部空间。虽然Twingo在问世之初所搭载的引擎，动力只是仅仅够用，但搭配轻量化的车身，足以让它轻快灵动地在都市中穿行。此外它还配备了可滑动的后排座椅，可以实现多种空间布局，这种在实用车型中添加独特功能的设计受到了好评。
officialDetails.heroEn: Practical yet cute. A breath of fresh air for the A-segment.
officialDetails.heroZh: 实用又可爱。为A级车市场注入清新活力。

usedCar.en:
Hi there. Looking for a small car with a big personality? Then
I’ve got the find for you—a first-generation Renault Twingo.

Take a look at its round headlights. Aren’t they adorable? In 1992,
this quirky monobox design took the world by storm.

Get in, and you’ll immediately see the magic of its design. At just
<3.4m> in length, it can comfortably seat four adults.

What’s more, the rear seats slide backward and forward,
meaning boot space can be extended for longer drives.

he interior uses a lot of plastic, but avoids feeling cheap
through a colorful aesthetic that matches its exterior.

This ’93 model runs on a 1.2-liter 4-cylinder OHV engine.
It may only have <55ps>, but it’s pure joy to redline.

With a 14-yearproduction run, the first-generation Twingo proves
that Renault is a true ster of the sml-cargenre.
usedCar.zh:
你好！想找一辆个性十足的小车？那我这里为你
准备了一个绝佳的选择——一辆初代雷诺Twingo！

瞧瞧这圆圆的大灯，可爱吧？
1992年，这款造型小巧的单厢车一经推出便风靡全球。

车身长度仅<3.4m>，却能轻松容纳四名成年人。

更妙的是，它的后排座椅可以前后滑动，
这样一来，在长途旅行时，还能方便灵活地扩展行空间。

内饰虽然采用了不少的塑料材质，但通过
和外观协调呼应的色彩美学设计，有效地避免了廉价感。

这里这辆93款搭载了一台1.2升的4缸顶置阀门引擎。
马力虽仅有<55ps>，但将它推x转速红线的过程却充满乐趣。

初代Twingo历经了长达14RP的生产周u
_以证明雷诺对小车类市场的把握堪称大师水准。

vehicleCollection.en:
Practical yet cute. A breath of fresh air for the A-segment.

In 1990, Renault transitioned from the Super 5 to the Clio. The Clio’s increased size, however, left space in the lineup for a smaller model. The car developed to fill that role was the Twingo, an A-segment hatchback.

The Twingo became known for its 3-door monospace design, with a nearly continuous curve flowing from the truncated hood, over the roof and into the rear. This distinctive shape set it apart from contemporary rivals and made a strong impression at its 1992 debut. Its wheels were positioned at the extreme corners of the body, maximizing interior space despite compact dimensions of <3433mm> in length and <1423mm> in height.

At launch, the Twingo was equipped with a transversely mounted 1.2-liter inline-4 OHV engine. While modest in output, it complemented the lightweight body and delivered a lively, city-friendly driving experience. The car was also praised for bringing character to a practical design, with sliding rear seats that allowed for multiple seating and cargo configurations.

Over time, the first-generation Twingo received a series of mechanical and visual updates, remaining in production for 14 years until 2007. Practical yet distinctive, it remains one of the most influential models in A-segment history.

long.zh:
1990年，雷诺停产了Super 5，推出了其继任车型Clio。然而，由于Clio的车身尺寸加大，因此该公司的产品阵容中，仍然欠缺一款小型车来填补空白。为此，雷诺推出了Twingo，一款A级掀背车。

Twingo以其三门单厢式车身而闻名，其轮廓线条从短促的引擎盖开始，经车顶延伸至车尾，几乎一气呵成，流畅自然。这一设计使其与同时代的竞争对手区分开来，在1992年首次亮相时震撼了市场。四个车轮被极限排布在车身的四角，使其在仅<3433mm>长、<1423mm>高的紧凑车身尺寸下，仍然保证了超乎寻常的内部空间。

Twingo在问世之初，搭载了一台横置的1.2升直列四缸顶置阀门引擎。虽然这台引擎只能提供够用的动力，但与轻量化车身搭配得将将好，足以让它轻快灵动地在都市中穿行。此外，Twingo还配备了可滑动的后排座椅，从而实现数种空间布局，这种在实用车型中引入独特功能的设计受到了好评。

第一代Twingo在多年间历经多次引擎和外观升级，生产周期长达14年，直至2007年方才落幕。这是一辆实用又可爱的小车，堪称A级车发展史上最具革命性的车型之一。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This machine was the winner of the 2014 Gran Turismo Award. A heavily customized 1970 Chevrolet Camaro SS, it was reimagined by Roadster Shop in Illinois, USA. The car’s structure was rebuilt from the ground up using lightweight carbon fiber and aluminum components, while under the hood sat a rear-offset 7.0-liter LS7 engine tuned to produce 739.6 HP. Its aggressive aesthetic was matched by performance, with wide overfenders, a bold front spoiler, and a prominent rear wing.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2014年Gran Turismo大奖得主。这款1970年Chevrolet Camaro SS由美国伊利诺伊州Roadster Shop定制改装。基础结构采用碳纤维和铝制部件重新构建，搭载后置布局的7升LS7引擎，调校至750 PS。强劲动力与大尺寸宽体轮眉、前扰流板和尾翼组成的震撼外观完美匹配。
officialDetails.heroEn: This 2014 GT Awards winner was a high-speed monster wearing the skin of a Camaro SS.
officialDetails.heroZh: 2014年GT奖得主。披着Camaro SS外皮的高速怪物。

brandCentral.en:
The Roadster Shop is a hot-rod shop based in Illinois, U.S.A.

It's particularly famous for its
custom chassis offerings.

This Rampage is one of its main showpieces. It won
the Gran Turismo Award at the 2014 SEMA Show.

It's based on a 1970 Chevrolet Camaro SS.

In addition to a reworked frame, its body is equipped
with a roll cage for extra reinforcement.

Also, its engine is more centrally located, which means that
the car's handling balance is superb!

Roadster Shop是一家位于美国伊利诺伊州的改装车店，

尤其以定制底盘产品而闻名。

这台Rampage是他们的杰作，
也是2014年SEMA展会上Gran Turismo大奖的得主！

它以1970年的Chevrolet Camaro SS为基础。

除了重新制作的车身框架，
还增加了防滚架，以进行额外刚度加固……

而且它的引擎更靠近中间位置
——依我看，这是一个匠心独具的设计！

vehicleCollection.en:
This 2014 GT Awards winner was a high-speed monster wearing the skin of a Camaro SS.

For years, Gran Turismo handed out its "Best in Show" award at the SEMA show, a giant aftermarket convention that takes place annually in Las Vegas, Nevada. In 2014, the 12th Best in Show award went to the 1970 Chevrolet Camaro SS "Rampage," built by muscle-car chassis specialists Roadster Shop of Illinois, United States.

True to its name, the car looked mean from every angle. Bulging fender flares at both the front and rear gave it a wide, menacing stance, while a large front spoiler and rear wing hinted of the prowess underneath the hood, which was a 7.0-liter LS7 tuned to produce <750ps> and mounted <13cm> rearward to improve weight distribution.

Perhaps the most notable aspect of the car was its rebuilt chassis, which came with a roll cage and plenty of carbon-fiber and aluminum components. Also, the suspension was converted to an inboard cantilever design, which thoroughly impressed the Gran Turismo team and earned the car its distinct recognition.

long.zh:
在每年的美国汽车用品改装车展览会上，都会向最优秀的改装车授予GT大奖。在2014年的第12届展会上，这项大奖颁给了美国伊利诺伊州的肌肉车底盘专家“Roadster Shop”所打造的一辆名为“公羊”的1970年雪佛兰科迈罗SS。

这辆车采用了超大尺寸的前后挡泥板，还增加了大号的前扰流板和尾翼，呈现出极其富有侵略性的外观。但更惊人之处还在于它的内在。底盘完全重新打造，为了提高刚度增加了防滚架，而且整车的许多零件也替换为了碳纤维和铝制部件，极大地减轻了车重。

排量高达7L的LS7引擎也经过调校，可以输出<750ps>的动力，并在布局位置上后移了<13cm>，优化了前后配重比。不过我们底盘专家的拿手好戏还是将悬挂系统转换为了一套内侧悬臂设计。或许这辆车就是终极的现代化复古改装作品。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo is Subaru’s ultimate expression of a next-generation sports car, carrying forward the brand’s “VIZIV” philosophy—Vision for Innovation. Carbon materials have been used extensively throughout the body, keeping weight down to 3042 lbs. At its heart is a specially tuned horizontally-opposed 2.0-liter engine paired with high-output electric motors, delivering a combined output of 591.7 HP and a peak torque of 800Nm (593.1 ft-lb).
officialDetails.descriptionZh: “SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo”是Subaru旗下最终极的跑车，延续了他们对“VIZIV”——即“创新的愿景”——这一概念的坚持。这款车全车采用了碳纤维材料，仅重1,380 公斤。在一部特殊调校的2升水平对置引擎和高功率电机的驱动下，这套动力系统总共能够输出最大600 PS的动力，而最大扭矩也达到了800牛米（82.0 公斤力米）。

vehicleCollection.en:
Subaru's most aggressive sports car ever is potent yet civilized. R

Vision Gran Turismo is a revolutionary project established for car enthusiasts all over the world. The car provided by Subaru for this dream project, where the world's car manufacturers and brands develop concept cars in the game world, is an ultimate sports car carrying Subaru's concept car motto "VIZIV"; Vision for Innovation. The car is called the "SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo".

Inheriting the design language of Subaru's "SUBARU VIZIV 2 Concept" revealed at the March 2014 Geneva show, the Subaru design team have added dynamic and solid shapes to the model. Its shoulder line extends from the front hexagonal grill all the way to the rear. Its tough-looking body seems as though it was carved from hard, solid metal. And with blister fenders extending its shape three dimensionally outward, it visually expresses Subaru's pursuit of a safe and enjoyable driving experience. Its large diffuser, the roof integrated rear spoiler, and its shooting brake silhouette, which accounts for aerodynamic performance, will surely stand out among others in the game.

Thorough weight reduction was a focus in the design of the body structure, and carbon materials have been utilized everywhere. As a result, the vehicle weight was held down to <1380kg> despite being equipped with heavy batteries and motors. And propelling the lightweight body is Subaru's legendary 2 liter horizontally opposed engine that has been fully tuned with years of motorsports experience. The direct injection turbocharged engine that has been powered up with revised restrictor diameters is combined with one high-power motor in the front and two in the rear, which achieves a total system power output of <600ps> and 800 Nm (<82kgm>) of maximum torque. By independently controlling each of the motor outputs, turning ability while cornering is drastically improved, while the torque vectoring lamps built into the fenders visualize its movement. Thus, as with any other Subaru, the car is made controllable for anyone driving it, regardless of its extremely high performance levels.

Experience the "SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo," a car that delivers Subaru's ideals of confidence and driving pleasure through an unprecedented aggressive design and extreme levels of performance.

long.zh:
跑车浪漫旅愿景是一项专为全世界赛车爱好者设立的革命性项目。全世界的汽车制造商和品牌会联合起来共同打造游戏内的概念赛车，而斯巴鲁为这项梦幻项目所提供的是一辆终极跑车。车名延续了斯巴鲁概念赛车座右铭 “VIZIV”：意为创新的愿景，因此这辆车被命名为“斯巴鲁VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo”。

这辆车沿袭了2014年3月日内瓦车展上公布的“斯巴鲁VIZIV 2 Concept”的设计语言，除此之外，斯巴鲁的设计团队还为这款车加入动感硬朗的造型。其肩部线条从车头六角形进气格栅一直延伸到车尾，硬朗风格的车身看起来就像是刚从一块坚硬、结实的金属上切削下来的一样。鼓起的挡泥板将车身横向扩展，完美展现了斯巴鲁对于安全和舒适驾驶体验的追求。这辆车有着大号的扰流翼、与车顶一体的后扰流板、以及考虑到空气动力学性能的猎装车外形，绝对可以在游戏里脱颖而出。

彻底的减重是车体结构设计的重点，因此碳纤维材料得到了广泛使用。因此，尽管装备了许多沉重的电池和电机，车重还是被控制在了<1380kg>。推动这套轻量化车身的是斯巴鲁传奇般的2升水平对置引擎，并使用多年的赛车运动经验进行了精心调校。直喷涡轮增压引擎的限制器直径得到了改良，再搭配上前部的一台和后部的两台大功率电机，总输出功率可达<600ps>，最大扭矩可达800 牛·米（<82kgm>）。通过对两部电机的输出功率进行独立控制，这辆车的弯道转向能力得到了大幅增强，而内置在挡泥板上的扭矩矢量控制灯让它的运动变得清晰可见。因此ｌ和斯巴鲀的儶他车款一样，虽然这辆车月着超高的性能，其设计䍵都诩每一个人都可以轻松驾驭。

“斯巴鲁VIZIV GT Wision Gran Turismo” 通过前所未有的冲击性鮾计和超强的性能展掰了斯巴鲁的自忡哌对詾驶乐趣皅扦行追求，快叻伓騌下这迆车呧

彻底的减重是车体结构设计的重点，因此碳纤维材料得到了广泛使用。因此，尽管装备了许多沉重的电池和电机，车重还是被控制在了<1380kg>。推动这套轻量化车身的是斯巴鲁传奇般的2升水平对置引擎，并使用多年的赛车运动经验进行了精心调校。直喷涡轮增压引擎的限制器直径得到了改良，再搭配上前部的一台和后部的两台大功率电机，总输出功率可达<600ps>，最大扭矩可达800 牛·米（<82kgm>）。通过对两部电机的输出功率进行独立控制，这辆车的弯道转向能力得到了大幅增强，而内置在挡泥板上的扭矩矢量控制灯让它的运动变得清晰可见。因此ｌ和斯巴鲀的儶他车款一样，虽然这辆车月着超高的性能，其设计䍵都诩每一个人都可以轻松驾驭。

“斯巴鲁VIZIV GT Wision Gran Turismo” 通过前所未有的冲击性鮾计和超强的性能展掰了斯巴鲁的自忡哌对詾驶乐趣皅扦行追求，快叻伓騌下这迆车呧

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The SUZUKI Vision Gran Turismo harnesses the cutting-edge engine technology of the renowned Hayabusa sports bike, paired with advanced electrification and weight-saving innovations. Its powertrain combines the 1,340 cm³ (1340 cc) Hayabusa engine with three high-output electric motors in an all-wheel-drive layout. brandCentral.en:
Suzuki is one of the few manufacturers
that builds both 2- and 4-wheel vehicles.

This machine you see here broke new ground for the company.
It's called the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo.

It's a compact 2-seater convertible evoking
memories of the Swift Sport and Cappuccino.

Under the hood, located just aft of the front axle line is...

...the <1340cc> engine from the Suzuki Hayabusa,
one of the most popular motorbikes in the world.

In addition to sporting two motors up front,
the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo also has one at the rear.

This gives the hybrid-powered vehicle all-wheel-drive
and plenty of power on demand.
brandCentral.zh:
铃木是为数不多同时制造两轮摩托车和四轮汽车
的制造商之一。

我们这里的这辆尤物是他们的一个“突破”——
铃木Vision Gran Turismo。

从车身来看，这是一辆紧凑型的双座敞篷车，
令人想起速翼特Sport和Cappuccino。

但是最值得注意的是它的前中置引擎！

别惊讶，这可是一台<1340cc>的铃木隼引擎——
世界上最顶级的摩托车引擎。

除了前面的两个电机，后面也安装了一个……

它是四轮驱动车型中最令人印象深刻的混合动力车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
A super sports car combining the heart of the Hayabusa with electric motors.

Suzuki is one of a small number of manufacturers to produce both cars and motorbikes. First introduced 20 years ago, the GSX-R/4 sports concept was developed as the amalgamation of its 2- and 4-wheeled sports vehicles. It featured the high-performance engine from the company's "Hayabusa" flagship sports bike mounted amidships on a lightweight aluminum-framed car body. The GSX-R/4 has also appeared in previous Gran Turismo titles.

And now, the latest rendition of the Hayabusa engine returns with Suzuki's latest developments in electrification and lightweight construction methods in the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo.

The car sports a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout with the new Hayabusa <1340cc> engine mounted just aft of the front axle. The gasoline engine is combined with two electric motors that drive the front wheels and one that powers the rear. Total output is rated at 318kW (<432ps>) and 610 Nm (<62kgm>) of torque peaking at 3000 rpm. And thanks to Suzuki's lightweight construction methods, the 2-seat convertible tips the scales at a lean <970kg>.

The exterior design combines the DNA of Suzuki's sporting heritage seen on the Swift Sport. The GSX-R/4's long nose is reminiscent of the company's Cappuccino "kei car." The interior design possesses the aesthetics of a motorcycle and expresses the joy of driving in a modern pure sports fashion.

long.zh:
铃木是少数几家同时生产汽车和摩托车的制造商之一。在20年前首次推出时，GSX-R/4的开发理念是针对2轮与4轮运动车型混合开发。它将一颗来自铃木旗舰摩托车“隼”的高性能引擎安装在轻量化铝制框架车身的中部。这款GSX-R/4在之前的跑车浪漫旅作品中就亮过相了。

如今，隼引擎的进化版随着铃木在电动化和轻量化工程方案方面的最新进展一同回归，铃木Vision Gran Turismo应运而生。

这款车采用了前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，一台新款隼 1340cm³（即<1340cc>）引擎依然置于车身中部，附带前2后1的电机配置，形成全轮驱动系统。引擎和电机的混合动力输出让总功率达到了318kw（<432ps>）和3000转下610牛·米（<62kgm>）的最大扭矩。再配合铃木通过轻量化工程方案实现的<970kg>双座无顶紧凑车身，打造出一款超级跑车。

此车的外观设计继承了以速翼特运动版为代表的铃木运动基因，修长的前车头轮廓让人想起了经典的Cappuccino。内饰部分与GSX-R/4相近，拥有摩托车框架的美学表达，以现代、纯粹的运动风格展现驾驶的乐趣。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.3 racecar was based on
the Suzuki VGT.

To comply with Gr.3 specifications, it adopted
a simple FR layout.

Powering the vehicle was a twin-turbocharged V-8.

This powerplant was actually two Hayabusa engines from
the company’s flagship sports bike stuck together.

It redlined at a very high <10000rpm>
and churned out <586ps> of power.

Thanks to enlarged front and rear spoilers and added air ducts,
the body generated gobs of downforce.

Also, the use of carbon-fiber throughout the body
kept the entire vehicle extremely lightweight.

Sporting the colors of Suzuki’s motorcycle race team,
this particular Suzuki car is sure to turn heads on the track.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原版Gr.3级别赛车
是基于Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo改装而来。

根据Gr.3的规格要求，它采用了普通的
前置后驱传动系统，

搭载一台狂野的双涡轮增压V8引擎。

事实上，这款引擎是由两台Suzuki旗舰级运动摩托车
Hayabusa的引擎组合而成。

它能达到<10000rpm>的转速，输出<586ps>马力。

除了全面提升的下压力、加大尺寸的前后扰流板
和新增的导气口……

这台猛兽还在全车身应用了轻量化碳纤维材料，
大幅减轻了自重。

此外，它还装备了Suzuki摩托车车队的官方配色，
在赛道上一定能夺人目光。

catch.en: This Gr.3 Vision Gran Turismo possesses Suzuki's racing spirit.
catch.zh: 这辆Gr.3 Vision Gran Turismo充满了Suzuki的不屈斗争精神。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Gr.3 Vision Gran Turismo possesses Suzuki's racing spirit.

This car is the Gr.3 version of the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo, a lightweight sports car combining the sporting philosophies of Suzuki's 2- and 4-wheel machines. This model highlights the company's racing prowess and has been extensively tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations.

The base Suzuki VGT features a hybrid powerplant, combining the <1340cc> Hayabusa engine with three high-powered electric motors. While the base car was all-wheel drive, the Gr.3 machine takes the form of a front-engine/rear-wheel driver with two 4-cyclinder Hayabusa engines bolted together, making it a <2680cc> V-8. With twin turbochargers providing extra muscle, this amazing engine produces <586ps> at an astoundingly high <10000rpm>.

Compared to the base model, the design aesthetics have been altered to provide increased downforce that comes via an enlarged front spoiler, rear wing, air ducting on the hood, and front and rear diffusers. Also, plenty of carbon fiber has been used to keep the car's weight minimal.

The livery represents a vivid representation of Suzuki's passion for motorsports, featuring graphics using Metallic Triton Blue and Metallic Mystic Silver, Suzuki's motorcycle race team colors.

long.en:

While the base car was all-wheel drive, the Gr.3 machine takes the form of a front-engine/rear-wheel driver with two 4-cyclinder Hayabusa engines bolted together, making it a <2680cc> V-8. With twin turbochargers providing extra muscle, this amazing engine produces <586ps> at an astoundingly high <10000rpm>.

Compared to the base model, the design aesthetics have been altered to provide increased downforce that comes via an enlarged front spoiler, rear wing, air ducting on the hood, and front and rear diffusers. Also, plenty of carbon fiber has been used to keep the car's weight minimal.

The livery represents a vivid representation of Suzuki's passion for motorsports, featuring graphics using Metallic Triton Blue and Metallic Mystic Silver, Suzuki's motorcycle race team colors.
long.zh:
这辆车是铃木Vision Gran Turismo的组别3版本，这款轻量级跑车结合了铃木在二轮和四轮车型上的运动理念，体现出了铃木在赛车运动上强大的实力，并经过大幅改装，以满足组别3规则的要求。

作为基础车型的铃木Vision Gran Turismo采用了1340 cm³（<1340cc>）的隼引擎，并在全轮驱动系统中与3台高功率电机相连。然而，这个组别3版本却采用了简化的前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，由两个隼引擎模块组成V8双涡轮增压动力组，总排量达2680 cm³（<2680cc>）。在此形态下，这台怪兽般的引擎能够在令人惊叹的<10000rpm>下产生最大<586ps>的强劲动力。

与基础车型相比，外观设计被稍作调整以增大下压力，加大了前扰流板，并增加了前后扩散器，GT尾翼和引擎盖上的风道。此外，车身通过换装多处碳纤维部件，极大地减轻了车重。

此车的涂装采用了铃木摩托车车队的官方配色：海神金属蓝和神秘金属银，旗帜鲜明地展现了铃木对赛车运动的激情。

of all motorsports events.

It wasn’t until 1988 that it officially
made its return.

And it did so with this car, the Sauber-Mercedes.

Because it was painted all silver, the car was called
the "Silver Arrow."

Actually, there’s a story behind the name.
Would you care to hear it?
2

conversation.zh:
在1955年，Mercedes-Benz选择从汽车运动赛事中抽身。

直到1988年，他们才正式推出这辆Sauber-Mercedes，

并用它上演了一出王者归来！

因为采用了通体银色的车身，它得到了“银箭”的称号。

其实这个名字背后还有一段故事。你想要听吗？

conversation.en:
It all goes back some 90 years,
to the Eifel race of 1934.

Back then, the all-white Mercedes F1 was deemed
<1kg> too heavy for competition.

To reduce its weight, a mechanic scraped off the car's
paint, exposing its aluminum body.

It was this silver-colored car
that ended up winning the race.

This car was dubbed the "Silver Arrow," instantly becoming
a symbol for racing excellence.

Sinc then, silver has been Germany’s national
racing color.

Of course, sponsorship liveries are much
more common today.

And race cars painted in their national colors
are very much a thing of the past.

But if youpre interested in racing history, you should
look into the national race cors of other cotries

当时的那辆全白色梅赛德斯F1赛车因为超重<1kg>，无法参加比赛。

为了减重，一名机械师直接刮掉了喷漆，露出了铝制的
赛车车身。

最终，这辆原色梅赛德斯赛车还赢下了比赛！

于是赛车运动历史上最传奇的名称之一“银箭”便诞生了！

4那之后，银色就成为了德国的赛车运动主色调！

当然，今天的赛车运动中赞助商涂装已经非常普及。

采用国家官方配色的赛车已经成为了历史。

不过，如果你对F1历史感兴趣，
不妨多了解一下其他国家的官方配色！

dialogues.en:
When the Sauber Mercedes C9 was introduced, it was already
somewhat aged...

...having arrived just as Group C regulations ushered
in a new era of automotive technology.

It was the era of carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, showcased
by TWR-Jaguar machines...

...along with entries from Nissan, Toyota, and Aston Martin.

Meanwhile, the Sauber C9 stuck with an all-aluminum construction.

But tha didn’t stop it from dominating Le Mans in 1989 with a
stunning 1-2 finish.

How did it achieve such an incredible feat?

The answer lies in the power of Mercedes' advanced
computer systems and rock-solid engineering.</>
It was the kind of victory that only cutting-edge technology
could deler!

dialogues.zh:
从1987年首次亮相的那一刻起，Sauber Mercedes C9
就已经有些过时了。

毕竟，它诞生于C组别规则推出和汽车技术
新时代来临之前的黎明。

这是碳纤维单体壳底盘闪亮登场的年代，以TWR-Jaguar……

Nissan、Toyota和Aston Martin为代表的车型就是例证。

而Sauber C9仍然坚持全铝结构。

但这并没有阻止它在1989年的勒芒取得
一二带回的成绩。

它是如何取得这一惊人壮举的呢？

这都要归功于Mercedes自己的计算机系统
和可靠的制造工艺！

确实，这是一场只有计算机才能实现mtB！

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The C9 was a Group C race car developed by Switzerland’s Sauber. Having supplied engines in earlier efforts, Mercedes officially brought Sauber under its factory racing umbrella in 1988. By 1989, the C9 appeared in a striking all-silver livery, evoking memories of the legendary Silver Arrows. In a stunning performance at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, car No. 63 claimed victory, followed by No. 61 in 2nd place and No. 62 in 5th.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: C9是瑞士车厂Sauber开发的C组别赛车。在与这家车厂进行引擎供应合作多年后，Mercedes在1988年开始雇佣Sauber担任他们的原厂车队。在1989年，这款车以纯银色车身的涂装亮相，也唤醒了车迷们对“银箭传奇”的回忆。在勒芒24小时耐力赛上，这款车取得了震撼全场的成绩。其中63号赛车夺得了冠军，61号则屈居第二，而62号也跻身前五。
officialDetails.heroEn: The unbeatable group C car marked the return of the Mercedes-Benz Works racing team.
officialDetails.heroZh: 战无不胜的C组别赛车，重返赛场的Mercedes车队令人敬畏不已。

collection.en:
If I were to ask you to think of Swiss F1 team,
chances are you'd think of Sauber,

which was founded by Peter Sauber, a keen amateur race driver.

Sauber built his first race car in 1970,
and drove it in hill climbs.

Sauber then focused on the management side of things, and the
team experienced early success with the BMW-engined C5.

In many ways, that success was the launchpad which propelled
the team all the way to Formula 1 in 1993.

Prior to its F1 involvement, Sauber's greatet achievement
was the C9, a Group C race car developed with Mercedes.

The C9 made its racing debut in 1987, and soon tasted victory.

In the 1989 season it was virtually unrivaled,

becoming the winner of the World Sports Car Championship
and inning the 24 Hours of Le Mans!
collection.zh:
提到瑞士的F1车队，您自然会想到索伯车队。

车队的创始人Peter Sauber是一位激情四溢的业余赛车手。

他在1970年打造出了他的第一辆赛车，并驾驶它参加爬坡赛。

后来，他将重点转向管理，而他的车队也凭借搭载BMW引
擎的C5取得了早期的成功。

这种成功在方方面面激励着车队，推动他们在1993年登上
F1大赛的舞台。

在参与F1之前，索伯车队最大的成就是C9：一款与Mercedes
合作开发的C组别赛车。

C9于1987年在赛场上首次亮相。不久就尝到了胜利的滋味。

在1989年赛季中，它表现得所向披靡，

连续夺得了世界跑车锦标赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军！~

catch.zh: 战无不胜的C组别赛车，重返赛场的Mercedes车队令人敬畏不已。

vehicleCollection.en:
The unbeatable group C car marked the return of the Mercedes-Benz Works racing team.

Spearheaded by Swiss car constructor Sauber, the C9 appeared in 1988 as a Group C car. Beginning in 1986, Mercedes-Benz began supplying Sauber with Group C engines, and two years after that, Mercedes-Benz officially announced Sauber as its motorsports partner, forming a partnership committed to building GT race cars. This marked the first time since 1955 that Mercedes-Benz built GT race cars, ever since a big accident at the 24 Hours of Le Mans forced the company out of motorsports.

The Sauber Mercedes-Benz C9 met with success immediately, earning pole position in the opener for the 1988 WSPC (World Sportscar Championship) and going on to win five of 12 races that year. In 1989, Mercedes-Benz replaced the turbocharged 5.0-liter SOHC V-8 with a 4-valve version that increased power to <720ps>. The restyled C9 looked imposing, bathed in silver paint and was christened with the nickname "Silver Arrow," a reference to the legendary Mercedes-Benz (and Auto Union) Grand Prix cars during the Golden Age of Racing.

That year, the Silver Arrows finished 1-2 at the World Sportscar Championship at Suzuka Circuit and 2-3 at Dijon. At the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Silver Arrows finished 1-2, and another car finishing 5th. In 1988, with seven wins in eight races, Jean-Louis Schlesser became the Drivers' Champion and Sauber took the team title.

long.zh:
索伯C9是瑞士车厂索伯于1988年开发的一款C组赛车，主要设计师为皮特·索伯。梅赛德斯-奔驰自1986年起开始向索伯供应C组引擎。1988年，梅赛德斯-奔驰宣布自1955年勒芒耐力赛后，首次重新参加赛车活动，索伯车队被宣布为他们的车厂车队。

这款车在铝质单体底盘上安装了一台5.0升的V8涡轮增压引擎。在1998年世界原型跑车锦标赛上，索伯梅赛德斯C9在首轮比赛中就从杆位发车并获胜，并在接下来的十二场比赛中获得五场胜利。1989年，梅赛德斯-奔驰将引擎更换为每缸4阀门的双顶置式凸轮轴引擎，将最大马力提升到令人震惊的<720ps>。这款大排量的V8引擎采用低压升压、注重扭矩的设计，目标只有一个：成为系列赛的冠军。

C9赛车在登场当年选择了全银色车身的全新形象。这个造型令许多人为之胆寒，被他们看作原来梅赛德斯厂车的归来，这些赛车当年有着“银箭”的赫赫威名。这一年，C9在世界跑车锦标赛开幕第一轮比赛的铃鹿赛道上展现出压倒性的力量，以1、2名获胜，并在后来第戎的比赛上获得了2、3名。

6月，C9参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛。第63号车获得了第一名的伟大战绩，61号车荣获第二，62号车位列第五。

此后C9在比赛中继续大发神威。1989年，施勒塞尔创下八场七胜的纪录，成为车手冠军，索伯也成为车队冠军。*

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Shelby developed the Cobra 427 with the goal of winning the FIA Speed World Challenge, where the team was actively competing at the time. The car was powered by a formidable 7.0-liter 427 “Side Oiler” V-8—a purpose-built race engine originally designed for stock car competition. To handle its impressive 493.1 HP output, the Cobra 427 replaced its signature side-mounted leaf springs with a modern double wishbone suspension, greatly enhancing its handling and stability.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 为了赢得当时所参加的FIA速度世界挑战赛，Shelby Cobra专门开发了Cobra 427。这辆车搭载了7升427 “Side Oiler”引擎，一款专门用于原厂改装车比赛的引擎。为了适配惊人的500 PS输出，该车放弃了标志性的侧边安装的钢板弹簧悬挂系统，转而采用新的双叉臂布局。
officialDetails.heroEn: Lightweight and powerful, the Cobra is an American sports car icon.
officialDetails.heroZh: 美国跑车的典范，采用大排量引擎。

collection.en:
A winner at Le Mans, a competitor in Formula 1,
and one of America’s greatest car enthusiasts...

Carroll Shelby has a permanent place in automotive history.

After retiring as a driver, Shelby became a constructor,
with a focus on road cars that could win races.

The Cobra is one of the iconic cars produced by Shelby.

The first production lots were shipped out
in the spring of 1963...

And were initially powered by Ford’s 260 CID engine,
which were soon replaced by the 289 CID unit.

Then the legendary Cobra 427 was introduced in 1964.

Powered by a 7L Ford 427...

It was intended by Shelby to defeat Ferrari in competition.

With their proven competition pedigree
and aggressive looks...

Big block Cobras are sogh ater by car enthusiasts
all over te world.

在汽车历史上永久地占有一席之地。

在从赛车手的身份退役后，他转而成为一名汽车架构师，
专注于开发能够赢得比赛的公路车。

“Cobra”是谢尔比的代表作之一。

第一批Cobra在1963年春天发售，

最初搭载了福特的260 CID引擎，但很快被289 CID动单元所取代。

传奇的Cobra 427则于1964年推出。

Cobra 427由一台7升福特427引擎驱动，

这是谢尔比亲自选择的引擎，目的是在比赛中将法拉利拉下马。

由于其成熟的赛车血统和咄咄逼人s外观，

大块头的Cobra被世界各地的汽车爱好者所追捧dA

vehicleCollection.en:
Lightweight and powerful, the Cobra is an American sports car icon.

The Shelby Cobra competed in the FIA Speed World Challenge, a world endurance championship that differed from GT-class racing as there was no limitation on engine displacement. To defeat its rival, Ferrari, in this series, Shelby American fitted a large displacement engine into its race car, which came in the form of the 7.0-liter 427 ci "Side Oiler," a pure custom-built racing engine. Thus, the development of the Shelby Cobra 427 was under way, starting near the end of 1964. The first prototype was completed in the spring of 1965.

One problem that immediately arose during development was the strength of the chassis, or lack thereof. In comparison to the <350ps> produced by the 289 engine, the 427 Side Oiler's <500ps> was simply too much power for the existing setup. Phil Remington, in charge of design at Shelby America, determined that the suspension was the car's weakest link, so the side-mounted leaf suspension was abandoned in favor of a conventional double wishbone with coil dampers. The Shelby Cobra 427 cleared its 100-unit minimum production requirement and acquired FIA homologation. The car first competed in the SCCA A Production class at the opening of the 1966 season. In the end, 348 Shelby Cobra 427s were built with 88 of them being competition spec models or test cars. The 427 S/C was a road-going model with competition spec equipment. Only 31 of these examples were built.

long.zh:
国际汽联世界速度挑战赛，即Shelby Cobra参加的世界耐力锦标赛，与GT类赛事不同，不对引擎排量进行限制。

为了在这个系列赛中击败对手法拉利，Shelby美国决定以大排量引擎参赛。当时，福特正好拥有一款7升427“侧置机油供给”引擎，这是一款专门用于原厂改装车比赛的引擎。Shelby决定在Cobra上安装这款引擎，Shelby Cobra 427的开发从1964年年底开始启动。其原型车于1965年春完成。

关键问题紧接着出现，与289动力单元提供的<350ps>相比，472侧置机油供给的马力约为<500ps>。谢尔比美国的设计主管菲尔·雷明顿发现现有的悬挂系统无法承受这么大的马力。因此放弃了标志性的侧边安装的钢板弹簧悬架，改用带线圈避震的常规双叉臂悬挂。

Shelby Cobra 427按照最低产量生产了100辆，并取得了国际汽协认证，此车自1966年赛季开始参加美国赛车俱乐部A级量产车比赛。最终，Shelby Cobra 427一共生产了348辆，其中88辆为比赛规格车款或测试用车。

此外还有配备了赛车规格装备的公路车款427S/C，仅有31辆车是最初就按此规格来制造的。

conversation.en:
This car is a masterpiece of
American race-car design.

Because of the era, I think its design was undoubtedly
influenced by the Ferrari GTO...

But this massive Daytona Coupe possesses an exclusively
bold American flair, which I think is fantastic.

From the fully pushed back cabin to the squeezed out rear,
the proportions of this car have been taken to the limit.

But that balance is what makes the car so alluring.

I feel this was from using the open-top AC Cobra as a base
and getting the most aerodynamic performance possible.

The design sense of Pete Brock, who effectively
put this car together, really comes through.
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.zh:
这辆车是美国赛车设计史上的杰作。

由于所属时代的原因，我认为它的设计毫无疑问
深受Ferrari GTO的影响……

不过这辆体型庞大的Daytona Coupe依然拥有独一无二的
粗犷美国风味，我觉得这一点非常美妙。

从大幅后移的座舱，到高度压缩的翘车尾，
这辆车的比例被推向了极限。

不过，这种奇妙的平衡恰恰是这辆车最迷人的地方。

我认为这是因为它采用了敞篷的AC Cobra作为基础车型，
并尽可能地提升了空气动力学性能。

皮特·布洛克贯彻他的设计理念，成功打造了这款经典车。
]

conversation.en:
Carroll Shelby made it his life’s mission to trounce
Ferrari at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

The first attempt he made was, of course,
in the famed Shelby Cobra.

However, as the open-bodied Cobra was lacking in terms
of high-speed aerodynamics...

Shelby turned to designer Pete Brock
for a body overhaul.

In return, Brock handed him back
the Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe.

However, by the, Shelby had given his attention to
the development of the Ford GT40.

So this Cobra Daytona Coupe really only raced
for a fleeting two years...

In 1964 and ’65.

Only a few Shelby Cobras were ever produced--I'm
ealous of anyone who gets their hands on one!
]
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.zh:
卡罗尔·谢尔比毕生的宿愿
就是在勒芒24小时耐力赛中完胜法拉利。

他的第一次尝试当然就是这辆声名斐然的Shelby Cobra。

显然，Cobra的敞篷车身缺乏高速时所需的空气动力学性能……

于是，谢尔比向设计师皮特·布洛克求助，
对车身进行了大幅修改。

布洛克交付给他的便是这台Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe了。

只不过，此时谢尔比的注意力已经转向了福特GT40的开发。

因此这辆Cobra Daytona Coupe的赛车经历
只有短短的两年……

即1964和65年。

Shelby Cobra的制造数f极为有限——
真是嫉妒那些能搞到一辆的幸运儿！
'

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The AC Cobra had already made a name for itself on the racing scene in the 1960s, and its closed-roof variant was the Shelby Cobra Coupe. While the open-bodied Cobra excelled in acceleration and handling, it lagged behind in top speed due to poor aerodynamics. That changed with a coupe body designed by Pete Brock, which dramatically improved the car’s airflow and added more than 18.6 mph to its top speed. With its full potential unlocked, the Cobra Coupe went on to win numerous races over the following two years.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: AC Cobra在1960年代的赛车界占据了统治地位，Shelby Cobra是这辆车的双门轿车版本。AC Cobra凭借卓越的加速能力与操控性在赛场上驰骋，但由于开放式车身带来的空气动力学效率低下，让其在与对手的竞争中落入下风。得益于皮特·布洛克设计的双门轿跑车身，这台车的空气动力学得到显著优化，最高速度提升超过30 公里/小时。在真正的潜力得以施放之后，这台车在两年内横扫多项赛事。
officialDetails.heroEn: Only 6 units of the legendary, and very successful, Shelby Daytona Coupe race car were ever made.
officialDetails.heroZh: 成功改进了原版Cobra的空气动力学性能，是当时横扫各大比赛的传奇。

collection.en:
The Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe may be the most
valuable Shelby Cobra of them all.

Determined to win Le Mans for Ford...

Carroll Shelby asked friend and employee Pete Brock
to design a coupé body for the Cobra.

Spec-wise, it was virtually the same as the 289 Cobra, but
the coupé body boosted its top speed by over <30km/h>.

Taking class victories at Le Mans and Daytona, this Cobra
became the champion of the FIA GT Class in 1965.

With only six Daytona Coupes in existence, including
prototypes, they are almost mythical in their rarity.
collection.zh:
Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe可能是Shelby Cobra中
价值最高的一款车型。

在下决心要为Ford赢得勒芒耐力赛后……

Carroll Shelby便邀请他的朋友兼雇员Pete Brock
为他设计Cobra的的车身。

它的规格配置几乎与289 Cobra完全相同，
但得益于双门车身的引入，最高速度提高了<30km/h>。

这款Cobra在勒芒和戴通纳都赢得了其所属组别的比赛，
最终又赢得了1965年国际GT制造商锦标赛GT组冠军。

包括原型车在内，Daytona Coupe只生产了六辆，如此稀少的产量
也把这台车推上了封神的位置。

catch.en: Only 6 units of the legendary, and very successful, Shelby Daytona Coupe race car were ever made.
catch.zh: 成功改进了原版Cobra的空气动力学性能，是当时横扫各大比赛的传奇。

vehicleCollection.en:
Only 6 units of the legendary, and very successful, Shelby Daytona Coupe race car were ever made.

The AC Cobra was the dominant force in the 1960s racing scene. It was a top contender virtually everywhere... that is, except on high-speed venues. The problem was that its open body was a detriment to aerodynamic efficiency. This blunted its advantage of having a lightweight body and large displacement American V8 on long, fast straights. Since Shelby American had already expanded its racing efforts into Europe, and had seen the AC Cobra lag on the lengthy straightaway of the Sarthe Circuit, home to the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the company knew it needed a Cobra with better aerodynamics.

Shelby American's solution was to put a lid on it. Thus, the Shelby Cobra Coupe was born. Its two-door, hardtop body, designed by famed designer Pete Brock, had a long nose that housed the car's 4.7-liter V8 and a short deck that ended behind the rear tires, a style referred to as "coda tronca." Unlike the roadster, the Coupe was full of cutting edge, aerodynamic designs, including the unique rear end design.

Thanks to this new body, the car, which shared the same specs as the original AC Cobra aside from some suspension improvements, achieved a top speed that was <30km/h> faster than the original. In its short two-year lifespan, the racing performance of the Cobra Coupe achieved incredible results in the big events held in North America, as well as in GT-class racing events in Europe.

long.zh:
AC Cobra在1960年代的赛车界占据了统治地位，Shelby Cobra是这辆车的双门轿车版本。

基本款AC Cobra的优势在于超轻量的车身和大排量的美式V8引擎。快速上手的操控和卓越的加速性能使得AC Cobra成为了赛车界的顶尖竞争者。然而，开放式的车身设计让空气动力学大大减分，在高速赛道上显得差强人意。在24小时勒芒拉力赛的长直道上，AC Cobra的表现特别糟糕。对于当时已经将赛车版图拓展至欧洲的Shelby美国来说，急需空气动力学性能更佳的Cobra车型。

由著名设计师皮特·布洛克设计的双门轿跑车型拥有较长的车鼻，容纳了一台4.7升的V8引擎。后轮之后的行李箱空间则略显局促。车辆全身上下都采用了最新的空气动力学设计，包括竖向切断造型的“断尾”尾部设计。

得益于全新车型设计，Shelby Cobra虽然使用与最初的AC Cobra车型相同的规格（除了悬挂系统有部分改进外），最高时速增加了<30km/h>。Shelby Cobra的赛道表现非常不俗，在短短两年间就在北美重大赛事和欧洲的GT级别赛事上大放异彩。

conversation.en:
An iconic cream white body with Shelby’s signature
blue stripes...

Were once the signs of a genuine GT Mustang.

The original Mustang combined great proportions
with a simple and clean design.

Despite the special nature of this G.T. 350...

No parts were added to its exterior
due to regulations.

However, it did come with a lowered suspension,
wide tyres and that iconic stripe.

If I could own a Mustang, this would be
at the top of my list.

conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.speaker: Tom Matano
conversation.zh:
当你看到经典的奶白色车身和Shelby蓝色条纹，
就代表这是一辆血统纯正的GT Mustang……

……当然了，G.T.350肯定要比人气超高的
基础车型更胜一筹。

原款Mustang的车身比例本就十分优秀，

设计方面也以简洁、精炼为主。

受赛事规定限制，这台Shelby G.T.350没有增加任何外部部件，

只是调低了悬挂系统，安装了宽胎
以及加入了标志性的涂装。

要是我想买一台Mustang，那么这款车绝对是我的首选。
