officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Toyota 86 represents Toyota’s take on the compact, front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car co-developed with Subaru. Its front-mid-engine-mounted, naturally-aspirated 2.0-liter DOHC boxer engine produced 197.2 HP and 144.7 ft-lb of torque. Many components were freshly designed specifically for this model, resulting in precise, responsive handling that made the driver feel truly connected to the car. It was a next-generation lightweight sports car, created with driving enthusiasts at its core.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Toyota 86是与Subaru联合开发的Toyota版紧凑型前置后驱跑车。它的前中置自然进气2升双顶置凸轮轴水平对置引擎能够输出200 PS/20.0 公斤力米的动力。团队为这款车设计和开发了许多新的部件，最终实现的效果就是让车手感觉和汽车合二为一。这是一辆真正将车迷们放在第一位的新一代轻量化跑车。
officialDetails.heroEn: The rebirth of the AE86, Toyota creates an exciting 21st-century version of the ideal sports car.
officialDetails.heroZh: 新一代的86，21世纪前置后驱紧凑车型理念的发扬光大者。

brandCentral.en:
This FR sports car carried on the tradition of the
venerable AE86 of the 1980s.

The naturally-aspirated horizontally-opposed 4-cylinder engine
was developed in collaboration with Subaru.

With the engine in the middle, and a low center of gravity,
its cornering is very solid indeed.

In 2015, the body was stiffened to further improve its cornering.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆典型的前置后驱跑车是在80年代声名鹊起的AE86的后
继者。

它的水平对置四缸自然进气发动机是与Subaru联合开发的。

这部引擎置于车身中部，有效降低了车身重心，以此获
得可靠的过弯性能。

在2015款车型上，车身刚性也进行了强化。_

catch.en: The rebirth of the AE86, Toyota creates an exciting 21st-century version of the ideal sports car.
catch.zh: 新一代的86，21世纪前置后驱紧凑车型理念的发扬光大者。

vehicleCollection.en:
The rebirth of the AE86, Toyota creates an exciting 21st-century version of the ideal sports car.

The FT-86 Concept was introduced in 2009 to the delight of Japanese sports car enthusiasts everywhere. The exciting front-engine/rear-drive sports car was developed by a collaborative effort between Toyota and Subaru, and it rekindled the spirit of the legendary Toyota AE86. In 2011, the production version of the FT-86 made its long-awaited debut at the Tokyo Motor Show.

The "FT" (Future Toyota) designation was dropped, going simply by the name Toyota 86. The new-generation "Hachi-Roku" (86 in Japanese) featured a profile similar to that of the FT-86 II Concept shown at the 2011 Geneva Motor Show. The sleek body adopted Toyota's "Aero Handling" concept, which was the company's advanced aerodynamic philosophy.

Under the hood was a naturally-aspirated 1998cc DOHC flat-4, or "boxer" engine, mounted aft of the front axle. It produced an even <200ps> at <7000rpm> and <20.9kgm> of torque at <6600rpm>. The power was transferred to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox or a 6-speed automatic transmission with paddle shifters. Its ideal 53:47 front/rear weight distribution allowed for true sports car handling, with some models getting a limited-slip differential for even more precise cornering. Another reason for the car's amazing agility was because its center of gravity was located in the same place as many exotic supercars, sitting only <460mm> off the ground. The car was also lightweight, tipping the scales at <1230kg>.

Tuning firms, such as Modelista and TRD, offered plenty of customization for the 86, and they showed us that it made for a excellent starting point to build a race car. In sum, the 86 was a lightweight sports car that truly catered to the young car enthusiast of its day.

long.zh:
2009年发布的FT-86 Concept是一款令人惊艳的前置引擎、后轮驱动的紧凑型跑车，由丰田和斯巴鲁合作开发。这款车吸引了全世界车迷期待的目光。2011年，丰田版的量产车型终于在东京车展亮相。

名称中的未来丰田被去掉，正式命名为丰田86。这款新世代车型名称中的“86”源自其前辈，一款上世纪八十年代的超人气车型。其外形更接近2011年日内瓦车展上展出的FT-86 II Concept。这款车在设计上秉持“航天驾控”的理念，即通过卓越的空气动力学设计，使车身从来自各个方向的下压力中获得足够的抓地力。

前置自然吸气<1998cc>4缸双顶置凸轮轴水平对置引擎在<7000rpm>的转速下能够产生<200ps>，在<6600rpm>转速时可产生<20.9kgm>扭矩，然后通过短行程6档手动变速箱或带换挡拨片的6档自动变速箱传递到后轮。

前后配重比被设计为53:47，以增加车尾的可控性，并获得优秀的转向反馈。车辆的重心与超级跑车相当，距地面仅<460mm>。标准款的手动车型车重为<1230kg>，此外也有标配限滑差速器的车型。

新一代86的每一个细节都经过专门设计，以便驾驶者快速上手和操控，使得这辆跑车仿佛就是你手脚的延伸。在这辆车上，你可以享受到特别的操控体验，仿佛人车合二为一。

此外，丰田还计划开发更多的Modellista与丰田赛车开发中心定制套件，以及一款可定制的比赛用车型。这款新世代的轻量级跑车可以说是专为满足车迷而生。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Released in 2012, the Toyota 86 was a sports car that combined a compact body with a rear-wheel-drive layout. The first minor update came in 2016, enhancing body rigidity and aerodynamics. Models equipped with the 6-speed manual transmission received engine retuning along with upgrades to numerous components, placing greater emphasis on performance rather than appearance. The GT Limited trim represented the highest grade in the 86 lineup. Its interior featured upscale materials such as leather and Alcantara, offering a more premium and mature cabin environment.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2012年发布的Toyota 86是一款采用紧凑车身和后轮驱动布局的跑车。2016年首次小改款提升了车身刚性和空气动力学性能。6速手动版本还进行了引擎调校和多项部件改进，注重性能提升胜过外观变化。这款“GT Limited”是86车系中的最高等级版本。内饰采用皮革和Alcantara等高品质材料，营造更加成熟的整体氛围。

brandCentral.en:
Nicknamed the Kouki ('late'), this edition appeared in 2016,
relatively late in the lifecycle of the Toyota 86.

It features improved power and torque, and the suspension
settings have undergone an overhaul.

Front and rear bumpers have also been heavily redesigned to
improve airflow.

Rigidity improvements were a key focus, too, particularly
at the rear of the vehicle.

Jump behind the wheel and you're sure to notice the
difference!
brandCentral.zh:
这款Toyata 86在2016年上市，由于已经进入产品周期的后期，
因此获得了“Kouki”的昵称。

它的动力和扭矩都得到了增强，整个悬挂配置也进行了
全面重置。

通过重新设计前后保险杠，增强了空气流动。

另外，车身刚性也是后期改款的重中之重，尤其是车身
后部。

当您握住它的方向盘时，就能感觉到个中差别了！

vehicleCollection.en:
The "classic" Toyota 86 sports car takes on a more mature character.

The 86 signaled a return to the classic front-engine/rear-drive sports-car segment for Toyota. Introduced in 2012, the 86 was essentially a modern-day version of the classic Corolla/Sprinter AE86 from the 1980s.

Unlike its predecessor, the new 86 came equipped with a boxer-type engine - a 2.0-liter flat-4 - that gave the compact sports car a very low center of gravity, thus better agility and handling response on both road and track. In 2016, the 86 received its first minor update, which included more spot welds to enhance the rigidity of the body and a revised front spoiler for better aerodynamics. The power of the 6-speed manual version was raised to <207ps>/<21.6kgm>, while Sachs dampers were offered as optional equipment for all trim levels.

The GT "Limited" version is the top-of-the-line model, which featured high quality materials such as leather and alcantara in the cabin, resulting in a more mature overall character.

In 2016, the 86 received its first minor update, which included more spot welds to enhance the rigidity of the body and a revised front spoiler for better aerodynamics. The power of the 6-speed manual version was raised to <207ps>/<21.6kgm>, while Sachs dampers were offered as optional equipment for all trim levels.

The GT "Limited" version is the top-of-the-line model, which featured high quality materials such as leather and alcantara in the cabin, resulting in a more mature overall character.
long.zh:
2012年发售的运动车型丰田86兼有相对紧凑的车身和后轮驱动布局。

灵敏且可控的特点沿袭自1980年代热门的卡罗拉/Sprinter AE86。在中置引擎前移的布局，压低的重心和一台2.0水平对置引擎的帮助下，让这样的特质体现得淋漓尽致，因而广泛受到驾驶爱好者的推崇。

在2016年，86进行了第一次小改款。除了外观升级外，还有不少改善驾驶体验的改进，包括增加多处焊点来提高车身刚性，改变前扰流板的形状来提升空气动力学效果等。其6速手动版本的动力被提高到了<207ps>/<21.6kgm>，并且全系增加了萨克斯的避震器作为可选配件。

限量发售的GT版本是86的顶级车型，也是产品线中最“成熟”的版本，高品质材料，如内饰部分的皮革和阿尔卡塔纳合成材料得到了大量的应用。

vehicleCollection.zh:
和Subaru联合研发的前置后驱跑车，有着较低的重心和极佳的前后配重比。

2012年发售的运动车型丰田86兼有相对紧凑的车身和后轮驱动布局。

灵敏且可控的特点沿袭自1980年代热门的卡罗拉/Sprinter AE86。在中置引擎前移的布局，压低的重心和一台2.0水平对置引擎的帮助下，让这样的特质体现得淋漓尽致，因而广泛受到驾驶爱好者的推崇。

在2016年，86进行了第一次小改款。除了外观升级外，还有不少改善驾驶体验的改进，包括增加多处焊点来提高车身刚性，改变前扰流板的形状来提升空气动力学效果等。其6速手动版本的动力被提高到了<207ps>/<21.6kgm>，并且全系增加了萨克斯的避震器作为可选配件。

限量发售的GT版本是86的顶级车型，也是产品线中最“成熟”的版本，高品质材料，如内饰部分的皮革和阿尔卡塔纳合成材料得到了大量的应用。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: A Gran Turismo Original, this version of Toyota’s new sports car, the 86, has been specially modified to comply with Gr.4 racing regulations. While the 86 had already seen action in clubman-level motorsports across the globe, this iteration transforms it into a true race machine, with its power output raised to 364 horsepower. It excels through corners, where its lightweight and compact body can be fully exploited to deliver exceptional handling.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: “86”是Toyota的新一代标准跑车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是针对Gr.4规则开发的改装版本。虽然86本身就已经在全世界范围内参加各种爱好者赛事，但这个版本却将其升级成了一款真正的赛车，就连动力输出都提升到了364马力。这部赛车以弯道见长，它能在过弯时将自己轻量化紧凑车身的优势发挥到最大。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is a Gran Turismo original version of the Toyota 86 FR sports car modified for Gr.4.\

The FT-86 Concept was introduced in 2009 to the delight of Japanese sports car enthusiasts everywhere. The exciting front-engine/rear-drive sports car was developed by a collaborative effort between Toyota and Subaru, and it rekindled the spirit of the legendary Toyota AE86. In 2011, the production version of the FT-86 made its long-awaited debut at the Tokyo Motor Show.

The "FT" (Future Toyota) designation was dropped, going simply by the name Toyota 86. The new-generation "Hachi-Roku" (86 in Japanese) featured a profile similar to that of the FT-86 II Concept shown at the 2011 Geneva Motor Show. The sleek body adopted Toyota's "Aero Handling" concept, which was the company's advanced aerodynamic philosophy.

Under the hood was a naturally-aspirated 1998cc DOHC flat-4, or "boxer" engine, mounted aft of the front axle. It produced an even <200ps> at <7000rpm> and <20.9kgm> of torque at <6600rpm>. The power was transferred to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox or a 6-speed automatic transmission with paddle shifters. Its ideal 53:47 front/rear weight distribution allowed for true sports car handling, with some models getting a limited-slip differential for even more precise cornering. Another reason for the car's amazing agility was because its center of gravity was located in the same place as many exotic supercars, sitting only <460mm> off the ground. The car was also lightweight, tipping the scales at <1230kg>.

Tuning firms, such as Modelista and TRD, offered plenty of customization for the 86, and they showed us that it made for a excellent starting point to build a race car. In sum, the 86 was a lightweight sports car that truly catered to the young car enthusiast of its day.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.!

long.zh:
2009年发布的FT-86 Concept是一款令人惊艳的前置引擎、后轮驱动的紧凑型跑车，由丰田和斯巴鲁合作开发。这款车吸引了全世界车迷期待的目光。2011年，丰田版的量产车型终于在东京车展亮相。

名称中的FT（未来丰田）被去掉，正式命名为丰田86。这款新世代车型名称中的“86”源自其前辈，一款上世纪八十年代的超人气车型。其外形更接近2011年日内瓦车展上展出的FT-86 II Concept赛车。这款车在设计上秉持“航天驾控”的理念，即通过卓越的空气动力学设计，使车身从来自各个方向的下压力中获得足够的抓地力。

前置自然吸气<1998cc>4缸双顶置凸轮轴水平对置引擎在<7000rpm>的转速下能够产生<200ps>，在<6600rpm>转速时可产生<20.9kgm>扭矩，然后通过短行程6档手动变速箱或带换挡拨片的6档自动变速箱传递到后轮。

前后配重比被设计为53:47，以增加车尾的可控性，并获得优秀的转向反馈。车辆的重心与超级跑车相当，距地面仅<460mm>。标准款的手动车型车重为<1230kg>，此外也有标配限滑差速器的车型。

新一代86的每一个细节都经过专门设计，以便驾驶者快速上手和操控，使得这辆跑车仿佛就是你手脚的延伸。在这辆车上，你可以享受到特别的操控体验，仿佛人车合而为一。

此外，丰田还计划开发更多的Modellista与丰田赛车开发中心定制套件，以及一款可定制的比赛用车型。这款新世代的轻量级跑车可以说是专为满足车迷而生。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: A Gran Turismo Original, this version of Toyota’s new sports car, the 86, has been specially modified to comply with Gr.B racing regulations. The car has been transformed into a top-class rally machine, with its original rear-wheel-drive layout converted to 4-wheel drive, while aggressive aerodynamic elements such as canards and a two-level rear wing generated substantial downforce.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: “86”是Toyota的新一代标准跑车，而这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是针对Gr.B规则开发的改装版本。这个版本将基础车型的后轮驱动布局改为了四轮驱动，还加上了能够产生强劲下压力的前翼和二段式尾翼，让它脱胎换骨，成为一辆顶级的拉力赛车。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on
the sporty Toyota 86.

Its two-layered rear spoiler and other aerodynamic elements
help make it a truly state-of-the-art rally machine.

The drivetrain has been adapted from rear-wheel drive to AWD,
ensuring appropriate grip and traction on the dirt.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于Toyota 86开发。

双层尾部扰流板以及其他空气动力学配件的添加使它摇
身一变，成为一款最先进的拉力机器。

另外，其传动系统也从原有车型的前置后驱配置改为了
四轮驱动布局。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The TOYOTA GR010 HYBRID 2021 succeeded the TS050, developed in response to the new regulations introduced that year. It featured a twin-turbo 3.5-liter V-6 engine producing 670.6 HP, paired with a 268.2 HP electric motor at the front in a 4-wheel-drive layout. Driver lineups including Kamui Kobayashi and Kazuki Nakajima went on to win all six rounds of the WEC season, including Le Mans, ushering in the beginning of the hypercar era.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: TOYOTA GR010 HYBRID 2021是TS050的后继车型，专为适应2021年引入的新赛事规则而开发。引擎更换为3.5升V6双涡轮增压机组，输出680 PS，采用四驱布局，前轴配备272 PS电机。包括小林可梦伟和中岛一贵在内的车手阵容横扫了勒芒站在内的WEC赛季全部6站比赛，标志着终极跑车时代的开启。
officialDetails.heroEn: Four consecutive wins at Le Mans for Toyota with this prototype race car
officialDetails.heroZh: Toyota的这款原型赛车在勒芒比赛中获得4连胜，从而在超跑时代伊始登上了舞台的正中央。

brandCentral.en:
This GR010 HYBRID was Toyota’s all-new entry for
the 2021 World Endurance Championship (WEC).

The 2021 season saw the introduction of
a ‘Hypercar’ category.

This top-tier class is the successor to the LMP1.

In any event, the GR010 HYBRID was built
specifically for the Hypercar Class.

This Car No. 7 claimed a victory in the fourth round
of the 2021 WEC event at Le Mans.

It was driven by Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi
and José María López.

To top things off, Car No. 8 followed right
on its heels, placing in second.

Therefore, in its first Le Mans attempt, the GR010 HYBRID
claimed an impressive one-two finish.

With this, Toyota was able to extend its winning streak to
four straight Le Mans victories since 201
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GR010 HYBRID是Toyota为
2021年世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）准备的全新参赛车辆。

2021赛季，锦标赛引进了“超级跑车”组别。

这个顶级类别可以视作是LMP1的继承者。

总而言之，GR010 HYBRID是特别为“超级跑车”
级别而设计的。

这辆幸运的7号赛车由迈克·康威、小林可梦伟
和何塞·马里亚·洛佩斯驾驶。

在勒芒的2021 WEC第四轮比赛中取得了冠军。

锦上添花的是，8号赛车也紧随其后冲线，名列第二亚军。

也就是说，GR010 HYBRID在勒芒的第一次亮相，
就令人惊叹地包揽了冠亚军。

算下来，Toyota自2018年以来已经在勒芒取得四连冠了。

catch.zh: Toyota的这款原型赛车在勒芒比赛中获得4连胜，从而在超跑时代伊始登上了舞台的正中央。

vehicleCollection.en:
Four consecutive wins at Le Mans for Toyota with this prototype race carQ

With the LMP1-class TS050 Hybrid, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing captured two consecutive titles in the 2018–2019 and 2019–2020 World Endurance Championship seasons, along with three straight victories at Le Mans. But from 2021 onward, new regulations shifted the top level of competition to the LMH class. To meet these new conditions, Toyota developed the GR010 HYBRID.

As a completely new design, the GR010 differed from the TS050 in many ways, most notably in its powertrain. The engine went from a <500ps> twin-turbocharged 2.4-liter V-6 to a <680ps> twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V-6. Meanwhile, the <500ps> electric motors powering both front and rear wheels were replaced by a <272ps> system driving only the front wheels. The result was a 4-wheel-drive configuration that relied on electric power at the front and engine power at the rear.

For the 2021 season, Car No. 7 was driven by Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi, and José María López, while Car No. 8 was piloted by Sébastien Buemi, Kazuki Nakajima, and Brendon Hartley. That year, Toyota secured its fourth consecutive Le Mans victory—and sixth overall—marking a triumphant start to the new Hypercar era.

officialDetails.descriptionZh: Toyota在2015年秋季的东京车展上推出了这辆S-FR轻量化跑车，并为其设定了“入门级车型也能提供完美操控性，让驾驶者在日常驾驶中享受与汽车互动”的概念。其设计中提炼了经典车型Toyota Sports 800的精髓，并针对现代品味进行了相应的更新。
officialDetails.heroEn: Toyota's exciting concept vehicle that carries on the lightweight sports-car torch established by the Sport 800.

brandCentral.en:
The S-FR was a concept vehicle unveiled at the 2015
Tokyo Motor Show.

While this lightweight RWD sports car was designed for everyday
use, it certainly turned heads at the show.

With a compact body on par with the AE86, its weight is

The design was inspired by the famous Toyota Sports 800.
brandCentral.zh:
S-FR是在2015年东京车展上发布的一款概念车。

这是一款针对日常驾驶设计的轻量级后轮驱动跑车，生
来就拥有一种引人注目的特质！

它的设计灵感来自于鼎鼎大名的早期跑车Toyota Sports 800。

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's exciting concept vehicle that carries on the lightweight sports-car torch established by the Sport 800.

The S-FR was a concept car that the company claimed to “provide perfect control in an entry model, allowing the driver to enjoy interacting with the car in its everyday use.”

One look at the body, and the connection to the Sport 800 was obvious by its long nose and rounded body, but the lines and general design of the car had been updated to incorporate modern styling cues.

The only specifications Toyota released for the car were its measurements. It rode on a <2480mm>-wheelbase, while its overall dimensions were <3990mm>, <1695mm>, and <1320mm>, length, width and height, respectively. The four-passenger vehicle possessed a front/rear weight distribution of 50/50 with two passengers on board. The gearbox was designated as a 6-speed manual.

At the 2016 Tokyo Auto Salon, Toyota displayed the S-FR Racing Concept. Based on the S-FR, it featured a number of carbon fiber aerodynamic parts, including fender flares, front spoilers, canards and a large rear wing. Toyota showed that its exciting new concept was sporty enough to become a track-only model if customers so desired.

long.zh:
丰田S-FR是丰田推出的一款轻量级跑车。这款概念赛车定位于入门车型也能提供完美的操控感受，让驾驶者在日常使用中也能感受到与车辆互动的乐趣。

其车体设计包含了著名的丰田Sports 800的元素，有着较长的前鼻和可爱的圆润车身。同时加入时尚元素，使其设计适应现代市场的品味。

在2015年全球首次亮相时，其引擎与其他信息并未披露，只提供了车身大小等尺寸信息：<2480mm>的轴距、长度<3990mm> x 宽度<1695mm>、车高<1320mm>，以及这将是一款四座车型。前后配重比在两名乘客时达到50:50，变速箱将采用6档手动变速箱。

在2016年1月的东京汽车沙龙上，丰田还展出了一款S-FR Racing Concept。基于S-FR灵动和简约的风格，这一车型被赋予了碳纤维空力组件，包括挡泥板、前下部扰流板、前翼和大尺寸的尾翼。通过不断探索发挥最佳赛道表现的设计，他们展示了S-FR的全新可能。

vehicleCollection.en:
The racing version of the attention-getting S-FR concept car.)

The Toyota made a splash at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show when it unveiled the S-FR. The sporty car was compact, measuring only <3990mm> in overall length and sitting <1695mm> wide. It weighed a mere <980kg>, which meant that this stylish car with the long nose and short rear deck was quick and fun to drive. Despite the fact that Toyota said it had no plans to produce the car, it nonetheless generated quite a bit of interest from the show goers.

The race version of this car, called the S-FR Racing Concept, was introduced at the 2016 Tokyo Auto Salon. This concept vehicle sported flared fenders, increasing the S-FR's width by <20mm> on each side. Other visual enhancements included a large air outlet on the hood, carbon-fiber front spoiler, rear wing, side skirts and rear diffuser. The end result was a car that appeared to be a serious GT racing machine.

While the road-going S-FR's overall height was <1320mm>, the race car sat <50mm> lower, at <1270mm>. Underneath sheet metal, the suspension was lowered and most likely stiffened, while the front brakes utilize drilled disks and horizontally opposed 4-pot calipers.

No details regarding the engine were offered, and there was no mention of it actually going on sale.

long.zh:
丰田S-FR的概念赛车于2015年的东京车展上公开。这款跑车尺寸小巧，长度仅有<3990mm>，宽度则是<1695mm>，重量仅有<980kg>。加上较长的前鼻和短车身的设计风格，以及前中置引擎、后轮驱动的布局，给人以易于驾驶的第一印象。尽管没有制定商用计划，但它还是在车展上吸引了相当多的注意力。

这款车的赛车版便是S-FR Racing Concept，于2016年东京汽车沙龙上展出。顾名思义，此车也是一款概念赛车。

其配备了两侧各外扩<20mm>的挡泥板、引擎盖上设有大型出风口，还装备了碳纤维空气动力套件，如前部的大型扰流板、尾翼、侧包围和后扩散器，这些额外配件使其从原版的可爱风格摇身一变，展现出一台超级跑车的形象。

尽管S-FR的公路版本高度也只有<1320mm>，但赛车版本的车高进一步降低<50mm>，达到了<1270mm>，由于底盘与路面之间几乎没有空隙，悬挂设定估计也会偏硬。前刹车使用了钻孔刹车碟和水平对向的4活塞卡钳。

目前该车引擎的信息尚未公布，也并没有未来进入量产的消息。不过，在所有参展该年汽车沙龙的车型中，此车依然获得了相当高的关注度。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 2000 by British sports car manufacturer TVR, this two-door coupe featured a detachable roof and a distinctive exterior design that blended bold curves with aggressive lines. Power came from TVR’s in-house developed 4.0L inline-6, known as the Speed 6, which produced 359 HP. With a lightweight body tipping the scales at just 2425 lbs, the car delivered truly staggering performance.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这款双门轿跑由跑车制造商TVR于2000年推出，采用了活动式顶篷和有趣而又犀利的曲线外观设计。它配备了一款内部团队开发、被称为“Speed 6”的4升直列6缸引擎，能够输出365 PS的动力，而车重也仅有1,100 公斤，具备不可思议的性能素质。
officialDetails.heroEn: This unique machine offers a classic sports car feel to enthusiast drivers of today.
officialDetails.heroZh: 独特的双门跑车，在今天又重现了经典跑车的观感。

usedCar.en:
The TVR Tuscan Speed Six is a racing car that exudes
the thrill of the track.

It features a 'Speed Six' 4L straight-six engine developed
by TVR themselves.

With its mighty roar and exceptional torque, it's no
wonder the engine features in the name of the car!

Despite boasting a maximum power of <360ps>,
it weighs in at a mere <1100kg>.
usedCar.zh:
TVR Tuscan Speed Six这款赛车能把赛道本身的刺激
体现得淋漓尽致。

它搭载了由TVR自主开发的
“Speed Six”4升直列六缸引擎。

该款引擎能发出巨大的轰鸣声，拥有非凡的扭矩，
难怪这款车型冠名了它的名字！

尽管拥有高达<360ps>的最大马力，
这辆车却只重<1100kg>。

vehicleCollection.en:
This unique machine offers a classic sports car feel to enthusiast drivers of today.

TVR, a name derived from the first name of founder Trevor Wilkinson, is noted for making high-performance specialty cars, British coachworks style.

The company's first production car, the Grantura, made its debut in 1958, and featured the skillful combination of components from existing production cars such as Volkswagens and Austin Healeys, wrapped in sporty, head-turning body styles.

Another model was the Tuscan, that, despite its racing struggles in the 1960s, was resurrected in 2000, armed with a bevy of new features. The 2-seat, 2-door car didn't share the styling of its predecessor. It came equipped with a detachable roof, making it look as good as a convertible as it did as a coupe.

Its eye-catching exterior, highlighted by a wild face, made the car look big, but in fact, the car possessed modest dimensions. Its overall length, width and height measured <4235mm>, <1810mm> and <1200mm>, respectively, while the wheelbase was stretched to <2361mm>. The Speed 6 got its name from the number of cylinders in the engine.

Two inline-6s were available; a 3.6-liter model and a 4.0-liter model. The latter featured the day's latest racing technologies, including dry-sump lubrication. Output was rated at <365ps> and <42.86kgm> of torque, and when this power was coupled with the car's lean <1100kg> body, the Speed 6's acceleration was impressive, to say the least. It sprinted to <100km/h> in less than 4.0 seconds, making it one of the quickest cars of its day.

long.zh:
特维尔公司以创始人特雷沃·威尔金森的名字而命名，这是一家研发专业车辆的英国汽车制造商。他们的首款量产车是1958年上市的Grantura。从那时起，他们就树立起自己独特的风格，以玻璃纤维强化塑胶车身搭配来自大众和奥斯汀-海利等公司量产车的部件，制造拥有高驾驶性能的车辆。

2000年上市的Tuscan是继承了一款同名跑车精髓的新车，后者曾是1960年代在各大赛道上闻名遐迩的著名车款。

这款双门双座轿跑风格独特，在车身多处使用了圆润的曲线设计，和其初代型号几乎没有相似之处。如今它依然是全球最风格独特的造型之一。

由于这诱人的造型，车体的尺寸看起来相当大，但实际上整车还是比较紧凑的，尺寸仅为<4235mm>长，<1810mm>宽，<1200mm>高。轴距也相当短，只有<2361mm>。

动力单元是一台自主研发的4升双顶置凸轮轴6缸引擎。名称中的“Speed 6”也正是来自这台6缸引擎。它配备了干式润滑系统和油式冷却，6缸直列节流阀体则负责控制进气，制造工艺堪比赛车发动机。

动力输出为<365ps>，最大扭矩是<42.86kgm>，可让只有<1100kg>重的车身迅猛加速。

从各个角度来看，这都不是一款非常现代的车款，但却是一辆可以享受纯粹的，不经雕琢的跑车体验的车款。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Tesla Model 3 is a compact battery-electric sedan. At the top of the lineup sat the Performance Dual Motor AWD variant, capable of accelerating from zero to 62.1 mph in just 3.3 seconds and reaching a top speed of 162.2 mph. Under WLTP testing—the global standard for electric and fuel efficiency—it offered an impressive maximum range of 339.9 miles. In 2023, it received its first major update, introducing refinements to the front fascia, overall length, and interior controls.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Tesla Model 3是一款紧凑型纯电动轿车。车系中最强悍的车型是Performance Dual Motor AWD版本，0-100 公里/小时加速时间仅需3.3秒，最高时速可达261 公里/小时。在WLTP测试（电力和燃油效率国际标准）下，这款车的最大续航里程达到547 公里。2023年，它迎来了首次重大更新，前脸造型、车身长度和控制系统均有所改变。
officialDetails.heroEn: A best-seller from the company that changed the EV market forever.
officialDetails.heroZh: 彻底改变了电动汽车行业的企业所推出的销冠产品。

brandCentral.en:
The Model 3 is Tesla’s entry model,
and a compact sedan EV.

Much like the Model S, it has a sporty design
that is almost coupe-like in appearance.

Powered by two motors at the front and rear,
this is one car that does not underperform.

Capable of going from 0-100 km/h in just 3.3 seconds,
this 4WD sedan can accelerate like a super sports car!

The interior of the car is, naturally, as thoroughly
Tesla as the exterior...

With many of the car’s controls laid out on a 15-inch
touchscreen.
brandCentral.zh:
Model 3是Tesla的入门车款，也是一辆紧凑型电动轿车。

和Model S类似，它采用了运动型外观设计，形似双门轿车。

Model 3的前后轮各由一部电机驱动，
在性能方面丝毫没有妥协。

这款四驱版本的加速性能可以媲美超级跑车，
能够在3.3秒内完成0-100 km/h的加速！

这款车将大量的控制模块集中布置在一块15英寸触摸屏上……

而内饰方面也和外观一样，拥有鲜明的特斯拉风格。>

vehicleCollection.en:
A best-seller from the company that changed the EV market forever.

The Tesla Model 3, an EV sedan introduced in 2016, was one of Tesla's smaller models, measuring <4695mm> long, <1850mm> wide and <1445mm> tall. Rumor has it that it was designed with considerations for Japanese mechanical parking garages.

Inside the sporty 5-door hatchback style body was a surprisingly simple cabin. You couldn't find any switches on the dashboard or on the center console because nearly every car function, from the climate control to the "autopilot" system, was operated through a 15-inch touch screen. What's more, many of these functions could also be managed on your smartphone.

The most powerful model in the lineup was the Performance Dual Motor AWD grade, which was available until 2023. This all-wheel-drive system placed an electric motor on each of the front and rear axles and, while the total system output was never officially published, the car was able to run to <100km/h> in 3.3 seconds and reach a top speed of <261km/h>. Based on these figures and its retail price tag, the Model 3 had very few rivals in cost-to-performance ratio.

The claimed battery range was <547km> as calculated by the WLPT cycle, an international test standard for energy consumption.

In September 2023, the Model 3 received its first major change since its debut. The car grew slightly, to <4720mm> in overall length, and wore a sharper looking front fascia. Inside, the dashboard and controls looked more similar to other Tesla models.

long.zh: 特斯拉Model 3是一款于2016年首次发布的电动轿车。它的车身长<4695mm>、宽<1850mm>、高<1445mm>，是特斯拉尺寸最紧凑的车型，明显考虑到了日本的机械式立体车库的需求。它的5门掀背车身充满运动感，但车辆内部却出奇地朴实无华。仪表板和中控台上几乎没有任何开关，从空调到“自动驾驶”系统，几乎所有功能都通过一块15英寸触摸屏进行控制。许多功能也可以通过智能手机上的特斯拉应用程序进行控制。产品线中性能最强的型号是从首发起至今一直在售的Performance Dual Motor AWD版本。这套全轮驱动系统在前后轴各安装了一部电机，尽管官方并未公布总输出，不过这辆车可以在3.3秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，极速可达<261km/h>。以这样的性能数据和市场售价，Model 3可以说在性价比方面全无敌手。根据全球统一轻型汽车测试规程的续航标准计算，其电池续航能力据称可达<547km>。在2023年9月，Model 3迎来了自首发后的第一次重大更新。新款车型的长度略有增加，达到了<4720mm>，并换上了更犀利的前脸设计，以及与其他特斯拉车型更为类似的仪表板和控制台。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: This vehicle marked Tesla’s second production model, following the Roadster. Its spacious sedan form incorporated a rear hatch, classifying it as a 5-door. Buyers could choose from three distinct battery capacities, each aligned with a specific price tier. At the top of the range, the Signature Performance variant delivered 410.3 HP and 441.2 ft-lb of torque, firmly placing it in supercar territory.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是电动车巨头Tesla继Roadster之后推出的第二款车。它采用了大尺寸轿车车身和掀背式后备箱，成为一款五门车型。根据不同的价位，消费者还可以选择三种不同的电池容量。其中最高档的高性能签名版能够输出416 PS/61.0 公斤力米的动力，使其足以跻身超级跑车的行列。
officialDetails.heroEn: A stylish 5-door sedan introduced by Tesla, the pioneer of electric cars.
officialDetails.heroZh: 由电动汽车的先锋企业特斯拉打造的别具一格的5门轿车。

brandCentral.en:
Tesla is a pioneer in the manufacturing of electric
vehicles, and the Model S is its most iconic car.

You won't believe how fabulous it feels to drive!

Thanks to its low centre of gravity, typical of electric
vehicles, it handles like a dream.

And wait till you see how well it takes corners—
It’s just like a fully-fledged sports car!
brandCentral.zh:
Tesla是制造电动车的先驱，而Model S是其最具代表性的车型。

您不会相信它的驾驶感觉有多么美妙！

catch.en: A stylish 5-door sedan introduced by Tesla, the pioneer of electric cars.
catch.zh: 由电动汽车的先锋企业特斯拉打造的别具一格的5门轿车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A stylish 5-door sedan introduced by Tesla, the pioneer of electric cars.

In 2006, Tesla Motors introduced its open-air, 2-seat electric car (EV), the Tesla Roadster. At this time, many car companies were still figuring out how to make electric cars viable in the marketplace. Delivery of the Lotus Elise-based sports car began in 2008, and by 2012, all 2500 units were sold.

The company's second model, a 5-door sedan introduced in 2009, was called the Model S. It was a much larger vehicle than its predecessor, being somewhere between a Mercedes S-Class and E-Class in terms of size.

Designed by Franz von Holzhausen, formerly with Mazda's North American Design Center, the Model S featured a sharp nose and short front and rear overhangs, giving it a sporty stance and a luxurious demeanor. The interior featured environmentally-friendly materials, including 100-percent recyclable PET plastic and no-lead Italian leather. Taking center stage was a large 17-inch touch screen monitor on the center dash that acted like a computer, including having 3G wireless capabilities that allowed continuous connection to the internet.

Providing the power was a liquid-cooled 9-inch motor with lithium-ion batteries that were mounted under the car’s floor to ensure a low center of gravity. The battery pack came in three different configurations, with the most expensive one offering a total driving distance of <483km> and producing a whopping <416ps>. All versions could be charged via a household outlet, compatible with 110V, 220V and 440V types. The total charging time was four hours when using a 220V charger, and only 45 minutes when using a 440V charger.

The Model S was among the quickest performance sedans in the marketplace, with a 0-to-60-mph time of 4.4 seconds. It indeed offered the best of both worlds: a clean-burning luxury sedan with sports car performance.

long.zh:
美国车辆制造商特斯拉汽车首次公布其旗下的两座敞篷电动跑车，还要追溯到2006年。在那个年代，当大部分汽车制造商仍在试验如何将电动车推向市场时，捷足先登的特斯拉已经在2008年开始供货。截止2012年，他们已经完售了预订生产的2500台订单，坚定不移地将脚步迈向了带入大众市场。

特斯拉产品线的第二款车型是一款五门轿车Model S，发布于2009年。车身尺寸介于梅赛德斯的E级和S级之间。其外观设计出自前马自达北美公司设计师弗朗兹·冯·霍尔兹豪森之手，拥有时尚的紧凑前鼻和极短的前后悬间距。

内饰部分全部采用环保材料，包括100%可回收的PET塑料和无铅意大利皮革。内饰面板部分被一块17英寸的触摸屏占据，所有信息都会汇聚到这里处理，并且提供可选的3G联网服务。

其动力总成是一套全新设计的液冷电机，以及底板之下铺得满满当当的锂电池组。根据定价，可向用户提供3档容量不同的电池组，最高容量下可支持300英里的总驾驶里程。特斯拉支持家用电充电，同时兼容110伏、220伏和440伏电压。使用220伏充电时，需要4个小时充满。如果换用440伏电压，充电时间可缩短至45分钟。

特斯拉 S的顶级性能可以输出<416ps>和<61.2kgm>最大扭矩，远超出普通运动车型的范畴。0-60英里的加速时间仅需4.4秒。

conversation.en:
The year 1967 marked a milestone in Japanese motorsports history.

The country hosted its very first 24-hour endurance race
at the newly opened Fuji Speedway.

Long-distance endurance races like Le Mans had been
a European tradition since the 1920s.

But with their arrival in Japan, a new chapter
in motorsport history began.

And the winner of that historic inaugural
Fuji 24 Hours?

It was none other than the Toyota works team,
racing this 2000GT!

It was driven by the legendary duo of Shihomi Hosoya
and co-driver Yoshio Otsubo.
|

细谷四方洋和领航员大坪善男。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Unveiled in 1967, the Toyota 2000GT blended engineering excellence with timeless design, instantly capturing the hearts of sports car enthusiasts. It made its mark on the track as well, setting a world record at 136.7 mph on the Yatabe test course. Global fame followed when it appeared as James Bond’s car in "You Only Live Twice."
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1967年首次亮相的Toyota 2000GT是许多人的梦想之车，其设计、工程构造和性能均超乎当时汽车爱好者的期待。该车还在赛道上斩获无数胜利，并且在谷田部测试赛道上跑出了220 公里/小时的速度，创下了世界纪录。此车在全球声名鹊起，甚至在电影《雷霆谷》中作为邦德的座驾登上了银幕。
officialDetails.heroEn: Considered to be Japan's first supercar, this special car possessed originality in both style and mechanics.
officialDetails.heroZh: 日本汽车史上的梦幻车型，造型和机械技术都充满创意。

collection.en:
Toyota's 2000GT ranks among the most beautiful GT cars
in history.

It is truly a masterpiece of Japanese car design.

When it debuted in 1967, it sold for a little over
two million yen, or around $6,800.

Today, it would fetch high six figures in dollars.

A minor design modification in 1969 divides the 2000GTs
into early models and late models.

The 2000GT competed in numerous speed trials
where it set records.

It was even raced by Carroll Shelby in 1968.

All in all, it's a fabulous car, and one which you can enjoy
owning for many years.
collection.zh:
作为日本汽车设计的伟大杰作之一，

Toyota 2000GT已跻身世界上最美丽的GT跑车之列。

当它在1967年首次亮相时，售价只略高于200万日元，在当
时约等于6800美元。

如今，它的售价按美元计算已达到六位数的天价。

按照1969年的小改款划分，2000GT可以被分为早期和后期型号。

2000GT参加了许多速度测试，并创下多项项速度记录，

甚至在1968年的比赛中担任Carroll Shelby的座驾。

总之，这辆无与伦比的车在您的收藏中停上多少年都依
然值得回味。

catch.en: Considered to be Japan's first supercar, this special car possessed originality in both style and mechanics.
catch.zh: 日本汽车史上的梦幻车型，造型和机械技术都充满创意。

vehicleCollection.en:
Considered to be Japan's first supercar, this special car possessed originality in both style and mechanics.

Called Japan’s first exotic or supercar by some, the Toyota 2000GT was certainly revolutionary as far as Japanese cars went. The smooth, flowing lines of the 2000GT were reminiscent of European super cars of the day, and it was built on a backbone chassis.

Underneath its long hood was a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-6, based on the top-of-the-line Crown powerplant, which produced <150ps>. This engine was jointly developed by Yamaha. The famous motorcycle/musical instrument maker also provided the wood grain on the car’s dashboard with materials it used for its world-class pianos.

The car’s suspension was also first rate, with double wishbones at both front and rear. But the Toyota 2000GT was not all about beauty. This highly tuned machine was able to win several times on the Fuji Speedway and Suzuka circuit, even establishing the international speed record on the Yatabe test course going as fast as <220km/h>. Two special convertible versions were produced for the James Bond movie, “You Only Live Twice,” giving the Toyota sports car worldwide appeal.

Sales of such a high-end sports car were not stellar, especially one with a price tag of 2,380,000 yen, which was twice as expensive as the luxury model Crown, and Toyota was faced with the hard reality of ceasing the car’s production after making only 300 cars.

long.zh:
丰田2000GT是一款日本代表性的经典车型。

此车在1967年如彗星般闪现，是一款远远超出当时的汽车爱好者想象的梦幻之车。该车采用子弹造型的双门车身，力图将空气阻力减小到最低，这种设计带来的震撼在之后的数年里一直为人们所津津乐道。

此车的机械部件几乎与任何量产车都不同。应用大截面的背骨式车架，前后配备完全独立的双叉臂悬挂。引擎采用前置安装，是一款马力为<150ps>的2升双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎。这款引擎是与雅马哈联合开发的，后者在车型设计的其他方面也有贡献，如在木制仪表板上使用了钢琴材料。

丰田2000GT不止拥有外观上的美。经过深度调校的2000GT在富士和铃鹿耐力赛上取得了无数的胜利，并在谷田部测试赛道上创下了国际速度纪录。在当时的日本，有谁能想象得到<220km/h>的速度纪录？此车在全球声名鹊起，在007系列电影的第五部作品《雷霆谷》中，一辆特殊敞蓬版的2000GT作为邦德的座驾登上了银幕。

丰田自己也知道，这样的超级跑车不会有多少销量。这款车的标价高达238万日元，是豪华轿车皇冠的两倍。虽然还推出了出口美国的自动档版本以及采用性能较弱引擎的版本，2000GT最终只生产了300辆左右就告停产。

丰田2000GT不止拥有外观上的美。经过深度调校的2000GT在富士和铃鹿耐力赛上取得了无数的胜利，并在谷田部测试赛道上创下了国际速度纪录。在当时的日本，有谁能想象得到<220km/h>的速度纪录？此车在全球声名鹊起，在007系列电影的第五部作品《雷霆谷》中，一辆特殊敞蓬版的2000GT作为邦德的座驾登上了银幕。

丰田自己也知道，这样的超级跑车不会有多少销量。这款车的标价高达238万日元，是豪华轿车皇冠的两倍。虽然还推出了出口美国的自动档版本以及采用性能较弱引擎的版本，2000GT最终只生产了300辆左右就告停产。

The development of the Toyota 86 started at the Nürburgring
in 2011.

The first time the test drivers got a taste of the 86,
they were somewhat underwhelmed.

One of them said after driving it, "We realized we had to
rebuild the car from scratch."

The production and race versions of the 86 were both
developed at the same time.

The race car took part in races such as the
Nürburgring 24 Hours.

The experiences from those races were used to improve the
production car, which is the car here.

In fact, the developers ended up referring to this one as
the "ultimate 86"!

Toyota86的开发始于2011年的纽博格林赛道。

开发测试车手与86的第一次邂逅，并没有擦出火花。

其中一位车手指出，“我们意识到我们必须从头开始重新

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Available exclusively through online orders beginning in January 2016, the 86 GRMN was a fully tuned machine crafted by Toyota, based on its beloved 86 sports car. Beyond structural enhancements, its center of gravity was further lowered through the extensive use of lightweight materials. A host of additional refinements were made—not only was power output increased, but the car also received a newly developed close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission, upgraded brakes, and staggered tire sizing between the front and rear.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 86 GRMN于2016年1月开始发售，且仅提供网络渠道的预订。这款车是以Toyota备受欢迎的“86”跑车为原型，经过完整调校而诞生的车型。除了进行结构强化之外，这款车还通过采用轻量化材料，将整体重心降低。此外它还接受了一系列其他改装。首先增强的自然是它的动力，同时还换用了一套全新的密齿轮比6速手动变速箱，就连刹车也得到提升，前后轮也使用了不同尺寸的轮胎。

The Toyota 86 GRMN is the epitome of a concept car.

It employs lightweight pistons, a custom crankshaft...

And a finely-tuned exhaust system.

Furthermore, the roof and bonnet are of carbon fibre, and
the brakes have been reinforced with special materials.

Oh, and in case you're not aware, the 'MN' in the name
stands for 'Meister of Nürburgring'.

It is the direct product of knowledge and experience gained
from the Nürburgring 24 Hours race.

Dubbed the 'perfect' 86, it is the pride of Toyota.

采用轻量化活塞、定制曲轴……

此外，车顶和引擎盖用上了碳纤维材质，刹车系统也用

哦，也许您还没听说，车型名字中的“MN”是“纽博格
林大师”（Meister of Nürburgring）的缩写。

因为这款车是Toyota在纽博格林24小时耐力赛中获得的知识
和经验的直接产物。

它是Toyota的骄傲，也是大家口中的“完美”86。

vehicleCollection.en:
The "Nürburgring Meister" in the form of the Toyota 86.

The 86 GRMN is a factory-tuned version of Toyota's popular 86 sports car. The "GR" in GRMN stands for Gazoo Racing, which is Toyota's factory race division, and "MN" stands for "Meister of the Nürburgring". Gazoo Racing has participated in the classic Nürburgring 24 hour race since 2012, where it won its class twice with the 86. The 86 GRMN represents the fruits of the company's racing experience at the historic track.

For this special race car, the chassis was stiffened significantly, and the center of gravity was lowered by adding a carbon-fiber roof, hood, and trunk lid. Also, the rear windows were composed of polycarbonate plastic, which is significantly lighter than glass. Aerodynamic parts such as the front spoiler and rear wing were specifically developed to induce downforce, and the car was further lightened by becoming a 2-seater, with special Recaro bucket seats and a small diameter steering wheel.

Mechanically, the intake and exhaust components were replaced, and the friction of the internal parts were reduced to improve response and power in the high RPM ranges. As a result, both power and torque were increased from the standard model, by <19ps>/<1.2kgm>, respectively. The 86 GRMN's engine ended up producing <219ps>/<7300rpm> and <22.1kgm>/<5200rpm> of torque, and came mated to a close-ratio 6-speed gearbox.

The suspension system consisted of specially-developed dampers and springs, while the tires were developed specially for this car by Toyota and Bridgestone. The brakes featured opposed 6-pot monoblock calipers in front and a 4-pot setup at the rear.

Limited to only 100 units, the 86 GRMN was indeed a special car, and everyone seemed to realize that fact right away. Despite having a price tag that was double the price of a standard model, Toyota received more than 3000 orders for the 86 GRMN.

long.zh:
86 GRMN于2016年1月开始发售，且仅提供网络渠道的预订。这款车是以丰田备受欢迎的“86”跑车为原型，经过完全改造而诞生的车型。GRMN中的“GR”代表Gazoo Racing，这是一支代表丰田在各种赛车活动中出战的车队。“MN”则代表“纽博格林的冠军”。

Gazoo Racing自2012年起就驾驶86在纽博格林24小时耐力赛中参战，并两次获得本级别的冠军。这款86 GRMN融合了车队在比赛中积累的所有经验，是终极版的86。

底盘经过加固后硬度提高。为了降低其重心，引擎盖、后备箱盖和车顶都改用碳纤维材料，而后车窗和后三角车窗则采用聚碳酸酯塑料制成。前扰流板和尾翼等空气动力学部件经过特别设计，提高了效率。这款车仍保留了两个座位，并使用特制的Recaro赛车座椅和小直径的方向盘。

引擎更换了进气与排气零件，并减小了内部零件的磨擦力，从而在高转速时能够改善响应速度和提升动力。因此，动力和扭矩比标准版提高了<19ps>/<1.2kgm>，达到了<219ps>/<7300rpm>和<22.1kgm>/<5200rpm>。为充分利用新的特性，这辆车还配备了密齿轮比6档手动变速箱。

当然，底盘也经过了调校。悬挂采用了特别开发的减震器和弹簧，甚至轮胎也是与普利司通联合开发的特别款，而且前后轮的尺寸不同。前轮刹车系统采用了6活塞单片式卡钳，后轮则为4活塞。

86 GRMN限量生产100台。虽然其价格是标准版的两倍以上，但最终收到的订单却高达其计划产量的30倍。=

conversation.en:
In Japan, where minivans enjoy tremendous popularity,
the Toyota Alphard is the one everyone has their eye on.

One reason for its popularity is its extremely luxurious nature,
in equipment and quality.

Ever since the original model was introduced in 2002, the Alphard
has remained true to its "luxury minivan" identity.

And the 2015 third-generation model took that
premium identity to new heights.

This Executive Lounge was the third-generation Alphard’s
top-of-the-line grade.

The oversized second-row seats, unique to this version,
were the very definition of comfort!
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
在日本，厢式旅行车可是非常热门的车型。
而且更夸张的是，好像每个人都想拥有一辆Toyota Alphard。

这辆车广受欢迎的一个理由
就是借助设计和配置散发出“豪车”的风范。

自从这个型号在2002年推出第一代之后，Alphard
就始终保持着自己“豪华厢式旅行车”的定位……

而2015年的第三代更是抓住了豪华车的精髓。

这辆Executive Lounge版本是第三代Alphard的顶配，

配备有专属的超大尺寸后排座椅，
绝对是无可置疑的舒适性的天花板了！

vehicleCollection.en:
Japan's premium minivan that evolved into a high-class luxury car.

The minivan is a popular automotive category in Japan. It has become a highly competitive segment with each manufacturer vying to outdo the other. But the one vehicle that has held the undisputed title of the ultimate premium minivan is the Toyota Alphard.

Since its introduction in 2002, the Toyota Alphard redefined the category with its classy styling and smooth, quiet ride quality. Its highly premium nature has made it a popular limousine for transporting VIP guests in Japan.

The third-generation Alphard that bowed in 2015 was a refined version of its predecessor. Of note was the "Executive Lounge" luxury version that redefined the vehicle's second-row seating. Unique to the Executive Lounge were the "Executive Lounge Seats," which were one size larger than the seats of the base model, equipped with heating and ventilation as well as a folding mini-table. The quality of the leather and stitching was a major point of focus by Toyota, and the result was a high level of comfort and convenience that were comparable to a first-class airline seat.

A minor model change was performed in 2017, with output of the Alphard's 3.5-liter V-6 being increased from <280ps> to <301ps>. The transmission was also optimized with more gears, going from a 6-speed automatic to an 8-speed. Also, the Alphard's structural rigidity was enhanced, making its ride smoother and more stable than ever before.

厢式旅行车是日本所独有、且非常流行的一类多功能车。这个市场品类竞争非常激烈，每一家制造商都希望能够占据更大的市场份额。不过能够独占终极高品质厢式旅行车头衔的毫无疑问还是丰田埃尔法。

自从在2002年首次面市以来，这个型号就孜孜不倦地追求并发展“高品质厢式旅行车”的精髓。时至今日，埃尔法已经成为了接送贵客的首选礼宾车，并跻身日本最高档次的豪车之一。

2015年推出的第三代埃尔法在品质和舒适性方面进行了精益求精的打磨。其最佳的范例就是奢华档次的“行政豪华版”型号，将第二排座椅的舒适性推上了全新的高度。型号专属的“行政豪华版座椅”是比标准型号座椅尺寸更大的独立座椅，并配备有加热和通风功能，甚至还有可折叠式迷你桌。皮面和缝线的做工也是重中之重，能够提供不亚于飞机头等舱座椅的舒适性。

这个型号在2017年进行了小幅改款，其3.5升V6引擎从原本的<280ps>升级到了<301ps>，传动系统也相应优化，从6速自动挡升级到了8速自动挡。此外还有一系列改良，提升了地板和移门的刚度，并让驾驶性能和舒适性再上一层楼。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Since the 1950s, Toyota had been producing ambulances based on specially adapted passenger and commercial vehicles. The most recent of these was the third-generation Himedic, a high-standard ambulance introduced in 2006. Its platform was built on the 200 Series HiAce Super Long. With improvements such as an expanded patient compartment, this vehicle was engineered for maximum functionality in critical, life-saving situations.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 自1950年代起，Toyota便开始改装旗下的乘用车及其他商用车辆来生产救护车。最新款是2006年推出的第3代“Himedic”高规格救护车。该车车身基于200系列HiAce Super Long改造而成。相较于前代车型，这款车通过扩大后厢急救区域等改进，充分考量了在紧急救援的情况下所能提供的极致功能性。
officialDetails.heroEn: Saving lives faster and more safely.
officialDetails.heroZh: 更快、更安全地拯救生命的急救车辆。

brandCentral.en:
The Toyota Himedic is one of Japan’s most iconic
ambulatory vehicles.

Not only does it transport sick and injured persons
to the hospital...

But it is also fitted with a wealth of medical devices
necessary for saving lives...

Allowing first-responders to perform essential medical
procedures while en route to the ER.

For this reason, it is sometimes referred to as
a ‘high-standard ambulance.’

Toyota’s first Himedic made its debut in 1992, and was
the first ambulance of its kind in Japan.

The name ‘Himedic’ is a catchy portmanteau
of the words ‘high’ and ‘medical.’
brandCentral.zh:
Toyota Himedic是日本最具代表性的救护车之一。

它不仅负责将伤病员送往医院……

车内还配备有大量抢救必备的医疗设备……

让急救人员在前往急诊室的途中就能实施必要的急救操作。

因此，它有时被称为“高标准救护车”。

Toyota的第一辆Himedic于1992年首次发布，也是该类别救护车
首次在日本亮相。

“Himedic”这一名字本身便是以“高”和“医”的英文综合而成。-

vehicleCollection.en:
Saving lives faster and more safely.

Having a good ambulance can make the difference between life or death. From the 1950s, Toyota has produced ambulances made from specially outfitted passenger and commercial vehicles. The latest of these is the third-generation "Himedic" high-standard ambulance.

The body is based on the 200 Series Hiace Super Long that was outfitted by Toyota's race car development and customization team, Toyota Customizing & Development. Propelling the <5600mm> long, <1895mm> wide, <2490mm> tall body is the 2TR-FE, a 2.7-liter inline-4 gasoline engine. The front and rear of the vehicle are fitted with an all-LED array of red warning lights.

The interior was designed with the utmost functionality in a lifesaving situation. In the patient area, the high roof of the Hiace was raised even further to secure <1850mm> of vertical space, and for the first time on an ambulance of this type, it has sliding doors on both sides. Space in the patient area has also been improved over the previous model by the strategic relocation of specialized equipment such as the hand wash basin.

The third-generation Himedic received regular updates, making sure it is always up to date. In 2009, the seat layout was rearranged to increase space. In 2013, the gauges were replaced by a multifunction display as standard equipment, allowing the operators to track data such as average fuel consumption and atmospheric temperature. Also, from 2020, the Himedic came with the Toyota Safety Sense, a preventative safety package, as standard equipment, and the 4-speed automatic transmission was upgraded to a 6-speed unit.

In November 2020, production of the Himedic reached 10,000 units, making it one of the most popular lifesaving vehicles in Japan.

long.zh:
一辆可靠的救护车是救死扶伤的急救医疗人员最坚实的伙伴。自1950年代起，丰田便开始改装旗下的乘用车及其他商用车辆，并作为救护车出售。最新推出的救护车便是第三代“海医”高规格标准救护车。

该车车身由海狮超长版200系列的出口型号改装而成，并交由丰田的赛车开发与改装团队丰田改装与研发部精心调校。为这台<5600mm>长、<1895mm>宽、<2490mm>高的庞然大物提供充沛动力的是一台2.7L、2TR-FE直列4缸汽油引擎。车身前后都加装了全LED矩阵红色警示灯。

其内部设计的宗旨，便是在紧急救援的情况下提供最大的功能性。在后厢急救区域，海狮本来已经不低的车顶被加到了<1850mm>，以提供更充裕的垂直空间；并且，在同类救护车中，海医是第一个在左右两侧都安装了滑动门的车型。丰田还重新规划了急救区域中诸如手部清洗池等设备，来为急救人员提供更多操作空间。

另外，丰田会为第三代海医进行周期性更新，以确保其能够与时俱进。在2009年，丰田调整了海医的座椅布局来为内部提供更多空间。在2013年，海医的传统仪表盘被替换成了全系标配的多功能显示系统，以便操作人员查看平均油耗、气温等信息。还有，自2020年起，海医车型将开始全系标配有着规避碰撞功能的“丰田智行安全”系统，原来的4速自动变速箱也将升级为6速版本。

在2020年11月，海医的总产量突破了10000辆的里程碑。这辆车是一位真正的无名英雄，它使得急救人员可以更快、更安全地拯救生命。

conversation.en:
The Toyota Prius is arguably the most popular Japanese
hybrid car.

And when it comes to subcompacts, the most popular
could well be the Toyota Aqua.

Outside of Japan, the Aqua is marketed as the "Prius C."

But perhaps I'm getting ahead of myself.
Are you familiar with the term "hybrid car?"
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
Toyota Prius是日本最著名的混合动力汽车。

而如果我们再把范围缩小到紧凑型汽车的范畴，
那最著名的要属Toyota Aqua了。

在日本以外，Aqua被称为“Prius C”。

但是等等——也许我忽略了一点。
你熟悉“混合动力汽车”这个概念吗？
u

conversation.en:
Oh great! It's a car that runs on two power sources—
a fuel-burning engine and an electric motor.

Electric motors are great for accelerating, and allow
for tight control.

By balancing engine and motor power, hybrid cars offer
a very efficient driving experience.
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
conversation.speaker: Stella
conversation.zh:
太棒了！这是一种靠两种动力源运行的汽车——
燃烧燃料的引擎和电机。

电机的加速能力很强，并且可以实现精确控制。

通过平衡引擎和电机输出的动力，混合动力汽车可以
提供非常高效的驾驶体验。

Q

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展

conversation.en:
This is one of Toyota’s best designs in recent years.

It's been over a decade since this car
hit the streets.

Yet to see it today, you’d think it were novel.

The low height and its double-bubble roof result in a drag
coefficient of 0.28, allowing for a smooth ride.

From the significantly canted windscreen...

...to the drastically sloping rear, this car expresses
a bold, clear vision.
!
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.zh:
这辆车是Toyota近些年来最好的设计之一。

其实它也已经出现在街头十多年了……

但今天看到它，
还是有种新鲜感。

Toyota通过压低车身高度和采用双气泡型车顶
成功将阻力系数降低至0.28。这样的车开起来肯定很舒服。

无论是明显下探的挡风玻璃……

还是向后延、并在车尾收束下坠的利落侧面轮廓线，
都让人有耳目一新的良好感受。

conversation.en:

again sometime.

Its hybrid system was a lighter, optimized version of that used in the third-generation Prius. In JC08 fuel economy tests conducted in Japan, it reached a maximum efficiency of 83.3 MPG. Internationally, the car was marketed as the Prius C.

brandCentral.en:
The Toyota Aqua was a smaller version of the popular Prius,
equipped with the same hybrid technology.

Not only was it super fuel efficient, Toyota made the car
fun to drive!

Note that the battery is located under the rear seats.

This allows for a lower center of gravity, which in turn,
results in better handling balance.
brandCentral.zh:
Toyota Aqua通过与Prius共享的混合动力技术获益不少：

不仅超级省油，而且驾驶体验尚佳！

请注意，此车的电池位于后座下面……

这项创新设计能够降低车辆重心，从而改善其操控性。

usedCar.en:
The Toyota Aqua is one of the most fuel-efficient cars
on the planet, thanks to its hybrid drivetrain.

It comes powered by a 1.5-liter inline-4 and an electric motor.

The Aqua's system is called Hybrid Synergy Drive, which is
similar to the one used in the Prius.

The battery, which is the usually the heaviest component
of the system, is placed under the rear seats.

This results in lots of interior space and excellent weight
distribution, making this vehicle surprising fun to drive.
usedCar.zh:
丰田Aqua由1.5L四缸引擎搭配电机驱动。

这样的车被称为“混合动力汽车”。

Aqua的混合动力系统是基于Prius动力系统
特别设计。

为它提供动力的沉重电池位于后排座椅
下方，接近车的中心位置。

它绝佳的重量分配使得其能够实现精准的
转向，并提供稳定的驾驶体验。/

vehicleCollection.en:
More economical than the larger Prius, this model is helping to expand the hybrid vehicle market.

Following all the success of the Prius hybrid car, Toyota planned to release a smaller, even more economical hybrid to the market. This was meant to address those customers who were attracted to the fuel efficiency and environmental statement of the Prius, but felt it was too expensive, or too big for their everyday needs.

Enter the Aqua, which went on sale at the end of 2011. In the U.S., the car was named the Prius C. Based on the Vitz (Yaris) platform, the car's structure was significantly reinforced, while the width of the car was narrowed by <60mm> compared to that of the normal Prius. For the hybrid mechanism, the same THS II as in the third-generation Prius, with a reduction mechanism, was utilized. The Atkinson Cycle 1.5-liter engine was paired with a newly designed Type 1LM motor and a nickel-hydrogen battery. This battery is <42kg> lighter than the battery mounted in the Prius and, as a result, the car weighs <300kg> less. The gasoline engine produced <74ps>, while the electric motor generated <61ps> giving the car some welcome punch off the line.

With a more rigid front end, as well as stiffer suspension mounts, it exhibited a sporty overall ride quality. But the Aqua's real charm point was its price, which was 30 percent lower than the Prius. Fuel economy was rated at 53/46 mpg, which gives it a combined number of 50 mpg. And even though the fuel tank holds only 9.5 gallons, the Aqua can go <1274.4km> without refueling.

long.zh:
在普锐斯混动汽车大获成功之后，丰田注意到部分目标客户钟情于普锐斯经济环保的特性，但对价格望而却步，或者认为自己的住房条件或驾驶技能无法驾驭普锐斯这种大型车辆，于是计划推出更小、更经济的同类产品。

在发布了多款概念赛车之后，Aqua终于在2011年底推出，并在日本以外的市场以普锐斯C的型号名发售。以Vitz（Yaris）平台为基础，Aqua的车身有了长足改进和强化。车身宽度比普锐斯窄<60mm>。

混合动力技术为丰田混动系统II，配置有与第三代普锐斯相同的节能降档技术。阿特金森循环1.5升发动机结合了新设计的1LM型电机以及镍氢电池。和普锐斯相比，Aqua的电池轻<42kg>，汽车重量则为<1050kg>-<1080kg>，轻了<300kg>。

<74ps>的引擎和<61ps>的电机要带动这个重量的车身不在话下，而且起步速度比普锐斯更快。前段和悬挂架安装位置的刚性更高，整体行驶运动感十足。

最重要的是，Aqua全线产品的价格都比普锐斯平均低30%以上。在JC08模式的测试中，其耗油率仅为<35.4km/l>。而致享的油箱容量有36升，也就是说可以在不加油的情况下行驶<1274.4km>。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Following a series of internationally-focused models such as the Corolla and Yaris, Toyota introduced the C-HR crossover SUV in 2016, designed as a global vehicle for the modern era. This distinctive SUV also hinted at sporting ambitions, with a prototype version taking part in the Nürburgring 24 Hours race. Built on Toyota’s next-generation TNGA platform, the C-HR came with a choice of a 1.8-liter hybrid powertrain or a turbocharged 1.2-liter inline-4. The C-HR would go on to earn broad acclaim, becoming a bestseller.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 继Corolla和Yaris等多款面向国际市场的车型之后，Toyota于2016年推出了C-HR跨界SUV，这是专为21世纪打造的全新全球化车型。这款非传统SUV同样展现出作为跑车的野心，其原型车曾参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛。车身采用新一代TNGA平台，搭载1.8升混合动力单元或1.2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。C-HR获得了广泛认可，成为畅销车型。
officialDetails.heroEn: An unconventional crossover SUV that took on the Nürburgring 24 Hours.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款非传统跨界SUV曾征战过纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

brandCentral.en:
Have you ever heard of a "crossover SUV?" It combines the
ruggedness of an SUV with the sleekness of a coupe.

Here is a prime example, developed as part of Toyota’s global
strategy to meet the demands of the 21st century.

It was called the C-HR.

Measuring just <4360mm> in length, this compact car featured
a complex body design that exuded both strength and style.

It featured a 1.8-liter hybrid powertrain, delivering an impressive
fuel efficiency of <30.2km/l>, or a turbocharged 1.2-liter engine.

As Toyota envisioned, the C-HR broke records around the globe.

Practical yet sporty, a prototype of this unconventional
crossover took on the legendary Nürburgring 24 Hours race!
brandCentral.zh:
你听说过“跨界SUV”吗？这是一种将SUV的硬朗
与轿跑车的运动感完美融合的车型。

眼前的这款跨界车是Toyota为满足21世纪多样化市场需求而开发的
全球战略车型。

它就是“C-HR”。

作为一款总长仅为<4360mm>的紧凑型汽车，
其富有层次感的车身设计完美诠释了力量与时尚的结合。

搭载1.8升混合动力或1.2升涡轮增压动力总成，
其源自Prius的混合动力系统实现了<30.2km/l>的卓越燃油经济性。

C-HR不负Toyota期望，一经推出，就在全球市场创造了佳绩。

这款独特的跨界车不仅实用性强，还具备运动基因，其原型车
曾征战过纽博格林24小时耐力赛！

catch.en: An unconventional crossover SUV that took on the Nürburgring 24 Hours.
catch.zh: 这款非传统跨界SUV曾征战过纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

vehicleCollection.en:
An unconventional crossover SUV that took on the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

Toyota has a storied history of creating notable global vehicles, with the Corolla and the Yaris serving as prime examples. In 2016, the automaker unveiled a fresh entrant to its world lineup: the C-HR, a car to embody the 21st century.

The car is defined by its daring compact crossover SUV silhouette. Toyota envisioned a vehicle that could cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, combining the spaciousness and comfort of an SUV with the sporty appeal of a coupe.

This bold ambition found its foundation in Toyota’s next-generation TNGA platform, first introduced in 2015 with the fourth-generation Prius. The front suspension employed a newly developed strut system, while the rear came equipped with a double-wishbone setup. Its exterior showcased intricate, faceted surfaces that lent the vehicle a futuristic and assertive presence on the road.

Under the hood, the C-HR came with two distinct powertrains: a 1.8-liter hybrid engine, shared with the fourth-generation Prius, and a downsized turbocharged 1.2-liter 4-cylinder engine. The 1.8-liter engine came in a front-wheel-drive configuration, while the 1.2-liter was paired with all-wheel drive. The model highlighted here is the S-grade hybrid variant for the Japanese market, featuring 17-inch wheels.

True to Toyota’s vision, the C-HR quickly gained a loyal following worldwide, becoming a bestseller. Beyond its role as a practical everyday vehicle, it also carved out a niche in motorsports, with a prototype race version competing in the grueling Nürburgring 24 Hours.

包括卡罗拉和雅力士在内，丰田曾打造出多款全球热销车型。2016年，丰田推出了一款面向21世纪的全新全球车型C-HR。

这款车最大特点是其紧凑型跨界SUV的设计理念。为满足人们多样化的生活需求，丰田开发了这款全新车型，完美融合了SUV的舒适空间和轿跑车的运动特性。

该车型基于丰田在2015年首次应用于第四代普锐斯的新一代TNGA平台打造。前悬采用新开发的支柱系统，后部则是双叉臂独立悬挂结构。车身采用溜背式设计，融入复杂的多面切割造型。

动力单元方面，可选择与第四代普锐斯相同的1.8升混合动力系统，或小排量的1.2升四缸涡轮增压引擎。前者采用前轮驱动，后者则配备四轮驱动系统。这里提到的C-HR S是面向日本市场的混合动力入门版本，标配17英寸轮圈。

正如丰田预期，C-HR在全球市场广受欢迎，迅速成为畅销车型。这款非传统跨界SUV不仅因经济性和便利性备受用户的青睐，还杀入了赛车领域——其原型车曾征战过纽博格林24小时耐力赛。~

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The sixth-generation Toyota Celica made its debut in October 1993. Its futuristic design was sharpened by the distinctive quad round headlights, while a larger body emphasized its identity as a front-wheel-drive specialty car. In 1994, the GT-FOUR (ST205) appeared as a homologation model for the WRC. Its 3S-GTE turbocharged 2.0-liter engine produced 251.5 HP.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第六代Toyota Celica于1993年10月推出。Celica的未来主义造型因四个圆形大灯而更加鲜明，加上车身尺寸的增大等改变，进一步强化了其前轮驱动专精车型的形象。1994年，GT-FOUR（ST205）作为世界拉力锦标赛参赛基础车型问世。搭载的3S-GTE 2升涡轮增压引擎经过调校可输出255 PS动力。
officialDetails.heroEn: This is the WRC base model of the popular sporty coupe, complete with aluminum hood and rear spoiler.
officialDetails.heroZh: 采用了铝制引擎盖和后扰流器的世界拉力锦标赛基础车型。

usedCar.en:
Looking for a sports car that was developed specially for
motorsports?

Then the Toyota Celica GT-Four should be right up
your alley!

It's a 4WD sports car, developed by Toyota in the 1990s in
order to win the World Rally Championship.

The grade name—GT-Four—serves as proof of this.

The original Celica was a two-wheel drive coupé, but the
GT-Four is a four-wheel drive rally machine.

The engine's a mighty beast as well.

It's a 2L 3S-GTE, developed in conjunction with the
GT-Four over successive generations.

It packs a massive <255ps> of power!
usedCar.zh:
想找一辆专门为赛车运动而开发的跑车吗？

那么Toyota Celica GT-Four应该能满足您的需求！

这是一辆Toyota在上世纪90年代，
为了在世界拉力锦标赛中夺胜而专门开发出的四驱跑车。

它名字中的等级GT-Four见证了这段历史。

原版Celica是一辆双轮驱动的双门轿车，
而GT-Four是一辆四驱拉力赛车。

它还搭载了一台动力澎湃的引擎。

这台引擎是2升的3S-GTE，与GT-Four共同经历了数个世代的开发。

这台引擎能输出<255ps>的强大动力！

catch.en: This is the WRC base model of the popular sporty coupe, complete with aluminum hood and rear spoiler.
catch.zh: 采用了铝制引擎盖和后扰流器的世界拉力锦标赛基础车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is the WRC base model of the popular sporty coupe, complete with aluminum hood and rear spoiler.

The sixth-generation Toyota Celica, introduced in October 1993, solidified the model's image as one of the world's most popular front-wheel-drive sports coupes. The styling direction of the new model took a wild turn for the better, highlighted by a svelte roofline and a distinctive front fascia that featured four round headlights.

The car was powered by either the 3S-GE, a <185ps> 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the SS-II model, or the 3S-FE that produced <140ps> in the SS-I. The suspension system consisted of struts all around and disc brakes at all four corners.

In February 1994, Toyota introduced the Celica GT-Four to serve as a base for its World Rally Championship race car. The GT-Four is now known as the ultimate performance Celica, equipped with aluminum hood and a rear spoiler, with a powerful <225ps> 3S-GTE turbocharged 2.0-liter powerplant. *

long.en:
The sixth-generation Toyota Celica, introduced in October 1993, solidified the model's image as one of the world's most popular front-wheel-drive sports coupes. The styling direction of the new model took a wild turn for the better, highlighted by a svelte roofline and a distinctive front fascia that featured four round headlights.

The car was powered by either the 3S-GE, a <185ps> 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the SS-II model, or the 3S-FE that produced <140ps> in the SS-I. The suspension system consisted of struts all around and disc brakes at all four corners.

In February 1994, Toyota introduced the Celica GT-Four to serve as a base for its World Rally Championship race car. The GT-Four is now known as the ultimate performance Celica, equipped with aluminum hood and a rear spoiler, with a powerful <225ps> 3S-GTE turbocharged 2.0-liter powerplant. *
long.zh:
赛利卡在1993年10月再次进行了全面改款，推出了第六代车型。从此版本开始，它开始以一款采用未来风格的前轮驱动运动小跑车的身份脱颖而出。

第六代的主要变化在于按照日本3级车身尺寸进行了加宽。其<4435mm>的长度和<1305mm>的高度与旧款几乎相同，但其<1750mm>的宽度为赛利卡提供了新的设计潜力。它摒弃了旧款的圆润外观，升级为强调错落有致的凹凸面设计。车头灯也从之前的翻转式改为了四盏圆形车灯，这种设计重新定义了车身的前脸。

第六代车型有两款2.0 L 双顶置凸轮轴 直列4缸引擎可选，分别为可以输出<180ps>的3S-GE型号，和可以输出<140ps>的3S-FE型号。其悬挂系统采用了传统的前/后支撑轴，以及前后碟式刹车（前通风）。安装3S-FE引擎的款式称为SS-I，而安装3S-GE引擎的款式称为SS-II。SS-I可选择四轮转向，而SS-II则可以安装全新开发的超级支撑轴悬挂系统。

在1994年2月，赛利卡又为世界拉力锦标赛推出了一款类似的基础型号：GT-Four。GT-Four采用标准配置，使用了带有凸起进气口的铝制引擎盖和后扰流器，而且其3S-GTE 2.0 L涡轮增压引擎的功率输出也增加到了<255ps>。其敞篷车车款也于同年晚些时候推出。

vehicleCollection.en:
The rally machine that left an impression on many fans, though it only competed for a short time.

After capturing the double title of Driver and Constructors championships with the ST185's brilliant showing in 1993, Toyota introduced the new ST205 Celica the following year, searching for even more victories in the WRC.

Although the new Celica was bigger than its predecessor, it had better weight distribution with a longer wheelbase and wider track. The TTE works team was involved in the car's development from the very start, providing key contributions to overall aerodynamic and cooling performance.

The Celica was scheduled to appear at the 1994 1000 Lakes Rally, but because of unexpected delays in undercarriage development, it spent the 1994 season running trial races.

The Celica participated as a full-time entrant in the 1995 WRC season, battling with the newly improved Subaru Impreza. Driver Didier Auriol scored the first win for the car in the fourth round at the Tour de Corse. Although Toyota continued to experience problems with its super strut suspension, the team continued racing and making improvements throughout the season to overcome the handicap.

In the seventh round at Catalonia, the Celica was found to be in violation of the intake restrictor diameter regulation and was stripped of all points for the season. In a show of opposition to the decision, Toyota ended its participation in the WRC, which resulted in the ST205's run in the series to be limited to just one season.

Although it was only active for a short time, this machine's unmistakable silhouette imprinted itself on the hearts of many fans. When discussing Toyota's rally cars, this is one that must be mentioned.

long.zh:
在1993年以ST185惊艳亮相，夺得车手和车厂双料冠军后，丰田又在下一年度推出了这辆全新的ST205赛利卡，志在赢得更多胜利。

虽然新款赛利卡的车身更大，但其相应扩大的轴距和轮距也提升了稳定性，优化了重量分布比例。丰田厂队TTE从项目伊始就全程参与了开发，并在整体空气动力性能和散热性能等方面做出了关键贡献。

赛利卡原本计划于1994年的千湖拉力赛上亮相，但因为底盘开发意外延期，只能在赛季中参加测试比赛。

新赛利卡在1995年完整参与了整个赛季，与全新优化的斯巴鲁翼豹展开竞争，并在第四轮的科西嘉岛拉力赛中由迪迪埃·奥里奥尔夺下了首胜。尽管超级支柱式悬挂的设计问题给车队带来了各种困扰，但TTE还是坚持继续参赛，并在赛季中不断做出改良，以克服这一先天的缺陷。

在加泰罗尼亚的第七轮中，官方发现赛利卡违反了进气限制器直径规定，因此剥夺了车队整个赛季的积分。为了对这个判罚表示抗议，丰田决定不再参加世界拉力锦标赛，这也使得ST205在这项赛事的舞台上的亮相仅限于一个赛季。

尽管活跃的时间较短，这部比赛机器的英姿依然烙印在了车迷们的心中。每当谈论起拉力赛领域中的丰田品牌，就一定会提到这辆车。

That made the Chaser’s championship victory
a fitting conclusion to˅n important er

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.zh:
“Mark II”、“Chaser”和“Cresta”是Toyota旗下
豪华轿车产品阵容的三兄弟。

这款第6代Chaser因其在日本房车赛中的傲人成绩而独负盛名……

特别是它在1998年日本房车锦标赛中的惊艳表现。

此前的一年，对手Honda和Nissan
同时率旗下厂队退出了这一传奇赛事。

虽然这使得1998年赛季几乎变成了Toyota的单一车种系列赛……

但关谷正德驾驶ESSO TOM'S Chaser发挥出色，
赢得了11场比赛中的6场……

并拿下了冠军。

JTCC组别的比赛正是在那个1998年赛季宣告终止。

因此，第KChser获得的历史性胜利就更q得弥足珍贵。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Chaser was Toyota’s midsize sedan, sharing the Mark II’s fundamental design but wearing different exterior styling. The Tourer V performance model was powered by the second-generation 1JZ-GTE engine with variable valve timing, and flooring the pedal launched this beast forward with ferocious boost. The front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout provided excellent control, making the car responsive to the driver’s inputs.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Chaser是Toyota的一款中型轿车，与Mark II共享基本设计，但采用了不同的外观造型。Tourer V运动版搭载了第二代1JZ-GTE引擎，配备可变气门正时系统。踩下油门踏板，这头猛兽便伴随着强劲的增压推背感向前猛冲。前置引擎、后轮驱动的布局带来了出色的操控性，能够灵敏地响应驾驶者的每一个操作指令。

usedCar.en:
Hey there! In the market for a slightly retro FR saloon?
Then how about a 6th generation Chaser from Toyota?

A fierce-looking hardtop with concealed B-pillars, the Chaser
is the sharper sibling of the Cresta and Mark II.

The Tourer V is the Chaser's most hardcore trim, powered by
a 2.5L straight-6 second-generation 1JZ-GTE.

With <280ps> of power and <38.5kgm> of torque, this saloon
can easily go wheel-to-wheel with sports car thoroughbreds.

Need proof? Look no further than its storied win
at the 1998 Japanese Touring Car Championship!

And thanks to its robust engine, it serves as
an ideal platform for competitive drift cars.

Perennially popular among gearheads, the Chaser
is a high-performance saloon with a hidden wild side.
usedCar.zh:
你好啊！在找稍微带点经典风格的前驱轿车吗？
要不要看看Toyota的第6代Chaser？

Chaser是一辆风格硬朗、隐藏了B柱的硬顶车，
是Cresta、Mark II更加犀利的姐妹款。

Tourer V的配置在Chaser车型中是最硬核的，
搭载一台2.5升直列6缸第二代1JZ-GTE引擎。

其输出动力达<280ps>、扭矩<38.5kgm>，
能和纯血跑车轻松进行轮对轮的较量。

不信吗？只要看看它在1998年日本房车锦标赛上
传奇的冠军经历就知道了！

由于其结实耐用的引擎，它也是比赛用漂移赛车的理想改装平台。

Chaser在热衷改装的车迷圈子里享有经久不衰的人气，
是隐藏了狂野一面的高性能轿车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This sister to the Toyota Mark II provides an intense drive.

The Chaser was a midsize sedan that shared the same basic construction as the Mark II but offered different exterior styling. Of the Mark II, Chaser and Cresta sister cars, the Chaser offered the sportiest character and became the favorite of driving enthusiasts. The Tourer V was a performance-grade Chaser model featuring a turbocharged engine. The Tourer V grade was also available on the Mark II.

The version shown here was a sixth-generation Chaser Tourer V, also known as the X100 series. The engine was a second-generation 1JZ-GTE with variable valve timing and a single-turbocharger system, producing a dramatic driving feel. Pressing the throttle pedal delivered a surge of boost and fierce acceleration, while the front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout delivered predictable control and responsive handling.

While the engine was obviously powerful, it also had excellent reliability, leading the Chaser to be lauded as a tuning base car. The more work you put into it, the more intense the driving experience this exceptional FR sedan provided.

这里展示的是第六代Chaser Tourer V，即X100系列。它的引擎是第二代1JZ-GTE，具备可变气门正时，并采用单涡轮增压系统，营造出动感强烈的驾驶感受。踩下油门，涡轮增压瞬间爆发，加速迅猛，而前置后驱布局则提供了易于预判的操控特性和灵敏的响应。

这台引擎不仅动力强劲，而且极其可靠，使得Chaser被誉为绝佳的改装平台。只要愿意花时间改装调校，这款卓越的前置后驱轿车就能回馈给你激情澎湃的驾驶体验。

conversation.en:
The most appealing aspect of the AE86 is the experience it
offered to spirited-driving enthusiasts.

It was a rear-wheel-drive coupe that offered excellent control
and a highly engaging drive.

In the well-known Japanese comic series “Initial D,”
the sister model, the Trueno, took center stage.

However, many enthusiasts favored the Levin.

One reason was weight.

The Levin, with its fixed headlights, was approximately
<5kg> lighter than the Trueno.

In a car this light, an extra <5kg> over the front axle could make
a noticeable difference in handling.

conversation.zh:
AE86最吸引人的要素朴实无华，就在于它的驾驶感。

这是一款操纵感极强的后驱双门轿车，给驾驶者带来非

著名的日本漫画《头文字D》就将Levin的姐妹车Trueno

原因在于车重的差异。

配有固定头灯的Levin要比Trueno轻<5kg>。

在这么轻的车头上多出的<5kg>，会带来天差地别的影响。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The fourth-generation Corolla Levin was introduced in 1983. It carried over the floor panel from the previous TE71 and was the only model of its generation to retain a rear-wheel-drive layout, while all other Corollas had transitioned to front-wheel drive. The 1.6-liter 4A-GEU DOHC engine and lightweight body delivered a sharp, responsive driving experience. After production ended, demand for affordable rear-wheel-drive cars only grew, securing this model’s legacy as one of the greatest sports cars ever produced by Toyota.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这是1983年首次亮相的第四代Corolla Levin。该车型延续了前代TE71的底盘结构，在同代车型中独树一帜地保持了后轮驱动布局，而其他所有Corolla车型都已改为前轮驱动。1.6升4A-GEU双顶置凸轮轴引擎与轻量化车身的完美结合，成就了灵敏迅捷的驾驶体验。停产后市场对经济型后驱车的需求反而日益高涨，进一步确立了它作为Toyota史上最经典运动车型之一的不朽地位。
officialDetails.heroEn: The now legendary AE86, a compact rear-drive coupe that emphasized driving excitement.
officialDetails.heroZh: 紧凑型后轮驱动车的传奇，带来令人颤栗的驾驶体验。

usedCar.en:
Toyota's Corolla Levin, aka AE86, has become the stuff of legends,
especially after being featured in manga and the movies!

It isn't the most powerful car around, with <130ps> coming
from its 4-cylinder engine, but it does rev to <7000rpm>!

What most fans love about it is that it has a front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive layout, or FR as we say in the industry.

It's light and agile, and wonderfully fun to drive. I would
recommend that you put one in your garage!
usedCar.zh:
AE86 Corolla Levin是一款由Toyota制造的紧凑型前置后驱车，
亦是一项工程杰作——这辆车一年比一年受欢迎。

虽然<130ps>的输出功率不高，
但它的自然吸气四缸引擎能达到<7000rpm>的转速！

除此之外，它轻巧的车身和后驱布局也使
得它很适合在赛道上疾驰。

在经过适当的调校后，Levin有能力在各种赛事中比拼，
所以在车库里备一辆有利无弊！

catch.en: The now legendary AE86, a compact rear-drive coupe that emphasized driving excitement.
catch.zh: 紧凑型后轮驱动车的传奇，带来令人颤栗的驾驶体验。

vehicleCollection.en:
The now legendary AE86, a compact rear-drive coupe that emphasized driving excitement.

Already considered a classic among enthusiasts today, this compact car has become a favorite for drifters and has been featured in movies and comic books. The car has its roots from the Corolla/Sprinter, but when this model changed its layout to FF (front engine/front drive), the sporty version in the lineup, the AE86 or Corolla Levin/Sprinter Trueno, remained as a rear-wheel driver.

The "86" (or Hachi-Roku, as it was called in Japan) developed an immediate following because of its rear-drive layout, lightweight, excellent handling and affordable price tag. It came in two shapes: a 3-door hatchback and a 2-door notchback. The main difference between the Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno was the front end, where the former featured a horizontal grille and fixed headlights and the latter no grille and retractable headlights.

Providing power was the newly developed 4A-GEU, a 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4. This engine featured some of the day's most advanced technology, including EFI-D (Electronic Fuel Injection-Druck), which calculated fuel amount through a pressure sensor, and the T-VIS (Toyota Variable Injection System). This helped the 4-cylinder to produce <130ps> and <15.2kgm> of torque.

It revved freely and quick, and demonstrated excellent throttle response, making the car wonderfully controllable through tricky corners. The suspension, body and engine worked harmoniously together to provide real sports car attributes. It was this performance and personality that made the "86" loved by so many.

long.en:

The "86" (or Hachi-Roku, as it was called in Japan) developed an immediate following because of its rear-drive layout, lightweight, excellent handling and affordable price tag. It came in two shapes: a 3-door hatchback and a 2-door notchback. The main difference between the Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno was the front end, where the former featured a horizontal grille and fixed headlights and the latter no grille and retractable headlights.

Providing power was the newly developed 4A-GEU, a 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4. This engine featured some of the day's most advanced technology, including EFI-D (Electronic Fuel Injection-Druck), which calculated fuel amount through a pressure sensor, and the T-VIS (Toyota Variable Injection System). This helped the 4-cylinder to produce <130ps> and <15.2kgm> of torque.

It revved freely and quick, and demonstrated excellent throttle response, making the car wonderfully controllable through tricky corners. long.zh:
1983年5月，丰田的主流热销车型卡罗拉/Sprinter进行了一次全系大改款，全面改为前置前驱车型。惟有运动车型保留了前置后驱的布局，它就是后来脍炙人口的“86”—AE86卡罗拉Levin/Sprinter Trueno。

作为最后一款轻型前置后驱车型，86立即变得炙手可热起来。在这其中，又可分为三门版掀背和两门版斜背。卡罗拉Levin和Sprinter Trueno的主要差异集中在车身的前半段，前者采用横向格栅和方形固定头灯，而后者没有进气格栅，但拥有上翻式头灯。

两者均采用新开发的1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸发动机4A-GEU，而且为了尽可能体现双顶置凸轮轴的效用，空气流量计被电子燃油喷射系统取而代之，后者可以根据压力探测器反馈的数据来计算喷油量。除此之外，进气口处还安装了丰田可变进气系统，帮助引擎输出<130ps>的最大马力和<15.2kgm>的最大扭矩。

轻盈小巧的引擎加上精准响应的转向为驾驶者带来难以言语的驾驶体验，尽管引擎动力不那么充沛，操控也不够稳定，但驾驶者能获得到随心所欲、车随心动的感觉。所以说，这是一台能让人“人车合一”的纯正前置后驱车。

在当时，虽然有同级别配置的对手虎视眈眈，86却赢得了大多数享受驾驶乐趣，欣喜于其操控体验的车迷的热烈追捧。在它之后，也涌现出了许多主打高性能的车型，但再难找到一款像86这般备受大众喜爱的车。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 2012, the Toyota Crown underwent a full model change, entering its 14th generation with a bold new front-end design. The lineup was split into two distinct versions: the more conservative "Royal" and the sportier "Athlete." The Royal featured design elements inspired by a crown, while the Athlete adopted a more aggressive look with lightning bolt motifs. Together, they introduced a fresh visual identity while preserving the core values that had defined the Crown nameplate for generations.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2012年Toyota Crown迎来全新改款推出第14代车型，前脸得到了焕新。这一代产品线涵盖稳重的“Royal”版与运动的“Athlete”版。Royal版以皇冠为设计元素，而Athlete版则以闪电为主题，造型更加锐利。在延续历代核心理念的同时开创出全新的风貌。
officialDetails.heroEn: The 14th-generation Crown sported a bold front-end design, giving the sport sedan an extra dose of flair.
officialDetails.heroZh: 属于第14代车型的Crown采用了大胆而新颖的前脸设计，风貌焕然一新。

brandCentral.en:
Sold only in Japan, the Toyota Crown has represented
the quintessential Japanese luxury sports sedan.

This particular model, which was introduced in 2012, was the
14th-generation version.

With the first Crown appearing in 1955, it's one of the longest
running models in Japan to date.

The name "Athlete" was chosen to represent its
distinctively sporty nature.

It's a shame that the car has never been marketed worldwide.
brandCentral.zh:
“Toyota Crown”这个名字在全日本汽车爱好者的心目中代表着
尊贵。

这台车在2012年首次发布，已经是久负盛名的Crown系列中的
第14代产品了。

回首1955年推出的第一代Crown，这个系列已经传承延续了超
过半个世纪。

Toyota为14代车型定下的型号名称“Athlete”充分表达了它的运
动基因……

以及它那公路王者的霸气外形。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 14th-generation Crown sported a bold front-end design, giving the sport sedan an extra dose of flair.

The 14th-generation model of the Toyota Crown was introduced in 2012. It carried on the basic formula of the 12th-generation model, which underwent an extensive full-model change, which some argued was the first time that had happened in the model's long history.

The latest Crown was built on the same platform as its predecessor, with the drivetrain and mechanical components largely unchanged, although the steering did receive a slight update, with increased response and sportiness, while the front end was restyled to sport a better look.

The Crown lineup consisted of the "Royal" and the "Athlete." While the shape of the Royal's front fascia gave off the essence of a "crown," the Athlete possessed edges that appeared as if lightning bolts had sprouted from the model's wider and more menacing grille.

Four engine options were available with the new Crown: a 3.5-liter V-6, a 2.5-liter V-6, a 2.5-liter inline-4 hybrid, and a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4.

long.zh:
丰田的豪华型轿车“皇冠”在2012年全新改款，升级到第14代型号。

在其漫长的历史中，皇冠的改款都相当保守，直到第12代车型对主要部件进行了重大升级。第14代车型沿用了这种做法：开发平台沿袭自前一代型号，转向设计与前两代类似，偏向运动风格，正面的造型也得到了升级。

在这一代的产品线中，丰田推出了高端经典的“皇家”版本和运动型的“Athlete”版本。皇家版本的前脸造型依然彰显着皇冠之名，但Athlete版本却具有闪电般锐利的边缘线条，格栅显得更宽也更犀利，与皇冠车型那温文尔雅的传统印象大相径庭。

丰田为这款车型配置了四种引擎选项：3.5升和2.5升V6引擎、2.5升直列4缸混合动力引擎和2升涡轮增压直列4缸引擎。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 2012, the Toyota Crown underwent a full model change, entering its 14th generation with a bold new front-end design. The lineup was split into two distinct versions: the more conservative "Royal" and the sportier "Athlete." Four different powertrains were offered across the series: a 3.5-liter V-6, a 2.5-liter V-6, a 2.5-liter inline-4 hybrid, and a 2.0-liter inline-4 turbo. This safety car version was a Gran Turismo Original design.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 2012年Toyota Crown迎来全新改款推出第14代车型，前脸得到了焕新。这一代产品线涵盖稳重的“Royal”版与运动的“Athlete”版。全系提供4种动力单元：3.5升和2.5升V6引擎、2.5L直列4缸混合动力引擎和2升直列4缸涡轮增压引擎。这款安全车是跑车浪漫旅的原创设计。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo itself was a racing adaptation of Toyota’s FT-1 sports design concept, developed by CALTY Design Research, the company’s North American design studio. The design drew heavily from data and practical experience, featuring oversized fenders, an expanded front air intake, a large rear wing, and aggressive front canards.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: FT-1是由Toyota北美设计中心CALTY DESIGN打造的一款设计概念跑车，而这辆FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo则是前者的赛车版本。这款车的设计大量运用了团队积累的数据和经验，外观上采用了超大尺寸挡泥板、扩大的进气口、大尺寸尾翼以及前翼。

brandCentral.en:
The Toyota FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo is a car that redefines
the future of racing!

Its design is based on the FT-1, which was developed in the
pursuit of functional beauty.

You could say that this model takes that concept
to an entirely new level.

The large spoilers at the front and rear were installed after
closely studying their aerodynamic effect on the car.

It's clear no compromises were made on its styling,
either!
brandCentral.zh:
Toyota FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo是一款纯粹的赛车，
并将重新定义赛车的未来！

其设计原型FT-1是一款为追求功能之美而开发的汽车。

而这款Vision Gran Turismo车型又将这一理念提升到了全新的
高度！

前侧轮拱处和后部的扰流板是在对空气动力学进行了广
泛研究的基础上添加的，

而且我们可以看到，它在设计方面完全没有做出妥协！

catch.en: The FT-1 design concept transformed into a pure race car.
catch.zh: FT-1概念设计升级，化身纯粹运动赛车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The FT-1 design concept transformed into a pure race car.

Following the excitement of the FT-1 release in the Gran Turismo 6 game, the CALTY design team from Toyota’s North American Design branch has taken their dream one step further in creating the ultimate race car, the FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo.

The designers’ original intention in designing the FT-1 was to unabashedly appeal to the die hard car enthusiasts. In the same way, the FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo is designed for die-hard Gran Turismo fans. The designers focused on keeping the FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo authentic for the virtual racetracks of the game, to maximize their driving pleasure.

Because the bones and architecture of the FT-1 already lend itself to cooling and downforce through “function-sculpting,” the vision version just needed to be enhanced as a pure racing car. The designers closely studied racetracks and race cars, and applied their research into the styling. A deep sense of rawness is evident in the FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo, due to its purely function-driven design aesthetics. The fenders and tires are wider for extreme grip on the track. The enlarged air intakes provide increased cooling, and a larger rear wing and additional front canards have been added for even more downforce. The rear diffuser has been enlarged with multiple vertical fins, and is moved further back for cleaner airflow.

The FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo looks and feels the way it performs, so the driver can speed through the racetracks with the same sensation and thrill of real racing. .

long.zh:
受FT-1在跑车浪漫旅6游戏中发布的鼓舞，来自丰田北美设计分部的Calty设计团队向他们的梦想跨近了一步，打造出了终极赛车FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo。

FT-1 的设计初衷是直接而大胆地吸引硬派车迷的目光。同样，FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo也是为跑车浪漫旅的铁杆玩家而设计的。设计师的重点是要让FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo在虚拟的游戏赛道上也保持逼真的视觉感受，尽可能地增加驾驶的乐趣。

由于FT-1的结构和构造已经通过“功能雕刻”保证了冷却性能和下压力，愿景版只需继续强化，变成纯粹的竞速跑车即可。设计师们仔细研究了赛道和赛车，并将他们的研究应用到造型设计中。因为崇尚功能至上的设计美学，FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo明显给人一种粗犷的感觉。挡泥板和轮胎更宽，可以在赛道上发挥极强的抓地力。加大的进气口增强了冷却性能，尾翼被增大，并额外安装了前翼，进一步加强下压力。后扰流翼上增设多个垂直翅片，并进一步后移，使气流路径更为清晰。

FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo的外观和驾驶感受都与其性能相匹配，使得车手在赛道上飞驰时可以享受到与真实赛车相同的感觉与刺激。

FT-1概念设计升级，化身纯粹运动赛车。

受FT-1在跑车浪漫旅6游戏中发布的鼓舞，来自丰田北美设计分部的Calty设计团队向他们的梦想跨近了一步，打造出了终极赛车FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo。

FT-1的设计初衷是直接而大胆地吸引硬派车迷的目光。同样，FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo也是为跑车浪漫旅的铁杆玩家而设计的。设计师的重点是要让FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo在虚拟的游戏赛道上也保持逼真的视觉感受，尽可能地增加驾驶的乐趣。

由于FT-1的结构和构造已经通过“功能雕刻”保证了冷却性能和下压力，愿景版只需继续强化，变成纯粹的竞速跑车即可。设计师们仔细研究了赛道和赛车，并将他们的研究应用到造型设计中。因为崇尚功能至上的设计美学，FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo明显给人一种粗犷的感觉。挡泥板和轮胎更宽，可以在赛道上发挥极强的抓地力。加大的进气口增强了冷却性能，尾翼被增大，并额外安装了前翼，进一步加强下压力。后扰流翼上增设多个垂直翅片，并进一步后移，使气流路径更为清晰。

FT-1 Vision Gran Turismo的外观和驾驶感受都与其性能相匹配，使得车手在赛道上飞驰时可以享受到与真实赛车相同的感觉与刺激。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Toyota FT-1 is a concept car created by CALTY Design, Toyota’s North American design studio, offering a glimpse into the potential future of the brand’s sports car philosophy. Its projected dimensions are: overall length, 184.1 inches; width 77.6 inches; height 48.2 inches; with a wheelbase of 107.9 inches. The design draws inspiration from Toyota’s rich sports car heritage, beginning with the iconic Toyota 2000GT.
