vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's sports design concept presented at the January 2014 Detroit Auto Show.

The Toyota FT-1 is a "pure performance dream" concept model created by CALTY Design, the U.S. base of Toyota’s design network as a showcase for the future direction of Toyota sports car design.

Its exterior and interior design draws heavily on the Toyota brand’s long sports car tradition with influential vehicles such as 2000GT, Celica, Supra, and most recently, 86 (Model Name USA：FR-S, Europe：GT86).

The FT-1 concept’s purposeful yet elegant expression of functional beauty should not be viewed as precursor to a forthcoming Toyota production sports car. Rather, the bold and passionate design theme indicates a shift to a more exciting direction for the entire Toyota brand.

Dimensions:

Length: 4675 mm

Width: 1970 mm

Height: 1225 mm

Wheelbase: 2740 mm

The Toyota FT-1 debuted at the North American International Auto Show in January, 2014.

*The specifications for this car are a fictitious set created specially for Gran Turismo.

long.zh:
丰田FT-1是一款由丰田美国的设计部门CALTY Design设计，被称作“纯粹性能之梦”的概念赛车款，用以展示丰田跑车的未来设计方向。

此车的内外饰设计在很大程度上对丰田品牌下的一系列经典跑车如2000GT、赛利卡、Supra和最近的86（美国代号：FR-S、欧洲：GT86）等车型进行了借鉴。

FT-1概念赛车对功能之美的表达指向明确而又不失优雅，但与其把这款车看作丰田未来量产型跑车的预告，不如说，这款车大胆而充满激情的设计预示着整个丰田品牌将转向一个更激动人心的方向。

尺寸：长度：4,675毫米，宽度：1,970毫米，高度：1,225毫米，轴距：2,740毫米，丰田FT-1于2014年1月在北美车展上首次亮相。

*该规格是专为跑车浪漫旅特别定制的虚拟设定。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The GR Corolla was developed by Toyota’s high-performance GR division as a hot hatch aimed squarely at outperforming its rivals. Already the most powerful model in Corolla history, it was taken even further with the hardcore MORIZO Edition. At a time when the automotive world moves toward electrification and advanced systems, the GR Corolla stood out as a rare celebration of the pure, mechanical thrill of the internal combustion engine.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: GR Corolla是Toyota旗下高性能品牌“GR”打造的高性能掀背车，旨在在性能上超越所有竞争对手。虽然这已是Corolla历史上最强车型，但厂家还是在此基础上推出了更加极致的“MORIZO Edition”版本。在汽车行业迈向电气化和智能化的今天，GR Corolla难能可贵地展现了内燃机的纯粹魅力。
officialDetails.heroEn: A 2-seat model that takes the GR Corolla to the extreme.
officialDetails.heroZh: 一款将GR Corolla推向极致的双座车型。

brandCentral.en:
The GR Corolla is indeed an exceptional sports car born
of GAZOO Racing’s motorsport success.

But with the MORIZO Edition, it was brought even closer
to the track, so to speak.

‘Morizo’ is the racing alias of Akio Toyoda, Toyota’s
president at the time of this variant’s debut.

Toyoda now serves as Toyota’s master driver, and plays
an active role in motorsport racing.

From its strong yet lightweight body to its souped-up engine
and transmission—this is one finely-tuned machine!

GAZOO Racing在赛车运动中的成功经验造就了
GR Corolla这款非凡的跑车。

随着MORIZO版的推出，它的赛道血统变得愈发浓厚。

“Morizo”其实是Toyota前总裁丰田章男在赛车时使用的别名，
该车发布时，他还没有卸任。

以大师级赛车手自居的丰田章男，对Toyota在赛车运动领域的
投入起到了推波助澜的作用。

从坚固而轻质的车身到高度调校的引擎和变速箱，这款车
可谓精雕细琢！>

vehicleCollection.en:
A 2-seat model that takes the GR Corolla to the extreme.

Gazoo Racing (GR), Toyota’s high-performance brand, had drawn on its motorsports experience to create the ultimate hot hatch, the GR Corolla.

The goal for this car was to deliver exceptional performance, ready to take on any rival. The base chassis of the Corolla Sport had its front track widened by <60mm> and the rear by <85mm>, enhancing cornering ability. To further increase rigidity during hard cornering, 349 additional structural spot welds were applied.

The powerplant was the same turbocharged 1.6-liter 3-cylinder Dynamic Force Engine that had been highly praised in the GR Yaris. Its output was further improved by reducing exhaust flow resistance, pushing past the GR Yaris’ figure to deliver a maximum of <304ps>. The drivetrain, meanwhile, featured an active torque-split 4-wheel-drive system with a Torsen LSD. Consequently, the car delivered both remarkable stability and agile maneuverability.

Although the GR Corolla was introduced as the most advanced Corolla to date, an even more radical special model made its debut alongside it—the Morizo Edition. Morizo is the nickname of Toyota Motor Corporation’s chairman and master driver, Akio Toyoda. This limited-edition version was born from Toyoda’s wish to "bring back Corollas that turn heads."

To save weight, the Morizo Edition did away with its rear seats, effectively transforming it into a 2-seater. It also employed a unique close-ratio transmission and final gear setup, while the turbocharger’s maximum boost was increased to raise peak torque. Together with exclusive forged wheels and monotube suspension dampers, this model achieved a new echelon of performance.

In an automotive world advancing toward electrification and automation, the GR Corolla stood apart as a rare celebration of the enduring beauty of the internal combustion engine.-

long.zh:
丰田的高性能品牌图像赛车借力公司在赛车运动领域的丰富经验，打造出了终极的高性能掀背车：GR卡罗拉。

这款车的设计初衷就是为了实现能够击败任何对手的杰出性能。相比于基础车型卡罗拉运动版的底盘，它的前轮距拓宽了<60mm>，后轮距拓宽了<85mm>，进而有效增强了过弯表现。此外，为了增加急转弯时的车身刚性，车身增加了共计349处结构点焊。

其动力核心是GR雅力士那备受赞誉的1.6升3缸涡轮增压动态出力引擎。动力输出已通过降低排气阻力而得到了增强，最大可达<304ps>，超过了GR 雅力士的规格。与此同时，它的传动系统是一套带有托森限滑差速器的主动扭矩分配四轮驱动系统，实现了卓越的稳定性和极高的操控性。

作为史上性能最强的卡罗拉，GR卡罗拉在首次发布时还同时推出了一款改动非常激进的特殊型号“MORIZO Edition”。MORIZO是时任丰田汽车公司社长的大师级赛车手丰田章男的昵称。这款限量版型号的诞生源自于丰田章男想要“再次打造出能够引人注目的卡罗拉汽车”的愿望。

为了节省重量，MORIZO Edition直接取消了后排座椅，变成了一款双座车型。它还采用了一套特殊密齿轮比变速箱和主传动齿轮设置，而涡轮增压器的最大性能输出也有所提升，从而提高峰值扭矩。再加上独特的锻铁轮毂和单管式悬挂避震器，这一车型将卡罗拉的性能推上了又一个高峰。

在汽车行业开始向电气化和自动驾驶方向发展的当下，GR卡罗拉是一辆独一无二的汽车，充分体现出了朴实无华的内燃机引擎的经典美感。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Toyota Supra made its long-awaited return in 2019, following its discontinuation in 2002. The new model retained an inline-6 engine and rear-wheel-drive layout, embodying the essence of a pure sports car. It featured an ideal 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution and a low center of gravity, delivering superb balance and driving dynamics. A twin-scroll turbocharger ensured strong, responsive acceleration, while its wide stance and short wheelbase contributed to nimble, agile handling, making it a truly compelling performance machine.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Toyota Supra在2002年停产后，于2019年重新回归。新一代Supra延续了前代的直列六缸引擎和后轮驱动布局，追求纯粹跑车的理想境界。它拥有理想的车身平衡，前后50:50的重量分布和低重心设计。双涡流涡轮增压器带来出色加速性能，宽体车身和短轴距成就敏捷操控，组合之后极具吸引力。
officialDetails.heroEn: Toyota's flagship FR sports car returned after a 17-year absence with a completely new look.
officialDetails.heroZh: 丰田的旗舰版前置后驱跑车在缺席17年后再次回归，底盘变得更宽更短。

brandCentral.en:
The GR Supra possesses all the qualities of a typical
front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car...

...especially the top-of-the-line RZ that comes with a
turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6.

This engine pumps out an impressive <340ps> and
<51kgm> of torque.

The styling was fashioned after a formula race car, which
is evident by the car's front fascia.

Nearly 20 years after the last Supra, the new version has been
met with the approval of driving enthusiasts everywhere.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GR Supra是一款汇聚了高马力和前置后驱传动系统的完
美跑车。

作为最高配置的RZ版本，使用的是一台涡轮增压3升直列六
缸引擎……

可以输出惊人的<340ps>动力和<51kgm>的扭矩。

catch.en: Toyota's flagship FR sports car returned after a 17-year absence with a completely new look.
catch.zh: 丰田的旗舰版前置后驱跑车在缺席17年后再次回归，底盘变得更宽更短。

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's flagship FR sports car returned after a 17-year absence with a completely new look.

It was in 2002 when Toyota's popular high-performance sports car, the Supra, was discontinued to the dismay of hardcore fans all over the world. And ever since, people wondered if Toyota was secretly planning to bring the car back. Well, wonder no more because an all-new production version made its eagerly-anticipated debut at the 2019 North American International Auto Show.

The reborn sports car comes equipped with a twin-turbocharged inline-6 that powers the rear wheels. The development of the car was headed by chief engineer Tetsuya Tada, who was also in charge of creating the renewed Toyota 86. The working theme of the car was "Numbers are one thing, feeling is what matters." And by the looks of it, the Toyota team remained true to those values. The new Supra features an optimal 50:50 front/rear weight distribution and a low center of gravity, while possessing ideal sports car proportions, highlighted by a wide stance and short wheelbase. Thanks to the powerful engine, lightweight body and solid chassis, the car can shred a winding road with the best of them.

The new Supra will also star in the virtual world as Gran Turismo Sport has been charting the development progress of this car from day one, offering gamers a true representation of how this exciting sports car drives.

long.zh:
丰田Supra在2002年的停产令世界各地的车迷们都沮丧不已。好在在2019年的北美国际车展上，丰田宣告了它的回归。

这款配置了直列6缸引擎和后轮驱动的丰田旗舰车型由丰田总工程师多田哲哉领衔开发。正是后者将丰田86带回了众人的视线。心怀“数据固然重要，体验更加关键”的理念，他致力于创造一台为驾驶者的感受代言的车。均衡的50:50重量配比、压低的重心、双涡流涡轮带来的强劲加速感、宽体和短轴距所赋予的灵敏操控，都是追逐一辆理想跑车所带来的成果。优雅迷人的外形配上直6引擎发出的动人音调，为Supra带来了无可比拟的信仰光环。

除了面向现实中的赛车运动，Supra在开发之初就将跑车浪漫旅竞速中的虚拟比赛考虑在内。对于它在现实和虚拟竞速赛场所能取得的辉煌成就，丰田抱有着极高的期待。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Toyota Supra made its long-awaited return in 2019, following its discontinuation in 2002. The new model retained an inline-6 engine and rear-wheel-drive layout, embodying the essence of a pure sports car. It featured an ideal 50:50 front-to-rear weight distribution and a low center of gravity, delivering superb balance and driving dynamics. A twin-scroll turbocharger ensured strong, responsive acceleration, while its wide stance and short wheelbase contributed to nimble, agile handling, making it a truly compelling performance machine.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Toyota Supra在2002年停产后，于2019年重新回归。新一代Supra延续了前代的直列六缸引擎和后轮驱动布局，追求纯粹跑车的理想境界。它拥有理想的车身平衡，前后50:50的重量分布和低重心设计。双涡流涡轮增压器带来出色加速性能，宽体车身和短轴距成就敏捷操控，组合之后极具吸引力。
officialDetails.heroEn: The 2020 Supra possessed a significant power boost compared to the past model.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这辆2020款Supra的3升涡轮引擎经过了大幅的动力提升。

brandCentral.en:
A year after the release of the original GR Supra RZ,
the 2020 model appeared...

Boasting a serious power-up, from <340ps> to a
much meatier <387ps>.

New turbines and a redesigned exhaust manifold were fitted,
giving it much more grunt at high revs too.
brandCentral.zh:
在初代GR Supra RZ亮相的一年后，2020年车款也紧接着推出……

新款的动力得到了大幅强化，从<340ps>直接提升到了更强劲
的<387ps>。

它的引擎中安装了一套新的涡轮，再加上重新设计的排
气管，给了它更多在高转速区间的底气。

很荣幸可以认识您！

神乐坂先生是一位杰出的汽车设计师。他出身日本，现
在在意大利任职，

conversation.en:
A true sports car of Toyota making a 17-year comeback
was this Supra.

In the model changes for the Celica, Toyota never tried
to build a design identity for itself.

As if to keep denying its past, the company
continued to be the innovator.

And that in itself commands respect,
but the Celica is no more.

And the Supra for sure appeared on a blank canvas, without
looking to the past, making a dazzling first appeaance.

It shares a few components with the BMW Z4, but a different
design direction successfully differentiated them.

The only thing that is a little disappointing...

...is that to effectively show the design f its body sides,
you want a little more width.

You ju can' help your eyes wandering towards the FT-1.
W
conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
conversation.zh:
这辆Supra是丰田17年后卷土重来的真正跑车杰作。

从赛利卡变到Supra后，丰田并未尝试为它建立一个真正
的设计标识。

他们一直在追逐创新，仿佛是为了不断否定自己的过去。

赛利卡的确值得尊敬，但在Supra身上，你感受不到它的
一丝影子。

Supra无疑是在一块空白的画布上绘制的，在众人眼前
闪亮登场的它与过去y成就毫无牵连。

虽然和宝马Z4共享了相当多的部件，但两者的设计截
然不同，成功地将彼此区分开来。

唯一的小遗憾就是……

如果能加宽车体，就能更好Y展示出车身两侧的设计。

我n
承认，它V让T不由自主地联想到那台永远停留
在概念里的丰田FT-1。<next id200070 tpe=9ۜ

哎呀，兄弟，我是说，我一见到这样不得了的车，就控

conversation.en:
Ah, so this is the GR Supra that entered the Nürburgring
24 Hour race just a month after it went on sale...

Did you know the driver for the first stint of the final was none
other than Toyota President, Akio 'Morizo' Toyoda?

Basically, the man who brought the GR Supra to life!

The car was basically the retail model, with the bare
minimum safety equipment needed to race.

Still, it managed to claim 41st place overall,
and was third in its class.

It totally showed how good a performer
the GR Supra really is.
+

所以这就是刚刚上市一个月就去参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛
的GR Supra……

你知道在决赛中驾驶第一赛段的车手不是别人，
正是Toyota的总裁丰田章男吗？

事实上，就是他让这辆GR Supra复活的！

这辆参赛的Supra基本上就是一台零售车型，

但它还是获得了第41名的总成绩，并在同级车中排名第3。

这样的成绩完全显示出了GR Supra的卓越性能。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The GR Supra marked the return of Toyota’s flagship sports car, 17 years after production ended. It retained a rear-wheel-drive layout and inline-6, but came wrapped in a modern two-seat body with advanced construction and a twin-scroll turbocharger. It made its Nürburgring 24 Hours debut in 2018 and, in 2019, finished 3rd in the SP8T class and 41st overall. This cementing its image as a true performance contender.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 消失17年的Toyota旗舰跑车重获新生，GR Supra延续了经典的后驱布局和直列六缸引擎，以全新双座设计、先进车身和双涡管涡轮增压技术回归。该车于2018年首次征战纽博格林24小时耐力赛，2019年参加SP8T组别竞技，获得组别第三名、总成绩第41名的佳绩。这确立了GR Supra作为纯粹战斗跑车的形象。

officialDetails.heroZh: Supra暌违17年后再次归。这款跑车曾参与过2019年的纽博格林赛事。

brandCentral.en:
This GT4 race car was specially developed by TOYOTA GAZOO
Racing for the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

Aside from the safety systems required by the regulations,
very little here is different from the factory model.

Finishing a respectable 3rd in its class...

This car serves as a testament
to the performance potential of the GR Supra.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GT4赛车由TOYOTA GAZOO Racing团队专门为
纽博格林24小时耐力赛所打造。

除了添置赛事规则强制要求的安全系统外，这辆赛车和
原厂车几乎毫无差别。

最终，它在同组别比赛中取得了第三名的好成绩……

这足以从侧面印证出GR Supra的基础性能有多么强大。

vehicleCollection.en:
The Supra returned after a 17-year hiatus, with this racing version competing at the Nürburgring in 2019.

After 17 long years, the beloved Supra made its return, first as the race-ready GR Supra. Toyota's flagship sports car was co-developed with BMW, borrowing among other things the BMW Z4's superb inline-6 engine.

The 2-seat sports car made its first appearance at the 2018 Nürburgring 24 hour race a year before its release along with the slogan: To make even better cars. It entered the SP8T class in 2019 after its release.

With Masahiro Sasaki, Uwe Kleen, Herwig Daenens, and Morizo at the wheel, the GR Supra started the final race at the Ring from 99th place, but steadily made its way up the field as the drivers avoided a number of accidents at the beginning of the race. Eight hours into the contest, the car was involved in a slight crash, but fortunately for Toyota, damage was minimal and the car went on to finish in a respectable 41st place overall, and 3rd in its class.

Its outing proved that the GR Supra was a true sports car with a genuine race car heart.

long.en:
After 17 long years, the beloved Supra made its return, first as the race-ready GR Supra. Toyota's flagship sports car was co-developed with BMW, borrowing among other things the BMW Z4's superb inline-6 engine.

The 2-seat sports car made its first appearance at the 2018 Nürburgring 24 hour race a year before its release along with the slogan: To make even better cars. It entered the SP8T class in 2019 after its release.

With Masahiro Sasaki, Uwe Kleen, Herwig Daenens, and Morizo at the wheel, the GR Supra started the final race at the Ring from 99th place, but steadily made its way up the field as the drivers avoided a number of accidents at the beginning of the race. Eight hours into the contest, the car was involved in a slight crash, but fortunately for Toyota, damage was minimal and the car went on to finish in a respectable 41st place overall, and 3rd in its class.

Its outing proved that the GR Supra was a true sports car with a genuine race car heart.
long.zh:
在停产长达17年后，丰田的旗舰型跑车GR Supra于2019年王者归来。在保留后驱和直列6缸引擎的传统后，丰田选择了宝马作为合作开发伙伴，旨在让Supra进化成一辆拥有最先进的底盘和双涡流涡轮、血统最纯正的21世纪两座跑车。

2018年，GR Supra在纽博格林24小时耐力赛上首次崭露头角。这次亮相距离其正式发售尚有一年之遥。受到“造出更出色的汽车”的使命的驱动，Supra在发售当年（也就是2019年）再战纽博格林，参加了SP8T组别的角逐。

佐佐木正博、乌韦·克莱恩、赫维格·戴嫩斯和森寿四人驾驶着GR Supra在决赛中从第99位起步，避开了赛事初期发生的多起事故，稳扎稳打，排名逐步攀升。8小时后，赛车不幸与另一辆高级别的比赛车辆发生了擦碰事故，但仍坚持继续比赛，最终以SP8T组别第3，总排名41位的成绩完赛。

这也是GR Supra致力打造的印象，一辆不折不扣的竞技性跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
First seen at the 2018 Geneva Motor Show, this race Supra represented a preview of the production model.

The GR Supra Racing Concept, unveiled at the 2018 Geneva Motor Show, was a bold reimagining of Toyota’s legendary Supra—a sports car that had been out of production since 2002. With this concept, the nameplate returned for the first time in 16 years, reborn as a pure race car.

The car was developed by TOYOTA GAZOO Racing, the division responsible for the company’s motorsports activities and the GR sports-car series.

Its design followed the classic long-nose, short-deck form, with a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive, two-door coupe layout. The compact body was constructed from lightweight, high-strength carbon composite materials, the kind used in frontline racing. Large blister fenders, a rear wing, and a pronounced diffuser were added to deliver superior aerodynamics and high-speed stability.

The suspension, wheels, tires, and brakes were all racing-spec. The stripped-down interior included a dashboard with a rear-view monitor, competition seats, a race steering wheel with paddle shifters, and a full roll cage—all purpose-built for the track.

For a quarter of a century, the Supra had been beloved worldwide as “The Sports of Toyota,” leaving a powerful mark on motorsports history.

long.zh:
GR Supra Racing Concept于2018年日内瓦车展亮相，其原型车Supra是丰田旗下的运动跑车，直至2002年才停产。而这款概念车标志着该车型时隔16年首次以赛车身份荣耀回归。

这款车由丰田图像赛车研发，该部门专门负责丰田的赛车运动事务及“GR”跑车系列的研发。

这款概念车采用传统的长前鼻短后悬造型，为前置引擎、后轮驱动的双门轿跑布局。紧凑车身采用轻量化高强度碳纤维复合材料，此类材质常见于一线赛车。大型宽体翼子板、尾翼及后扩散器为自行研发，旨在实现卓越的空气动力学性能与驾驶表现。

悬挂系统、轮毂、轮胎与制动系统均采用纯正赛车规格部件。座舱内饰方面，带后视监控器的仪表板、赛车座椅、带换挡拨片的方向盘，转向柱、踏板及防滚架等部件亦按照赛车规格装配。

在长达四分之一个世纪里，Supra作为“丰田运动精神的象征”深受全球车迷喜爱，并在赛车运动史上留下了不可磨灭的足迹。

The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare
example of a fully in-house sports car.

It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body
structure designed specifically for this model.

Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.

The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in
the World Rally Championship (WRC).

It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with
performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.

It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark
in automotive history.

碳纤维车顶和坚固的车身都是专门为这款车设计的，

dialogues.en:
The Yaris WRC is a car that totally dominated
the World Rally Championships.

It claimed the Manufacturers' title in 2018...

and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well,
with a record six wins.

Sure enough, the GR Yaris was developed specifically
with the goal of total domination of the WRC in mind.

Initially, a competition car was developed for the WRC,
with a commercial car planned for homologation.

In any case, for a real motorsports fan, there aren't
many cars on the road that are quite this exciting!
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.zh:
Yaris WRC是一款彻底统治了世界拉力锦标赛的赛车。

它在2018年获得了制造商冠军，

在2019年则取得创纪录的6场胜利，摘下车手冠军的桂冠。

我们可以确定的是，这辆GR Yaris是专为统治世界拉力
锦标赛而研发的！

他们先是制造了一台能在锦标赛上夺冠的比赛机器，
然后再规划量产车型，接受赛事认证。

不管怎么说，对于一个真正的赛车迷来说，这是少数几
辆能令人兴奋到不能自己的公路车！

dialogues.en:
It's not big, but you just can ignore it.

Ah, I see. This GR Yaris was made for motorsports.

I guess it does look like a sportscar,
and it's no slouch out on the track.

It's nice that it's also good for everyday use—I mean,
you can even sit in the back!
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.zh:
这辆车虽然小巧玲珑，但实力却不可小觑。

噢，原来是这样。这辆GR雅力士是专为赛车运动而生的。

它看上去确实就是一辆跑车，在赛道上表现得也不弱。

而且日常使用也非常好开，我说真的，后排也能坐人！

dialogues.en:
Look at the tyres placed way out on the corners, and the
cabin that narrows naturally towards the rear.

It's a winning combination, wouldn't you say?

It has a marvellous sense of real agility,
regardless of the height of the body.

It's a type of appeal that is common with cars
like the Honda CR-Z.

Recent Toyotas' front designs have been tending
towards the aggressive in recent years.

In this case, they've taken that and run with it, for
the kind of car a real revhead would appreciate.

The appearance of the fascia isn't bad, but it's a bit
of a shame it resembles an old Peugeot from afar.

Still, the car has plenty of god eaures, so I'm hoping
it will provepopular on the streets.

vehicleCollection.en:
This new WRC race car was created to carry the torch for Toyota's strong rallying tradition.

Toyota has long been a dominant presence in the World Rally Championships, consistently fighting for the series championship year after year. After building a number of classic rally race cars, the company will be introducing its newest off-road competition machine in 2021: the GR Yaris.

At first, it may not look that different from the production hatchback, aside from the super wide rear fenders, but under the skin beats the heart of a serious racer. Built on a combination of the TNGA GA-B and GA-C platforms, the extremely lightweight body possesses increased rigidity. Its flowing profile, characterized by the low carbon-fiber roof, optimizes airflow.

Under the hood of the RZ model is the G16E-GTS, a turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-3. Boasting the smallest size and lightest weight in its class, this unit produces 200 kW (<272ps>)/370 Nm (<37.7kgm>) and comes mated to a 6-speed manual transmission that sends power to all four wheels via a newly developed electronically controlled coupling type center differential. The RZ High Performance model is equipped with Torsen LSDs for both the front and rear differentials, for maximum traction.

This "First Edition" model, introduced alongside the GR Yaris in January 2020, was offered to those who pre-ordered the car. Among other things, it featured special forged aluminum wheels and was autographed by Toyota "master driver" Morizo, who is in fact Toyota CEO Akio Toyoda.

Boasting the smallest size and lightest weight in its class, this unit produces 200 kW (<272ps>)/370 Nm (<37.7kgm>) and comes mated to a 6-speed manual transmission that sends power to all four wheels via a newly developed electronically controlled coupling type center differential. The RZ High Performance model is equipped with Torsen LSDs for both the front and rear differentials, for maximum traction.

This "First Edition" model, introduced alongside the GR Yaris in January 2020, was offered to those who pre-ordered the car. Among other things, it featured special forged aluminum wheels and was autographed by Toyota "master driver" Morizo, who is in fact Toyota CEO Akio Toyoda.
long.zh:
多年来，丰田为了继续完善赛车，持续征战世界拉力锦标赛。他们为2021年推出的新款拉力赛车而开发的原型车就是这款GR雅力士。

它给人的第一印象可能是一款可爱的紧凑车，但事实上这是一款为了在世界拉力锦标赛中夺冠而专门打造的战斗机器。三门车身里包含了两个丰田新全球架构 GA-B和GA-C模块，用于加固车身所需的刚性，同时也能减轻车重，降低重心。加宽的后挡泥板彰显着这台车的潜力，而以顺滑线条延伸至车后部的碳纤维顶棚及后扰流翼则是优化气流设计的成果。

为这款四轮驱动RZ车型提供动力的是一台G16E-GTS 1.6升涡轮增压3缸引擎。这是丰田最新开发的动力单元，在同级别中具有最小的尺寸和最轻的重量，可以输出200kW功率（<272ps>）马力和370牛·米（<37.7kgm>）扭矩。与这套动力系统搭配的是一台6速手动变速箱。其传动系统也非常有创意，采用了一款全新开发的电控联轴中央差速器，用以调整前后轮的扭矩配比。此外，其“RZ高性能”版本还为前后差速器增加了托森限滑差速器，确保为车辆提供稳定的牵引力。

在2020年1月随GR雅力士一同发布的还有一款特殊“首发版本”。这款限量版本需要预订，车身上带有传奇赛车手“Morizo”的签名，并配备了一些限量版的配件，如铸造铝轮毂。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Toyota’s lightweight 86, a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive sports car, was introduced in 2012 and sold more than 200,000 units worldwide. Nine years later, it was reborn as the GR86, now equipped with a larger naturally-aspirated 2.4-liter flat-4 DOHC engine producing 231.8 HP and 184.4 ft-lb of torque. With enhanced body rigidity, reduced weight, and an aerodynamic design shaped by motorsport experience, the GR86 delivered an even more engaging and dynamic driving experience.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Toyota轻量化前置后驱跑车“86”于2012年发布，全球销量突破20万辆。发布9年后，该车以“GR86”的身份重生，搭载2.4升自然进气四缸双顶置凸轮轴水平对置引擎，输出235 PS的动力和25.5 公斤力米的最大扭矩。通过强化车身刚性、削减车身重量，以及采用汲取自赛车运动的全新空气动力学设计，这款车带来了前所未有的驾驶乐趣。

它继承由AE86开创的传统：适中的车身尺寸，以及必不可

当您握住这辆车的方向盘，您会感觉自己仿佛能够掌控

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of Japan's signature lightweight sports car boasts a bigger engine, but it remains true to its heritage.

Since its introduction in 2012, more than 200,000 units of the Toyota 86 were sold around the world, solidifying its place in the history books as one of the most popular front-engine/rear-wheel-drive compact sports cars of all time.

Nine years after the 86's debut, Toyota introduced the GR86, a high-performance version of the car that wore the Gazoo Racing badge (GR). While maintaining the virtues of the original car, namely a lightweight body and superb handling, Toyota engineers equipped the GR86 with a larger engine. Under the bonnet was a 2.4-litre flat-4 that replaced the 2.0-litre variant. Power came in at an impressive <235ps>/<7000rpm> with maximum torque peaking at <25.5kgm>/<3700rpm>. This translated to a 0-<100km/h> acceleration time of 6.3 seconds, which was a stark improvement over the 7.4 seconds of the first-generation model.

To enhance the 86's handling, the company's chassis engineers stiffened the body and adopted aluminium in the roof panel to lower the center of gravity, as well as reduce overall weight. With the GR86, Toyota offered sports-car enthusiasts exactly what they were hoping for with the 86: a meaner, faster version of the car that was designed for the race track.

long.zh:
自从2012年推出以来，丰田86在全世界已经售出了超过20万台，巩固了它作为史上最受欢迎的前置后驱紧凑型跑车的地位。

在86亮相的九年后，丰田又推出了GR86，这是一款顶着Gazoo Racing头衔的高性能版本。丰田的工程师们保留了原始款的优点，也就是轻量化车身和出众的操控性，还为GR86配置了更强大的引擎。这辆车的引擎盖下藏着一部2.4升水平对置4缸引擎，替代了原本的2.0升版本。其功率输出高达<235ps>/<7000rpm>，最大扭矩峰值可达<25.5kgm>/<3700rpm>。这样的性能可以在6.3秒内实现0-<100km/h>的加速，相比于第一代7.4秒的成绩可谓是长足的进步。

为了增强86的操控性，底盘工程师们加固了车身，并采用了铝制车顶，进而降低了车辆的重心，并且整体降低了整车重量。GR86是丰田为所有的跑车迷们提供的梦寐以求的86升级款，它专门为赛道打造，速度更快，更具侵略性。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 1998, Toyota developed the GT-One (TS020) with the singular goal of winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Designed by André de Cortanze, the car incorporated Formula 1-inspired aerodynamics and suspension. Although mechanical issues prevented a result in its debut year, the GT-One returned in 1999 as an evolved LM GTP machine. Ukyo Katayama and company finished 2nd overall—the highest-ever at Le Mans for a team composed entirely of Japanese drivers.

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's endurance race machine that achieved a class win at Le Mans in 1999.!

In the early 1990s, Toyota set out to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans with its Group C TS010 race car. A number of unsuccessful years followed, but the company would return for the 1998 season with the Toyota GT-One (TS020). During its Group C racing days, Toyota developed its race cars almost exclusively within Japan. However, it revamped its plans and entrusted this project to the group in charge of their World Rally Championship activities, German-based TTE (Toyota Team Europe), in an attempt to once again claim overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The new Le Mans car, the GT-One, was designed by André De Cortanze, a race-car design genius with a brilliant track record in top motorsports genres, including Formula 1, Le Mans and the WRC. De Cortanze designed the Peugeot 905B, the first Group C Peugeot car to claim victory at Le Mans in 1992 and 1993.

For the GT-One, Cortanze incorporated the latest in F1 technology into its design. Its carbon-composite monocoque body was developed for aerodynamic performance. Providing the power was the same twin-turbocharged 3.6-liter V-8 developed during the Toyota's Group C days. The suspension had very long arms in both the front and rear, allowing for ideal suspension geometry.

In its first time out at Le Mans in 1998, Toyota entered three GT-Ones in the LM GT1 class in a serious attempt for overall victory. While one of its cars led the race, a combination of mechanical trouble and bad luck kept it from taking the checkered flag.

The following year, a change in the race's technical regulations saw the GT-One entered in the LM GTP prototype class. Three GT-Ones were entered in the race, but two of them, including the favorite and its supporting car, were forced to withdraw due to a host of problems.

However, the third car, driven by Ukyo Katayama, Toshio Suzuki and Keiichi Tsuchiya managed to stay in the race and claim 2nd place overall. This was the highest ever finish for a Japanese car driven by an all-Japanese team.

long.zh:
在1990年代初期，丰田派出旗下的TS010赛车争夺勒芒24小时耐力赛C组别的冠军。虽然接连数年受挫，但丰田并未气馁。在1998赛季，公司决定再度参赛，这次他们派出的是丰田GT-1（TS020）。在C组别时代，丰田的赛车几乎全部由日本工厂开发。然而，这次他们改变了做法，将这个项目交给了负责其世界拉力锦标赛活动的德国TTE（丰田车队欧洲）团队。他们的目标是再次在勒芒24小时耐力赛中摘下总冠军。

这台新的勒芒战车GT-1由赛车设计天才安德烈·德·科尔但泽设计，他的辉煌战绩遍布F1、勒芒和世界拉力锦标赛等顶级赛事。德·科尔但泽曾帮标致设计出了首辆在1992和1993年的勒芒摘桂的C组别赛车——标致905B。这一次，他将最新的F1技术融入了GT-1的设计中。

其碳纤维复合单体车身旨在提高空气动力学性能，搭载了丰田在C组别时代开发的双涡轮增压3.6升V8引擎。悬挂系统的前后悬臂都拥有较长的臂长，实现了理想的悬挂几何构造。

1998年，丰田首次将三辆GT-1赛车带到LM GT1组别，剑指勒芒赛总冠军。尽管曾一度领先，但由于机械故障加上时运不济，再次无奈折戟。

在此车问世的第二年，1999年，为适应技术规则变化，GT-1被改装成LM GTP原型级别的赛车。在出战的三辆GT-1赛车当中，备受期待的领头羊赛车和其支援车由于一系列问题双双退赛。

然而，由片山右京、铃木利男和土屋圭市驾驶的第三台车成功坚持到了终点，并一举拿下总排名亚军。这成为由全日本团队驾驶的日本赛车在勒芒耐力赛中取得的最高名次。{

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Hiace has long stood as Toyota’s flagship commercial vehicle, earning widespread support around the globe. Introduced in 2004 and continually refined, the fifth-generation H200 model became a record-setting seller. Offered in various configurations based on body size, it came with a choice of 2.0-liter or 2.7-liter gasoline engines, or a 2.8-liter diesel engine. The Van DX variant featured a standard roof height and rear-wheel drive. It accommodated up to nine passengers, or, with the seats folded, transforming into a spacious cargo carrier.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Hiace是Toyota商用车的代表车型，在全球范围内都有大量拥趸。第五代H200车型于2004年推出并持续更新，已成为创纪录的长青畅销车型。H200根据车身尺寸提供多档选择，可选2升或2.7升汽油引擎，或2.8升柴油引擎。Van DX是标准车顶高度的后轮2轮驱动车型。最多可容纳9人乘坐，座椅也可折叠收起，形成宽敞的载货空间。
officialDetails.heroEn: The cab-over commercial van was equally capable of moving people and cargo.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款前置驾驶室的商用厢型车在载人和载货方面同样出色。

brandCentral.en:
Storability, operability, durability—commercial vehicles
certainly have a lot of boxes to tick.

And one that’s been ticking them for near 60 years is
Toyota’s forward control Hiace.

This Hiace is a 5th-generation model from 2004.

'DX' refers to the base grade or regular size developed according
to Japan’s five-number vehicle size regulations.

With room for a maximum of nine passengers, its seats can
be folded for additional storage.

Such efficient interior design has naturally made the Hiace
exceedingly popular as a base car for caravans.
brandCentral.zh:
储存能力、操控性、耐久性——商用车确实需要满足
诸多要求。

而近60年来持续满足这些要求的正是这一台Toyota的
前控式车型Hiace。

这款Hiace是2004年推出的第5代车型。

“DX”指的是车辆基础级别，即根据日本五号车辆尺寸
规定开发的标准尺寸车型。

它最多可容纳9名乘客，座椅可折叠以增加储物空间。

如此高效的内部设计使Hiace自然而然地成为了极受
欢迎的房车改装基础车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
The cab-over commercial van was equally capable of moving people and cargo."

Since its introduction in 1967, Toyota's Hiace cab-over commercial van has enjoyed international acclaim for its utility and reliability. The fifth-generation H200 model was introduced in 2004 and, thanks to regular updates, remains in production to this day.

The H200 Hiace lineup featured a number of different configurations and trim levels to meet various uses and specifications, but these can largely be categorized by the body's overall length, width and height. The H200 was equipped with a choice of engines: a 2.0-liter or 2.7-liter gasoline inline-4, or a 2.8-liter diesel inline-4.

This Van DX was the base model that measured <4695mm> long, <1695mm> wide and <1980mm> high. It was powered by the 2.0-liter gasoline engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission that sent power to the two rear wheels. This 4-door configuration did not include a right-hand sliding door, and accommodated nine people. When needing to haul large cargo, the second- and third-row seats folded down to provide <2435mm> of storage.

Japanese off-road history.

Released in 1960, this '40' is the third-generation model.

It’s affectionately known to fans in Japan as the 'Yonmaru,'

as a 'working car.'

part of this car was built to last, so to speak.

Well-made and dependable, it carries all the trademarks
of a great Land Cruiser.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Renowned for its all-terrain performance and reliability, the Toyota Land Cruiser has become among the world’s most beloved off-road vehicles. Introduced in 1960, the third-generation “40” series also offered a surprising degree of on-road comfort. The 2-door hardtop variant shown here was powered by a 3.9-liter F-model gasoline engine, paired with a part-time 4-wheel-drive system. Its popularity only grew in 1974 with the introduction of the 3.0-liter B-model diesel engine. The 40 series went on to become a massive success, remaining in production until 1984.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 凭借卓越的全地形性能与可靠性，Land Cruiser已成为全球最受喜爱的越野车型。1960年问世的第三代“40”车型还同时兼顾了舒适的公路驾驶体验。这台双门硬顶车型搭载3.9升F型汽油引擎和分时四驱传动系统。但1974年推出3升B型柴油引擎让这台车的人气进一步提升。该系列热销不衰，持续生产至1984年。

collection.en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is one of the longest-running
and most respected vehicles in the world.

Its story began more than 70 years ago, in 1951.

The FJ40 series arrived in 1960, marking
the model’s third generation.

It was offered in a variety of body styles,
each designed for a specific purpose.

The 2-door hardtop, seen here, was built to conquer
the harshest off-road conditions.

Although compact at just <3.9m> in length, it was
powered by a stout 3.9-liter gasoline engine
Its rugged 4WD system with a 2-speed transfer case
made it indispensable on mountain trails.

With its distinctive charm, the FJ40 became an enduring favorite
and stayed in production for 24 years, until 1984.

In 2021, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing bega producing
reproduction parts for the model.

Why? Because a legendaryˋff-roader likeʞhis
as simply too good to let fade away.
collection.zh:
Toyota Land Cruiser是品牌最常青
且最受景仰的车型之一。

它的故事始于70多年前的1951年。

1960年推出的FJ40系列标志着该车系进入第三代，

且提供多种车款以满足不同用户的需求。

这里展示的双门硬顶版本专为应对极端越野条件而打造。

车身虽然小巧（车长约<3.9m>），却搭载了实力派的3.9升汽油引擎。

再加上带有两速分动箱的四驱系统，
让这台车成为山路驾驶的绝对利器。

FJ40凭借迷人外观大受欢迎，持续生产24年，
直至1984年才停产。

TOYOTA GAZOO Racing于2021年开始
为其生产复刻零件。

原因很简单，因为如此杰出的越野车型值得被永续传承！

vehicleCollection.en:
A best-selling Land Cruiser with a 24-year production run.

The Toyota Land Cruiser was first conceived as a vehicle for Japan’s National Police Reserve, but it evolved into a world-class off-roader renowned for its all-terrain ability and legendary reliability. More than 70 years later, the model that continued to hold a special place in the hearts of enthusiasts was the third-generation “40,” introduced in 1960.

Exports had begun earlier with the “20” series in 1955, establishing the Land Cruiser as a serious contender on the world stage. The “40” was designed to better meet the expectations of international customers. Beyond its refreshed exterior, it elevated the model’s already renowned off-road prowess with greater comfort on the highway, broadening its appeal.

The 40 series was available in short, medium, and long-wheelbase versions, each tailored to different needs. The 2-door hardtop variant, seen here, found extensive use in mountainous regions, where its short <2285mm> wheelbase proved invaluable.

Compact in size, it measured <3870mm> in length, <1690mm> in width, and <1930mm> in height. Originally equipped with a 3.9-liter “F” gasoline engine, the lineup gained even more popularity in 1974 with the addition of the 3.0-liter “B” diesel engine. Its part-time 4-wheel-drive system with a 2-speed transfer case only reinforced its reputation for toughness. This was the model that embodied the Land Cruiser philosophy of “go anywhere and come back alive.”

Alongside the 2-door hardtop, the 40 series as a whole became one of the Land Cruiser’s greatest successes, remaining in production for 24 years, until 1984. Its enduring popularity inspired the launch of the FJ Cruiser in 2006, a modern homage that revived many of the classic 40’s design cues.

And in 2021, Toyota announced the reproduction of 40-series parts through Gazoo Racing, proving that this iconic Land Cruiser was, and always will be, worth keeping alive on the road.

long.zh:
丰田Land Cruiser最初是为日本国家警察预备队设计的车辆，后来凭借其卓越的全地形能力和可靠性，演变成了世界级的越野车。70多年后，有一款车型已深深植根于Land Cruiser车迷的心中，那便是1960年推出的第三代车型“40”。

自1955年的“20”车型起，Land Cruiser便开始出口全球，并迅速成为全球越野舞台的有力竞争者。“40”车型的设计旨在更好地满足全球消费者的期望。除了外观方面的升级，这款车还在原本就有口皆碑的越野能力基础上，提升了高速公路上行驶时的舒适性。

40车型提供了短、中、长轴距三种版本，可满足不同的用车环境。此处的双门硬顶版本广泛应用于山地环境，<2285mm>短轴距得以一展所长。

车身尺寸也相对紧凑，长<3870mm>、宽<1690mm>、高<1930mm>。最初的动力单元是一台3.9升“F”汽油引擎，而1974年推出的3升“B”柴油引擎更让这款车的人气飙升。传动系统为分时四驱，并配备两速分动箱。这款车型完美诠释了Land Cruiser“无惧前路，安全归来”的理念。

与这款双门硬顶版本一样，“40”也成为Land Cruiser最畅销的车型之一，持续生产近24年，直至1984年才停产。其人气之高使得丰田于2006年推出FJ Cruiser，复刻经典40车型的多项设计元素。

在此之后，2021年丰田又通过图像赛车宣布复产40车型零件，从侧面证明了40 Land Cruiser是一款永不过时、值得永远驾驶下去的经典。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Introduced in 1989, the second-generation MR2, designated SW20, succeeded the AW11, Japan’s first mass-produced mid-engine sports car. Its body dimensions were stretched to the upper limits of Japan’s Class 5 vehicle regulations, while its design adopted smoother, more aerodynamic lines to emphasize its mid-engine configuration. At launch, the car faced criticism for its challenging handling character, but subsequent refinements transformed it into a well-balanced performer.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第二代MR2发布于1989年，也被称为SW20，是日本第一部中置布局量产车AW11的继任者。SW20的车身延长后达到日本5级汽车尺寸的上限，平滑圆润的造型也与第一代MR2截然不同，但仍然采用了中置式布局。发布初期，这辆车因其糟糕的操控而饱受批评，后续的更新升级却将其打造成了一款平衡性极佳的中置引擎跑车。
officialDetails.heroEn: The turbocharged model of Toyota's mid-engine sports car featured a rigid chassis that matched its extra power.
officialDetails.heroZh: 最终的涡轮增压机车型，具有可以承受引擎动力的底盘稳定性。

usedCar.en:
You don't see many affordable mid-engine sports cars, but
Toyota threw caution to the wind and produced the MR2.

While the first-gen model had quirky styling, this final revision,
called in-house as the SW20, looks like a mini exotic.

It handles like an exotic too, thanks to a sport-tuned
suspension system and quick steering responses.

The engine, mounted behind the GT-S' cockpit, is a turbo
2.0-liter inline-4 that pumps out an impressive <245ps>.

模型，以其先进的处理而闻名。

此 GT-S 等级配备 2升直列四缸涡轮增压
引擎能够达到 <245ps>。

更重要的是，这辆车的后备箱超大！
非常适合用来装一大堆行李。>

vehicleCollection.en:
The turbocharged model of Toyota's mid-engine sports car featured a rigid chassis that matched its extra power.

The second-generation MR2, which arrived in 1989, represented the all-new version of the AW11, Japan's first mass produced mid-engine sports car. Toyota wanted to broaden the appeal of its two-seater to the general public, so it made the car larger. To compensate for the added mass, Toyota increased power. The 4A-G, a 1.6-liter inline-4, was swapped in favor of the 3S-G, a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4, which produced <165 ps> in naturally-aspirated form and <225 ps> when turbocharged. Unfortunately, with the new engines, the handling characteristics of the AW11 worsened, as the car exhibited a tendency to oversteer. As a result, in December 1991, the chassis was completely revised in the updated SW20 II model.

Things dramatically improved, even more so in 1994 with version III that featured more power via a stronger turbocharger; <245 ps> and <31.0 kgm> of torque. The naturally-aspirated model also saw an increase in performance going to <180 ps> and <19.5 kgm> of torque. In June 1996, the IV added a helical LSD, as well as standard fare ABS. In December 1997, the V introduced the VVT-i (Variable Valve Timing-intelligent) to the naturally-aspirated engine that was now pumping out <200 ps> and <21.0 kgm> of torque. With all these improvements, the SW20 became one of the most popular sports cars of its day, outshining the AW11, the model that started it all.

long.zh:
第二代MR2发行于1989年，也被称为SW20，是日本第一部中置式量产车AW11的继任者。虽然外表酷似跑车，但AW11从未被丰田归类为跑车。不过，他们宣称这款第二代的MR2是一款真正的高性能跑车。

SW20的车身延长后达到日本第5级尺寸的极限，平滑的造型也与第一代MR2截然不同，但仍然采用了中置式布局。布局在车手身后的引擎从1.6升4A-G升级为2.0升3S-G，自然吸气版的马力为<165ps>，涡轮增压版的马力则为<225ps>。然而，最初的版本未能解决马力增大带来的困扰，使得这款车比AW11更加难以操控，因而在1991年12月对底盘进行了修正，发布了第II型。

1994年，第III型亮相，采用了更强的涡轮增压引擎，能够产生<245ps>和<31kgm>扭矩。自然吸气版则提升到<180ps>和<19.5kgm>扭矩。底盘悬挂、弹簧、避震和刹车也进行了对应改进。

此后，1996年6月，发布了第IV型。G级的手动版本使用了螺旋式限滑差速器，跑车款制动防抱死系统也成为所有车型的标配。1997年12月，第V型诞生，加入更多改进。这次自然吸气引擎上采用了连续可变气门定时，将输出提升至<200ps>和<21.0kgm>扭矩。

在不断进化的过程中，底盘设计逐渐成熟，操控不再像早期那样过于敏感。在SW20系列中，最终型号为第V型的自然吸气版可能是最佳车型，在马力和底盘之间做到了极好的平衡。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Tourer V was a performance model added to the eighth-generation Mark II lineup. Its biggest selling point was its power unit: a turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-6 engine that produced 276.1 HP and 278.5 ft-lb of torque. A 5-speed manual transmission was also available, and the roar of the 6-cylinder engine, combined with tremendous boost, hit as soon as the throttle pedal was floored. Even so, the interior was lavish and comfortable, bringing two seemingly opposite characters together in the Tourer V.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Tourer V是第8代Mark II系列车款中新增的一款运动版车型。其最大卖点是动力单元：一台涡轮增压2.5升直列六缸引擎，可输出280 PS动力和38.5 公斤力米扭矩。该车还提供了5速手动变速箱。当你将油门踏板踩到底时，六缸引擎的轰鸣声，伴随着强大的增压推背感，向你瞬间袭来。有如此澎湃动力，Tourer V的内饰依然堪称奢华舒适，将两种看似矛盾的特质集于一身。
officialDetails.heroEn: This sports sedan's refined looks hide sharp teeth.
officialDetails.heroZh: 这款运动轿车精致的外表下暗藏锋芒。

usedCar.en:
Ever heard of the Toyota Mark II? It was an iconic FR car
that led Japan’s midsize sedan market for decades.

The performance version of the Mark II was the Tourer V, and
I happen to have an excellent one in stock right now.

This is an X100-series car from the model’s eighth generation.
What do you think? Looks like a regular sedan, right?

Well, wait until you see the serious hardware under the hood:
a 1JZ-GTE 2.5-liter inline-6 inherited from the A70 Supra.

The rush of its <280p> acceleration is pure madness,
and its 5-speed manual captivated enthusiasts everywhere.

With double wishbones at all four corners, the setup is supple
yet grippy, giving the car a remarkable degree of depth.

Older sedans are seeing a major resurence right now,
so adding this one to your collection is an easy call.
usedCar.zh:
听说过Toyota Mark II吗？这款标志性的前置后驱车型
曾主导日本中型轿车市场数十年。

Mark II的运动版名为Tourer V，
我店里现在正好就有一台成色极好的。

是第八代的X100系列。
怎么样？看着像普通轿车，对吧？

不过等你见识过它那台凶悍的引擎再说：一台源自
A70 Supra的1JZ-GTE 2.5升直列六缸涡轮增压引擎！

它<280ps>的加速动力简直狂野，
5速手动变速箱更是让全球车迷为之着迷。

前后双叉臂悬挂调校偏软，
却抓地力十足，极高的可操控性令人惊叹。

如今把玩老式轿车的风潮再起，
所以把这台车收入车库，根本无需犹豫！

catch.en: This sports sedan's refined looks hide sharp teeth.
catch.zh: 这款运动轿车精致的外表下暗藏锋芒。

vehicleCollection.en:
This sports sedan's refined looks hide sharp teeth.

Originally released in 1968, the Toyota Mark II was Japan’s answer to the midsize sedan. The Tourer V was a performance trim grade that became available from the seventh-generation Mark II onward. The version shown here was the Tourer V from the eighth-generation Mark II, also known as the X100 series. The clean-cut, long-nose sedan body and wild driving character resulted in a very attractive car.

Its most notable feature was the power unit. The 2.5-liter inline-6 1JZ-GTE engine was a further-evolved, second-generation model with variable valve timing and a single turbocharger, producing <280ps>/<38.5kgm>. Also available with a 5-speed manual transmission, a push of the throttle pedal delivered a surge of boost and the sensuous growl of the inline-6.

While it boasted excellent performance, the interior focused instead on luxury and comfort, gently enveloping the driver and passengers.

This dichotomy was what made the Tourer V so attractive. It hid its teeth, presenting the image of a refined gentleman. Its discerning drivability sent many car enthusiasts wild.

long.zh:
丰田Mark II于1968年首次推出，是日本应对中型轿车市场的代表作。Tourer V是该车型的一款运动版配置，从第七代Mark II开始提供。这里展示的是第八代Mark II的Tourer V，即X100系列。利落的长车头轿车车身与狂野的驾驶特性，共同打造出一款极具魅力的车型。

它最为人称道的地方在于其动力单元。这台2.5L直列六缸1JZ-GTE引擎是经过进一步优化的第二代机型，具备可变气门正时技术，并搭载单涡轮增压器，可输出<280ps>/<38.5kgm>的动力和扭矩。搭配5速手动变速箱，踩下油门，涡轮增压瞬间爆发，伴随直列六缸引擎悦耳的咆哮。

在卓越性能之上，内饰也是意料之外的豪华与舒适，将驾乘者温柔环抱其中。

正是这种矛盾统一，让Tourer V独具魅力。它藏起锋芒，塑造出一副温文尔雅的绅士形象。但又凭借其突出的操控性能，让无数车迷为之狂热。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The third-generation Prius remained synonymous with hybrid technology. This iteration sought to elevate not only its environmental credentials but also the pleasure of driving itself. Its newly sculpted body featured a sleek, aerodynamic silhouette that conveyed a sense of motion even at rest. The engine was upsized to 1.8 liters, and more than 90 percent of the hybrid system components were newly developed. Fuel efficiency reached an astonishing 89.4 MPG, introducing a new dimension to the driving experience, one where performance met the pure satisfaction of exceptional economy.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 第三代Prius车型，混合动力汽车的代名词。这款车型不仅致力于提升环保性能，更注重驾驶乐趣的提升。全新车身采用利落的空气动力学造型，散发出强烈的速度感。引擎不仅扩大至1.8升，混合动力系统更是有超过90%的部件采用了全新开发的技术。在燃油经济性方面，这款车达到了惊人的2.7 升/百公里，为驾驶世界带来了全新品质——节油的乐趣。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Prius variant focused on both increased performance and delivering better overall driving pleasure.

The third-generation Prius, introduced at the 2009 North American International Auto Show, did not simply improve the environmental characteristics of its predecessor, it significantly raised the bar in terms of sportiness and the all-important fun-to-drive factor.

While the overall body style of the new Prius was defined by sharp lines and angles, making the vehicle more aerodynamic and better looking than the outgoing model, it also had a vastly improved drive system. A larger 1.8-liter engine was installed and more than 90 percent of the hybrid system was redesigned. And yes, it was more fun to drive than any Prius before it.

With an increase in the popularity of "green" vehicles in the global marketplace, the new Prius shattered its sales target goal of 10,000 units per month by selling 18,000 soon after its release. It continued to top the new-car sales chart for the next six months, all the way up to November 2009. Naturally, it was awarded Japan's Car of the Year for 2009.

The new Prius came in three trim levels of L, S, and G, with the G being the most luxurious, fitted with leather-wrapped steering and smart entry system.

long.zh:
2009年的北美国际车展上，第三代普锐斯首次进入大众视野。

丰田对第三代车型的改进不仅限于环保，还加入了对驾驶乐趣的探求。

技术方面，新车型的车身线条更直接，也更符合空气动力学规则。超过90%的混合动力系统被重新设计，引擎排量也相应扩大到了1.8升。这些改进不仅带来了全球最佳的燃油经济性数据：<38km/l>，也证明了在讲究环保的同时，驾驶乐趣并不会缺席。

数据证明，喜爱环保驾驶的新用户数量明显增长，在普锐斯原本月销10000台的基础上，新普锐斯发售第一个月就创下了18000台的销售纪录。而且高燃油经济性和驾驶乐趣成为了持续吸引用户加入的亮点，在2009年5月到2009年11月的6个月间，普锐斯一直稳居新车销售榜的榜首。因其对混动车市场的巨大带动作用，普锐斯还在2009年当选日本年度风云车。

在普锐斯推出的三款车型“L”，“S”和“G”当中，并无太多技术差异，只是在轮胎和部分配置细节上做出了区分。普锐斯的拥簇们倒是对猜测这些差异给能耗带来的细微影响乐此不疲。虽然代表普锐斯产品线最高等级的“G”系列配有真皮包裹方向盘和智能进入系统，以彰显品质，但从燃油经济性方面考虑，它却并非首选。

vehicleCollection.en:
An adventurous SUV for active lifestyles.

When it was introduced in 1994, the Toyota RAV4 pioneered an entirely new market segment, called the “crossover SUV.” Combining smooth off-road handling with a compact body, the first-generation model was widely praised for its ability to transcend the boundaries of on-road and off-road vehicles, and it continued to evolve with each successive generation. In 2018, the fifth-generation RAV4 was introduced on an all-new platform. Built on Toyota’s New Global Architecture (TNGA), it set new benchmarks for driving dynamics, safety, and comfort.

The Adventure grade, in particular, embodied the core spirit of an SUV. With its distinctive front grille, skid-plate bumper, and 19-inch tires, it projected rugged styling and a readiness to embrace the great outdoors. Its powertrain paired a 2.0-liter 4-cylinder Dynamic Force Engine with a Direct Shift-CVT, delivering smooth acceleration and impressive fuel efficiency.

Of special note was the newly developed Dynamic Torque Vectoring AWD system, which precisely controlled torque distribution between the left and right rear wheels, enhancing both traction and stability. A disconnect mechanism allowed the driver to disengage the rear-drive system entirely, improving fuel economy during everyday use.

On the safety front, Toyota Safety Sense came standard across the lineup, offering advanced features such as a pre-collision safety system, Lane Tracing Assist, and adaptive Radar Cruise Control. Additional amenities included a modern multimedia system with smartphone integration and a Panoramic View Monitor that provided a bird’s-eye view around the vehicle.

An ideal expression of the modern SUV, it excelled on city streets and natural terrain, infusing a sense of adventure into daily driving.

When it was introduced in 1994, the Toyota RAV4 pioneered an entirely new market segment, called the “crossover SUV.” Combining smooth off-road handling with a compact body, the first-generation model was widely praised for its ability to transcend the boundaries of on-road and off-road vehicles, and it continued to evolve with each successive generation. In 2018, the fifth-generation RAV4 was introduced on an all-new platform. Built on Toyota’s New Global Architecture (TNGA), it set new benchmarks for driving dynamics, safety, and comfort.

The Adventure grade, in particular, embodied the core spirit of an SUV. With its distinctive front grille, skid-plate bumper, and 19-inch tires, it projected rugged styling and a readiness to embrace the great outdoors. Its powertrain paired a 2.0-liter 4-cylinder Dynamic Force Engine with a Direct Shift-CVT, delivering smooth acceleration and impressive fuel efficiency.

Of special note was the newly developed Dynamic Torque Vectoring AWD system, which precisely controlled torque distribution between the left and right rear wheels, enhancing both traction and stability. A disconnect mechanism allowed the driver to disengage the rear-drive system entirely, improving fuel economy during everyday use.

On the safety front, Toyota Safety Sense came standard across the lineup, offering advanced features such as a pre-collision safety system, Lane Tracing Assist, and adaptive Radar Cruise Control. Additional amenities included a modern multimedia system with smartphone integration and a Panoramic View Monitor that provided a bird’s-eye view around the vehicle.

An ideal expression of the modern SUV, it excelled on city streets and natural terrain, infusing a sense of adventure into daily driving.
long.zh:
1994年问世的丰田RAV4荣放开创了“跨界运动型多用途汽车”这一全新的细分市场。首代车型的紧凑车身能提供顺畅的越野操控，因其突破公路与越野车型的界限而广受好评，并持续在此基础上不断进化。2018年，采用新平台的第五代车型发布。基于丰田新全球架构，这款车型在操控、安全性和舒适性方面树立了新标杆。

Adventure版本充分体现了运动型多用途汽车的核心特质。配备专属前格栅、防护板保险杠及19英寸轮胎，外观硬朗，彰显征服户外的决心。动力系统上搭载的是2.0升四缸动力引擎与直接换挡无级变速箱，可同时实现平顺加速与出色的油耗。

特别值得一提的是一套全新开发的动态扭矩矢量分配全轮驱动系统，可通过控制左右后轮扭矩分配来兼顾牵引力与稳定性。此外，它还配备了断开机构，可让驾驶者切断后轮驱动系统从而提升燃油经济性。

安全性方面，车型全系标配丰田智行安全套件，涵盖预碰撞安全系统、车道保持辅助及自适应雷达巡航控制等功能。车辆还配备了多项实用功能，如支持智能手机互联的多媒体系统，以及能提供俯视视角的全景模式影像监测系统。

作为理想的现代运动型多用途汽车，RAV4荣放能自由穿梭于城市与野外场景，为日常驾驶增添冒险乐趣。>

This car has the reputation of having a cute design.

strived to make the design extremely functional.

The end result is effective and quite pleasant.

Based on national automotive standards at the time, Toyota

It's also known as the "Yota Hachi."

Despite having a small engine, the car's look suggests
it drives in a spritely manner...

...with emphasis placed on aerodynamics and lightness.

..plaed a central role in this design.

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The Toyota Sports 800, affectionately known as the “Yota-Hachi,” was a compact sports car distinguished by its fixed B-pillar Targa-style removable roof panel. Extensive use of aluminum and acrylic throughout the body kept its weight down to just 1279 lbs. While its 750 cc engine produced a modest 44.4 HP, the car’s featherlight construction allowed it to reach a top speed of 96.3 mph—comparable to many 1.500 cc-class vehicles of its era.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 被昵称为“Yota-Hachi”的Toyota Sports 800是一款小型跑车，采用固定B柱式可拆卸车顶设计（即Targa顶）。车身大量采用铝合金和丙烯酸材质部件，将整车重量降至仅580 公斤。750 立方厘米引擎虽然仅有45 PS的功率输出，但凭借轻量化的车身，最高速度可达到155 公里/小时，这已经与当时许多1,500 立方厘米级别车型的速度相当了。
officialDetails.heroEn: With its wide tread and low center of gravity, the "Yota-Hachi" was a capable sports car.
officialDetails.heroZh: 被车迷爱称为“Toyota 8”的车型。宽胎搭配上较低的重心，在过弯时优势明显。

usedCar.en:
Toyota has produced some very cool sports cars over the years,
but one of the most memorable could be the Sports 800.

Introduced in 1965, it was called the "Yota-Hachi."

It was the first Japanese production model to feature aluminum
bodywork, so the car is extremely lightweight.

Weighing only <580kg>, it's half the size of today's cars.

While its air-cooled flat-2 produces only <45ps>, you can be
sure that it's a true sports car, thanks to its FR layout.
usedCar.zh:
Sports 800是Toyota跑车设计制造史上
一大杰作，诞生于20世纪60年代。

在日本，它以“Yota 8”的昵称
为人们所熟知...

Sports 800是首款采用铝制面板的
日产车型。

因此它的车身极为轻巧。

尽管它的风冷水平对置双缸引擎只能产生<45ps>的马力，
但它开起来就像是一辆真正的跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its wide tread and low center of gravity, the "Yota-Hachi" was a capable sports car.\

With its compact and lightweight body, the Toyota Sports 800 was one of the most admired sports cars of its day. It made its debut in 1965, and represented Toyota's first production sports car. Known in Japan as the "Yota-Hachi" a vernacular phrase for "Toyota Eight," it also was the first Japanese car to feature a targa top and removable roof panel.

As a sports car, it was cleverly designed. It aimed for simplicity rather than complicated mechanics, so many parts came from its popular boxy passenger-car, the Publica. The Yota-Hachi was smaller than the Publica, with an overall length of <3580mm>.

The engine was a <790cc> flat-2 with two carburetors helping it to produce <45ps>. Although it wasn't as powerful as other sports cars, its lean <580kg> curb weight allowed it to behave like a true performance machine on the road. The FR (Front engine, Rear drive) exhibited adequate punch off the line and was able to reach <155km/h>, performance comparable to cars with <1500cc> engines.

Thanks in part to the Publica's wide tread and low center of gravity, the Sports 800 demonstrated exceptional agility on the twisty stuff, with sharp turn-in response and near neutral handling balance. Its main rival was the Honda S800, and oftentimes, the Sports 800 battled the little Honda on both road and track.

long.zh:
丰田Sports 800，别名“约塔八”亮相于1965年，证明了轻量化和紧凑的尺寸才是跑车的关键要素。它还是全球最早一批采用车顶收起后仍然保留B柱的车型，这套敞篷系统在后来被统称为Targa顶棚。

这台跑车内藏着非常精妙的构思——遵循简洁的原则，避免使用任何复杂组件。其深层原因在于这台车的大部分零件都取自当时的经济型汽车帕布利卡。当你踩下油门时，就可以听到那台横置双缸风冷引擎发出耳熟能详的嗡嗡声和突突声，仿佛与它那圆润可爱的造型一唱一和。

撇开外观不谈，Sports 800最擅长的就是扮猪吃老虎。简单到极致的车壳设计，加上全车大量使用的铝制和亚克力零件，让全车车重仅有<580kg>——对于跑车来说实属不可多得的优势。<790cc>的引擎虽然在双化油器的帮助下也只能输出<45ps>的动力，却依然能跑出<155km/h>的最高时速，可以与现今的<1500cc>级别车辆相媲美。

21世纪的我们虽然都将“生态环境友好”和“环保”挂在嘴边。但其实远在1965年的先行者丰田Sports 800才是领先于时代的表率，并为我们留下了这台永不过时的设计。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In 1983, the Corolla and Sprinter lines largely transitioned to a front-wheel-drive layout, with the sole exception being the rear-wheel-drive AE86 variant—the Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno—affectionately known as the "Hachi-Roku." It was offered as a 3-door hatchback and a 2-door notchback coupe. Power came from a newly developed 1.6-liter DOHC 4A-GEU inline-4. While several rivals featured similar specifications, the Hachi-Roku continued to win over driving enthusiasts with its playful, rewarding handling.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: Corolla/Sprinter在1983年大部分改为前轮驱动布局，唯一例外是后轮驱动的AE86型Corolla Levin/Sprinter Trueno，也就是俗称的“Hachi-Roku”（86）。车身提供3门掀背和2门三厢斜背车两种版本。引擎为新开发的1.6升4A-GEU直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴型。虽然竞争对手也推出了相似规格的车型，但86至今仍因其趣味十足的操控体验而深受汽车爱好者喜爱。
officialDetails.heroEn: The tossable nature of this original hatchback 86 more than compensated for its lack of structural rigidity.
officialDetails.heroZh: 原版86掀背车，车身刚性欠缺的问题在怀旧面前就不再是问题了。

usedCar.en:
There were two versions of the Toyota AE86 that were released
at the same time: the Trueno and the Levin.

Do you know which was the more popular one? If you guessed
the Levin, you're absolutely right.

But this means that there are fewer used Truenos around today,
making them more of a collector's car than the Levin.

You can tell the difference between the cars by the headlights.
The Trueno has retractable ones, while the Levin's are fixed.

Under the hood is the 4A-G, a reliable 1.6-liter inline-4.

The front-engine/rear-drive sports car, or FR, weighs only
<900kg>, making it a fun car to toss around corners.
usedCar.zh:
哪一款AE86车型在发售时更受欢迎，
Trueno还是Levin？

不管你是否相信，Levin更受欢迎。
但不用为Trueno感到遗憾！

由于在发售之初缺乏人气，二手Trueno数量现在非常稀少，
如今已经成为了人们梦寐以求的收藏品。

Trueno的4A-G引擎是一款久经考验的1.6升直列四缸引擎...

它在过渡到更高转速范围时非常强劲
有力，也因此而闻名。

对于想要提高车技的车手来说，
Trueno作为一款车重约<900kg>的前置后驱跑车，正是他们的绝佳之选。

catch.en: The tossable nature of this original hatchback 86 more than compensated for its lack of structural rigidity.
catch.zh: 原版86掀背车，车身刚性欠缺的问题在怀旧面前就不再是问题了。

vehicleCollection.en:
The tossable nature of this original hatchback 86 more than compensated for its lack of structural rigidity.

Already considered a classic among enthusiasts today, this compact car has become a favorite for drifters and has been featured in movies and comic books. The car has its roots from the Corolla/Sprinter, but when this model changed its layout to FF (front engine/front drive), the sporty version in the lineup, the AE86 or Corolla Levin/Sprinter Trueno, remained as a rear-wheel driver.

The "86" (or Hachi-Roku, as it was called in Japan) developed an immediate following because of its rear-drive layout, lightweight, excellent handling and affordable price tag. It came in two shapes: a 3-door hatchback and a 2-door notchback. The main difference between the Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno was the front end, where the former featured a horizontal grille and fixed headlights and the latter no grille and retractable headlights.

Providing power was the newly developed 4A-GEU, a 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4. This engine featured some of the day's most advanced technology, including EFI-D (Electronic Fuel Injection-Druck), which calculated fuel amount through a pressure sensor, and the T-VIS (Toyota Variable Injection System). This helped the 4-cylinder to produce <130ps> and <15.2kgm> of torque.

It revved freely and quick, and demonstrated excellent throttle response, making the car wonderfully controllable through tricky corners. The suspension, body and engine worked harmoniously together to provide real sports car attributes. It was this performance and personality that made the "86" loved by so many.

It came in two shapes: a 3-door hatchback and a 2-door notchback. Providing power was the newly developed 4A-GEU, a 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4. This engine featured some of the day's most advanced technology, including EFI-D (Electronic Fuel Injection-Druck), which calculated fuel amount through a pressure sensor, and the T-VIS (Toyota Variable Injection System). This helped the 4-cylinder to produce <130ps> and <15.2kgm> of torque.

It revved freely and quick, and demonstrated excellent throttle response, making the car wonderfully controllable through tricky corners. long.zh:
1983年5月，丰田的主流热销车型卡罗拉/Sprinter进行了一次全系大改款，全面改为前置前驱车型。惟有运动车型保留了前置后驱的布局，它就是后来脍炙人口的“86”—AE86卡罗拉Levin/Sprinter Trueno。

作为最后一款轻型前置后驱车型，86立即变得炙手可热起来。在这其中，又可分为三门版掀背和两门版斜背。卡罗拉Levin和Sprinter Trueno的主要差异集中在车身的前半段，前者采用横向格栅和方形固定头灯，而后者没有进气格栅，但拥有上翻式头灯。

两者均采用新开发的1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸发动机4A-GEU，而且为了尽可能体现双顶置凸轮轴的效用，空气流量计被电子燃油喷射系统取而代之，后者可以根据压力探测器反馈的数据来计算喷油量。除此之外，进气口处还安装了丰田可变进气系统，帮助引擎输出<130ps>的最大马力和<15.2kgm>的最大扭矩。

轻盈小巧的引擎加上精准响应的转向为驾驶者带来难以言语的驾驶体验，尽管引擎动力不那么充沛，操控也不够稳定，但驾驶者能获得到随心所欲、车随心动的感觉。所以说，这是一台能让人“人车合一”的纯正前置后驱车。

在当时，虽然有同级别配置的对手虎视眈眈，86却赢得了大多数享受驾驶乐趣，欣喜于其操控体验的车迷的热烈追捧。在它之后，也涌现出了许多主打高性能的车型，但再难找到一款像86这般备受大众喜爱的车。

轻盈小巧的引擎加上精准响应的转向为驾驶者带来难以言语的驾驶体验，尽管引擎动力不那么充沛，操控也不够稳定，但驾驶者能获得到随心所欲、车随心动的感觉。所以说，这是一台能让人“人车合一”的纯正前置后驱车。

在当时，虽然有同级别配置的对手虎视眈眈，86却赢得了大多数享受驾驶乐趣，欣喜于其操控体验的车迷的热烈追捧。在它之后，也涌现出了许多主打高性能的车型，但再难找到一款像86这般备受大众喜爱的车。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: Originally introduced as a variant of the Celica, the XX evolved into a standalone model in February 1986 with the debut of the Supra. Among its various trim levels, the most celebrated was the high-performance 3.0GT Turbo A—built for championship homologation—featuring the turbocharged 3.0-liter 7M-GTEU engine, producing 266.3 HP. It also featured a wider body, matching the North American specification at 68.7 inches, along with reinforced suspension.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: XX起初只是Celica的一个改款，后来在1986年2月独立成一个车型，并获得了Supra的名号。在所有不同档次型号之中，人气最高的就是高性能的3.0GT Turbo A。这个型号是专为参加锦标赛而生产的认证车型，采用了一台270 PS的7M-GTEU 3升涡轮增压引擎。此外，它还采用了与北美规格车型相同的1,745毫米宽车身，外加一套加强型悬挂。

vehicleCollection.en:
This variant of the Supra was a homologation model with special equipment for Group A racing.

Using the popular Celica XX, which made its debut in 1981, as the foundation, Toyota decided to embark on making a true sports car that would challenge the best examples from Europe. And after much research and development work, the company introduced the Supra in 1986.

Intended mainly for the North American market, the Supra featured a double-wishbone suspension at all four corners, a first for the company since the 2000GT. The rear differential utilized a subframe to deliver sporty handling and a comfortable ride.

The new Toyota sports car was large for a coupe, measuring <4620mm> long, <1690mm> wide and <1310mm> high. It initially came powered by the 7M engine, a 3.0-liter turbocharged unit that produced <230ps>, with a twin-turbocharged <185ps> 2.0-liter inline-4 and normally-aspirated versions added later (<105ps> and <140ps>). But the most noteworthy Supra was the 3.0 GT Turbo A, which appeared in 1988. This model became the foundation for a race car that competed in the Japan National Touring Car Series. It used a 3.0-liter turbo engine that produced <270ps>., and it wore the same <1745mm>-wide body as the North American-spec model, with low-profile tires and improved suspension.

In 1990, this power plant was replaced by the 1JZ-GTE in the 2.5GT Twin Turbo R. The new engine cranked out <280ps>, which was the maximum allowed for JDM cars at that time.

Intended mainly for the North American market, the Supra featured a double-wishbone suspension at all four corners, a first for the company since the 2000GT. The rear differential utilized a subframe to deliver sporty handling and a comfortable ride.

The new Toyota sports car was large for a coupe, measuring <4620mm> long, <1690mm> wide and <1310mm> high. It initially came powered by the 7M engine, a 3.0-liter turbocharged unit that produced <230ps>, with a twin-turbocharged <185ps> 2.0-liter inline-4 and normally-aspirated versions added later (<105ps> and <140ps>). But the most noteworthy Supra was the 3.0 GT Turbo A, which appeared in 1988. This model became the foundation for a race car that competed in the Japan National Touring Car Series. It used a 3.0-liter turbo engine that produced <270ps>., and it wore the same <1745mm>-wide body as the North American-spec model, with low-profile tires and improved suspension.

In 1990, this power plant was replaced by the 1JZ-GTE in the 2.5GT Twin Turbo R. The new engine cranked out <280ps>, which was the maximum allowed for JDM cars at that time.
long.zh:
Supra是丰田的高性能GT，于1986年2月首次亮相。这款车脱胎自赛利卡系列，是1981年亮相的赛利卡XX（美国版Supra）衍生出来的车款。这原本是一款针对北美市场推出的长车头、掀背双门轿车，但随着日本跑车热的升温，这款车进一步进化成了高性能跑车。

Supra与Soarer共享平台，车身长<4620mm>，宽<1690mm>，高<1310mm>。4轮悬挂均为独立双叉臂式。这是自2000GT以来，丰田旗下车型首次采用这种悬挂布局。后差速器利用副车架来平衡驾驶性能与舒适性。

在最初推出的引擎阵容中，领衔的是7M型3升涡轮增压引擎，动力为<230ps>。此外还有<185ps>的2升双涡轮增压引擎、<140ps>的2升双顶置凸轮轴增压引擎，和<105ps>的2升双顶置凸轮轴增压引擎。此后，又有多款引擎加入了该系列。

这些车型中最受热议的是1988年发布的3.0 GT Turbo A。这款经过认证的车型用于参加全日本巡回赛车比赛的组别A比赛，采用动力高达<270ps>的7M-GTEU引擎。和北美规格的车型一样，这款车的车身宽<1745mm>，车身降低，使用宽度50mm的轮胎和经过改进的悬挂。

在1990年进行的一次重要小改款中，3升引擎从产品线中退出，顶级车型变为2.5GT双涡轮增压R，采用新的1JZ-GTE引擎。该车型的动力为<280ps>，达到当时日本汽车制造行业自己设定的最大马力限制。这使得Supra进入了超高性能跑车的行列之中，在服役的7年内，一直是丰田跑车车型中的王者。

collection.en:
The 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra is one of the most famous
race cars in the history of Japanese motorsport.

The All Japan Grand Touring Championship was a very
popular event in Japan from the late 90s to the early 2000s,

Featuring cars like the Nissan Skyline GT-R, the Honda NSX,
and of course, the Toyota Supra.

Nissan's GT-R had always dominated the series title
from the start of the championships...

And the first Japanese car that challenged and overthrew
the GT-R was this 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra.

The Supra would go on to win the All Japan Grand Touring
Championship four times in total.

But it's this iconic TOM's Supra that I remember most fondly.
collection.zh:
1997嘉实多TOM'S Supra是日本汽车运动史上最著名的赛车之一。

全日本GT锦标赛曾是90年代末期到2000年代初日
本非常热门的汽车赛事。

参赛车型包括了日产Skyline GT-R、本田NSX，
当然也少不了丰田Supra。

日产GT-R在赛事早期是最具有统治力的赛车……

且这辆1997嘉实多TOM'S Supra是最先向它们发起挑战
并夺走其统治地位的日本挑战者。

Supra在日后总计赢得了四次全日本GT锦标赛，

但给我留下最深刻印象的还是这辆标志性的TOM'S Supra。

catch.en: This car brought an end to the GT-R's domination by taking the title in 1997.!
catch.zh: 这台机器正是终结GT-R王朝的勇士。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car brought an end to the GT-R's domination by taking the title in 1997.!

As the most popular form of motorsports in Japan, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC) featured the country's top car makers doing battle on the country's most famous racetracks. The series was renamed the Super GT Series in 2005, with races held in Malaysia and China, expanding its appeal throughout Asia. So it was understandable that Japanese automobile manufacturers poured plenty of energy and resources into producing results in this racing series.

Toyota was among the early pioneers, whose Supra, running in the GT500 class, was the main challenger to the Nissan GT-R that had dominated the series for three straight years beginning with the first year of the championship in 1993. In 1997, the Supra finally dethroned the GT-R and became series champion with the number 36 Castrol Tom's Supra.

The winning car was piloted by Michael Krumm and Pedro de la Rosa, who began racing the Tom's Supra starting with the second round of that year. In their next five races, they won two races and placed 2nd and 3rd in two others to secure the championship. This was accomplished despite the fact that the car had not changed greatly from the previous year; the only differences were a switch from an "H"-pattern gearbox to a Hewland 6-speed sequential transmission, and lowering engine displacement to 2.0 liters to decrease weight. Still, the 3S-GT engine produced nearly <500ps>.

When all this was combined with better structural rigidity, an improved suspension system and better aerodynamics, the GT500 race Supra had no equals.

long.en:
As the most popular form of motorsports in Japan, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC) featured the country's top car makers doing battle on the country's most famous racetracks. The series was renamed the Super GT Series in 2005, with races held in Malaysia and China, expanding its appeal throughout Asia. So it was understandable that Japanese automobile manufacturers poured plenty of energy and resources into producing results in this racing series.

Toyota was among the early pioneers, whose Supra, running in the GT500 class, was the main challenger to the Nissan GT-R that had dominated the series for three straight years beginning with the first year of the championship in 1993. In 1997, the Supra finally dethroned the GT-R and became series champion with the number 36 Castrol Tom's Supra.

The winning car was piloted by Michael Krumm and Pedro de la Rosa, who began racing the Tom's Supra starting with the second round of that year. In their next five races, they won two races and placed 2nd and 3rd in two others to secure the championship. This was accomplished despite the fact that the car had not changed greatly from the previous year; the only differences were a switch from an "H"-pattern gearbox to a Hewland 6-speed sequential transmission, and lowering engine displacement to 2.0 liters to decrease weight. Still, the 3S-GT engine produced nearly <500ps>.

When all this was combined with better structural rigidity, an improved suspension system and better aerodynamics, the GT500 race Supra had no equals.
long.zh:
2005年，日本的GT系列赛事成为一项国际赛事并因此更名为“Super GT”。而在2004年之前，这项赛事被称为“全日本GT锦标赛（JGTC）”。从举办伊始，它就拥有全日本赛车运动最大的观众人数。也因此，日本的汽车制造商们都为这项锦标赛投注了大量的精力。

丰田Supra从1994年开始参加这项锦标赛，对从1993年首届锦标赛起便连续三年统治这项赛事的日产GT-R发起直接挑战。3年之后的1997年，Supra终于击败了GT-R，夺得了锦标赛的冠军。实现这一壮举的历史性比赛机器是36号赛车，嘉实多Tom’s Supra。

车手是迈克尔·克鲁姆和佩德罗·德拉罗萨，他们在当年比赛的第二轮才加入汤姆车队，担任二号车的车手。在随后的5轮比赛中，这台Supra的表现异常出色，两次摘得冠军，取得亚军和季军各一次，并最终赢得了系列赛的冠军。

这台车和前一年相比并没有太多变化。唯一的重大变化就是从H布局变速箱改为使用Hewland 6速序列式变速箱。除此之外，为了符合赛事规定，降低最小重量，引擎排量缩水到了2升。但这台3S-GT引擎依然可以输出接近<500ps>，而诸如对车身刚性的强化、悬挂系统结构的改动、空气动力学套件的改良，都只是一部赛车的标准进化过程。

啊，我以前见过这款车，是在《速度与激情》电影里。

dialogues.en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.

Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.

It was a time of ambition and decision.

There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.

Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the orld.

When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,

it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first
saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.<next id=2000206 type=9p

dialogues.zh:
日本在20世纪80年代经济蓬勃发展时期，曾短暂地为了世

在汽车行业的领导地位使其自然而然地产生了许多想法，

撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受{了全球车迷

那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新s感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的a莱斯勒时mJ乎i模一样。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: In May 1993, the Toyota Supra was reborn, shedding its long-nose silhouette in favor of a bold, muscular new design. At the heart of the twin-turbo 3.0-liter DOHC model was the legendary 2JZ engine, delivering 276.1 HP. The highest-grade variant came equipped with a 6-speed manual transmission and Bilstein suspension. Structural reinforcements, along with carefully tuned dampers and bushings, transformed the car into a refined high-performance machine.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 1993年5月，Toyota Supra重获新生，摒弃了传统的长车鼻设计，换上了更具魅力的肌肉形态。这个车型采用了著名的2JZ 3升双顶置凸轮轴双涡轮增压引擎，能够输出280 PS的动力。而最高档车型还搭载了一套六速手动变速箱和Bilstein悬挂。此外它还获得了结构强化，并对避震器和衬套进行了调校，让这只桀骜的野兽更易驯服。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Supra was all business, equipped with a 6-speed gearbox and Bilstein suspension.

Toyota took its flagship sports car, the Supra, in an entirely new direction when it introduced the second-generation variant in May 1993. This was evident from the car's unique exterior styling that featured a long nose, large fixed rectangular headlights and slim taillights on a round rear. It looked nothing at all like the previous model, or anything else on the road for that matter. It sat <120mm> wider and <100mm> shorter. Inside the cockpit was a snug 2+2 layout with the dashboard wrapping around the front-seat occupants.

There were two engines offered, a naturally aspirated and turbocharged version of the 2JZ. The base 3.0-liter DOHC inline-6 produced <225ps> while the turbocharged one cranked out <280ps>. A race version of this engine is said to produce <400ps> to <500ps>, so it was far from reaching its potential in the Supra, though many aftermarket tuners managed to reach that figure and beyond. The engines came mated to a 5-speed manual, 4-speed automatic or a new Getrag 6-speed manual gearbox.

The Supra's suspension consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, tuned to provide maximum cornering prowess. Thus, ride quality was on the stiff side, but this FR (Front engine, Rear drive) car possessed the best handling in its class.

1993年5月，丰田的GT跑车Supra在经过改款后，重生为全新的车款。

与原本强劲的美式肌肉车理念不同，丰田希望用新一代车款创造一种坚忍、有耐力的印象。长车头的设计被迷人的、阳刚的车身取而代之，宽度增加了<120mm>，总长度减少了<100mm>，使得该车拥有了更加理想的跑车比例。

内饰采用了简约的黑色，有五个独立的仪表盘，包括一个模拟时钟。

引擎仍使用一款简单实用的2JZ型3升双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，有双涡轮增压和自然进气两个版本。双涡轮增压版的马力为<280ps>，自然吸气版则为<225ps>。2JZ-GTE双涡轮增压引擎常常用作调试的参照，<500ps>规格的引擎十分常见。

变速箱有5速手动变速、4速自动变速和6速手动变速多种可选。传动系统则是与德国格特拉克公司共同研发的，与倍适登的悬挂一起搭配使用在SZ-R、RZ和RZ-S等耐力跑车款上。

悬挂采用和前一车款相同的4轮双叉臂悬挂，但尺寸和其他规格都经过了重新设计。多个部位的刚度都经过加强，避震和衬套经过调校后可控性得到显著提高。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The TS030 Hybrid was developed to compete in the 2012 World Endurance Championship. Its THS-R powertrain was the result of a collaborative effort between Toyota’s production hybrid engineers and the motorsports division at the Higashi-Fuji Technical Center, built around a newly designed V-8 engine. Although it was forced to retire during its debut at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the car went on to claim three victories over the season, ultimately securing 2nd place in the championship standings.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这辆TS030 Hybrid是专为参加2012世界耐力锦标赛所开发。它的“THS-R”动力系统由Toyota的量产混动开发团队与东富士技术中心的赛车运动部门合作打造，采用了一部全新设计的V8引擎。在参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的首秀中，这辆车不幸被迫退赛。但在接下来的整个赛季里，它夺得了3场胜利，并最终在排行榜上位列第二。

catch.en: The revolutionary hybrid-powered racing prototype that waged war at Le Mans and the WEC.

vehicleCollection.en:
The revolutionary hybrid-powered racing prototype that waged war at Le Mans and the WEC.

The TS030 hybrid prototype race car waged battle in the 2012 24 Hours of Le Mans and the WEC (World Endurance Championships) as one of the first hybrid-powered machines to step onto the international motorsports stage.

As its name suggests, the TS030 succeeds the TS010 and TS020, Toyota's awesome race cars that competed at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1990s. What sets the TS030 apart from its predecessors is its hybrid powertrain.

The THS-R system (Toyota Hybrid System-Racing) was developed by Toyota's production hybrid development team and the East Fuji Research Lab's motorsports department. The car utilizes a newly designed naturally-aspirated 3.4-liter V8 and a Denso motor unit built into the rear gearbox. Power is stored in an electric double-layer capacitor.

The drivers of the TS030 were Alexander Wurz, Nicolas Lapierre and Kazuki Nakajima. For the 24-hour race, a second car, driven by the formidable lineup of Anthony Davidson, Stéphane Sarrazin and Sébastien Buemi, was added.

At its first Le Mans race, the TS030 ran at the top of its class, but was forced to retire due to accidents and problems. However, the car made up for its shortcomings in the WEC. Of the six races the TS030 ran, it won three times, took three pole positions, and set four fastest laps. And although the car didn't partake in every race of the series, it still managed to take 2nd overall at the end of the WEC season.

long.zh:
TS030 Hybrid是由丰田研发的原型赛车，参加了2012年的勒芒24小时耐力赛和世界耐力锦标赛。

从其名称可以看出，这款车来自1990年代参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛的一系列车型，例如TS010和TS020，主要的区别就在于其使用了混合动力系统。

THS-R（丰田混合系统赛车）的动力系统由丰田量产版混合动力系统的研发团队与东富士实验室的赛车运动部门联手开发，使用了全新设计的3.4升V8自然吸气引擎。电量储存单元并非电池，而是一个双电层电容器。电装电机单元内置在后变速箱内。

驾驶这台赛车的车手是亚历山大·武尔茨、尼古拉斯·拿派尔与中岛一贵。在参加勒芒24小时耐力赛时，第二辆车的车组成员是实力强大的安东尼·戴维森、斯特凡·萨拉赞与塞巴斯蒂安·布耶米。

在其勒芒24小时耐力赛的首秀中，这款车排名一度靠前，但因事故和故障被迫退赛。但随后他们证明了这台赛车在勒芒表现出的速度并非昙花一现，从世界耐力锦标赛的第4轮开始不断创造佳绩。在参加的6站赛事中赢得了3站冠军，取得了3个杆位和4次最快圈速成绩。尽管并未参加全部的赛事，但依然在世界耐力锦标赛的总排行中位列第2。

他们的首个胜利直到2018年才姗姗来迟。

在此之前，这些赛车每每都展现出令人惊叹的速度，
但却始终无法将这种速度转化为胜利。

不过，期间也有过几次胜利触手可及的时刻——2016年，
领跑车阵的Toyota却在离终点只剩下一圈时抛锚了！

就连捡漏的Porsche车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。

不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！

dialogues.en:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans
since 2012...

...with its first victory coming in 2018.

While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year,
they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.

There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped
at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!

The victorious Porsche teamcouldn't believe its luck.

In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter.
I remember it clearly—I was so happy!

What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row,
its most recent win being in 2022!

dialogues.en:
The TS050 Hybrid is the pride of Japan, and one car that
I’d really like to take to the track!

2016 was the year that Toyota introduced the bright white,
red, and black colour scheme for its GAZOO Racing cars.

It was also the year that two TS050s faced off against
the Porsche 919 at Le Mans.

Tragically, a mere 6 minutes from the finish line, the lead
Toyota car suffered engine trouble and lost the race.

However, in 2018, 33 years after its first Le Mans appearance,
Toyota took home an incredible overall victory.

It was the first Japanese car to do so since the Mazda
787B’s win in 1991.<next id=1901006 type

TS050 Hybrid是日本的骄傲，同时也是我
非常渴望在赛道上驾驶的一款车！

2016年，丰田为旗下所属的Gazoo Racing车队引入了
鲜艳的白色、红色和黑色配色方案。

这一年也是两辆TS050与保时捷919在勒芒
展开激烈对决的一年。

不幸的是，距离终点仅有6分钟时，领先的丰田赛车却遭遇
引擎故障，输掉了比赛。

不过，在2018年，在距离首次亮相勒芒已经
过去33年之际，丰田却取得了令人难以置信的全面胜利。

这是继1991年马自达787B赢得比赛后，日本车队首次在勒芒夺冠。

officialDetails.descriptionEn: The TS050 - Hybrid was developed for competition in the 2016 World Endurance Championship. It featured motor generator units (MGUs) on both the front and rear axles, paired with a V-6 direct-injection twin-turbocharged engine. The combined output of the engine and electric motors reached 986.2 HP. While the car showed strong potential as a title contender, it ultimately finished 3rd in the drivers’ standings. It also secured 3rd place in the manufacturers’ rankings.
officialDetails.descriptionZh: 这辆TS050 - Hybrid 是专为参加2016世界耐力锦标赛所开发。这辆车安装有一部V6直喷双涡轮增压引擎，前后轴上还安装了电机发电机单元。引擎和电机的总动力输出达到了1,000 PS。这辆车来势汹汹，似乎对车手冠军头衔志在必得，但最终只在排行榜上屈居第三。而在车厂排行上，这款车也以第三名的成绩收官。

brandCentral.en:
This prototype, introduced at Le Mans in 2016, was yet another
effort from Toyota to grab that elusive title.

The naturally-aspirated V-8 of its predecessor, the TS040,
was replaced with a twin-turbocharged V-6.

In fact, almost everything, from the battery system to its
aerodynamics, was totally redesigned.

Although its <1000ps> power output was similar to the TS040,
the way it behaved on the track was totally different.
brandCentral.zh:
作为Toyota追逐胜利的最新尝试，这辆原型车在2016年勒芒耐
力赛上粉墨登场。

其前任车型TS040采用的自然进气V8引擎在这款车上被换成
了V6双涡轮增压引擎。

而事实上，从电池系统到空气动力学方案，车辆的每一
个方面都进行了重新设计。

它的输出功率虽然和TS040类似，都是<1000ps>，但驾驶体验却有
天壤之别。

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's hybrid LMP1 car was developed to dominate the World Endurance Championship.

The TS050 Hybrid was Toyota’s prototype race car, developed in 2016 to compete in the LMP1 class of the FIA World Endurance Championship, which included the legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans. Two years earlier, in 2014, Toyota had claimed the series championship with the TS040 Hybrid. By 2015, however, the team finished the season in 3rd place, prompting Toyota to design the TS050 from scratch to reclaim the top.

Like its predecessor, the TS050 was an all-wheel-drive hybrid, employing MGUs at both the front and rear wheels. But the powertrain switched from the naturally-aspirated 3.7-liter V-8 to a twin-turbocharged, direct-injection 2.4-liter V-6. Its supercapacitor system was replaced with a high-power lithium-ion battery, specially developed for racing and capable of rapid energy storage and deployment. The total system output stood at <1000ps>, equal to the TS040’s, but torque was significantly boosted thanks to turbocharging.

Further refinements included a more compact front MGU, which enabled aerodynamic redesigns to channel airflow more efficiently under the car, further sharpening its performance.

Toyota Gazoo Racing fielded two TS050 Hybrids in the World Endurance Championships. One car was piloted by Kazuki Nakajima, Sébastien Buemi, and Anthony Davidson, while the other was shared by Kamui Kobayashi, Stéphane Sarrazin, and Mike Conway. In 2016, the Kobayashi entry demonstrated blistering pace and remained in contention for the Drivers’ Championship, but in the end, the team concluded the season ranked 3rd in the Manufacturers’ standings.

long.zh:
TS050 Hybrid是一款原型赛车，由丰田于2016年研发，专为征战国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛勒芒原型车1组别而打造，著名的勒芒24小时耐力赛即为该组别赛事之一。在此之前的2014年，即两年前，丰田曾凭借TS040 Hybrid在该赛事中夺魁。2015赛季，丰田以年度季军收官。而TS050赛车就是为此全新研发，志在重夺冠军宝座。

与前代车型相同，这款赛车仍采用全轮驱动混合动力架构，前后轮均配备电机单元，但动力总成实现了重大革新：从原有的3.7升自然进气V8引擎升级为2.4升双涡轮增压直喷V6引擎。储能装置由具备快速充放电特性的超级电容器，更换为专为赛事研发的高功率锂离子电池，其能量存储密度显著提升。包括引擎与前后电机在内的系统总输出功率达到<1000ps>，虽然在参数上与TS040持平，但得益于涡轮增压技术的应用，扭矩输出获得了显著提升。

此外，前轮电机单元的布局更为紧凑，这一设计优化使得气流能够更有效地被导流至车底，从而进一步提升空气动力学性能。

丰田图像赛车车队派出两辆TS050 Hybrid赛车出战世界耐力锦标赛。其中一辆由中岛一贵/塞巴斯蒂安·布埃米/安东尼·戴维森执驾，另一辆则由小林可梦伟/斯特凡·萨拉赞/迈克·康威执驾。2016年，小林可梦伟所属车队展现出强劲的竞速实力，一度是车手总冠军的有力争夺者，但最终只以赛季总排名第三名收官，同时在制造商排行榜上同样收获季军。-
